# KRYPTON SCHOOL ERP — ACCESSIBILITY & UI/UX AUDIT REPORT
**Standard:** WCAG 2.1 Level AA Compliance  
**Application:** `apps/web` (Next.js 16.4 PWA Portal)  
**Portals Evaluated:** Super Admin, School Principal, Accountant, Teacher, Parent, Student, Driver

---

## 1. Compliance Audit Overview

The Krypton School ERP frontend was audited against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 AA) and mobile usability guidelines tailored for budget Android smartphones commonly used by parents and teachers across Kenya and East Africa.

---

## 2. Key Verification Findings

### 2.1 Color Contrast & Visual Design
- **Body Text:** Minimum contrast ratio of 4.8:1 achieved against light and dark backgrounds using tailored slate/indigo palettes.
- **Form Controls:** Inputs, borders, and active states maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 3.2:1 against background containers.
- **Status Badges:** Status indicators (`PAID`, `PENDING`, `OVERDUE`, `PRESENT`, `ABSENT`, `EE`, `ME`, `AE`, `BE`) utilize dual encoding (high-contrast background colors + text labels and icons), ensuring color-blind users can distinguish statuses.

### 2.2 Keyboard Navigation & Focus Management
- **Tab Sequence:** Logical top-to-bottom, left-to-right DOM tab order maintained across all 111 pages.
- **Focus Indicators:** Clear, high-visibility 2px focus ring (`ring-2 ring-indigo-500 ring-offset-2`) on all interactive buttons, links, inputs, and modal dialogs.
- **Skip to Content:** Direct skip-to-content links present on top layouts for keyboard navigation efficiency.

### 2.3 Semantic HTML & Screen Reader Support
- **Headings:** Strict single `<h1>` per page hierarchy with logical `<h2>` and `<h3>` sectioning.
- **ARIA Attributes:** ARIA live regions for dynamic alerts, M-Pesa payment progress bars, and modal overlays (`aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`, `role="dialog"`).
- **Form Labels:** Every `<input>`, `<select>`, and `<textarea>` is explicitly associated with an accessible `<label>` element.

### 2.4 Mobile Responsiveness & Low-Bandwidth Optimizations
- **Budget Hardware Performance:** Responsive layouts tested on 360px viewport widths (entry-level Android smartphones).
- **Touch Targets:** Minimum 44x44px touch target sizes for all interactive action buttons, preventing mis-taps.
- **Offline Transparency:** Clear banner indicators display network synchronization status (`Offline - Records queued for sync` vs `Synced with server`).

# ADMIN DASHBOARD - IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE ✅

**Project:** Krypton School ERP  
**Component:** Platform Admin Dashboard  
**Status:** Production Ready  
**Completion Date:** January 2025  
**Total Pages:** 7 (Login + 6 Admin Pages)

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Successfully implemented a complete, production-ready Platform Admin Dashboard for KryptonLogic to manage the entire Krypton School ERP SaaS platform. The dashboard provides Super Admins with comprehensive tools to manage schools, subscriptions, users, system health, and support operations.

### Key Achievements

✅ **7 Complete Pages** - All fully functional with elevated security  
✅ **Super Admin Access** - SUPER_ADMIN role validation with MFA support  
✅ **Multi-School Management** - Centralized control of all schools  
✅ **Revenue Tracking** - MRR, ARR, and payment monitoring  
✅ **System Monitoring** - Real-time health and performance metrics  
✅ **Production Quality** - Security, audit logging, confirmation dialogs

---

## IMPLEMENTED PAGES

### 1. ADMIN LOGIN PAGE
**Path:** `/admin/login`  
**File:** `apps/web/src/app/admin/login/page.tsx`

**Features:**
- **Security-First Design:** Dark gradient theme with red warning banner
- **Role Validation:** Explicit SUPER_ADMIN role requirement
- **MFA Support:** 6-digit code verification flow
- **Password Security:** Visibility toggle, secure input
- **Access Logging:** All login attempts monitored
- **Restricted Access Warning:** Legal notice for unauthorized access

**Security Measures:**
- JWT token with elevated privileges
- Role verification on backend
- Session tracking
- Failed attempt monitoring
- Automatic lockout capability

---

### 2. PLATFORM DASHBOARD
**Path:** `/admin/dashboard`  
**File:** `apps/web/src/app/admin/dashboard/page.tsx`

**Key Metrics Display:**
- **Schools:** Total, Active, Trial, Suspended
- **Users:** Total students and staff across platform
- **Subscriptions:** Active and expiring counts
- **Revenue:** MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue), ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue)
- **Payments:** Total revenue and pending amounts

**System Health Overview:**
- Real-time uptime percentage
- API response time (ms)
- Database status
- Storage usage (GB)
- Active users count
- Error rate monitoring

**Recent Activities Feed:**
- School creation events
- Subscription renewals
- Payment confirmations
- User registrations
- System alerts

**Alert System:**
- Priority-based badges (low/medium/high/critical)
- Subscription expiring warnings
- Payment failure notifications
- System error alerts
- Actionable items with "View Details" buttons

**Time Range Filtering:**
- Today
- This Week
- This Month

**Quick Actions:**
- Add new school
- Manage users
- View billing
- Generate reports

---

### 3. SCHOOL MANAGEMENT
**Path:** `/admin/schools`  
**File:** `apps/web/src/app/admin/schools/page.tsx`

**Features:**

#### School Listing
- Comprehensive table with all registered schools
- Search by name, email, phone
- Filter by status (Active/Trial/Suspended/Inactive)
- Statistics cards (total/active/trial/suspended)

#### School Information Display
- School name and address
- Contact details (email, phone, website)
- Subscription plan and status
- Student and staff counts
- Admin information
- Subscription expiry tracking with color-coded warnings

#### School Management Actions

# Digital Admissions & Lead Management CRM

**Implementation Status:** ✅ Complete & Production Ready  
**Date:** October 11, 2026  
**Module:** Krypton Admissions & CRM Suite (`@krypton/web`, `@krypton/types`, & `@krypton/api`)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

The **Digital Admissions & Lead Management CRM** enables schools to maximize new student enrollments, streamline parent applications, and manage lead conversions with an enterprise-grade visual pipeline.

It solves three critical bottlenecks in school admissions:
1. **Paperless Online Applications**: A frictionless, multi-step public portal for parents to fill child details and instantly upload birth certificates and student passport photographs.
2. **Visual 5-Stage Kanban CRM Board**: An interactive drag-and-drop pipeline for school administrators to track and advance applicants from initial inquiry to official enrollment.
3. **Automated Parent Communication**: Instant WhatsApp and SMS confirmations, interview scheduling invites, offer letters, fee receipts, and official student admission slips.

---

## 2. Five-Stage Kanban Pipeline

The admissions CRM enforces a 5-stage lifecycle matching standard school governance:

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[1. Inquiry Received<br/>പുതിയ അപേക്ഷ] --> B[2. Interview Scheduled<br/>അഭിമുഖം നിശ്ചയിച്ചു]
    B --> C[3. Accepted<br/>അംഗീകരിച്ചു]
    C --> D[4. Fee Paid<br/>ഫീസ് അടച്ചു]
    D --> E[5. Admitted<br/>ഔദ്യോഗികമായി ചേർത്തു]
```

1. **Inquiry Received (പുതിയ അപേക്ഷ)**:
   - Captures leads from the Online Web Portal, Front-Desk Walk-ins, WhatsApp Campaigns, and Referrals.
   - Verifies uploaded Birth Certificate and Student Passport Photo.
2. **Interview Scheduled (അഭിമുഖം നിശ്ചയിച്ചു)**:
   - Calendar date & time picker, panel/interviewer allocation, and campus venue or virtual Google Meet link.
   - 1-click WhatsApp interview reminder dispatch in Malayalam & English.
3. **Accepted (അംഗീകരിച്ചു / സീറ്റ് ഉറപ്പിച്ചു)**:
   - Admission committee assessment scores (e.g. 94/100).
   - Generates digital seat offer letter with deadline for fee payment.
4. **Fee Paid (ഫീസ് അടച്ചു)**:
   - Records admission and term 1 tuition fee payments via UPI, NetBanking, Card, or Cash.
   - Generates formal fee receipt number (e.g. `RCP-2026-4091`).
5. **Admitted (ഔദ്യോഗികമായി ചേർത്തു)**:
   - Generates official school admission number (e.g. `KPS-2026-1044`).
   - Assigns Class & Section (e.g. Grade 1 - Section B) and roll number.
   - Issues digital student ID and sends welcome kit confirmation to parent.

---

# Krypton School ERP - Complete API Reference

**Version:** 1.0.0  
**Base URL:** `http://localhost:3001/api/v1` (Development)  
**Production URL:** `https://api.kryptonschool.com/api/v1`  
**Interactive Docs:** `/api/docs` (Swagger UI)  

---

## Authentication

All endpoints (except public ones) require JWT authentication.

**Headers:**
```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Get Access Token:**
```http
POST /auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "admin@demoacademy.ac.ke",
  "password": "Admin@123"
}

Response:
{
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "user": {...}
}
```

## 1. Authentication (3 endpoints)

### POST /auth/login
Login with email and password.

**Request:**
```json
{
  "email": "admin@school.ac.ke",
  "password": "SecurePassword123"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGc...",
  "refreshToken": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": "user-uuid",
    "email": "admin@school.ac.ke",
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "role": "PRINCIPAL",
    "tenantId": "tenant-uuid"
  }
}
```

### POST /auth/refresh
Refresh access token using refresh token.

### POST /auth/logout
Logout user (invalidate tokens).

## 2. Students (8 endpoints)

### POST /students
Create a new student with guardian.

**Roles:** PRINCIPAL, SCHOOL_ADMIN

**Request:**
```json
{
  "admissionNumber": "2024/001",
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "dateOfBirth": "2010-05-15",
  "gender": "MALE",
  "currentClassId": "class-uuid",
  "currentStreamId": "stream-uuid",
  "guardian": {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "relationship": "MOTHER",
    "phoneNumber": "254712345678",
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "isPrimary": true
  }
}
```

### GET /students
List all students with pagination and filters.

**Query Parameters:**
- `page` - Page number (default: 1)
- `pageSize` - Items per page (default: 20)
- `search` - Search by name or admission number
- `classId` - Filter by class
- `streamId` - Filter by stream
- `status` - Filter by status (ACTIVE, GRADUATED, etc.)

### GET /students/stats
Get student statistics.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "total": 450,
  "active": 445,
  "graduated": 3,
  "transferred": 1,
  "withdrawn": 1
}
```

### GET /students/:id
Get single student details.

### PATCH /students/:id
Update student information.

### DELETE /students/:id
Soft delete student.

### POST /students/:id/assign-class
Assign student to class and stream.

### GET /students/:id/guardians
Get student's guardians.

## Error Responses

### Standard Error Format
```json
{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "Validation failed",
  "error": "Bad Request",
  "details": [
    {
      "field": "email",
      "message": "Email is invalid"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Common Status Codes

| Code | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|---------|
| 200 | Success | Resource retrieved |
| 201 | Created | Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request | Invalid input data |
| 401 | Unauthorized | Missing or invalid token |
| 403 | Forbidden | Insufficient permissions |
| 404 | Not Found | Resource doesn't exist |
| 409 | Conflict | Duplicate entry or constraint violation |
| 422 | Unprocessable | Validation failed |
| 429 | Too Many Requests | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | Server Error | Internal server error |

---

## Rate Limiting

**Default Limits:**
- 100 requests per minute per user
- Applies to all authenticated endpoints
- Rate limit headers included in response:
  ```
  X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
  X-RateLimit-Remaining: 95
  X-RateLimit-Reset: 1642345678
  ```

---

## Pagination

**Request:**
```
GET /students?page=2&pageSize=20
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": {
    "page": 2,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "total": 450,
    "totalPages": 23
  }
}
```

---

## Filtering and Search

**Common Query Parameters:**
- `search` - Full-text search
- `status` - Filter by status
- `startDate` & `endDate` - Date range
- `sort` - Sort field (e.g., `createdAt:desc`)

**Example:**
```
GET /students?search=john&status=ACTIVE&sort=createdAt:desc
```

---

## Best Practices

### Authentication
- Store tokens securely
- Refresh token before expiry
- Logout on sensitive operations

### Error Handling
- Check `statusCode` in response
- Display user-friendly error messages
- Log detailed errors for debugging

### Performance
- Use pagination for large lists
- Filter data server-side
- Cache frequently accessed data
- Implement debouncing for search

### Security
- Never log sensitive data
- Validate all inputs
- Use HTTPS in production
- Implement CSRF protection

# Government Module Integration Guide

## Quick Start Integration

### 1. Import the Module in Your Main App Module

```typescript
// apps/api/src/app.module.ts
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigModule } from '@nestjs/config';
import { BullModule } from '@nestjs/bull';
import { GovernmentModule } from './modules/government';

@Module({
  imports: [
    ConfigModule.forRoot({
      isGlobal: true,
    }),
    
    // Configure Bull for background jobs
    BullModule.forRoot({
      redis: {
        host: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost',
        port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT) || 6379,
      },
    }),
    
    // Import Government Module
    GovernmentModule,
    
    // ... your other modules
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

### 2. Update Environment Variables

```env
# .env file

# Encryption (REQUIRED)
ENCRYPTION_KEY=your-very-secure-encryption-key-change-this

# Redis (REQUIRED for background jobs)
REDIS_HOST=localhost
REDIS_PORT=6379

# Database (already configured)
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/school_db

# NEMIS Configuration (Optional - can be set via API)
NEMIS_API_URL=https://nemis.education.go.ke/api
NEMIS_SCHOOL_CODE=
NEMIS_API_KEY=
NEMIS_API_SECRET=

# KNEC Configuration (Optional - can be set via API)
KNEC_API_URL=https://portal.knec.ac.ke/api
KNEC_CENTRE_NUMBER=
KNEC_API_KEY=
KNEC_API_SECRET=
```

### 3. Run Database Migration

```bash
cd packages/database
npx prisma migrate dev --name add_government_integration
npx prisma generate
```

### 4. Start Redis (if not running)

**Using Docker:**
```bash
docker run --name redis -p 6379:6379 -d redis
```

**Or install locally:**
- Windows: Download from https://github.com/tporadowski/redis/releases
- Mac: `brew install redis && brew services start redis`
- Linux: `sudo apt-get install redis-server && sudo service redis-server start`

### 5. Start Your Application

```bash
npm run dev
```

## 📡 Using the APIs

### Example: Sync Students to NEMIS

```typescript
// In your service or controller
import { NemisService } from './modules/government';

@Injectable()
export class MyService {
  constructor(private readonly nemisService: NemisService) {}

  async syncToNemis(tenantId: string) {
    // Sync all students
    const result = await this.nemisService.syncStudentEnrollment(tenantId);
    
    console.log(`Synced ${result.succeeded} students`);
    console.log(`Failed: ${result.failed}`);
    
    return result;
  }
}
```

### Example: Register KNEC Candidates

```typescript
import { KnecService } from './modules/government';

@Injectable()
export class ExamService {
  constructor(private readonly knecService: KnecService) {}

  async registerForKcpe(tenantId: string, studentIds: string[]) {
    const result = await this.knecService.registerCandidates(
      tenantId,
      2024,
      'November 2024',
      'KCPE',
      studentIds,
    );
    
    return result;
  }
}
```

### Example: Generate Compliance Report

```typescript
import { ComplianceService } from './modules/government';

@Injectable()
export class ReportingService {
  constructor(private readonly complianceService: ComplianceService) {}

  async generateMonthlyReport(tenantId: string) {
    const report = await this.complianceService.generateEnrollmentReport(
      tenantId,
      'January 2024',
      2024,
    );
    
    return report;
  }
}
```

### Example: Schedule Background Job

```typescript
import { GovernmentSchedulerService } from './modules/government';

@Injectable()
export class SyncService {
  constructor(
    private readonly scheduler: GovernmentSchedulerService,
  ) {}

  async scheduleNightlySync(tenantId: string) {
    // This will be added to the queue and processed by background worker
    await this.scheduler.scheduleNemisFullSync(tenantId);
  }
}
```

## 🎨 Frontend Integration Examples

### React/Next.js Example

```typescript
// API client
import axios from 'axios';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: 'http://localhost:3000',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});

// Sync students
export const syncStudentsToNemis = async () => {
  const response = await api.post('/government/nemis/sync/students');
  return response.data;
};

// Get compliance dashboard
export const getComplianceDashboard = async () => {
  const response = await api.get('/government/compliance/dashboard');
  return response.data;
};

// Generate report
export const generateReport = async (data) => {
  const response = await api.post('/government/compliance/reports/generate', data);
  return response.data;
};
```

### React Component Example

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { syncStudentsToNemis } from './api';

const NemisSyncButton: React.FC = () => {
  const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);

  const handleSync = async () => {
    setSyncing(true);
    try {
      const data = await syncStudentsToNemis();
      setResult(data);
      alert(`Success! Synced ${data.succeeded} students`);
    } catch (error) {
      alert('Sync failed: ' + error.message);
    } finally {
      setSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <button onClick={handleSync} disabled={syncing}>
        {syncing ? 'Syncing...' : 'Sync to NEMIS'}
      </button>
      {result && (
        <div>
          <p>Attempted: {result.attempted}</p>
          <p>Succeeded: {result.succeeded}</p>
          <p>Failed: {result.failed}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default NemisSyncButton;
```

## 🔐 Authentication Guard Example

```typescript
// Add tenant context to requests
import { Injectable, CanActivate, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';

@Injectable()
export class TenantGuard implements CanActivate {
  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    
    // Add tenant ID from JWT token to request
    request.user = {
      id: 'user-id',
      tenantId: 'tenant-id', // Extract from JWT
      role: 'SCHOOL_ADMIN',
    };
    
    return true;
  }
}

// Apply to controllers
@Controller('government/nemis')
@UseGuards(TenantGuard)
export class NemisController {
  // ... controller methods
}
```

## 📊 Monitoring Dashboard Integration

```typescript
// Example service to get dashboard data
@Injectable()
export class DashboardService {
  constructor(
    private readonly nemisService: NemisService,
    private readonly knecService: KnecService,
    private readonly complianceService: ComplianceService,
  ) {}

  async getGovernmentIntegrationDashboard(tenantId: string) {
    const [
      nemisIntegration,
      knecIntegration,
      nemisSyncHistory,
      knecRegistrations,
      complianceAlerts,
      complianceReports,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      this.nemisService.getIntegration(tenantId),
      this.knecService.getIntegration(tenantId),
      this.nemisService.getSyncHistory(tenantId, 10),
      this.knecService.getRegistrations(tenantId),
      this.complianceService.getAlerts(tenantId),
      this.complianceService.getReports(tenantId),
    ]);

    return {
      nemis: {
        configured: !!nemisIntegration,
        lastSync: nemisIntegration?.lastSyncAt,
        status: nemisIntegration?.syncStatus,
        recentSyncs: nemisSyncHistory,
      },
      knec: {
        configured: !!knecIntegration,
        totalRegistrations: knecRegistrations.length,
        pendingPayment: knecRegistrations.filter(r => !r.isPaid).length,
        resultsAvailable: knecRegistrations.filter(r => r.resultsAvailable).length,
      },
      compliance: {
        activeAlerts: complianceAlerts.filter(a => a.status === 'ACTIVE').length,
        criticalAlerts: complianceAlerts.filter(a => a.severity === 'CRITICAL').length,
        pendingReports: complianceReports.filter(r => r.status === 'DRAFT').length,
        submittedReports: complianceReports.filter(r => r.status === 'SUBMITTED').length,
      },
    };
  }
}
```

## 🧪 Testing

### Unit Test Example

```typescript
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { NemisService } from './nemis.service';
import { PrismaService } from '@krypton/database';

describe('NemisService', () => {
  let service: NemisService;
  let prisma: PrismaService;
```

## 📝 Common Issues & Solutions

### Issue: Background jobs not running
**Solution:** Ensure Redis is running and accessible
```bash
# Test Redis connection
redis-cli ping
# Should return: PONG
```

### Issue: Encryption errors
**Solution:** Ensure ENCRYPTION_KEY is set in environment
```bash
# Generate a secure key
node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
```

### Issue: API calls failing
**Solution:** Check API credentials and network connectivity
```typescript
// Test API connectivity
const integration = await nemisService.getIntegration(tenantId);
console.log('Integration status:', integration);
```

### Issue: Sync failures
**Solution:** Run data validation first
```typescript
// Validate before syncing
const validation = await nemisService.validateStudentData(studentId);
if (!validation.isValid) {
  console.log('Fix these issues:', validation.errors);
}
```

import { Injectable, ServiceUnavailableException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from './database/prisma.service';

@Injectable()
export class AppService {
  constructor(private prisma: PrismaService) {}

  getHealth() {
    return {
      status: 'ok',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      service: 'Krypton School ERP API',
      version: '1.0.0',
    };
  }

  async getDetailedHealth() {
    const health = {
      status: 'ok',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      service: 'Krypton School ERP API',
      version: '1.0.0',
      checks: {
        database: 'unknown',
      },
    };

    // Check database connection
    try {
      await this.prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
      health.checks.database = 'healthy';
    } catch (error: any) {
      health.checks.database = 'unhealthy';
      health.status = 'degraded';
    }

    if (health.status !== 'ok') throw new ServiceUnavailableException('Database unavailable');
    return health;
  }
}

import { createParamDecorator, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';

export interface CurrentUserData {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  tenantId: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
}

/**
 * Decorator to get current user from request
 */
export const CurrentUser = createParamDecorator(
  (data: keyof CurrentUserData | undefined, ctx: ExecutionContext) => {
    const request = ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest();

File: apps/api/src/common/filters/http-exception.filter.ts
================
import {
  ExceptionFilter,
  Catch,
  ArgumentsHost,
  HttpException,
  HttpStatus,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Response } from 'express';

@Catch(HttpException)
export class HttpExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(HttpExceptionFilter.name);

  catch(exception: HttpException, host: ArgumentsHost) {
    const ctx = host.switchToHttp();
    const response = ctx.getResponse<Response>();
    const request = ctx.getRequest();
    const status = exception.getStatus();
    const exceptionResponse = exception.getResponse();

    const errorResponse = {
      success: false,
      message: this.getErrorMessage(exceptionResponse),
      error: {
        code: this.getErrorCode(status),
        message: this.getErrorMessage(exceptionResponse),
        details: this.getErrorDetails(exceptionResponse),
      },
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      path: request.path,
    };

    // Log error
    if (status >= 500) {
      this.logger.error(
        `${request.method} ${request.path}`,
        exception.stack,
        'HttpExceptionFilter'
      );
    } else {
      this.logger.warn(
        `${request.method} ${request.path} - ${status}`,
        'HttpExceptionFilter'
      );
    }

    response.status(status).json(errorResponse);
  }

  private getErrorCode(status: number): string {
    const errorCodes: Record<number, string> = {
      [HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST]: 'BAD_REQUEST',
      [HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED]: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
      [HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN]: 'FORBIDDEN',
      [HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND]: 'NOT_FOUND',
      [HttpStatus.CONFLICT]: 'CONFLICT',
      [HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY]: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
      [HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS]: 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
      [HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR]: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
    };

    return errorCodes[status] || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';
  }

  private getErrorMessage(exceptionResponse: any): string {
    if (typeof exceptionResponse === 'string') {
      return exceptionResponse;
    }

    if (exceptionResponse.message) {
      if (Array.isArray(exceptionResponse.message)) {
        return exceptionResponse.message[0];
      }
      return exceptionResponse.message;
    }

    return 'An error occurred';
  }

  private getErrorDetails(exceptionResponse: any): any[] | undefined {
    if (typeof exceptionResponse === 'object' && exceptionResponse.message) {
      if (Array.isArray(exceptionResponse.message)) {
        return exceptionResponse.message.map((msg: string) => ({
          message: msg,
        }));
      }
    }

    return undefined;
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/common/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts
================
import { Injectable, ExecutionContext, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { IS_PUBLIC_KEY } from '../decorators/public.decorator';

@Injectable()
export class JwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard('jwt') {
  constructor(private reflector: Reflector) {
    super();
  }

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext) {
    // Check if route is marked as public
    const isPublic = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>(IS_PUBLIC_KEY, [
      context.getHandler(),
      context.getClass(),
    ]);

    if (isPublic) {
      return true;
    }

    return super.canActivate(context);
  }

  handleRequest(err: any, user: any, info: any) {
    if (err || !user) {
      throw err || new UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired token');
    }
    return user;
  }
}

import {Injectable,CanActivate,ExecutionContext,UnauthorizedException,ServiceUnavailableException} from '@nestjs/common';
import {ConfigService} from '@nestjs/config';
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
@Injectable()
export class PaymentCallbackGuard implements CanActivate{
 constructor(private config:ConfigService){}
 canActivate(context:ExecutionContext){
  const secret=this.config.get<string>('MPESA_CALLBACK_TOKEN');if(!secret)throw new ServiceUnavailableException('Payment callbacks are not configured');
  const req=context.switchToHttp().getRequest();const token=req.query.token;
  if(typeof token!=='string'||Buffer.byteLength(token)!==Buffer.byteLength(secret)||!timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(token),Buffer.from(secret)))throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid callback credential');
  return true;
 }
}

File: apps/api/src/common/guards/roles.guard.ts
================
import { Injectable, CanActivate, ExecutionContext, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { ROLES_KEY } from '../decorators/roles.decorator';
import { UserRole } from '@krypton/types';

@Injectable()
export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private reflector: Reflector) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const requiredRoles = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<UserRole[]>(ROLES_KEY, [
      context.getHandler(),
      context.getClass(),
    ]);

    if (!requiredRoles) {
      return true;
    }

    const { user } = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();

    if (!user) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('User not authenticated');
    }

    const hasRole = requiredRoles.some((role) => user.role === role);

    if (!hasRole) {
      throw new ForbiddenException(
        `Insufficient permissions. Required roles: ${requiredRoles.join(', ')}`
      );
    }

    return true;
  }
}

================
File: apps/api/src/common/guards/tenant.guard.ts
================
import { Injectable, CanActivate, ExecutionContext, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { SKIP_TENANT_CHECK_KEY } from '../decorators/skip-tenant-check.decorator';

/**
 * Guard to ensure tenant context is set
 * Most endpoints require a tenant context
 */
@Injectable()
export class TenantGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private tenantService: TenantService,
    private reflector: Reflector,
  ) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    // Check if route should skip tenant check (e.g., platform admin routes)
    const skipTenantCheck = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>(
      SKIP_TENANT_CHECK_KEY,
      [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()]
    );

    if (skipTenantCheck) {
      return true;
    }

    const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    if (req.user?.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      return true;
    }

    // Require tenant context
    let tenantId = this.tenantService.getTenantId();
    if (!tenantId && req.user?.tenantId) {
      this.tenantService.setTenantId(req.user.tenantId);
      tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
    }

    if (!tenantId) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        'Tenant context required. Please access via school domain or subdomain.'
      );
    }

    return true;
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NestInterceptor,
  ExecutionContext,
  CallHandler,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { tap } from 'rxjs/operators';

/**
 * Interceptor to log all HTTP requests and responses
 */
@Injectable()
export class LoggingInterceptor implements NestInterceptor {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('HTTP');

  intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<any> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const { method, ip } = request;
    const url = request.path;
    const userAgent = request.get('user-agent') || '';
    const now = Date.now();

    this.logger.log(
      `→ ${method} ${url} - ${ip} - ${userAgent}`
    );

    return next.handle().pipe(
      tap({
        next: () => {
          const response = context.switchToHttp().getResponse();
          const delay = Date.now() - now;
          
          this.logger.log(
            `← ${method} ${url} ${response.statusCode} - ${delay}ms`
          );
        },
        error: (error) => {
          const delay = Date.now() - now;
          
          this.logger.error(
            `← ${method} ${url} ${error.status || 500} - ${delay}ms - ${error.message}`
          );
        },
      }),
    );
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/common/interceptors/transform.interceptor.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  NestInterceptor,
  ExecutionContext,
  CallHandler,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { map } from 'rxjs/operators';

export interface Response<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta?: any;
}

/**
 * Interceptor to transform all successful responses to standard format
 */
@Injectable()
export class TransformInterceptor<T> implements NestInterceptor<T, Response<T>> {
  intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<Response<T>> {
    return next.handle().pipe(
      map((data) => {
        // If data is already in the correct format, return as is
        if (data && typeof data === 'object' && 'success' in data) {
          return data;
        }

        // Transform to standard format
        return {
          success: true,
          data,
        };
      }),
    );
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/common/middleware/tenant-resolution.middleware.ts

import { Injectable, NestMiddleware, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';

/**
 * Middleware to resolve tenant from:
 * 1. Subdomain (e.g., demo.kryptonschool.com)
 * 2. Custom domain (e.g., www.exampleschool.ac.ke)
 * 3. JWT token (tenantId claim)
 */
@Injectable()
export class TenantResolutionMiddleware implements NestMiddleware {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async use(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
    try {
      let tenant = null;
      const host = req.hostname;

      // Try to resolve tenant from subdomain
      const subdomain = this.extractSubdomain(host);
      if (subdomain && subdomain !== 'www' && subdomain !== 'api') {
        tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({
          where: { subdomain },
          select: { id: true, subdomain: true, status: true },
        });

        if (tenant) {
          this.tenantService.setSubdomain(subdomain);
        }
      }

      // Try to resolve tenant from custom domain
      if (!tenant) {
        tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({
          where: { customDomain: host },
          select: { id: true, customDomain: true, status: true },
        });

        if (tenant) {
          this.tenantService.setCustomDomain(host);
        }
      }

      // Try to resolve tenant from explicit headers (for mobile/API clients and testing)
      if (!tenant) {
        const headerSubdomain = req.headers['x-tenant-subdomain'] as string;
        const headerTenantId = req.headers['x-tenant-id'] as string;
        if (headerSubdomain) {
          tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({
            where: { subdomain: headerSubdomain.toLowerCase().trim() },
            select: { id: true, subdomain: true, status: true },
          });
          if (tenant) {
            this.tenantService.setSubdomain(headerSubdomain);
          }
        } else if (headerTenantId) {
          tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({
            where: { id: headerTenantId.trim() },
            select: { id: true, subdomain: true, status: true },
          });
        }
      }

      // If tenant found, set tenant context
      if (tenant) {
        // Check if tenant is active
        if (tenant.status !== 'ACTIVE' && tenant.status !== 'TRIAL') {
          throw new UnauthorizedException(
            `School account is ${tenant.status.toLowerCase()}. Please contact support.`
          );
        }

        this.tenantService.setTenantId(tenant.id);
      }

      next();
    } catch (error: any) {
      next(error);
    }
  }

  private extractSubdomain(host: string): string | null {
    // Remove port if present
    const hostname = host.split(':')[0];
    
    // Split by dots
    const parts = hostname.split('.');
    
    // If we have at least 3 parts (subdomain.domain.tld), extract subdomain
    if (parts.length >= 3) {
      return parts[0];
    }
    
    // For localhost or single domain, no subdomain
    return null;
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import * as nodemailer from 'nodemailer';
import type { Transporter } from 'nodemailer';

/**
 * Email Template Type
 */
export type EmailTemplate = 
  | 'password-reset'
  | 'password-changed'
  | 'account-locked'
  | 'welcome'
  | 'mfa-enabled';

/**
 * Email Service
 * 
 * Provides email sending functionality for:
 * - Password reset notifications
 * - Account security alerts
 * - Welcome emails
 * - System notifications
 * 
 * Features:
 * - SMTP transport with configuration
 * - HTML email templates
 * - Fallback to console logging in development
 * - Rate limiting protection
 */
@Injectable()
export class EmailService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(EmailService.name);
  private transporter: Transporter | null = null;
  private readonly isDevelopment: boolean;

  constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {
    this.isDevelopment = this.configService.get('NODE_ENV') !== 'production';
    this.initializeTransporter();
  }

  /**
   * Initialize nodemailer transporter
   */
  private initializeTransporter() {
    try {
      const smtpHost = this.configService.get('SMTP_HOST');
      const smtpPort = this.configService.get('SMTP_PORT');
      const smtpSecure = this.configService.get('SMTP_SECURE') === 'true';
      const smtpUser = this.configService.get('SMTP_USER');
      const smtpPass = this.configService.get('SMTP_PASS');

      if (!smtpHost) {
        this.logger.warn('SMTP not configured. Emails will be logged to console.');
        return;
      }

      this.transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
        host: smtpHost,
        port: parseInt(smtpPort || '587', 10),
        secure: smtpSecure,
        auth: smtpUser && smtpPass ? {
          user: smtpUser,
          pass: smtpPass,
        } : undefined,
      });

      this.logger.log('Email service initialized successfully');
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to initialize email service', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send password reset email
   */
  async sendPasswordReset(
    to: string,
    resetToken: string,
    userName: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const resetUrl = `${this.configService.get('WEB_URL')}/reset-password?token=${resetToken}`;
    
    const subject = 'Password Reset Request - Krypton School ERP';
    const html = this.getPasswordResetTemplate(userName, resetUrl);
    const text = `Hi ${userName},\n\nYou requested to reset your password. Click the link below to reset it:\n\n${resetUrl}\n\nThis link will expire in 24 hours.\n\nIf you didn't request this, please ignore this email.\n\nRegards,\nKrypton School ERP Team`;

    return await this.sendEmail(to, subject, html, text);
  }

  /**
   * Send password changed confirmation
   */
  async sendPasswordChanged(
    to: string,
    userName: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const subject = 'Password Changed - Krypton School ERP';
    const html = this.getPasswordChangedTemplate(userName);
    const text = `Hi ${userName},\n\nYour password was successfully changed.\n\nIf you didn't make this change, please contact your administrator immediately.\n\nRegards,\nKrypton School ERP Team`;

    return await this.sendEmail(to, subject, html, text);
  }

  /**
   * Send account locked notification
   */
  async sendAccountLocked(
    to: string,
    userName: string,
    lockoutMinutes: number
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const subject = 'Account Temporarily Locked - Krypton School ERP';
    const html = this.getAccountLockedTemplate(userName, lockoutMinutes);
    const text = `Hi ${userName},\n\nYour account has been temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts.\n\nYour account will be automatically unlocked in ${lockoutMinutes} minutes.\n\nIf this wasn't you, please contact your administrator.\n\nRegards,\nKrypton School ERP Team`;

    return await this.sendEmail(to, subject, html, text);
  }

  /**
   * Send generic email
   */
  private async sendEmail(
    to: string,
    subject: string,
    html: string,
    text: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const from = `${this.configService.get('EMAIL_FROM_NAME', 'Krypton School ERP')} <${this.configService.get('EMAIL_FROM', 'noreply@kryptonschool.com')}>`;

      if (!this.transporter || this.isDevelopment) {
        // In development, log to console
        this.logger.log('=== EMAIL (Development Mode) ===');
        this.logger.log(`To: ${to}`);
        this.logger.log(`From: ${from}`);
        this.logger.log(`Subject: ${subject}`);
        this.logger.log(`Text: ${text}`);
        this.logger.log('================================');
        return true;
      }

      await this.transporter.sendMail({
        from,
        to,
        subject,
        html,
        text,
      });

      this.logger.log(`Email sent successfully to ${to}`);
      return true;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to send email to ${to}: ${error.message}`, error.stack);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**

   */
  private getPasswordResetTemplate(userName: string, resetUrl: string): string {
    return `

File: apps/api/src/common/services/redis.service.ts

import { Injectable, OnModuleDestroy, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';

// Use the Redis type from Bull's ioredis dependency
type Redis = any;

/**
 * Redis Service
 * 
 * Provides Redis client for caching and temporary data storage.
 * Used for:
 * - Account lockout tracking
 * - Rate limiting
 * - Session management
 * - Temporary token storage
 * 
 * Note: This service lazily imports ioredis from Bull's dependencies
 * to avoid adding it as a direct dependency.
 */
@Injectable()
export class RedisService implements OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(RedisService.name);
  private client: Redis | null = null;
  private Redis: any;

  constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {}

  /**
   * Initialize Redis client (lazy loading)
   */
  private async initClient(): Promise<Redis> {
    if (this.client) {
      return this.client;
    }

    try {
      // Import ioredis from Bull's dependencies
      const ioredis = await import('ioredis');
      this.Redis = ioredis.default || ioredis;

      const redisConfig = {
        host: this.configService.get('REDIS_HOST', 'localhost'),
        port: this.configService.get('REDIS_PORT', 6379),
        password: this.configService.get('REDIS_PASSWORD'),
        retryStrategy: (times: number) => {
          const delay = Math.min(times * 50, 2000);
          return delay;
        },
        maxRetriesPerRequest: 3,
      };

      this.client = new this.Redis(redisConfig);

      this.client.on('connect', () => {
        this.logger.log('Redis client connected');
      });

      this.client.on('error', (error: Error) => {
        this.logger.error('Redis client error', error);
      });

      this.client.on('close', () => {
        this.logger.warn('Redis client connection closed');
      });

      return this.client;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to initialize Redis client', error);
      throw new Error('Redis initialization failed. Ensure Bull queue is configured correctly.');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get Redis client instance
   */
  async getClient(): Promise<Redis> {
    return await this.initClient();
  }

  /**
   * Set a key-value pair with optional TTL
   */
  async set(key: string, value: string, ttlSeconds?: number): Promise<void> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    if (ttlSeconds) {
      await client.set(key, value, 'EX', ttlSeconds);
    } else {
      await client.set(key, value);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get value by key
   */
  async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    return await client.get(key);
  }

  /**
   * Delete a key
   */
  async del(key: string): Promise<number> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    return await client.del(key);
  }

  /**
   * Delete multiple keys matching a pattern
   */
  async delPattern(pattern: string): Promise<number> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    const keys = await client.keys(pattern);
    if (keys.length === 0) return 0;
    return await client.del(...keys);
  }

  /**
   * Check if key exists
   */
  async exists(key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    const result = await client.exists(key);
    return result === 1;
  }

  /**
   * Increment a counter
   */
  async incr(key: string): Promise<number> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    return await client.incr(key);
  }

  /**
   * Decrement a counter
   */
  async decr(key: string): Promise<number> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    return await client.decr(key);
  }

  /**
   * Set expiry on an existing key
   */
  async expire(key: string, seconds: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    const result = await client.expire(key, seconds);
    return result === 1;
  }

  /**
   * Get remaining TTL for a key
   */
  async ttl(key: string): Promise<number> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    return await client.ttl(key);
  }

  /**
   * Get all keys matching a pattern
   */
  async keys(pattern: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const client = await this.initClient();
    return await client.keys(pattern);
  }

  /**
   * Cleanup on module destroy
   */
  async onModuleDestroy() {
    if (this.client) {
      await this.client.quit();
      this.logger.log('Redis client disconnected');
    }
  }
}

        S3_REGION: 'us-east-1',

      return config[key] ?? defaultValue;
    }),

          provide: ConfigService,

File: apps/api/src/common/services/storage.service.ts

import { Injectable, Logger, ForbiddenException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { S3Client, PutObjectCommand, GetObjectCommand, DeleteObjectCommand, HeadObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { getSignedUrl } from '@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { createHash } from 'crypto';

export interface UploadResult {
  key: string;
  url: string;
  size: number;
  mimeType: string;
  checksum: string;
}

export interface PresignedUrlResult {
  url: string;
  expiresIn: number;
}

@Injectable()
export class StorageService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(StorageService.name);
  private readonly s3Client: S3Client;
  private readonly s3Bucket: string;
  private readonly s3Enabled: boolean;
  private readonly s3PublicUrl: string;

  constructor(
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
    private readonly tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {
    // S3 Configuration
    const s3Endpoint = this.configService.get<string>('S3_ENDPOINT');
    const s3AccessKey = this.configService.get<string>('S3_ACCESS_KEY');
    const s3SecretKey = this.configService.get<string>('S3_SECRET_KEY');
    const s3Region = this.configService.get<string>('S3_REGION', 'us-east-1');
    const s3UseSSL = this.configService.get<string>('S3_USE_SSL', 'true') === 'true';
    
    this.s3Bucket = this.configService.get<string>('S3_BUCKET', 'krypton-media');
    this.s3PublicUrl = this.configService.get<string>('S3_PUBLIC_URL', s3Endpoint || '');
    this.s3Enabled = !!s3Endpoint && !!s3AccessKey && !!s3SecretKey;

    if (this.s3Enabled) {
      this.s3Client = new S3Client({
        endpoint: s3Endpoint,
        region: s3Region,
        credentials: {
          accessKeyId: s3AccessKey || '',
          secretAccessKey: s3SecretKey || '',
        },
        forcePathStyle: true, // Required for MinIO
      });
      this.logger.log('S3 storage service initialized');
    } else {
      this.logger.warn('S3 storage not configured - file uploads will fail');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Upload file to S3 with tenant isolation
   * Files are stored with key pattern: {tenantId}/media/{category}/{year}/{month}/{filename}
   */
  async uploadFile(
    file: Buffer | Express.Multer.File,
    options: {
      tenantId?: string;
      category: 'photos' | 'documents' | 'videos' | 'exports' | 'imports';
      filename: string;
      mimeType: string;
      metadata?: Record<string, string>;
    },
  ): Promise<UploadResult> {
    // Get tenant ID (from parameter or current context)
    const tenantId = options.tenantId || this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    if (!this.s3Enabled) {
      throw new Error('S3 storage not configured');
    }

    // Generate S3 key with tenant prefix
    const now = new Date();
    const year = now.getFullYear();
    const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    
    // CRITICAL: Always prefix with tenantId for tenant isolation
    const s3Key = `${tenantId}/${options.category}/${year}/${month}/${options.filename}`;

    // Get file buffer
    const fileBuffer = Buffer.isBuffer(file) ? file : file.buffer;

    // Calculate checksum
    const checksum = createHash('sha256').update(fileBuffer).digest('hex');

    // Upload to S3
    const command = new PutObjectCommand({
      Bucket: this.s3Bucket,
      Key: s3Key,
      Body: fileBuffer,
      ContentType: options.mimeType,
      Metadata: {
        tenantId, // Store tenant ID in metadata for additional verification
        checksum,
        ...options.metadata,
      },
    });

    await this.s3Client.send(command);

    this.logger.log(`File uploaded: ${s3Key} (${fileBuffer.length} bytes, tenant: ${tenantId})`);

    return {
      key: s3Key,
      url: this.getPublicUrl(s3Key),
      size: fileBuffer.length,
      mimeType: options.mimeType,
      checksum,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get pre-signed URL for secure file download
   * CRITICAL: Validates tenant ownership before generating URL
   */
  async getPresignedUrl(
    s3Key: string,
    expiresIn: number = 3600, // 1 hour default
    options?: {
      tenantId?: string;
      responseContentDisposition?: string;
    },
  ): Promise<PresignedUrlResult> {
    // Extract tenant ID from S3 key (format: {tenantId}/...)
    const keyTenantId = this.extractTenantIdFromKey(s3Key);
    if (!keyTenantId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Invalid S3 key format - tenant ID missing');
    }

    // Get current tenant context
    const currentTenantId = options?.tenantId || this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // CRITICAL SECURITY CHECK: Verify tenant ownership
    if (keyTenantId !== currentTenantId) {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Cross-tenant access attempt blocked: tenant ${currentTenantId} tried to access file from tenant ${keyTenantId}`
      );
      throw new ForbiddenException('Access denied - file belongs to different tenant');
    }

    if (!this.s3Enabled) {
      throw new Error('S3 storage not configured');
    }

    // Verify file exists and metadata matches
    await this.verifyFileOwnership(s3Key, currentTenantId);

    // Generate pre-signed URL
    const command = new GetObjectCommand({
      Bucket: this.s3Bucket,
      Key: s3Key,
      ResponseContentDisposition: options?.responseContentDisposition,
    });

    const url = await getSignedUrl(this.s3Client, command, { expiresIn });

    this.logger.log(`Pre-signed URL generated: ${s3Key} (expires in ${expiresIn}s, tenant: ${currentTenantId})`);

    return {
      url,
      expiresIn,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Delete file from S3 with tenant validation
   */
  async deleteFile(s3Key: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<void> {
    // Extract tenant ID from S3 key
    const keyTenantId = this.extractTenantIdFromKey(s3Key);
    if (!keyTenantId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Invalid S3 key format - tenant ID missing');
    }

    // Get current tenant context
    const currentTenantId = tenantId || this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // CRITICAL SECURITY CHECK: Verify tenant ownership
    if (keyTenantId !== currentTenantId) {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Cross-tenant delete attempt blocked: tenant ${currentTenantId} tried to delete file from tenant ${keyTenantId}`
      );
      throw new ForbiddenException('Access denied - file belongs to different tenant');
    }

    if (!this.s3Enabled) {
      throw new Error('S3 storage not configured');
    }

    // Delete from S3
    const command = new DeleteObjectCommand({
      Bucket: this.s3Bucket,
      Key: s3Key,
    });

    await this.s3Client.send(command);

    this.logger.log(`File deleted: ${s3Key} (tenant: ${currentTenantId})`);
  }

  /**
   * Get file metadata (including tenant verification)
   */
  async getFileMetadata(s3Key: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<{
    size: number;
    lastModified: Date;
    contentType: string;
    metadata: Record<string, string>;
  }> {
    // Extract tenant ID from S3 key
    const keyTenantId = this.extractTenantIdFromKey(s3Key);
    if (!keyTenantId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Invalid S3 key format - tenant ID missing');
    }

    // Get current tenant context
    const currentTenantId = tenantId || this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // CRITICAL SECURITY CHECK: Verify tenant ownership
    if (keyTenantId !== currentTenantId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Access denied - file belongs to different tenant');
    }

    if (!this.s3Enabled) {
      throw new Error('S3 storage not configured');
    }

    const command = new HeadObjectCommand({
      Bucket: this.s3Bucket,
      Key: s3Key,
    });

    const response = await this.s3Client.send(command);

    // Verify metadata tenant ID matches
    if (response.Metadata?.tenantid !== currentTenantId) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Metadata tenant mismatch for ${s3Key}: key=${keyTenantId}, metadata=${response.Metadata?.tenantid}, current=${currentTenantId}`
      );
      throw new ForbiddenException('File metadata verification failed');
    }

    return {
      size: response.ContentLength || 0,
      lastModified: response.LastModified || new Date(),
      contentType: response.ContentType || 'application/octet-stream',
      metadata: response.Metadata || {},
    };
  }

  /**
   * List files for a tenant with optional prefix
   */
  async listFiles(
    tenantId: string,
    prefix?: string,
  ): Promise<Array<{ key: string; size: number; lastModified: Date }>> {
    // Verify tenant context
    const currentTenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    if (tenantId !== currentTenantId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot list files for different tenant');
    }

    // Build prefix with tenant isolation
    const fullPrefix = prefix ? `${tenantId}/${prefix}` : `${tenantId}/`;

    if (!this.s3Enabled) {
      this.logger.log(`List files requested for tenant ${tenantId} with prefix: ${fullPrefix}`);
      return [];
    }

    // Note: ListObjectsV2 is used for listing, but implementation would require pagination
    // For now, returning empty array as placeholder
    // In production, implement with ListObjectsV2Command and pagination

    this.logger.log(`List files requested for tenant ${tenantId} with prefix: ${fullPrefix}`);
    return [];
  }

  // ========== PRIVATE HELPER METHODS ==========

  /**
   * Extract tenant ID from S3 key
   * Expected format: {tenantId}/...
   */
  private extractTenantIdFromKey(s3Key: string): string | null {
    const parts = s3Key.split('/');
    if (parts.length < 2 || parts[0] === 'no-tenant-prefix' || !parts[0]) {
      return null;
    }
    return parts[0];
  }

  /**
   * Verify file ownership by checking S3 metadata
   */
  private async verifyFileOwnership(s3Key: string, expectedTenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const command = new HeadObjectCommand({
        Bucket: this.s3Bucket,
        Key: s3Key,
      });

      const response = await this.s3Client.send(command);

      // Verify metadata tenant ID matches
      // Note: S3 metadata keys are lowercased
      const metadataTenantId = response.Metadata?.tenantid || response.Metadata?.tenantId;
      
      if (metadataTenantId && metadataTenantId !== expectedTenantId) {
        throw new ForbiddenException('File metadata verification failed - tenant mismatch');
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.name === 'NotFound' || error.statusCode === 404) {
        throw new NotFoundException('File not found');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get public URL for S3 object
   * Note: This returns a direct URL, not pre-signed. Use getPresignedUrl() for private files.
   */
  private getPublicUrl(s3Key: string): string {
    if (this.s3PublicUrl) {
      return `${this.s3PublicUrl}/${this.s3Bucket}/${s3Key}`;
    }
    return `https://${this.s3Bucket}.s3.amazonaws.com/${s3Key}`;
  }
}

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { EncryptionUtil } from './encryption.util';

describe('EncryptionUtil', () => {
  let encryptionUtil: EncryptionUtil;
  let configService: ConfigService;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        EncryptionUtil,
        {
          provide: ConfigService,
          useValue: {
            get: jest.fn((key: string) => {
              if (key === 'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY') {
                return 'test-master-key-that-is-at-least-32-characters-long-for-security';
              }
              if (key === 'ENCRYPTION_SALT') {
                return '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef';
              }
              return null;
            }),
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();

    encryptionUtil = module.get<EncryptionUtil>(EncryptionUtil);
    configService = module.get<ConfigService>(ConfigService);
  });

  describe('encrypt and decrypt', () => {
    it('should encrypt and decrypt a simple string', async () => {
      const plaintext = 'Hello, World!';
      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);
      const decrypted = await encryptionUtil.decrypt(encrypted);

      expect(decrypted).toBe(plaintext);
    });

    it('should encrypt and decrypt sensitive credentials', async () => {
      const credentials = {
        apiKey: 'sk_test_1234567890abcdef',
        apiSecret: 'very-secret-passphrase-12345',
        passkey: 'bfb279f9aa9bdbcf158e97dd71a467cd2e0c893059b10f78e6b72ada1ed2c919',
      };

      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(credentials)) {
        const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(value);
        const decrypted = await encryptionUtil.decrypt(encrypted);
        expect(decrypted).toBe(value);
      }
    });

    it('should produce different ciphertext for same plaintext (unique IV)', async () => {
      const plaintext = 'same plaintext';
      const encrypted1 = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);
      const encrypted2 = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);

      expect(encrypted1).not.toBe(encrypted2);

      const decrypted1 = await encryptionUtil.decrypt(encrypted1);
      const decrypted2 = await encryptionUtil.decrypt(encrypted2);

      expect(decrypted1).toBe(plaintext);
      expect(decrypted2).toBe(plaintext);
    });

    it('should handle special characters and unicode', async () => {
      const plaintext = '🔐 Special: !@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:",.<>?/~` Unicode: 你好世界';
      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);
      const decrypted = await encryptionUtil.decrypt(encrypted);

      expect(decrypted).toBe(plaintext);
    });

    it('should handle long strings', async () => {
      const plaintext = 'A'.repeat(10000);
      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);
      const decrypted = await encryptionUtil.decrypt(encrypted);

      expect(decrypted).toBe(plaintext);
    });

    it('should throw error for empty plaintext', async () => {
      await expect(encryptionUtil.encrypt('')).rejects.toThrow(
        'Cannot encrypt empty value'
      );
    });

    it('should throw error for empty ciphertext', async () => {
      await expect(encryptionUtil.decrypt('')).rejects.toThrow(
        'Cannot decrypt empty value'
      );
    });

    it('should throw error for invalid encrypted format', async () => {
      await expect(encryptionUtil.decrypt('invalid-format')).rejects.toThrow(
        'Invalid encrypted format'
      );
    });

    it('should throw error for tampered data', async () => {
      const plaintext = 'original text';
      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);

      // Tamper with the encrypted data
      const [iv, authTag, data] = encrypted.split(':');
      const tamperedData = data.slice(0, -4) + 'XXXX';
      const tampered = `${iv}:${authTag}:${tamperedData}`;

      await expect(encryptionUtil.decrypt(tampered)).rejects.toThrow();
    });

    it('should throw error for tampered auth tag', async () => {
      const plaintext = 'original text';
      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);

      // Tamper with the auth tag
      const [iv, authTag, data] = encrypted.split(':');
      const tamperedAuthTag = authTag.slice(0, -4) + 'XXXX';
      const tampered = `${iv}:${tamperedAuthTag}:${data}`;

      await expect(encryptionUtil.decrypt(tampered)).rejects.toThrow();
    });
  });

  describe('encryptMany and decryptMany', () => {
    it('should encrypt multiple values', async () => {
      const values = {
        key1: 'value1',
        key2: 'value2',
        key3: 'value3',
      };

      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encryptMany(values);

      expect(Object.keys(encrypted)).toEqual(['key1', 'key2', 'key3']);
      expect(encrypted.key1).not.toBe(values.key1);
      expect(encrypted.key2).not.toBe(values.key2);
      expect(encrypted.key3).not.toBe(values.key3);

      const decrypted = await encryptionUtil.decryptMany(encrypted);

      expect(decrypted).toEqual(values);
    });

    it('should handle empty values in batch encryption', async () => {
      const values = {
        key1: 'value1',
        key2: '',
        key3: 'value3',
      };

      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encryptMany(values);

      expect(encrypted.key1).toBeTruthy();
      expect(encrypted.key2).toBeFalsy();
      expect(encrypted.key3).toBeTruthy();
    });
  });

  describe('isEncrypted', () => {
    it('should detect encrypted values', async () => {
      const plaintext = 'test value';
      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);

      expect(encryptionUtil.isEncrypted(encrypted)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should detect non-encrypted values', () => {
      expect(encryptionUtil.isEncrypted('plain text')).toBe(false);
      expect(encryptionUtil.isEncrypted('base64string==')).toBe(false);
      expect(encryptionUtil.isEncrypted('')).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('migrateFromBase64', () => {
    it('should migrate base64-encoded value to encrypted', async () => {
      const originalValue = 'secret-api-key';
      const base64Value = Buffer.from(originalValue).toString('base64');

      const migrated = await encryptionUtil.migrateFromBase64(base64Value);

      expect(migrated).not.toBe(base64Value);
      expect(encryptionUtil.isEncrypted(migrated!)).toBe(true);

      const decrypted = await encryptionUtil.decrypt(migrated!);
      expect(decrypted).toBe(originalValue);
    });

    it('should not re-encrypt already encrypted values', async () => {
      const plaintext = 'already encrypted value';
      const encrypted = await encryptionUtil.encrypt(plaintext);

      const migrated = await encryptionUtil.migrateFromBase64(encrypted);

      expect(migrated).toBe(encrypted);
    });

    it('should handle null values', async () => {
      const migrated = await encryptionUtil.migrateFromBase64(null);
      expect(migrated).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('key initialization', () => {
    it('should throw error if ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY not set', async () => {
      const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
        providers: [
          EncryptionUtil,
          {
            provide: ConfigService,
            useValue: {
              get: jest.fn(() => null),
            },
          },
        ],
      }).compile();

      const util = module.get<EncryptionUtil>(EncryptionUtil);

      await expect(util.encrypt('test')).rejects.toThrow(
        'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY not configured'
      );
    });

    it('should throw error if ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY too short', async () => {
      const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
        providers: [
          EncryptionUtil,
          {
            provide: ConfigService,
            useValue: {
              get: jest.fn((key: string) => {
                if (key === 'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY') return 'short';
                return null;
              }),
            },
          },
        ],
      }).compile();

      const util = module.get<EncryptionUtil>(EncryptionUtil);

      await expect(util.encrypt('test')).rejects.toThrow(
        'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY must be at least 32 characters'
      );
    });
  });

  describe('static utility methods', () => {
    it('should generate valid master key', () => {
      const masterKey = EncryptionUtil.generateMasterKey();

      expect(masterKey).toHaveLength(64); // 32 bytes = 64 hex chars
      expect(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(masterKey)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should generate valid salt', () => {
      const salt = EncryptionUtil.generateSalt();

      expect(salt).toHaveLength(64); // 32 bytes = 64 hex chars
      expect(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(salt)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should generate unique keys', () => {
      const key1 = EncryptionUtil.generateMasterKey();
      const key2 = EncryptionUtil.generateMasterKey();

      expect(key1).not.toBe(key2);
    });
  });
});

File: apps/api/src/common/utils/encryption.util.ts

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';

/**
 * AES-256-GCM Encryption Utility
 * 
 * Provides secure encryption/decryption for sensitive credentials such as:
 * - M-Pesa API keys and secrets
 * - NEMIS API credentials
 * - KNEC API credentials
 * - Other sensitive school configuration
 * 
 * Security Features:
 * - AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption
 * - Unique IV (initialization vector) per encryption
 * - Authentication tag for integrity verification
 * - Key derivation from master key using scrypt
 * - Base64 encoding for storage compatibility
 * 
 * Format: {iv}:{authTag}:{encryptedData} (all base64 encoded)
 */
@Injectable()
export class EncryptionUtil {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(EncryptionUtil.name);
  private readonly algorithm = 'aes-256-gcm';
  private readonly ivLength = 16; // 128 bits for GCM
  private readonly authTagLength = 16; // 128 bits authentication tag
  private readonly saltLength = 32; // 256 bits salt for key derivation
  private readonly keyLength = 32; // 256 bits key
  private readonly scryptCost = 16384; // N parameter for scrypt (CPU/memory cost)
  
  private encryptionKey: Buffer | null = null;
  private salt: Buffer | null = null;

  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {}

  /**
   * Initialize encryption key from environment
   * Must be called before encrypt/decrypt operations
   */
  private async ensureKeyInitialized(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.encryptionKey) {
      return;
    }

    const masterKey = this.configService.get<string>('ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY');
    
    if (!masterKey) {
      throw new Error(
        'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY not configured. Please set this environment variable to a secure random string (minimum 32 characters).'
      );
    }

    if (masterKey.length < 32) {
      throw new Error(
        'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY must be at least 32 characters long for security.'
      );
    }

    // Get or generate salt
    const saltConfig = this.configService.get<string>('ENCRYPTION_SALT');
    
    if (saltConfig) {
      // Use configured salt
      this.salt = Buffer.from(saltConfig, 'hex');
      
      if (this.salt.length !== this.saltLength) {
        throw new Error(
          `ENCRYPTION_SALT must be ${this.saltLength * 2} hex characters (${this.saltLength} bytes)`
        );
      }
    } else {
      // Generate salt (should be done once and stored in config)
      this.salt = crypto.randomBytes(this.saltLength);
      this.logger.warn(
        `ENCRYPTION_SALT not configured. Generated salt: ${this.salt.toString('hex')}. ` +
        'IMPORTANT: Add this to your .env file as ENCRYPTION_SALT to ensure data can be decrypted after restart.'
      );
    }

    // Derive encryption key using scrypt
    this.encryptionKey = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      crypto.scrypt(
        masterKey,
        this.salt!,  // Non-null assertion since we validated above
        this.keyLength,
        { N: this.scryptCost },
        (err, derivedKey) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(derivedKey);
        }
      );
    });

    this.logger.log('Encryption key initialized successfully');
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt a string value
   * 
   * @param plaintext - The string to encrypt
   * @returns Encrypted string in format: {iv}:{authTag}:{encryptedData}
   * @throws Error if encryption fails or key not initialized
   */
  async encrypt(plaintext: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!plaintext) {
      throw new Error('Cannot encrypt empty value');
    }

    await this.ensureKeyInitialized();

    try {
      // Generate unique IV for this encryption
      const iv = crypto.randomBytes(this.ivLength);

      // Create cipher
      const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(
        this.algorithm,
        this.encryptionKey!,
        iv,
        { authTagLength: this.authTagLength }
      );

      // Encrypt
      let encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8', 'base64');
      encrypted += cipher.final('base64');

      // Get authentication tag
      const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();

      // Return as base64-encoded string: iv:authTag:encrypted
      return [
        iv.toString('base64'),
        authTag.toString('base64'),
        encrypted,
      ].join(':');
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Encryption failed', error);
      throw new Error(`Encryption failed: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt an encrypted string
   * 
   * @param encrypted - Encrypted string in format: {iv}:{authTag}:{encryptedData}
   * @returns Decrypted plaintext string
   * @throws Error if decryption fails, data is tampered, or format is invalid
   */
  async decrypt(encrypted: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!encrypted) {
      throw new Error('Cannot decrypt empty value');
    }

    await this.ensureKeyInitialized();

    try {
      // Parse encrypted format
      const parts = encrypted.split(':');
      
      if (parts.length !== 3) {
        throw new Error(
          'Invalid encrypted format. Expected format: {iv}:{authTag}:{encryptedData}'
        );
      }

      const [ivBase64, authTagBase64, encryptedData] = parts;

      // Decode components
      const iv = Buffer.from(ivBase64, 'base64');
      const authTag = Buffer.from(authTagBase64, 'base64');

      // Validate lengths
      if (iv.length !== this.ivLength) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid IV length: expected ${this.ivLength}, got ${iv.length}`);
      }

      if (authTag.length !== this.authTagLength) {
        throw new Error(
          `Invalid auth tag length: expected ${this.authTagLength}, got ${authTag.length}`
        );
      }

      // Create decipher
      const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(
        this.algorithm,
        this.encryptionKey!,
        iv,
        { authTagLength: this.authTagLength }
      );

      // Set authentication tag
      decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);

      // Decrypt
      let decrypted = decipher.update(encryptedData, 'base64', 'utf8');
      decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');

      return decrypted;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Decryption failed', error);
      
      // More specific error for authentication failures (tampered data)
      if (error.message?.includes('Unsupported state or unable to authenticate data')) {
        throw new Error(
          'Decryption failed: Data has been tampered with or encryption key has changed'
        );
      }

      throw new Error(`Decryption failed: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt multiple values at once
   * Useful for batch encryption operations
   */
  async encryptMany(values: Record<string, string>): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
    const encrypted: Record<string, string> = {};

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
      if (value) {
        encrypted[key] = await this.encrypt(value);
      }
    }

    return encrypted;
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt multiple values at once
   * Useful for batch decryption operations
   */
  async decryptMany(values: Record<string, string>): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
    const decrypted: Record<string, string> = {};

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
      if (value) {
        try {
          decrypted[key] = await this.decrypt(value);
        } catch (error: any) {
          this.logger.error(`Failed to decrypt value for key: ${key}`, error);
          // Continue with other values
          decrypted[key] = '';
        }
      }
    }

    return decrypted;
  }

  /**
   * Check if a string is encrypted (has the expected format)
   * Useful for migration from base64 to AES-256-GCM
   */
  isEncrypted(value: string): boolean {
    if (!value) return false;

    const parts = value.split(':');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return false;

    try {
      // Check if parts are valid base64
      Buffer.from(parts[0], 'base64');
      Buffer.from(parts[1], 'base64');
      Buffer.from(parts[2], 'base64');
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Migrate from base64 encoding to AES-256-GCM encryption
   * Detects if value is already encrypted or needs migration
   */
  async migrateFromBase64(value: string | null): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!value) return null;

    // If already encrypted, return as-is
    if (this.isEncrypted(value)) {
      return value;
    }

    // Otherwise, assume it's base64-encoded and migrate
    try {
      const decoded = Buffer.from(value, 'base64').toString('utf8');
      return await this.encrypt(decoded);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.warn(`Failed to migrate value from base64: ${error.message}`);
      // If decode fails, try encrypting the value as-is (might be plain text)
      return await this.encrypt(value);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generate a secure random encryption master key
   * Use this to generate ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY for .env
   */
  static generateMasterKey(): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Generate a secure random salt
   * Use this to generate ENCRYPTION_SALT for .env
   */
  static generateSalt(): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  }
}

export function validateEnvironment(env:Record<string,unknown>){
 const required=['DATABASE_URL','JWT_SECRET','JWT_REFRESH_SECRET'];
 for(const key of required)if(typeof env[key]!=='string'||!env[key])throw new Error(key+' must be configured');
 if(env.NODE_ENV==='production'){
  for(const key of ['JWT_SECRET','JWT_REFRESH_SECRET'])if(String(env[key]).length<32||/change-this|your-|example/i.test(String(env[key])))throw new Error(key+' must be an independent random secret of at least 32 characters');
  if(env.JWT_SECRET===env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET)throw new Error('Access and refresh secrets must differ');
  if(!env.CORS_ORIGIN||String(env.CORS_ORIGIN).includes('*')||!String(env.CORS_ORIGIN).split(',').every(o=>o.trim().startsWith('https://')))throw new Error('CORS_ORIGIN must list explicit HTTPS origins');
 }
 return env;
}

import { Injectable, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaClient } from '@krypton/database';
import { createTenantFilterMiddleware } from '@krypton/database';
import { TenantService } from './tenant.service';

@Injectable()
export class PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PrismaService.name);

  constructor(private tenantService: TenantService) {
    super({
      log: [
        { level: 'query', emit: 'event' },
        { level: 'error', emit: 'stdout' },
        { level: 'warn', emit: 'stdout' },
      ],
    });

    // Set up tenant filtering middleware
    this.$use(
      createTenantFilterMiddleware(() => {
        return this.tenantService.getTenantId();
      })
    );

    // Log queries in development
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      // @ts-ignore
      this.$on('query' as never, (e: { query: string; duration: number }) => {
        this.logger.debug(`Query: ${e.query}`);
        this.logger.debug(`Duration: ${e.duration}ms`);
      });
    }
  }

  async onModuleInit() {
    try {
      await this.$connect();
      this.logger.log('✅ Database connected successfully');
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('❌ Database connection failed', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async onModuleDestroy() {
    await this.$disconnect();
    this.logger.log('Database disconnected');
  }

  /**
   * Execute query without tenant filter (for platform admin operations)
   */
  async executeWithoutTenantFilter<T>(operation: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const currentTenantId = this.tenantService.getTenantId();
    
    try {
      // Temporarily clear tenant context
      this.tenantService.setTenantId(null);
      return await operation();
    } finally {
      // Restore tenant context
      this.tenantService.setTenantId(currentTenantId);
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks';
interface TenantContext { tenantId: string | null; subdomain: string | null; customDomain: string | null }
@Injectable()
export class TenantService {
 private readonly storage = new AsyncLocalStorage<TenantContext>();
 run<T>(operation:()=>T):T {return this.storage.run({tenantId:null,subdomain:null,customDomain:null},operation);}
 private context(){const value=this.storage.getStore();if(!value)throw new Error('Tenant request context is not initialized');return value;}
 setTenantId(id:string|null){const store=this.storage.getStore();if(store){store.tenantId=id;}else{this.storage.enterWith({tenantId:id,subdomain:null,customDomain:null});}}
 getTenantId(){return this.storage.getStore()?.tenantId||null;}
 setSubdomain(value:string|null){this.context().subdomain=value;}
 getSubdomain(){return this.storage.getStore()?.subdomain||null;}
 setCustomDomain(value:string|null){this.context().customDomain=value;}
 getCustomDomain(){return this.storage.getStore()?.customDomain||null;}
 getTenantContext(){return this.storage.getStore()||null;}
 clearTenantContext(){Object.assign(this.context(),{tenantId:null,subdomain:null,customDomain:null});}
 hasTenantContext(){return !!this.getTenantId();}
 requireTenantContext():string {const id=this.getTenantId();if(!id)throw new Error('Tenant context required');return id;}
}

import {NestFactory} from '@nestjs/core';
