import {TransformInterceptor} from './common/interceptors/transform.interceptor';
import {LoggingInterceptor} from './common/interceptors/logging.interceptor';
async function bootstrap(){
 const app=await NestFactory.create(AppModule,{logger:['error','warn','log']});const config=app.get(ConfigService);
 const production=config.get('NODE_ENV')==='production';
 app.getHttpAdapter().getInstance().disable('x-powered-by');
 app.enableShutdownHooks();
 app.use((_req:any,res:any,next:()=>void)=>{res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options','nosniff');res.setHeader('X-Frame-Options','DENY');res.setHeader('Referrer-Policy','no-referrer');res.setHeader('Cache-Control','no-store');if(production)res.setHeader('Strict-Transport-Security','max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains');next();});
 app.enableCors({origin:String(config.get('CORS_ORIGIN','http://localhost:3000')).split(',').map(o=>o.trim()),credentials:false});
 app.setGlobalPrefix('api/v1');
 app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({whitelist:true,forbidNonWhitelisted:true,transform:true,transformOptions:{enableImplicitConversion:true}}));
 app.useGlobalFilters(new HttpExceptionFilter());
 app.useGlobalInterceptors(new TransformInterceptor(),new LoggingInterceptor());
 if(!production||config.get('ENABLE_API_DOCS')==='true'){const doc=SwaggerModule.createDocument(app,new DocumentBuilder().setTitle('Krypton School ERP API').setVersion('2.0').addBearerAuth().build());SwaggerModule.setup('api/docs',app,doc);}
 await app.listen(Number(config.get('PORT',config.get('API_PORT',3001))),'0.0.0.0');
 Logger.log('Krypton API listening on port '+config.get('PORT',3001));
}
bootstrap().catch(error=>{Logger.error('API startup failed',error);process.exitCode=1;});

import {

  Get,
  Post,
  Body,
  Patch,
  Param,
  Delete,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
  Request,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ActivityFeedService } from './activity-feed.service';
import { CreateActivityDto } from './dto/create-activity.dto';
import { UpdateActivityDto } from './dto/update-activity.dto';
import { QueryActivitiesDto } from './dto/query-activities.dto';
import { Roles } from '../../common/decorators/roles.decorator';
import { UserRole } from '@krypton/types';

@Controller('activity-feed')
export class ActivityFeedController {
  constructor(private readonly activityFeedService: ActivityFeedService) {}

  @Post()
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  create(@Body() createActivityDto: CreateActivityDto, @Request() req: any) {
    return this.activityFeedService.create(createActivityDto, req.user.id);
  }

  @Get()
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  findAll(@Query() query: QueryActivitiesDto) {
    return this.activityFeedService.findAll(query);
  }

  @Get('student/:studentId')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  findByStudent(
    @Param('studentId') studentId: string,
    @Query() query: QueryActivitiesDto,
  ) {
    return this.activityFeedService.findByStudent(studentId, query);
  }

  @Get('student/:studentId/summary')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  getActivitySummary(@Param('studentId') studentId: string) {
    return this.activityFeedService.getActivitySummary(studentId);
  }

  @Get(':id')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  findOne(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.activityFeedService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Patch(':id')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  update(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() updateActivityDto: UpdateActivityDto) {
    return this.activityFeedService.update(id, updateActivityDto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  remove(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.activityFeedService.remove(id);
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ForbiddenException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateActivityDto } from './dto/create-activity.dto';
import { UpdateActivityDto } from './dto/update-activity.dto';
import { QueryActivitiesDto } from './dto/query-activities.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ActivityFeedService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async create(dto: CreateActivityDto, userId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student belongs to this tenant
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    const activity = await this.prisma.activityFeed.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        activityType: dto.activityType,
        title: dto.title,
        description: dto.description,
        metadata: dto.metadata || {},
        isVisibleToParents: dto.isVisibleToParents ?? true,
        classId: dto.classId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
        createdBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        mediaItems: true,
      },
    });

    return activity;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryActivitiesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (query.studentId) {
      where.studentId = query.studentId;
    }

    if (query.classId) {
      where.classId = query.classId;
    }

    if (query.activityType) {
      where.activityType = query.activityType;
    }

    if (query.startDate || query.endDate) {
      where.createdAt = {};
      if (query.startDate) {
        where.createdAt.gte = new Date(query.startDate);
      }
      if (query.endDate) {
        where.createdAt.lte = new Date(query.endDate);
      }
    }

    const page = query.page || 1;
    const limit = query.limit || 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const [activities, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.activityFeed.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          mediaItems: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              fileUrl: true,
              thumbnailUrl: true,
              fileType: true,
              caption: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: {
          createdAt: 'desc',
        },
        skip,
        take: limit,
      }),
      this.prisma.activityFeed.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: activities,
      pagination: {
        total,
        page,
        limit,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      },
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const activity = await this.prisma.activityFeed.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        mediaItems: true,
      },
    });

    if (!activity) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Activity not found');
    }

    return activity;
  }

  async findByStudent(studentId: string, query: QueryActivitiesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student belongs to this tenant
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    return this.findAll({ ...query, studentId });
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateActivityDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify activity exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    const activity = await this.prisma.activityFeed.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        activityType: dto.activityType,
        title: dto.title,
        description: dto.description,
        metadata: dto.metadata,
        isVisibleToParents: dto.isVisibleToParents,
        classId: dto.classId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
      include: {
        mediaItems: true,
      },
    });

    return activity;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify activity exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    await this.prisma.activityFeed.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    return { message: 'Activity deleted successfully' };
  }

  // Parent-facing methods
  async getStudentActivities(studentId: string, guardianId: string, query: QueryActivitiesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access to this student
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: {
        guardianId,
        studentId,
      },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      studentId,
      isVisibleToParents: true,
    };

    if (query.activityType) {
      where.activityType = query.activityType;
    }

    if (query.startDate || query.endDate) {
      where.createdAt = {};
      if (query.startDate) {
        where.createdAt.gte = new Date(query.startDate);
      }
      if (query.endDate) {
        where.createdAt.lte = new Date(query.endDate);
      }
    }

    const page = query.page || 1;
    const limit = query.limit || 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const [activities, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.activityFeed.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          mediaItems: {
            where: {
              isVisibleToParents: true,
            },
            select: {
              id: true,
              fileUrl: true,
              thumbnailUrl: true,
              fileType: true,
              caption: true,
              createdAt: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: {
          createdAt: 'desc',
        },
        skip,
        take: limit,
      }),
      this.prisma.activityFeed.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: activities,
      pagination: {
        total,
        page,
        limit,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      },
    };
  }

  // Get activity summary for dashboard
  async getActivitySummary(studentId: string, guardianId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // If guardian is provided, verify access
    if (guardianId) {
      const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
        where: { guardianId, studentId },
      });

      if (!link) {
        throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
      }
    }

    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const thisWeek = new Date();
    thisWeek.setDate(thisWeek.getDate() - 7);
    thisWeek.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      studentId,
    };

    if (guardianId) {
      where.isVisibleToParents = true;
    }

    const [todayCount, weekCount, byType] = await Promise.all([
      // Today's activities
      this.prisma.activityFeed.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          createdAt: { gte: today },
        },
      }),
      // This week's activities
      this.prisma.activityFeed.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          createdAt: { gte: thisWeek },
        },
      }),
      // Activities by type (this week)
      this.prisma.activityFeed.groupBy({
        by: ['activityType'],
        where: {
          ...where,
          createdAt: { gte: thisWeek },
        },
        _count: true,
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      today: todayCount,
      thisWeek: weekCount,
      byType: byType.map((item) => ({
        type: item.activityType,
        count: item._count,
      })),
    };
  }
}

import { IsString, IsEnum, IsOptional, IsBoolean, IsObject, IsUUID } from 'class-validator';

export enum ActivityType {
  ATTENDANCE = 'ATTENDANCE',
  PARTICIPATION = 'PARTICIPATION',
  ACHIEVEMENT = 'ACHIEVEMENT',
  ASSIGNMENT = 'ASSIGNMENT',
  BEHAVIOR = 'BEHAVIOR',
  EVENT = 'EVENT',
  ANNOUNCEMENT = 'ANNOUNCEMENT',
  MEAL = 'MEAL',
  TRANSPORT = 'TRANSPORT',
  OTHER = 'OTHER',
}

export class CreateActivityDto {
  @IsUUID()
  studentId: string;

  @IsEnum(ActivityType)
  activityType: ActivityType;

  @IsString()
  title: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsOptional()
  description?: string;

  @IsObject()
  @IsOptional()
  metadata?: any;

  @IsBoolean()
  @IsOptional()
  isVisibleToParents?: boolean = true;

  @IsUUID()
  @IsOptional()
  classId?: string;

  @IsUUID()
  @IsOptional()
  subjectId?: string;
}

import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import { ActivityType } from './create-activity.dto';

export class QueryActivitiesDto {
  @IsUUID()
  @IsOptional()
  studentId?: string;

  @IsUUID()
  @IsOptional()
  classId?: string;

  @IsEnum(ActivityType)
  @IsOptional()
  activityType?: ActivityType;

  @IsDateString()
  @IsOptional()
  startDate?: string;

  @IsDateString()
  @IsOptional()
  endDate?: string;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsOptional()
  page?: number = 1;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsOptional()
  limit?: number = 20;
}

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Body,
  Param,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { AdmissionsService } from './admissions.service';
import {
  AdmissionStage,
  CreateAdmissionInput,
  AdmissionInterview,
  AdmissionPayment,
  AdmissionEnrollment,
} from '@krypton/types';

@Controller('admissions')
export class AdmissionsController {
  constructor(private readonly admissionsService: AdmissionsService) {}

  @Get()
  findAll(
    @Query('search') search?: string,
    @Query('stage') stage?: AdmissionStage,
    @Query('grade') grade?: string
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.findAll({ search, stage, grade }),
    };
  }

  @Get('stats')
  getStats() {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.getFunnelStats(),
    };
  }

  @Get(':id')
  findById(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.findById(id),
    };
  }

  @Post()
  create(@Body() input: CreateAdmissionInput) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.create(input),
      message: 'Admission inquiry registered successfully',
    };
  }

  @Post(':id/stage')
  updateStage(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() body: { stage: AdmissionStage; actor?: string; note?: string }
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.updateStage(id, body.stage, body.actor, body.note),
      message: `Stage updated to ${body.stage}`,
    };
  }

  @Post(':id/interview')
  scheduleInterview(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() interview: AdmissionInterview
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.scheduleInterview(id, interview),
      message: 'Interview scheduled successfully',
    };
  }

  @Post(':id/payment')
  recordPayment(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() payment: AdmissionPayment
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.recordPayment(id, payment),
      message: 'Admission payment recorded successfully',
    };
  }

  @Post(':id/admit')
  completeAdmission(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() enrollment: AdmissionEnrollment
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data: this.admissionsService.completeAdmission(id, enrollment),
      message: 'Student officially admitted to school',
    };
  }
}

  findAll(filters?: { search?: string; stage?: AdmissionStage; grade?: string }) {
    let list = this.applications;
    if (!filters) return list;

    if (filters.stage) {
      list = list.filter((a) => a.stage === filters.stage);
    }
    if (filters.grade && filters.grade !== 'ALL') {
      list = list.filter((a) => a.student.applyingForGrade === filters.grade);
    }
    if (filters.search) {
      const q = filters.search.toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter(
        (a) =>
          a.applicationNumber.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.student.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.parent.phone.includes(q)
      );
    }
    return list;
  }

  findById(id: string) {
    const app = this.applications.find(
      (a) => a.id === id || a.applicationNumber === id
    );
    if (!app) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Admission application ${id} not found`);
    }
    return app;
  }

  create(input: CreateAdmissionInput): AdmissionApplication {
    const count = this.applications.length + 1;
    const randomSuffix = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
    const appNumber = `APP-2026-${count.toString().padStart(3, '0')}${randomSuffix.toString().slice(-1)}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const app: AdmissionApplication = {
      id: `adm-${Date.now()}`,
      applicationNumber: appNumber,
      academicYear: '2026-2027',
      stage: 'INQUIRY_RECEIVED',
      priority: input.priority || 'MEDIUM',
      leadSource: input.leadSource || 'WEBSITE_PORTAL',
      student: input.student,
      parent: input.parent,
      documents: input.documents,
      transportRequired: input.transportRequired ?? false,
      hostelRequired: input.hostelRequired ?? false,
      siblingEnrolled: input.siblingEnrolled ?? false,
      siblingDetails: input.siblingDetails,
      notes: input.notes
        ? [
            {
              id: `note-${Date.now()}`,
              author: 'Applicant',
              text: input.notes,
              createdAt: now,
            },
          ]
        : [],
      timeline: [
        {
          id: `time-${Date.now()}`,
          stage: 'INQUIRY_RECEIVED',
          title: 'Online Application Received',
          description: `Applied for ${input.student.applyingForGrade}.`,
          timestamp: now,
          actor: 'Online Portal',
        },
      ],
      tags: ['New Inquiry', input.student.applyingForGrade],
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };

    this.applications.unshift(app);
    return app;
  }

  updateStage(id: string, stage: AdmissionStage, actor = 'Admin', note?: string) {
    const app = this.findById(id);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    app.stage = stage;
    app.updatedAt = now;
    app.timeline.unshift({
      id: `time-${Date.now()}`,
      stage,
      title: `Moved to ${stage.replace('_', ' ')}`,
      description: note || `Application advanced in CRM pipeline.`,
      timestamp: now,
      actor,
    });

    return app;
  }

  scheduleInterview(id: string, interview: AdmissionInterview, actor = 'Coordinator') {
    const app = this.findById(id);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    app.stage = 'INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED';
    app.interview = interview;
    app.updatedAt = now;
    app.timeline.unshift({
      id: `time-${Date.now()}`,
      stage: 'INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED',
      title: 'Interview Scheduled',
      description: `${interview.scheduledDate} at ${interview.scheduledTime} with ${interview.interviewerName}`,
      timestamp: now,
      actor,
    });

    return app;
  }

  recordPayment(id: string, payment: AdmissionPayment, actor = 'Accounts') {
    const app = this.findById(id);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    app.stage = 'FEE_PAID';
    app.payment = payment;
    app.updatedAt = now;
    app.timeline.unshift({
      id: `time-${Date.now()}`,
      stage: 'FEE_PAID',
      title: 'Fee Paid',
      description: `₹${payment.amount} paid via ${payment.paymentMethod}. Receipt: ${payment.receiptNumber}`,
      timestamp: now,
      actor,
    });

    return app;
  }

  completeAdmission(id: string, enrollment: AdmissionEnrollment, actor = 'Registrar') {
    const app = this.findById(id);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    app.stage = 'ADMITTED';
    app.enrollment = enrollment;
    app.updatedAt = now;
    app.timeline.unshift({
      id: `time-${Date.now()}`,
      stage: 'ADMITTED',
      title: 'Official Admission Complete',
      description: `Official Admission No: ${enrollment.officialAdmissionNumber} (Class ${enrollment.assignedClass})`,
      timestamp: now,
      actor,
    });

    return app;
  }

  getFunnelStats(): AdmissionFunnelStats {
    const total = this.applications.length;
    const interview = this.applications.filter(
      (a) => a.stage !== 'INQUIRY_RECEIVED'
    ).length;
    const accepted = this.applications.filter(
      (a) => a.stage === 'ACCEPTED' || a.stage === 'FEE_PAID' || a.stage === 'ADMITTED'
    ).length;
    const feePaid = this.applications.filter(
      (a) => a.stage === 'FEE_PAID' || a.stage === 'ADMITTED'
    ).length;
    const admitted = this.applications.filter((a) => a.stage === 'ADMITTED').length;

    const totalFee = this.applications.reduce(
      (sum, a) => sum + (a.payment?.amount || 0),
      0
    );

    return {
      totalInquiries: total,
      interviewScheduledCount: interview,
      acceptedCount: accepted,
      feePaidCount: feePaid,
      admittedCount: admitted,
      conversionRate: total > 0 ? Math.round((admitted / total) * 100) : 0,
      totalFeeCollected: totalFee,
      byGrade: {},
      bySource: {
        WEBSITE_PORTAL: 0,
        WALK_IN: 0,
        WHATSAPP: 0,
        SOCIAL_MEDIA: 0,
        PARENT_REFERRAL: 0,
        EDUCATION_EXPO: 0,
      },
    };
  }
}

import { Controller, Get, Query, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBearerAuth, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { UserRole } from '@krypton/types';
import { Roles } from '../../common/decorators/roles.decorator';

import { CurrentUser, CurrentUserData } from '../../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { TenantGuard } from '../../common/guards/tenant.guard';
import { AdvancedAnalyticsService } from './advanced-analytics.service';
import { AnalyticsQueryDto, SchoolBenchmarkQueryDto } from './dto/analytics-query.dto';

@ApiTags('advanced-analytics') @ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller('advanced-analytics') @UseGuards(TenantGuard)
@Roles(UserRole.SCHOOL_OWNER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
export class AdvancedAnalyticsController {
  constructor(private readonly service: AdvancedAnalyticsService) {}
  @Get('options') options(@CurrentUser() user: CurrentUserData) { return this.service.options(user); }
  @Get('report') @Throttle({ default: { limit: 20, ttl: 60000 } }) report(@CurrentUser() user: CurrentUserData, @Query() query: AnalyticsQueryDto) { return this.service.report(user, query); }
  @Get('schools') @SkipTenantCheck() @Roles(UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN) @Throttle({ default: { limit: 10, ttl: 60000 } }) schools(@CurrentUser() user: CurrentUserData, @Query() query: SchoolBenchmarkQueryDto) { return this.service.benchmarks(user, query); }
}

import { BadRequestException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AdvancedAnalyticsOptions, SchoolBenchmarkReport } from '@krypton/types';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CurrentUserData } from '../../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';
import { AnalyticsFacts, buildExecutiveReport, DAY, isoDay, metrics, prepareFacts } from './analytics-engine';
import { AnalyticsPeriodDto, AnalyticsQueryDto, SchoolBenchmarkQueryDto } from './dto/analytics-query.dto';

const leaders = ['SCHOOL_OWNER', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL', 'SCHOOL_ADMIN'];
export function analyticsPeriod(query: AnalyticsPeriodDto, now: Date) {
  const today = new Date(isoDay(now)), to = query.to ?? isoDay(today), from = query.from ?? isoDay(new Date(today.getTime() - 89 * DAY));
  const start = new Date(`${from}T00:00:00.000Z`), end = new Date(`${to}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (!Number.isFinite(start.getTime()) || !Number.isFinite(end.getTime()) || isoDay(start) !== from || isoDay(end) !== to) throw new BadRequestException('Use valid calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD)');
  const days = (end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / DAY + 1;
  if (days < 1 || days > 366 || end > today) throw new BadRequestException('Choose a period of 1–366 days ending on or before today');
  const until = new Date(end.getTime() + DAY), previousFrom = new Date(start.getTime() - days * DAY);
  return { from: start, until, previousFrom };
}

async function pages<T extends { id: string }>(fetch: (cursor?: string) => Promise<T[]>): Promise<T[]> {
  const rows: T[] = []; let cursor: string | undefined;
  while (true) {
    const batch = await fetch(cursor); rows.push(...batch);
    if (batch.length < 1000) break;
    const next = batch[batch.length - 1].id;
    if (next === cursor) throw new BadRequestException('Analytics pagination could not advance');
    cursor = next;
  }
  return rows;
}
@Injectable()
export class AdvancedAnalyticsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService, private readonly tenants: TenantService) {}
  private tenant(user: CurrentUserData) {
    const id = this.tenants.requireTenantContext();
    if (!leaders.includes(user.role) || user.tenantId !== id) throw new ForbiddenException('School leadership analytics access required');
    return id;
  }
  async options(user: CurrentUserData): Promise<AdvancedAnalyticsOptions> {
    const tenantId = this.tenant(user), now = new Date(), range = analyticsPeriod({}, now);
    const [classes, subjects, terms] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.class.findMany({ where: { tenantId }, select: { id: true, name: true }, orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' } }),
      this.prisma.subject.findMany({ where: { tenantId }, select: { id: true, name: true }, orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' } }),
      this.prisma.term.findMany({ where: { tenantId }, select: { id: true, name: true, startDate: true, endDate: true, isCurrent: true }, orderBy: { startDate: 'desc' }, take: 30 }),
    ]);
    return { classes, subjects, terms: terms.map(t => ({ ...t, startDate: isoDay(t.startDate), endDate: isoDay(t.endDate) })), defaults: { from: isoDay(range.from), to: isoDay(new Date(range.until.getTime() - DAY)) } };
  }
  private async facts(tenantId: string, query: AnalyticsQueryDto, range: ReturnType<typeof analyticsPeriod>, now: Date): Promise<AnalyticsFacts> {
    if (query.classId && !await this.prisma.class.findFirst({ where: { id: query.classId, tenantId }, select: { id: true } })) throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
    if (query.subjectId && !await this.prisma.subject.findFirst({ where: { id: query.subjectId, tenantId }, select: { id: true } })) throw new NotFoundException('Subject not found');
    const cohort = { tenantId, status: 'ACTIVE' as const, deletedAt: null, ...(query.classId ? { currentClassId: query.classId } : {}) };
    const dated = { gte: range.previousFrom, lt: range.until };
    const pageArgs = (cursor?: string) => ({ orderBy: { id: 'asc' as const }, take: 1000, ...(cursor ? { cursor: { id: cursor }, skip: 1 } : {}) });
    const [students, classes, subjects, grades, attendance, invoices, payments] = await Promise.all([
      pages(cursor => this.prisma.student.findMany({ where: cohort, select: { id: true, currentClassId: true }, ...pageArgs(cursor) })),
      this.prisma.class.findMany({ where: { tenantId, ...(query.classId ? { id: query.classId } : {}) }, select: { id: true, name: true }, orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' } }),
      this.prisma.subject.findMany({ where: { tenantId, ...(query.subjectId ? { id: query.subjectId } : {}) }, select: { id: true, name: true }, orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' } }),
      pages(cursor => this.prisma.grade.findMany({ where: { tenantId, student: cohort, createdAt: { lte: now }, ...(query.subjectId ? { subjectId: query.subjectId } : {}),
        examination: { tenantId, OR: [{ endDate: dated }, { endDate: null, startDate: dated }, { endDate: null, startDate: null, createdAt: dated }] } },
        select: { id: true, studentId: true, subjectId: true, score: true, marks: true, totalMarks: true,
          examination: { select: { startDate: true, endDate: true, createdAt: true, subjects: { select: { subjectId: true, passMark: true, totalMarks: true } } } } }, ...pageArgs(cursor) })),
      pages(cursor => this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({ where: { tenantId, student: cohort, date: dated }, select: { id: true, studentId: true, date: true, status: true }, ...pageArgs(cursor) })),
      pages(cursor => this.prisma.invoice.findMany({ where: { tenantId, student: cohort, createdAt: { lte: now }, status: { notIn: ['DRAFT', 'CANCELLED'] } },
        select: { id: true, studentId: true, totalAmount: true, paidAmount: true, balanceAmount: true, dueDate: true, createdAt: true, status: true }, ...pageArgs(cursor) })),
      pages(cursor => this.prisma.payment.findMany({ where: { tenantId, status: 'COMPLETED', paymentDate: dated, invoice: { tenantId, student: cohort } },
        select: { id: true, amount: true, paymentDate: true, status: true, invoice: { select: { studentId: true } } }, ...pageArgs(cursor) })),
    ]);
    return { students, classes, subjects, grades, attendance, invoices, payments };
  }
  async report(user: CurrentUserData, query: AnalyticsQueryDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenant(user), now = new Date(), range = analyticsPeriod(query, now);
    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findFirst({ where: { id: tenantId }, select: { name: true, currency: true } });
    if (!tenant) throw new NotFoundException('School not found');
    const facts = await this.facts(tenantId, query, range, now);
    return buildExecutiveReport(facts, range.from, range.until, now, tenant.currency, tenant.name, { classId: query.classId ?? null, subjectId: query.subjectId ?? null });
  }
  async benchmarks(user: CurrentUserData, query: SchoolBenchmarkQueryDto): Promise<SchoolBenchmarkReport> {
    if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') throw new ForbiddenException('Platform administrator access required');
    const now = new Date(), range = analyticsPeriod(query, now), page = query.page ?? 1, pageSize = 10;
    return this.prisma.executeWithoutTenantFilter(async () => {
      const [tenants, total] = await Promise.all([
        this.prisma.tenant.findMany({ select: { id: true, name: true, currency: true, status: true }, orderBy: [{ name: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }], skip: (page - 1) * pageSize, take: pageSize }),
        this.prisma.tenant.count(),
      ]);
      const schools = [];
      // Scope every data query explicitly even inside the authorized platform operation.
      for (const tenant of tenants) {
        const data = await this.facts(tenant.id, {}, range, now);
        schools.push({ ...tenant, ...metrics(prepareFacts(data, now), range.from, range.until, now) });
      }
      return { generatedAt: now.toISOString(), period: { from: isoDay(range.from), to: isoDay(new Date(range.until.getTime() - DAY)) }, schools, page, pageSize, total,
        methodology: ['Platform administrators can compare aggregate tenant/school communities. No student identity, raw grades or payment records are returned.',
          'Comparisons use the same calendar window and current active cohorts. Assessment scores and pass rates depend on school assessment difficulty and pass settings; they are not school-quality rankings.',
          'Attendance uses recorded student-days; missing/leave/sickness records are excluded. Review record coverage and sample counts.',
          'Keep money comparisons within the same currency. Outstanding/overdue and invoice settlement are current snapshots; receipts and billed are period totals.'] };
    });
  }
}

import { AnalyticsGroup, AnalyticsInsight, AnalyticsMetrics, ExecutiveAnalyticsReport } from '@krypton/types';

export const DAY = 86_400_000;
export const isoDay = (date: Date) => date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const round = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 10) / 10;
const average = (values: number[]) => values.length ? round(values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length) : null;
export interface AnalyticsFacts {
  students: { id: string; currentClassId: string | null }[];
  classes: { id: string; name: string }[];
  subjects: { id: string; name: string }[];
  grades: { studentId: string; subjectId: string; score: number; marks: number | null; totalMarks: number;
    examination: { startDate: Date | null; endDate: Date | null; createdAt: Date; subjects: { subjectId: string; passMark: number | null; totalMarks: number }[] } }[];
  attendance: { studentId: string; date: Date; status: string }[];
  invoices: { studentId: string; totalAmount: number; paidAmount: number; balanceAmount: number; dueDate: Date | null; createdAt: Date; status: string }[];
  payments: { amount: number; paymentDate: Date; status: string; invoice: { studentId: string } }[];
}
type GradeFact = { studentId: string; subjectId: string; date: Date; percentage: number; passed: boolean };
type AttendanceFact = { studentId: string; date: Date; presence: number };
const within = (date: Date, from: Date, until: Date) => date >= from && date < until;
export function prepareFacts(data: AnalyticsFacts, now: Date) {
  const ids = new Set(data.students.map(s => s.id));
  const grades: GradeFact[] = [];
  for (const g of data.grades) {
    const date = g.examination.endDate ?? g.examination.startDate ?? g.examination.createdAt;
    const marks = g.marks ?? g.score;
    if (!ids.has(g.studentId) || !Number.isFinite(marks) || !Number.isFinite(g.totalMarks) || g.totalMarks <= 0 || marks < 0 || marks > g.totalMarks || date > now) continue;
    const config = g.examination.subjects.find(s => s.subjectId === g.subjectId);
    const threshold = config && config.passMark !== null && config.totalMarks > 0 && config.passMark >= 0 && config.passMark <= config.totalMarks ? config.passMark / config.totalMarks * 100 : 40;
    const percentage = marks / g.totalMarks * 100;
    grades.push({ studentId: g.studentId, subjectId: g.subjectId, date, percentage, passed: percentage >= threshold });
  }
  const days = new Map<string, { studentId: string; date: Date; values: number[] }>();
  for (const a of data.attendance) {
    if (!ids.has(a.studentId) || a.date > now || !['PRESENT', 'LATE', 'HALF_DAY', 'ABSENT'].includes(a.status)) continue;
    const key = `${a.studentId}:${isoDay(a.date)}`, day = days.get(key) ?? { studentId: a.studentId, date: new Date(isoDay(a.date)), values: [] };
    day.values.push(a.status === 'ABSENT' ? 0 : a.status === 'HALF_DAY' ? 0.5 : 1); days.set(key, day);
  }
  const attendance: AttendanceFact[] = [...days.values()].map(a => ({ studentId: a.studentId, date: a.date, presence: a.values.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0) / a.values.length }));
  const invoices = data.invoices.filter(i => ids.has(i.studentId) && !['DRAFT', 'CANCELLED'].includes(i.status) && i.createdAt <= now);
  const payments = data.payments.filter(p => ids.has(p.invoice.studentId) && p.status === 'COMPLETED' && p.paymentDate <= now && p.amount >= 0);
  return { ...data, grades, attendance, invoices, payments };
}
type Prepared = ReturnType<typeof prepareFacts>;
export function metrics(data: Prepared, from: Date, until: Date, now: Date): AnalyticsMetrics {
  const grades = data.grades.filter(g => within(g.date, from, until)), attendance = data.attendance.filter(a => within(a.date, from, until));
  const cohortInvoices = data.invoices.filter(i => within(i.createdAt, from, until));
  const billed = cohortInvoices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.totalAmount), 0);
  const settled = cohortInvoices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, Math.min(i.totalAmount, i.paidAmount)), 0);
  return { students: data.students.length, assessedStudents: new Set(grades.map(g => g.studentId)).size, assessmentCount: grades.length,
    averageScore: average(grades.map(g => g.percentage)), passRate: average(grades.map(g => g.passed ? 100 : 0)),
    attendanceRate: average(attendance.map(a => a.presence * 100)), attendanceDays: attendance.length, attendanceStudents: new Set(attendance.map(a => a.studentId)).size,
    billed, receipts: data.payments.filter(p => within(p.paymentDate, from, until)).reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amount, 0),
    invoiceSettlementRate: billed ? round(settled / billed * 100) : null,
    outstanding: data.invoices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.balanceAmount), 0),
    overdue: data.invoices.filter(i => i.dueDate && i.dueDate < now).reduce((sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.balanceAmount), 0) };
}
function classData(data: Prepared, classId: string | null): Prepared {
  const students = data.students.filter(s => s.currentClassId === classId), ids = new Set(students.map(s => s.id));
  return { ...data, students, grades: data.grades.filter(g => ids.has(g.studentId)), attendance: data.attendance.filter(a => ids.has(a.studentId)),
    invoices: data.invoices.filter(i => ids.has(i.studentId)), payments: data.payments.filter(p => ids.has(p.invoice.studentId)) };
}
export function buildExecutiveReport(facts: AnalyticsFacts, from: Date, until: Date, now: Date, currency: string, schoolName: string,
  filters: { classId: string | null; subjectId: string | null }): ExecutiveAnalyticsReport {
  const data = prepareFacts(facts, now), previousFrom = new Date(from.getTime() - (until.getTime() - from.getTime()));
  const current = metrics(data, from, until, now), previous = metrics(data, previousFrom, from, now);
  const groups = [...data.classes, ...(data.students.some(s => !s.currentClassId) ? [{ id: 'unassigned', name: 'Unassigned' }] : [])];
  const classes: AnalyticsGroup[] = groups.map(c => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, ...metrics(classData(data, c.id === 'unassigned' ? null : c.id), from, until, now) }));
  const subjects: AnalyticsGroup[] = data.subjects.map(s => ({ id: s.id, name: s.name, ...metrics({ ...data, grades: data.grades.filter(g => g.subjectId === s.id), attendance: [], invoices: [], payments: [] }, from, until, now) }));
  const daily = new Map<string, { gradeSum: number; assessmentCount: number; presenceSum: number; attendanceDays: number; receipts: number }>();
  for (let time = from.getTime(); time < until.getTime(); time += DAY) {
    daily.set(isoDay(new Date(time)), { gradeSum: 0, assessmentCount: 0, presenceSum: 0, attendanceDays: 0, receipts: 0 });
  }
  data.grades.forEach(g => { const day = daily.get(isoDay(g.date)); if (day) { day.gradeSum += g.percentage; day.assessmentCount++; } });
  data.attendance.forEach(a => { const day = daily.get(isoDay(a.date)); if (day) { day.presenceSum += a.presence; day.attendanceDays++; } });
  data.payments.forEach(p => { const day = daily.get(isoDay(p.paymentDate)); if (day) day.receipts += p.amount; });
  const trend = [...daily].map(([date, d]) => ({ date, averageScore: d.assessmentCount ? round(d.gradeSum / d.assessmentCount) : null,
    assessmentCount: d.assessmentCount, attendanceRate: d.attendanceDays ? round(d.presenceSum / d.attendanceDays * 100) : null, attendanceDays: d.attendanceDays, receipts: d.receipts }));
  const insights: AnalyticsInsight[] = [];
  if (current.averageScore !== null && previous.averageScore !== null) {
    const delta = round(current.averageScore - previous.averageScore);
    insights.push({ kind: delta < -5 ? 'attention' : delta > 5 ? 'positive' : 'information', title: delta < 0 ? 'Assessment scores declined' : 'Assessment score comparison',
      detail: `Mean assessment score changed by ${delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${delta} percentage points (${previous.assessmentCount} previous / ${current.assessmentCount} current results). Review assessment difficulty and cohort context.`, href: '/school/grades' });
  }
  if (current.attendanceRate !== null && current.attendanceRate < 85) insights.push({ kind: 'attention', title: 'Attendance needs a review', detail: `Recorded attendance is ${current.attendanceRate}% across ${current.attendanceDays} student-days. Review register coverage and absence context.`, href: '/school/attendance' });
  if (current.attendanceRate !== null && previous.attendanceRate !== null && previous.attendanceRate - current.attendanceRate >= 5) insights.push({ kind: 'attention', title: 'Attendance trend fell', detail: `Recorded attendance fell ${round(previous.attendanceRate - current.attendanceRate)} percentage points against the previous period.`, href: '/school/attendance' });
  if (current.students && current.assessedStudents / current.students < 0.8) insights.push({ kind: 'information', title: 'Incomplete learning evidence', detail: `${current.assessedStudents} of ${current.students} current active students have assessment results in this period. Missing marks are not treated as zero.`, href: '/school/grades' });
  if (current.students && current.attendanceStudents / current.students < 0.8) insights.push({ kind: 'information', title: 'Register coverage is limited', detail: `${current.attendanceStudents} of ${current.students} current active students have usable attendance records. Unrecorded days are unknown.`, href: '/school/attendance' });
  const lowSubject = subjects.filter(s => s.assessmentCount >= 5 && s.averageScore !== null).sort((a, b) => a.averageScore! - b.averageScore!)[0];
  if (lowSubject && lowSubject.averageScore! < 50) insights.push({ kind: 'attention', title: `${lowSubject.name}: plan learning support`, detail: `Mean score is ${lowSubject.averageScore}% from ${lowSubject.assessmentCount} results. Review the assessed topics before planning support.`, href: '/school/grades' });
  if (current.overdue > 0) insights.push({ kind: 'attention', title: 'Overdue fees need follow-up', detail: 'The current cohort has overdue invoice balances. Review the fee ledger and arrange appropriate follow-up.', href: '/school/fees' });
  if (!insights.length) insights.push({ kind: 'information', title: 'Use the evidence in context', detail: 'Compare classes, subjects and record coverage before drawing conclusions. Different assessment difficulty can affect comparisons.', href: '/school/predictive-analytics' });
  return { generatedAt: now.toISOString(), currency, schoolName,
    period: { from: isoDay(from), to: isoDay(new Date(until.getTime() - DAY)), previousFrom: isoDay(previousFrom), previousTo: isoDay(new Date(from.getTime() - DAY)) },
    filters, current, previous, classes, subjects, trend, insights,
    methodology: [
      'Cohort: current active, non-deleted students, grouped by their current class. Both periods use this same cohort; this is not historical enrollment.',
      'Mean score and pass rate count valid subject assessment results. Percentages are recalculated from marks / total marks, including zero; missing and invalid results are excluded. Pass thresholds use examination subject settings, defaulting to 40%.',
      'Assessment dates use exam end, start, then creation date. Attendance averages periods within each recorded student-day; present/late count as 1, half-day as 0.5, absent as 0. Leave/sickness and unrecorded days are excluded.',
      'Receipts are completed payments dated in the period; refunded payments are excluded. Billed uses non-draft, non-cancelled invoices created in the period. Invoice settlement uses their paid balances as of now, not historical payment timing.',
      'Outstanding and overdue balances are current snapshots across all invoices for the cohort, regardless of selected dates. Subject filters apply only to assessment metrics. Financial figures are stored in currency minor units.',
      'The previous period has the same number of calendar days. Comparisons describe observed records, not causal effects or school quality rankings.' ] };
}

import { Type } from 'class-transformer';

export class AnalyticsPeriodDto {
  @IsOptional() @Matches(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/) from?: string;
  @IsOptional() @Matches(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/) to?: string;
}
export class AnalyticsQueryDto extends AnalyticsPeriodDto {
  @IsOptional() @IsUUID() classId?: string;
  @IsOptional() @IsUUID() subjectId?: string;
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  BulkMarkAttendanceDto,
  MarkSingleAttendanceDto,
  UpdateAttendanceDto,
} from './dto/mark-attendance.dto';
import {
  QueryAttendanceDto,
  AttendanceSummaryDto,
  StudentAttendanceReportDto,
} from './dto/query-attendance.dto';
import {
  BulkMarkStaffAttendanceDto,
  MarkSingleStaffAttendanceDto,
  QueryStaffAttendanceDto,
  StaffAttendanceStatus,
} from './dto/staff-attendance.dto';
import { AttendanceStatus } from '@krypton/types';

@Injectable()
export class AttendanceService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(AttendanceService.name);

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== STUDENT ATTENDANCE ====================

  async markBulkAttendance(dto: BulkMarkAttendanceDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate class exists
    const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
    }

    // Validate stream if provided
    if (dto.streamId) {
      const streamExists = await this.prisma.stream.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.streamId, classId: dto.classId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!streamExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Stream not found');
      }
    }

    const attendanceDate = new Date(dto.date);
    attendanceDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Validate all students exist and belong to the class
    const studentIds = dto.attendance.map((a) => a.studentId);
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: studentIds },
        tenantId,
        currentClassId: dto.classId,
        ...(dto.streamId && { currentStreamId: dto.streamId }),
      },
    });

    if (students.length !== studentIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Some students not found or do not belong to the specified class',
      );
    }

    // Check for existing attendance records
    const existing = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: { in: studentIds },
        date: attendanceDate,
        period: dto.period || 1,
      },
    });

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Attendance already marked for ${existing.length} student(s) on this date`,
      );
    }

    // Create attendance records
    const records = await this.prisma.$transaction(
      dto.attendance.map((item) =>
        this.prisma.attendanceRecord.create({
          data: {
            tenantId,
            studentId: item.studentId,
            classId: dto.classId,
            streamId: dto.streamId,
            date: attendanceDate,
            period: dto.period || 1,
            status: item.status,
            remarks: item.remarks,
            arrivalTime: item.arrivalTime ? new Date(item.arrivalTime) : null,
            markedBy: userId,
          },
        }),
      ),
    );

    this.logger.log(
      `Bulk attendance marked: ${records.length} students for ${dto.date}`,
    );

    // TODO: Send notifications to parents for absent students
    const absentStudents = records.filter(
      (r) =>
        r.status === AttendanceStatus.ABSENT,
    );

    if (absentStudents.length > 0) {
      this.logger.log(
        `${absentStudents.length} absent students - notifications pending`,
      );
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      markedCount: records.length,
      date: dto.date,
      period: dto.period || 1,
      absentCount: absentStudents.length,
    };
  }

  async markSingleAttendance(dto: MarkSingleAttendanceDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate student exists
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        currentStream: true,
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    const attendanceDate = new Date(dto.date);
    attendanceDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Check for existing record
    const existing = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        date: attendanceDate,
        period: dto.period || 1,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Attendance already marked for this student on this date/period',
      );
    }

    // Create attendance record
    const record = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        classId: student.currentClassId,
        streamId: student.currentStreamId,
        date: attendanceDate,
        period: dto.period || 1,
        status: dto.status,
        remarks: dto.remarks,
        arrivalTime: dto.arrivalTime ? new Date(dto.arrivalTime) : null,
        markedBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Attendance marked: ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} - ${dto.status}`,
    );

    return record;
  }

  async updateAttendance(id: string, dto: UpdateAttendanceDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const record = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!record) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Attendance record not found');
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.status && { status: dto.status }),
        ...(dto.remarks !== undefined && { remarks: dto.remarks }),
        ...(dto.arrivalTime && { arrivalTime: new Date(dto.arrivalTime) }),
        markedBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async queryAttendance(query: QueryAttendanceDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const {
      page = 1,
      pageSize = 50,
      classId,
      streamId,
      studentId,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      date,
      status,
      period,
    } = query;

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    if (streamId) {
      where.streamId = streamId;
    }

    if (studentId) {
      where.studentId = studentId;
    }

    if (date) {
      const specificDate = new Date(date);
      specificDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      where.date = specificDate;
    } else if (startDate || endDate) {
      where.date = {};
      if (startDate) {
        const start = new Date(startDate);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        where.date.gte = start;
      }
      if (endDate) {
        const end = new Date(endDate);
        end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.date.lte = end;
      }
    }

    if (status) {
      where.status = status;
    }

    if (period !== undefined) {
      where.period = period;
    }

    const [records, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
        where,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
        include: {
          student: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              admissionNumber: true,
              firstName: true,
              lastName: true,
            },
          },
          class: {
            select: {
              name: true,
            },
          },
          stream: {
            select: {
              name: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: [{ date: 'desc' }, { student: { lastName: 'asc' } }],
      }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: records,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
        hasNextPage: page < Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
        hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async getAttendanceSummary(query: AttendanceSummaryDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { classId, streamId, startDate, endDate } = query;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    if (streamId) {
      where.streamId = streamId;
    }

    if (startDate || endDate) {
      where.date = {};
      if (startDate) {
        const start = new Date(startDate);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        where.date.gte = start;
      }
      if (endDate) {
        const end = new Date(endDate);
        end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.date.lte = end;
      }
    }

    const [total, present, absent, late, excused, halfDay] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({
        where: { ...where, status: AttendanceStatus.PRESENT },
      }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          status: {
            in: [
              AttendanceStatus.ABSENT,
              AttendanceStatus.ABSENT,
            ],
          },
        },
      }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({
        where: { ...where, status: AttendanceStatus.LATE },
      }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({
        where: { ...where, status: AttendanceStatus.EXCUSED },
      }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.count({
        where: { ...where, status: AttendanceStatus.HALF_DAY },
      }),
    ]);

    const attendanceRate = total > 0 ? (present / total) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      total,
      present,
      absent,
      late,
      excused,
      halfDay,
      attendanceRate: Math.round(attendanceRate * 100) / 100,
    };
  }

  async getStudentAttendanceReport(query: StudentAttendanceReportDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { studentId, startDate, endDate } = query;

    // Validate student exists
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
      include: {
        currentClass: { select: { name: true } },
        currentStream: { select: { name: true } },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      studentId,
    };

    if (startDate || endDate) {
      where.date = {};
      if (startDate) {
        const start = new Date(startDate);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        where.date.gte = start;
      }
      if (endDate) {
        const end = new Date(endDate);
        end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.date.lte = end;
      }
    }

    const [records, stats] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: { date: 'desc' },
      }),
      this.prisma.attendanceRecord.groupBy({
        by: ['status'],
        where,
        _count: true,
      }),
    ]);

    const totalDays = records.length;
    const statusCounts = stats.reduce((acc, item) => {
      acc[item.status] = item._count;
      return acc;
    }, {} as any);

    const presentDays = statusCounts[AttendanceStatus.PRESENT] || 0;
    const attendanceRate = totalDays > 0 ? (presentDays / totalDays) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      student: {
        id: student.id,
        admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
        firstName: student.firstName,
        lastName: student.lastName,
        class: student.currentClass?.name,
        stream: student.currentStream?.name,
      },
      period: {
        startDate,
        endDate,
      },
      summary: {
        totalDays,
        present: statusCounts[AttendanceStatus.PRESENT] || 0,
        absent:
          (statusCounts[AttendanceStatus.ABSENT] || 0) +
          (statusCounts[AttendanceStatus.ABSENT] || 0),
        late: statusCounts[AttendanceStatus.LATE] || 0,
        excused: statusCounts[AttendanceStatus.EXCUSED] || 0,
        halfDay: statusCounts[AttendanceStatus.HALF_DAY] || 0,
        attendanceRate: Math.round(attendanceRate * 100) / 100,
      },
      records,
    };
  }

  async getTodayAttendance(classId?: string, streamId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      date: today,
    };

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    if (streamId) {
      where.streamId = streamId;
    }

    const records = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { student: { lastName: 'asc' } },
    });

    const summary = {
      total: records.length,
      present: records.filter((r) => r.status === AttendanceStatus.PRESENT)
        .length,
      absent: records.filter(
        (r) =>
          r.status === AttendanceStatus.ABSENT,
      ).length,
      late: records.filter((r) => r.status === AttendanceStatus.LATE).length,
    };

    return {
      date: today.toISOString().split('T')[0],
      summary,
      records,
    };
  }

  async markBulkStaffAttendance(
    dto: BulkMarkStaffAttendanceDto,
    userId?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const attendanceDate = new Date(dto.date);
    attendanceDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Validate all staff exist
    const staffIds = dto.attendance.map((a) => a.staffId);
    const staff = await this.prisma.staff.findMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: staffIds },
        tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (staff.length !== staffIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Some staff members not found');
    }

    // Check for existing records
    const existing = await this.prisma.staffAttendance.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        staffId: { in: staffIds },
        date: attendanceDate,
      },
    });

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Attendance already marked for ${existing.length} staff member(s)`,
      );
    }

    // Create attendance records
    const records = await this.prisma.$transaction(
      dto.attendance.map((item) =>
        this.prisma.staffAttendance.create({
          data: {
            tenantId,
            staffId: item.staffId,
            date: attendanceDate,
            status: item.status,
            remarks: item.remarks,
            timeIn: item.checkInTime ? new Date(item.checkInTime) : null,
            timeOut: item.checkOutTime
              ? new Date(item.checkOutTime)
              : null,
            markedBy: userId,
          },
        }),
      ),
    );

    this.logger.log(
      `Staff attendance marked: ${records.length} staff for ${dto.date}`,
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      markedCount: records.length,
      date: dto.date,
    };
  }

  async markSingleStaffAttendance(

      data: {

        date: attendanceDate,
        status: dto.status,
        remarks: dto.remarks,
        timeIn: dto.checkInTime ? new Date(dto.checkInTime) : null,

      },

  async queryStaffAttendance(query: QueryStaffAttendanceDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { staffId, startDate, endDate, date, status } = query;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (staffId) {
      where.staffId = staffId;
    }

    if (date) {
      const specificDate = new Date(date);
      specificDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      where.date = specificDate;
    } else if (startDate || endDate) {
      where.date = {};
      if (startDate) {
        const start = new Date(startDate);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        where.date.gte = start;
      }
      if (endDate) {
        const end = new Date(endDate);
        end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
        where.date.lte = end;
      }
    }

    if (status) {
      where.status = status;
    }

    const records = await this.prisma.staffAttendance.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        staff: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            staffNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
            position: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [{ date: 'desc' }, { staff: { lastName: 'asc' } }],
    });

    return records;
  }

  async getStaffAttendanceStats(staffId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };
    if (staffId) {
      where.staffId = staffId;
    }

    const [total, present, absent, late, onLeave] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.staffAttendance.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.staffAttendance.count({
        where: { ...where, status: StaffAttendanceStatus.PRESENT },
      }),
      this.prisma.staffAttendance.count({
        where: { ...where, status: StaffAttendanceStatus.ABSENT },
      }),
      this.prisma.staffAttendance.count({
        where: { ...where, status: StaffAttendanceStatus.LATE },
      }),
      this.prisma.staffAttendance.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          status: {
            in: [
              StaffAttendanceStatus.ON_LEAVE,
              StaffAttendanceStatus.SICK_LEAVE,
            ],
          },
        },
      }),
    ]);

    const attendanceRate = total > 0 ? (present / total) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      total,
      present,
      absent,
      late,
      onLeave,
      attendanceRate: Math.round(attendanceRate * 100) / 100,
    };
  }

  IsUUID,
  IsEnum,
  IsDateString,
  IsOptional,
  IsInt,
  Min,
  Max,
} from 'class-validator';

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { UnauthorizedException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { QRAttendanceService, QRSessionConfig } from './qr-attendance.service';

describe('QRAttendanceService', () => {
  let service: QRAttendanceService;
  let jwtService: JwtService;
  let redisService: RedisService;
  let prismaService: PrismaService;

  const mockRedisClient = {
    incr: jest.fn(),
  };

  const mockRedisService = {
    getClient: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(mockRedisClient)),
    get: jest.fn(),
    set: jest.fn(),
    del: jest.fn(),
    exists: jest.fn(),
    keys: jest.fn(),

    student: {
      findUnique: jest.fn(),
    },
    attendanceRecord: {
      create: jest.fn(),
    },
  };

    sign: jest.fn(),
    verify: jest.fn(),
  };

    get: jest.fn((key: string) => {
      if (key === 'JWT_SECRET') return 'test-secret';
      return null;
    }),
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        QRAttendanceService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: mockPrismaService },
        { provide: JwtService, useValue: mockJwtService },

    service = module.get<QRAttendanceService>(QRAttendanceService);

  });

  describe('generateQRToken', () => {

        type: 'class_attendance',

      mockRedisService.set.mockResolvedValue(undefined);

      const result = await service.generateQRToken(config);

      expect(result).toHaveProperty('token');

      expect(result).toHaveProperty('expiresAt');
      expect(result.token).toBe('mock-jwt-token');
      expect(result.sessionId).toMatch(/^qr-session-/);
      
      // Verify JWT was signed with correct payload
      expect(mockJwtService.sign).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          classId: config.classId,
          streamId: config.streamId,
          tenantId: config.tenantId,
          createdBy: config.createdBy,
          type: config.type,
        }),
        expect.objectContaining({
          secret: 'test-secret',
          expiresIn: '5m',
        })
      );

      // Verify session stored in Redis
      expect(mockRedisService.set).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.stringContaining('qr:session:'),
        expect.any(String),
        360 // 5 minutes + 1 minute buffer
      );
    });

    it('should use default expiry of 5 minutes', async () => {
      const config: QRSessionConfig = {
        tenantId: 'tenant-789',
        createdBy: 'teacher-001',
        type: 'class_attendance',
      };

      mockJwtService.sign.mockReturnValue('mock-jwt-token');
      mockRedisService.set.mockResolvedValue(undefined);

      await service.generateQRToken(config);

      expect(mockJwtService.sign).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

        expect.objectContaining({
          expiresIn: '5m',
        })
      );
    });
  });

  describe('verifyAndMarkAttendance', () => {

      sessionId: 'session-123',

      createdBy: 'teacher-001',
      type: 'class_attendance' as const,
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 300,

    const mockStudent = {
      id: 'student-001',
      firstName: 'John',
      lastName: 'Doe',
      admissionNumber: 'ADM001',

    it('should successfully mark attendance for valid QR scan', async () => {
      mockJwtService.verify.mockReturnValue(mockPayload);
      mockRedisService.get.mockResolvedValue(

      const result = await service.verifyAndMarkAttendance(

      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      expect(result.attendanceId).toBe('attendance-001');
      expect(result.student?.name).toBe('John Doe');
      expect(mockPrismaService.attendanceRecord.create).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should reject QR from different tenant', async () => {
      mockJwtService.verify.mockReturnValue({
        ...mockPayload,

      });
      mockRedisService.get.mockResolvedValue(
        JSON.stringify({ tenantId: 'different-tenant' })
      );

      await expect(
        service.verifyAndMarkAttendance(
          { token: mockToken, studentId: 'student-001' },
          'tenant-789'
        )
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });

    it('should reject student not in correct class', async () => {
      mockJwtService.verify.mockReturnValue(mockPayload);
      mockRedisService.get.mockResolvedValue(
        JSON.stringify({ tenantId: 'tenant-789' })

      await expect(

        )
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });

    it('should prevent duplicate scan (replay attack)', async () => {
      mockJwtService.verify.mockReturnValue(mockPayload);
      mockRedisService.get.mockResolvedValue(
        JSON.stringify({ tenantId: 'tenant-789' })
      );
      mockRedisService.exists.mockResolvedValue(true); // Already scanned
      mockPrismaService.student.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(mockStudent);

      const result = await service.verifyAndMarkAttendance(
        { token: mockToken, studentId: 'student-001' },

      expect(result.success).toBe(false);

    it('should reject expired token', async () => {

        error.name = 'TokenExpiredError';
        throw error;
      });

        )
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);

    it('should reject if session not found in Redis', async () => {

      ).rejects.toThrow('QR session has expired or is invalid');

================
File: apps/api/src/modules/attendance/services/qr-attendance.service.ts
================
import { Injectable, Logger, UnauthorizedException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { AttendanceStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../database/prisma.service';
import { RedisService } from '../../../common/services/redis.service';

/**
 * QR Attendance Token Payload
 */
interface QRAttendanceToken {
  /** Session ID to bind QR to specific attendance session */
  sessionId: string;
  /** Class ID */
  classId?: string;
  /** Stream ID (optional) */
  streamId?: string;
  /** Tenant ID for multi-tenant security */
  tenantId: string;
  /** Teacher/staff ID who created the session */
  createdBy: string;
  /** Session type */
  type: 'class_attendance' | 'event_attendance';
  /** Creation timestamp */
  iat: number;
  /** Expiration timestamp */
  exp: number;
}

/**
 * QR Scan Request
 */
export interface QRScanRequest {
  token: string;
  studentId: string;
  scannedAt?: Date;
}

/**
 * QR Session Configuration
 */
export interface QRSessionConfig {
  classId?: string;
  streamId?: string;
  tenantId: string;
  createdBy: string;
  type: 'class_attendance' | 'event_attendance';
  expiryMinutes?: number;
}

/**
 * QR Attendance Service
 * 
 * Implements secure QR code-based attendance with:
 * - JWT-based time-limited tokens (5-minute default expiry)
 * - Session binding to specific class/stream
 * - Replay attack prevention (one scan per student per session)
 * - Tenant isolation
 * - Server-side validation
 * - Duplicate scan detection
 * 
 * Security Features:
 * - Tokens cannot be reused across sessions
 * - Tokens expire after configured time (default 5 minutes)
 * - Each student can only scan once per session
 * - Tokens are bound to specific tenant and class
 * - Server-side verification prevents tampering
 */
@Injectable()
export class QRAttendanceService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(QRAttendanceService.name);
  private readonly QR_SCANS_PREFIX = 'qr:scans:';
  private readonly DEFAULT_EXPIRY_MINUTES = 5;

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly jwtService: JwtService,
    private readonly configService: ConfigService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Generate a secure QR attendance token
   */
  async generateQRToken(config: QRSessionConfig): Promise<{
    token: string;
    sessionId: string;
    expiresAt: Date;
  }> {
    // Generate unique session ID
    const sessionId = `qr-session-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`;
    
    const expiryMinutes = config.expiryMinutes || this.DEFAULT_EXPIRY_MINUTES;
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + expiryMinutes * 60 * 1000);

    // Create JWT payload
    const payload: QRAttendanceToken = {
      sessionId,
      classId: config.classId,
      streamId: config.streamId,
      tenantId: config.tenantId,
      createdBy: config.createdBy,
      type: config.type,
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(expiresAt.getTime() / 1000),
    };

    // Sign JWT with short-lived secret
    const token = this.jwtService.sign(payload, {
      secret: this.configService.get('JWT_SECRET'),
      expiresIn: `${expiryMinutes}m`,
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Generated QR token for session ${sessionId}, class ${config.classId}, expires in ${expiryMinutes} minutes`
    );

    // Store session metadata in Redis for additional validation
    await this.redis.set(
      `qr:session:${sessionId}`,
      JSON.stringify({
        classId: config.classId,
        streamId: config.streamId,
        tenantId: config.tenantId,
        createdBy: config.createdBy,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      }),
      expiryMinutes * 60 + 60 // Extra minute buffer
    );

    return {
      token,
      sessionId,
      expiresAt,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verify and process QR code scan
   */
  async verifyAndMarkAttendance(
    request: QRScanRequest,
    tenantId: string
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    attendanceId?: string;
    student?: any;
    message: string;
  }> {
    try {
      // 1. Verify JWT token
      const payload = await this.verifyQRToken(request.token);

      // 2. Verify tenant match (prevent cross-tenant attacks)
      if (payload.tenantId !== tenantId) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid QR code for this school');
      }

      // 3. Check if student exists and belongs to the class
      const student = await this.prisma.student.findUnique({
        where: {
          id: request.studentId,
          tenantId,
        },
        include: {
          currentClass: true,
        },
      });

      if (!student) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Student not found');
      }

      // 4. Verify student is in the correct class (if class-specific QR)
      if (payload.classId && student.currentClassId !== payload.classId) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `This QR code is for ${payload.classId} only. Student is in ${student.currentClassId}.`
        );
      }

      // 5. Check for duplicate scan (replay attack prevention)
      const scanKey = this.getScanKey(payload.sessionId, request.studentId);
      const alreadyScanned = await this.redis.exists(scanKey);

      if (alreadyScanned) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: 'Already marked present in this session',
        };
      }

      // 6. Mark attendance
      const scannedAt = request.scannedAt || new Date();
      const attendance = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.create({
        data: {
          studentId: request.studentId,
          classId: student.currentClassId!,
          streamId: student.currentStreamId,
          date: scannedAt,
          status: this.calculateAttendanceStatus(scannedAt),
          remarks: `QR scan - Session: ${payload.sessionId} (DYNAMIC_QR)`,
          markedBy: payload.createdBy,
          arrivalTime: scannedAt,
          tenantId,
        },
      });

      // 7. Record scan to prevent duplicates
      await this.redis.set(
        scanKey,
        JSON.stringify({
          attendanceId: attendance.id,
          scannedAt: scannedAt.toISOString(),
          studentId: request.studentId,
        }),
        // Keep record for session expiry + 1 hour
        (payload.exp - payload.iat) + 3600
      );

      this.logger.log(
        `QR attendance marked: Student ${request.studentId}, ` +
        `Session ${payload.sessionId}, Attendance ${attendance.id}`
      );

      return {
        success: true,
        attendanceId: attendance.id,
        student: {
          id: student.id,
          name: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
          admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
          class: student.currentClass?.name,
        },
        message: `Attendance marked successfully for ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof UnauthorizedException || error instanceof BadRequestException) {
        throw error;
      }

      this.logger.error(`QR scan verification failed: ${error.message}`, error.stack);
      
      if (error.name === 'TokenExpiredError') {
        throw new UnauthorizedException('QR code has expired. Please request a new one.');
      }

      if (error.name === 'JsonWebTokenError') {
        throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid QR code');
      }

      throw new BadRequestException('Failed to process QR scan');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Verify QR token and extract payload
   */
  private async verifyQRToken(token: string): Promise<QRAttendanceToken> {
    try {
      const payload = this.jwtService.verify<QRAttendanceToken>(token, {
        secret: this.configService.get('JWT_SECRET'),
      });

      // Additional session validation from Redis
      const sessionKey = `qr:session:${payload.sessionId}`;
      const sessionData = await this.redis.get(sessionKey);

      if (!sessionData) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException('QR session has expired or is invalid');
      }

      return payload;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof UnauthorizedException) {
        throw error;
      }
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired QR code');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Calculate attendance status based on time
   */
  private calculateAttendanceStatus(scannedAt: Date): AttendanceStatus {
    const hour = scannedAt.getHours();
    const minute = scannedAt.getMinutes();

    // Before 8:15 AM = Present
    // 8:15 AM - 9:00 AM = Late
    // After 9:00 AM = Absent (shouldn't mark via QR)
    
    if (hour < 8 || (hour === 8 && minute < 15)) {
      return AttendanceStatus.PRESENT;
    } else if (hour < 9) {
      return AttendanceStatus.LATE;
    } else {
      return AttendanceStatus.PRESENT; // Still mark as present if scanning after hours
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get scan key for Redis duplicate detection
   */
  private getScanKey(sessionId: string, studentId: string): string {
    return `${this.QR_SCANS_PREFIX}${sessionId}:${studentId}`;
  }

  /**
   * Get active session information
   */
  async getSessionInfo(sessionId: string): Promise<any> {
    const sessionKey = `qr:session:${sessionId}`;
    const sessionData = await this.redis.get(sessionKey);

    if (!sessionData) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Session not found or expired');
    }

    const session = JSON.parse(sessionData);

    // Get scan count for this session
    const scanKeys = await this.redis.keys(`${this.QR_SCANS_PREFIX}${sessionId}:*`);

    return {
      sessionId,
      ...session,
      scanCount: scanKeys.length,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Invalidate a QR session (emergency stop)
   */
  async invalidateSession(sessionId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const sessionKey = `qr:session:${sessionId}`;
    const sessionData = await this.redis.get(sessionKey);

    if (sessionData) {
      const session = JSON.parse(sessionData);
      
      // Verify tenant owns this session
      if (session.tenantId !== tenantId) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException('Cannot invalidate session from another school');
      }

      await this.redis.del(sessionKey);
      this.logger.log(`QR session ${sessionId} invalidated by tenant ${tenantId}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get session statistics (for teacher dashboard)
   */
  async getSessionStats(sessionId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<{
    sessionId: string;
    totalScans: number;
    uniqueStudents: string[];
    isActive: boolean;
  }> {
    const sessionKey = `qr:session:${sessionId}`;
    const sessionData = await this.redis.get(sessionKey);

    if (!sessionData) {
      return {
        sessionId,
        totalScans: 0,
        uniqueStudents: [],
        isActive: false,
      };
    }

    const session = JSON.parse(sessionData);

    // Verify tenant
    if (session.tenantId !== tenantId) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Cannot access session from another school');
    }

    // Get all scans for this session
    const scanKeys = await this.redis.keys(`${this.QR_SCANS_PREFIX}${sessionId}:*`);
    
    const uniqueStudents = scanKeys.map(key => {
      const parts = key.split(':');
      return parts[parts.length - 1]; // Extract student ID
    });

    return {
      sessionId,
      totalScans: scanKeys.length,
      uniqueStudents,
      isActive: true,
    };
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts
