import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { S3Client, PutObjectCommand, HeadObjectCommand, GetObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { Upload } from '@aws-sdk/lib-storage';
import { createReadStream, createWriteStream, existsSync, mkdirSync, statSync, readdirSync, unlinkSync } from 'fs';
import { exec } from 'child_process';
import { promisify } from 'util';
import { createHash, randomBytes, createCipheriv, createDecipheriv } from 'crypto';
import { pipeline } from 'stream/promises';
import { createGzip, createGunzip } from 'zlib';
import * as path from 'path';

const execAsync = promisify(exec);

export interface BackupResult {
  success: boolean;
  backupId: string;
  filename: string;
  size: number;
  checksum: string;
  s3Key?: string;
  localPath?: string;
  duration: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface RestoreResult {
  success: boolean;
  backupId: string;
  duration: number;
  recordsRestored?: number;
  error?: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class BackupService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(BackupService.name);
  private readonly s3Client: S3Client;
  private readonly s3Bucket: string;
  private readonly s3Enabled: boolean;
  private readonly localBackupDir: string;
  private readonly encryptionKey: Buffer;
  private readonly dbConfig: {
    host: string;
    port: string;
    database: string;
    user: string;
    password: string;
  };

  constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {
    // S3 Configuration
    const s3Endpoint = this.configService.get<string>('S3_ENDPOINT');
    const s3AccessKey = this.configService.get<string>('S3_ACCESS_KEY');
    const s3SecretKey = this.configService.get<string>('S3_SECRET_KEY');
    const s3Region = this.configService.get<string>('S3_REGION', 'us-east-1');
    
    this.s3Bucket = this.configService.get<string>('S3_BUCKET', 'krypton-backups');
    this.s3Enabled = !!s3Endpoint && !!s3AccessKey && !!s3SecretKey;

    if (this.s3Enabled) {
      this.s3Client = new S3Client({
        endpoint: s3Endpoint,
        region: s3Region,
        credentials: {
          accessKeyId: s3AccessKey!,
          secretAccessKey: s3SecretKey!,
        },
        forcePathStyle: true, // Required for MinIO
      });
      this.logger.log('S3 backup storage configured');
    } else {
      this.logger.warn('S3 backup storage not configured - backups will be local only');
    }

    // Local backup directory
    this.localBackupDir = this.configService.get<string>('BACKUP_DIR', './backups');
    if (!existsSync(this.localBackupDir)) {
      mkdirSync(this.localBackupDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    // Encryption key for backup encryption
    const encryptionMasterKey = this.configService.get<string>('ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY');
    if (!encryptionMasterKey || encryptionMasterKey.length < 32) {
      throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY must be at least 32 characters for backup encryption');
    }
    // Derive a 32-byte key from master key for AES-256
    this.encryptionKey = createHash('sha256').update(encryptionMasterKey).digest();

    // Database configuration from DATABASE_URL or individual env vars
    const databaseUrl = this.configService.get<string>('DATABASE_URL');
    if (databaseUrl) {
      const url = new URL(databaseUrl);
      this.dbConfig = {
        host: url.hostname,
        port: url.port || '5432',
        database: url.pathname.slice(1),
        user: url.username,
        password: url.password,
      };
    } else {
      this.dbConfig = {
        host: this.configService.get<string>('POSTGRES_HOST', 'localhost'),
        port: this.configService.get<string>('POSTGRES_PORT', '5432'),
        database: this.configService.get<string>('POSTGRES_DB', 'krypton'),
        user: this.configService.get<string>('POSTGRES_USER', 'krypton'),
        password: this.configService.get<string>('POSTGRES_PASSWORD', ''),
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create a full database backup
   * Process: pg_dump -> gzip -> encrypt -> upload to S3
   */
  async createBackup(): Promise<BackupResult> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const backupId = `backup_${Date.now()}_${randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
    const filename = `${backupId}.sql.gz.enc`;
    const localPath = path.join(this.localBackupDir, filename);

    this.logger.log(`Starting database backup: ${backupId}`);

    try {
      // Step 1: Execute pg_dump with gzip compression
      const pgDumpFile = path.join(this.localBackupDir, `${backupId}.sql`);
      const pgDumpCommand = `pg_dump -h ${this.dbConfig.host} -p ${this.dbConfig.port} -U ${this.dbConfig.user} -d ${this.dbConfig.database} --no-owner --no-privileges --clean --if-exists -f "${pgDumpFile}"`;
      
      this.logger.log('Executing pg_dump...');
      await execAsync(pgDumpCommand, {
        env: {
          ...process.env,
          PGPASSWORD: this.dbConfig.password,
        },
      });

      // Step 2: Compress with gzip
      const gzipFile = `${pgDumpFile}.gz`;
      const readStream = createReadStream(pgDumpFile);
      const writeStream = createWriteStream(gzipFile);
      const gzip = createGzip({ level: 9 });
      await pipeline(readStream, gzip, writeStream);

      // Step 3: Encrypt with AES-256-CBC
      const encryptedFile = `${gzipFile}.enc`;
      await this.encryptFile(gzipFile, encryptedFile);

      // Step 4: Calculate checksum of encrypted file
      const checksum = await this.calculateChecksum(encryptedFile);

      // Step 5: Get file size (cross-platform)
      const stats = statSync(encryptedFile);
      const size = stats.size;

      // Step 6: Upload to S3 if enabled
      let s3Key: string | undefined;
      if (this.s3Enabled) {
        s3Key = `backups/${filename}`;
        await this.uploadToS3(encryptedFile, s3Key, checksum);
        this.logger.log(`Backup uploaded to S3: ${s3Key}`);
      }

      // Step 7: Clean up intermediate files
      try {
        if (existsSync(pgDumpFile)) unlinkSync(pgDumpFile);
        if (existsSync(gzipFile)) unlinkSync(gzipFile);
      } catch (cleanupErr: any) {
        this.logger.warn(`Failed to clean up intermediate backup files: ${cleanupErr.message}`);
      }

      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.logger.log(`Backup completed successfully in ${duration}ms: ${backupId}`);

      return {
        success: true,
        backupId,
        filename,
        size,
        checksum,
        s3Key,
        localPath: encryptedFile,
        duration,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.logger.error(`Backup failed after ${duration}ms: ${error.message}`, error.stack);
      
      return {
        success: false,
        backupId,
        filename,
        size: 0,
        checksum: '',
        duration,
        error: error.message,
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Verify a backup by downloading from S3 (if needed) and checking integrity
   */
  async verifyBackup(backupId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    this.logger.log(`Verifying backup: ${backupId}`);

    try {
      const filename = backupId.includes('.') ? backupId : `${backupId}.sql.gz.enc`;
      const localPath = path.join(this.localBackupDir, filename);

      // Download from S3 if not local
      if (!existsSync(localPath) && this.s3Enabled) {
        const s3Key = `backups/${filename}`;
        await this.downloadFromS3(s3Key, localPath);
      }

      if (!existsSync(localPath)) {
        this.logger.error(`Backup file not found: ${localPath}`);
        return false;
      }

      // Verify file is readable and encrypted
      const checksum = await this.calculateChecksum(localPath);
      this.logger.log(`Backup checksum: ${checksum}`);

      // Try to decrypt and decompress first few bytes to verify integrity
      const decryptedFile = `${localPath}.dec`;
      const decompressedFile = `${decryptedFile}.sql`;

      await this.decryptFile(localPath, decryptedFile);
      
      // Verify it's valid gzip by decompressing
      const readStream = createReadStream(decryptedFile);
      const writeStream = createWriteStream(decompressedFile);
      const gunzip = createGunzip();
      await pipeline(readStream, gunzip, writeStream);

      // Clean up verification files
      await execAsync(`rm -f "${decryptedFile}" "${decompressedFile}"`);

      this.logger.log(`Backup verification successful: ${backupId}`);
      return true;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Backup verification failed: ${error.message}`, error.stack);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Restore database from backup
   * WARNING: This will drop existing data if --clean flag was used in pg_dump
   */
  async restoreBackup(backupId: string, targetDatabase?: string): Promise<RestoreResult> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    this.logger.warn(`Starting database restore from backup: ${backupId}`);

    try {
      const filename = backupId.includes('.') ? backupId : `${backupId}.sql.gz.enc`;
      const localPath = path.join(this.localBackupDir, filename);

      // Download from S3 if not local
      if (!existsSync(localPath) && this.s3Enabled) {
        const s3Key = `backups/${filename}`;
        this.logger.log(`Downloading backup from S3: ${s3Key}`);
        await this.downloadFromS3(s3Key, localPath);
      }

      if (!existsSync(localPath)) {
        throw new Error(`Backup file not found: ${localPath}`);
      }

      // Step 1: Decrypt
      const decryptedFile = `${localPath}.dec`;
      this.logger.log('Decrypting backup...');
      await this.decryptFile(localPath, decryptedFile);

      // Step 2: Decompress
      const decompressedFile = `${decryptedFile}.sql`;
      this.logger.log('Decompressing backup...');
      const readStream = createReadStream(decryptedFile);
      const writeStream = createWriteStream(decompressedFile);
      const gunzip = createGunzip();
      await pipeline(readStream, gunzip, writeStream);

      // Step 3: Restore with psql
      const dbName = targetDatabase || this.dbConfig.database;
      this.logger.log(`Restoring to database: ${dbName}`);
      const psqlCommand = `psql -h ${this.dbConfig.host} -p ${this.dbConfig.port} -U ${this.dbConfig.user} -d ${dbName} -f "${decompressedFile}"`;
      
      const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(psqlCommand, {
        env: {
          ...process.env,
          PGPASSWORD: this.dbConfig.password,
        },
      });
      
      // Clean up temporary files
      try {
        if (existsSync(decryptedFile)) unlinkSync(decryptedFile);
        if (existsSync(decompressedFile)) unlinkSync(decompressedFile);
      } catch (cleanupErr: any) {
        this.logger.warn(`Failed to clean up temporary restore files: ${cleanupErr.message}`);
      }

      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.logger.log(`Restore completed successfully in ${duration}ms`);

      return {
        success: true,
        backupId,
        duration,
        recordsRestored: this.extractRecordCount(stdout + stderr),
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.logger.error(`Restore failed after ${duration}ms: ${error.message}`, error.stack);
      
      return {
        success: false,
        backupId,
        duration,
        error: error.message,
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * List all available backups (S3 and local)
   */
  async listBackups(): Promise<Array<{ backupId: string; source: string; size: number; timestamp: Date }>> {
    const backups: Array<{ backupId: string; source: string; size: number; timestamp: Date }> = [];

    // List local backups
    try {
      if (existsSync(this.localBackupDir)) {
        const files = readdirSync(this.localBackupDir);
        for (const file of files) {
          if (file.endsWith('.enc')) {
            const filePath = path.join(this.localBackupDir, file);
            const stats = statSync(filePath);
            const backupId = file.replace(/\.sql\.gz\.enc$/, '').replace(/\.enc$/, '');
            backups.push({
              backupId,
              source: 'local',
              size: stats.size,
              timestamp: stats.mtime,
            });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.warn(`Failed to list local backups: ${error.message}`);
    }

    return backups;
  }

  /**
   * Delete old backups (retention policy)
   */
  async pruneOldBackups(retentionDays: number = 14): Promise<number> {
    this.logger.log(`Pruning backups older than ${retentionDays} days`);
    
    try {
      let deletedCount = 0;
      if (existsSync(this.localBackupDir)) {
        const files = readdirSync(this.localBackupDir);
        const cutoffTime = Date.now() - retentionDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        for (const file of files) {
          if (file.startsWith('backup_') && file.endsWith('.enc')) {
            const filePath = path.join(this.localBackupDir, file);
            const stats = statSync(filePath);
            if (stats.mtimeMs < cutoffTime) {
              unlinkSync(filePath);
              deletedCount++;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      this.logger.log(`Pruned ${deletedCount} old backups`);
      return deletedCount;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to prune backups: ${error.message}`);
      return 0;
    }
  }

  // ========== PRIVATE HELPER METHODS ==========

  /**
   * Encrypt file using AES-256-CBC
   */
  private async encryptFile(inputPath: string, outputPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const iv = randomBytes(16);
    const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-cbc', this.encryptionKey, iv);

    const input = createReadStream(inputPath);
    const output = createWriteStream(outputPath);

    // Write IV as first 16 bytes
    output.write(iv);

    await pipeline(input, cipher, output);
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt file using AES-256-CBC
   */
  private async decryptFile(inputPath: string, outputPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const input = createReadStream(inputPath);
    const output = createWriteStream(outputPath);

    // Read IV from first 16 bytes
    const iv = await this.readBytes(inputPath, 16);
    const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-cbc', this.encryptionKey, iv);

    // Skip first 16 bytes (IV) when decrypting
    const encryptedStream = createReadStream(inputPath, { start: 16 });

    await pipeline(encryptedStream, decipher, output);
  }

  /**
   * Read first N bytes from file
   */
  private async readBytes(filePath: string, count: number): Promise<Buffer> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
      const stream = createReadStream(filePath, { start: 0, end: count - 1 });
      
      stream.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(Buffer.isBuffer(chunk) ? chunk : Buffer.from(chunk)));
      stream.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks)));
      stream.on('error', reject);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Calculate SHA-256 checksum of file
   */
  private async calculateChecksum(filePath: string): Promise<string> {
    const hash = createHash('sha256');
    const stream = createReadStream(filePath);

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      stream.on('data', (chunk) => hash.update(chunk));
      stream.on('end', () => resolve(hash.digest('hex')));
      stream.on('error', reject);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Upload file to S3 with multipart upload for large files
   */
  private async uploadToS3(filePath: string, s3Key: string, checksum: string): Promise<void> {
    const fileStream = createReadStream(filePath);
    
    const upload = new Upload({
      client: this.s3Client,
      params: {
        Bucket: this.s3Bucket,
        Key: s3Key,
        Body: fileStream,
        Metadata: {
          checksum,
          'backup-version': '1.0',
        },
      },
    });

    await upload.done();
  }

  /**
   * Download file from S3
   */
  private async downloadFromS3(s3Key: string, localPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const command = new GetObjectCommand({
      Bucket: this.s3Bucket,
      Key: s3Key,
    });

    const response = await this.s3Client.send(command);
    const writeStream = createWriteStream(localPath);

    await pipeline(response.Body as any, writeStream);
  }

  /**
   * Extract record count from psql output
   */
  private extractRecordCount(output: string): number {
    const match = output.match(/(\d+)\s+rows/i);
    return match ? parseInt(match[1]) : 0;
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ForbiddenException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateBehaviorDto } from './dto/create-behavior.dto';
import { UpdateBehaviorDto } from './dto/update-behavior.dto';
import { QueryBehaviorDto } from './dto/query-behavior.dto';

@Injectable()
export class BehaviorService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async create(dto: CreateBehaviorDto, userId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student belongs to this tenant
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    const behaviorRecord = await this.prisma.behaviorRecord.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        behaviorType: dto.behaviorType,
        category: dto.category,
        title: dto.title,
        description: dto.description,
        incidentDate: new Date(dto.incidentDate),
        location: dto.location,
        points: dto.points || 0,
        actionTaken: dto.actionTaken,
        followUpRequired: dto.followUpRequired || false,
        followUpDate: dto.followUpDate ? new Date(dto.followUpDate) : null,
        parentNotified: dto.parentNotified || false,
        parentNotifiedAt: dto.parentNotified ? new Date() : null,
        recordedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return behaviorRecord;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryBehaviorDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (query.studentId) {
      where.studentId = query.studentId;
    }

    if (query.behaviorType) {
      where.behaviorType = query.behaviorType;
    }

    if (query.category) {
      where.category = query.category;
    }

    if (query.startDate || query.endDate) {
      where.incidentDate = {};
      if (query.startDate) {
        where.incidentDate.gte = new Date(query.startDate);
      }
      if (query.endDate) {
        where.incidentDate.lte = new Date(query.endDate);
      }
    }

    const page = query.page || 1;
    const limit = query.limit || 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const [records, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: {
          incidentDate: 'desc',
        },
        skip,
        take: limit,
      }),
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: records,
      pagination: {
        total,
        page,
        limit,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      },
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const record = await this.prisma.behaviorRecord.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!record) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Behavior record not found');
    }

    return record;
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateBehaviorDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify record exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    const updateData: any = {};

    if (dto.behaviorType) updateData.behaviorType = dto.behaviorType;
    if (dto.category) updateData.category = dto.category;
    if (dto.title) updateData.title = dto.title;
    if (dto.description !== undefined) updateData.description = dto.description;
    if (dto.incidentDate) updateData.incidentDate = new Date(dto.incidentDate);
    if (dto.location !== undefined) updateData.location = dto.location;
    if (dto.points !== undefined) updateData.points = dto.points;
    if (dto.actionTaken !== undefined) updateData.actionTaken = dto.actionTaken;
    if (dto.followUpRequired !== undefined) updateData.followUpRequired = dto.followUpRequired;
    if (dto.followUpDate !== undefined) updateData.followUpDate = dto.followUpDate ? new Date(dto.followUpDate) : null;
    if (dto.parentNotified !== undefined) {
      updateData.parentNotified = dto.parentNotified;
      if (dto.parentNotified) {
        updateData.parentNotifiedAt = new Date();
      }
    }

    const record = await this.prisma.behaviorRecord.update({
      where: { id },
      data: updateData,
    });

    return record;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify record exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    await this.prisma.behaviorRecord.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    return { message: 'Behavior record deleted successfully' };
  }

  // Parent-facing methods
  async getStudentBehavior(
    studentId: string,
    guardianId: string,
    query: QueryBehaviorDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access to this student
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: {
        guardianId,
        studentId,
      },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    return this.findAll({ ...query, studentId });
  }

  // Get behavior summary/statistics
  async getBehaviorSummary(studentId: string, guardianId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // If guardian is provided, verify access
    if (guardianId) {
      const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
        where: { guardianId, studentId },
      });

      if (!link) {
        throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
      }
    }

    const thisWeek = new Date();
    thisWeek.setDate(thisWeek.getDate() - 7);
    thisWeek.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const thisMonth = new Date();
    thisMonth.setDate(1);
    thisMonth.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const where = {
      tenantId,
      studentId,
    };

    const [positiveCount, negativeCount, weeklyRecords, monthlyRecords, totalPoints, byCategory] = await Promise.all([
      // Positive behaviors
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.count({
        where: { ...where, behaviorType: 'POSITIVE' },
      }),
      // Negative behaviors
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.count({
        where: { ...where, behaviorType: 'NEGATIVE' },
      }),
      // This week's records
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          incidentDate: { gte: thisWeek },
        },
      }),
      // This month's records
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          incidentDate: { gte: thisMonth },
        },
      }),
      // Total points
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.aggregate({
        where,
        _sum: {
          points: true,
        },
      }),
      // Records by category (this month)
      this.prisma.behaviorRecord.groupBy({
        by: ['category', 'behaviorType'],
        where: {
          ...where,
          incidentDate: { gte: thisMonth },
        },
        _count: true,
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      totals: {
        positive: positiveCount,
        negative: negativeCount,
        points: totalPoints._sum.points || 0,
      },
      thisWeek: weeklyRecords,
      thisMonth: monthlyRecords,
      byCategory: byCategory.map((item) => ({
        category: item.category,
        behaviorType: item.behaviorType,
        count: item._count,
      })),
    };
  }

  // Get recent behavior records for dashboard
  async getRecentBehavior(studentId: string, limit: number = 5) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const records = await this.prisma.behaviorRecord.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId,
      },
      orderBy: {
        incidentDate: 'desc',
      },
      take: limit,
    });

    return records;
  }
}

import { IsString, IsEnum, IsOptional, IsBoolean, IsInt, IsUUID, IsDateString } from 'class-validator';

export enum BehaviorType {
  POSITIVE = 'POSITIVE',
  NEGATIVE = 'NEGATIVE',
  NEUTRAL = 'NEUTRAL',
}

export enum BehaviorCategory {
  // Positive
  ACADEMIC_EXCELLENCE = 'ACADEMIC_EXCELLENCE',
  GOOD_CONDUCT = 'GOOD_CONDUCT',
  LEADERSHIP = 'LEADERSHIP',
  HELPFULNESS = 'HELPFULNESS',
  PARTICIPATION = 'PARTICIPATION',
  PUNCTUALITY = 'PUNCTUALITY',
  
  // Negative
  LATE_ARRIVAL = 'LATE_ARRIVAL',
  ABSENCE = 'ABSENCE',
  DISRUPTION = 'DISRUPTION',
  INCOMPLETE_WORK = 'INCOMPLETE_WORK',
  UNIFORM_VIOLATION = 'UNIFORM_VIOLATION',
  BULLYING = 'BULLYING',
  DISRESPECT = 'DISRESPECT',
  
  // Neutral
  OBSERVATION = 'OBSERVATION',
  OTHER = 'OTHER',
}

export class CreateBehaviorDto {
  @IsUUID()
  studentId: string;

  @IsEnum(BehaviorType)
  behaviorType: BehaviorType;

  @IsEnum(BehaviorCategory)
  category: BehaviorCategory;

  @IsString()
  title: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsOptional()
  description?: string;

  @IsDateString()
  incidentDate: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsOptional()
  location?: string;

  @IsInt()
  @IsOptional()
  points?: number = 0;

  @IsString()
  @IsOptional()
  actionTaken?: string;

  @IsBoolean()
  @IsOptional()
  followUpRequired?: boolean = false;

  @IsDateString()
  @IsOptional()
  followUpDate?: string;

  @IsBoolean()
  @IsOptional()
  parentNotified?: boolean = false;
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ForbiddenException,
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateAvailabilityDto } from './dto/create-availability.dto';
import { CreateBookingDto, BookingStatus } from './dto/create-booking.dto';
import { UpdateBookingDto, CancelBookingDto } from './dto/update-booking.dto';

@Injectable()
export class BookingsService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ===== TEACHER AVAILABILITY =====

  async createAvailability(teacherId: string, dto: CreateAvailabilityDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify teacher exists
    const teacher = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
      where: { id: teacherId, tenantId, isTeacher: true },
    });

    if (!teacher) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Teacher not found');
    }

    // Validate time format and logic
    this.validateTimeSlot(dto.startTime, dto.endTime);

    const availability = await this.prisma.teacherAvailability.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        teacherId,
        dayOfWeek: dto.dayOfWeek,
        startTime: dto.startTime,
        endTime: dto.endTime,
        slotDuration: dto.slotDuration || 30,
        isActive: dto.isActive ?? true,
        effectiveFrom: dto.effectiveFrom ? new Date(dto.effectiveFrom) : null,
        effectiveUntil: dto.effectiveUntil ? new Date(dto.effectiveUntil) : null,
      },
    });

    return availability;
  }

  async getTeacherAvailability(teacherId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const availability = await this.prisma.teacherAvailability.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        teacherId,
        isActive: true,
      },
      orderBy: [
        { dayOfWeek: 'asc' },
        { startTime: 'asc' },
      ],
    });

    return availability;
  }

  async updateAvailability(id: string, dto: Partial<CreateAvailabilityDto>) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const availability = await this.prisma.teacherAvailability.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!availability) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Availability not found');
    }

    if (dto.startTime && dto.endTime) {
      this.validateTimeSlot(dto.startTime, dto.endTime);
    }

    return this.prisma.teacherAvailability.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        dayOfWeek: dto.dayOfWeek,
        startTime: dto.startTime,
        endTime: dto.endTime,
        slotDuration: dto.slotDuration,
        isActive: dto.isActive,
        effectiveFrom: dto.effectiveFrom ? new Date(dto.effectiveFrom) : undefined,
        effectiveUntil: dto.effectiveUntil ? new Date(dto.effectiveUntil) : undefined,
      },
    });
  }

  async deleteAvailability(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const availability = await this.prisma.teacherAvailability.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!availability) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Availability not found');
    }

    await this.prisma.teacherAvailability.delete({ where: { id } });

    return { message: 'Availability deleted successfully' };
  }

  // ===== BOOKINGS =====

  async createBooking(guardianId: string, dto: CreateBookingDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access to student
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: { guardianId, studentId: dto.studentId },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    // Verify teacher exists
    const teacher = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.teacherId, tenantId, isTeacher: true },
    });

    if (!teacher) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Teacher not found');
    }

    // Validate time slot
    this.validateTimeSlot(dto.startTime, dto.endTime);

    const bookingDate = new Date(dto.bookingDate);
    bookingDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Check for conflicts
    const conflict = await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        teacherId: dto.teacherId,
        bookingDate,
        status: {
          in: ['PENDING', 'CONFIRMED'],
        },
        OR: [
          {
            AND: [
              { startTime: { lte: dto.startTime } },
              { endTime: { gt: dto.startTime } },
            ],
          },
          {
            AND: [
              { startTime: { lt: dto.endTime } },
              { endTime: { gte: dto.endTime } },
            ],
          },
          {
            AND: [
              { startTime: { gte: dto.startTime } },
              { endTime: { lte: dto.endTime } },
            ],
          },
        ],
      },
    });

    if (conflict) {
      throw new ConflictException('This time slot is already booked');
    }

    const booking = await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        guardianId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        teacherId: dto.teacherId,
        bookingDate,
        startTime: dto.startTime,
        endTime: dto.endTime,
        purpose: dto.purpose,
        topic: dto.topic,
        status: BookingStatus.PENDING,
        meetingType: dto.meetingType || 'IN_PERSON',
        location: dto.location,
        meetingLink: dto.meetingLink,
        parentNotes: dto.parentNotes,
      },
    });

    return booking;
  }

  async getBookings(filters?: {
    guardianId?: string;
    teacherId?: string;
    studentId?: string;
    status?: BookingStatus;
    startDate?: string;
    endDate?: string;
  }) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (filters?.guardianId) {
      where.guardianId = filters.guardianId;
    }

    if (filters?.teacherId) {
      where.teacherId = filters.teacherId;
    }

    if (filters?.studentId) {
      where.studentId = filters.studentId;
    }

    if (filters?.status) {
      where.status = filters.status;
    }

    if (filters?.startDate || filters?.endDate) {
      where.bookingDate = {};
      if (filters.startDate) {
        where.bookingDate.gte = new Date(filters.startDate);
      }
      if (filters.endDate) {
        where.bookingDate.lte = new Date(filters.endDate);
      }
    }

    const bookings = await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: [
        { bookingDate: 'asc' },
        { startTime: 'asc' },
      ],
    });

    return bookings;
  }

  async getBooking(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const booking = await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!booking) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Booking not found');
    }

    return booking;
  }

  async updateBooking(id: string, dto: UpdateBookingDto, userId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const booking = await this.getBooking(id);

    // Only pending or confirmed bookings can be updated
    if (!['PENDING', 'CONFIRMED'].includes(booking.status)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot update this booking');
    }

    return this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: dto.status,
        teacherNotes: dto.teacherNotes,
        parentNotes: dto.parentNotes,
        location: dto.location,
        meetingLink: dto.meetingLink,
      },
    });
  }

  async confirmBooking(id: string, teacherId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const booking = await this.getBooking(id);

    // Verify teacher owns this booking
    if (booking.teacherId !== teacherId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You can only confirm your own bookings');
    }

    if (booking.status !== 'PENDING') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Only pending bookings can be confirmed');
    }

    return this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { status: BookingStatus.CONFIRMED },
    });
  }

  async cancelBooking(id: string, userId: string, dto: CancelBookingDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const booking = await this.getBooking(id);

    if (booking.status === 'CANCELLED') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Booking is already cancelled');
    }

    if (booking.status === 'COMPLETED') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot cancel completed booking');
    }

    return this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: BookingStatus.CANCELLED,
        cancelledBy: userId,
        cancellationReason: dto.cancellationReason,
        cancelledAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
  }

  async completeBooking(id: string, teacherId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const booking = await this.getBooking(id);

    if (booking.teacherId !== teacherId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You can only complete your own bookings');
    }

    if (booking.status !== 'CONFIRMED') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Only confirmed bookings can be completed');
    }

    return this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { status: BookingStatus.COMPLETED },
    });
  }

  // Get available slots for a teacher on a specific date
  async getAvailableSlots(teacherId: string, date: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const bookingDate = new Date(date);
    const dayOfWeek = bookingDate.getDay() || 7; // Convert Sunday from 0 to 7

    // Get teacher's availability for this day
    const availability = await this.prisma.teacherAvailability.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        teacherId,
        dayOfWeek,
        isActive: true,
        OR: [
          { effectiveFrom: null },
          { effectiveFrom: { lte: bookingDate } },
        ],
        AND: [
          {
            OR: [
              { effectiveUntil: null },
              { effectiveUntil: { gte: bookingDate } },
            ],
          },
        ],
      },
    });

    if (availability.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    // Get existing bookings for this date
    const existingBookings = await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        teacherId,
        bookingDate,
        status: {
          in: ['PENDING', 'CONFIRMED'],
        },
      },
      select: {
        startTime: true,
        endTime: true,
      },
    });

    // Generate available slots
    const slots: any[] = [];

    for (const avail of availability) {
      const slotDuration = avail.slotDuration;
      let currentTime = avail.startTime;

      while (this.isTimeBefore(currentTime, avail.endTime)) {
        const slotEnd = this.addMinutes(currentTime, slotDuration);

        if (this.isTimeBefore(slotEnd, avail.endTime) || slotEnd === avail.endTime) {
          // Check if slot conflicts with existing bookings
          const isBooked = existingBookings.some((booking) =>
            this.timeSlotsOverlap(currentTime, slotEnd, booking.startTime, booking.endTime),
          );

          if (!isBooked) {
            slots.push({
              startTime: currentTime,
              endTime: slotEnd,
              duration: slotDuration,
            });
          }
        }

        currentTime = slotEnd;
      }
    }

    return slots;
  }

  // Helper methods

  private validateTimeSlot(startTime: string, endTime: string) {
    const timeRegex = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)$/;

    if (!timeRegex.test(startTime) || !timeRegex.test(endTime)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid time format. Use HH:MM');
    }

    if (!this.isTimeBefore(startTime, endTime)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('End time must be after start time');
    }
  }

  private isTimeBefore(time1: string, time2: string): boolean {
    return time1 < time2;
  }

  private addMinutes(time: string, minutes: number): string {
    const [hours, mins] = time.split(':').map(Number);
    let totalMinutes = hours * 60 + mins + minutes;
    const newHours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
    const newMins = totalMinutes % 60;
    return `${String(newHours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(newMins).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }

  private timeSlotsOverlap(
    start1: string,
    end1: string,
    start2: string,
    end2: string,
  ): boolean {
    return start1 < end2 && start2 < end1;
  }
}

import { IsInt, IsString, IsBoolean, IsOptional, IsDateString, Min, Max } from 'class-validator';

export class CreateAvailabilityDto {
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(7)
  dayOfWeek: number; // 1=Monday, 7=Sunday

  @IsString()
  startTime: string; // HH:MM format

  @IsString()
  endTime: string; // HH:MM format

  @IsInt()
  @Min(15)
  @Max(120)
  @IsOptional()
  slotDuration?: number = 30; // minutes

  @IsBoolean()
  @IsOptional()
  isActive?: boolean = true;

  @IsDateString()
  @IsOptional()
  effectiveFrom?: string;

  @IsDateString()
  @IsOptional()
  effectiveUntil?: string;
}

import { Controller, Get, Post, Put, Body, Param, Query } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { CertificatesService } from './certificates.service';
import { BonafidePurpose, IDCardOrientation } from '@krypton/types';

@ApiTags('certificates')
@Controller('certificates')
export class CertificatesController {
  constructor(private readonly certificatesService: CertificatesService) {}

  @Get('students')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of students eligible for certificates' })
  getStudents() {
    return this.certificatesService.getStudents();
  }

  @Get('settings')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get school certificate branding and principal settings' })
  getSettings() {
    return this.certificatesService.getSchoolSettings();
  }

  @Put('settings')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update school certificate branding settings' })
  updateSettings(@Body() body: any) {
    return this.certificatesService.updateSchoolSettings(body);
  }

  @Get('transfer/:studentId')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Generate Transfer Certificate (TC) for student' })
  getTransferCertificate(
    @Param('studentId') studentId: string,
    @Query('reason') reason?: string
  ) {
    return this.certificatesService.generateTransferCertificate(studentId, {
      reasonForLeaving: reason,
    });
  }

  @Get('bonafide/:studentId')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Generate Bonafide Certificate for student' })
  getBonafideCertificate(
    @Param('studentId') studentId: string,
    @Query('purpose') purpose?: BonafidePurpose
  ) {
    return this.certificatesService.generateBonafideCertificate(studentId, purpose);
  }

  @Get('character/:studentId')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Generate Character & Conduct Certificate for student' })
  getCharacterCertificate(@Param('studentId') studentId: string) {
    return this.certificatesService.generateCharacterCertificate(studentId);
  }

  @Get('id-card/:studentId')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Generate Digital Student ID Card with live QR payload' })
  getIDCard(
    @Param('studentId') studentId: string,
    @Query('orientation') orientation?: IDCardOrientation
  ) {
    return this.certificatesService.generateIDCard(studentId, orientation);
  }

  @Get('verify/:code')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Cryptographic public verification of certificate hash or admission no' })
  verifyCertificate(@Param('code') code: string) {
    return this.certificatesService.verifyCertificate(code);
  }
}

  generateTransferCertificate(
    studentId: string,
    overrides?: Partial<TransferCertificateData>
  ): TransferCertificateData {
    const student = this.getStudent(studentId);
    const serial = Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900);
    const tcNo = overrides?.tcNumber || `TC/2026/${serial}`;
    const hash = `TC-${student.admissionNumber}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`;

    const data: TransferCertificateData = {
      tcNumber: tcNo,
      bookNumber: overrides?.bookNumber || 'BK-2026-04',
      issueDate: overrides?.issueDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
      studentName: student.fullName,
      studentNameMl: student.fullNameMl,
      fatherName: student.fatherName,
      motherName: student.motherName,
      nationality: student.nationality,
      religionAndCaste: `${student.religion} (${student.casteCategory})`,
      dateOfBirth: student.dateOfBirth,
      dateOfBirthWords: student.dateOfBirthWords,
      dateOfFirstAdmission: student.dateOfAdmission,
      classFirstAdmitted: student.classAdmitted,
      classLastStudied: student.currentClass,
      classLastStudiedWords: 'Tenth Standard',
      schoolBoardExamStatus: overrides?.schoolBoardExamStatus || 'AISSE (Class X Board) - Passed with Distinction',
      qualifiedForPromotion: overrides?.qualifiedForPromotion ?? true,
      promotedToClass: overrides?.promotedToClass || 'Eligible for Class XI (Higher Secondary)',
      duesPaidUpto: overrides?.duesPaidUpto || 'March 2026 (All School Dues Cleared)',
      feeConcessionDetails: overrides?.feeConcessionDetails || 'None (General Merit)',
      totalWorkingDays: overrides?.totalWorkingDays || 214,
      attendedWorkingDays: overrides?.attendedWorkingDays || 206,
      extracurricularActivities: overrides?.extracurricularActivities || 'Active Member of School Science Club & Table Tennis Team',
      generalConduct: overrides?.generalConduct || 'Exemplary',
      dateOfApplication: overrides?.dateOfApplication || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      dateOfIssue: overrides?.dateOfIssue || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      reasonForLeaving: overrides?.reasonForLeaving || 'Course Completed / Higher Secondary Admission',
      remarks: overrides?.remarks || 'Self-disciplined and sincere student. We wish all the best in future endeavors.',
      verificationHash: hash,
      verificationUrl: `${this.schoolSettings.verificationDomain}/tc/${hash}`,
      ...overrides,
    };

    return data;
  }

  generateBonafideCertificate(
    studentId: string,
    purpose: BonafidePurpose = 'PASSPORT_VISA'
  ): BonafideCertificateData {
    const student = this.getStudent(studentId);
    const serial = Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900);
    const certNo = `BON/2026/${serial}`;
    const hash = `BON-${student.admissionNumber}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`;

    return {
      certNumber: certNo,
      issueDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
      studentName: student.fullName,
      studentNameMl: student.fullNameMl,
      fatherName: student.fatherName,
      motherName: student.motherName,
      currentClass: student.currentClass,
      section: student.section,
      academicYear: student.academicYear,
      dateOfBirth: student.dateOfBirth,
      purpose,
      purposeDescription: 'Official submission to authorized governmental & educational bodies',
      conduct: 'Good moral character and disciplined conduct',
      validUntil: '2027-03-31',
      verificationHash: hash,
      verificationUrl: `${this.schoolSettings.verificationDomain}/bonafide/${hash}`,
    };
  }

  generateCharacterCertificate(studentId: string): CharacterCertificateData {
    const student = this.getStudent(studentId);
    const serial = Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900);
    const certNo = `CHR/2026/${serial}`;
    const hash = `CHR-${student.admissionNumber}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`;

    return {
      certNumber: certNo,
      issueDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
      studentName: student.fullName,
      studentNameMl: student.fullNameMl,
      fatherName: student.fatherName,
      motherName: student.motherName,
      periodFrom: student.dateOfAdmission.substring(0, 4),
      periodTo: '2026',
      lastClass: `${student.currentClass} (${student.section})`,
      academicYear: student.academicYear,
      conductLevel: 'Exemplary',
      moralCharacter: 'Bears an unblemished moral character and high ethical standards.',
      sportsAndActivities: 'Active in athletics and student leadership councils.',
      remarks: 'Exemplary conduct throughout school tenure.',
      verificationHash: hash,
      verificationUrl: `${this.schoolSettings.verificationDomain}/character/${hash}`,
    };
  }

  generateIDCard(studentId: string, orientation: IDCardOrientation = 'PORTRAIT'): DigitalIDCardData {
    const student = this.getStudent(studentId);
    const hash = `IDC-${student.admissionNumber}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`;
    const qrPayload = JSON.stringify({
      v: '1.0',
      type: 'KRYPTON_ID_CARD',
      admNo: student.admissionNumber,
      name: student.fullName,
      class: student.currentClass,
      sec: student.section,
      blood: student.bloodGroup,
      emg: student.emergencyContact,
      exp: '2027-05-31',
      hash,
    });

    return {
      cardId: `ID-${student.admissionNumber.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`,
      studentId: student.id,
      admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
      rollNumber: student.rollNumber,
      fullName: student.fullName,
      fullNameMl: student.fullNameMl,
      currentClass: student.currentClass,
      section: student.section,
      stream: student.stream,
      academicYear: student.academicYear,
      bloodGroup: student.bloodGroup,
      dateOfBirth: student.dateOfBirth,
      emergencyContact: student.emergencyContact,
      address: student.address,
      photoUrl: student.photoUrl,
      house: student.house,
      busRoute: student.busRoute,
      orientation,
      barcode: `*${student.admissionNumber}*`,
      qrPayload,
      issueDate: '2026-06-01',
      validUntil: '2027-05-31',
      verificationHash: hash,
    };
  }

  verifyCertificate(code: string) {
    const clean = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    const student = this.students.find((s) => s.admissionNumber.toUpperCase() === clean);
    if (student) {
      return {
        valid: true,
        student,
        verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        institution: this.schoolSettings.schoolName,
      };
    }
    return { valid: false };
  }
}

import * as nodemailer from 'nodemailer';
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  SendMessageDto,
  SendBulkMessageDto,
  SendAbsentAlertDto,
  SendFeeReminderDto,
  MessageChannel,
  MessageType,
  MessagePriority,
} from './dto/send-message.dto';
import {
  CreateTemplateDto,
  UpdateTemplateDto,
} from './dto/message-template.dto';
import axios from 'axios';
import { formatCurrency } from '@krypton/utils';

@Injectable()
export class CommunicationsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CommunicationsService.name);
  private readonly smsApiKey: string;
  private readonly smsUsername: string;
  private readonly smtpHost: string;
  private readonly smtpPort: number;
  private readonly smtpUser: string;
  private readonly smtpPassword: string;

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {
    // SMS Configuration (Africa's Talking)
    this.smsApiKey = this.configService.get('SMS_API_KEY', '');
    this.smsUsername = this.configService.get('SMS_USERNAME', '');

    // Email Configuration
    this.smtpHost = this.configService.get('SMTP_HOST', '');
    this.smtpPort = this.configService.get<number>('SMTP_PORT', 1025);
    this.smtpUser = this.configService.get('SMTP_USER', '');
    this.smtpPassword = this.configService.get('SMTP_PASSWORD', this.configService.get('SMTP_PASS', ''));
  }

  // ==================== MESSAGING ====================

  async sendMessage(dto: SendMessageDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    if(dto.scheduledAt) throw new BadRequestException('Scheduled delivery requires a configured job queue');
    if((dto.channel as string)==='PUSH') throw new BadRequestException('Push delivery is not configured');
    if(!dto.recipients.length||dto.recipients.length>500) throw new BadRequestException('Select between 1 and 500 recipients');
    // Create communication record
    const communication = await this.prisma.communication.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        channel: dto.channel,
        messageType: dto.messageType || MessageType.GENERAL,
        subject: dto.subject,
        body: dto.message,
        recipientCount: dto.recipients.length,
        priority: dto.priority || 'NORMAL',
        status: 'PENDING',
        scheduledAt: dto.scheduledAt ? new Date(dto.scheduledAt) : null,
        sentBy: userId,
      },
    });

    // Send immediately or schedule
    if (!dto.scheduledAt) {
      await this.processMessage(communication.id, dto.recipients);
    }

    return this.prisma.communication.findUnique({where:{id:communication.id}});
  }

  async sendBulkMessage(dto: SendBulkMessageDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get students in class/stream
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        currentClassId: dto.classId,
        ...(dto.streamId && { currentStreamId: dto.streamId }),
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        deletedAt: null,
      },
      include: {
        guardianLinks: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (students.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No students found in this class/stream');
    }

    // Collect recipients
    const recipients: string[] = [];

    if (dto.includeParents !== false) {
      students.forEach((student) => {
        student.guardianLinks.forEach((link) => {
          if (dto.channel === MessageChannel.SMS && link.guardian.phone) {
            recipients.push(link.guardian.phone);
          } else if (dto.channel === MessageChannel.EMAIL && link.guardian.email) {
            recipients.push(link.guardian.email);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    if (dto.includeStudents) {
      students.forEach((student) => {
        if (dto.channel === MessageChannel.SMS && student.phone) {
          recipients.push(student.phone);
        } else if (dto.channel === MessageChannel.EMAIL && student.email) {
          recipients.push(student.email);
        }
      });
    }

    // Remove duplicates
    const uniqueRecipients = [...new Set(recipients)];

    if (uniqueRecipients.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No valid recipients found');
    }

    return this.sendMessage(
      {
        channel: dto.channel,
        recipients: uniqueRecipients,
        subject: dto.subject,
        message: dto.message,
        messageType: dto.messageType,
      },
      userId,
    );
  }

  async sendAbsentAlerts(dto: SendAbsentAlertDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const attendanceDate = new Date(dto.date);
    attendanceDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Get absent students
    const absentRecords = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        date: attendanceDate,
        status: {
          in: ['ABSENT'],
        },
        ...(dto.classId && { classId: dto.classId }),
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardianLinks: {
              include: {
                guardian: true,
              },
              where: {
                isPrimary: true,
              },
            },
            currentClass: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (absentRecords.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'No absent students found',
        sent: 0,
      };
    }

    const channels = dto.channels || [MessageChannel.SMS];
    let totalSent = 0;

    for (const record of absentRecords) {
      const student = record.student;
      const primaryGuardian = student.guardianLinks[0]?.guardian;

      if (!primaryGuardian) continue;

      for (const channel of channels) {
        try {
          const message = this.renderTemplate('ABSENCE_ALERT', {
            parentName: primaryGuardian.firstName,
            studentName: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
            date: dto.date,
            class: student.currentClass?.name || 'N/A',
            reason: record.remarks || 'No reason provided',
          });

          const recipient =
            channel === MessageChannel.SMS
              ? primaryGuardian.phone
              : primaryGuardian.email;

          if (recipient) {
            await this.sendMessage(
              {
                channel,
                recipients: [recipient],
                subject: 'Student Absence Alert',
                message,
                messageType: MessageType.ATTENDANCE_ALERT,
                priority: MessagePriority.HIGH,
              },
              userId,
            );
            totalSent++;
          }
        } catch (error: any) {
          this.logger.error(
            `Failed to send absence alert for student ${student.id}`,
            error,
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      absentStudents: absentRecords.length,
      sent: totalSent,
    };
  }

  async sendFeeReminders(dto: SendFeeReminderDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get invoices with outstanding balance
    const invoices = await this.prisma.invoice.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        status: {
          in: ['PENDING', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'OVERDUE'],
        },
        balanceAmount: {
          gte: dto.minimumAmount || 100, // Minimum 1 KES
        },
        ...(dto.classId && {
          student: {
            currentClassId: dto.classId,
          },
        }),
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardianLinks: {
              include: {
                guardian: true,
              },
              where: {
                isPrimary: true,
              },
            },
            currentClass: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        },
        term: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (invoices.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'No outstanding invoices found',
        sent: 0,
      };
    }

    const channels = dto.channels || [MessageChannel.SMS];
    let totalSent = 0;

    for (const invoice of invoices) {
      const student = invoice.student;
      const primaryGuardian = student.guardianLinks[0]?.guardian;

      if (!primaryGuardian) continue;

      for (const channel of channels) {
        try {
          const message = this.renderTemplate('FEE_REMINDER', {
            parentName: primaryGuardian.firstName,
            studentName: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
            class: student.currentClass?.name || 'N/A',
            term: invoice.term.name,
            invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,
            totalAmount: formatCurrency(invoice.totalAmount),
            paidAmount: formatCurrency(invoice.paidAmount),
            balanceAmount: formatCurrency(invoice.balanceAmount),
            dueDate: invoice.dueDate
              ? new Date(invoice.dueDate).toLocaleDateString()
              : 'Not specified',
          });

          const recipient =
            channel === MessageChannel.SMS
              ? primaryGuardian.phone
              : primaryGuardian.email;

          if (recipient) {
            await this.sendMessage(
              {
                channel,
                recipients: [recipient],
                subject: 'School Fee Reminder',
                message,
                messageType: MessageType.FEE_REMINDER,
                priority: MessagePriority.NORMAL,
              },
              userId,
            );
            totalSent++;
          }
        } catch (error: any) {
          this.logger.error(
            `Failed to send fee reminder for invoice ${invoice.id}`,
            error,
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      invoices: invoices.length,
      sent: totalSent,
    };
  }

  // ==================== MESSAGE PROCESSING ====================

  private async processMessage(communicationId: string, recipients: string[]) {
    const communication = await this.prisma.communication.findUnique({
      where: { id: communicationId },
    });

    if (!communication) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Communication not found');
    }

    const results = {
      success: 0,
      failed: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    // Send messages based on channel
    switch (communication.channel) {
      case MessageChannel.SMS:
        await this.sendSMS(communication, recipients, results);
        break;
      case MessageChannel.EMAIL:
        await this.sendEmail(communication, recipients, results);
        break;
      case MessageChannel.IN_APP:
        await this.sendInApp(communication, recipients, results);
        break;
    }

    // Update communication status
    await this.prisma.communication.update({
      where: { id: communicationId },
      data: {
        status: results.success === 0 ? 'FAILED' : results.failed > 0 ? 'PARTIALLY_SENT' : 'SENT',
        sentAt: new Date(),
        deliveredCount: results.success,
        failedCount: results.failed,
      },
    });

    return results;
  }

  private async sendSMS(
    communication: any,
    recipients: string[],
    results: any,
  ) {
    if (!this.smsApiKey || !this.smsUsername) {
      this.logger.warn('SMS credentials not configured');
      results.failed = recipients.length;
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Africa's Talking SMS API
      const response = await axios.post(
        'https://api.africastalking.com/version1/messaging',
        {
          username: this.smsUsername,
          to: recipients.join(','),
          message: communication.body,
        },
        {
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            apiKey: this.smsApiKey,
          },
        },
      );

      const reports = response.data?.SMSMessageData?.Recipients || [];
      for (const recipient of recipients) {
        const report = reports.find((item:any) => item.number === recipient);
        const accepted = report?.status === 'Success';
        await this.prisma.communicationLog.create({
          data: {
            communicationId: communication.id,
            recipient,
            channel: MessageChannel.SMS,
            status: accepted ? 'SENT' : 'FAILED',
            sentAt: new Date(),
          },
        });
        if(accepted) results.success++; else results.failed++;
      }

      this.logger.log(`SMS sent to ${recipients.length} recipients`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to send SMS', error);
      results.failed = recipients.length;
      results.errors.push({ error: error.message });
    }
  }

  private async sendEmail(communication:any,recipients:string[],results:any){
    if(!this.smtpHost){results.failed=recipients.length;return;}
    const transport=nodemailer.createTransport({host:this.smtpHost,port:Number(this.smtpPort),secure:this.configService.get('SMTP_SECURE')==='true',auth:this.smtpUser?{user:this.smtpUser,pass:this.smtpPassword}:undefined,connectionTimeout:10000,socketTimeout:20000,disableFileAccess:true,disableUrlAccess:true});
    for(const recipient of recipients){
      try{
        const response=await transport.sendMail({from:this.configService.get('EMAIL_FROM'),to:recipient,subject:communication.subject||'School update',text:communication.body});
        if(!response.accepted?.length)throw new Error('SMTP server rejected recipient');
        await this.prisma.communicationLog.create({data:{communicationId:communication.id,recipient,channel:'EMAIL',status:'SENT',sentAt:new Date()}});results.success++;
      }catch(error:any){
        await this.prisma.communicationLog.create({data:{communicationId:communication.id,recipient,channel:'EMAIL',status:'FAILED',errorMessage:'Email delivery failed'}});results.failed++;results.errors.push({recipient,error:'Email delivery failed'});
      }
    }
    transport.close();
  }

  private async sendInApp(
    communication: any,
    recipients: string[],
    results: any,
  ) {
    // In-app notifications stored in database
    for (const recipient of recipients) {
      try {
        await this.prisma.communicationLog.create({
          data: {
            communicationId: communication.id,
            recipient,
            channel: MessageChannel.IN_APP,
            status: 'SENT',
            sentAt: new Date(),
          },
        });
        results.success++;
      } catch (error: any) {
        results.failed++;
      }
    }
  }

  // ==================== TEMPLATES ====================

  private renderTemplate(templateName: string, variables: Record<string, any>): string {
    const templates: Record<string, string> = {
      ABSENCE_ALERT: `Dear {{parentName}}, your child {{studentName}} ({{class}}) was absent on {{date}}. Reason: {{reason}}. Please contact the school if you have any questions.`,
      FEE_REMINDER: `Dear {{parentName}}, this is a reminder that {{studentName}} ({{class}}) has an outstanding balance of {{balanceAmount}} for {{term}}. Invoice: {{invoiceNumber}}. Due: {{dueDate}}. Please make payment at your earliest convenience.`,
      PAYMENT_RECEIPT: `Dear {{parentName}}, we confirm receipt of {{paidAmount}} for {{studentName}} ({{class}}). Invoice: {{invoiceNumber}}. New balance: {{balanceAmount}}. Receipt: {{receiptNumber}}. Thank you.`,
    };

    let message = templates[templateName] || '';

    // Replace variables
    Object.keys(variables).forEach((key) => {
      const placeholder = `{{${key}}}`;
      message = message.replace(new RegExp(placeholder, 'g'), variables[key]);
    });

    return message;
  }

  async createTemplate(dto: CreateTemplateDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const template = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        name: dto.name,
        messageType: dto.messageType,
        subject: dto.subject,
        body: dto.body,
        channels: dto.channels,
        variables: dto.variables || {},
        isActive: dto.isActive !== false,
      },
    });

    return template;
  }

  async findAllTemplates() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const templates = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return templates;
  }

  async getCommunicationStats() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [total, sent, failed, pending] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.communication.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
      this.prisma.communication.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'SENT' },
      }),
      this.prisma.communication.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'FAILED' },
      }),
      this.prisma.communication.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'PENDING' },
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      total,
      sent,
      failed,
      pending,
    };
  }
}
