import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Body,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiBearerAuth,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AttendanceAlertService } from './attendance-alert.service';
import { SendAttendanceAlertsDto } from './dto/send-attendance-alerts.dto';

@ApiTags('WhatsApp - Attendance Alerts')
@Controller('whatsapp/attendance-alerts')
// @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) // Uncomment when auth is set up
export class AttendanceAlertController {
  constructor(
    private readonly attendanceAlertService: AttendanceAlertService,
  ) {}

  @Post('send')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send attendance alerts via WhatsApp' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Attendance alerts sent successfully',
    schema: {
      example: {
        totalProcessed: 15,
        successful: 14,
        failed: 1,
        details: [
          {
            studentId: 'uuid',
            studentName: 'John Doe',
            guardianPhone: '+254712345678',
            status: 'ABSENT',
            success: true,
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  })
  async sendAttendanceAlerts(@Body() dto: SendAttendanceAlertsDto) {
    return this.attendanceAlertService.sendAttendanceAlerts({
      date: dto.date ? new Date(dto.date) : new Date(),
      classId: dto.classId,
      studentId: dto.studentId,
      status: dto.status,
      language: dto.language,
    });
  }

  @Post('send-absent')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send alerts for absent students only' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Absent student alerts sent',
  })
  async sendAbsentAlerts(
    @Body() dto: { date?: string; classId?: string; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ) {
    return this.attendanceAlertService.sendAttendanceAlerts({
      date: dto.date ? new Date(dto.date) : new Date(),
      classId: dto.classId,
      status: 'ABSENT',
      language: dto.language || 'en',
    });
  }

  @Post('send-late')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send alerts for late arrivals only' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Late arrival alerts sent',
  })
  async sendLateAlerts(
    @Body() dto: { date?: string; classId?: string; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ) {
    return this.attendanceAlertService.sendAttendanceAlerts({
      date: dto.date ? new Date(dto.date) : new Date(),
      classId: dto.classId,
      status: 'LATE',
      language: dto.language || 'en',
    });
  }

  @Post('send-daily-summary')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Send daily attendance summary to all parents',
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Daily summaries sent',
  })
  async sendDailySummary(
    @Body() dto: { date?: string; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ) {
    return this.attendanceAlertService.sendDailyAttendanceSummary(
      dto.date ? new Date(dto.date) : new Date(),
      dto.language || 'en',
    );
  }

  @Post('instant-alert')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Send instant alert for a specific attendance record',
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Instant alert sent',
  })
  async sendInstantAlert(
    @Body() dto: { attendanceId: string; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ) {
    const result = await this.attendanceAlertService.sendInstantAlert(
      dto.attendanceId,
      dto.language || 'en',
    );

    return {
      success: result,
      message: result
        ? 'Instant alert sent successfully'
        : 'Failed to send instant alert',
    };
  }
}

================
File: apps/api/src/modules/communications/whatsapp/notifications/attendance-alert.service.ts
================
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { WhatsAppService } from '../whatsapp.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../../../database/tenant.service';

export interface AttendanceAlertOptions {
  date?: Date; // Specific date (defaults to today)
  classId?: string; // Specific class
  studentId?: string; // Specific student
  status?: 'ABSENT' | 'LATE' | 'EXCUSED' | 'ALL'; // Alert for specific status
  language?: 'en' | 'sw' | 'ml';
}

export interface AttendanceAlertResult {
  totalProcessed: number;
  successful: number;
  failed: number;
  details: Array<{
    studentId: string;
    studentName: string;
    guardianPhone: string;
    status: string;
    success: boolean;
    error?: string;
  }>;
}

@Injectable()
export class AttendanceAlertService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(AttendanceAlertService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly whatsAppService: WhatsAppService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Send attendance alerts via WhatsApp
   */
  async sendAttendanceAlerts(
    options: AttendanceAlertOptions,
  ): Promise<AttendanceAlertResult> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const language = options.language || 'en';
    const alertDate = options.date || new Date();

    // Get attendance records for the specified criteria
    const attendanceRecords = await this.getAttendanceRecords(tenantId, options);

    if (attendanceRecords.length === 0) {
      this.logger.log('No attendance records found matching the criteria');
      return {
        totalProcessed: 0,
        successful: 0,
        failed: 0,
        details: [],
      };
    }

    this.logger.log(`Processing ${attendanceRecords.length} attendance alerts`);

    const results: AttendanceAlertResult = {
      totalProcessed: attendanceRecords.length,
      successful: 0,
      failed: 0,
      details: [],
    };

    // Send WhatsApp message to each guardian
    for (const record of attendanceRecords) {
      try {
        const guardianPhone = record.student.guardian?.phoneNumber;
        const guardianWhatsApp = record.student.guardian?.whatsappNumber;

        // Use WhatsApp number if available, otherwise try phone number
        const recipientPhone = guardianWhatsApp || guardianPhone;

        if (!recipientPhone) {
          this.logger.warn(
            `No contact number for student ${record.student.firstName} ${record.student.lastName}`,
          );
          results.failed++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: record.student.id,
            studentName: `${record.student.firstName} ${record.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: 'N/A',
            status: record.status,
            success: false,
            error: 'No contact number available',
          });
          continue;
        }

        // Format and validate phone number
        const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(
          recipientPhone,
        )
          ? recipientPhone
          : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(recipientPhone, '254');

        // Build message
        const message = this.buildAttendanceAlertMessage(record, language);

        // Send WhatsApp message
        const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
          to: formattedPhone,
          body: message,
        });

        if (result) {
          results.successful++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: record.student.id,
            studentName: `${record.student.firstName} ${record.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: formattedPhone,
            status: record.status,
            success: true,
          });

          // Log the alert in database
          await this.logAttendanceAlert(record.id, formattedPhone, result.sid);
        } else {
          results.failed++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: record.student.id,
            studentName: `${record.student.firstName} ${record.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: formattedPhone,
            status: record.status,
            success: false,
            error: 'Failed to send message',
          });
        }

        // Small delay to respect rate limits
        await this.delay(100);
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error(
          `Failed to send alert for student ${record.student.firstName}`,
          error.message,
        );
        results.failed++;
        results.details.push({
          studentId: record.student.id,
          studentName: `${record.student.firstName} ${record.student.lastName}`,
          guardianPhone: 'N/A',
          status: record.status,
          success: false,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `Attendance alerts completed: ${results.successful} successful, ${results.failed} failed`,
    );

    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Send daily attendance summary to all parents
   */
  async sendDailyAttendanceSummary(
    date?: Date,
    language: 'en' | 'sw' = 'en',
  ): Promise<AttendanceAlertResult> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const summaryDate = date || new Date();

    // Get all attendance records for the day
    const startOfDay = new Date(summaryDate);
    startOfDay.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const endOfDay = new Date(summaryDate);
    endOfDay.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

    const attendanceRecords = await this.prisma.attendance.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        date: {
          gte: startOfDay,
          lte: endOfDay,
        },
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        date: 'desc',
      },
    });

    if (attendanceRecords.length === 0) {
      this.logger.log('No attendance records found for daily summary');
      return {
        totalProcessed: 0,
        successful: 0,
        failed: 0,
        details: [],
      };
    }

    this.logger.log(`Sending daily summary for ${attendanceRecords.length} students`);

    const results: AttendanceAlertResult = {
      totalProcessed: attendanceRecords.length,
      successful: 0,
      failed: 0,
      details: [],
    };

    for (const record of attendanceRecords) {
      try {
        const guardianPhone =
          record.student.guardian?.whatsappNumber ||
          record.student.guardian?.phoneNumber;

        if (!guardianPhone) {
          results.failed++;
          continue;
        }

        const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(
          guardianPhone,
        )
          ? guardianPhone
          : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(guardianPhone, '254');

        const message = this.buildDailySummaryMessage(record, language);

        const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
          to: formattedPhone,
          body: message,
        });

        if (result) {
          results.successful++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: record.student.id,
            studentName: `${record.student.firstName} ${record.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: formattedPhone,
            status: record.status,
            success: true,
          });
        }

        await this.delay(100);
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error('Failed to send daily summary', error);
        results.failed++;
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Send instant alert when student is marked absent or late
   */
  async sendInstantAlert(
    attendanceId: string,
    language: 'en' | 'sw' = 'en',
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const attendance = await this.prisma.attendance.findFirst({
      where: { id: attendanceId, tenantId },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!attendance) {
      throw new Error('Attendance record not found');
    }

    // Only send instant alerts for ABSENT or LATE
    if (attendance.status !== 'ABSENT' && attendance.status !== 'LATE') {
      this.logger.log(
        `Skipping instant alert for status: ${attendance.status}`,
      );
      return false;
    }

    const guardianPhone =
      attendance.student.guardian?.whatsappNumber ||
      attendance.student.guardian?.phoneNumber;

    if (!guardianPhone) {
      this.logger.warn('No contact number for instant alert');
      return false;
    }

    const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(
      guardianPhone,
    )
      ? guardianPhone
      : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(guardianPhone, '254');

    const message = this.buildAttendanceAlertMessage(attendance, language);

    const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
      to: formattedPhone,
      body: message,
    });

    if (result) {
      await this.logAttendanceAlert(attendance.id, formattedPhone, result.sid);
    }

    return !!result;
  }

  /**
   * Get attendance records based on options
   */
  private async getAttendanceRecords(
    tenantId: string,
    options: AttendanceAlertOptions,
  ) {
    const alertDate = options.date || new Date();
    const startOfDay = new Date(alertDate);
    startOfDay.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const endOfDay = new Date(alertDate);
    endOfDay.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      date: {
        gte: startOfDay,
        lte: endOfDay,
      },
    };

    // Filter by status
    if (options.status && options.status !== 'ALL') {
      where.status = options.status;
    } else {
      // By default, only alert for ABSENT and LATE
      where.status = {
        in: ['ABSENT', 'LATE'],
      };
    }

    // Filter by class
    if (options.classId) {
      where.student = {
        classId: options.classId,
      };
    }

    // Filter by student
    if (options.studentId) {
      where.studentId = options.studentId;
    }

    return this.prisma.attendance.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        date: 'desc',
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Build attendance alert message
   */
  private buildAttendanceAlertMessage(
    attendance: any,
    language: 'en' | 'sw' | 'ml',
  ): string {
    const studentName = `${attendance.student.firstName} ${attendance.student.lastName}`;
    const className = attendance.student.class?.name || 'N/A';
    const date = this.formatDate(attendance.date);
    const status = attendance.status;
    const remarks = attendance.remarks || '';

    if (language === 'ml') {
      if (status === 'ABSENT') {
        return (
          `🏫 *സ്കൂൾ ഹാജർ അറിയിപ്പ് (Absence Alert)*\n\n` +
          `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ,\n\n` +
          `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `ക്ലാസ്സ്: *${className}*\n` +
          `തീയതി: *${date}*\n\n` +
          `⚠️ നിങ്ങളുടെ കുട്ടി ഇന്ന് സ്കൂളിൽ ഹാജരായിട്ടില്ലെന്ന് ക്ലാസ്സ് ടീച്ചർ രേഖപ്പെടുത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ട്.\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `വിശദാംശങ്ങൾ: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `കുട്ടി സുരക്ഷിതമായി വീട്ടിൽ തന്നെയുണ്ടെന്ന് ഉറപ്പുവരുത്തുക. അപ്രതീക്ഷിതമാണെങ്കിൽ ദയവായി സ്കൂൾ ഹെൽപ്പ്‌ലൈനിൽ ബന്ധപ്പെടുക.\n\n` +
          `നന്ദി`
        );
      } else if (status === 'LATE') {
        return (
          `🏫 *വൈകിയെത്തിയ വിവരം (Late Notice)*\n\n` +
          `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ,\n\n` +
          `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `ക്ലാസ്സ്: *${className}*\n` +
          `തീയതി: *${date}*\n\n` +
          `ℹ️ നിങ്ങളുടെ കുട്ടി ഇന്ന് സ്കൂളിൽ വൈകിയാണ് എത്തിയത്.\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `കാരണം: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `നന്ദി`
        );
      } else {
        return (
          `🏫 *സ്കൂൾ ഹാജർ അറിയിപ്പ്*\n\n` +
          `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ,\n\n` +
          `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `ക്ലാസ്സ്: *${className}*\n` +
          `തീയതി: *${date}*\n` +
          `സ്റ്റാറ്റസ്: *${status}*\n\n` +
          `നന്ദി`
        );
      }
    } else if (language === 'sw') {
      // Swahili message
      if (status === 'ABSENT') {
        return (
          `🏫 *Arifa ya Mahudhurio*\n\n` +
          `Mzazi mpendwa,\n\n` +
          `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Darasa: *${className}*\n` +
          `Tarehe: *${date}*\n\n` +
          `⚠️ Mtoto wako hakuhudhuria shuleni leo.\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `Maelezo: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `Ikiwa hii ni jambo la ajabu, tafadhali wasiliana na shule.\n\n` +
          `Asante`
        );
      } else if (status === 'LATE') {
        return (
          `🏫 *Arifa ya Kuchelewa*\n\n` +
          `Mzazi mpendwa,\n\n` +
          `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Darasa: *${className}*\n` +
          `Tarehe: *${date}*\n\n` +
          `ℹ️ Mtoto wako alifika shuleni kwa kuchelewa leo.\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `Maelezo: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `Asante`
        );
      } else {
        return (
          `🏫 *Arifa ya Mahudhurio*\n\n` +
          `Mzazi mpendwa,\n\n` +
          `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Darasa: *${className}*\n` +
          `Tarehe: *${date}*\n` +
          `Hali: *${status}*\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `Maelezo: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `Asante`
        );
      }
    } else {
      // English message
      if (status === 'ABSENT') {
        return (
          `🏫 *Attendance Alert*\n\n` +
          `Dear Parent,\n\n` +
          `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Class: *${className}*\n` +
          `Date: *${date}*\n\n` +
          `⚠️ Your child was marked absent from school today.\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `Remarks: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `If this is unexpected, please contact the school.\n\n` +
          `Thank you`
        );
      } else if (status === 'LATE') {
        return (
          `🏫 *Late Arrival Notice*\n\n` +
          `Dear Parent,\n\n` +
          `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Class: *${className}*\n` +
          `Date: *${date}*\n\n` +
          `ℹ️ Your child arrived late to school today.\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `Remarks: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `Thank you`
        );
      } else {
        return (
          `🏫 *Attendance Notice*\n\n` +
          `Dear Parent,\n\n` +
          `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Class: *${className}*\n` +
          `Date: *${date}*\n` +
          `Status: *${status}*\n\n` +
          (remarks ? `Remarks: ${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
          `Thank you`
        );
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Build daily summary message
   */
  private buildDailySummaryMessage(
    attendance: any,
    language: 'en' | 'sw',
  ): string {
    const studentName = `${attendance.student.firstName} ${attendance.student.lastName}`;
    const className = attendance.student.class?.name || 'N/A';
    const date = this.formatDate(attendance.date);
    const status = attendance.status;

    const statusEmoji = {
      PRESENT: '✅',
      ABSENT: '❌',
      LATE: '⏰',
      EXCUSED: '📝',
    };

    const emoji = statusEmoji[status] || 'ℹ️';

    if (language === 'sw') {
      const statusText = {
        PRESENT: 'Yupo',
        ABSENT: 'Hayupo',
        LATE: 'Amechelewa',
        EXCUSED: 'Ruhusa',
      };

      return (
        `🏫 *Muhtasari wa Mahudhurio ya Kila Siku*\n\n` +
        `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +
        `Darasa: *${className}*\n` +
        `Tarehe: *${date}*\n\n` +
        `Hali: ${emoji} *${statusText[status] || status}*\n\n` +
        `Asante`
      );
    } else {
      return (
        `🏫 *Daily Attendance Summary*\n\n` +
        `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
        `Class: *${className}*\n` +
        `Date: *${date}*\n\n` +
        `Status: ${emoji} *${status}*\n\n` +
        `Thank you`
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Log attendance alert in database
   */
  private async logAttendanceAlert(
    attendanceId: string,
    recipientPhone: string,
    twilioSid: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.prisma.communicationLog.create({
        data: {
          type: 'WHATSAPP',
          recipient: recipientPhone,
          subject: 'Attendance Alert',
          status: 'SENT',
          sentAt: new Date(),
          metadata: {
            attendanceId,
            twilioSid,
          },
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to log attendance alert', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Format date
   */
  private formatDate(date: Date): string {
    return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
      day: '2-digit',
      month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric',
    });
  }

  /**
   * Utility delay function
   */
  private delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Body,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { FeeReminderService } from './fee-reminder.service';
import { SendFeeRemindersDto } from './dto/send-fee-reminders.dto';

@ApiTags('WhatsApp - Fee Reminders')
@Controller('whatsapp/fee-reminders')
// @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) // Uncomment when auth is set up
export class FeeReminderController {
  constructor(private readonly feeReminderService: FeeReminderService) {}

  @Post('send')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send fee reminders via WhatsApp' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Fee reminders sent successfully',
    schema: {
      example: {
        totalProcessed: 25,
        successful: 23,
        failed: 2,
        details: [
          {
            studentId: 'uuid',
            studentName: 'John Doe',
            guardianPhone: '+254712345678',
            success: true,
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: 'Invalid request parameters',
  })
  async sendFeeReminders(@Body() dto: SendFeeRemindersDto) {
    return this.feeReminderService.sendFeeReminders({
      invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
      classId: dto.classId,
      studentId: dto.studentId,
      daysBeforeDue: dto.daysBeforeDue,
      overdueOnly: dto.overdueOnly,
      language: dto.language,
    });
  }

  @Post('send-overdue')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send reminders for all overdue fees' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Overdue fee reminders sent',
  })
  async sendOverdueReminders(@Body() dto: { language?: 'en' | 'sw' }) {
    return this.feeReminderService.sendFeeReminders({
      overdueOnly: true,
      language: dto.language || 'en',
    });
  }

  @Post('send-upcoming')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send reminders for fees due soon' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Upcoming fee reminders sent',
  })
  async sendUpcomingReminders(
    @Body() dto: { days?: number; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ) {
    return this.feeReminderService.sendFeeReminders({
      daysBeforeDue: dto.days || 7, // Default 7 days before due
      language: dto.language || 'en',
    });
  }

  @Post('payment-confirmation')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send payment confirmation via WhatsApp' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Payment confirmation sent',
  })
  async sendPaymentConfirmation(
    @Body() dto: { paymentId: string; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ) {
    const result = await this.feeReminderService.sendPaymentConfirmation(
      dto.paymentId,
      dto.language || 'en',
    );

    return {
      success: result,
      message: result
        ? 'Payment confirmation sent successfully'
        : 'Failed to send payment confirmation',
    };
  }
}

================
File: apps/api/src/modules/communications/whatsapp/notifications/fee-reminder.service.ts
================
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { WhatsAppService } from '../whatsapp.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../../../database/tenant.service';

export interface FeeReminderOptions {
  invoiceId?: string; // Send reminder for specific invoice
  classId?: string; // Send reminders to all students in a class
  studentId?: string; // Send reminder to specific student
  daysBeforeDue?: number; // Send reminder X days before due date
  overdueOnly?: boolean; // Only send to overdue invoices
  language?: 'en' | 'sw' | 'ml';
}

export interface FeeReminderResult {
  totalProcessed: number;
  successful: number;
  failed: number;
  details: Array<{
    studentId: string;
    studentName: string;
    guardianPhone: string;
    success: boolean;
    error?: string;
  }>;
}

@Injectable()
export class FeeReminderService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(FeeReminderService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly whatsAppService: WhatsAppService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Send fee reminders via WhatsApp based on options
   */
  async sendFeeReminders(options: FeeReminderOptions): Promise<FeeReminderResult> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const language = options.language || 'en';

    // Build query to find invoices that need reminders
    const invoices = await this.getInvoicesForReminder(tenantId, options);

    if (invoices.length === 0) {
      this.logger.log('No invoices found matching the reminder criteria');
      return {
        totalProcessed: 0,
        successful: 0,
        failed: 0,
        details: [],
      };
    }

    this.logger.log(`Processing ${invoices.length} fee reminders`);

    const results: FeeReminderResult = {
      totalProcessed: invoices.length,
      successful: 0,
      failed: 0,
      details: [],
    };

    // Send WhatsApp message to each guardian
    for (const invoice of invoices) {
      try {
        const guardianPhone = invoice.student.guardian?.phoneNumber;
        const guardianWhatsApp = invoice.student.guardian?.whatsappNumber;
        
        // Use WhatsApp number if available, otherwise try phone number
        const recipientPhone = guardianWhatsApp || guardianPhone;

        if (!recipientPhone) {
          this.logger.warn(
            `No contact number for student ${invoice.student.firstName} ${invoice.student.lastName}`,
          );
          results.failed++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: invoice.student.id,
            studentName: `${invoice.student.firstName} ${invoice.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: 'N/A',
            success: false,
            error: 'No contact number available',
          });
          continue;
        }

        // Format and validate phone number
        const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(recipientPhone)
          ? recipientPhone
          : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(recipientPhone, '254'); // Default to Kenya

        // Build message
        const message = this.buildFeeReminderMessage(invoice, language);

        // Send WhatsApp message
        const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
          to: formattedPhone,
          body: message,
        });

        if (result) {
          results.successful++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: invoice.student.id,
            studentName: `${invoice.student.firstName} ${invoice.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: formattedPhone,
            success: true,
          });

          // Log the reminder in database
          await this.logFeeReminder(invoice.id, formattedPhone, result.sid);
        } else {
          results.failed++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: invoice.student.id,
            studentName: `${invoice.student.firstName} ${invoice.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: formattedPhone,
            success: false,
            error: 'Failed to send message',
          });
        }

        // Small delay to respect rate limits
        await this.delay(100);
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error(
          `Failed to send reminder for invoice ${invoice.invoiceNumber}`,
          error.message,
        );
        results.failed++;
        results.details.push({
          studentId: invoice.student.id,
          studentName: `${invoice.student.firstName} ${invoice.student.lastName}`,
          guardianPhone: 'N/A',
          success: false,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `Fee reminders completed: ${results.successful} successful, ${results.failed} failed`,
    );

    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Send immediate payment confirmation via WhatsApp
   */
  async sendPaymentConfirmation(
    paymentId: string,
    language: 'en' | 'sw' = 'en',
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const payment = await this.prisma.payment.findFirst({
      where: { id: paymentId, tenantId },
      include: {
        invoice: {
          include: {
            student: {
              include: {
                guardian: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!payment) {
      throw new Error('Payment not found');
    }

    const paymentData = payment as any;
    const guardianPhone =
      paymentData.invoice?.student?.guardian?.whatsappNumber ||
      paymentData.invoice?.student?.guardian?.phoneNumber;

    if (!guardianPhone) {
      this.logger.warn('No contact number for payment confirmation');
      return false;
    }

    const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(guardianPhone)
      ? guardianPhone
      : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(guardianPhone, '254');

    const message = this.buildPaymentConfirmationMessage(payment, language);

    const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
      to: formattedPhone,
      body: message,
    });

    return !!result;
  }

  /**
   * Query invoices that need reminders
   */
  private async getInvoicesForReminder(tenantId: string, options: FeeReminderOptions) {
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      status: { not: 'PAID' }, // Don't send reminders for paid invoices
    };

    // Specific invoice
    if (options.invoiceId) {
      where.id = options.invoiceId;
    }

    // Filter by class
    if (options.classId) {
      where.student = {
        classId: options.classId,
      };
    }

    // Filter by student
    if (options.studentId) {
      where.studentId = options.studentId;
    }

    // Overdue only
    if (options.overdueOnly) {
      where.dueDate = {
        lt: new Date(),
      };
      where.status = 'OVERDUE';
    }

    // Days before due
    if (options.daysBeforeDue && !options.overdueOnly) {
      const targetDate = new Date();
      targetDate.setDate(targetDate.getDate() + options.daysBeforeDue);

      where.dueDate = {
        lte: targetDate,
        gte: new Date(),
      };
    }

    return (this.prisma as any).invoice.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
        feeStructure: {
          include: {
            term: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        dueDate: 'asc',
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Build fee reminder message
   */
  private buildFeeReminderMessage(invoice: any, language: 'en' | 'sw' | 'ml'): string {
    const studentName = `${invoice.student.firstName} ${invoice.student.lastName}`;
    const amount = this.formatAmount(invoice.totalAmount - invoice.paidAmount);
    const dueDate = this.formatDate(invoice.dueDate);
    const invoiceNumber = invoice.invoiceNumber;
    const className = invoice.student.class?.name || 'N/A';
    const termName = invoice.feeStructure?.term?.name || 'Current Term';
    const isOverdue = new Date(invoice.dueDate) < new Date();
    const upiLink = `upi://pay?pa=schoolfees@icici&pn=School+Fees&am=${invoice.totalAmount - invoice.paidAmount}&cu=INR&tn=${invoiceNumber}`;

    if (language === 'ml') {
      if (isOverdue) {
        return `🏫 *സ്കൂൾ ഫീ കുടിശ്ശിക അറിയിപ്പ് (Overdue Fee)*\n\n` +
          `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ,\n\n` +
          `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `ക്ലാസ്സ്: *${className}*\n` +
          `ടേം: *${termName}*\n\n` +
          `⚠️ നിങ്ങളുടെ കുട്ടിയുടെ സ്കൂൾ ഫീസ് അവസാന തീയതി കഴിഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു.\n\n` +
          `• അടയ്ക്കേണ്ട തുക: *${amount}*\n` +
          `• അവസാന തീയതി: *${dueDate}*\n` +
          `• ഇൻവോയ്സ് നമ്പർ: ${invoiceNumber}\n\n` +
          `⚡ *1-ക്ലിക്ക് യു.പി.ഐ പേയ്‌മെന്റ് ലിങ്ക്:*\n` +
          `${upiLink}\n\n` +
          `താഴെയുള്ള ലിങ്കിൽ ക്ലിക്ക് ചെയ്ത് ഗൂഗിൾ പേ/ഫോൺപേ/Paytm വഴി സെക്കൻഡുകൾക്കുള്ളിൽ പണമടയ്ക്കാം.\n\n` +
          `നന്ദി`;
      } else {
        return `🏫 *സ്കൂൾ ഫീ പേയ്‌മെന്റ് റിമൈൻഡർ*\n\n` +
          `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ,\n\n` +
          `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `ക്ലാസ്സ്: *${className}*\n` +
          `ടേം: *${termName}*\n\n` +
          `• അടയ്ക്കേണ്ട തുക: *${amount}*\n` +
          `• അവസാന തീയതി: *${dueDate}*\n` +
          `• ഇൻവോയ്സ് നമ്പർ: ${invoiceNumber}\n\n` +
          `⚡ *1-ക്ലിക്ക് യു.പി.ഐ പേയ്‌മെന്റ് ലിങ്ക്:*\n` +
          `${upiLink}\n\n` +
          `ബാങ്കിലോ സ്കൂളിലോ വരിനിൽക്കാതെ മുകളിലെ ലിങ്കിൽ ക്ലിക്ക് ചെയ്ത് യു.പി.ഐ വഴി ഉടൻ പണമടയ്ക്കാം.\n\n` +
          `നന്ദി`;
      }
    } else if (language === 'sw') {
      // Swahili message
      if (isOverdue) {
        return `🏫 *Notisi ya Ada ya Shule*\n\n` +
          `Mzazi mpendwa,\n\n` +
          `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Darasa: *${className}*\n` +
          `Muhula: *${termName}*\n\n` +
          `⚠️ Malipo ya ada ya mtoto wako yamechelewa.\n\n` +
          `Kiasi Kilichobaki: *${amount}*\n` +
          `Tarehe ya Mwisho: *${dueDate}*\n` +
          `Nambari ya Ankara: ${invoiceNumber}\n\n` +

          `Mzazi mpendwa,\n\n` +
          `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +

          `Muhula: *${termName}*\n\n` +
          `Kiasi Kilichobaki: *${amount}*\n` +
          `Tarehe ya Mwisho: *${dueDate}*\n` +
          `Nambari ya Ankara: ${invoiceNumber}\n\n` +

    } else {
      // English message
      if (isOverdue) {
        return `🏫 *School Fee Notice*\n\n` +

          `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Class: *${className}*\n` +

          `Please make the payment as soon as possible to avoid any inconvenience.\n\n` +

      } else {
        return `🏫 *School Fee Reminder*\n\n` +
          `Dear Parent,\n\n` +
          `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
          `Class: *${className}*\n` +
          `Term: *${termName}*\n\n` +
          `Outstanding Amount: *${amount}*\n` +
          `Due Date: *${dueDate}*\n` +
          `Invoice Number: ${invoiceNumber}\n\n` +
          `Please ensure payment is made by the due date.\n\n` +
          `Thank you`;
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Build payment confirmation message
   */
  private buildPaymentConfirmationMessage(payment: any, language: 'en' | 'sw'): string {
    const studentName = `${payment.invoice.student.firstName} ${payment.invoice.student.lastName}`;
    const amount = this.formatAmount(payment.amount);
    const paymentDate = this.formatDate(payment.paymentDate);
    const receiptNumber = payment.receiptNumber;
    const balance = this.formatAmount(
      payment.invoice.totalAmount - payment.invoice.paidAmount - payment.amount,
    );

    if (language === 'sw') {
      return `✅ *Uthibitisho wa Malipo*\n\n` +
        `Mzazi mpendwa,\n\n` +
        `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n\n` +
        `Malipo yako yamepokelewa kwa mafanikio.\n\n` +
        `Kiasi Kilicholipwa: *${amount}*\n` +
        `Tarehe: ${paymentDate}\n` +
        `Nambari ya Risiti: ${receiptNumber}\n` +
        `Kiasi Kilichobaki: *${balance}*\n\n` +
        `Asante!`;
    } else {
      return `✅ *Payment Confirmation*\n\n` +
        `Dear Parent,\n\n` +
        `Student: *${studentName}*\n\n` +
        `Your payment has been successfully received.\n\n` +
        `Amount Paid: *${amount}*\n` +
        `Date: ${paymentDate}\n` +
        `Receipt Number: ${receiptNumber}\n` +
        `Balance: *${balance}*\n\n` +
        `Thank you!`;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Log fee reminder in database
   */
  private async logFeeReminder(
    invoiceId: string,
    recipientPhone: string,
    twilioSid: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await (this.prisma as any).communicationLog.create({
        data: {
          channel: 'WHATSAPP',
          recipient: recipientPhone,
          status: 'SENT',
          sentAt: new Date(),
          metadata: {
            invoiceId,
            twilioSid,
          },
        } as any,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to log fee reminder', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Format amount with currency
   */
  private formatAmount(amount: number): string {
    return `KES ${amount.toLocaleString('en-KE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
  }

  /**
   * Format date
   */
  private formatDate(date: Date): string {
    return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
      day: '2-digit',
      month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric',
    });
  }

  /**
   * Utility delay function
   */
  private delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Body,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiBearerAuth,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { ReportCardService } from './report-card.service';
import { SendReportCardsDto } from './dto/send-report-cards.dto';

@ApiTags('WhatsApp - Report Cards')
@Controller('whatsapp/report-cards')
// @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) // Uncomment when auth is set up
export class ReportCardController {
  constructor(private readonly reportCardService: ReportCardService) {}

  @Post('send')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send report cards via WhatsApp' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Report cards sent successfully',
    schema: {
      example: {
        totalProcessed: 30,
        successful: 28,
        failed: 2,
        details: [
          {
            studentId: 'uuid',
            studentName: 'John Doe',
            guardianPhone: '+254712345678',
            success: true,
          },
        ],
      },
    },
  })
  async sendReportCards(@Body() dto: SendReportCardsDto) {
    return this.reportCardService.sendReportCards({
      reportCardId: dto.reportCardId,
      termId: dto.termId,
      classId: dto.classId,
      studentId: dto.studentId,
      language: dto.language,
      includeRemarks: dto.includeRemarks,
    });
  }

  @Post('send-by-term')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send all report cards for a specific term' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Term report cards sent',
  })
  async sendByTerm(
    @Body()
    dto: {
      termId: string;
      classId?: string;
      language?: 'en' | 'sw';
      includeRemarks?: boolean;
    },
  ) {
    return this.reportCardService.sendReportCards({
      termId: dto.termId,
      classId: dto.classId,
      language: dto.language || 'en',
      includeRemarks: dto.includeRemarks !== false,
    });
  }

  @Post('send-by-class')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send report cards for all students in a class' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Class report cards sent',
  })
  async sendByClass(
    @Body()
    dto: {
      classId: string;
      termId?: string;
      language?: 'en' | 'sw';
      includeRemarks?: boolean;
    },
  ) {
    return this.reportCardService.sendReportCards({
      classId: dto.classId,
      termId: dto.termId,
      language: dto.language || 'en',
      includeRemarks: dto.includeRemarks !== false,
    });
  }

  @Post('send-with-pdf')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Send individual report card with PDF attachment',
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Report card with PDF sent',
  })
  async sendWithPdf(
    @Body()
    dto: {
      reportCardId: string;
      pdfUrl: string;
      language?: 'en' | 'sw';
    },
  ) {
    const result = await this.reportCardService.sendReportCardWithPdf(
      dto.reportCardId,
      dto.pdfUrl,
      dto.language || 'en',
    );

    return {
      success: result,
      message: result
        ? 'Report card sent successfully with PDF'
        : 'Failed to send report card',
    };
  }

  @Post('send-summary')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Send report card summary (grades overview without PDF)',
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Report card summary sent',
  })
  async sendSummary(
    @Body()
    dto: {
      reportCardId: string;
      language?: 'en' | 'sw';
    },
  ) {
    const result = await this.reportCardService.sendReportCardSummary(
      dto.reportCardId,
      dto.language || 'en',
    );

    return {
      success: result,
      message: result
        ? 'Report card summary sent successfully'
        : 'Failed to send summary',
    };
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/modules/communications/whatsapp/notifications/report-card.service.ts

import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { WhatsAppService } from '../whatsapp.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../../../database/tenant.service';

export interface ReportCardDeliveryOptions {
  reportCardId?: string; // Specific report card
  termId?: string; // All report cards for a term
  classId?: string; // All report cards for a class
  studentId?: string; // Report card for specific student
  language?: 'en' | 'sw' | 'ml';
  includeRemarks?: boolean; // Include teacher's remarks in message
}

export interface ReportCardDeliveryResult {
  totalProcessed: number;
  successful: number;
  failed: number;
  details: Array<{
    studentId: string;
    studentName: string;
    guardianPhone: string;
    success: boolean;
    error?: string;
  }>;
}

@Injectable()
export class ReportCardService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ReportCardService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly whatsAppService: WhatsAppService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Send report cards via WhatsApp
   */
  async sendReportCards(
    options: ReportCardDeliveryOptions,
  ): Promise<ReportCardDeliveryResult> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const language = options.language || 'en';

    // Get report cards based on criteria
    const reportCards = await this.getReportCards(tenantId, options);

    if (reportCards.length === 0) {
      this.logger.log('No report cards found matching the criteria');
      return {
        totalProcessed: 0,
        successful: 0,
        failed: 0,
        details: [],
      };
    }

    this.logger.log(`Processing ${reportCards.length} report card deliveries`);

    const results: ReportCardDeliveryResult = {
      totalProcessed: reportCards.length,
      successful: 0,
      failed: 0,
      details: [],
    };

    // Send WhatsApp message with report card to each guardian
    for (const reportCard of reportCards) {
      try {
        const guardianPhone = reportCard.student.guardian?.phoneNumber;
        const guardianWhatsApp = reportCard.student.guardian?.whatsappNumber;

        // Use WhatsApp number if available, otherwise try phone number
        const recipientPhone = guardianWhatsApp || guardianPhone;

        if (!recipientPhone) {
          this.logger.warn(
            `No contact number for student ${reportCard.student.firstName} ${reportCard.student.lastName}`,
          );
          results.failed++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: reportCard.student.id,
            studentName: `${reportCard.student.firstName} ${reportCard.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: 'N/A',
            success: false,
            error: 'No contact number available',
          });
          continue;
        }

        // Format and validate phone number
        const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(
          recipientPhone,
        )
          ? recipientPhone
          : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(recipientPhone, '254');

        // Build message
        const message = this.buildReportCardMessage(
          reportCard,
          language,
          options.includeRemarks,
        );

        // Check if report card has a PDF URL
        const pdfUrl = reportCard.pdfUrl;

        // Send WhatsApp message (with PDF if available)
        const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
          to: formattedPhone,
          body: message,
          mediaUrl: pdfUrl || undefined,
        });

        if (result) {
          results.successful++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: reportCard.student.id,
            studentName: `${reportCard.student.firstName} ${reportCard.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: formattedPhone,
            success: true,
          });

          // Log the delivery in database
          await this.logReportCardDelivery(
            reportCard.id,
            formattedPhone,
            result.sid,
          );

          // Update report card as delivered
          await this.markAsDelivered(reportCard.id);
        } else {
          results.failed++;
          results.details.push({
            studentId: reportCard.student.id,
            studentName: `${reportCard.student.firstName} ${reportCard.student.lastName}`,
            guardianPhone: formattedPhone,
            success: false,
            error: 'Failed to send message',
          });
        }

        // Small delay to respect rate limits
        await this.delay(100);
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error(
          `Failed to send report card for student ${reportCard.student.firstName}`,
          error.message,
        );
        results.failed++;
        results.details.push({
          studentId: reportCard.student.id,
          studentName: `${reportCard.student.firstName} ${reportCard.student.lastName}`,
          guardianPhone: 'N/A',
          success: false,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `Report card delivery completed: ${results.successful} successful, ${results.failed} failed`,
    );

    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Send individual report card with PDF
   */
  async sendReportCardWithPdf(
    reportCardId: string,
    pdfUrl: string,
    language: 'en' | 'sw' = 'en',
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const reportCard = await this.prisma.reportCard.findFirst({
      where: { id: reportCardId, tenantId },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
        term: true,
      },
    });

    if (!reportCard) {
      throw new Error('Report card not found');
    }

    const guardianPhone =
      reportCard.student.guardian?.whatsappNumber ||
      reportCard.student.guardian?.phoneNumber;

    if (!guardianPhone) {
      this.logger.warn('No contact number for report card delivery');
      return false;
    }

    const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(
      guardianPhone,
    )
      ? guardianPhone
      : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(guardianPhone, '254');

    const message = this.buildReportCardMessage(reportCard, language, true);

    const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendDocument(
      formattedPhone,
      message,
      pdfUrl,
    );

    if (result) {
      await this.logReportCardDelivery(reportCard.id, formattedPhone, result.sid);
      await this.markAsDelivered(reportCard.id);
    }

    return !!result;
  }

  /**
   * Send report card summary (grades overview without PDF)
   */
  async sendReportCardSummary(
    reportCardId: string,
    language: 'en' | 'sw' = 'en',
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const reportCard = await this.prisma.reportCard.findFirst({
      where: { id: reportCardId, tenantId },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
        term: true,
        grades: {
          include: {
            subject: true,
          },
          orderBy: {
            subject: {
              name: 'asc',
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!reportCard) {
      throw new Error('Report card not found');
    }

    const guardianPhone =
      reportCard.student.guardian?.whatsappNumber ||
      reportCard.student.guardian?.phoneNumber;

    if (!guardianPhone) {
      return false;
    }

    const formattedPhone = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(
      guardianPhone,
    )
      ? guardianPhone
      : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(guardianPhone, '254');

    const message = this.buildDetailedReportCardMessage(reportCard, language);

    const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
      to: formattedPhone,
      body: message,
    });

    return !!result;
  }

  /**
   * Get report cards based on criteria
   */
  private async getReportCards(
    tenantId: string,
    options: ReportCardDeliveryOptions,
  ) {
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      status: 'APPROVED', // Only send approved report cards
    };

    // Specific report card
    if (options.reportCardId) {
      where.id = options.reportCardId;
    }

    // Filter by term
    if (options.termId) {
      where.termId = options.termId;
    }

    // Filter by class
    if (options.classId) {
      where.student = {
        classId: options.classId,
      };
    }

    // Filter by student
    if (options.studentId) {
      where.studentId = options.studentId;
    }

    return this.prisma.reportCard.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
        term: true,
        grades: {
          include: {
            subject: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'desc',
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Build report card notification message
   */
  private buildReportCardMessage(
    reportCard: any,
    language: 'en' | 'sw' | 'ml',
    includeRemarks: boolean = false,
  ): string {
    const studentName = `${reportCard.student.firstName} ${reportCard.student.lastName}`;
    const className = reportCard.student.class?.name || 'N/A';
    const termName = reportCard.term?.name || 'Current Term';
    const totalMarks = reportCard.totalMarks || 0;
    const obtainedMarks = reportCard.obtainedMarks || 0;
    const percentage = totalMarks > 0 ? ((obtainedMarks / totalMarks) * 100).toFixed(2) : '0.00';
    const grade = reportCard.overallGrade || 'N/A';
    const position = reportCard.position || 'N/A';
    const remarks = reportCard.teacherRemarks || '';

    if (language === 'ml') {
      return (
        `📊 *പരീക്ഷാ ഫലം ലഭ്യമാണ് (Report Card)*\n\n` +
        `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ,\n\n` +
        `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി: *${studentName}*\n` +
        `ക്ലാസ്സ്: *${className}*\n` +
        `ടേം: *${termName}*\n\n` +
        `📈 പരീക്ഷാ പ്രകടനം:\n` +
        `മൊത്തം മാർക്ക്: ${obtainedMarks}/${totalMarks}\n` +
        `ശതമാനം: ${percentage}%\n` +
        `ഗ്രേഡ്: *${grade}*\n` +
        `ക്ലാസ്സ് റാങ്ക്: *${position}*\n\n` +
        (includeRemarks && remarks ? `ടീച്ചറുടെ വിലയിരുത്തൽ:\n${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
        `ഔദ്യോഗിക ഡിജിറ്റൽ പ്രോഗ്രസ് കാർഡ് PDF താഴെ ചേർത്തിരിക്കുന്നു. ചാറ്റിൽ നിന്ന് നേരിട്ട് ഡൗൺലോഡ് ചെയ്യാം.\n\n` +
        `അഭിനന്ദനങ്ങൾ! 🎉`
      );
    } else if (language === 'sw') {
      // Swahili message
      return (
        `📊 *Kadi ya Ripoti Iko Tayari*\n\n` +
        `Mzazi mpendwa,\n\n` +
        `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +
        `Darasa: *${className}*\n` +
        `Muhula: *${termName}*\n\n` +
        `📈 Muhtasari wa Utendaji:\n` +
        `Jumla ya Alama: ${obtainedMarks}/${totalMarks}\n` +
        `Asilimia: ${percentage}%\n` +
        `Daraja: *${grade}*\n` +
        `Nafasi: *${position}*\n\n` +
        (includeRemarks && remarks ? `Maoni ya Mwalimu:\n${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
        `Tafadhali angalia kadi ya ripoti kamili iliyoambatishwa kama PDF.\n\n` +
        `Hongera! 🎉`
      );
    } else {
      // English message
      return (
        `📊 *Report Card Ready*\n\n` +
        `Dear Parent,\n\n` +
        `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
        `Class: *${className}*\n` +
        `Term: *${termName}*\n\n` +
        `📈 Performance Summary:\n` +
        `Total Marks: ${obtainedMarks}/${totalMarks}\n` +
        `Percentage: ${percentage}%\n` +
        `Grade: *${grade}*\n` +
        `Position: *${position}*\n\n` +
        (includeRemarks && remarks ? `Teacher's Remarks:\n${remarks}\n\n` : '') +
        `Please find the detailed report card attached as PDF.\n\n` +
        `Congratulations! 🎉`
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Build detailed report card message with subject-wise breakdown
   */
  private buildDetailedReportCardMessage(
    reportCard: any,
    language: 'en' | 'sw',
  ): string {
    const studentName = `${reportCard.student.firstName} ${reportCard.student.lastName}`;
    const className = reportCard.student.class?.name || 'N/A';
    const termName = reportCard.term?.name || 'Current Term';
    const grade = reportCard.overallGrade || 'N/A';
    const position = reportCard.position || 'N/A';

    // Build subject-wise breakdown
    let subjectBreakdown = '';
    if (reportCard.grades && reportCard.grades.length > 0) {
      reportCard.grades.forEach((gradeEntry: any) => {
        const subjectName = gradeEntry.subject?.name || 'Unknown';
        const marks = gradeEntry.obtainedMarks || 0;
        const total = gradeEntry.totalMarks || 0;
        const subjectGrade = gradeEntry.grade || 'N/A';
        
        if (language === 'sw') {
          subjectBreakdown += `• ${subjectName}: ${marks}/${total} (${subjectGrade})\n`;
        } else {
          subjectBreakdown += `• ${subjectName}: ${marks}/${total} (${subjectGrade})\n`;
        }
      });
    }

    if (language === 'sw') {
      return (
        `📊 *Muhtasari wa Kadi ya Ripoti*\n\n` +
        `Mwanafunzi: *${studentName}*\n` +
        `Darasa: *${className}*\n` +
        `Muhula: *${termName}*\n\n` +
        `📚 Utendaji wa Masomo:\n${subjectBreakdown}\n` +
        `Daraja la Jumla: *${grade}*\n` +
        `Nafasi: *${position}*\n\n` +
        `Umefanya vizuri! 🎓`
      );
    } else {
      return (
        `📊 *Report Card Summary*\n\n` +
        `Student: *${studentName}*\n` +
        `Class: *${className}*\n` +
        `Term: *${termName}*\n\n` +
        `📚 Subject-wise Performance:\n${subjectBreakdown}\n` +
        `Overall Grade: *${grade}*\n` +
        `Position: *${position}*\n\n` +
        `Well done! 🎓`
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Mark report card as delivered
   */
  private async markAsDelivered(reportCardId: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.prisma.reportCard.update({
        where: { id: reportCardId },
        data: {
          deliveredAt: new Date(),
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to mark report card as delivered', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Log report card delivery in database
   */
  private async logReportCardDelivery(
    reportCardId: string,
    recipientPhone: string,
    twilioSid: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.prisma.communicationLog.create({
        data: {
          type: 'WHATSAPP',
          recipient: recipientPhone,
          subject: 'Report Card Delivery',
          status: 'SENT',
          sentAt: new Date(),
          metadata: {
            reportCardId,
            twilioSid,
          },
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to log report card delivery', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Utility delay function
   */
  private delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }
}

# WhatsApp Integration Module 🔥

## Overview

Complete WhatsApp integration for the School Management System using Twilio's WhatsApp API with bilingual support (English/Swahili).

## Features

### ✅ Implemented

1. **Fee Reminders** (`/notifications/fee-reminder.service.ts`)
   - Overdue payment reminders
   - Upcoming payment reminders
   - Payment confirmations
   - Bulk reminders by class/term

2. **Attendance Alerts** (`/notifications/attendance-alert.service.ts`)
   - Absence notifications
   - Late arrival alerts
   - Daily attendance summaries
   - Instant real-time alerts

3. **Report Card Delivery** (`/notifications/report-card.service.ts`)
   - Report cards with PDF attachments
   - Subject-wise grade summaries
   - Performance metrics
   - Teacher remarks

4. **Background Job Queue** (`/scheduler/`)
   - BullMQ queue processor
   - Automated cron jobs
   - Job scheduling and tracking
   - Queue statistics

5. **Admin Panel** (`/settings/`)
   - WhatsApp settings management
   - Message template CRUD
   - Communication logs
   - Statistics and analytics

6. **Bilingual Support**
   - English (en)
   - Swahili (ml)
   - Template-based messages
   - Automatic language detection

## Automated Cron Jobs

| Job | Schedule | Description |
|-----|----------|-------------|

| Upcoming Fee Reminders | Daily 10:00 AM | Remind about fees due in 7 days |
| Absence Alerts | Weekdays 11:00 AM | Alert parents about absent students |
| Daily Attendance Summary | Weekdays 4:00 PM | Send daily attendance summary |
| Job Cleanup | Daily Midnight | Clean up old completed/failed jobs |

## Message Templates

```
🏫 *School Fee Reminder*

Dear Parent,

Class: *{className}*
Term: *{termName}*

Outstanding Amount: *{amount}*
Due Date: *{dueDate}*
Invoice Number: {invoiceNumber}

Please ensure payment is made by the due date.

Thank you
```

### Variables Available
- Fee Reminders: `studentName`, `className`, `termName`, `amount`, `dueDate`, `invoiceNumber`

import { ApiProperty } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  IsObject,
  IsOptional,
  IsInt,
  Min,
  Max,
  IsEnum,
} from 'class-validator';

export class ScheduleJobDto {
  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Job payload (varies based on job type)',
    example: {
      classId: 'uuid-of-class',
      overdueOnly: true,
    },
  })
  @IsObject()
  payload: any;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Delay in minutes before job execution',
    example: 30,
    required: false,
  })
  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  @IsOptional()
  delayMinutes?: number;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Job priority (1-10, higher is more important)',
    example: 5,
    required: false,
  })
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(10)
  @IsOptional()
  priority?: number;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Message language',
    example: 'en',
    enum: ['en', 'sw'],
    required: false,
  })
  @IsEnum(['en', 'sw'])
  @IsOptional()
  language?: 'en' | 'sw';
}

import { Process, Processor } from '@nestjs/bull';
import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Job } from 'bull';
import { WhatsAppService } from '../whatsapp.service';
import { FeeReminderService } from '../notifications/fee-reminder.service';
import { AttendanceAlertService } from '../notifications/attendance-alert.service';
import { ReportCardService } from '../notifications/report-card.service';

export const WHATSAPP_QUEUE = 'whatsapp-notifications';

export interface WhatsAppJobData {
  type: 'fee-reminder' | 'attendance-alert' | 'report-card' | 'custom';
  payload: any;
  language?: 'en' | 'sw';
}

@Processor(WHATSAPP_QUEUE)
export class WhatsAppQueueProcessor {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(WhatsAppQueueProcessor.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly whatsAppService: WhatsAppService,
    private readonly feeReminderService: FeeReminderService,
    private readonly attendanceAlertService: AttendanceAlertService,
    private readonly reportCardService: ReportCardService,
  ) {}

  @Process('send-fee-reminders')
  async handleFeeReminders(job: Job<WhatsAppJobData>) {
    this.logger.log(`Processing fee reminders job ${job.id}`);

    try {
      const { payload, language } = job.data;
      const result = await this.feeReminderService.sendFeeReminders({
        ...payload,
        language: language || 'en',
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `Fee reminders completed: ${result.successful}/${result.totalProcessed} successful`,
      );

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to process fee reminders job ${job.id}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  @Process('send-attendance-alerts')
  async handleAttendanceAlerts(job: Job<WhatsAppJobData>) {
    this.logger.log(`Processing attendance alerts job ${job.id}`);

    try {
      const { payload, language } = job.data;
      const result = await this.attendanceAlertService.sendAttendanceAlerts({
        ...payload,
        language: language || 'en',
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `Attendance alerts completed: ${result.successful}/${result.totalProcessed} successful`,
      );

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to process attendance alerts job ${job.id}`,
        error,
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }

  @Process('send-daily-attendance-summary')
  async handleDailyAttendanceSummary(job: Job<WhatsAppJobData>) {
    this.logger.log(`Processing daily attendance summary job ${job.id}`);

    try {
      const { payload, language } = job.data;
      const result =
        await this.attendanceAlertService.sendDailyAttendanceSummary(
          payload.date ? new Date(payload.date) : new Date(),
          language || 'en',
        );

      this.logger.log(
        `Daily attendance summary completed: ${result.successful}/${result.totalProcessed} successful`,
      );

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to process daily attendance summary job ${job.id}`,
        error,
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }

  @Process('send-report-cards')
  async handleReportCards(job: Job<WhatsAppJobData>) {
    this.logger.log(`Processing report cards job ${job.id}`);

    try {
      const { payload, language } = job.data;
      const result = await this.reportCardService.sendReportCards({
        ...payload,
        language: language || 'en',
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `Report cards delivery completed: ${result.successful}/${result.totalProcessed} successful`,
      );

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to process report cards job ${job.id}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  @Process('send-custom-message')
  async handleCustomMessage(job: Job<WhatsAppJobData>) {
    this.logger.log(`Processing custom message job ${job.id}`);

    try {
      const { payload } = job.data;
      const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
        to: payload.to,
        body: payload.message,
        mediaUrl: payload.mediaUrl,
      });

      this.logger.log(`Custom message sent: ${result?.sid}`);

      return {
        success: !!result,
        messageId: result?.sid,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to process custom message job ${job.id}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  @Process('send-bulk-messages')
  async handleBulkMessages(job: Job<WhatsAppJobData>) {
    this.logger.log(`Processing bulk messages job ${job.id}`);

    try {
      const { payload } = job.data;
      const results = await this.whatsAppService.sendBulkMessages(
        payload.messages,
      );

      const successCount = results.filter((r) => r !== null).length;

      this.logger.log(
        `Bulk messages completed: ${successCount}/${results.length} successful`,
      );

      return {
        total: results.length,
        successful: successCount,
        failed: results.length - successCount,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to process bulk messages job ${job.id}`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/modules/communications/whatsapp/scheduler/whatsapp-scheduler.controller.ts

import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Get,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { WhatsAppSchedulerService } from './whatsapp-scheduler.service';
import { ScheduleJobDto } from './dto/schedule-job.dto';

@ApiTags('WhatsApp - Scheduler')
@Controller('whatsapp/scheduler')
export class WhatsAppSchedulerController {
  constructor(
    private readonly schedulerService: WhatsAppSchedulerService,
  ) {}

  @Post('schedule/fee-reminders')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Schedule fee reminders job' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Job scheduled successfully',
    schema: {
      example: {
        jobId: '12345',
        message: 'Fee reminders job scheduled successfully',
      },
    },
  })
  async scheduleFeeReminders(@Body() dto: ScheduleJobDto) {
    const jobId = await this.schedulerService.scheduleFeeReminders(
      dto.payload,
      {
        delay: dto.delayMinutes ? dto.delayMinutes * 60 * 1000 : undefined,
        priority: dto.priority,
        language: dto.language,
      },
    );

    return {
      jobId,
      message: 'Fee reminders job scheduled successfully',
    };
  }

  @Post('schedule/attendance-alerts')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Schedule attendance alerts job' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Job scheduled successfully',
  })
  async scheduleAttendanceAlerts(@Body() dto: ScheduleJobDto) {
    const jobId = await this.schedulerService.scheduleAttendanceAlerts(
      dto.payload,
      {
        delay: dto.delayMinutes ? dto.delayMinutes * 60 * 1000 : undefined,
        priority: dto.priority,
        language: dto.language,
      },
    );

    return {
      jobId,
      message: 'Attendance alerts job scheduled successfully',
    };
  }

  @Post('schedule/report-cards')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Schedule report card delivery job' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Job scheduled successfully',
  })
  async scheduleReportCards(@Body() dto: ScheduleJobDto) {
    const jobId = await this.schedulerService.scheduleReportCards(
      dto.payload,
      {
        delay: dto.delayMinutes ? dto.delayMinutes * 60 * 1000 : undefined,
        priority: dto.priority,
        language: dto.language,
      },
    );

    return {
      jobId,
      message: 'Report cards job scheduled successfully',
    };
  }

  @Get('job/:jobId')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get job status' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Job status retrieved',
  })
  async getJobStatus(@Param('jobId') jobId: string) {
    return this.schedulerService.getJobStatus(jobId);
  }

  @Delete('job/:jobId')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Cancel a scheduled job' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Job cancelled successfully',
  })
  async cancelJob(@Param('jobId') jobId: string) {
    const cancelled = await this.schedulerService.cancelJob(jobId);

    return {
      success: cancelled,
      message: cancelled
        ? 'Job cancelled successfully'
        : 'Job not found or already completed',
    };
  }

  @Get('stats')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get queue statistics' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Queue statistics',
    schema: {
      example: {
        waiting: 5,
        active: 2,
        completed: 150,
        failed: 3,
        delayed: 10,
        total: 170,
      },
    },
  })
  async getQueueStats() {
    return this.schedulerService.getQueueStats();
  }

  @Get('scheduled-jobs')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of automated scheduled jobs' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,

import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectQueue } from '@nestjs/bull';
import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule';
import { Queue } from 'bull';
import { WHATSAPP_QUEUE, WhatsAppJobData } from './whatsapp-queue.processor';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';

@Injectable()
export class WhatsAppSchedulerService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(WhatsAppSchedulerService.name);
  private schedulerEnabled: boolean;

  constructor(
    @InjectQueue(WHATSAPP_QUEUE) private whatsappQueue: Queue,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {
    // Enable/disable scheduler based on environment variable
    this.schedulerEnabled =
      this.configService.get('WHATSAPP_SCHEDULER_ENABLED', 'true') === 'true';
  }

  /**
   * Schedule a job to send fee reminders
   */
  async scheduleFeeReminders(
    payload: any,
    options?: { delay?: number; priority?: number; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ): Promise<string> {
    const job = await this.whatsappQueue.add(
      'send-fee-reminders',
      {
        type: 'fee-reminder',
        payload,
        language: options?.language || 'en',
      } as WhatsAppJobData,
      {
        delay: options?.delay,
        priority: options?.priority || 5,
        attempts: 3,
        backoff: {
          type: 'exponential',
          delay: 2000,
        },
      },
    );

    this.logger.log(`Scheduled fee reminders job: ${job.id}`);
    return job.id.toString();
  }

  /**
   * Schedule attendance alerts
   */
  async scheduleAttendanceAlerts(
    payload: any,
    options?: { delay?: number; priority?: number; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ): Promise<string> {
    const job = await this.whatsappQueue.add(
      'send-attendance-alerts',
      {
        type: 'attendance-alert',
        payload,
        language: options?.language || 'en',
      } as WhatsAppJobData,
      {
        delay: options?.delay,
        priority: options?.priority || 5,
        attempts: 3,
        backoff: {
          type: 'exponential',
          delay: 2000,
        },
      },
    );

    this.logger.log(`Scheduled attendance alerts job: ${job.id}`);
    return job.id.toString();
  }

  /**
   * Schedule report card delivery
   */
  async scheduleReportCards(
    payload: any,
    options?: { delay?: number; priority?: number; language?: 'en' | 'sw' },
  ): Promise<string> {
    const job = await this.whatsappQueue.add(
      'send-report-cards',
      {
        type: 'report-card',
        payload,
        language: options?.language || 'en',
      } as WhatsAppJobData,
      {
        delay: options?.delay,
        priority: options?.priority || 5,
        attempts: 3,
        backoff: {
          type: 'exponential',
          delay: 2000,
        },
      },
    );

    this.logger.log(`Scheduled report cards job: ${job.id}`);
    return job.id.toString();
  }

  /**
   * Schedule custom message
   */
  async scheduleCustomMessage(
    payload: { to: string; message: string; mediaUrl?: string },
    options?: { delay?: number; priority?: number },
  ): Promise<string> {
    const job = await this.whatsappQueue.add(
      'send-custom-message',
      {
        type: 'custom',
        payload,
      } as WhatsAppJobData,
      {
        delay: options?.delay,
        priority: options?.priority || 5,
        attempts: 3,
        backoff: {
          type: 'exponential',
          delay: 2000,
        },
      },
    );

    this.logger.log(`Scheduled custom message job: ${job.id}`);
    return job.id.toString();
  }

  /**
   * Get job status
   */
  async getJobStatus(jobId: string): Promise<any> {
    const job = await this.whatsappQueue.getJob(jobId);

    if (!job) {
      return { error: 'Job not found' };
    }

    const state = await job.getState();
    const progress = job.progress();
    const result = job.returnvalue;

    return {
      id: job.id,
      state,
      progress,
      result,
      attemptsMade: job.attemptsMade,
      timestamp: job.timestamp,
      processedOn: job.processedOn,
      finishedOn: job.finishedOn,
      failedReason: job.failedReason,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Cancel a scheduled job
   */
  async cancelJob(jobId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const job = await this.whatsappQueue.getJob(jobId);

    if (!job) {
      return false;
    }

    await job.remove();
    this.logger.log(`Cancelled job: ${jobId}`);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Get queue statistics
   */
  async getQueueStats(): Promise<any> {
    const [waiting, active, completed, failed, delayed] = await Promise.all([
      this.whatsappQueue.getWaitingCount(),
      this.whatsappQueue.getActiveCount(),
      this.whatsappQueue.getCompletedCount(),
      this.whatsappQueue.getFailedCount(),
      this.whatsappQueue.getDelayedCount(),
    ]);

    return {
      waiting,
      active,
      completed,
      failed,
      delayed,
      total: waiting + active + completed + failed + delayed,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Automated cron jobs
   */

  /**
   * Send overdue fee reminders every day at 9 AM
   */
  @Cron('0 9 * * *', {
    name: 'send-overdue-fee-reminders',
  })
  async handleOverdueFeeReminders() {
    if (!this.schedulerEnabled) return;

    this.logger.log('Running automated overdue fee reminders');

    await this.scheduleFeeReminders(
      {
        overdueOnly: true,
      },
      {
        priority: 8,
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Send fee reminders for fees due in 7 days - every day at 10 AM
   */
  @Cron('0 10 * * *', {
    name: 'send-upcoming-fee-reminders',
  })
  async handleUpcomingFeeReminders() {
    if (!this.schedulerEnabled) return;

    this.logger.log('Running automated upcoming fee reminders (7 days)');

    await this.scheduleFeeReminders(
      {
        daysBeforeDue: 7,
      },
      {
        priority: 6,
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Send daily attendance summary every day at 4 PM
   */
  @Cron('0 16 * * 1-5', {
    name: 'send-daily-attendance-summary',
    timeZone: 'Africa/Nairobi',
  })
  async handleDailyAttendanceSummary() {
    if (!this.schedulerEnabled) return;

    this.logger.log('Running automated daily attendance summary');

    await this.whatsappQueue.add(
      'send-daily-attendance-summary',
      {
        type: 'attendance-alert',
        payload: {
          date: new Date(),
        },
      } as WhatsAppJobData,
      {
        priority: 7,
        attempts: 3,
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Send absence alerts every day at 11 AM (for students marked absent)
   */
  @Cron('0 11 * * 1-5', {
    name: 'send-absence-alerts',
    timeZone: 'Africa/Nairobi',
  })
  async handleAbsenceAlerts() {
    if (!this.schedulerEnabled) return;

    this.logger.log('Running automated absence alerts');

    await this.scheduleAttendanceAlerts(
      {
        status: 'ABSENT',
        date: new Date(),
      },
      {
        priority: 9, // High priority for absence alerts
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Clean up old completed jobs - every day at midnight
   */
  @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_DAY_AT_MIDNIGHT, {
    name: 'cleanup-old-jobs',
  })
  async handleJobCleanup() {
    this.logger.log('Running job cleanup');

    try {
      // Remove completed jobs older than 7 days
      const sevenDaysAgo = Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      await this.whatsappQueue.clean(sevenDaysAgo, 'completed');

      // Remove failed jobs older than 30 days
      const thirtyDaysAgo = Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      await this.whatsappQueue.clean(thirtyDaysAgo, 'failed');

      this.logger.log('Job cleanup completed');
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to cleanup old jobs', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get list of scheduled cron jobs
   */
  getScheduledJobs(): Array<{
    name: string;
    nextRun: string;
    enabled: boolean;
  }> {
    return [
      {
        name: 'Overdue Fee Reminders',
        nextRun: 'Daily at 9:00 AM',
        enabled: this.schedulerEnabled,
      },
      {
        name: 'Upcoming Fee Reminders (7 days)',
        nextRun: 'Daily at 10:00 AM',
        enabled: this.schedulerEnabled,
      },
      {
        name: 'Daily Attendance Summary',
        nextRun: 'Weekdays at 4:00 PM (EAT)',
        enabled: this.schedulerEnabled,
      },
      {
        name: 'Absence Alerts',
        nextRun: 'Weekdays at 11:00 AM (EAT)',
        enabled: this.schedulerEnabled,
      },
      {
        name: 'Job Cleanup',
        nextRun: 'Daily at Midnight',
        enabled: true,
      },
    ];
  }
}
