import { Injectable, Logger, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../../../database/tenant.service';

export interface WhatsAppSettings {
  id: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  accountSid: string;
  authToken: string;
  whatsappNumber: string;
  defaultLanguage: 'en' | 'sw';
  autoSendFeeReminders: boolean;
  autoSendAttendanceAlerts: boolean;
  autoSendReportCards: boolean;
  feeReminderSchedule: string; // Cron expression
  attendanceAlertSchedule: string; // Cron expression
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

export interface MessageTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'FEE_REMINDER' | 'ATTENDANCE_ALERT' | 'REPORT_CARD' | 'CUSTOM';
  language: 'en' | 'sw';
  content: string;
  variables: string[]; // Array of variable names like ['studentName', 'amount']
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

@Injectable()
export class WhatsAppSettingsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(WhatsAppSettingsService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Get WhatsApp settings for tenant
   */
  async getSettings(): Promise<WhatsAppSettings | null> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const settings = await this.prisma.whatsAppSettings.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    return settings as WhatsAppSettings | null;
  }

  /**
   * Update WhatsApp settings
   */
  async updateSettings(data: Partial<WhatsAppSettings>): Promise<WhatsAppSettings> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const existingSettings = await this.prisma.whatsAppSettings.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    let settings;

    if (existingSettings) {
      settings = await this.prisma.whatsAppSettings.update({
        where: { id: existingSettings.id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });
    } else {
      settings = await this.prisma.whatsAppSettings.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          ...data,
        },
      });
    }

    this.logger.log(`WhatsApp settings updated for tenant ${tenantId}`);
    return settings as WhatsAppSettings;
  }

  /**
   * Get all message templates
   */
  async getTemplates(type?: string, language?: 'en' | 'sw'): Promise<MessageTemplate[]> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (type) {
      where.type = type;
    }

    if (language) {
      where.language = language;
    }

    const templates = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'desc',
      },
    });

    return templates as MessageTemplate[];
  }

  /**
   * Get a single template by ID
   */
  async getTemplate(id: string): Promise<MessageTemplate> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const template = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!template) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Template not found');
    }

    return template as MessageTemplate;
  }

  /**
   * Create a new message template
   */
  async createTemplate(data: {
    name: string;
    type: 'FEE_REMINDER' | 'ATTENDANCE_ALERT' | 'REPORT_CARD' | 'CUSTOM';
    language: 'en' | 'sw';
    content: string;
    variables?: string[];
  }): Promise<MessageTemplate> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Extract variables from content (e.g., {studentName}, {amount})
    const extractedVariables =
      data.variables || this.extractVariables(data.content);

    const template = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        name: data.name,
        type: data.type,
        language: data.language,
        content: data.content,
        variables: extractedVariables,
        isActive: true,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(`Created message template: ${template.id}`);
    return template as MessageTemplate;
  }

  /**
   * Update a message template
   */
  async updateTemplate(
    id: string,
    data: Partial<MessageTemplate>,
  ): Promise<MessageTemplate> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const existingTemplate = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!existingTemplate) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Template not found');
    }

    // Re-extract variables if content is being updated
    if (data.content) {
      data.variables = this.extractVariables(data.content);
    }

    const template = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...data,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(`Updated message template: ${id}`);
    return template as MessageTemplate;
  }

  /**
   * Delete a message template
   */
  async deleteTemplate(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const template = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!template) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Template not found');
    }

    await this.prisma.messageTemplate.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    this.logger.log(`Deleted message template: ${id}`);
  }

  /**
   * Toggle template active status
   */
  async toggleTemplate(id: string): Promise<MessageTemplate> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const template = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!template) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Template not found');
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.messageTemplate.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        isActive: !template.isActive,
      },
    });

    return updated as MessageTemplate;
  }

  /**
   * Get communication logs/history
   */
  async getCommunicationLogs(filters?: {
    type?: string;
    status?: string;
    startDate?: Date;
    endDate?: Date;
    limit?: number;
  }): Promise<any[]> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (filters?.type) {
      where.type = filters.type;
    }

    if (filters?.status) {
      where.status = filters.status;
    }

    if (filters?.startDate || filters?.endDate) {
      where.sentAt = {};
      if (filters.startDate) {
        where.sentAt.gte = filters.startDate;
      }
      if (filters.endDate) {
        where.sentAt.lte = filters.endDate;
      }
    }

    const logs = await this.prisma.communicationLog.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: {
        sentAt: 'desc',
      },
      take: filters?.limit || 100,
    });

    return logs;
  }

  /**
   * Get communication statistics
   */
  async getStatistics(startDate?: Date, endDate?: Date): Promise<any> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId, type: 'WHATSAPP' };

    if (startDate || endDate) {
      where.sentAt = {};
      if (startDate) {
        where.sentAt.gte = startDate;
      }
      if (endDate) {
        where.sentAt.lte = endDate;
      }
    }

    const [total, sent, failed, bySubject] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.communicationLog.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.communicationLog.count({
        where: { ...where, status: 'SENT' },
      }),
      this.prisma.communicationLog.count({
        where: { ...where, status: 'FAILED' },
      }),
      this.prisma.communicationLog.groupBy({
        by: ['subject'],
        where,
        _count: true,
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      total,
      sent,
      failed,
      successRate: total > 0 ? ((sent / total) * 100).toFixed(2) : 0,
      byType: bySubject.map((item) => ({
        type: item.subject,
        count: item._count,
      })),
    };
  }

  /**

  async createDefaultTemplates(): Promise<void> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const defaultTemplates = [

      },
      // Attendance Alert - English
      {
        name: 'Absence Alert - English',

      },

      },
      // Report Card - Swahili
      {
        name: 'Report Card Ready - Swahili',
        type: 'REPORT_CARD' as const,
        language: 'sw' as const,
        content:
          '📊 *Kadi ya Ripoti Iko Tayari*\n\nMzazi mpendwa,\n\nMwanafunzi: *{studentName}*\nDarasa: *{className}*\nMuhula: *{termName}*\n\n📈 Muhtasari wa Utendaji:\nJumla ya Alama: {obtainedMarks}/{totalMarks}\nAsilimia: {percentage}%\nDaraja: *{grade}*\nNafasi: *{position}*\n\nTafadhali angalia kadi ya ripoti kamili iliyoambatishwa.\n\nHongera! 🎉',
      },
    ];

    for (const template of defaultTemplates) {
      await this.prisma.messageTemplate.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          ...template,
          variables: this.extractVariables(template.content),
          isActive: true,
        },
      });
    }

    this.logger.log(`Created ${defaultTemplates.length} default templates`);
  }

  /**
   * Extract variable names from template content
   */
  private extractVariables(content: string): string[] {
    const regex = /\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}/g;
    const variables: string[] = [];
    let match;

    while ((match = regex.exec(content)) !== null) {
      if (!variables.includes(match[1])) {
        variables.push(match[1]);
      }
    }

    return variables;
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Body,
  Get,
  UseGuards,
  HttpStatus,
  HttpCode,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { WhatsAppService } from './whatsapp.service';
import { SendMessageDto, SendBulkMessageDto } from './dto/send-message.dto';

@ApiTags('WhatsApp')
@Controller('whatsapp')
// @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) // Uncomment when auth is set up
export class WhatsAppController {
  constructor(private readonly whatsAppService: WhatsAppService) {}

  @Get('status')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Check WhatsApp service status' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'WhatsApp service status',
    schema: {
      example: {
        available: true,
        message: 'WhatsApp service is configured and ready',
      },
    },
  })
  getStatus() {
    const available = this.whatsAppService.isAvailable();
    return {
      available,
      message: available
        ? 'WhatsApp service is configured and ready'
        : 'WhatsApp service is not configured. Please set Twilio credentials.',
    };
  }

  @Post('send')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send a WhatsApp message' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Message sent successfully',
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: 'Invalid phone number or message',
  })
  async sendMessage(@Body() dto: SendMessageDto) {
    // Validate phone number
    if (!this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(dto.to)) {
      const formatted = this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(dto.to);
      dto.to = formatted;
    }

    const result = await this.whatsAppService.sendMessage({
      to: dto.to,
      body: dto.message,
      mediaUrl: dto.mediaUrl,
    });

    return {
      success: !!result,
      messageId: result?.sid,
      status: result?.status,
    };
  }

  @Post('send-bulk')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Send bulk WhatsApp messages' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Bulk messages processing initiated',
  })
  async sendBulkMessages(@Body() dto: SendBulkMessageDto) {
    const messages = dto.recipients.map((recipient) => ({
      to: this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(recipient.phoneNumber)
        ? recipient.phoneNumber
        : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(recipient.phoneNumber),
      body: dto.message.replace(/\{name\}/g, recipient.name || ''),
    }));

    const results = await this.whatsAppService.sendBulkMessages(messages);

    const successCount = results.filter((r) => r !== null).length;
    const failureCount = results.length - successCount;

    return {
      total: results.length,
      successful: successCount,
      failed: failureCount,
      details: results.map((r, index) => ({
        to: dto.recipients[index].phoneNumber,
        success: !!r,
        messageId: r?.sid,
      })),
    };
  }

  @Post('validate-phone')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Validate phone number format' })
  validatePhoneNumber(@Body() body: { phoneNumber: string }) {
    const isValid = this.whatsAppService.validatePhoneNumber(body.phoneNumber);
    const formatted = isValid
      ? body.phoneNumber
      : this.whatsAppService.formatPhoneNumber(body.phoneNumber);

    return {
      original: body.phoneNumber,
      isValid,
      formatted,
    };
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/modules/communications/whatsapp/whatsapp.service.ts

import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import * as twilio from 'twilio';
import { MessageInstance } from 'twilio/lib/rest/api/v2010/account/message';

export interface WhatsAppMessage {
  to: string; // Phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +254712345678)
  body: string;
  mediaUrl?: string; // Optional media URL for images/documents
}

export interface WhatsAppTemplateMessage {
  to: string;
  templateName: string;
  templateParams?: Record<string, string>;
  language?: 'en' | 'sw'; // English or Swahili
}

@Injectable()
export class WhatsAppService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(WhatsAppService.name);
  private twilioClient: twilio.Twilio;
  private whatsappNumber: string;
  private isConfigured: boolean = false;

  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    this.initializeTwilio();
  }

  private initializeTwilio(): void {
    const accountSid = this.configService.get<string>('TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID');
    const authToken = this.configService.get<string>('TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN');
    this.whatsappNumber = this.configService.get<string>('TWILIO_WHATSAPP_NUMBER', 'whatsapp:+14155238886'); // Default Twilio sandbox

    if (!accountSid || !authToken) {
      this.logger.warn(
        'Twilio credentials not configured. WhatsApp service will be disabled. Please set TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID and TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN environment variables.',
      );
      this.isConfigured = false;
      return;
    }

    try {
      this.twilioClient = (twilio as any)(accountSid, authToken);
      this.isConfigured = true;
      this.logger.log('WhatsApp service initialized successfully');
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to initialize Twilio client', error?.message || String(error));
      this.isConfigured = false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if WhatsApp service is properly configured
   */
  isAvailable(): boolean {
    return this.isConfigured;
  }

  /**
   * Send a simple text message via WhatsApp
   */
  async sendMessage(message: WhatsAppMessage): Promise<MessageInstance | null> {
    if (!this.isConfigured) {
      this.logger.warn('WhatsApp service not configured, message not sent');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      const formattedTo = message.to.startsWith('whatsapp:')
        ? message.to
        : `whatsapp:${message.to}`;

      const twilioMessage = await this.twilioClient.messages.create({
        from: this.whatsappNumber,
        to: formattedTo,
        body: message.body,
        ...(message.mediaUrl && { mediaUrl: [message.mediaUrl] }),
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `WhatsApp message sent successfully to ${message.to}. SID: ${twilioMessage.sid}`,
      );

      return twilioMessage;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to send WhatsApp message to ${message.to}`,
        error?.message || String(error),
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send a message using a predefined template
   */
  async sendTemplateMessage(
    template: WhatsAppTemplateMessage,
  ): Promise<MessageInstance | null> {
    if (!this.isConfigured) {
      this.logger.warn('WhatsApp service not configured, template message not sent');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      const body = this.buildTemplateMessage(
        template.templateName,
        template.templateParams || {},
        template.language || 'en',
      );

      return await this.sendMessage({
        to: template.to,
        body,
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(
        `Failed to send template message to ${template.to}`,
        error?.message || String(error),
      );
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send bulk messages (with rate limiting consideration)
   */
  async sendBulkMessages(
    messages: WhatsAppMessage[],
  ): Promise<Array<MessageInstance | null>> {
    if (!this.isConfigured) {
      this.logger.warn('WhatsApp service not configured, bulk messages not sent');
      return [];
    }

    const results: Array<MessageInstance | null> = [];

    // Twilio has rate limits, so we'll process messages with a slight delay
    for (const message of messages) {
      try {
        const result = await this.sendMessage(message);
        results.push(result);

        // Add small delay between messages to respect rate limits (100ms)
        await this.delay(100);
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.error(`Failed to send bulk message to ${message.to}`, error);
        results.push(null);
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(`Bulk WhatsApp send completed: ${results.filter(r => r !== null).length}/${messages.length} successful`);
    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Send a message with a PDF attachment
   */
  async sendDocument(
    to: string,
    message: string,
    documentUrl: string,
  ): Promise<MessageInstance | null> {
    return this.sendMessage({
      to,
      body: message,
      mediaUrl: documentUrl,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Build a message from a template with parameters
   */
  private buildTemplateMessage(
    templateName: string,
    params: Record<string, string>,
    language: 'en' | 'sw',
  ): string {
    // This will be replaced with actual template system
    // For now, we'll use a simple string replacement
    const templates = this.getTemplates(language);
    let template = templates[templateName];

    if (!template) {
      this.logger.warn(`Template ${templateName} not found, using default`);
      template = 'Message from school: {message}';
    }

    // Replace all {paramName} with actual values
    Object.keys(params).forEach((key) => {
      template = template.replace(new RegExp(`\\{${key}\\}`, 'g'), params[key]);
    });

    return template;
  }

  /**
   * Get message templates (will be moved to database later)
   */
  private getTemplates(language: 'en' | 'sw'): Record<string, string> {
    // Placeholder - these will be stored in database
    const templates = {
      en: {
        welcome: 'Welcome to {schoolName}! We are excited to have {studentName} join us.',
        generic: '{message}',
      },
      sw: {
        welcome: 'Karibu {schoolName}! Tunafurahi kuwa na {studentName} akiungana nasi.',
        generic: '{message}',
      },
    };

    return templates[language] || templates.en;
  }

  /**
   * Utility function to add delay
   */
  private delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  /**
   * Validate phone number format (E.164)
   */
  validatePhoneNumber(phoneNumber: string): boolean {
    // E.164 format: +[country code][number]
    // Example: +254712345678 (Kenya), +919876543210 (India)
    const e164Regex = /^\+[1-9]\d{1,14}$/;
    return e164Regex.test(phoneNumber);
  }

  /**
   * Format phone number to E.164 if possible
   */
  formatPhoneNumber(phoneNumber: string, defaultCountryCode: string = '254'): string {
    // Remove all non-digit characters except +
    let cleaned = phoneNumber.replace(/[^\d+]/g, '');

    // If already starts with +, assume it's in E.164 format
    if (cleaned.startsWith('+')) {
      return cleaned;
    }

    // If starts with 0, remove it and add country code
    if (cleaned.startsWith('0')) {
      cleaned = cleaned.substring(1);
    }

    // Add + and country code if not present
    return `+${defaultCountryCode}${cleaned}`;
  }
}

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  IsString,
  IsUUID,
  IsEnum,
  IsOptional,
  IsDateString,
  IsInt,
  Min,
  Max,
  MinLength,
  IsArray,
  ValidateNested,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';

export enum ExaminationType {
  FORMATIVE = 'FORMATIVE', // Continuous assessment
  SUMMATIVE = 'SUMMATIVE', // End of term
  DIAGNOSTIC = 'DIAGNOSTIC', // Placement/screening
  COMPETENCY = 'COMPETENCY', // CBC assessment
}

export enum GradingSystem {
  PERCENTAGE = 'PERCENTAGE', // 0-100
  LETTER = 'LETTER', // A, B, C, D, E
  COMPETENCY = 'COMPETENCY', // Exceeds, Meets, Approaches, Below
  POINTS = 'POINTS', // 12, 11, 10, 9...
}

    minimum: 1,

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(1000)
  totalMarks: number;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'Pass mark', example: 40 })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  passMark?: number;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'Weighting factor', example: 1.0 })
  @IsOptional()
  weight?: number;
}

export class UpdateExaminationDto {
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'Examination name' })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MinLength(3)

File: apps/api/src/modules/examinations/examinations.service.ts
================
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  CreateExaminationDto,
  UpdateExaminationDto,
  GradingSystem,
} from './dto/create-examination.dto';
import {
  EnterGradeDto,
  BulkEnterGradesDto,
  UpdateGradeDto,
  QueryGradesDto,
  CompetencyLevel,
} from './dto/marks-entry.dto';
import {
  GenerateReportCardDto,
  BulkGenerateReportCardsDto,
  UpdateReportCardDto,
  ApproveReportCardDto,
  QueryReportCardsDto,
  ReportCardStatus,
} from './dto/report-card.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ExaminationsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExaminationsService.name);

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== EXAMINATIONS ====================

  async createExamination(dto: CreateExaminationDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate term exists
    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Validate class exists
    const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
    }

    // Validate stream if provided
    if (dto.streamId) {
      const streamExists = await this.prisma.stream.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.streamId, classId: dto.classId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!streamExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Stream not found');
      }
    }

    // Validate all subjects exist
    const subjectIds = dto.subjects.map((s) => s.subjectId);
    const subjects = await this.prisma.subject.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: subjectIds }, tenantId },
    });

    if (subjects.length !== subjectIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Some subjects not found');
    }

    // Create examination
    const examination = await this.prisma.examination.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        name: dto.name,
        description: dto.description,
        termId: dto.termId,
        classId: dto.classId,
        streamId: dto.streamId,
        examinationType: dto.examinationType,
        gradingSystem: dto.gradingSystem,
        startDate: dto.startDate ? new Date(dto.startDate) : null,
        endDate: dto.endDate ? new Date(dto.endDate) : null,
        createdBy: userId,
      },
    });

    // Create subject configurations
    await this.prisma.examinationSubject.createMany({
      data: dto.subjects.map((subject) => ({
        examinationId: examination.id,
        subjectId: subject.subjectId,
        totalMarks: subject.totalMarks,
        passMark: subject.passMark,
        weight: subject.weight || 1.0,
      })),
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Examination created: ${examination.name} for ${classExists.name}`,
    );

    return this.findOneExamination(examination.id);
  }

  async findAllExaminations(
    termId?: string,
    classId?: string,
    streamId?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    if (streamId) {
      where.streamId = streamId;
    }

    const examinations = await this.prisma.examination.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
        class: {
          select: { name: true, level: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        _count: {
          select: { grades: true },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return examinations;
  }

  async findOneExamination(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const examination = await this.prisma.examination.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        term: true,
        class: true,
        stream: true,
        subjects: {
          include: {
            subject: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
                code: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!examination) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Examination not found');
    }

    return examination;
  }

  async updateExamination(
    id: string,
    dto: UpdateExaminationDto,
    userId?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    await this.findOneExamination(id);

    const updated = await this.prisma.examination.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.name && { name: dto.name }),
        ...(dto.description !== undefined && { description: dto.description }),
        ...(dto.startDate && { startDate: new Date(dto.startDate) }),
        ...(dto.endDate && { endDate: new Date(dto.endDate) }),
      },
    });

    return this.findOneExamination(updated.id);
  }

  async deleteExamination(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const examination = await this.findOneExamination(id);

    // Check if grades have been entered
    const gradesCount = await this.prisma.grade.count({
      where: { examinationId: id },
    });

    if (gradesCount > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Cannot delete examination with existing grades',
      );
    }

    // Delete subject configurations first
    await this.prisma.examinationSubject.deleteMany({
      where: { examinationId: id },
    });

    // Delete examination
    await this.prisma.examination.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    return { success: true, message: 'Examination deleted successfully' };
  }

  // ==================== GRADES ====================

  async enterGrade(dto: EnterGradeDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate examination exists
    const examination = await this.findOneExamination(dto.examinationId);

    // Validate student exists and belongs to the class
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: {
        id: dto.studentId,
        tenantId,
        currentClassId: examination.classId,
        ...(examination.streamId && { currentStreamId: examination.streamId }),
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        'Student not found or does not belong to examination class',
      );
    }

    // Validate subject is part of examination
    const examSubject = await this.prisma.examinationSubject.findFirst({
      where: {
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (!examSubject) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Subject not part of this examination');
    }

    // Validate score doesn't exceed total marks
    if (dto.score > examSubject.totalMarks) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Score (${dto.score}) exceeds total marks (${examSubject.totalMarks})`,
      );
    }

    // Check for existing grade
    const existing = await this.prisma.grade.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException('Grade already entered for this student/subject');
    }

    // Calculate grade and position
    const percentage = (dto.score / examSubject.totalMarks) * 100;
    const letterGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(percentage);

    // Create grade
    const grade = await this.prisma.grade.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
        score: dto.score,
        totalMarks: examSubject.totalMarks,
        percentage: Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100,
        letterGrade,
        competencyLevel: dto.competencyLevel,
        remarks: dto.remarks,
        enteredBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        subject: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Grade entered: ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} - ${examSubject.totalMarks} - ${dto.score}`,
    );

    return grade;
  }

  async bulkEnterGrades(dto: BulkEnterGradesDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate examination and subject
    const examination = await this.findOneExamination(dto.examinationId);

    const examSubject = await this.prisma.examinationSubject.findFirst({
      where: {
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (!examSubject) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Subject not part of this examination');
    }

    // Validate all students
    const studentIds = dto.grades.map((g) => g.studentId);
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: studentIds },
        tenantId,
        currentClassId: examination.classId,
      },
    });

    if (students.length !== studentIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Some students not found or not in class');
    }

    // Check for existing grades
    const existing = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: { in: studentIds },
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Grades already exist for ${existing.length} student(s)`,
      );
    }

    // Validate scores
    for (const grade of dto.grades) {
      if (grade.score > examSubject.totalMarks) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Score ${grade.score} exceeds total marks ${examSubject.totalMarks}`,
        );
      }
    }

    // Create grades in transaction
    const grades = await this.prisma.$transaction(
      dto.grades.map((grade) => {
        const percentage = (grade.score / examSubject.totalMarks) * 100;
        const letterGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(percentage);

        return this.prisma.grade.create({
          data: {
            tenantId,
            studentId: grade.studentId,
            examinationId: dto.examinationId,
            subjectId: dto.subjectId,
            score: grade.score,
            totalMarks: examSubject.totalMarks,
            percentage: Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100,
            letterGrade,
            competencyLevel: grade.competencyLevel,
            remarks: grade.remarks,
            enteredBy: userId,
          },
        });
      }),
    );

    this.logger.log(
      `Bulk grades entered: ${grades.length} students for subject ${dto.subjectId}`,
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      gradesEntered: grades.length,
      examinationId: dto.examinationId,
      subjectId: dto.subjectId,
    };
  }

  async updateGrade(id: string, dto: UpdateGradeDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const grade = await this.prisma.grade.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!grade) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Grade not found');
    }

    let percentage = grade.percentage;
    let letterGrade = grade.letterGrade;

    if (dto.score !== undefined) {
      percentage = (dto.score / grade.totalMarks) * 100;
      letterGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(percentage);
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.grade.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.score !== undefined && {
          score: dto.score,
          percentage: Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100,
          letterGrade,
        }),
        ...(dto.competencyLevel && { competencyLevel: dto.competencyLevel }),
        ...(dto.remarks !== undefined && { remarks: dto.remarks }),
        enteredBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        subject: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async queryGrades(query: QueryGradesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { examinationId, studentId, subjectId, classId, termId } = query;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (examinationId) {
      where.examinationId = examinationId;
    }

    if (studentId) {
      where.studentId = studentId;
    }

    if (subjectId) {
      where.subjectId = subjectId;
    }

    if (classId || termId) {
      where.examination = {};
      if (classId) {
        where.examination.classId = classId;
      }
      if (termId) {
        where.examination.termId = termId;
      }
    }

    const grades = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        subject: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        examination: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            examinationType: true,
            gradingSystem: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [
        { examination: { createdAt: 'desc' } },
        { student: { lastName: 'asc' } },
      ],
    });

    return grades;
  }

  // ==================== REPORT CARDS ====================

  async generateReportCard(dto: GenerateReportCardDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate student and term
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        currentStream: true,
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Check if report card already exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.reportCard.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException('Report card already generated for this term');
    }

    // Get all grades for this student in this term
    const grades = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        examination: {
          termId: dto.termId,
        },
      },
      include: {
        subject: true,
        examination: true,
      },
    });

    if (grades.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'No grades found for this student in this term',
      );
    }

    // Calculate overall statistics
    const totalScore = grades.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.score, 0);
    const totalPossible = grades.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.totalMarks, 0);
    const averagePercentage = (totalScore / totalPossible) * 100;
    const overallGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(averagePercentage);

    // Create report card
    const reportCard = await this.prisma.reportCard.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
        classId: student.currentClassId,
        streamId: student.currentStreamId,
        totalScore,
        averagePercentage: Math.round(averagePercentage * 100) / 100,
        overallGrade,
        classTeacherComments: dto.classTeacherComments,
        principalComments: dto.principalComments,
        status: ReportCardStatus.DRAFT,
        generatedBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        term: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            termNumber: true,
          },
        },
        class: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Report card generated: ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} - ${term.name}`,
    );

    return reportCard;
  }

  async bulkGenerateReportCards(dto: BulkGenerateReportCardsDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get all students in the class/stream
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      currentClassId: dto.classId,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (dto.streamId) {
      where.currentStreamId = dto.streamId;
    }

    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where,
      select: { id: true, firstName: true, lastName: true },
    });

    if (students.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No students found in this class/stream');
    }

    const results = {
      total: students.length,
      generated: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const student of students) {
      try {
        await this.generateReportCard(
          {
            studentId: student.id,
            termId: dto.termId,
          },
          userId,
        );
        results.generated++;
      } catch (error: any) {
        if (error instanceof ConflictException) {
          results.skipped++;
        } else {
          results.errors.push({
            student: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
            error: error.message,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async findAllReportCards(query: QueryReportCardsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { termId, studentId, classId, status } = query;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    if (studentId) {
      where.studentId = studentId;
    }

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    if (status) {
      where.status = status;
    }

    const reportCards = await this.prisma.reportCard.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        term: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            termNumber: true,
          },
        },
        class: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [{ term: { termNumber: 'desc' } }, { student: { lastName: 'asc' } }],
    });

    return reportCards;
  }

  async findOneReportCard(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const reportCard = await this.prisma.reportCard.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            currentClass: true,
            currentStream: true,
          },
        },
        term: true,
        class: true,
        stream: true,
      },
    });

    if (!reportCard) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Report card not found');
    }

    // Get all grades for this report card
    const grades = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: reportCard.studentId,
        examination: {
          termId: reportCard.termId,
        },
      },
      include: {
        subject: true,
        examination: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            examinationType: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { subject: { name: 'asc' } },
    });

    return {
      ...reportCard,
      grades,
    };
  }

  async updateReportCard(id: string, dto: UpdateReportCardDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    await this.findOneReportCard(id);

    const updated = await this.prisma.reportCard.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.classTeacherComments !== undefined && {
          classTeacherComments: dto.classTeacherComments,
        }),
        ...(dto.principalComments !== undefined && {
          principalComments: dto.principalComments,
        }),
        ...(dto.status && { status: dto.status }),
      },
    });

    return this.findOneReportCard(updated.id);
  }

  async approveReportCard(dto: ApproveReportCardDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const reportCard = await this.findOneReportCard(dto.reportCardId);

    if (reportCard.status === ReportCardStatus.PUBLISHED) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Report card already published');
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.reportCard.update({
      where: { id: dto.reportCardId },
      data: {
        status: ReportCardStatus.APPROVED,
        principalComments: dto.principalComments || reportCard.principalComments,
        approvedBy: userId,
        approvedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    return this.findOneReportCard(updated.id);
  }

  // ==================== UTILITIES ====================

  private calculateLetterGrade(percentage: number): string {
    if (percentage >= 80) return 'A';
    if (percentage >= 70) return 'B';
    if (percentage >= 60) return 'C';
    if (percentage >= 50) return 'D';
    return 'E';
  }

  async getExaminationStats(examinationId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [totalGrades, gradeDistribution, subjectStats] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.grade.count({
        where: { tenantId, examinationId },
      }),
      this.prisma.grade.groupBy({
        by: ['letterGrade'],
        where: { tenantId, examinationId },
        _count: true,
      }),
      this.prisma.grade.groupBy({
        by: ['subjectId'],
        where: { tenantId, examinationId },
        _avg: { percentage: true },
        _count: true,
      }),
    ]);

    const distribution = gradeDistribution.reduce((acc, item) => {
      acc[item.letterGrade] = item._count;
      return acc;
    }, {} as any);

    return {
      totalGrades,
      distribution,
      subjectStats,
    };
  }
}

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  IsUUID,
  IsInt,
  Min,
  IsEnum,
  IsString,
  IsOptional,
  IsDateString,
  MinLength,
} from 'class-validator';
import { PaymentMethod } from '@krypton/types';

export class RecordPaymentDto {
  @ApiProperty({ description: 'Invoice ID to allocate payment to' })
  @IsUUID()
  invoiceId: string;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Payment amount in minor units (cents)',
    example: 500000,
    minimum: 1,
  })
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  amount: number;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Payment method',
    enum: PaymentMethod,
    example: PaymentMethod.MPESA,
  })
  @IsEnum(PaymentMethod)
  paymentMethod: PaymentMethod;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Payment reference (M-Pesa code, receipt number, etc.)',
    example: 'QGH123XYZ',
  })
  @IsString()
  @MinLength(3)
  reference: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    description: 'Payment date (defaults to now)',
    example: '2024-01-15',
  })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsDateString()
  paymentDate?: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'Additional notes' })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  notes?: string;
}

File: apps/api/src/modules/fees/fees.service.ts
================
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { FeeCategory } from '@krypton/types';
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateFeeStructureDto } from './dto/create-fee-structure.dto';
import { CreateInvoiceDto } from './dto/create-invoice.dto';
import { RecordPaymentDto } from './dto/record-payment.dto';
import { QueryInvoicesDto } from './dto/query-invoices.dto';
import { GenerateInvoicesDto } from './dto/generate-invoices.dto';
import { formatCurrency } from '@krypton/utils';

@Injectable()
export class FeesService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== FEE STRUCTURES ====================

  async createFeeStructure(dto: CreateFeeStructureDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate term exists
    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Validate class if provided
    if (dto.classId) {
      const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!classExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
      }
    }

    // Create fee structure with items
    const feeStructure = await this.prisma.feeStructure.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        name: dto.name,
        description: dto.description,
        termId: dto.termId,
        classId: dto.classId,
        isActive: true,
        feeItems: {
          create: dto.feeItems.map((item) => ({
            name: item.name,
            description: item.description,
            amount: item.amount,
            feeCategory: item.feeCategory as FeeCategory,
            isOptional: item.isOptional || false,
            sortOrder: item.sortOrder || 0,
          })),
        },
      },
      include: {
        feeItems: {
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
        class: {
          select: { name: true, level: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return feeStructure;
  }

  async findAllFeeStructures(termId?: string, classId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    const feeStructures = await this.prisma.feeStructure.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        feeItems: {
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
        class: {
          select: { name: true, level: true },
        },
        _count: {
          select: { invoices: true },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return feeStructures;
  }

  async findOneFeeStructure(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const feeStructure = await this.prisma.feeStructure.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        feeItems: {
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
        term: true,
        class: true,
      },
    });

    if (!feeStructure) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Fee structure not found');
    }

    return feeStructure;
  }

  async deactivateFeeStructure(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    await this.findOneFeeStructure(id);

    const updated = await this.prisma.feeStructure.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { isActive: false },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  // ==================== INVOICES ====================

  async createInvoice(dto: CreateInvoiceDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate student exists
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    // Validate term exists
    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Check if invoice already exists for this student and term
    const existing = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
        status: { not: 'CANCELLED' },
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException('Invoice already exists for this student and term');
    }

    // Calculate total amount
    const totalAmount = dto.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);

    // Generate invoice number
    const invoiceNumber = await this.generateInvoiceNumber();

    // Create invoice with items
    const invoice = await this.prisma.invoice.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        invoiceNumber,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
        totalAmount,
        paidAmount: 0,
        balanceAmount: totalAmount,
        status: 'PENDING',
        dueDate: dto.dueDate ? new Date(dto.dueDate) : null,
        invoiceItems: {
          create: dto.items.map((item) => ({
            description: item.description,
            amount: item.amount,
            feeCategory: item.feeCategory as FeeCategory,
          })),
        },
      },
      include: {
        invoiceItems: true,
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return invoice;
  }

  async generateInvoices(dto: GenerateInvoicesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get fee structure
    const feeStructure = await this.findOneFeeStructure(dto.feeStructureId);

    if (!feeStructure.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Fee structure is not active');
    }

    // Get students to generate invoices for
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (dto.classId) {
      where.currentClassId = dto.classId;
    } else if (feeStructure.classId) {
      where.currentClassId = feeStructure.classId;
    }

    if (dto.streamId) {
      where.currentStreamId = dto.streamId;
    }

    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where,
      select: { id: true, admissionNumber: true, firstName: true, lastName: true },
    });

    if (students.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No students found matching criteria');
    }

    // Generate invoices
    const results = {
      total: students.length,
      created: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const student of students) {
      try {
        // Check if invoice already exists
        const existing = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            studentId: student.id,
            termId: feeStructure.termId,
            status: { not: 'CANCELLED' },
          },
        });

        if (existing) {
          results.skipped++;
          continue;
        }

        // Create invoice
        const items = feeStructure.feeItems.map((item) => ({
          description: (item.description || item.name || 'Fee item') as string,
          amount: item.amount,
          feeCategory: item.feeCategory as FeeCategory,
        }));

        await this.createInvoice({
          studentId: student.id,
          termId: feeStructure.termId,
          items,
          dueDate: dto.dueDate,
        });

        results.created++;
      } catch (error: any) {
        results.errors.push({
          student: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} (${student.admissionNumber})`,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async findAllInvoices(query: QueryInvoicesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { page = 1, pageSize = 20, ...filters } = query;

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (filters.studentId) {
      where.studentId = filters.studentId;
    }

    if (filters.termId) {
      where.termId = filters.termId;
    }

    if (filters.status) {
      where.status = filters.status;
    }

    const [invoices, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.invoice.findMany({
        where,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
        include: {
          student: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              admissionNumber: true,
              firstName: true,
              lastName: true,
              currentClass: {
                select: { name: true },
              },
            },
          },
          term: {
            select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
          },
          _count: {
            select: { payments: true },
          },
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.count({ where }),
    ]);

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

    return {
      data: invoices,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages,
        hasNextPage: page < totalPages,
        hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async findOneInvoice(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const invoice = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        invoiceItems: true,
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
            middleName: true,
            currentClass: {
              select: { name: true, level: true },
            },
            currentStream: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        },
        term: true,
        payments: {
          orderBy: { paymentDate: 'desc' },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!invoice) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Invoice not found');
    }

    return invoice;
  }

  async cancelInvoice(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const invoice = await this.findOneInvoice(id);

    if (invoice.paidAmount > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot cancel invoice with payments');
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.invoice.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { status: 'CANCELLED' },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  // ==================== PAYMENTS ====================

  async recordPayment(dto: RecordPaymentDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(dto.amount) || dto.amount <= 0) throw new BadRequestException('Amount must be positive minor units');
    const existing = await this.prisma.payment.findFirst({where:{tenantId,reference:dto.reference}});
    if(existing){
      if(existing.invoiceId===dto.invoiceId&&existing.amount===dto.amount&&existing.status==='COMPLETED')return existing;
      throw new ConflictException('Payment reference is already in use');
    }
    try {
      return await this.prisma.$transaction(async tx=>{
        // The conditional decrement obtains the invoice row lock and prevents concurrent overpayments.
        const changed=await tx.invoice.updateMany({where:{id:dto.invoiceId,tenantId,status:{in:['PENDING','PARTIALLY_PAID','OVERDUE']},balanceAmount:{gte:dto.amount}},data:{paidAmount:{increment:dto.amount},balanceAmount:{decrement:dto.amount}}});
        if(!changed.count)throw new BadRequestException('Invoice unavailable or payment exceeds the remaining balance');
        const invoice=await tx.invoice.findFirstOrThrow({where:{id:dto.invoiceId,tenantId}});
        await tx.invoice.update({where:{id:invoice.id,tenantId},data:{status:invoice.balanceAmount===0?'PAID':'PARTIALLY_PAID'}});
        return tx.payment.create({data:{tenantId,invoiceId:dto.invoiceId,amount:dto.amount,paymentMethod:dto.paymentMethod,reference:dto.reference,status:'COMPLETED',paymentDate:dto.paymentDate?new Date(dto.paymentDate):new Date(),receiptNumber:'RCT-'+randomUUID().slice(0,12).toUpperCase(),receiptIssued:true,receiptIssuedAt:new Date(),notes:dto.notes,processedBy:userId}});
      });
    }catch(error:any){
      if(error.code==='P2002'){
        const duplicate=await this.prisma.payment.findFirst({where:{tenantId,reference:dto.reference}});
        if(duplicate?.invoiceId===dto.invoiceId&&duplicate.amount===dto.amount&&duplicate.status==='COMPLETED')return duplicate;
        throw new ConflictException('Payment reference is already in use');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async findAllPayments(invoiceId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (invoiceId) {
      where.invoiceId = invoiceId;
    }

    const payments = await this.prisma.payment.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        invoice: {
          select: {
            invoiceNumber: true,
            student: {
              select: {
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { paymentDate: 'desc' },
    });

    return payments;
  }

  async findOnePayment(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const payment = await this.prisma.payment.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        invoice: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                currentClass: {
                  select: { name: true },
                },
              },
            },
            term: {
              select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!payment) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Payment not found');
    }

    return payment;
  }

  // ==================== FINANCIAL REPORTS ====================

  async getFinancialSummary(termId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    const [invoices, totalExpected, totalCollected, overdueInvoices] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.invoice.count({
        where: { ...where, status: { not: 'CANCELLED' } },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.aggregate({
        where: { ...where, status: { not: 'CANCELLED' } },
        _sum: { totalAmount: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.aggregate({
        where: { ...where, status: { not: 'CANCELLED' } },
        _sum: { paidAmount: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          status: 'OVERDUE',
        },
      }),
    ]);

    const expected = totalExpected._sum.totalAmount || 0;
    const collected = totalCollected._sum.paidAmount || 0;
    const outstanding = expected - collected;
    const collectionRate = expected > 0 ? (collected / expected) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      totalInvoices: invoices,
      totalExpected: expected,
      totalCollected: collected,
      outstanding,
      collectionRate: Math.round(collectionRate * 100) / 100,
      overdueInvoices,
    };
  }

  // ==================== UTILITIES ====================

  private async generateInvoiceNumber(): Promise<string> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const count = await this.prisma.invoice.count({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    return 'INV-'+year+'-'+randomUUID().slice(0,8).toUpperCase();
  }

  private async generateReceiptNumber(): Promise<string> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const count = await this.prisma.payment.count({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    return `RCT-${year}-${String(count + 1).padStart(6, '0')}`;
  }
}

import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger';

  GenerateReportDto,
  GetReportsQueryDto,
  ApproveReportDto,
  SubmitReportDto,

  ChecklistResponseDto,

  AlertResponseDto,
  ExportPortalDataDto,
  LogAuditRecordOverrideDto,
} from '../dto';

@ApiTags('Government - Compliance Reporting')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@Controller('government/compliance')
export class ComplianceController {
  constructor(private readonly complianceService: ComplianceService) {}

  // ===================================
  // REPORTS
  // ===================================

  @Post('reports/generate')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Generate a compliance report' })
  @ApiResponse({ 
    status: 201, 
    description: 'Report generated successfully',
    type: ComplianceReportResponseDto,
  })
  async generateReport(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Body() dto: GenerateReportDto,
  ): Promise<any> {
    const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
    
    switch (dto.reportType) {
      case 'ENROLLMENT_STATISTICS':
        return this.complianceService.generateEnrollmentReport(
          tenantId,
          dto.reportPeriod,
          dto.reportYear,
          dto.reportQuarter,
        );
      
      case 'ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY':
        if (!dto.startDate || !dto.endDate) {
          throw new Error('Start date and end date required for attendance report');
        }
        return this.complianceService.generateAttendanceReport(
          tenantId,
          dto.reportPeriod,
          dto.reportYear,
          new Date(dto.startDate),
          new Date(dto.endDate),
        );
      
      case 'TEACHER_DATA_REPORT':
        return this.complianceService.generateTeacherDataReport(
          tenantId,
          dto.reportPeriod,
          dto.reportYear,
        );
      
      case 'EXAMINATION_ANALYSIS':
        if (!dto.termId) {
          throw new Error('Term ID required for examination report');
        }
        return this.complianceService.generateExaminationReport(
          tenantId,
          dto.reportPeriod,
          dto.reportYear,
          dto.termId,
        );
      
      case 'FINANCIAL_SUMMARY':
        return this.complianceService.generateFinancialReport(
          tenantId,
          dto.reportPeriod,
          dto.reportYear,
          dto.reportMonth,
        );
      
      default:
        throw new Error('Unsupported report type');
    }
  }

  @Get('reports')

        approved: reports.filter(r => r.status === 'APPROVED').length,
        submitted: reports.filter(r => r.status === 'SUBMITTED').length,
      },
      checklists: {
        total: checklists.length,
        pending: checklists.filter(c => c.status === 'PENDING').length,
        inProgress: checklists.filter(c => c.status === 'IN_PROGRESS').length,
        completed: checklists.filter(c => c.status === 'COMPLETED').length,
        overdue: checklists.filter(c => c.status === 'OVERDUE').length,
      },
      alerts: {
        total: alerts.length,
        critical: alerts.filter(a => a.severity === 'CRITICAL').length,
        error: alerts.filter(a => a.severity === 'ERROR').length,
        warning: alerts.filter(a => a.severity === 'WARNING').length,
        info: alerts.filter(a => a.severity === 'INFO').length,
        active: alerts.filter(a => a.status === 'ACTIVE').length,
      },
    };
  }

      dto.evidenceUrls,
    );
  }

  @Get('sync-history')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get KNEC sync history' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Sync history retrieved' })
  async getSyncHistory(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Query('limit') limit?: number,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
    return this.knecService.getSyncHistory(tenantId, limit || 50);
  }

  @Get('stats')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get KNEC registration statistics' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Statistics retrieved' })
  async getStatistics(@Request() req: any) {
    const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
    const registrations = await this.knecService.getRegistrations(tenantId);
    
    const stats = {
      totalRegistrations: registrations.length,
      byExamLevel: registrations.reduce((acc: any, reg: any) => {
        acc[reg.examLevel] = (acc[reg.examLevel] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
      }, {}),
      byStatus: registrations.reduce((acc: any, reg: any) => {
        acc[reg.registrationStatus] = (acc[reg.registrationStatus] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
      }, {}),
      pendingPayment: registrations.filter((r: any) => !r.isPaid).length,
      resultsAvailable: registrations.filter((r: any) => r.resultsAvailable).length,
    };

    return stats;
  }
}

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigModule } from '@nestjs/config';
import { BullModule } from '@nestjs/bull';
import { ScheduleModule } from '@nestjs/schedule';
import { DatabaseModule } from '../../database/database.module';

// Services
import { NemisService } from './services/nemis.service';
import { KnecService } from './services/knec.service';
import { ComplianceService } from './services/compliance.service';

// Controllers
import { NemisController } from './controllers/nemis.controller';
import { KnecController } from './controllers/knec.controller';
import { ComplianceController } from './controllers/compliance.controller';

// Jobs
import { GovernmentSyncProcessor } from './jobs/government-sync.processor';
import { GovernmentSchedulerService } from './jobs/government-scheduler.service';

@Module({
  imports: [
    ConfigModule,
    DatabaseModule,
    ScheduleModule.forRoot(),
    BullModule.registerQueue({
      name: 'government-sync',
      defaultJobOptions: {
        attempts: 3,
        backoff: {
          type: 'exponential',
          delay: 2000,
        },
        removeOnComplete: {
          age: 7 * 24 * 3600, // Keep completed jobs for 7 days
          count: 1000, // Keep last 1000 jobs
        },
        removeOnFail: {
          age: 30 * 24 * 3600, // Keep failed jobs for 30 days
        },
      },
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [
    NemisController,
    KnecController,
    ComplianceController,
  ],
  providers: [
    NemisService,
    KnecService,
    ComplianceService,
    GovernmentSyncProcessor,
    GovernmentSchedulerService,
  ],
  exports: [
    NemisService,
    KnecService,
    ComplianceService,
    GovernmentSchedulerService,
  ],
})
export class GovernmentModule {}
