import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule';
import { InjectQueue } from '@nestjs/bull';
import { Queue } from 'bull';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../database/prisma.service';

/**
 * Scheduler service for automated government integration tasks
 */
@Injectable()
export class GovernmentSchedulerService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GovernmentSchedulerService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('government-sync') private readonly syncQueue: Queue,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Schedule NEMIS sync jobs based on tenant configuration
   * Runs every hour to check if any tenant needs syncing
   */
  @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_HOUR)
  async scheduleNemisSync() {
    this.logger.log('Checking for NEMIS sync schedules...');

    try {
      const integrations = await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.findMany({
        where: {
          isEnabled: true,
          autoSync: true,
        },
      });

      for (const integration of integrations) {
        const shouldSync = this.shouldPerformSync(
          integration.syncFrequency,
          integration.syncTime,
          integration.lastSyncAt,
        );

        if (shouldSync) {
          this.logger.log(`Scheduling NEMIS sync for tenant: ${integration.tenantId}`);
          
          await this.syncQueue.add('nemis-full-sync', {
            tenantId: integration.tenantId,
          }, {
            attempts: 3,
            backoff: {
              type: 'exponential',
              delay: 5000,
            },
            removeOnComplete: true,
            removeOnFail: false,
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Error scheduling NEMIS sync: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check for compliance report deadlines
   * Runs daily at 8 AM
   */
  @Cron('0 8 * * *')
  async checkComplianceDeadlines() {
    this.logger.log('Checking compliance deadlines...');

    try {
      const tenants = await this.prisma.tenant.findMany({
        where: { status: 'ACTIVE' },
        select: { id: true },
      });

      for (const tenant of tenants) {
        await this.syncQueue.add('check-compliance-deadlines', {
          tenantId: tenant.id,
        }, {
          attempts: 2,
          removeOnComplete: true,
        });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Error checking compliance deadlines: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Run weekly data quality audits
   * Runs every Monday at 2 AM
   */
  @Cron('0 2 * * 1')
  async runWeeklyDataAudits() {
    this.logger.log('Running weekly data quality audits...');

    try {
      const tenants = await this.prisma.tenant.findMany({
        where: { status: 'ACTIVE' },
        select: { id: true },
      });

      for (const tenant of tenants) {
        await this.syncQueue.add('data-quality-audit', {
          tenantId: tenant.id,
          auditType: 'FULL_AUDIT',
        }, {
          attempts: 2,
          removeOnComplete: true,
        });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Error running data quality audits: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generate monthly compliance reports
   * Runs on the 1st of each month at 3 AM
   */
  @Cron('0 3 1 * *')
  async generateMonthlyReports() {
    this.logger.log('Generating monthly compliance reports...');

    try {
      const tenants = await this.prisma.tenant.findMany({
        where: { status: 'ACTIVE' },
        select: { id: true },
      });

      const now = new Date();
      const lastMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 1, 1);
      const lastMonthEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 0);
      
      const reportPeriod = `${lastMonth.toLocaleString('default', { month: 'long' })} ${lastMonth.getFullYear()}`;
      const reportYear = lastMonth.getFullYear();
      const reportMonth = lastMonth.getMonth() + 1;

      for (const tenant of tenants) {
        // Generate enrollment report
        await this.syncQueue.add('generate-compliance-report', {
          tenantId: tenant.id,
          reportType: 'ENROLLMENT_STATISTICS',
          reportPeriod,
          reportYear,
          reportMonth,
        }, {
          attempts: 2,
          removeOnComplete: true,
        });

        // Generate attendance report
        await this.syncQueue.add('generate-compliance-report', {
          tenantId: tenant.id,
          reportType: 'ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY',
          reportPeriod,
          reportYear,
          reportMonth,
          startDate: lastMonth,
          endDate: lastMonthEnd,
        }, {
          attempts: 2,
          removeOnComplete: true,
        });

        // Generate financial report
        await this.syncQueue.add('generate-compliance-report', {
          tenantId: tenant.id,
          reportType: 'FINANCIAL_SUMMARY',
          reportPeriod,
          reportYear,
          reportMonth,
        }, {
          attempts: 2,
          removeOnComplete: true,
        });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Error generating monthly reports: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check for KNEC results availability
   * Runs daily at 6 AM during exam result release periods
   */
  @Cron('0 6 * * *')
  async checkKnecResults() {
    this.logger.log('Checking for KNEC results...');

    try {
      // Check for registrations that might have results available
      const registrations = await this.prisma.knecExamRegistration.findMany({
        where: {
          registrationStatus: 'APPROVED',
          resultsAvailable: false,
          // Check exams from last 6 months
          createdAt: {
            gte: new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
          },
        },
        distinct: ['tenantId', 'examYear', 'examLevel'],
        select: {
          tenantId: true,
          examYear: true,
          examLevel: true,
        },
      });

      for (const reg of registrations) {
        await this.syncQueue.add('knec-results-download', {
          tenantId: reg.tenantId,
          examYear: reg.examYear,
          examLevel: reg.examLevel,
        }, {
          attempts: 3,
          backoff: {
            type: 'exponential',
            delay: 10000,
          },
          removeOnComplete: true,
        });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Error checking KNEC results: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sync daily attendance to NEMIS
   * Runs every day at 11 PM to sync the day's attendance
   */
  @Cron('0 23 * * *')
  async syncDailyAttendance() {
    this.logger.log('Syncing daily attendance to NEMIS...');

    try {
      const integrations = await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.findMany({
        where: {
          isEnabled: true,
        },
      });

      const today = new Date();
      today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      
      const tomorrow = new Date(today);
      tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);

      for (const integration of integrations) {
        await this.syncQueue.add('nemis-attendance-sync', {
          tenantId: integration.tenantId,
          startDate: today,
          endDate: tomorrow,
        }, {
          attempts: 3,
          backoff: {
            type: 'exponential',
            delay: 5000,
          },
          removeOnComplete: true,
        });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Error syncing daily attendance: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Manual scheduling methods
   */

  /**
   * Schedule immediate NEMIS full sync
   */
  async scheduleNemisFullSync(tenantId: string) {
    return this.syncQueue.add('nemis-full-sync', {
      tenantId,
    }, {
      priority: 1,
      attempts: 3,
      backoff: {
        type: 'exponential',
        delay: 5000,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Schedule NEMIS student sync
   */
  async scheduleNemisStudentSync(tenantId: string) {
    return this.syncQueue.add('nemis-student-sync', {
      tenantId,
    }, {
      priority: 2,
      attempts: 3,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Schedule NEMIS teacher sync
   */
  async scheduleNemisTeacherSync(tenantId: string) {
    return this.syncQueue.add('nemis-teacher-sync', {
      tenantId,
    }, {
      priority: 2,
      attempts: 3,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Schedule compliance report generation
   */
  async scheduleReportGeneration(
    tenantId: string,
    reportType: string,
    reportPeriod: string,
    reportYear: number,
    options?: any,
  ) {
    return this.syncQueue.add('generate-compliance-report', {
      tenantId,
      reportType,
      reportPeriod,
      reportYear,
      ...options,
    }, {
      priority: 3,
      attempts: 2,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Schedule data quality audit
   */
  async scheduleDataAudit(tenantId: string, auditType: string) {
    return this.syncQueue.add('data-quality-audit', {
      tenantId,
      auditType,
    }, {
      priority: 4,
      attempts: 2,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Schedule KNEC results download
   */
  async scheduleKnecResultsDownload(
    tenantId: string,
    examYear: number,
    examLevel: string,
  ) {
    return this.syncQueue.add('knec-results-download', {
      tenantId,
      examYear,
      examLevel,
    }, {
      priority: 2,
      attempts: 3,
      backoff: {
        type: 'exponential',
        delay: 10000,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Helper method to determine if sync should be performed
   */
  private shouldPerformSync(
    frequency: string,
    syncTime: string | null,
    lastSyncAt: Date | null,
  ): boolean {
    const now = new Date();
    
    // If never synced, sync now
    if (!lastSyncAt) return true;

    const hoursSinceLastSync = (now.getTime() - lastSyncAt.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);

    switch (frequency) {
      case 'HOURLY':
        return hoursSinceLastSync >= 1;
      
      case 'DAILY':
        // Check if it's the scheduled time (if specified)
        if (syncTime && hoursSinceLastSync >= 24) {
          const [hours, minutes] = syncTime.split(':').map(Number);
          const scheduledTime = new Date();
          scheduledTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
          
          // Sync if we're within 1 hour of the scheduled time
          const timeDiff = Math.abs(now.getTime() - scheduledTime.getTime()) / (1000 * 60);
          return timeDiff <= 60;
        }
        return hoursSinceLastSync >= 24;
      
      case 'WEEKLY':
        return hoursSinceLastSync >= 168; // 7 days
      
      case 'MONTHLY':
        return hoursSinceLastSync >= 720; // 30 days
      
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get queue statistics
   */
  async getQueueStats() {
    const [waiting, active, completed, failed, delayed] = await Promise.all([
      this.syncQueue.getWaitingCount(),
      this.syncQueue.getActiveCount(),
      this.syncQueue.getCompletedCount(),
      this.syncQueue.getFailedCount(),
      this.syncQueue.getDelayedCount(),
    ]);

    return {
      waiting,
      active,
      completed,
      failed,
      delayed,
      total: waiting + active + completed + failed + delayed,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get recent jobs
   */
  async getRecentJobs(limit: number = 50) {
    const jobs = await this.syncQueue.getJobs(
      ['completed', 'failed', 'active', 'waiting'],
      0,
      limit,
    );

    return jobs.map(job => ({
      id: job.id,
      name: job.name,
      data: job.data,
      progress: job.progress(),
      attemptsMade: job.attemptsMade,
      finishedOn: job.finishedOn,
      processedOn: job.processedOn,
      failedReason: job.failedReason,
      returnvalue: job.returnvalue,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Clean completed jobs older than 7 days
   */
  @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_DAY_AT_MIDNIGHT)
  async cleanOldJobs() {
    this.logger.log('Cleaning old completed jobs...');
    
    try {
      const sevenDaysAgo = Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      await this.syncQueue.clean(sevenDaysAgo, 'completed');
      await this.syncQueue.clean(sevenDaysAgo, 'failed');
      
      this.logger.log('Old jobs cleaned successfully');
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Error cleaning old jobs: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

File: apps/api/src/modules/government/jobs/government-sync.processor.ts

import { Processor, Process, OnQueueActive, OnQueueCompleted, OnQueueFailed } from '@nestjs/bull';
import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Job } from 'bull';
import { NemisService } from '../services/nemis.service';
import { KnecService } from '../services/knec.service';
import { ComplianceService } from '../services/compliance.service';

/**
 * Background processor for government integration sync jobs
 */
@Processor('government-sync')
export class GovernmentSyncProcessor {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GovernmentSyncProcessor.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly nemisService: NemisService,
    private readonly knecService: KnecService,
    private readonly complianceService: ComplianceService,
  ) {}

  @OnQueueActive()
  onActive(job: Job) {
    this.logger.log(`Processing job ${job.id} of type ${job.name}...`);
  }

  @OnQueueCompleted()
  onComplete(job: Job, result: any) {
    this.logger.log(`Job ${job.id} completed successfully`);
  }

  @OnQueueFailed()
  onError(job: Job, error: Error) {
    this.logger.error(`Job ${job.id} failed: ${error.message}`, error.stack);
  }

  /**
   * Process NEMIS full sync job
   */
  @Process('nemis-full-sync')
  async processNemisFullSync(job: Job<{ tenantId: string }>) {
    const { tenantId } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Starting NEMIS full sync for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      const result = await this.nemisService.performFullSync(tenantId);
      const errors = result.results?.errors || [];
      
      // Create alerts if there were errors
      if (errors.length > 0) {
        await this.complianceService.createAlert(
          tenantId,
          'SYNC_FAILURE',
          'WARNING',
          'NEMIS Sync Completed with Errors',
          `NEMIS sync completed but encountered ${errors.length} error(s)`,
          'NEMIS_SYNC',
          tenantId,
        );
      }

      return result;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`NEMIS full sync failed for tenant ${tenantId}: ${error.message}`);
      
      // Create critical alert
      await this.complianceService.createAlert(
        tenantId,
        'SYNC_FAILURE',
        'CRITICAL',
        'NEMIS Sync Failed',
        `NEMIS sync failed: ${error.message}`,
        'NEMIS_SYNC',
        tenantId,
      );

      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process NEMIS student sync job
   */
  @Process('nemis-student-sync')
  async processNemisStudentSync(job: Job<{ tenantId: string }>) {
    const { tenantId } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Starting NEMIS student sync for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      return await this.nemisService.syncStudentEnrollment(tenantId);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`NEMIS student sync failed: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process NEMIS teacher sync job
   */
  @Process('nemis-teacher-sync')
  async processNemisTeacherSync(job: Job<{ tenantId: string }>) {
    const { tenantId } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Starting NEMIS teacher sync for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      return await this.nemisService.syncTeacherData(tenantId);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`NEMIS teacher sync failed: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process NEMIS attendance sync job
   */
  @Process('nemis-attendance-sync')
  async processNemisAttendanceSync(
    job: Job<{ tenantId: string; startDate: Date; endDate: Date }>,
  ) {
    const { tenantId, startDate, endDate } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Starting NEMIS attendance sync for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      return await this.nemisService.syncAttendanceData(
        tenantId,
        new Date(startDate),
        new Date(endDate),
      );
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`NEMIS attendance sync failed: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process KNEC results download job
   */
  @Process('knec-results-download')
  async processKnecResultsDownload(
    job: Job<{ tenantId: string; examYear: number; examLevel: string }>,
  ) {
    const { tenantId, examYear, examLevel } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Downloading KNEC results for tenant: ${tenantId}, ${examLevel} ${examYear}`);

    try {
      const result = await this.knecService.downloadResults(
        tenantId,
        examYear,
        examLevel as any,
      );

      // Create alert if results are available
      if (result.succeeded > 0) {
        await this.complianceService.createAlert(
          tenantId,
          'SYNC_FAILURE',
          'INFO',
          'KNEC Results Available',
          `Downloaded ${result.succeeded} examination results for ${examLevel} ${examYear}`,
          'KNEC_RESULTS',
          tenantId,
        );
      }

      return result;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`KNEC results download failed: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process automated compliance report generation
   */
  @Process('generate-compliance-report')
  async processComplianceReport(
    job: Job<{
      tenantId: string;
      reportType: string;
      reportPeriod: string;
      reportYear: number;
      termId?: string;
      startDate?: Date;
      endDate?: Date;
    }>,
  ) {
    const { tenantId, reportType, reportPeriod, reportYear, termId, startDate, endDate } =
      job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Generating ${reportType} report for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      let report;

      switch (reportType) {
        case 'ENROLLMENT_STATISTICS':
          report = await this.complianceService.generateEnrollmentReport(
            tenantId,
            reportPeriod,
            reportYear,
          );
          break;

        case 'ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY':
          if (!startDate || !endDate) {
            throw new Error('Start and end dates required for attendance report');
          }
          report = await this.complianceService.generateAttendanceReport(
            tenantId,
            reportPeriod,
            reportYear,
            new Date(startDate),
            new Date(endDate),
          );
          break;

        case 'TEACHER_DATA_REPORT':
          report = await this.complianceService.generateTeacherDataReport(
            tenantId,
            reportPeriod,
            reportYear,
          );
          break;

        case 'EXAMINATION_ANALYSIS':
          if (!termId) {
            throw new Error('Term ID required for examination report');
          }
          report = await this.complianceService.generateExaminationReport(
            tenantId,
            reportPeriod,
            reportYear,
            termId,
          );
          break;

        case 'FINANCIAL_SUMMARY':
          report = await this.complianceService.generateFinancialReport(
            tenantId,
            reportPeriod,
            reportYear,
          );
          break;

        default:
          throw new Error(`Unsupported report type: ${reportType}`);
      }

      // Create alert that report is ready
      await this.complianceService.createAlert(
        tenantId,
        'REPORT_DUE',
        'INFO',
        'Compliance Report Generated',
        `${reportType} report for ${reportPeriod} has been generated and is ready for review`,
        'REPORT',
        report.id,
      );

      return report;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Compliance report generation failed: ${error.message}`);
      
      await this.complianceService.createAlert(
        tenantId,
        'SYSTEM_ERROR',
        'ERROR',
        'Report Generation Failed',
        `Failed to generate ${reportType} report: ${error.message}`,
        'REPORT',
        tenantId,
      );

      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process data quality audit job
   */
  @Process('data-quality-audit')
  async processDataQualityAudit(
    job: Job<{ tenantId: string; auditType: string }>,
  ) {
    const { tenantId, auditType } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Running ${auditType} audit for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      const audit = await this.complianceService.runDataQualityAudit(
        tenantId,
        auditType as any,
      );

      // Create alerts for critical issues
      if (audit.criticalIssues > 0) {
        await this.complianceService.createAlert(
          tenantId,
          'DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE',
          'CRITICAL',
          'Critical Data Quality Issues Found',
          `Data quality audit found ${audit.criticalIssues} critical issue(s) that require immediate attention`,
          'AUDIT',
          audit.id,
        );
      } else if (audit.warningIssues > 0) {
        await this.complianceService.createAlert(
          tenantId,
          'DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE',
          'WARNING',
          'Data Quality Warnings',
          `Data quality audit found ${audit.warningIssues} warning(s) that should be addressed`,
          'AUDIT',
          audit.id,
        );
      }

      return audit;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Data quality audit failed: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process compliance deadline check job
   */
  @Process('check-compliance-deadlines')
  async processComplianceDeadlineCheck(job: Job<{ tenantId: string }>) {
    const { tenantId } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Checking compliance deadlines for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      const checklists = await this.complianceService.getChecklists(tenantId);
      const now = new Date();
      const threeDaysFromNow = new Date(now.getTime() + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

      for (const checklist of checklists) {
        if (checklist.dueDate && checklist.status === 'PENDING') {
          const dueDate = new Date(checklist.dueDate);

          // Check if overdue
          if (dueDate < now) {
            await this.complianceService.createAlert(
              tenantId,
              'DEADLINE_APPROACHING',
              'ERROR',
              'Compliance Item Overdue',
              `"${checklist.title}" is overdue. Required by ${checklist.requiredBy}`,
              'CHECKLIST',
              checklist.id,
            );
          }
          // Check if due within 3 days
          else if (dueDate <= threeDaysFromNow) {
            await this.complianceService.createAlert(
              tenantId,
              'DEADLINE_APPROACHING',
              'WARNING',
              'Compliance Deadline Approaching',
              `"${checklist.title}" is due soon. Required by ${checklist.requiredBy}`,
              'CHECKLIST',
              checklist.id,
            );
          }
        }
      }

      return { checked: checklists.length };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Compliance deadline check failed: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process scheduled report submission
   */
  @Process('submit-scheduled-report')
  async processScheduledReportSubmission(
    job: Job<{ tenantId: string; reportId: string; userId: string }>,
  ) {
    const { tenantId, reportId, userId } = job.data;
    this.logger.log(`Submitting scheduled report ${reportId} for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    try {
      const report = await this.complianceService.submitReport(reportId, userId);

      await this.complianceService.createAlert(
        tenantId,
        'REPORT_DUE',
        'INFO',
        'Report Submitted',
        `Compliance report has been submitted to ${report.submittedTo}`,
        'REPORT',
        reportId,
      );

      return report;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Report submission failed: ${error.message}`);
      
      await this.complianceService.createAlert(
        tenantId,
        'SYSTEM_ERROR',
        'ERROR',
        'Report Submission Failed',
        `Failed to submit report: ${error.message}`,
        'REPORT',
        reportId,
      );

      throw error;
    }
  }
}

# Government Integration Module

Comprehensive government integration module for Kenyan schools, providing seamless integration with NEMIS (National Education Management Information System), KNEC (Kenya National Examinations Council), and automated compliance reporting.

## 🔥 Features

### NEMIS Integration
- **Student Enrollment Sync**: Automatically sync student data with NEMIS
- **Teacher Registration**: Register and update teacher information with TSC
- **School Profile Sync**: Keep school information up-to-date
- **Attendance Reporting**: Daily attendance data submission
- **Data Validation**: Comprehensive validation against NEMIS requirements
- **Automated Sync**: Scheduled background jobs for automatic data synchronization

### KNEC Integration
- **Candidate Registration**: Register students for national examinations (KCPE, KCSE, KPSEA)
- **Results Download**: Automatic download of examination results
- **Exam Timetable**: Retrieve official exam schedules
- **Irregularity Reporting**: Submit exam irregularity reports
- **Registration Management**: Track candidate registrations and payment status

### Automated Compliance Reporting
- **Enrollment Statistics**: Automated enrollment reports for government agencies
- **Attendance Summary**: Daily, weekly, monthly, and termly attendance reports
- **Teacher Data Reports**: TSC compliance reporting
- **Examination Analysis**: Performance analysis and statistics
- **Financial Reports**: Fee collection and financial summaries
- **Data Quality Audits**: Automated data validation and completeness checks
- **Compliance Alerts**: Real-time alerts for deadlines and issues
- **Checklist Management**: Track compliance requirements and deadlines

## 🔄 Background Jobs

### Automated Sync Jobs

The module includes several automated background jobs:

1. **NEMIS Full Sync** - Runs based on tenant configuration (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly)
2. **Daily Attendance Sync** - Runs every day at 11 PM
3. **KNEC Results Check** - Runs daily at 6 AM during exam result periods
4. **Compliance Deadline Check** - Runs daily at 8 AM
5. **Weekly Data Audits** - Runs every Monday at 2 AM
6. **Monthly Reports** - Runs on the 1st of each month at 3 AM

### Manual Job Scheduling

```typescript
import { GovernmentSchedulerService } from './modules/government';

@Injectable()
export class MyService {
  constructor(
    private readonly scheduler: GovernmentSchedulerService,
  ) {}

  async triggerSync(tenantId: string) {
    // Schedule immediate NEMIS sync
    await this.scheduler.scheduleNemisFullSync(tenantId);
    
    // Schedule report generation
    await this.scheduler.scheduleReportGeneration(
      tenantId,
      'ENROLLMENT_STATISTICS',
      'Term 1 2024',
      2024,
    );
    
    // Schedule data audit
    await this.scheduler.scheduleDataAudit(tenantId, 'FULL_AUDIT');
  }
}
```

## 🔧 Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

1. **Sync Failures**
   - Check API credentials are correctly configured
   - Verify network connectivity to government APIs
   - Review sync logs for detailed error messages

2. **Data Validation Errors**
   - Ensure all required fields are populated
   - Verify data format matches NEMIS/KNEC requirements
   - Run data quality audits to identify missing information

3. **Background Jobs Not Running**
   - Verify Redis is running and accessible
   - Check Bull queue configuration
   - Review scheduler service logs

## 📝 Best Practices

1. **Initial Setup**
   - Run data quality audit before first sync
   - Fix all critical data issues
   - Test with small data sets first

2. **Regular Maintenance**
   - Monitor sync logs regularly
   - Address data quality issues promptly
   - Keep credentials up-to-date

3. **Compliance**
   - Set up automated report generation
   - Configure deadline reminders
   - Review alerts daily

import { Injectable, Logger, HttpException, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../database/prisma.service';
import { 
  ComplianceReportType, 
  ReportStatus, 
  ComplianceArea,
  ChecklistStatus,
  DataAuditType,
  AuditStatus,
  ComplianceAlertType,
  AlertSeverity,
  AlertStatus,
  StudentStatus,
  AttendanceStatus,
} from '@prisma/client';

/**
 * Compliance Reporting Service
 * Handles automated compliance reporting for government agencies
 */
@Injectable()
export class ComplianceService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ComplianceService.name);

  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  /**
   * Generate enrollment statistics report
   */
  async generateEnrollmentReport(
    tenantId: string,
    reportPeriod: string,
    reportYear: number,
    reportQuarter?: number,
  ) {
    this.logger.log(`Generating enrollment report for ${reportPeriod}`);

    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        currentStream: true,
      },
    });

    // Statistics by status
    const byStatus = this.groupBy(students, 'status');
    
    // Statistics by gender
    const byGender = this.groupBy(students, 'gender');
    
    // Statistics by class
    const byClass = students.reduce((acc: any, student: any) => {
      const className = student.currentClass?.name || 'Unassigned';
      if (!acc[className]) {
        acc[className] = { total: 0, male: 0, female: 0 };
      }
      acc[className].total++;
      if (student.gender === 'MALE') acc[className].male++;
      if (student.gender === 'FEMALE') acc[className].female++;
      return acc;
    }, {} as any);

    const reportData = {
      summary: {
        totalStudents: students.length,
        activeStudents: byStatus[StudentStatus.ACTIVE] || 0,
        maleStudents: byGender['MALE'] || 0,
        femaleStudents: byGender['FEMALE'] || 0,
      },
      byStatus: byStatus,
      byGender: byGender,
      byClass: byClass,
      generatedAt: new Date(),
    };

    const report = await this.prisma.complianceReport.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        reportType: ComplianceReportType.ENROLLMENT_STATISTICS,
        reportPeriod,
        reportYear,
        reportQuarter,
        status: ReportStatus.DRAFT,
        reportData,
        isAutomated: true,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(`Enrollment report generated: ${report.id}`);
    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Generate attendance summary report
   */
  async generateAttendanceReport(
    tenantId: string,
    reportPeriod: string,
    reportYear: number,
    startDate: Date,
    endDate: Date,
  ) {
    this.logger.log(`Generating attendance report for ${reportPeriod}`);

    const attendanceRecords = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        date: {
          gte: startDate,
          lte: endDate,
        },
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            currentClass: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    // Calculate statistics
    const totalRecords = attendanceRecords.length;
    const byStatus = this.groupBy(attendanceRecords, 'status');
    
    const presentCount = byStatus[AttendanceStatus.PRESENT] || 0;
    const absentCount = byStatus[AttendanceStatus.ABSENT] || 0;
    const lateCount = byStatus[AttendanceStatus.LATE] || 0;
    
    const attendanceRate = totalRecords > 0 
      ? ((presentCount / totalRecords) * 100).toFixed(2)
      : '0.00';

    // Daily attendance trends
    const dailyStats = this.groupAttendanceByDate(attendanceRecords);
    
    // Class-wise attendance
    const classStats = this.groupAttendanceByClass(attendanceRecords);

    const reportData = {
      period: {
        startDate,
        endDate,
        totalDays: this.calculateSchoolDays(startDate, endDate),
      },
      summary: {
        totalRecords,
        presentCount,
        absentCount,
        lateCount,
        attendanceRate: parseFloat(attendanceRate),
        absenteeismRate: totalRecords > 0 
          ? parseFloat(((absentCount / totalRecords) * 100).toFixed(2))
          : 0,
      },
      byStatus,
      dailyStats,
      classStats,
      generatedAt: new Date(),
    };

    const report = await this.prisma.complianceReport.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        reportType: ComplianceReportType.ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY,
        reportPeriod,
        reportYear,
        status: ReportStatus.DRAFT,
        reportData,
        isAutomated: true,
      },
    });

    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Generate teacher data report for TSC compliance
   */
  async generateTeacherDataReport(
    tenantId: string,
    reportPeriod: string,
    reportYear: number,
  ) {
    this.logger.log(`Generating teacher data report for ${reportPeriod}`);

    const teachers = await this.prisma.staff.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        isTeacher: true,
      },
    });

    // Get NEMIS staff records for TSC numbers
    const nemisRecords = await this.prisma.nemisStaffRecord.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        staffId: { in: teachers.map((t: any) => t.id) },
      },
    });

    const tscMap = new Map(nemisRecords.map((r: any) => [r.staffId, r.tscNumber]));

    const teacherData = teachers.map((teacher: any) => ({
      staffNumber: teacher.staffNumber,
      tscNumber: tscMap.get(teacher.id) || 'PENDING',
      name: `${teacher.firstName} ${teacher.middleName || ''} ${teacher.lastName}`,
      gender: teacher.gender,
      email: teacher.email,
      phone: teacher.phone,
      department: teacher.department,
      position: teacher.position,
      employmentType: teacher.employmentType,
      hireDate: teacher.hireDate,
      status: teacher.status,
      subjects: teacher.subjects,
    }));

    // Statistics
    const byStatus = this.groupBy(teachers, 'status');
    const byEmploymentType = this.groupBy(teachers, 'employmentType');
    const byGender = this.groupBy(teachers, 'gender');

    const reportData = {
      summary: {
        totalTeachers: teachers.length,
        activeTeachers: byStatus['ACTIVE'] || 0,
        permanentTeachers: byEmploymentType['PERMANENT'] || 0,
        contractTeachers: byEmploymentType['CONTRACT'] || 0,
        maleTeachers: byGender['MALE'] || 0,
        femaleTeachers: byGender['FEMALE'] || 0,
        registeredWithTSC: nemisRecords.filter((r: any) => r.tscNumber).length,
      },
      byStatus,
      byEmploymentType,
      byGender,
      teachers: teacherData,
      generatedAt: new Date(),
    };

    const report = await this.prisma.complianceReport.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        reportType: ComplianceReportType.TEACHER_DATA_REPORT,
        reportPeriod,
        reportYear,
        status: ReportStatus.DRAFT,
        reportData,
        submittedTo: 'TSC',
        isAutomated: true,
      },
    });

    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Generate examination analysis report
   */
  async generateExaminationReport(
    tenantId: string,
    reportPeriod: string,
    reportYear: number,
    termId: string,
  ) {
    this.logger.log(`Generating examination report for ${reportPeriod}`);

    const examinations = await this.prisma.examination.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        termId,
      },
      include: {
        grades: {
          include: {
            student: true,
            subject: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    const allGrades = examinations.flatMap((exam: any) => exam.grades);

    // Calculate statistics
    const totalExams = examinations.length;
    const totalGrades = allGrades.length;
    const averageScore = totalGrades > 0
      ? allGrades.reduce((sum: any, g: any) => sum + (g.marks || 0), 0) / totalGrades
      : 0;

    // Grade distribution
    const gradeDistribution = this.groupBy(allGrades, 'grade');

    // Subject performance
    const subjectPerformance = this.calculateSubjectPerformance(allGrades);

    const reportData = {
      summary: {
        totalExaminations: totalExams,
        totalGradesRecorded: totalGrades,
        averageScore: parseFloat(averageScore.toFixed(2)),
        passingRate: this.calculatePassingRate(allGrades),
      },
      gradeDistribution,
      subjectPerformance,
      examinations: examinations.map((exam: any) => ({
        name: exam.name,
        examType: exam.examType,
        totalStudents: exam.grades.length,
        averageScore: exam.grades.length > 0
          ? exam.grades.reduce((sum: any, g: any) => sum + (g.marks || 0), 0) / exam.grades.length
          : 0,
      })),
      generatedAt: new Date(),
    };

    const report = await this.prisma.complianceReport.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        reportType: ComplianceReportType.EXAMINATION_ANALYSIS,
        reportPeriod,
        reportYear,
        status: ReportStatus.DRAFT,
        reportData,
        isAutomated: true,
      },
    });

    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Generate financial summary report
   */
  async generateFinancialReport(
    tenantId: string,
    reportPeriod: string,
    reportYear: number,
    reportMonth?: number,
  ) {
    this.logger.log(`Generating financial report for ${reportPeriod}`);

    // Get invoices and payments
    const invoices = await this.prisma.invoice.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: {
        payments: true,
      },
    });

    const totalRevenue = invoices.reduce((sum: any, inv: any) => sum + inv.paidAmount, 0);
    const totalExpected = invoices.reduce((sum: any, inv: any) => sum + inv.totalAmount, 0);
    const totalOutstanding = invoices.reduce((sum: any, inv: any) => sum + inv.balanceAmount, 0);

    // Payment methods breakdown
    const payments = invoices.flatMap((inv: any) => inv.payments);
    const byPaymentMethod = this.groupBy(payments, 'paymentMethod');

    // Monthly collection trend
    const monthlyCollections = this.groupPaymentsByMonth(payments);

    const reportData = {
      summary: {
        totalExpectedRevenue: totalExpected,
        totalCollectedRevenue: totalRevenue,
        totalOutstanding: totalOutstanding,
        collectionRate: totalExpected > 0 
          ? parseFloat(((totalRevenue / totalExpected) * 100).toFixed(2))
          : 0,
        totalInvoices: invoices.length,
        paidInvoices: invoices.filter((i: any) => i.status === 'PAID').length,
        pendingInvoices: invoices.filter((i: any) => i.status === 'PENDING').length,
      },
      byPaymentMethod: Object.entries(byPaymentMethod).map(([method, count]) => ({
        method,
        count,
        amount: payments
          .filter((p: any) => p.paymentMethod === method)
          .reduce((sum: any, p: any) => sum + p.amount, 0),
      })),
      monthlyCollections,
      generatedAt: new Date(),
    };

    const report = await this.prisma.complianceReport.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        reportType: ComplianceReportType.FINANCIAL_SUMMARY,
        reportPeriod,
        reportYear,
        reportMonth,
        status: ReportStatus.DRAFT,
        reportData: reportData as any,
        isAutomated: true,
      },
    });

    return report;
  }

  /**
   * Submit report to government body
   */
  async submitReport(reportId: string, userId: string) {
    const report = await this.prisma.complianceReport.findUnique({
      where: { id: reportId },
    });

    if (!report) {
      throw new HttpException('Report not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    if (report.status !== ReportStatus.APPROVED) {
      throw new HttpException(
        'Report must be approved before submission',
        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
      );
    }

    // In production, actually submit to government API
    const submittedTo = this.getSubmissionDestination(report.reportType);

    const updatedReport = await this.prisma.complianceReport.update({
      where: { id: reportId },
      data: {
        status: ReportStatus.SUBMITTED,
        submittedTo,
        submittedAt: new Date(),
        submittedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(`Report ${reportId} submitted to ${submittedTo}`);
    return updatedReport;
  }

  /**
   * Approve report
   */
  async approveReport(reportId: string, userId: string) {
    return this.prisma.complianceReport.update({
      where: { id: reportId },
      data: {
        status: ReportStatus.APPROVED,
        approvedBy: userId,
        approvedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
  }

      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Run data quality audit
   */
  async runDataQualityAudit(tenantId: string, auditType: DataAuditType) {
    this.logger.log(`Running data quality audit: ${auditType}`);

    let auditResults: any;

    switch (auditType) {
      case DataAuditType.STUDENT_DATA:
        auditResults = await this.auditStudentData(tenantId);
        break;
      case DataAuditType.STAFF_DATA:
        auditResults = await this.auditStaffData(tenantId);
        break;
      case DataAuditType.ATTENDANCE_DATA:
        auditResults = await this.auditAttendanceData(tenantId);
        break;
      case DataAuditType.FULL_AUDIT:
        auditResults = await this.runFullAudit(tenantId);
        break;
      default:
        throw new HttpException('Invalid audit type', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    return this.prisma.dataQualityAudit.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        auditType,
        entityType: this.getEntityType(auditType),
        completeness: auditResults.completeness,
        accuracy: auditResults.accuracy,
        consistency: auditResults.consistency,
        overallScore: auditResults.overallScore,
        issuesFound: auditResults.issues.length,
        criticalIssues: auditResults.issues.filter((i: any) => i.severity === 'CRITICAL').length,
        warningIssues: auditResults.issues.filter((i: any) => i.severity === 'WARNING').length,
        issues: auditResults.issues,
        status: auditResults.issues.length > 0 
          ? AuditStatus.REQUIRES_ACTION 
          : AuditStatus.COMPLETED,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Audit student data quality
   */
  private async auditStudentData(tenantId: string) {
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, status: StudentStatus.ACTIVE },
    });

    const issues: any[] = [];
    let completenessScore = 0;
    let accuracyScore = 0;

    students.forEach((student: any) => {
      let studentCompleteness = 0;
      const requiredFields = 10;

      // Check required fields
      if (student.firstName) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.lastName) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.dateOfBirth) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.gender) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.admissionNumber) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.admissionDate) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.currentClassId) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.email || student.phone) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.nationalId || student.birthCertNumber) studentCompleteness++;
      if (student.address) studentCompleteness++;

      completenessScore += (studentCompleteness / requiredFields) * 100;

      // Identify issues
      if (!student.nationalId && !student.birthCertNumber) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'CRITICAL',
          entity: 'STUDENT',
          entityId: student.id,
          field: 'identification',
          message: `Student ${student.admissionNumber} missing both National ID and Birth Certificate`,
        });
      }

      if (!student.currentClassId) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'WARNING',
          entity: 'STUDENT',
          entityId: student.id,
          field: 'currentClassId',
          message: `Student ${student.admissionNumber} not assigned to a class`,
        });
      }
    });

    const avgCompleteness = students.length > 0 ? completenessScore / students.length : 0;

    return {
      completeness: parseFloat(avgCompleteness.toFixed(2)),
      accuracy: 95, // Placeholder
      consistency: 90, // Placeholder
      overallScore: parseFloat(((avgCompleteness + 95 + 90) / 3).toFixed(2)),
      issues,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Audit staff data quality
   */
  private async auditStaffData(tenantId: string) {
    const staff = await this.prisma.staff.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, status: 'ACTIVE' },
    });

    const issues: any[] = [];
    let completenessScore = 0;

    staff.forEach((member: any) => {
      let staffCompleteness = 0;
      const requiredFields = 9;

      if (member.firstName) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.lastName) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.email) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.phone) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.staffNumber) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.department) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.position) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.employmentType) staffCompleteness++;
      if (member.hireDate) staffCompleteness++;

      completenessScore += (staffCompleteness / requiredFields) * 100;

      // Check TSC registration for teachers
      if (member.isTeacher) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'WARNING',
          entity: 'STAFF',
          entityId: member.id,
          field: 'tscNumber',
          message: `Teacher ${member.staffNumber} - verify TSC registration`,
        });
      }
    });

    const avgCompleteness = staff.length > 0 ? completenessScore / staff.length : 0;

    return {
      completeness: parseFloat(avgCompleteness.toFixed(2)),
      accuracy: 92,
      consistency: 88,
      overallScore: parseFloat(((avgCompleteness + 92 + 88) / 3).toFixed(2)),
      issues,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Audit attendance data quality
   */
  private async auditAttendanceData(tenantId: string) {
    // Get last 30 days of attendance
    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
    thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);

    const records = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        date: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo },
      },
    });

    const issues: any[] = [];
    
    // Check for missing dates
    const uniqueDates = new Set(records.map((r: any) => r.date.toISOString().split('T')[0]));
    const expectedDays = 22; // Approximate school days in 30 days

    if (uniqueDates.size < expectedDays) {
      issues.push({
        severity: 'WARNING',
        entity: 'ATTENDANCE',
        field: 'date',
        message: `Only ${uniqueDates.size} days of attendance recorded in last 30 days`,
      });
    }

    return {
      completeness: parseFloat(((uniqueDates.size / expectedDays) * 100).toFixed(2)),
      accuracy: 95,
      consistency: 92,
      overallScore: 94,
      issues,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Run full audit
   */
  private async runFullAudit(tenantId: string) {
    const studentAudit = await this.auditStudentData(tenantId);
    const staffAudit = await this.auditStaffData(tenantId);
    const attendanceAudit = await this.auditAttendanceData(tenantId);

    const allIssues = [
      ...studentAudit.issues,
      ...staffAudit.issues,
      ...attendanceAudit.issues,
    ];

    const overallScore = (
      studentAudit.overallScore +
      staffAudit.overallScore +
      attendanceAudit.overallScore
    ) / 3;

    return {
      completeness: (studentAudit.completeness + staffAudit.completeness + attendanceAudit.completeness) / 3,
      accuracy: (studentAudit.accuracy + staffAudit.accuracy + attendanceAudit.accuracy) / 3,
      consistency: (studentAudit.consistency + staffAudit.consistency + attendanceAudit.consistency) / 3,
      overallScore: parseFloat(overallScore.toFixed(2)),
      issues: allIssues,
    };
  }

  // Helper methods

  private groupBy(array: any[], key: string): any {
    return array.reduce((acc, item) => {
      const value = item[key];
      acc[value] = (acc[value] || 0) + 1;
      return acc;
    }, {});
  }

  private groupAttendanceByDate(records: any[]): any[] {
    const grouped = records.reduce((acc, record) => {
      const date = record.date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      if (!acc[date]) {
        acc[date] = { date, present: 0, absent: 0, late: 0, total: 0 };
      }
      acc[date].total++;
      if (record.status === AttendanceStatus.PRESENT) acc[date].present++;
      if (record.status === AttendanceStatus.ABSENT) acc[date].absent++;
      if (record.status === AttendanceStatus.LATE) acc[date].late++;
      return acc;
    }, {});

    return Object.values(grouped);
  }

  private groupAttendanceByClass(records: any[]): any {
    return records.reduce((acc, record) => {
      const className = record.student?.currentClass?.name || 'Unknown';
      if (!acc[className]) {
        acc[className] = { class: className, present: 0, absent: 0, total: 0 };
      }
      acc[className].total++;
      if (record.status === AttendanceStatus.PRESENT) acc[className].present++;
      if (record.status === AttendanceStatus.ABSENT) acc[className].absent++;
      return acc;
    }, {});
  }

  private calculateSchoolDays(startDate: Date, endDate: Date): number {
    const oneDay = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const days = Math.round((endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / oneDay);
    // Approximate school days (excluding weekends)
    return Math.floor((days / 7) * 5);
  }

  private calculateSubjectPerformance(grades: any[]): any[] {
    const subjectMap = new Map<string, any>();

    grades.forEach(grade => {
      const subjectName = grade.subject?.name || 'Unknown';
      if (!subjectMap.has(subjectName)) {
        subjectMap.set(subjectName, {
          subject: subjectName,
          count: 0,
          totalMarks: 0,
          averageMarks: 0,
        });
      }

      const stats = subjectMap.get(subjectName);
      stats.count++;
      stats.totalMarks += grade.marks || 0;
    });

    return Array.from(subjectMap.values()).map(stat => ({
      ...stat,
      averageMarks: parseFloat((stat.totalMarks / stat.count).toFixed(2)),
    }));
  }

  private calculatePassingRate(grades: any[]): number {
    if (grades.length === 0) return 0;
    
    const passingGrades = ['A', 'A-', 'B+', 'B', 'B-', 'C+', 'C', 'C-', 'D+', 'D', 'D-'];
    const passing = grades.filter(g => passingGrades.includes(g.grade || '')).length;
    
    return parseFloat(((passing / grades.length) * 100).toFixed(2));
  }

  private groupPaymentsByMonth(payments: any[]): any[] {
    const monthly = payments.reduce((acc, payment) => {
      const date = new Date(payment.paymentDate);
      const monthKey = `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      
      if (!acc[monthKey]) {
        acc[monthKey] = { month: monthKey, count: 0, amount: 0 };
      }
      
      acc[monthKey].count++;
      acc[monthKey].amount += payment.amount;
      return acc;
    }, {});

    return Object.values(monthly);
  }

  private getSubmissionDestination(reportType: ComplianceReportType): string {
    const destinations: Record<ComplianceReportType, string> = {
      [ComplianceReportType.ENROLLMENT_STATISTICS]: 'NEMIS',
      [ComplianceReportType.ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY]: 'NEMIS',
      [ComplianceReportType.TEACHER_DATA_REPORT]: 'TSC',
      [ComplianceReportType.EXAMINATION_ANALYSIS]: 'KNEC',
      [ComplianceReportType.FINANCIAL_SUMMARY]: 'MOE',
      [ComplianceReportType.INFRASTRUCTURE_STATUS]: 'MOE',
      [ComplianceReportType.SAFETY_AUDIT]: 'MOE',
      [ComplianceReportType.TSC_COMPLIANCE]: 'TSC',
      [ComplianceReportType.ANNUAL_SCHOOL_CENSUS]: 'NEMIS',
      [ComplianceReportType.TERMLY_RETURNS]: 'NEMIS',
      [ComplianceReportType.LEARNER_TRACKING]: 'NEMIS',
      [ComplianceReportType.DROPOUT_ANALYSIS]: 'NEMIS',
      [ComplianceReportType.SPECIAL_NEEDS_REPORT]: 'NEMIS',
    };

    return destinations[reportType] || 'NEMIS';
  }

  private getEntityType(auditType: DataAuditType): string {
    const types: Record<DataAuditType, string> = {
      [DataAuditType.STUDENT_DATA]: 'STUDENT',
      [DataAuditType.STAFF_DATA]: 'STAFF',
      [DataAuditType.SCHOOL_PROFILE]: 'SCHOOL',
      [DataAuditType.ATTENDANCE_DATA]: 'ATTENDANCE',
      [DataAuditType.EXAMINATION_DATA]: 'EXAMINATION',
      [DataAuditType.FULL_AUDIT]: 'ALL',
    };

    return types[auditType] || 'UNKNOWN';
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger, HttpException, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../database/prisma.service';
import { 
  KnecSyncType, 
  SyncStatus, 
  KnecExamLevel,
  RegistrationStatus 
} from '@prisma/client';
import { EncryptionUtil } from '../../../common/utils/encryption.util';

/**
 * KNEC Integration Service
 * Handles integration with Kenya National Examinations Council
 */
@Injectable()
export class KnecService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(KnecService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly config: ConfigService,
    private readonly encryptionUtil: EncryptionUtil,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Initialize KNEC integration
   */
  async initializeIntegration(
    tenantId: string,
    knecCentreNumber: string,
    apiKey?: string,
    apiSecret?: string,
  ) {
    try {
      const integration = await this.prisma.knecIntegration.upsert({
        where: { knecCentreNumber },
        update: {
          apiKey: apiKey ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiKey) : undefined,
          apiSecret: apiSecret ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiSecret) : undefined,
          isEnabled: true,
        },
        create: {
          tenantId,
          knecCentreNumber,
          apiKey: apiKey ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiKey) : null,
          apiSecret: apiSecret ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiSecret) : null,
          isEnabled: true,
        },
      });

      this.logger.log(`KNEC integration initialized for tenant: ${tenantId}`);
      return integration;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to initialize KNEC integration: ${error.message}`);
      throw new HttpException(
        'Failed to initialize KNEC integration',
        HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get KNEC integration
   */
  async getIntegration(tenantId: string) {
    return this.prisma.knecIntegration.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Register candidates for KNEC examination
   */
  async registerCandidates(
    tenantId: string,
    examYear: number,
    examSession: string,
    examLevel: KnecExamLevel,
    studentIds: string[],
  ) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('KNEC integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const syncLog = await this.createSyncLog(
      tenantId,
      integration.id,
      KnecSyncType.CANDIDATE_REGISTRATION,
    );

    try {
      const results = {
        attempted: studentIds.length,
        succeeded: 0,
        failed: 0,
        registrations: [] as any[],
        errors: [] as any[],
      };

      for (const studentId of studentIds) {
        try {
          const registration = await this.registerCandidate(
            integration,
            studentId,
            examYear,
            examSession,
            examLevel,
          );
          results.registrations.push(registration);
          results.succeeded++;
        } catch (error: any) {
          results.failed++;
          results.errors.push({
            studentId,
            error: error.message,
          });
        }
      }

      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: results.failed === 0 ? SyncStatus.COMPLETED : SyncStatus.PARTIAL_SUCCESS,
        recordsAttempted: results.attempted,
        recordsSucceeded: results.succeeded,
        recordsFailed: results.failed,
        errorDetails: results.errors.length > 0 ? results.errors : null,
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        ...results,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Candidate registration failed: ${error.message}`);
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.FAILED,
        errorMessage: error.message,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Register individual candidate
   */
  private async registerCandidate(
    integration: any,
    studentId: string,
    examYear: number,
    examSession: string,
    examLevel: KnecExamLevel,
  ) {
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findUnique({
      where: { id: studentId },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        guardianLinks: {
          include: { guardian: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new Error('Student not found');
    }

    // Validate student eligibility
    this.validateCandidateEligibility(student, examLevel);

    // Get subjects for the exam level
    const subjects = await this.getExamSubjects(student.tenantId, examLevel);

    const candidateData = {
      centre_number: integration.knecCentreNumber,
      exam_year: examYear,
      exam_session: examSession,
      exam_level: examLevel,
      student: {
        admission_number: student.admissionNumber,
        first_name: student.firstName,
        middle_name: student.middleName,
        last_name: student.lastName,
        date_of_birth: student.dateOfBirth,
        gender: student.gender,
        national_id: student.nationalId,
        birth_cert_number: student.birthCertNumber,
      },
      subjects: subjects.map((s: any) => s.code),
      special_needs: null, // TODO: Implement special needs tracking
    };

    // Call KNEC API
    const response = await this.callKnecApi(
      integration,
      '/candidates/register',
      'POST',
      candidateData,
    );

    // Create or update registration record
    const registration = await this.prisma.knecExamRegistration.upsert({
      where: {
        candidateNumber: response.candidate_number || `TEMP-${studentId}-${examYear}`,
      },
      update: {
        candidateNumber: response.candidate_number,
        indexNumber: response.index_number,
        registrationDate: new Date(),
        registrationStatus: RegistrationStatus.SUBMITTED,
        syncStatus: SyncStatus.COMPLETED,
        lastSyncedAt: new Date(),
      },
      create: {
        tenantId: student.tenantId,
        knecIntegrationId: integration.id,
        studentId: student.id,
        examYear,
        examSession,
        examLevel,
        candidateNumber: response.candidate_number,
        indexNumber: response.index_number,
        subjects: subjects.map((s: any) => s.code),
        registrationDate: new Date(),
        registrationStatus: RegistrationStatus.SUBMITTED,
        syncStatus: SyncStatus.COMPLETED,
        lastSyncedAt: new Date(),
        registrationFee: this.getRegistrationFee(examLevel),
      },
    });

    return registration;
  }

  /**
   * Download examination results
   */
  async downloadResults(tenantId: string, examYear: number, examLevel: KnecExamLevel) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('KNEC integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const syncLog = await this.createSyncLog(
      tenantId,
      integration.id,
      KnecSyncType.RESULTS_DOWNLOAD,
    );

    try {
      const registrations = await this.prisma.knecExamRegistration.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          examYear,
          examLevel,
          registrationStatus: RegistrationStatus.APPROVED,
        },
      });

      const studentIds = registrations.map(r => r.studentId);
      const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: studentIds } },
        select: { id: true, firstName: true, lastName: true },
      });
      const studentMap = new Map(students.map(s => [s.id, `${s.firstName} ${s.lastName}`]));

      const results = {
        attempted: registrations.length,
        succeeded: 0,
        failed: 0,
        downloaded: [] as any[],
        errors: [] as any[],
      };

      for (const registration of registrations) {
        try {
          const result = await this.downloadCandidateResults(
            integration,
            registration,
          );
          results.downloaded.push(result);
          results.succeeded++;
        } catch (error: any) {
          results.failed++;
          results.errors.push({
            candidateNumber: registration.candidateNumber,
            studentName: studentMap.get(registration.studentId) || 'Unknown Student',
            error: error.message,
          });
        }
      }

      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: results.failed === 0 ? SyncStatus.COMPLETED : SyncStatus.PARTIAL_SUCCESS,
        recordsAttempted: results.attempted,
        recordsSucceeded: results.succeeded,
        recordsFailed: results.failed,
        errorDetails: results.errors.length > 0 ? results.errors : null,
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        ...results,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Results download failed: ${error.message}`);
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.FAILED,
        errorMessage: error.message,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Download results for individual candidate
   */
  private async downloadCandidateResults(integration: any, registration: any) {
    const response = await this.callKnecApi(
      integration,
      `/results/${registration.candidateNumber}`,
      'GET',
    );

    // Update registration with results
    await this.prisma.knecExamRegistration.update({
      where: { id: registration.id },
      data: {
        resultsAvailable: true,
        resultsDownloadedAt: new Date(),
        results: response.results,
      },
    });

    // Store results in examination and grades tables
    await this.storeResultsInSystem(registration, response.results);

    return {
      candidateNumber: registration.candidateNumber,
      results: response.results,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Store KNEC results in the school's examination system
   */
  private async storeResultsInSystem(registration: any, results: any) {
    // Find or create examination record
    const examination = await this.prisma.examination.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId: registration.tenantId,
        name: `${registration.examLevel} ${registration.examYear}`,
        examType: 'NATIONAL',
      },
    });

    if (!examination) {
      this.logger.warn(`No examination record found for ${registration.examLevel} ${registration.examYear}`);
      return;
    }

    // Store subject grades
    for (const subjectResult of results.subjects || []) {
      const subject = await this.prisma.subject.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId: registration.tenantId,
          code: subjectResult.code,
        },
      });

      if (subject) {
        await this.prisma.grade.upsert({
          where: {
            examinationId_studentId_subjectId: {
              examinationId: examination.id,
              studentId: registration.studentId,
              subjectId: subject.id,
            },
          },
          update: {
            marks: subjectResult.marks,
            grade: subjectResult.grade,
            remarks: `KNEC Official Result - ${registration.examYear}`,
          },
          create: {
            tenantId: registration.tenantId,
            examinationId: examination.id,
            studentId: registration.studentId,
            subjectId: subject.id,
            marks: subjectResult.marks,
            grade: subjectResult.grade,
            remarks: `KNEC Official Result - ${registration.examYear}`,
          },
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get exam timetable from KNEC
   */
  async getExamTimetable(
    tenantId: string,
    examYear: number,
    examLevel: KnecExamLevel,
  ) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('KNEC integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const syncLog = await this.createSyncLog(
      tenantId,
      integration.id,
      KnecSyncType.EXAM_TIMETABLE,
    );

    try {
      const response = await this.callKnecApi(
        integration,
        `/timetable/${examYear}/${examLevel}`,
        'GET',
      );

      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.COMPLETED,
        recordsAttempted: 1,
        recordsSucceeded: 1,
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        timetable: response.timetable,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Timetable download failed: ${error.message}`);
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.FAILED,
        errorMessage: error.message,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get candidate registration status
   */
  async getCandidateStatus(tenantId: string, candidateNumber: string) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('KNEC integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const response = await this.callKnecApi(
      integration,
      `/candidates/${candidateNumber}/status`,
      'GET',
    );

    return response;
  }

  /**
   * Get all registrations for a tenant
   */
  async getRegistrations(
    tenantId: string,
    examYear?: number,
    examLevel?: KnecExamLevel,
  ) {
    const where: any = { tenantId };
    if (examYear) where.examYear = examYear;
    if (examLevel) where.examLevel = examLevel;

    const registrations = await this.prisma.knecExamRegistration.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    const studentIds = registrations.map(r => r.studentId);
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: studentIds } },
      select: {
        id: true,
        admissionNumber: true,
        firstName: true,
        middleName: true,
        lastName: true,
        currentClass: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    const studentMap = new Map(students.map(s => [s.id, s]));

    return registrations.map(r => ({
      ...r,
      student: studentMap.get(r.studentId) || null,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Submit irregularity report
   */
  async submitIrregularityReport(
    tenantId: string,
    candidateNumber: string,
    irregularityType: string,
    description: string,
    evidenceUrls?: string[],
  ) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('KNEC integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const syncLog = await this.createSyncLog(
      tenantId,
      integration.id,
      KnecSyncType.IRREGULARITY_REPORT,
    );

    try {
      const reportData = {
        centre_number: integration.knecCentreNumber,
        candidate_number: candidateNumber,
        irregularity_type: irregularityType,
        description,
        evidence_urls: evidenceUrls,
        reported_at: new Date(),
      };

      const response = await this.callKnecApi(
        integration,
        '/irregularities/report',
        'POST',
        reportData,
      );

      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.COMPLETED,
        recordsAttempted: 1,
        recordsSucceeded: 1,
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        reportId: response.report_id,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Irregularity report submission failed: ${error.message}`);
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.FAILED,
        errorMessage: error.message,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get sync history
   */
  async getSyncHistory(tenantId: string, limit = 50) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration) {
      throw new HttpException('KNEC integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    return this.prisma.knecSyncLog.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        knecIntegrationId: integration.id,
      },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
      take: limit,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Validate candidate eligibility
   */
  private validateCandidateEligibility(student: any, examLevel: KnecExamLevel) {
    const errors: string[] = [];

    // Basic validation
    if (!student.firstName) errors.push('First name is required');
    if (!student.lastName) errors.push('Last name is required');
    if (!student.dateOfBirth) errors.push('Date of birth is required');
    if (!student.gender) errors.push('Gender is required');

    // Identification
    if (!student.nationalId && !student.birthCertNumber) {
      errors.push('Either National ID or Birth Certificate is required');
    }

    // Age validation based on exam level
    const age = this.calculateAge(student.dateOfBirth);
    
    switch (examLevel) {
      case KnecExamLevel.KCPE:
        if (age < 10) errors.push('Candidate is too young for KCPE (minimum 10 years)');
        if (age > 16) errors.push('Candidate may be too old for KCPE');
        break;
      case KnecExamLevel.KCSE:
        if (age < 15) errors.push('Candidate is too young for KCSE (minimum 15 years)');
        break;
    }

    if (errors.length > 0) {
      throw new HttpException(
        `Candidate validation failed: ${errors.join(', ')}`,
        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get exam subjects for level
   */
  private async getExamSubjects(tenantId: string, examLevel: KnecExamLevel) {
    // Map exam levels to education levels
    let educationLevel: any;
    
    switch (examLevel) {
      case KnecExamLevel.KCPE:
      case KnecExamLevel.KPSEA:
        educationLevel = 'PRIMARY';
        break;
      case KnecExamLevel.KCSE:
        educationLevel = 'SENIOR_SECONDARY';
        break;
    }

    return this.prisma.subject.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        educationLevel,
        isCore: true,
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get registration fee based on exam level
   */
  private getRegistrationFee(examLevel: KnecExamLevel): number {
    // Fees in KES (minor units)
    switch (examLevel) {
      case KnecExamLevel.KCPE:
      case KnecExamLevel.KPSEA:
        return 150000; // 1500 KES
      case KnecExamLevel.KCSE:
        return 350000; // 3500 KES
      default:
        return 0;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Calculate age from date of birth
   */
  private calculateAge(dateOfBirth: Date): number {
    const today = new Date();
    const birthDate = new Date(dateOfBirth);
    let age = today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear();
    const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - birthDate.getMonth();
    
    if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < birthDate.getDate())) {
      age--;
    }
    
    return age;
  }

  /**
   * Create sync log
   */
  private async createSyncLog(
    tenantId: string,
    knecIntegrationId: string,
    syncType: KnecSyncType,
  ) {
    return this.prisma.knecSyncLog.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        knecIntegrationId,
        syncType,
        status: SyncStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update sync log
   */
  private async updateSyncLog(syncLogId: string, data: any) {
    return this.prisma.knecSyncLog.update({
      where: { id: syncLogId },
      data: {
        ...data,
        completedAt: new Date(),
        duration: data.startedAt 
          ? Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(data.startedAt).getTime()) / 1000)
          : undefined,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Call KNEC API
   */
  private async callKnecApi(
    integration: any,
    endpoint: string,
    method: string,
    data?: any,
  ) {
    const apiKey = integration.apiKey ? await this.encryptionUtil.decrypt(integration.apiKey) : null;
    const apiSecret = integration.apiSecret ? await this.encryptionUtil.decrypt(integration.apiSecret) : null;

    this.logger.debug(`KNEC API Call: ${method} ${endpoint}`);
    
    // Log API call
    await this.logApiCall(integration.tenantId, 'KNEC', endpoint, method, data);

    // Simulate API response
    return {
      success: true,
      candidate_number: `KNEC-${Date.now()}`,
      index_number: `IDX-${Date.now()}`,
      results: {
        overall_grade: 'A',
        total_marks: 420,
        mean_grade: 8.4,
        subjects: [
          { code: 'ENG', name: 'English', marks: 85, grade: 'A' },
          { code: 'KIS', name: 'Kiswahili', marks: 82, grade: 'A-' },
          { code: 'MAT', name: 'Mathematics', marks: 88, grade: 'A' },
          { code: 'BIO', name: 'Biology', marks: 84, grade: 'A-' },
          { code: 'CHE', name: 'Chemistry', marks: 81, grade: 'A-' },
        ],
      },
      timetable: [
        { subject: 'English', date: '2024-11-04', time: '08:00-10:00' },
        { subject: 'Kiswahili', date: '2024-11-05', time: '08:00-10:00' },
      ],
      report_id: `RPT-${Date.now()}`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Log API call
   */
  private async logApiCall(
    tenantId: string,
    service: string,
    endpoint: string,
    method: string,
    requestBody?: any,
  ) {
    await this.prisma.governmentApiLog.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        service,
        endpoint,
        method,
        requestBody,
        responseStatus: 200,
        status: 'SUCCESS',
        respondedAt: new Date(),
        duration: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000) + 100,
      },
    });
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger, HttpException, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../../database/prisma.service';
import { 
  NemisSyncType, 
  SyncStatus, 
  SyncDirection, 
  ValidationStatus 
} from '@prisma/client';
import axios, { AxiosInstance } from 'axios';
import { EncryptionUtil } from '../../../common/utils/encryption.util';

/**
 * NEMIS Integration Service
 * Handles synchronization with National Education Management Information System
 */
@Injectable()
export class NemisService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(NemisService.name);
  private axiosInstance: AxiosInstance;

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly config: ConfigService,
    private readonly encryptionUtil: EncryptionUtil,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Initialize NEMIS integration for a tenant
   */
  async initializeIntegration(
    tenantId: string,
    nemisSchoolCode: string,
    apiKey?: string,
    apiSecret?: string,
  ) {
    try {
      const integration = await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.upsert({
        where: { nemisSchoolCode },
        update: {
          apiKey: apiKey ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiKey) : undefined,
          apiSecret: apiSecret ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiSecret) : undefined,
          isEnabled: true,
        },
        create: {
          tenantId,
          nemisSchoolCode,
          apiKey: apiKey ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiKey) : null,
          apiSecret: apiSecret ? await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(apiSecret) : null,
          isEnabled: true,
          autoSync: true,
          syncFrequency: 'DAILY',
          syncTime: '02:00',
        },
      });

      this.logger.log(`NEMIS integration initialized for tenant: ${tenantId}`);
      return integration;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to initialize NEMIS integration: ${error.message}`);
      throw new HttpException(
        'Failed to initialize NEMIS integration',
        HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get NEMIS integration settings
   */
  async getIntegration(tenantId: string) {
    return this.prisma.nemisIntegration.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Sync student enrollment data with NEMIS
   */
  async syncStudentEnrollment(tenantId: string) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('NEMIS integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const syncLog = await this.createSyncLog(
      tenantId,
      integration.id,
      NemisSyncType.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT,
    );

    try {
      // Fetch students that need syncing
      const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        },
        include: {
          currentClass: true,
          currentStream: true,
          guardianLinks: {
            include: {
              guardian: true,
            },
          },
        },
      });

      const syncResults = {
        attempted: students.length,
        succeeded: 0,
        failed: 0,
        errors: [] as any[],
      };

      // Process each student
      for (const student of students) {
        try {
          await this.syncStudentToNemis(integration, student);
          syncResults.succeeded++;
        } catch (error: any) {
          syncResults.failed++;
          syncResults.errors.push({
            studentId: student.id,
            admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
            error: error.message,
          });
        }
      }

      // Update sync log
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: syncResults.failed === 0 ? SyncStatus.COMPLETED : SyncStatus.PARTIAL_SUCCESS,
        recordsAttempted: syncResults.attempted,
        recordsSucceeded: syncResults.succeeded,
        recordsFailed: syncResults.failed,
        errorDetails: syncResults.errors.length > 0 ? syncResults.errors : null,
      });

      // Update integration last sync time
      await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.update({
        where: { id: integration.id },
        data: {
          lastSyncAt: new Date(),
          syncStatus: syncResults.failed === 0 ? SyncStatus.COMPLETED : SyncStatus.PARTIAL_SUCCESS,
        },
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        ...syncResults,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Student enrollment sync failed: ${error.message}`);
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.FAILED,
        errorMessage: error.message,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }
