  /**
   * Sync teacher data with NEMIS
   */
  async syncTeacherData(tenantId: string) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('NEMIS integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const syncLog = await this.createSyncLog(
      tenantId,
      integration.id,
      NemisSyncType.TEACHER_DATA,
    );

    try {
      // Fetch teachers (staff who are teachers)
      const teachers = await this.prisma.staff.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          isTeacher: true,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        },
      });

      const syncResults = {
        attempted: teachers.length,
        succeeded: 0,
        failed: 0,
        errors: [] as any[],
      };

      // Process each teacher
      for (const teacher of teachers) {
        try {
          await this.syncTeacherToNemis(integration, teacher);
          syncResults.succeeded++;
        } catch (error: any) {
          syncResults.failed++;
          syncResults.errors.push({
            staffId: teacher.id,
            staffNumber: teacher.staffNumber,
            error: error.message,
          });
        }
      }

      // Update sync log
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: syncResults.failed === 0 ? SyncStatus.COMPLETED : SyncStatus.PARTIAL_SUCCESS,
        recordsAttempted: syncResults.attempted,
        recordsSucceeded: syncResults.succeeded,
        recordsFailed: syncResults.failed,
        errorDetails: syncResults.errors.length > 0 ? syncResults.errors : null,
      });

      // Update integration
      await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.update({
        where: { id: integration.id },
        data: { lastSyncAt: new Date() },
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        ...syncResults,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Teacher data sync failed: ${error.message}`);
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.FAILED,
        errorMessage: error.message,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sync attendance data
   */
  async syncAttendanceData(tenantId: string, startDate: Date, endDate: Date) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration || !integration.isEnabled) {
      throw new HttpException('NEMIS integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    const syncLog = await this.createSyncLog(
      tenantId,
      integration.id,
      NemisSyncType.ATTENDANCE_DATA,
    );

    try {
      const attendanceRecords = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          date: {
            gte: startDate,
            lte: endDate,
          },
        },
        include: {
          student: true,
        },
      });

      // Group by date and calculate statistics
      const attendanceByDate = new Map<string, any>();
      
      attendanceRecords.forEach((record: any) => {
        const dateKey = record.date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        if (!attendanceByDate.has(dateKey)) {
          attendanceByDate.set(dateKey, {
            date: dateKey,
            total_students: 0,
            present: 0,
            absent: 0,
            late: 0,
            excused: 0,
          });
        }

        const stats = attendanceByDate.get(dateKey);
        stats.total_students++;
        
        switch (record.status) {
          case 'PRESENT':
            stats.present++;
            break;
          case 'ABSENT':
            stats.absent++;
            break;
          case 'LATE':
            stats.late++;
            break;
          case 'EXCUSED':
          case 'SICK':
            stats.excused++;
            break;
        }
      });

      const attendanceData = {
        school_code: integration.nemisSchoolCode,
        start_date: startDate,
        end_date: endDate,
        daily_attendance: Array.from(attendanceByDate.values()),
      };

      await this.callNemisApi(
        integration,
        '/attendance/bulk-upload',
        'POST',
        attendanceData,
      );

      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.COMPLETED,
        recordsAttempted: attendanceRecords.length,
        recordsSucceeded: attendanceRecords.length,
      });

      return { success: true, recordsSynced: attendanceRecords.length };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Attendance sync failed: ${error.message}`);
      await this.updateSyncLog(syncLog.id, {
        status: SyncStatus.FAILED,
        errorMessage: error.message,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Perform full sync of all data
   */
  async performFullSync(tenantId: string) {
    this.logger.log(`Starting full NEMIS sync for tenant: ${tenantId}`);

    const results = {
      schoolProfile: null as any,
      studentEnrollment: null as any,
      teacherData: null as any,
      errors: [] as string[],
    };

    try {
      results.schoolProfile = await this.syncSchoolProfile(tenantId);
    } catch (error: any) {
      results.errors.push(`School profile sync failed: ${error.message}`);
    }

    try {
      results.studentEnrollment = await this.syncStudentEnrollment(tenantId);
    } catch (error: any) {
      results.errors.push(`Student enrollment sync failed: ${error.message}`);
    }

    try {
      results.teacherData = await this.syncTeacherData(tenantId);
    } catch (error: any) {
      results.errors.push(`Teacher data sync failed: ${error.message}`);
    }

    return {
      success: results.errors.length === 0,
      results,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get sync history
   */
  async getSyncHistory(tenantId: string, limit = 50) {
    const integration = await this.getIntegration(tenantId);
    if (!integration) {
      throw new HttpException('NEMIS integration not configured', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    return this.prisma.nemisSyncLog.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        nemisIntegrationId: integration.id,
      },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
      take: limit,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Validate student data against NEMIS requirements
   */
  async validateStudentData(studentId: string) {
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findUnique({
      where: { id: studentId },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        guardianLinks: {
          include: { guardian: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new HttpException('Student not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    const validationErrors: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    // Required fields validation
    if (!student.firstName) validationErrors.push('First name is required');
    if (!student.lastName) validationErrors.push('Last name is required');
    if (!student.dateOfBirth) validationErrors.push('Date of birth is required');
    if (!student.gender) validationErrors.push('Gender is required');
    if (!student.admissionNumber) validationErrors.push('Admission number is required');
    if (!student.admissionDate) validationErrors.push('Admission date is required');

    // Identification validation
    if (!student.nationalId && !student.birthCertNumber) {
      validationErrors.push('Either National ID or Birth Certificate Number is required');
    }

    // Guardian validation
    if (student.guardianLinks.length === 0) {
      validationErrors.push('At least one guardian is required');
    } else {
      const primaryGuardian = student.guardianLinks.find((link: any) => link.isPrimary);
      if (!primaryGuardian) {
        warnings.push('No primary guardian specified');
      }
    }

    // Class assignment
    if (!student.currentClass) {
      warnings.push('Student not assigned to a class');
    }

    const isValid = validationErrors.length === 0;

    // Update NEMIS student record validation status
    await this.prisma.nemisStudentRecord.upsert({
      where: { studentId: student.id },
      update: {
        validationStatus: isValid ? ValidationStatus.VALID : ValidationStatus.INVALID,
        validationErrors: (validationErrors.length > 0 ? validationErrors : null) as any,
      },
      create: {
        tenantId: student.tenantId,
        studentId: student.id,
        validationStatus: isValid ? ValidationStatus.VALID : ValidationStatus.INVALID,
        validationErrors: (validationErrors.length > 0 ? validationErrors : null) as any,
      },
    });

    return {
      isValid,
      errors: validationErrors,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Create sync log entry
   */
  private async createSyncLog(
    tenantId: string,
    nemisIntegrationId: string,
    syncType: NemisSyncType,
  ) {
    return this.prisma.nemisSyncLog.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        nemisIntegrationId,
        syncType,
        status: SyncStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
        direction: SyncDirection.OUTBOUND,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update sync log entry
   */
  private async updateSyncLog(syncLogId: string, data: any) {
    return this.prisma.nemisSyncLog.update({
      where: { id: syncLogId },
      data: {
        ...data,
        completedAt: new Date(),
        duration: data.startedAt 
          ? Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(data.startedAt).getTime()) / 1000)
          : undefined,
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Call NEMIS API
   */
  private async callNemisApi(
    integration: any,
    endpoint: string,
    method: string,
    data?: any,
  ) {
    const apiKey = integration.apiKey ? await this.encryptionUtil.decrypt(integration.apiKey) : null;
    const apiSecret = integration.apiSecret ? await this.encryptionUtil.decrypt(integration.apiSecret) : null;

    // In production, implement actual API calls
    // For now, simulate successful response
    this.logger.debug(`NEMIS API Call: ${method} ${endpoint}`);
    
    // Log the API call
    await this.logApiCall(integration.tenantId, 'NEMIS', endpoint, method, data);

    // Simulate API response
    return {
      success: true,
      upi: `UPI-${Date.now()}`,
      student_id: `NEMIS-STU-${Date.now()}`,
      staff_id: `NEMIS-STF-${Date.now()}`,
      tsc_number: `TSC-${Date.now()}`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Log API call
   */
  private async logApiCall(
    tenantId: string,
    service: string,
    endpoint: string,
    method: string,
    requestBody?: any,
  ) {
    await this.prisma.governmentApiLog.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        service,
        endpoint,
        method,
        requestBody,
        responseStatus: 200,
        status: 'SUCCESS',
        respondedAt: new Date(),
        duration: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000) + 100,
      },
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Date utility functions for government integration
 */
export class DateUtil {
  /**
   * Get Kenyan academic terms for a given year
   */
  static getKenyanAcademicTerms(year: number): Array<{
    term: number;
    name: string;
    startDate: Date;
    endDate: Date;
  }> {
    return [
      {
        term: 1,
        name: 'Term 1',
        startDate: new Date(year, 0, 2), // January 2
        endDate: new Date(year, 3, 15), // April 15
      },
      {
        term: 2,
        name: 'Term 2',
        startDate: new Date(year, 4, 1), // May 1
        endDate: new Date(year, 7, 15), // August 15
      },
      {
        term: 3,
        name: 'Term 3',
        startDate: new Date(year, 8, 1), // September 1
        endDate: new Date(year, 10, 30), // November 30
      },
    ];
  }

  /**
   * Get current academic term
   */
  static getCurrentTerm(date: Date = new Date()): {
    term: number;
    name: string;
    year: number;
  } | null {
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const terms = this.getKenyanAcademicTerms(year);

    for (const term of terms) {
      if (date >= term.startDate && date <= term.endDate) {
        return {
          term: term.term,
          name: term.name,
          year,
        };
      }
    }

    // If between terms, return the next term
    const nextYear = year + 1;
    const nextTerms = this.getKenyanAcademicTerms(nextYear);
    
    if (date > terms[2].endDate) {
      return {
        term: 1,
        name: 'Term 1',
        year: nextYear,
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Get next academic term
   */
  static getNextTerm(currentTerm: number, currentYear: number): {
    term: number;
    year: number;
  } {
    if (currentTerm === 3) {
      return { term: 1, year: currentYear + 1 };
    }
    return { term: currentTerm + 1, year: currentYear };
  }

  /**
   * Calculate school days between two dates (excluding weekends)
   */
  static calculateSchoolDays(startDate: Date, endDate: Date): number {
    let count = 0;
    const current = new Date(startDate);

    while (current <= endDate) {
      const dayOfWeek = current.getDay();
      // Exclude weekends (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday)
      if (dayOfWeek !== 0 && dayOfWeek !== 6) {
        count++;
      }
      current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1);
    }

    return count;
  }

  /**
   * Get Kenyan public holidays for a given year
   */
  static getKenyanPublicHolidays(year: number): Array<{
    name: string;
    date: Date;
  }> {
    return [
      { name: 'New Year\'s Day', date: new Date(year, 0, 1) },
      { name: 'Labour Day', date: new Date(year, 4, 1) },
      { name: 'Madaraka Day', date: new Date(year, 5, 1) },
      { name: 'Mashujaa Day', date: new Date(year, 9, 20) },
      { name: 'Jamhuri Day', date: new Date(year, 11, 12) },
      { name: 'Christmas Day', date: new Date(year, 11, 25) },
      { name: 'Boxing Day', date: new Date(year, 11, 26) },
      // Note: Eid ul-Fitr and Eid ul-Adha dates vary and should be added dynamically
    ];
  }

  /**
   * Check if a date is a Kenyan public holiday
   */
  static isPublicHoliday(date: Date): boolean {
    const holidays = this.getKenyanPublicHolidays(date.getFullYear());
    return holidays.some(holiday => 
      holiday.date.getDate() === date.getDate() &&
      holiday.date.getMonth() === date.getMonth()
    );
  }

  /**
   * Check if a date is a school day
   */
  static isSchoolDay(date: Date): boolean {
    const dayOfWeek = date.getDay();
    // Not a weekend
    if (dayOfWeek === 0 || dayOfWeek === 6) return false;
    // Not a public holiday
    if (this.isPublicHoliday(date)) return false;
    // Within term dates
    const currentTerm = this.getCurrentTerm(date);
    return currentTerm !== null;
  }

  /**
   * Get age from date of birth
   */
  static calculateAge(dateOfBirth: Date, referenceDate: Date = new Date()): number {
    const age = referenceDate.getFullYear() - dateOfBirth.getFullYear();
    const monthDiff = referenceDate.getMonth() - dateOfBirth.getMonth();
    
    if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && referenceDate.getDate() < dateOfBirth.getDate())) {
      return age - 1;
    }
    
    return age;
  }

  /**
   * Format date range
   */
  static formatDateRange(startDate: Date, endDate: Date): string {
    const start = startDate.toLocaleDateString('en-KE', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    });
    const end = endDate.toLocaleDateString('en-KE', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    });
    return `${start} - ${end}`;
  }

  /**
   * Get start and end of month
   */
  static getMonthBounds(year: number, month: number): {
    start: Date;
    end: Date;
  } {
    return {
      start: new Date(year, month, 1),
      end: new Date(year, month + 1, 0),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get start and end of year
   */
  static getYearBounds(year: number): {
    start: Date;
    end: Date;
  } {
    return {
      start: new Date(year, 0, 1),
      end: new Date(year, 11, 31),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get quarter bounds
   */
  static getQuarterBounds(year: number, quarter: number): {
    start: Date;
    end: Date;
  } {
    const startMonth = (quarter - 1) * 3;
    const endMonth = startMonth + 2;
    
    return {
      start: new Date(year, startMonth, 1),
      end: new Date(year, endMonth + 1, 0),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Add business days to a date
   */
  static addBusinessDays(date: Date, days: number): Date {
    const result = new Date(date);
    let addedDays = 0;

    while (addedDays < days) {
      result.setDate(result.getDate() + 1);
      const dayOfWeek = result.getDay();
      if (dayOfWeek !== 0 && dayOfWeek !== 6 && !this.isPublicHoliday(result)) {
        addedDays++;
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Get days until deadline
   */
  static getDaysUntilDeadline(deadline: Date): number {
    const now = new Date();
    const diffTime = deadline.getTime() - now.getTime();
    return Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  }

  /**
   * Check if deadline is approaching (within specified days)
   */
  static isDeadlineApproaching(deadline: Date, daysThreshold: number = 7): boolean {
    const daysUntil = this.getDaysUntilDeadline(deadline);
    return daysUntil >= 0 && daysUntil <= daysThreshold;
  }

  /**
   * Check if date is overdue
   */
  static isOverdue(deadline: Date): boolean {
    return deadline < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Get fiscal year (Kenya: July - June)
   */
  static getFiscalYear(date: Date = new Date()): {
    startYear: number;
    endYear: number;
    startDate: Date;
    endDate: Date;
  } {
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = date.getMonth();

    // Fiscal year starts in July (month 6)
    const startYear = month >= 6 ? year : year - 1;
    const endYear = startYear + 1;

    return {
      startYear,
      endYear,
      startDate: new Date(startYear, 6, 1), // July 1
      endDate: new Date(endYear, 5, 30), // June 30
    };
  }

  /**
   * Convert date to ISO string (YYYY-MM-DD)
   */
  static toIsoDateString(date: Date): string {
    return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  }

  /**
   * Parse ISO date string safely
   */
  static parseIsoDate(dateString: string): Date | null {
    try {
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

import * as crypto from 'crypto';

/**
 * Encryption utilities for sensitive government integration credentials
 */
export class EncryptionUtil {
  private static readonly ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm';
  private static readonly KEY_LENGTH = 32;
  private static readonly IV_LENGTH = 16;
  private static readonly TAG_LENGTH = 16;

  /**
   * Get encryption key from environment
   */
  private static getEncryptionKey(): Buffer {
    const key = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY;
    
    if (!key) {
      throw new Error('ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable is not set');
    }

    // Ensure key is the correct length
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    hash.update(key);
    return hash.digest();
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt sensitive data
   */
  static encrypt(text: string): string {
    try {
      const key = this.getEncryptionKey();
      const iv = crypto.randomBytes(this.IV_LENGTH);
      const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(this.ALGORITHM, key, iv);

      let encrypted = cipher.update(text, 'utf8', 'hex');
      encrypted += cipher.final('hex');

      const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();

      // Combine IV + encrypted data + auth tag
      return Buffer.concat([
        iv,
        Buffer.from(encrypted, 'hex'),
        tag,
      ]).toString('base64');
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(`Encryption failed: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt sensitive data
   */
  static decrypt(encryptedData: string): string {
    try {
      const key = this.getEncryptionKey();
      const buffer = Buffer.from(encryptedData, 'base64');

      // Extract IV, encrypted data, and auth tag
      const iv = buffer.slice(0, this.IV_LENGTH);
      const tag = buffer.slice(buffer.length - this.TAG_LENGTH);
      const encrypted = buffer.slice(this.IV_LENGTH, buffer.length - this.TAG_LENGTH);

      const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(this.ALGORITHM, key, iv);
      decipher.setAuthTag(tag);

      let decrypted = decipher.update(encrypted.toString('hex'), 'hex', 'utf8');
      decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');

      return decrypted;
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(`Decryption failed: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Hash data (one-way)
   */
  static hash(text: string): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
  }

  /**
   * Generate random token
   */
  static generateToken(length: number = 32): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(length).toString('hex');
  }
}

/**
 * Utility for generating formatted reports and exports
 */
export class ReportGeneratorUtil {
  /**
   * Generate CSV from report data
   */
  static generateCsv(data: any[], headers: string[]): string {
    const rows: string[] = [];
    
    // Add header row
    rows.push(headers.join(','));

    // Add data rows
    data.forEach(item => {
      const row = headers.map(header => {
        const value = item[header];
        // Escape commas and quotes
        if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
        const stringValue = String(value);
        if (stringValue.includes(',') || stringValue.includes('"')) {
          return `"${stringValue.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
        }
        return stringValue;
      });
      rows.push(row.join(','));
    });

    return rows.join('\n');
  }

  /**
   * Generate Excel-compatible CSV with UTF-8 BOM
   */
  static generateExcelCsv(data: any[], headers: string[]): Buffer {
    const csv = this.generateCsv(data, headers);
    // Add UTF-8 BOM for Excel compatibility
    const BOM = '\uFEFF';
    return Buffer.from(BOM + csv, 'utf8');
  }

  /**
   * Generate HTML table from data
   */
  static generateHtmlTable(data: any[], headers: string[], title?: string): string {
    let html = '<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html>\n<head>\n';
    html += '<meta charset="UTF-8">\n';
    html += '<style>\n';
    html += 'table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }\n';
    html += 'th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; text-align: left; }\n';
    html += 'th { background-color: #4F46E5; color: white; }\n';
    html += 'tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: #f2f2f2; }\n';
    html += 'h1 { color: #333; }\n';
    html += '</style>\n';
    html += '</head>\n<body>\n';

    if (title) {
      html += `<h1>${title}</h1>\n`;
    }

    html += '<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n';
    
    // Add headers
    headers.forEach(header => {
      html += `<th>${this.escapeHtml(header)}</th>\n`;
    });
    
    html += '</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n';

    // Add data rows
    data.forEach(item => {
      html += '<tr>\n';
      headers.forEach(header => {
        const value = item[header];
        html += `<td>${this.escapeHtml(String(value || ''))}</td>\n`;
      });
      html += '</tr>\n';
    });

    html += '</tbody>\n</table>\n</body>\n</html>';
    return html;
  }

  /**
   * Escape HTML special characters
   */
  private static escapeHtml(text: string): string {
    const map: Record<string, string> = {
      '&': '&amp;',
      '<': '&lt;',
      '>': '&gt;',
      '"': '&quot;',
      "'": '&#039;',
    };
    return text.replace(/[&<>"']/g, m => map[m]);
  }

  /**
   * Format statistics for report
   */
  static formatStatistics(stats: any): string {
    let formatted = '=== STATISTICS SUMMARY ===\n\n';

    Object.keys(stats).forEach(key => {
      const value = stats[key];
      if (typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
        formatted += `${this.toTitleCase(key)}:\n`;
        Object.keys(value).forEach(subKey => {
          formatted += `  ${this.toTitleCase(subKey)}: ${value[subKey]}\n`;
        });
        formatted += '\n';
      } else {
        formatted += `${this.toTitleCase(key)}: ${value}\n`;
      }
    });

    return formatted;
  }

  /**
   * Convert string to title case
   */
  private static toTitleCase(str: string): string {
    return str
      .replace(/_/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\b\w/g, char => char.toUpperCase());
  }

  /**
   * Generate summary report in text format
   */
  static generateTextSummary(
    title: string,
    data: any,
    sections: Array<{ title: string; fields: string[] }>,
  ): string {
    let text = `${'='.repeat(60)}\n`;
    text += `${title.toUpperCase()}\n`;
    text += `${'='.repeat(60)}\n\n`;
    text += `Generated: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}\n\n`;

    sections.forEach(section => {
      text += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;
      text += `${section.title}\n`;
      text += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;

      section.fields.forEach(field => {
        const value = data[field];
        if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
          if (typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
            text += `\n${this.toTitleCase(field)}:\n`;
            Object.keys(value).forEach(key => {
              text += `  ${this.toTitleCase(key)}: ${value[key]}\n`;
            });
          } else {
            text += `${this.toTitleCase(field)}: ${value}\n`;
          }
        }
      });

      text += '\n';
    });

    return text;
  }

  /**
   * Generate JSON report with metadata
   */
  static generateJsonReport(data: any, metadata?: any): string {
    const report = {
      metadata: {
        generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        version: '1.0',
        ...metadata,
      },
      data,
    };

    return JSON.stringify(report, null, 2);
  }

  /**
   * Calculate percentage with formatting
   */
  static formatPercentage(value: number, total: number, decimals: number = 2): string {
    if (total === 0) return '0.00%';
    const percentage = (value / total) * 100;
    return `${percentage.toFixed(decimals)}%`;
  }

  /**
   * Format currency (Kenyan Shillings)
   */
  static formatCurrency(amount: number): string {
    // Convert from minor units (cents) to major units
    const majorAmount = amount / 100;
    return `KES ${majorAmount.toLocaleString('en-KE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
  }

  /**
   * Format date for display
   */
  static formatDate(date: Date | string, format: 'short' | 'long' = 'short'): string {
    const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date;
    
    if (format === 'long') {
      return d.toLocaleDateString('en-KE', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'long',
        day: 'numeric',
      });
    }
    
    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-KE', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
    });
  }

  /**
   * Generate compliance report summary
   */
  static generateComplianceSummary(report: any): string {
    let summary = `COMPLIANCE REPORT SUMMARY\n`;
    summary += `${'='.repeat(60)}\n\n`;
    summary += `Report Type: ${report.reportType}\n`;
    summary += `Period: ${report.reportPeriod}\n`;
    summary += `Status: ${report.status}\n`;
    summary += `Generated: ${this.formatDate(report.createdAt, 'long')}\n\n`;

    if (report.reportData) {
      summary += `KEY METRICS\n`;
      summary += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;
      
      const data = report.reportData;
      if (data.summary) {
        Object.keys(data.summary).forEach(key => {
          summary += `${this.toTitleCase(key)}: ${data.summary[key]}\n`;
        });
      }
    }

    return summary;
  }

  /**
   * Generate audit report summary
   */
  static generateAuditSummary(audit: any): string {
    let summary = `DATA QUALITY AUDIT REPORT\n`;
    summary += `${'='.repeat(60)}\n\n`;
    summary += `Audit Type: ${audit.auditType}\n`;
    summary += `Date: ${this.formatDate(audit.createdAt, 'long')}\n`;
    summary += `Status: ${audit.status}\n\n`;

    summary += `QUALITY SCORES\n`;
    summary += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;
    summary += `Overall Score: ${audit.overallScore}%\n`;
    summary += `Completeness: ${audit.completeness}%\n`;
    summary += `Accuracy: ${audit.accuracy}%\n`;
    summary += `Consistency: ${audit.consistency}%\n\n`;

    summary += `ISSUES FOUND\n`;
    summary += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;
    summary += `Total Issues: ${audit.issuesFound}\n`;
    summary += `Critical: ${audit.criticalIssues}\n`;
    summary += `Warnings: ${audit.warningIssues}\n`;

    return summary;
  }

  /**
   * Generate grade distribution chart (ASCII)
   */
  static generateGradeDistributionChart(distribution: Record<string, number>): string {
    let chart = 'GRADE DISTRIBUTION\n';
    chart += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;

    const maxCount = Math.max(...Object.values(distribution));
    const barWidth = 40;

    Object.keys(distribution).sort().forEach(grade => {
      const count = distribution[grade];
      const barLength = maxCount > 0 ? Math.floor((count / maxCount) * barWidth) : 0;
      const bar = '█'.repeat(barLength);
      chart += `${grade.padEnd(3)} | ${bar} ${count}\n`;
    });

    return chart;
  }

  /**
   * Generate attendance trend visualization (ASCII)
   */
  static generateAttendanceTrend(dailyStats: Array<{ date: string; present: number; total: number }>): string {
    let trend = 'ATTENDANCE TREND\n';
    trend += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;
    trend += `Date         | Present | Total | Rate\n`;
    trend += `${'-'.repeat(60)}\n`;

    dailyStats.forEach(stat => {
      const rate = stat.total > 0 ? ((stat.present / stat.total) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
      trend += `${stat.date} | ${String(stat.present).padStart(7)} | ${String(stat.total).padStart(5)} | ${rate}%\n`;
    });

    return trend;
  }
}

/**
 * Validation utilities for government integration data
 */
export class ValidationUtil {
  /**
   * Validate Kenyan National ID format
   */
  static isValidNationalId(id: string): boolean {
    // Kenyan National ID is typically 7-8 digits
    const nationalIdRegex = /^\d{7,8}$/;
    return nationalIdRegex.test(id);
  }

  /**
   * Validate Kenyan Birth Certificate Number
   */
  static isValidBirthCertificate(certNumber: string): boolean {
    // Birth certificate format varies, basic validation
    return !!certNumber && certNumber.length >= 6 && certNumber.length <= 20;
  }

  /**
   * Validate TSC (Teachers Service Commission) Number
   */
  static isValidTscNumber(tscNumber: string): boolean {
    // TSC number format: typically 6 digits
    const tscRegex = /^\d{6}$/;
    return tscRegex.test(tscNumber);
  }

  /**
   * Validate NEMIS UPI (Universal Personal Identifier)
   */
  static isValidNemisUpi(upi: string): boolean {
    // UPI format validation (alphanumeric)
    const upiRegex = /^[A-Z0-9]{8,12}$/;
    return upiRegex.test(upi.toUpperCase());
  }

  /**
   * Validate KNEC Centre Number
   */
  static isValidKnecCentreNumber(centreNumber: string): boolean {
    // Centre number is typically 5 digits
    const centreRegex = /^\d{5}$/;
    return centreRegex.test(centreNumber);
  }

  /**
   * Validate KNEC Candidate Number
   */
  static isValidCandidateNumber(candidateNumber: string): boolean {
    // Candidate number format varies
    return !!candidateNumber && candidateNumber.length >= 8 && candidateNumber.length <= 15;
  }

  /**
   * Validate KNEC Index Number
   */
  static isValidIndexNumber(indexNumber: string): boolean {
    // Index number format
    const indexRegex = /^\d{2,3}-\d{3,5}-\d{3,5}$/;
    return indexRegex.test(indexNumber);
  }

  /**
   * Validate Kenyan phone number
   */
  static isValidKenyanPhone(phone: string): boolean {
    // Kenyan phone formats: +254..., 254..., 07..., 01...
    const phoneRegex = /^(\+?254|0)[17]\d{8}$/;
    return phoneRegex.test(phone.replace(/\s/g, ''));
  }

  /**
   * Validate email address
   */
  static isValidEmail(email: string): boolean {
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    return emailRegex.test(email);
  }

  /**
   * Validate date is not in the future
   */
  static isNotFutureDate(date: Date): boolean {
    return date <= new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Validate age is within reasonable range for education level
   */
  static isValidAgeForLevel(dateOfBirth: Date, educationLevel: string): {
    valid: boolean;
    reason?: string;
  } {
    const today = new Date();
    const age = today.getFullYear() - dateOfBirth.getFullYear();
    const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dateOfBirth.getMonth();
    const adjustedAge = monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dateOfBirth.getDate())
      ? age - 1
      : age;

    switch (educationLevel) {
      case 'PRE_PRIMARY':
        if (adjustedAge < 3 || adjustedAge > 7) {
          return { valid: false, reason: 'Age should be between 3-7 for pre-primary' };
        }
        break;

      case 'PRIMARY':
        if (adjustedAge < 6 || adjustedAge > 16) {
          return { valid: false, reason: 'Age should be between 6-16 for primary' };
        }
        break;

      case 'JUNIOR_SECONDARY':
        if (adjustedAge < 11 || adjustedAge > 18) {
          return { valid: false, reason: 'Age should be between 11-18 for junior secondary' };
        }
        break;

      case 'SENIOR_SECONDARY':
        if (adjustedAge < 14 || adjustedAge > 21) {
          return { valid: false, reason: 'Age should be between 14-21 for senior secondary' };
        }
        break;

      default:
        return { valid: true };
    }

    return { valid: true };
  }

  /**
   * Validate academic year format
   */
  static isValidAcademicYear(year: number): boolean {
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    return year >= 2000 && year <= currentYear + 1;
  }

  /**
   * Sanitize input to prevent injection attacks
   */
  static sanitizeInput(input: string): string {
    return input
      .replace(/[<>]/g, '') // Remove < and >
      .replace(/javascript:/gi, '') // Remove javascript: protocol
      .replace(/on\w+=/gi, '') // Remove event handlers
      .trim();
  }

  /**
   * Validate data completeness percentage
   */
  static calculateCompleteness(data: any, requiredFields: string[]): number {
    let completedFields = 0;

    requiredFields.forEach(field => {
      const value = data[field];
      if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '') {
        completedFields++;
      }
    });

    return (completedFields / requiredFields.length) * 100;
  }

  /**
   * Check if student data is complete for NEMIS submission
   */
  static validateStudentDataForNemis(student: any): {
    isComplete: boolean;
    missingFields: string[];
    warnings: string[];
  } {
    const requiredFields = [
      'firstName',
      'lastName',
      'dateOfBirth',
      'gender',
      'admissionNumber',
      'admissionDate',
    ];

    const missingFields: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    requiredFields.forEach(field => {
      if (!student[field]) {
        missingFields.push(field);
      }
    });

    // Check identification
    if (!student.nationalId && !student.birthCertNumber) {
      missingFields.push('nationalId or birthCertNumber');
    }

    // Warnings for optional but important fields
    if (!student.currentClassId) warnings.push('Student not assigned to a class');
    if (!student.email && !student.phone) warnings.push('No contact information');
    if (!student.address) warnings.push('No address information');

    return {
      isComplete: missingFields.length === 0,
      missingFields,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Check if teacher data is complete for TSC/NEMIS submission
   */
  static validateTeacherDataForNemis(teacher: any): {
    isComplete: boolean;
    missingFields: string[];
    warnings: string[];
  } {
    const requiredFields = [
      'firstName',
      'lastName',
      'email',
      'phone',
      'staffNumber',
      'department',
      'position',
      'employmentType',
      'hireDate',
    ];

    const missingFields: string[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    requiredFields.forEach(field => {
      if (!teacher[field]) {
        missingFields.push(field);
      }
    });

    // Warnings
    if (!teacher.nationalId) warnings.push('No national ID');
    if (teacher.isTeacher && !teacher.subjects) warnings.push('No subjects assigned');
    if (!teacher.dateOfBirth) warnings.push('No date of birth');

    return {
      isComplete: missingFields.length === 0,
      missingFields,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Normalize Kenyan phone number to standard format
   */
  static normalizeKenyanPhone(phone: string): string {
    // Remove all spaces and special characters
    let normalized = phone.replace(/[\s\-\(\)]/g, '');

    // Convert to +254 format
    if (normalized.startsWith('0')) {
      normalized = '+254' + normalized.substring(1);
    } else if (normalized.startsWith('254')) {
      normalized = '+' + normalized;
    } else if (!normalized.startsWith('+254')) {
      normalized = '+254' + normalized;
    }

    return normalized;
  }

  /**
   * Format date for government APIs (ISO format)
   */
  static formatDateForApi(date: Date): string {
    return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  }

  /**
   * Validate and parse date string
   */
  static parseDateSafely(dateString: string): Date | null {
    try {
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

  @Delete(':id')

  linkStudent(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() linkStudentDto: LinkStudentDto) {
    return this.guardiansService.linkStudent(id, linkStudentDto);
  }

  @Delete(':id/students/:studentId')
  @Roles(

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateGuardianDto } from './dto/create-guardian.dto';
import { UpdateGuardianDto } from './dto/update-guardian.dto';
import { LinkStudentDto } from './dto/link-student.dto';

@Injectable()
export class GuardiansService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async create(createGuardianDto: CreateGuardianDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        ...createGuardianDto,
      },
    });

    return guardian;
  }

  async findAll(search?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { firstName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { lastName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { phone: { contains: search } },
        { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    const guardians = await this.prisma.guardian.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                status: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'desc',
      },
    });

    return guardians;
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                middleName: true,
                dateOfBirth: true,
                gender: true,
                status: true,
                currentClass: {
                  select: {
                    name: true,
                    level: true,
                  },
                },
                currentStream: {
                  select: {
                    name: true,
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!guardian) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Guardian with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return guardian;
  }

  async update(id: string, updateGuardianDto: UpdateGuardianDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.update({
      where: { id },
      data: updateGuardianDto,
    });

    return guardian;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Check if guardian is linked to any students
    const links = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.count({
      where: { guardianId: id },
    });

    if (links > 0) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Cannot delete guardian who is linked to students. Remove student links first.'
      );
    }

    await this.prisma.guardian.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    return { message: 'Guardian deleted successfully' };
  }

  async linkStudent(id: string, linkStudentDto: LinkStudentDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Verify student exists and belongs to same tenant
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: {
        id: linkStudentDto.studentId,
        tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Student with ID ${linkStudentDto.studentId} not found`);
    }

    // Check if link already exists
    const existingLink = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: {
        guardianId: id,
        studentId: linkStudentDto.studentId,
      },
    });

    if (existingLink) {
      throw new ConflictException('Guardian is already linked to this student');
    }

    // If setting as primary, unset other primary guardians for this student
    if (linkStudentDto.isPrimary) {
      await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.updateMany({
        where: {
          studentId: linkStudentDto.studentId,
          isPrimary: true,
        },
        data: {
          isPrimary: false,
        },
      });
    }

    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.create({
      data: {
        guardianId: id,
        studentId: linkStudentDto.studentId,
        relationship: linkStudentDto.relationship as any,
        isPrimary: linkStudentDto.isPrimary || false,
        canPickup: linkStudentDto.canPickup !== false,
        receiveUpdates: linkStudentDto.receiveUpdates !== false,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    return link;
  }

  async unlinkStudent(id: string, studentId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: {
        guardianId: id,
        studentId,
      },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Link not found between guardian and student');
    }

    await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.delete({
      where: { id: link.id },
    });

    return { message: 'Student unlinked successfully' };
  }

  async getStudents(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              include: {
                currentClass: true,
                currentStream: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!guardian) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Guardian with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return guardian.studentLinks.map((link) => ({
      ...link.student,
      relationship: link.relationship,
      isPrimary: link.isPrimary,
    }));
  }
}

import { IsOptional, IsUUID, IsEnum, IsDateString, IsInt, Min } from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';

export enum HomeworkStatus {
  NOT_SUBMITTED = 'NOT_SUBMITTED',
  SUBMITTED = 'SUBMITTED',
  GRADED = 'GRADED',
  LATE = 'LATE',
}

export class QueryHomeworkDto {
  @IsUUID()
  @IsOptional()
  studentId?: string;

  @IsUUID()
  @IsOptional()
  classId?: string;

  @IsUUID()
  @IsOptional()
  subjectId?: string;

  @IsEnum(HomeworkStatus)
  @IsOptional()
  status?: HomeworkStatus;

  @IsDateString()
  @IsOptional()
  startDate?: string;

  @IsDateString()
  @IsOptional()
  endDate?: string;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsOptional()
  page?: number = 1;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Type(() => Number)
  @IsOptional()
  limit?: number = 20;
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ForbiddenException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { QueryHomeworkDto, HomeworkStatus } from './dto/query-homework.dto';

@Injectable()
export class HomeworkService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // Get assignments for a student (parent-facing)
  async getStudentHomework(
    studentId: string,
    guardianId: string,
    query: QueryHomeworkDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access to this student
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: { guardianId, studentId },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    // Get student's class
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
      select: { currentClassId: true },
    });

    if (!student || !student.currentClassId) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found or not enrolled in a class');
    }

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      classId: student.currentClassId,
    };

    if (query.subjectId) {
      where.subjectId = query.subjectId;
    }

    if (query.startDate || query.endDate) {
      where.dueDate = {};
      if (query.startDate) {
        where.dueDate.gte = new Date(query.startDate);
      }
      if (query.endDate) {
        where.dueDate.lte = new Date(query.endDate);
      }
    }

    const page = query.page || 1;
    const limit = query.limit || 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const [assignments, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.assignment.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          subject: {
            select: {
              name: true,
              code: true,
            },
          },
          class: {
            select: {
              name: true,
            },
          },
          submissions: {
            where: { studentId },
            select: {
              id: true,
              status: true,
              score: true,
              feedback: true,
              submittedAt: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: {
          dueDate: 'asc',
        },
        skip,
        take: limit,
      }),
      this.prisma.assignment.count({ where }),
    ]);

    // Enhance with status
    const now = new Date();
    const homeworkList = assignments.map((assignment) => {
      const submission = assignment.submissions[0];
      let status: HomeworkStatus;

      if (!submission) {
        // Not submitted
        status = new Date(assignment.dueDate) < now
          ? HomeworkStatus.LATE
          : HomeworkStatus.NOT_SUBMITTED;
      } else if (submission.score !== null && submission.score !== undefined) {
        status = HomeworkStatus.GRADED;
      } else {
        status = HomeworkStatus.SUBMITTED;
      }

      return {
        id: assignment.id,
        title: assignment.title,
        description: assignment.description,
        dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
        maxMarks: assignment.maxMarks,
        subject: assignment.subject,
        class: assignment.class,
        submission,
        status,
      };
    });

    // Filter by status if requested
    const filteredHomework = query.status
      ? homeworkList.filter((hw) => hw.status === query.status)
      : homeworkList;

    return {
      data: filteredHomework,
      pagination: {
        total: query.status ? filteredHomework.length : total,
        page,
        limit,
        totalPages: Math.ceil((query.status ? filteredHomework.length : total) / limit),
      },
    };
  }

  // Get homework summary/statistics for student
  async getHomeworkSummary(studentId: string, guardianId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: { guardianId, studentId },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    // Get student's class
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
      select: { currentClassId: true },
    });

    if (!student || !student.currentClassId) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found or not enrolled in a class');
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const thisWeek = new Date();
    thisWeek.setDate(thisWeek.getDate() - 7);
    thisWeek.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Get all assignments for the student's class
    const assignments = await this.prisma.assignment.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        classId: student.currentClassId,
      },
      include: {
        submissions: {
          where: { studentId },
          select: {
            status: true,
            score: true,
            submittedAt: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    let total = 0;
    let submitted = 0;
    let graded = 0;
    let pending = 0;
    let overdue = 0;
    let dueSoon = 0; // Due in next 3 days

    const threeDaysFromNow = new Date();
    threeDaysFromNow.setDate(threeDaysFromNow.getDate() + 3);

    assignments.forEach((assignment) => {
      total++;
      const submission = assignment.submissions[0];
      const dueDate = new Date(assignment.dueDate);

      if (!submission) {
        if (dueDate < now) {
          overdue++;
        } else {
          pending++;
          if (dueDate <= threeDaysFromNow) {
            dueSoon++;
          }
        }
      } else {
        submitted++;
        if (submission.score !== null && submission.score !== undefined) {
          graded++;
        }
      }
    });

    // Calculate average score for graded assignments
    const gradedAssignments = await this.prisma.assignmentSubmission.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId,
        score: { not: null },
      },
      include: {
        assignment: {
          select: {
            maxMarks: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    let totalPercentage = 0;
    gradedAssignments.forEach((sub) => {
      if (sub.score !== null && sub.assignment.maxMarks > 0) {
        totalPercentage += (sub.score / sub.assignment.maxMarks) * 100;
      }
    });

    const averageScore = gradedAssignments.length > 0
      ? totalPercentage / gradedAssignments.length
      : 0;

    return {
      total,
      submitted,
      graded,
      pending,
      overdue,
      dueSoon,
      submissionRate: total > 0 ? (submitted / total) * 100 : 0,
      averageScore: Math.round(averageScore * 10) / 10,
    };
  }

  // Get upcoming homework (due in next 7 days)
  async getUpcomingHomework(studentId: string, guardianId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: { guardianId, studentId },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    // Get student's class
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
      select: { currentClassId: true },
    });

    if (!student || !student.currentClassId) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found or not enrolled in a class');
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const nextWeek = new Date();
    nextWeek.setDate(nextWeek.getDate() + 7);

    const assignments = await this.prisma.assignment.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        classId: student.currentClassId,
        dueDate: {
          gte: now,
          lte: nextWeek,
        },
      },
      include: {
        subject: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
        submissions: {
          where: { studentId },
          select: {
            id: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        dueDate: 'asc',
      },
    });

    // Filter out already submitted assignments
    const upcomingAssignments = assignments.filter(
      (assignment) => assignment.submissions.length === 0,
    );

    return upcomingAssignments.map((assignment) => ({
      id: assignment.id,
      title: assignment.title,
      subject: assignment.subject.name,
      dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
      maxMarks: assignment.maxMarks,
    }));
  }

  // Get assignment details
  async getAssignmentDetails(assignmentId: string, studentId: string, guardianId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: { guardianId, studentId },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    const assignment = await this.prisma.assignment.findFirst({
      where: {
        id: assignmentId,
        tenantId,
      },
      include: {
        subject: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        class: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
        submissions: {
          where: { studentId },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Assignment not found');
    }

    return assignment;
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Delete,
  Param,
  Query,
  Body,
  UseInterceptors,
  UploadedFile,
  Request,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { FileInterceptor } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import { MediaService } from './media.service';
import { UploadMediaDto } from './dto/upload-media.dto';
import { QueryMediaDto } from './dto/query-media.dto';
import { Roles } from '../../common/decorators/roles.decorator';
import { UserRole } from '@krypton/types';

@Controller('media')
export class MediaController {
  constructor(private readonly mediaService: MediaService) {}

  @Post('upload')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  @UseInterceptors(FileInterceptor('file'))
  async upload(
    @UploadedFile() file: Express.Multer.File,
    @Body() uploadMediaDto: UploadMediaDto,
    @Request() req: any,
  ) {
    if (!file) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No file uploaded');
    }

    return this.mediaService.upload(file, uploadMediaDto, req.user.id);
  }

  @Get()
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  findAll(@Query() query: QueryMediaDto) {
    return this.mediaService.findAll(query);
  }

  @Get('class/:classId/gallery')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  getClassGallery(
    @Param('classId') classId: string,
    @Query() query: QueryMediaDto,
  ) {
    return this.mediaService.getClassGallery(classId, query);
  }

  @Get(':id')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  findOne(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.mediaService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Get(':id/presigned-url')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN, UserRole.PARENT)
  async getPresignedUrl(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Query('expiresIn') expiresIn?: string,
  ) {
    const expires = expiresIn ? parseInt(expiresIn) : 3600;
    return this.mediaService.getPresignedUrl(id, expires);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  @Roles(UserRole.TEACHER, UserRole.CLASS_TEACHER, UserRole.PRINCIPAL, UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN)
  remove(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.mediaService.remove(id);
  }
}

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { MulterModule } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import { MediaService } from './media.service';
import { MediaController } from './media.controller';
import { DatabaseModule } from '../../database/database.module';
import { StorageService } from '../../common/services/storage.service';

@Module({
  imports: [
    DatabaseModule,
    MulterModule.register({
      limits: {
        fileSize: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB
      },
      storage: {
        _handleFile(req: any, file: any, cb: (error: Error | null, info?: any) => void) {
          // Store in memory for processing
          const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
          file.stream.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => chunks.push(chunk));
          file.stream.on('end', () => {
            (file as any).buffer = Buffer.concat(chunks);
            cb(null, {
              buffer: (file as any).buffer,
              size: (file as any).buffer.length,
            });
          });
          file.stream.on('error', cb);
        },
        _removeFile(req: any, file: any, cb: (error: Error | null) => void) {
          delete (file as any).buffer;
          cb(null);
        },
      },
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [MediaController],
  providers: [MediaService, StorageService],
  exports: [MediaService, StorageService],
})
export class MediaModule {}

File: apps/api/src/modules/media/media.service.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ForbiddenException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { StorageService } from '../../common/services/storage.service';
import { UploadMediaDto, MediaType } from './dto/upload-media.dto';
import { QueryMediaDto } from './dto/query-media.dto';
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import * as path from 'path';
import 'multer';

@Injectable()
export class MediaService {
  private readonly maxFileSize = 50 * 1024 * 1024; // 50MB
  private readonly allowedImageTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp'];
  private readonly allowedVideoTypes = ['video/mp4', 'video/mpeg', 'video/quicktime', 'video/x-msvideo'];
  private readonly allowedDocumentTypes = ['application/pdf', 'application/msword', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'];

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
    private storageService: StorageService,
  ) {}

  async upload(
    file: Express.Multer.File,
    dto: UploadMediaDto,
    userId: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate file size
    if (file.size > this.maxFileSize) {
      throw new BadRequestException('File size exceeds maximum allowed (50MB)');
    }

    // Determine media type from mime type
    let mediaType: MediaType;
    let storageCategory: 'photos' | 'videos' | 'documents';
    
    if (this.allowedImageTypes.includes(file.mimetype)) {
      mediaType = MediaType.PHOTO;
      storageCategory = 'photos';
    } else if (this.allowedVideoTypes.includes(file.mimetype)) {
      mediaType = MediaType.VIDEO;
      storageCategory = 'videos';
    } else if (this.allowedDocumentTypes.includes(file.mimetype)) {
      mediaType = MediaType.DOCUMENT;
      storageCategory = 'documents';
    } else {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Unsupported file type. Allowed: images (jpg, png, gif, webp), videos (mp4, mpeg, mov, avi), documents (pdf, doc, docx)',
      );
    }

    // Verify associations belong to tenant
    if (dto.studentId) {
      const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
      });
      if (!student) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
      }
    }

    if (dto.classId) {
      const classObj = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
      });
      if (!classObj) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
      }
    }

    if (dto.activityFeedId) {
      const activity = await this.prisma.activityFeed.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.activityFeedId, tenantId },
      });
      if (!activity) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Activity not found');
      }
    }

    // Generate unique filename
    const fileExt = path.extname(file.originalname);
    const randomSuffix = randomBytes(8).toString('hex');
    const fileName = `${Date.now()}-${randomSuffix}${fileExt}`;

    // Upload to S3 with tenant isolation
    const uploadResult = await this.storageService.uploadFile(file, {
      tenantId,
      category: storageCategory,
      filename: fileName,
      mimeType: file.mimetype,
      metadata: {
        originalName: file.originalname,
        uploadedBy: userId,
        studentId: dto.studentId || '',
        classId: dto.classId || '',
      },
    });

    // For images, we could generate thumbnails here
    // For now, we'll use the same URL for thumbnail
    const thumbnailUrl = mediaType === MediaType.PHOTO ? uploadResult.url : null;

    // Create media record with S3 key stored in fileUrl
    const media = await this.prisma.mediaItem.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        fileName: file.originalname,
        fileUrl: uploadResult.key, // Store S3 key, not full URL
        thumbnailUrl,
        fileType: mediaType,
        fileSize: file.size,
        mimeType: file.mimetype,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        classId: dto.classId,
        activityFeedId: dto.activityFeedId,
        caption: dto.caption,
        takenAt: dto.takenAt ? new Date(dto.takenAt) : null,
        uploadedBy: userId,
        isVisibleToParents: dto.isVisibleToParents ?? true,
      },
    });

    return {
      ...media,
      fileUrl: uploadResult.url, // Return public URL in response
    };
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryMediaDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (query.studentId) {
      where.studentId = query.studentId;
    }

    if (query.classId) {
      where.classId = query.classId;
    }

    if (query.activityFeedId) {
      where.activityFeedId = query.activityFeedId;
    }

    if (query.fileType) {
      where.fileType = query.fileType;
    }

    if (query.startDate || query.endDate) {
      where.createdAt = {};
      if (query.startDate) {
        where.createdAt.gte = new Date(query.startDate);
      }
      if (query.endDate) {
        where.createdAt.lte = new Date(query.endDate);
      }
    }

    const page = query.page || 1;
    const limit = query.limit || 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const [mediaItems, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.mediaItem.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: {
          createdAt: 'desc',
        },
        skip,
        take: limit,
      }),
      this.prisma.mediaItem.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: mediaItems,
      pagination: {
        total,
        page,
        limit,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      },
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const media = await this.prisma.mediaItem.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        activityFeed: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            title: true,
            activityType: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!media) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Media not found');
    }

    return media;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const media = await this.findOne(id);

    // Delete file from S3 (tenant validation handled by StorageService)
    try {
      await this.storageService.deleteFile(media.fileUrl, tenantId);
    } catch (error) {
      // Log error but don't fail the deletion
      console.error('Failed to delete file from S3:', error);
    }

    // Delete record
    await this.prisma.mediaItem.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    return { message: 'Media deleted successfully' };
  }

  // Parent-facing methods
  async getStudentMedia(
    studentId: string,
    guardianId: string,
    query: QueryMediaDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access to this student
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: {
        guardianId,
        studentId,
      },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      studentId,
      isVisibleToParents: true,
    };

    if (query.fileType) {
      where.fileType = query.fileType;
    }

    if (query.startDate || query.endDate) {
      where.createdAt = {};
      if (query.startDate) {
        where.createdAt.gte = new Date(query.startDate);
      }
      if (query.endDate) {
        where.createdAt.lte = new Date(query.endDate);
      }
    }

    const page = query.page || 1;
    const limit = query.limit || 20;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const [mediaItems, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.mediaItem.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          activityFeed: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              title: true,
              activityType: true,
              createdAt: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: {
          createdAt: 'desc',
        },
        skip,
        take: limit,
      }),
      this.prisma.mediaItem.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: mediaItems,
      pagination: {
        total,
        page,
        limit,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      },
    };
  }

  // Get media gallery for class
  async getClassGallery(classId: string, query: QueryMediaDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const classObj = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classObj) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
    }

    return this.findAll({ ...query, classId });
  }

  /**
   * Get pre-signed URL for secure file access
   * This method validates tenant ownership before generating the URL
   */
  async getPresignedUrl(mediaId: string, expiresIn: number = 3600): Promise<{ url: string; expiresIn: number }> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get media item
    const media = await this.findOne(mediaId);

    // Generate pre-signed URL (tenant validation handled by StorageService)
    return this.storageService.getPresignedUrl(media.fileUrl, expiresIn, {
      tenantId,
      responseContentDisposition: `inline; filename="${media.fileName}"`,
    });
  }
}

import { PaymentCallbackGuard } from '../../common/guards/payment-callback.guard';
import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Body,
  Param,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiParam,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
