import { PaymentMethod } from '@krypton/types';
import {
  Injectable,
  BadRequestException,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  Logger,
  InternalServerErrorException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { FeesService } from '../fees/fees.service';
import {
  InitiateSTKPushDto,
  STKPushResponseDto,
  STKPushCallbackDto,
  QuerySTKStatusDto,
} from './dto/stk-push.dto';
import {
  C2BCallbackDto,
  C2BValidationDto,
  C2BValidationResponseDto,
  C2BConfirmationResponseDto,
} from './dto/c2b-callback.dto';
import {
  ReconcileTransactionDto,
  QueryUnmatchedTransactionsDto,
  ManualReconciliationDto,
  ReconciliationStatus,
  ReconciliationAction,
} from './dto/reconciliation.dto';
import axios from 'axios';

@Injectable()
export class MpesaService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(MpesaService.name);
  private readonly baseUrl: string;
  private readonly consumerKey: string;
  private readonly consumerSecret: string;
  private readonly shortCode: string;
  private readonly passkey: string;
  private readonly callbackUrl: string;
  private readonly validationUrl: string;
  private readonly confirmationUrl: string;
  private accessTokenCache: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
    private feesService: FeesService,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {
    this.baseUrl =
      this.configService.get('MPESA_BASE_URL', '') ||
      'https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke';
    this.consumerKey = this.configService.get('MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY', '');
    this.shortCode =
      this.configService.get('MPESA_SHORT_CODE', '') ||
      this.configService.get('MPESA_SHORTCODE', '');
    this.passkey = this.configService.get('MPESA_PASSKEY', '');
    const callbackBase = this.configService.get('MPESA_CALLBACK_URL', '');
    const callbackToken = this.configService.get('MPESA_CALLBACK_TOKEN', '');
    this.callbackUrl = callbackBase && callbackToken ? callbackBase + (callbackBase.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'token=' + encodeURIComponent(callbackToken) : ''; 
    this.validationUrl = this.configService.get('MPESA_VALIDATION_URL', '');
    this.confirmationUrl = this.configService.get('MPESA_CONFIRMATION_URL', '');
  }

  private parseProviderDate(value:unknown):Date {
    const text=String(value);
    if(!/^\d{14}$/.test(text))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid payment date');
    const date=new Date(text.slice(0,4)+'-'+text.slice(4,6)+'-'+text.slice(6,8)+'T'+text.slice(8,10)+':'+text.slice(10,12)+':'+text.slice(12,14)+'+03:00');
    if(!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid payment date');
    return date;
  }
  // ==================== AUTHENTICATION ====================

  private async getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
    // Return cached token if still valid
    if (
      this.accessTokenCache &&
      this.accessTokenCache.expiresAt > Date.now()
    ) {
      return this.accessTokenCache.token;
    }

    try {
      const auth = Buffer.from(
        `${this.consumerKey}:${this.consumerSecret}`,
      ).toString('base64');

      const response = await axios.get(
        `${this.baseUrl}/oauth/v1/generate?grant_type=client_credentials`,
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Basic ${auth}`,
          },
        },
      );

      const { access_token, expires_in } = response.data;

      // Cache token (expire 1 minute early for safety)
      this.accessTokenCache = {
        token: access_token,
        expiresAt: Date.now() + (parseInt(expires_in) - 60) * 1000,
      };

      return access_token;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to get M-Pesa access token', error);
      throw new InternalServerErrorException(
        'Failed to authenticate with M-Pesa',
      );
    }
  }

  // ==================== STK PUSH ====================

  async initiateSTKPush(
    dto: InitiateSTKPushDto,
    userId?: string,
  ): Promise<STKPushResponseDto> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    if (!this.consumerKey || !this.consumerSecret || !this.passkey || !this.callbackUrl) throw new BadRequestException('M-Pesa is not configured. Contact your school office.');

    // Validate invoice exists and get details
    const invoice = await this.feesService.findOneInvoice(dto.invoiceId);

    if (invoice.status === 'CANCELLED') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot pay for cancelled invoice');
    }

    if (invoice.status === 'PAID') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invoice is already fully paid');
    }

    // Validate payment amount
    if (dto.amount > invoice.balanceAmount) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Payment amount exceeds invoice balance (${invoice.balanceAmount} cents)`,
      );
    }

    if (dto.amount < 100) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Minimum payment amount is KES 1.00');
    }

    // Generate timestamp and password
    const timestamp = new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
      .slice(0, 14);
    const password = Buffer.from(
      `${this.shortCode}${this.passkey}${timestamp}`,
    ).toString('base64');

    // Convert amount from cents to shillings
    if (dto.amount % 100 !== 0) throw new BadRequestException('M-Pesa payments must use whole shilling amounts');
    const amountInShillings = dto.amount / 100;

    const accountReference =
      dto.accountReference || invoice.invoiceNumber || 'SCHOOL_FEE';
    const transactionDesc = dto.transactionDesc || 'School Fee Payment';

    try {
      const accessToken = await this.getAccessToken();

      const response = await axios.post(
        `${this.baseUrl}/mpesa/stkpush/v1/processrequest`,
        {
          BusinessShortCode: this.shortCode,
          Password: password,
          Timestamp: timestamp,
          TransactionType: 'CustomerPayBillOnline',
          Amount: amountInShillings,
          PartyA: dto.phoneNumber,
          PartyB: this.shortCode,
          PhoneNumber: dto.phoneNumber,
          CallBackURL: this.callbackUrl,
          AccountReference: accountReference,
          TransactionDesc: transactionDesc,
        },
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        },
      );

      const {
        CheckoutRequestID,
        MerchantRequestID,
        ResponseCode,
        ResponseDescription,
        CustomerMessage,
      } = response.data;

      // Record transaction in database
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          transactionType: 'STK_PUSH',
          merchantRequestId: MerchantRequestID,
          checkoutRequestId: CheckoutRequestID,
          phoneNumber: dto.phoneNumber,
          amount: dto.amount,
          accountReference: accountReference,
          transactionDesc: transactionDesc,
          invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
          status: 'PENDING',
          initiatedBy: userId,
          responseCode: ResponseCode,
          responseDescription: ResponseDescription,
        },
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `STK Push initiated: ${CheckoutRequestID} for invoice ${dto.invoiceId}`,
      );

      return {
        checkoutRequestId: CheckoutRequestID,
        merchantRequestId: MerchantRequestID,
        responseCode: ResponseCode,
        responseDescription: ResponseDescription,
        customerMessage: CustomerMessage,
        invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
        amount: dto.amount,
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('STK Push failed', error);

      if (error.response?.data) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          error.response.data.errorMessage ||
            'Failed to initiate M-Pesa payment',
        );
      }

      throw new InternalServerErrorException('Failed to initiate M-Pesa payment');
    }
  }

  async handleSTKCallback(callback: STKPushCallbackDto): Promise<void> {
    const { stkCallback } = callback.Body;
    const {
      MerchantRequestID,
      CheckoutRequestID,
      ResultCode,
      ResultDesc,
      CallbackMetadata,
    } = stkCallback;

    this.logger.log(`STK Callback received: ${CheckoutRequestID}`);

    // Find transaction
    const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: {
        checkoutRequestId: CheckoutRequestID,
        merchantRequestId: MerchantRequestID,
      },
    });

    if (!transaction) {
      this.logger.error(`Transaction not found: ${CheckoutRequestID}`);
      return;
    }

    this.tenantService.setTenantId(transaction.tenantId);

    // Check if already processed
    if (transaction.callbackReceived) {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Duplicate callback received for: ${CheckoutRequestID}`,
      );
      return;
    }

    // Success
    if (ResultCode === 0 && CallbackMetadata) {
      const metadata = CallbackMetadata.Item.reduce((acc, item) => {
        acc[item.Name] = item.Value;
        return acc;
      }, {} as any);

      if (Math.round(Number(metadata.Amount) * 100) !== transaction.amount || String(metadata.PhoneNumber) !== transaction.phoneNumber) throw new BadRequestException('Payment callback does not match the original request');
      const mpesaReceiptNumber = metadata.MpesaReceiptNumber;
      const transactionDate = this.parseProviderDate(metadata.TransactionDate);
      const phoneNumber = metadata.PhoneNumber?.toString();

      // Atomic idempotency check: only update if callbackReceived is false
      const updateResult = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.updateMany({
        where: { id: transaction.id, callbackReceived: false },
        data: {
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          resultCode: ResultCode,
          resultDesc: ResultDesc,
          mpesaReceiptNumber,
          transactionDate,
          phoneNumber: phoneNumber || transaction.phoneNumber,
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'PENDING',
        },
      });

      if (updateResult.count === 0) {
        this.logger.warn(
          `Concurrent duplicate callback safely dropped for transaction: ${transaction.id}`,
        );
        return;
      }

      // Auto-allocate payment to invoice if not already done
      if (transaction.invoiceId && !transaction.paymentId) {
        try {
          const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment(
            {
              invoiceId: transaction.invoiceId,
              amount: transaction.amount,
              paymentMethod: PaymentMethod.MPESA,
              reference: mpesaReceiptNumber,
              paymentDate: transactionDate.toISOString(),
              notes: `M-Pesa payment from ${phoneNumber}`,
            },
            transaction.initiatedBy || undefined,
          );

          // Link payment to transaction
          await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
            where: { id: transaction.id },
            data: {
              paymentId: payment!.id,
              reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
            },
          });

          this.logger.log(
            `Payment auto-allocated: ${mpesaReceiptNumber} → Invoice ${transaction.invoiceId}`,
          );
        } catch (error: any) {
          this.logger.error('Failed to auto-allocate payment', error);
          // Mark as unmatched for manual reconciliation
          await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
            where: { id: transaction.id },
            data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
          });
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Failed transaction
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
        where: { id: transaction.id },
        data: {
          status: 'FAILED',
          resultCode: ResultCode,
          resultDesc: ResultDesc,
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'FAILED',
        },
      });

      this.logger.warn(
        `STK Push failed: ${CheckoutRequestID} - ${ResultDesc}`,
      );
    }
  }

  async querySTKStatus(dto: QuerySTKStatusDto): Promise<any> {
    const timestamp = new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
      .slice(0, 14);
    const password = Buffer.from(
      `${this.shortCode}${this.passkey}${timestamp}`,
    ).toString('base64');

    try {
      const accessToken = await this.getAccessToken();

      const response = await axios.post(
        `${this.baseUrl}/mpesa/stkpushquery/v1/query`,
        {
          BusinessShortCode: this.shortCode,
          Password: password,
          Timestamp: timestamp,
          CheckoutRequestID: dto.checkoutRequestId,
        },
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        },
      );

      return response.data;
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('STK status query failed', error);
      throw new BadRequestException('Failed to query transaction status');
    }
  }

  // ==================== C2B CALLBACKS ====================

  async validateC2BPayment(
    dto: C2BValidationDto,
  ): Promise<C2BValidationResponseDto> {
    this.logger.log(`C2B Validation: ${dto.TransID}`);

    // Basic validation - accept all valid transactions
    // You can add custom validation logic here (e.g., check invoice exists)

    if (dto.TransAmount < 1) {
      return {
        ResultCode: 1,
        ResultDesc: 'Invalid transaction amount',
      };
    }

    return {
      ResultCode: 0,
      ResultDesc: 'Accepted',
    };
  }

  async confirmC2BPayment(
    dto: C2BCallbackDto,
  ): Promise<C2BConfirmationResponseDto> {
    this.logger.log(`C2B Confirmation: ${dto.TransID}`);

    const invoices = await this.prisma.executeWithoutTenantFilter(() => this.prisma.invoice.findMany({ where: { invoiceNumber: dto.BillRefNumber }, take: 2 }));
    const tenantId = invoices.length === 1 ? invoices[0].tenantId : null;
    if (tenantId) this.tenantService.setTenantId(tenantId);

    if (!tenantId) {
      this.logger.error('No tenant context for C2B callback');
      return {
        ResultCode: 1,
        ResultDesc: 'No tenant context',
      };
    }

    try {
      // Check for duplicate
      const existing = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.TransID,
        },
      });

      if (existing) {
        this.logger.warn(`Duplicate C2B transaction: ${dto.TransID}`);
        return {
          ResultCode: 0,
          ResultDesc: 'Duplicate transaction',
        };
      }

      // Parse transaction date
      const transactionDate = this.parseTransactionTime(dto.TransTime);

      // Convert amount from shillings to cents
      const amountInCents = Math.floor(dto.TransAmount * 100);

      // Create transaction record
      const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          transactionType: 'C2B',
          mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.TransID,
          phoneNumber: dto.MSISDN,
          amount: amountInCents,
          accountReference: dto.BillRefNumber,
          transactionDate,
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          resultCode: 0,
          resultDesc: 'Success',
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'PENDING',
          metadata: {
            TransactionType: dto.TransactionType,
            FirstName: dto.FirstName,
            MiddleName: dto.MiddleName,
            LastName: dto.LastName,
            InvoiceNumber: dto.InvoiceNumber,
            OrgAccountBalance: dto.OrgAccountBalance,
          },
        },
      });

      // Try to auto-match with invoice
      await this.autoReconcileC2B(transaction.id, dto.BillRefNumber);

      return {
        ResultCode: 0,
        ResultDesc: 'Accepted',
      };
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to process C2B confirmation', error);
      return {
        ResultCode: 1,
        ResultDesc: 'Failed to process payment',
      };
    }
  }

  private async autoReconcileC2B(
    transactionId: string,
    billReference: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // Try to find invoice by invoice number or admission number
      const invoice = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
        where: {
          OR: [
            { invoiceNumber: billReference },
            {
              student: {
                admissionNumber: billReference,
              },
            },
          ],
          status: {
            not: 'CANCELLED',
          },
        },
      });

      if (!invoice) {
        this.logger.warn(
          `No invoice found for bill reference: ${billReference}`,
        );
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: transactionId },
          data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
        });
        return;
      }

      const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findUnique({
        where: { id: transactionId },
      });

      if (!transaction) return;

      // Check if amount matches or is less than balance
      if (transaction.amount > invoice.balanceAmount) {
        this.logger.warn(
          `Payment amount exceeds invoice balance for ${billReference}`,
        );
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: transactionId },
          data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
        });
        return;
      }

      // Record payment
      const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment({
        invoiceId: invoice.id,
        amount: transaction.amount,
        paymentMethod: PaymentMethod.MPESA,
        reference: transaction.mpesaReceiptNumber || (() => { throw new BadRequestException("Missing M-Pesa receipt"); })(),
        paymentDate: transaction.transactionDate?.toISOString(),
        notes: `C2B payment from ${transaction.phoneNumber}`,
      });

      // Update transaction
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
        where: { id: transactionId },
        data: {
          invoiceId: invoice.id,
          paymentId: payment!.id,
          reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
        },
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `C2B payment auto-reconciled: ${transaction.mpesaReceiptNumber} → Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNumber}`,
      );
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error('Auto-reconciliation failed', error);
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
        where: { id: transactionId },
        data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
      });
    }
  }

  // ==================== RECONCILIATION ====================

  async queryUnmatchedTransactions(query: QueryUnmatchedTransactionsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { page = 1, pageSize = 20, status, startDate, endDate } = query;

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      reconciliationStatus: status || 'UNMATCHED',
    };

    if (startDate || endDate) {
      where.transactionDate = {};
      if (startDate) {
        where.transactionDate.gte = new Date(startDate);
      }
      if (endDate) {
        where.transactionDate.lte = new Date(endDate);
      }
    }

    const [transactions, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findMany({
        where,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
        orderBy: { transactionDate: 'desc' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: transactions,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
        hasNextPage: page < Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
        hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async reconcileTransaction(dto: ReconcileTransactionDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.transactionId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!transaction) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Transaction not found');
    }

    switch (dto.action) {
      case ReconciliationAction.MATCH:
        if (!dto.invoiceId) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Invoice ID required for matching');
        }

        // Record payment
        const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment({
          invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
          amount: transaction.amount,
          paymentMethod: PaymentMethod.MPESA,
          reference: transaction.mpesaReceiptNumber || (() => { throw new BadRequestException("Missing M-Pesa receipt"); })(),
          paymentDate: transaction.transactionDate?.toISOString(),
          notes: dto.notes || `Manual reconciliation by user ${userId}`,
        });

        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: dto.transactionId },
          data: {
            invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
            paymentId: payment!.id,
            reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
          },
        });

        return { success: true, message: 'Transaction matched successfully' };

      case ReconciliationAction.UNMATCH:
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: dto.transactionId },
          data: {
            reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED',
          },
        });

        return { success: true, message: 'Transaction unmatched' };

      case ReconciliationAction.MARK_DUPLICATE:
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: dto.transactionId },
          data: {
            reconciliationStatus: 'DUPLICATE',
          },
        });

        return { success: true, message: 'Transaction marked as duplicate' };

      default:
        throw new BadRequestException('Invalid reconciliation action');
    }
  }

  async manualReconciliation(dto: ManualReconciliationDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Check if transaction exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.mpesaReference,
      },
    });

    let transaction;

    if (existing) {
      transaction = existing;
    } else {
      // Create manual transaction record
      transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          transactionType: 'MANUAL',
          accountReference: dto.invoiceId,
          mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.mpesaReference,
          phoneNumber: dto.customerPhone || '',
          amount: dto.amount,
          invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
          transactionDate: dto.transactionDate
            ? new Date(dto.transactionDate)
            : new Date(),
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          resultCode: 0,
          resultDesc: 'Manual entry',
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'PENDING',
          initiatedBy: userId,
        },
      });
    }

    // Record payment
    const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment({
      invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
      amount: dto.amount,
      paymentMethod: PaymentMethod.MPESA,
      reference: dto.mpesaReference,
      paymentDate: dto.transactionDate,
      notes: dto.notes || 'Manual reconciliation',
    });

    // Update transaction
    await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
      where: { id: transaction.id },
      data: {
        invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
        paymentId: payment!.id,
        reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
      },
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Payment manually reconciled',
      paymentId: payment!.id,
    };
  }

  // ==================== UTILITIES ====================

  private parseTransactionTime(transTime: string): Date {
    // Format: YYYYMMDDHHmmss
    const year = parseInt(transTime.substring(0, 4));
    const month = parseInt(transTime.substring(4, 6)) - 1;
    const day = parseInt(transTime.substring(6, 8));
    const hour = parseInt(transTime.substring(8, 10));
    const minute = parseInt(transTime.substring(10, 12));
    const second = parseInt(transTime.substring(12, 14));

    return new Date(year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
  }

  async getTransactionById(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        invoice: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
        payment: true,
      },
    });

    if (!transaction) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Transaction not found');
    }

    return transaction;
  }

  async getTransactionStats() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [total, completed, pending, failed, unmatched] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'COMPLETED' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'PENDING' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'FAILED' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
      }),
    ]);

    const totalAmount = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.aggregate({
      where: { tenantId, status: 'COMPLETED' },
      _sum: { amount: true },
    });

    return {
      total,
      completed,
      pending,
      failed,
      unmatched,
      totalAmount: totalAmount._sum.amount || 0,
    };
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';

/**
 * Integration service for sending notifications about parent engagement events
 * This service connects Parent Engagement features with the Communications module
 */
@Injectable()
export class ParentEngagementNotificationsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ParentEngagementNotificationsService.name);

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Send activity notification to parents
   * Called when a teacher creates a new activity
   */
  async sendActivityNotification(activityId: string) {
    try {
      const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

      // Get activity with student and guardian info
      const activity = await this.prisma.activityFeed.findFirst({
        where: { id: activityId, tenantId },
        include: {
          student: {
            include: {
              guardianLinks: {
                where: {
                  receiveUpdates: true,
                },
                include: {
                  guardian: true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      });

      if (!activity || !activity.isVisibleToParents || !activity.student) {
        return;
      }

      // Get primary guardians
      const recipients: string[] = [];
      activity.student.guardianLinks.forEach((link: any) => {
        if (link.guardian.phone) {
          recipients.push(link.guardian.phone);
        }
      });

      if (recipients.length === 0) {
        return;
      }

      // Prepare message
      const message = this.formatActivityMessage(
        activity.student.firstName,
        activity.student.lastName,
        activity.title,
        activity.activityType,
      );

      // Send via Communications module (placeholder - integrate with actual module)
      // await this.communicationsService.sendMessage({
      //   channel: 'SMS',
      //   recipients,
      //   message,
      //   messageType: 'ACTIVITY_UPDATE',
      //   priority: 'NORMAL',
      // });

      this.logger.log(`Activity notification sent for activity ${activityId}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to send activity notification: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send behavior alert to parents
   * Called when a teacher records a behavior incident
   */
  async sendBehaviorAlert(behaviorRecordId: string) {
    try {
      const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

      const record = (await this.prisma.behaviorRecord?.findFirst({
        where: { id: behaviorRecordId, tenantId },
        include: {
          student: {
            include: {
              guardianLinks: {
                where: {
                  isPrimary: true,
                  receiveUpdates: true,
                },
                include: {
                  guardian: true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      })) as any;

      if (!record) {
        return;
      }

      // Get primary guardian
      const primaryGuardian = record.student.guardianLinks[0]?.guardian;
      if (!primaryGuardian || !primaryGuardian.phone) {
        return;
      }

      // Prepare message based on behavior type
      const message = this.formatBehaviorMessage(
        record.student.firstName,
        record.student.lastName,
        record.behaviorType,
        record.title,
        record.description,
      );

      // Determine priority based on behavior type
      const priority = record.behaviorType === 'NEGATIVE' ? 'HIGH' : 'NORMAL';

      // Send notification
      // await this.communicationsService.sendMessage({
      //   channel: 'SMS',
      //   recipients: [primaryGuardian.phone],
      //   message,
      //   messageType: 'BEHAVIOR_ALERT',
      //   priority,
      // });

      // Mark as notified
      if (this.prisma.behaviorRecord) {
        await this.prisma.behaviorRecord.update({
        where: { id: behaviorRecordId },
        data: {
          parentNotified: true,
          parentNotifiedAt: new Date(),
        },
        });
      }

      this.logger.log(`Behavior alert sent for record ${behaviorRecordId}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to send behavior alert: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send homework reminder to parents
   * Can be called by a scheduled job for upcoming homework
   */
  async sendHomeworkReminder(assignmentId: string, studentId: string) {
    try {
      const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

      const assignment = await this.prisma.assignment.findFirst({
        where: { id: assignmentId, tenantId },
        include: {
          subject: true,
        },
      });

      const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
        where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
        include: {
          guardianLinks: {
            where: {
              isPrimary: true,
              receiveUpdates: true,
            },
            include: {
              guardian: true,
            },
          },
        },
      });

      if (!assignment || !student) {
        return;
      }

      const primaryGuardian = student.guardianLinks[0]?.guardian;
      if (!primaryGuardian || !primaryGuardian.phone) {
        return;
      }

      // Check if already submitted
      const submission = await this.prisma.assignmentSubmission.findFirst({
        where: {
          assignmentId,
          studentId,
        },
      });

      if (submission) {
        return; // Already submitted, no reminder needed
      }

      const message = this.formatHomeworkMessage(
        student.firstName,
        student.lastName,
        assignment.subject.name,
        assignment.title,
        assignment.dueDate,
      );

      // Send reminder
      // await this.communicationsService.sendMessage({
      //   channel: 'SMS',
      //   recipients: [primaryGuardian.phone],
      //   message,
      //   messageType: 'HOMEWORK_REMINDER',
      //   priority: 'NORMAL',
      // });

      this.logger.log(`Homework reminder sent for assignment ${assignmentId}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to send homework reminder: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send booking confirmation to parent
   * Called when a teacher confirms a parent-teacher booking
   */
  async sendBookingConfirmation(bookingId: string) {
    try {
      const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

      const booking = (await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking?.findFirst({
        where: { id: bookingId, tenantId },
        include: {
          guardian: true,
          student: true,
        },
      })) as any;

      if (!booking || !booking.guardian.phone) {
        return;
      }

      const message = this.formatBookingMessage(
        booking.student.firstName,
        booking.student.lastName,
        booking.bookingDate,
        booking.startTime,
        booking.endTime,
        booking.meetingType,
        booking.location,
      );

      // Send confirmation
      // await this.communicationsService.sendMessage({
      //   channel: 'SMS',
      //   recipients: [booking.guardian.phone],
      //   message,
      //   messageType: 'BOOKING_CONFIRMATION',
      //   priority: 'NORMAL',
      // });

      // Mark reminder as sent
      if (this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking) {
        await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking.update({
        where: { id: bookingId },
        data: {
          reminderSent: true,
          reminderSentAt: new Date(),
        },
        });
      }

      this.logger.log(`Booking confirmation sent for booking ${bookingId}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to send booking confirmation: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send daily digest of activities to parents
   * Can be scheduled to run daily
   */
  async sendDailyActivityDigest() {
    try {
      const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

      const today = new Date();
      today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

      const tomorrow = new Date(today);
      tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);

      // Get today's activities
      const activities = (await this.prisma.activityFeed?.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          createdAt: {
            gte: today,
            lt: tomorrow,
          },
          isVisibleToParents: true,
        },
        include: {
          student: {
            include: {
              guardianLinks: {
                where: {
                  isPrimary: true,
                  receiveUpdates: true,
                },
                include: {
                  guardian: true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      })) || [];

      // Group by student
      const byStudent = new Map<string, typeof activities>();
      activities.forEach((activity) => {
        const studentId = activity.studentId;
        if (!byStudent.has(studentId)) {
          byStudent.set(studentId, []);
        }
        byStudent.get(studentId)!.push(activity);
      });

      // Send digest to each guardian
      for (const [studentId, studentActivities] of byStudent.entries()) {
        const student = studentActivities[0]?.student;
        if (!student) continue;
        const primaryGuardian = student.guardianLinks[0]?.guardian;

        if (!primaryGuardian || !primaryGuardian.phone) {
          continue;
        }

        const message = this.formatDailyDigest(
          student.firstName,
          student.lastName,
          studentActivities,
        );

        // Send digest
        // await this.communicationsService.sendMessage({
        //   channel: 'SMS',
        //   recipients: [primaryGuardian.phone],
        //   message,
        //   messageType: 'DAILY_DIGEST',
        //   priority: 'NORMAL',
        // });
      }

      this.logger.log(`Daily activity digest sent to ${byStudent.size} parents`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to send daily digest: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  // Message formatters

  private formatActivityMessage(
    firstName: string,
    lastName: string,
    activityTitle: string,
    activityType: string,
  ): string {
    return `${firstName} ${lastName}: ${activityTitle}. Check the parent portal for more details.`;
  }

  private formatBehaviorMessage(
    firstName: string,
    lastName: string,
    behaviorType: string,
    title: string,
    description?: string,
  ): string {
    const prefix =
      behaviorType === 'POSITIVE'
        ? '⭐ Great News!'
        : behaviorType === 'NEGATIVE'
        ? '⚠️ Attention Required'
        : 'ℹ️ Update';

    return `${prefix} ${firstName} ${lastName}: ${title}. ${description || 'Please check the parent portal for details.'}`;
  }

  private formatHomeworkMessage(
    firstName: string,
    lastName: string,
    subject: string,
    assignmentTitle: string,
    dueDate: Date,
  ): string {
    const dueDateStr = dueDate.toLocaleDateString();
    return `📚 Reminder: ${firstName} ${lastName} has homework in ${subject}: "${assignmentTitle}" due on ${dueDateStr}. Check the parent portal for details.`;
  }

  private formatBookingMessage(
    firstName: string,
    lastName: string,
    date: Date,
    startTime: string,
    endTime: string,
    meetingType: string,
    location?: string,
  ): string {
    const dateStr = date.toLocaleDateString();
    const locationInfo =
      meetingType === 'IN_PERSON'
        ? location
          ? ` at ${location}`
          : ' (location TBD)'
        : meetingType === 'VIRTUAL'
        ? ' (virtual meeting - link will be shared)'
        : ' (phone call)';

    return `✅ Meeting Confirmed: Parent-teacher meeting for ${firstName} ${lastName} on ${dateStr} at ${startTime}-${endTime}${locationInfo}.`;
  }

  private formatDailyDigest(
    firstName: string,
    lastName: string,
    activities: any[],
  ): string {
    const count = activities.length;
    const summary = activities
      .slice(0, 3)
      .map((a) => `• ${a.title}`)
      .join('\n');

    return `📱 Daily Update for ${firstName} ${lastName}: ${count} ${count === 1 ? 'activity' : 'activities'} today.\n${summary}${count > 3 ? `\n...and ${count - 3} more` : ''}\n\nView all in the parent portal.`;
  }
}

    @Query() query: QueryHomeworkDto,
    @Request() req: any,
  ) {
    const guardianId = req.user.guardianId || req.user.id;
    return this.homeworkService.getStudentHomework(studentId, guardianId, query);
  }

  @Get('student/:studentId/homework/summary')
  getHomeworkSummary(@Param('studentId') studentId: string, @Request() req: any) {
    const guardianId = req.user.guardianId || req.user.id;
    return this.homeworkService.getHomeworkSummary(studentId, guardianId);
  }

  @Get('student/:studentId/homework/upcoming')
  getUpcomingHomework(@Param('studentId') studentId: string, @Request() req: any) {
    const guardianId = req.user.guardianId || req.user.id;
    return this.homeworkService.getUpcomingHomework(studentId, guardianId);
  }

  @Get('homework/assignment/:assignmentId/student/:studentId')
  getAssignmentDetails(
    @Param('assignmentId') assignmentId: string,

  }

    });
  }

  ) {

  }

  @Post('bookings')
  createBooking(@Body() createBookingDto: CreateBookingDto, @Request() req: any) {

    return this.bookingsService.createBooking(guardianId, createBookingDto);
  }

  @Get('bookings/:id')
  getBooking(@Param('id') id: string) {

  }

  @Post('bookings/:id/cancel')
  cancelBooking(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Body() cancelBookingDto: CancelBookingDto,
    @Request() req: any,
  ) {
    return this.bookingsService.cancelBooking(id, req.user.id, cancelBookingDto);
  }

  // ===== NOTIFICATIONS =====

  @Get('notifications')
  getNotifications(@Request() req: any, @Query('limit') limit?: number) {
    const guardianId = req.user.guardianId || req.user.id;
    return this.parentPortalService.getParentNotifications(guardianId, limit ? Number(limit) : 10);
  }

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ForbiddenException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { ActivityFeedService } from '../activity-feed/activity-feed.service';
import { MediaService } from '../media/media.service';
import { BehaviorService } from '../behavior/behavior.service';
import { HomeworkService } from '../homework/homework.service';
import { BookingsService } from '../bookings/bookings.service';
import { BookingStatus } from '../bookings/dto/create-booking.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ParentPortalService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
    private activityFeedService: ActivityFeedService,
    private mediaService: MediaService,
    private behaviorService: BehaviorService,
    private homeworkService: HomeworkService,
    private bookingsService: BookingsService,
  ) {}

  // Get guardian's children
  async getMyChildren(guardianId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.findFirst({
      where: { id: guardianId, tenantId },
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                middleName: true,
                photo: true,
                dateOfBirth: true,
                gender: true,
                status: true,
                currentClass: {
                  select: {
                    name: true,
                    level: true,
                  },
                },
                currentStream: {
                  select: {
                    name: true,
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!guardian) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Guardian not found');
    }

    return guardian.studentLinks.map((link) => ({
      ...link.student,
      relationship: link.relationship,
      isPrimary: link.isPrimary,
    }));
  }

  // Get comprehensive dashboard for a student
  async getStudentDashboard(studentId: string, guardianId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: { guardianId, studentId },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    // Get student details
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        admissionNumber: true,
        firstName: true,
        lastName: true,
        middleName: true,
        photo: true,
        currentClass: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            level: true,
          },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    // Get summaries in parallel
    const [
      activitySummary,
      behaviorSummary,
      homeworkSummary,
      upcomingBookings,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      this.activityFeedService.getActivitySummary(studentId, guardianId),
      this.behaviorService.getBehaviorSummary(studentId, guardianId),
      this.homeworkService.getHomeworkSummary(studentId, guardianId),
      this.bookingsService.getBookings({
        guardianId,
        studentId,
        status: BookingStatus.CONFIRMED,
        startDate: new Date().toISOString(),
      }),
    ]);

    // Get recent activities (last 5)
    const recentActivities = await this.activityFeedService.getStudentActivities(
      studentId,
      guardianId,
      { page: 1, limit: 5 },
    );

    // Get upcoming homework (due in next 7 days)
    const upcomingHomework = await this.homeworkService.getUpcomingHomework(
      studentId,
      guardianId,
    );

    // Get recent behavior (last 3)
    const recentBehavior = await this.behaviorService.getRecentBehavior(studentId, 3);

    return {
      student,
      summaries: {
        activities: activitySummary,
        behavior: behaviorSummary,
        homework: homeworkSummary,
      },
      recentActivities: recentActivities.data,
      upcomingHomework: upcomingHomework.slice(0, 5),
      recentBehavior,
      upcomingBookings: upcomingBookings.slice(0, 3),
    };
  }

  // Get student profile with extended information
  async getStudentProfile(studentId: string, guardianId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian has access
    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: { guardianId, studentId },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this student');
    }

    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: studentId, tenantId },
      include: {
        currentClass: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            level: true,
            educationLevel: true,
          },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
        guardianLinks: {
          include: {
            guardian: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                phone: true,
                email: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    return student;
  }

  // Get notifications/alerts for parent
  async getParentNotifications(guardianId: string, limit: number = 10) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get guardian's children
    const links = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findMany({
      where: { guardianId },
      select: { studentId: true },
    });

    const studentIds = links.map((link) => link.studentId);

    if (studentIds.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const today = new Date();
    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
    sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);

    // Collect notifications from various sources
    const notifications: any[] = [];

    // 1. Recent behavior records (especially negative ones)
    const behaviorRecords = (await this.prisma.behaviorRecord?.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: { in: studentIds },
        incidentDate: { gte: sevenDaysAgo },
        parentNotified: false,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        incidentDate: 'desc',
      },
      take: limit,
    })) || [];

    behaviorRecords.forEach((record: any) => {
      notifications.push({
        type: 'BEHAVIOR',
        priority: record.behaviorType === 'NEGATIVE' ? 'HIGH' : 'NORMAL',
        title: `${record.behaviorType} Behavior: ${record.title}`,
        message: `${record.student.firstName} ${record.student.lastName} - ${record.description || record.title}`,
        studentId: record.studentId,
        date: record.incidentDate,
        metadata: {
          behaviorId: record.id,
          behaviorType: record.behaviorType,
          category: record.category,
        },
      });
    });

    // 2. Overdue homework
    for (const studentId of studentIds) {
      const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
        where: { id: studentId },
        select: {
          firstName: true,
          lastName: true,
          currentClassId: true,
        },
      });

      if (student && student.currentClassId) {
        const overdueAssignments = await this.prisma.assignment.findMany({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            classId: student.currentClassId,
            dueDate: { lt: today },
          },
          include: {
            submissions: {
              where: { studentId },
              select: { id: true },
            },
            subject: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        });

        overdueAssignments
          .filter((assignment) => assignment.submissions.length === 0)
          .forEach((assignment) => {
            notifications.push({
              type: 'HOMEWORK_OVERDUE',
              priority: 'HIGH',
              title: 'Overdue Homework',
              message: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} has overdue homework in ${assignment.subject.name}: ${assignment.title}`,
              studentId,
              date: assignment.dueDate,
              metadata: {
                assignmentId: assignment.id,
                subject: assignment.subject.name,
              },
            });
          });
      }
    }

    // 3. Upcoming bookings (in next 3 days)
    const threeDaysFromNow = new Date();
    threeDaysFromNow.setDate(threeDaysFromNow.getDate() + 3);

    const upcomingBookings = (await this.prisma.parentTeacherBooking?.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        guardianId,
        studentId: { in: studentIds },
        bookingDate: {
          gte: today,
          lte: threeDaysFromNow,
        },
        status: 'CONFIRMED' as const,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    })) || [];

    upcomingBookings.forEach((booking: any) => {
      notifications.push({
        type: 'BOOKING_REMINDER',
        priority: 'NORMAL',
        title: 'Upcoming Teacher Meeting',
        message: `Meeting scheduled for ${booking.student.firstName} ${booking.student.lastName} on ${booking.bookingDate.toDateString()} at ${booking.startTime}`,
        studentId: booking.studentId,
        date: booking.bookingDate,
        metadata: {
          bookingId: booking.id,
          startTime: booking.startTime,
          meetingType: booking.meetingType,
        },
      });
    });

    // Sort by priority and date
    notifications.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.priority === 'HIGH' && b.priority !== 'HIGH') return -1;
      if (a.priority !== 'HIGH' && b.priority === 'HIGH') return 1;
      return new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime();
    });

    return notifications.slice(0, limit);
  }
}

import {Injectable,NotFoundException,BadRequestException} from '@nestjs/common';
import {PrismaService} from '../../database/prisma.service';
import {RecordSpec,parseRecord} from '../workspace/records';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
const specs:Record<string,RecordSpec> = {
  "schools": {
    "model": "tenant",
    "fields": {
      "name": "text!",
      "subdomain": "slug!",
      "contactEmail": "email!",
      "contactPhone": "text!",
      "address": "text",
      "status": "enum:ACTIVE,TRIAL,SUSPENDED,EXPIRED,CANCELLED"
    }
  },
  "users": {
    "model": "user",

      "tenantId": "ref:tenant!",

      "lastName": "text!",
      "password": "password!",

      "planId": "ref:plan!",
      "startDate": "date!",
      "endDate": "date!",

    }
  },

      "priority": "enum:LOW,NORMAL,HIGH,URGENT"
    }
  },
  "announcements": {
    "model": "announcement",
    "fields": {
      "title": "text!",
      "body": "long!"
    }
  }

@Injectable()
export class PlatformService{
 constructor(private prisma:PrismaService){}
 async list(resource:string){return this.prisma.executeWithoutTenantFilter(async()=>{
  if(resource==='plans')return this.prisma.plan.findMany({where:{isActive:true},orderBy:{sortOrder:'asc'}});
  const spec=specs[resource];if(!spec)throw new NotFoundException('Unknown resource');
  if(resource==='users'){const users=await this.prisma.user.findMany({select:{id:true,tenantId:true,email:true,firstName:true,lastName:true,role:true,isActive:true,createdAt:true,tenant:{select:{name:true}}},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5000});return users.map(u=>({...u,name:u.firstName+' '+u.lastName,schoolName:u.tenant.name,status:u.isActive?'ACTIVE':'SUSPENDED'}));}
  if(resource==='subscriptions'){const rows=await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({include:{plan:true,tenant:{select:{name:true}}},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5000});return rows.map(r=>({...r,schoolName:r.tenant.name,planName:r.plan.name,price:r.plan.price}));}
  return (this.prisma as any)[spec.model].findMany({orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5000});
 });}
 async write(user:any,resource:string,input:Record<string,unknown>,id?:string){return this.prisma.executeWithoutTenantFilter(async()=>{
  const spec=specs[resource];if(!spec)throw new NotFoundException('Unknown resource');if(resource==='tickets'&&!id)throw new BadRequestException('Tickets are opened by schools');
  const data=parseRecord(spec,input,!!id);const db=this.prisma as any;
  if(data.subdomain&&!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$/.test(data.subdomain))throw new BadRequestException('Use 3?63 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens for the subdomain');
  for(const [key,rule] of Object.entries(spec.fields))if(rule.startsWith('ref:')&&data[key]){const model=rule.replace(/!$/,'').slice(4);if(!await db[model].findFirst({where:{id:data[key]}}))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid '+key);}
  const existing=id?await db[spec.model].findUnique({where:{id}}):null;if(id&&!existing)throw new NotFoundException('Record not found');
  if(resource==='users'){
   if(id===user.userId&&(data.status==='SUSPENDED'||data.role&&data.role!=='SUPER_ADMIN'||data.tenantId&&data.tenantId!==user.tenantId))throw new BadRequestException('You cannot disable or demote your own account');
   if(id&&data.tenantId&&data.tenantId!==existing.tenantId)throw new BadRequestException('User accounts cannot move between schools');
   if(data.password){data.passwordHash=await bcrypt.hash(data.password,12);delete data.password;}
   if(data.status){data.isActive=data.status==='ACTIVE';delete data.status;}
   if(id)data.tokenVersion={increment:1};
  }
  if(resource==='subscriptions'&&existing){if(data.tenantId&&data.tenantId!==existing.tenantId)throw new BadRequestException('Subscriptions cannot move between schools');if((data.startDate||existing.startDate)>(data.endDate||existing.endDate))throw new BadRequestException('End date must follow start date');}
  if(resource==='announcements'&&!id)data.createdBy=user.userId;
  const result=await this.prisma.$transaction(async tx=>{
   const entity=id?await (tx as any)[spec.model].update({where:{id},data}):await (tx as any)[spec.model].create({data});
   if(resource==='schools'&&!id)await tx.school.create({data:{tenantId:entity.id,name:entity.name,email:entity.contactEmail,phone:entity.contactPhone,address:entity.address||'Not provided',city:'Not provided',county:'Not provided',schoolType:'PRIVATE',educationLevel:['PRIMARY']}});
   await tx.auditLog.create({data:{tenantId:user.tenantId,userId:user.userId,action:id?'PLATFORM_RECORD_UPDATED':'PLATFORM_RECORD_CREATED',entityType:resource,entityId:entity.id}});
   return entity;
  });return {id:result.id};
 });}
 async publish(user:any,id:string){return this.prisma.executeWithoutTenantFilter(async()=>{const a=await this.prisma.announcement.findUnique({where:{id}});if(!a)throw new NotFoundException('Announcement not found');await this.prisma.$transaction([this.prisma.announcement.update({where:{id},data:{status:'PUBLISHED',publishedAt:new Date()}}),this.prisma.auditLog.create({data:{tenantId:user.tenantId,userId:user.userId,action:'ANNOUNCEMENT_PUBLISHED',entityType:'announcement',entityId:id}})]);return {message:'Published'};});}
 async overview(){return this.prisma.executeWithoutTenantFilter(async()=>{
  const [schools,students,staff,subscriptions,recentSchools,activities]=await Promise.all([this.prisma.tenant.count(),this.prisma.student.count({where:{deletedAt:null,status:'ACTIVE'}}),this.prisma.staff.count({where:{status:'ACTIVE'}}),this.prisma.subscription.findMany({where:{status:'ACTIVE',endDate:{gte:new Date()}},include:{plan:true}}),this.prisma.tenant.findMany({orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5,select:{id:true,name:true,status:true,createdAt:true}}),this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5})]);
  return {schools,students,staff,subscriptions:subscriptions.length,balance:subscriptions.reduce((sum,s)=>sum+s.plan.price*(s.plan.billingCycle==='MONTHLY'?12:1),0),recentSchools,activities,events:[]};
 });}
 async system(){const start=Date.now();let database='healthy';try{await this.prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;}catch{database='unavailable';}return {database,databaseLatency:Date.now()-start,uptimeSeconds:Math.floor(process.uptime()),memoryMB:Math.round(process.memoryUsage().rss/1048576),environment:process.env.NODE_ENV||'development',timestamp:new Date().toISOString()};}
}

import 'reflect-metadata';
import { ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { RolesGuard } from '../../common/guards/roles.guard';
import { PredictiveAnalyticsController } from './predictive-analytics.controller';
import { PredictiveAnalyticsService } from './predictive-analytics.service';

describe('predictive analytics access and tenant isolation', () => {
  it('requires a tenant before any database access', async () => {
    const prisma = { student: { findMany: jest.fn() }, tenant: { findFirst: jest.fn() } };
    const service = new PredictiveAnalyticsService(prisma as any, { requireTenantContext: () => { throw new Error('Tenant context required'); } } as any);
    await expect(service.report()).rejects.toThrow('Tenant context required');
    expect(prisma.student.findMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); expect(prisma.tenant.findFirst).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('scopes students and each sensitive nested relation to the authenticated tenant', async () => {
    const prisma = { student: { findMany: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([]) }, tenant: { findFirst: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ currency: 'KES' }) } };
    const service = new PredictiveAnalyticsService(prisma as any, { requireTenantContext: () => 'school-a' } as any);
    const report = await service.report();
    const query = prisma.student.findMany.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(query.where).toEqual({ tenantId: 'school-a', deletedAt: null });
    for (const relation of ['attendanceRecords', 'grades', 'invoices']) expect(query.select[relation].where.tenantId).toBe('school-a');
    expect(query.select.invoices.select.payments.where.tenantId).toBe('school-a');
    expect(query.select.grades.where.examination.tenantId).toBe('school-a');
    expect(query.select.gender).toBeUndefined(); expect(query.select.medicalConditions).toBeUndefined();
    expect(report.summary.students).toBe(0);
  });
  it.each(['SCHOOL_OWNER', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL', 'SCHOOL_ADMIN'])('allows school leadership: %s', role => {
    const context = { getHandler: () => PredictiveAnalyticsController.prototype.report,
      getClass: () => PredictiveAnalyticsController, switchToHttp: () => ({ getRequest: () => ({ user: { role } }) }) } as unknown as ExecutionContext;
    expect(new RolesGuard(new Reflector()).canActivate(context)).toBe(true);
  });
  it.each(['PARENT', 'STUDENT', 'TEACHER', 'ACCOUNTANT', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])('denies risk records to other roles: %s', role => {
    const context = { getHandler: () => PredictiveAnalyticsController.prototype.report,
      getClass: () => PredictiveAnalyticsController, switchToHttp: () => ({ getRequest: () => ({ user: { role } }) }) } as unknown as ExecutionContext;
    expect(() => new RolesGuard(new Reflector()).canActivate(context)).toThrow('Insufficient permissions');
  });
});

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { AnalyticsStudent, buildAnalytics } from './risk-engine';

@Injectable()
export class PredictiveAnalyticsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService, private readonly tenants: TenantService) {}

  async report() {
    const tenantId = this.tenants.requireTenantContext();
    const now = new Date();
    const historyStart = new Date(now.getTime() - 730 * 86_400_000);
    const attendanceStart = new Date(now.getTime() - 90 * 86_400_000);
    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findFirst({ where: { id: tenantId }, select: { currency: true } });
    const students: AnalyticsStudent[] = [];
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    // Fetch in batches; use explicit tenant predicates even on nested relations.
    while (true) {
      const batch = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
        where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null }, orderBy: { id: 'asc' }, take: 250,
        ...(cursor ? { cursor: { id: cursor }, skip: 1 } : {}),
        select: {
          id: true, firstName: true, lastName: true, admissionNumber: true, status: true,
          currentClassId: true, currentClass: { select: { name: true } },
          attendanceRecords: { where: { tenantId, date: { gte: attendanceStart, lte: now } }, select: { date: true, status: true } },
          grades: { where: { tenantId, createdAt: { gte: historyStart, lte: now }, examination: { tenantId } },
            select: { subjectId: true, score: true, marks: true, totalMarks: true, updatedAt: true,
              examination: { select: { id: true, startDate: true, endDate: true, createdAt: true,
                subjects: { select: { subjectId: true, passMark: true, totalMarks: true, weight: true } } } } } },
          invoices: { where: { tenantId, createdAt: { lte: now }, status: { notIn: ['CANCELLED', 'DRAFT'] },
            OR: [{ createdAt: { gte: historyStart } }, { balanceAmount: { gt: 0 } }] },
            select: { totalAmount: true, paidAmount: true, balanceAmount: true, status: true, dueDate: true, createdAt: true,
              payments: { where: { tenantId, paymentDate: { lte: now } }, select: { amount: true, paymentDate: true, status: true } } } },
        },
      });
      students.push(...batch);
      if (batch.length < 250) break;
      cursor = batch[batch.length - 1].id;
    }
    return buildAnalytics(students, now, tenant?.currency ?? 'KES');
  }
}

import { AnalyticsStudent, buildAnalytics } from './risk-engine';

const now = new Date('2026-10-11T12:00:00Z');
function student(overrides: Partial<AnalyticsStudent> = {}): AnalyticsStudent {

}

      startDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 7 + i, 1)), endDate: null,
      subjects: [{ subjectId: 'math', totalMarks: 100, passMark: 40, weight: 1 }] } }));
}

describe('predictive early-warning engine', () => {

    expect([result.academic.level, result.feeDefault.level, result.dropout.level]).toEqual(['HIGH', 'HIGH', 'HIGH']);
    expect(result.metrics.projectedAverage).toBe(3.3);

    expect([result.academic.score, result.feeDefault.score, result.dropout.score]).toEqual([null, null, null]);
  });
  it('shows low risk with improving marks, regular attendance and settled bills', () => {

    expect(result.overall).toBe('LOW');

  });

    history.forEach(g => { g.examination.subjects[0].passMark = 20; });

    expect(result.metrics.attendanceDays).toBe(5);

  });
  it('does not penalise approved leave, illness or official duty', () => {

    expect(profile(student({ attendanceRecords: records })).dropout.score).toBe(0);

    expect(profile(student({ invoices: [{ ...bill(), dueDate: null }] })).feeDefault.score).toBeNull();
  });

    const history = exams([90, 90]); history.forEach(g => { g.marks = 0; });
    expect(profile(student({ grades: history })).metrics.latestAverage).toBe(0);
    expect(profile(student({ grades: exams([0, 0]) })).academic.level).toBe('HIGH');
  });
  it('excludes inactive students from current watchlists and summary counts', () => {

  });
  it('flags upcoming fees when reconciled history shows repeated late settlement', () => {
    const old = bill(10000); old.payments[0].paymentDate = new Date('2026-09-15');
    const upcoming = { ...bill(), dueDate: new Date('2026-10-18'), createdAt: new Date('2026-10-01') };
    expect(profile(student({ invoices: [old, upcoming] })).feeDefault.level).toBe('HIGH');
  });
});

describe('school-trained logistic model validation gate', () => {
  const samples = (): TrainingSample[] => Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({
    features: [i % 2 ? 1 : -1, 0], outcome: (i % 2) as 0 | 1, date: new Date(Date.UTC(2025, 0, i + 1)) }));
  it('activates only with enough examples and successful later-date validation', () => {
    const model = trainRiskModel(samples());
    expect(model.info.status).toBe('ACTIVE'); expect(model.info.validationSamples).toBe(30);
    expect(model.predict!([1, 0])).toBeGreaterThan(0.65); expect(model.predict!([-1, 0])).toBeLessThan(0.35);
  });
  it('rejects a model that fails to generalise to later outcomes', () => {
    const rows = samples(); rows.slice(90).forEach(s => { s.outcome = s.outcome ? 0 : 1; });
    const model = trainRiskModel(rows);
    expect(model.info.status).toBe('VALIDATION_FAILED'); expect(model.predict).toBeNull();
  });
  it('requires both outcome classes, not just a large sample count', () => {
    const rows = samples(); rows.forEach(s => { s.outcome = 0; });
    expect(trainRiskModel(rows).info.status).toBe('INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY');
  });
  it('does not split the same exam date across training and validation', () => {
    const rows = samples(); rows.forEach(s => { s.date = now; });
    expect(trainRiskModel(rows).predict).toBeNull();
  });
});

================
File: apps/api/src/modules/predictive-analytics/risk-engine.ts
