import { PredictiveAnalyticsReport, RiskAssessment, RiskLevel, StudentRiskProfile } from '@krypton/types';
import { clamp, trainRiskModel, TrainingSample } from './risk-model';

const DAY = 86_400_000;
export interface AnalyticsStudent {
  id: string; firstName: string; lastName: string; admissionNumber: string; status: string;
  currentClassId: string | null; currentClass: { name: string } | null;
  attendanceRecords: { date: Date; status: string }[];
  grades: {
    subjectId: string; score: number; marks: number | null; totalMarks: number; updatedAt?: Date;
    examination: { id: string; startDate: Date | null; endDate: Date | null; createdAt: Date;
      subjects: { subjectId: string; passMark: number | null; totalMarks: number; weight: number }[] };
  }[];
  invoices: {
    totalAmount: number; paidAmount: number; balanceAmount: number; status: string; dueDate: Date | null; createdAt: Date;
    payments: { amount: number; paymentDate: Date; status: string }[];
  }[];
}
interface ExamPoint { date: Date; availableAt: Date; average: number; margin: number; below: number }
const mean = (values: number[]) => values.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / values.length;
function examHistory(student: AnalyticsStudent, now: Date): ExamPoint[] {
  const exams = new Map<string, AnalyticsStudent['grades']>();
  for (const grade of student.grades) {
    const exam = grade.examination;
    if ((exam.endDate ?? exam.startDate ?? exam.createdAt) > now) continue;
    const group = exams.get(exam.id) ?? [];
    group.push(grade); exams.set(exam.id, group);
  }
  const points: ExamPoint[] = [];
  for (const grades of exams.values()) {
    const exam = grades[0].examination;
    // Partial mark entry must not become a school-failure label.
    if (exam.subjects.some(s => !grades.some(g => g.subjectId === s.subjectId))) continue;
    let weight = 0, average = 0, margin = 0, below = 0, validGrades = 0;
    for (const grade of grades) {
      const config = exam.subjects.find(s => s.subjectId === grade.subjectId);
      const total = grade.totalMarks;
      const score = grade.marks ?? grade.score;
      if (total <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(score) || score < 0 || score > total) continue;
      const percent = score / total * 100;
      const pass = config?.passMark == null ? 40 : config.passMark / config.totalMarks * 100;
      const w = config && config.weight > 0 ? config.weight : 1;
      if (!Number.isFinite(pass) || pass < 0 || pass > 100) continue;
      validGrades++;
      weight += w; average += percent * w; margin += (percent - pass) * w;
      below += (percent < pass ? 1 : 0) * w;
    }
    if (weight && validGrades === grades.length) points.push({ date: exam.endDate ?? exam.startDate ?? exam.createdAt,
      availableAt: new Date(Math.max((exam.endDate ?? exam.startDate ?? exam.createdAt).getTime(), ...grades.map(g => g.updatedAt?.getTime() ?? 0))),
      average: average / weight, margin: margin / weight, below: below / weight });
  }
  return points.sort((a, b) => a.date.getTime() - b.date.getTime());
}
/** Linear regression over the last three completed examinations, projected one examination ahead. */
export function academicFeatures(points: ExamPoint[]) {
  const recent = points.slice(-3);
  const center = (recent.length - 1) / 2;
  const yMean = mean(recent.map(p => p.average));
  const denominator = recent.reduce((sum, _, i) => sum + (i - center) ** 2, 0);
  const slope = denominator ? recent.reduce((sum, p, i) => sum + (i - center) * (p.average - yMean), 0) / denominator : 0;
  const latest = recent[recent.length - 1];
  return { features: [clamp(-latest.margin / 50, -1, 1), clamp(-slope / 50, -1, 1), latest.below],
    slope, projection: clamp(yMean + slope * (recent.length - center), 0, 100) };
}
type Bill = AnalyticsStudent['invoices'][number];
const usableBill = (bill: Bill, now: Date) => !['CANCELLED', 'DRAFT'].includes(bill.status) && bill.createdAt <= now;
const ledgerValid = (bill: Bill, now: Date) => {
  const paid = bill.payments.filter(p => p.status === 'COMPLETED' && p.paymentDate <= now).reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amount, 0);
  return bill.totalAmount > 0 && paid === bill.paidAmount && bill.balanceAmount === bill.totalAmount - paid && paid <= bill.totalAmount;
};
const balanceAt = (bill: Bill, date: Date) => Math.max(0, bill.totalAmount - bill.payments
  .filter(p => p.status === 'COMPLETED' && p.paymentDate <= date).reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amount, 0));
function feeFeatures(bill: Bill, bills: Bill[], date: Date) {
  const earlier = bills.filter(b => b !== bill && b.createdAt <= date && b.dueDate && b.dueDate.getTime() + 30 * DAY <= date.getTime());
  const defaults = earlier.filter(b => balanceAt(b, new Date(b.dueDate!.getTime() + 30 * DAY)) > 0).length;
  const arrears = earlier.filter(b => balanceAt(b, date) > 0).length;
  return [balanceAt(bill, date) / bill.totalAmount, earlier.length ? defaults / earlier.length : 0,
    earlier.length ? arrears / earlier.length : 0];
}
const levelFor = (score: number | null): RiskLevel => score === null ? 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA' : score >= 65 ? 'HIGH' : score >= 35 ? 'MODERATE' : 'LOW';
function assessment(score: number | null, evidence: string[], actions: string[], trained = false): RiskAssessment {
  const rounded = score === null ? null : Math.round(clamp(score, 0, 100));
  return { score: rounded, level: levelFor(rounded), basis: trained ? 'SCHOOL_MODEL' : 'EARLY_WARNING', evidence, actions };
}

export function buildAnalytics(students: AnalyticsStudent[], now: Date, currency: string): PredictiveAnalyticsReport {
  const histories = new Map(students.map(s => [s.id, examHistory(s, now)]));
  const academicSamples: TrainingSample[] = [], feeSamples: TrainingSample[] = [];
  for (const student of students) {
    const points = histories.get(student.id)!;
    for (let i = 2; i < points.length; i++) {
      // No same-date or very old-to-new comparisons, and no outcome in input features.
      if (points[i].date <= points[i - 1].date || points[i].date.getTime() - points[i - 1].date.getTime() > 180 * DAY) continue;
      // A retrospectively entered or revised mark cannot become a historical predictor.
      const available = points.slice(0, i).filter(p => p.availableAt < points[i].date);
      if (available.length < 2) continue;
      academicSamples.push({ features: academicFeatures(available).features,
        outcome: points[i].margin < 0 ? 1 : 0, date: points[i].date });
    }
    const bills = student.invoices.filter(b => usableBill(b, now) && ledgerValid(b, now));
    for (const bill of bills) {
      if (!bill.dueDate || bill.dueDate.getTime() + 30 * DAY > now.getTime()) continue;
      const snapshot = new Date(bill.dueDate.getTime() - 7 * DAY);
      if (bill.createdAt > snapshot) continue;
      feeSamples.push({ features: feeFeatures(bill, bills, snapshot),
        outcome: balanceAt(bill, new Date(bill.dueDate.getTime() + 30 * DAY)) > 0 ? 1 : 0,
        date: new Date(bill.dueDate.getTime() + 30 * DAY) });
    }
  }
  const academicModel = trainRiskModel(academicSamples), feeModel = trainRiskModel(feeSamples);
  const profiles: StudentRiskProfile[] = students.filter(s => s.status === 'ACTIVE').map(student => {
    const points = histories.get(student.id)!;
    const latest = points[points.length - 1];
    const recentPoints = points.filter(p => p.date.getTime() >= now.getTime() - 180 * DAY);
    const academic = latest && recentPoints.length >= 2 ? academicFeatures(recentPoints) : null;
    const days = new Map<string, number[]>();
    for (const record of student.attendanceRecords) {
      if (record.date > now || record.date.getTime() < now.getTime() - 90 * DAY) continue;
      // Approved leave, sickness, and official duty do not count as disengagement.
      if (!['PRESENT', 'LATE', 'ABSENT', 'HALF_DAY'].includes(record.status)) continue;
      const day = record.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10), values = days.get(day) ?? [];
      values.push(record.status === 'ABSENT' ? 0 : record.status === 'HALF_DAY' ? 0.5 : 1); days.set(day, values);
    }
    const attendanceDays = days.size;
    const lastRecordedDay = [...days.keys()].sort().at(-1);
    const attendanceKnown = attendanceDays >= 10 && !!lastRecordedDay && now.getTime() - new Date(lastRecordedDay).getTime() <= 21 * DAY;
    const attendanceRate = attendanceDays ? mean([...days.values()].map(mean)) * 100 : null;
    let absenceStreak = 0;
    for (const [, values] of [...days.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => b.localeCompare(a))) {
      if (mean(values) > 0) break;
      absenceStreak++;
    }
    const academicEvidence = latest ? [`Latest completed exam average: ${latest.average.toFixed(1)}%.`,
      `${Math.round(latest.below * 100)}% of subject weight is below its pass mark.`] : ['No complete examination results.'];
    if (academic) academicEvidence.push(`Next-exam trend estimate: ${academic.projection.toFixed(1)}% (${academic.slope.toFixed(1)} points per exam).`);
    else academicEvidence.push('Two completed exams within 180 days are needed for a trend.');
    const academicScore = academic ? academicModel.predict ? academicModel.predict(academic.features) * 100 :
      clamp(40 - latest.margin * 2 + Math.max(0, -academic.slope) * 2 + latest.below * 20, 0, 100) : null;
    const academicRisk = assessment(academicScore, academicEvidence, ['Review subject-level marks and agree a tutoring plan.', 'Check progress after the next assessment.'], !!academicModel.predict && !!academic);

    const bills = student.invoices.filter(b => usableBill(b, now));
    const outstandingBalance = bills.reduce((sum, b) => sum + Math.max(0, b.balanceAmount), 0);
    const overdue = bills.filter(b => b.balanceAmount > 0 && b.dueDate && b.dueDate < now);
    const overdueBalance = overdue.reduce((sum, b) => sum + Math.max(0, b.balanceAmount), 0);
    const dueSoon = bills.filter(b => b.balanceAmount > 0 && b.dueDate && b.dueDate.getTime() <= now.getTime() + 30 * DAY);
    const oldestDays = overdue.length ? Math.floor(Math.max(...overdue.map(b => (now.getTime() - b.dueDate!.getTime()) / DAY))) : 0;
    let feeScore: number | null = bills.length && !outstandingBalance ? 0 : dueSoon.length ?
      clamp(25 + Math.min(oldestDays, 60) + Math.min(overdue.length, 3) * 10, 0, 100) : null;
    const validBills = bills.filter(b => ledgerValid(b, now));
    let previousDefaultRate = 0;
    if (feeScore !== null && dueSoon.length) {
      previousDefaultRate = Math.max(...dueSoon.filter(b => b.totalAmount > 0).map(b => feeFeatures(b, validBills, now)[1]), 0);
      feeScore = clamp(feeScore + previousDefaultRate * 40, 0, 100);
    }
    // Apply the trained model only at the same seven-days-before-due horizon used in training.
    const modelBills = dueSoon.filter(b => ledgerValid(b, now) && b.dueDate && Math.abs(b.dueDate.getTime() - now.getTime() - 7 * DAY) <= DAY);
    const useFeeModel = !!feeModel.predict && modelBills.length > 0 && overdue.length === 0;
    if (useFeeModel) feeScore = Math.max(...modelBills.map(b => feeModel.predict!(feeFeatures(b, validBills, now)) * 100));
    const feeEvidence = [`${overdue.length} overdue invoice(s); oldest is ${oldestDays} days past due.`];
    if (previousDefaultRate > 0) feeEvidence.push(`${Math.round(previousDefaultRate * 100)}% of earlier matured invoices still had an unpaid balance 30 days after their due date.`);
    if (feeScore === null) feeEvidence.push('No outstanding invoice with a due date in the next 30 days; default risk cannot be assessed.');
    if (bills.some(b => !ledgerValid(b, now))) feeEvidence.push('Some payment ledgers do not reconcile; those invoices are excluded from model training.');
    if (useFeeModel) feeEvidence.push('School model estimates an unpaid balance 30 days after the due date.');
    const feeRisk = assessment(feeScore, feeEvidence, ['Review the payment ledger with the accounts team.', 'Discuss a payment plan or fee support with the guardian.'], useFeeModel);

    const dropoutEvidence = [`${attendanceDays} attendance days recorded in the last 90 days.`];
    if (attendanceRate !== null) dropoutEvidence.push(`Attendance: ${attendanceRate.toFixed(1)}%; ${absenceStreak} most recent recorded days fully absent.`);
    if (!attendanceKnown) dropoutEvidence.push('At least 10 recorded days and an attendance update within 21 days are required.');
    const dropoutScore = attendanceKnown ? clamp((100 - attendanceRate!) * 2 + Math.min(absenceStreak, 5) * 8 +
      (academic && academic.slope < -5 ? 10 : 0), 0, 100) : null;
    const dropoutRisk = assessment(dropoutScore, dropoutEvidence, ['Ask the class teacher to check attendance context.', 'Arrange a supportive student and guardian check-in.']);
    const risks = [academicRisk, feeRisk, dropoutRisk];
    const scores = risks.map(r => r.score).filter((s): s is number => s !== null);
    const priorityScore = scores.length ? Math.max(...scores) : null;
    // Unknown dimensions are not silently represented as an all-clear.
    const overall = risks.some(r => r.level === 'HIGH') ? 'HIGH' : risks.some(r => r.level === 'MODERATE') ? 'MODERATE' :
      risks.some(r => r.level === 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA') ? 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA' : 'LOW';
    return { studentId: student.id, name: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`, admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
      classId: student.currentClassId, className: student.currentClass?.name ?? 'Unassigned', overall, priorityScore,
      academic: academicRisk, feeDefault: feeRisk, dropout: dropoutRisk,
      metrics: { latestAverage: latest ? Math.round(latest.average * 10) / 10 : null,
        projectedAverage: academic ? Math.round(academic.projection * 10) / 10 : null,
        attendanceRate: attendanceKnown ? Math.round(attendanceRate! * 10) / 10 : null, attendanceDays, outstandingBalance, overdueBalance } };
  });
  profiles.sort((a, b) => (b.priorityScore ?? -1) - (a.priorityScore ?? -1) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  const classes = new Map<string, string>();
  profiles.forEach(s => { if (s.classId) classes.set(s.classId, s.className); });
  return { generatedAt: now.toISOString(), engineVersion: '1.0.0', currency,
    methodology: 'Risk indices (0–100), not calibrated probabilities or guaranteed outcomes. Academic and fee models use school-only historical data with a temporal validation gate. When history or validation is inadequate, explainable early-warning indicators are used. Dropout is an attendance-based support indicator; no trained dropout classifier is available. Default pass mark is 40% where no subject pass mark is configured. Human review is required.',
    models: { academic: academicModel.info, feeDefault: feeModel.info },
    summary: { students: profiles.length, atRisk: profiles.filter(s => ['HIGH', 'MODERATE'].includes(s.overall)).length,
      academicHigh: profiles.filter(s => s.academic.level === 'HIGH').length,
      feeDefaultHigh: profiles.filter(s => s.feeDefault.level === 'HIGH').length,
      dropoutHigh: profiles.filter(s => s.dropout.level === 'HIGH').length,
      incompleteData: profiles.filter(s => [s.academic, s.feeDefault, s.dropout].some(r => r.score === null)).length,
      overdueBalance: profiles.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.metrics.overdueBalance, 0) },
    classes: [...classes.entries()].map(([id, name]) => ({ id, name })).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)), students: profiles };
}

================
File: apps/api/src/modules/predictive-analytics/risk-model.ts
================
import { PredictiveModelInfo } from '@krypton/types';

export interface TrainingSample { features: number[]; outcome: 0 | 1; date: Date }
export const clamp = (value: number, min = 0, max = 1) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
const sigmoid = (value: number) => 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-clamp(value, -30, 30)));

/** Small, regularized logistic model. All features must be available BEFORE the outcome. */
export function trainRiskModel(samples: TrainingSample[]) {
  const info: PredictiveModelInfo = {
    status: 'INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY', samples: samples.length, validationSamples: 0,
    balancedAccuracy: null, brierScore: null,
  };
  const unavailable = () => ({ info, predict: null });
  if (samples.length < 60) return unavailable();
  const sorted = [...samples].sort((a, b) => a.date.getTime() - b.date.getTime());
  const cutoff = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.75)].date.getTime();
  // Entire dates stay together: the same examination cannot straddle the split.
  const training = sorted.filter(s => s.date.getTime() < cutoff);
  const validation = sorted.filter(s => s.date.getTime() >= cutoff);
  info.validationSamples = validation.length;
  const positives = (rows: TrainingSample[]) => rows.filter(s => s.outcome === 1).length;
  if (training.length < 40 || positives(training) < 10 || training.length - positives(training) < 10 ||
      validation.length < 15 || positives(validation) < 5 || validation.length - positives(validation) < 5) return unavailable();
  const weights = new Array(training[0].features.length + 1).fill(0) as number[];
  const predict = (features: number[]) => sigmoid(weights[0] + features.reduce((n, x, i) => n + x * weights[i + 1], 0));
  for (let epoch = 0; epoch < 500; epoch++) {
    const gradient = weights.map(() => 0);
    for (const sample of training) {
      const error = predict(sample.features) - sample.outcome;
      gradient[0] += error;
      sample.features.forEach((x, i) => { gradient[i + 1] += error * x; });
    }
    weights.forEach((w, i) => { weights[i] -= 0.2 * (gradient[i] / training.length + (i ? 0.01 * w : 0)); });
  }
  const baseRate = positives(training) / training.length;
  let tp = 0, tn = 0, brier = 0, baseline = 0;
  for (const sample of validation) {
    const prediction = predict(sample.features);
    if (sample.outcome === 1 && prediction >= 0.5) tp++;
    if (sample.outcome === 0 && prediction < 0.5) tn++;
    brier += (prediction - sample.outcome) ** 2;
    baseline += (baseRate - sample.outcome) ** 2;
  }
  const accuracy = (tp / positives(validation) + tn / (validation.length - positives(validation))) / 2;
  info.balancedAccuracy = Math.round(accuracy * 1000) / 1000;
  info.brierScore = Math.round(brier / validation.length * 1000) / 1000;
  if (accuracy < 0.6 || brier >= baseline) {
    info.status = 'VALIDATION_FAILED';
    return unavailable();
  }
  info.status = 'ACTIVE';
  // Return the temporally validated weights; do not silently retrain on the holdout.
  return { info, predict };
}

File: apps/api/src/modules/staff/staff.service.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateStaffDto } from './dto/create-staff.dto';
import { UpdateStaffDto } from './dto/update-staff.dto';
import { QueryStaffDto } from './dto/query-staff.dto';
import { StaffStatus, StaffDepartment } from '@krypton/types';

@Injectable()
export class StaffService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(StaffService.name);

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async create(dto: CreateStaffDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Check staff number uniqueness within tenant
    const existing = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        staffNumber: dto.staffNumber,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Staff member with number ${dto.staffNumber} already exists in this school`,
      );
    }

    const staff = await this.prisma.staff.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        staffNumber: dto.staffNumber,
        firstName: dto.firstName,
        lastName: dto.lastName,
        middleName: dto.middleName,
        dateOfBirth: dto.dateOfBirth ? new Date(dto.dateOfBirth) : null,
        gender: dto.gender,
        nationalId: dto.nationalId,
        email: dto.email.toLowerCase(),
        phone: dto.phone,
        alternatePhone: dto.alternatePhone,
        address: dto.address,
        department: dto.department,
        position: dto.position,
        employmentType: dto.employmentType,
        hireDate: new Date(dto.hireDate),
        isTeacher: dto.isTeacher ?? false,
        subjects: dto.subjects ? (dto.subjects as any) : undefined,
        status: dto.status || StaffStatus.ACTIVE,
        userId: dto.userId,
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(`Created staff member: ${staff.staffNumber} (${staff.id})`);
    return staff;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryStaffDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const {
      page = 1,
      pageSize = 20,
      search,
      department,
      employmentType,
      status,
      isTeacher,
      sortBy = 'createdAt',
      sortOrder = 'desc',
    } = query;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (department) where.department = department;
    if (employmentType) where.employmentType = employmentType;
    if (status) where.status = status;
    if (typeof isTeacher === 'boolean') where.isTeacher = isTeacher;

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { firstName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { lastName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { staffNumber: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { phone: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { position: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.staff.findMany({
        where,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
        orderBy: { [sortBy]: sortOrder },
      }),
      this.prisma.staff.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
      },
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const staff = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        timetableEntries: {
          include: {
            subject: true,
            class: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!staff) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Staff member with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return staff;
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateStaffDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    await this.findOne(id);

    if (dto.staffNumber) {
      const duplicate = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          staffNumber: dto.staffNumber,
          NOT: { id },
        },
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          `Staff number ${dto.staffNumber} is already in use by another staff member`,
        );
      }
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.staff.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        staffNumber: dto.staffNumber,
        firstName: dto.firstName,
        lastName: dto.lastName,
        middleName: dto.middleName,
        dateOfBirth: dto.dateOfBirth ? new Date(dto.dateOfBirth) : undefined,
        gender: dto.gender,
        nationalId: dto.nationalId,
        email: dto.email?.toLowerCase(),
        phone: dto.phone,
        alternatePhone: dto.alternatePhone,
        address: dto.address,
        department: dto.department,
        position: dto.position,
        employmentType: dto.employmentType,
        hireDate: dto.hireDate ? new Date(dto.hireDate) : undefined,
        terminationDate: dto.terminationDate
          ? new Date(dto.terminationDate)
          : undefined,
        isTeacher: dto.isTeacher,
        subjects: dto.subjects ? (dto.subjects as any) : undefined,
        status: dto.status,
        userId: dto.userId,
      },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Soft-deactivate by transitioning to TERMINATED status
    const deactivated = await this.prisma.staff.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: StaffStatus.TERMINATED,
        terminationDate: new Date(),
      },
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Staff member deactivated successfully',
      staff: deactivated,
    };
  }

  async getDepartments() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const staffMembers = await this.prisma.staff.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      select: { department: true, status: true },
    });

    const breakdown: Record<string, { total: number; active: number }> = {};
    for (const member of staffMembers) {
      if (!breakdown[member.department]) {
        breakdown[member.department] = { total: 0, active: 0 };
      }
      breakdown[member.department].total++;
      if (member.status === StaffStatus.ACTIVE) {
        breakdown[member.department].active++;
      }
    }

    return breakdown;
  }

  async getTeachingStaff() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    return this.prisma.staff.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        isTeacher: true,
        status: StaffStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        staffNumber: true,
        firstName: true,
        lastName: true,
        email: true,
        phone: true,
        department: true,
        position: true,
        subjects: true,
      },
      orderBy: { firstName: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async getStats() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [total, active, onLeave, teachers] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.staff.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
      this.prisma.staff.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: StaffStatus.ACTIVE },
      }),
      this.prisma.staff.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: StaffStatus.ON_LEAVE },
      }),
      this.prisma.staff.count({
        where: { tenantId, isTeacher: true, status: StaffStatus.ACTIVE },
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      total,
      active,
      onLeave,
      teachers,
      nonTeaching: active - teachers,
    };
  }
}

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  IsString,
  IsEmail,
  IsOptional,
  IsDateString,
  IsEnum,
  IsUUID,
  MinLength,
  MaxLength,
  Matches,
  IsArray,
  ValidateNested,
  IsBoolean,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import { Gender } from '@krypton/types';

class GuardianInfoDto {
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'Existing guardian ID (if linking existing guardian)' })
  @IsOptional()

  guardianId?: string;

================
File: apps/api/src/modules/students/students.service.ts
================
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateStudentDto } from './dto/create-student.dto';
import { UpdateStudentDto } from './dto/update-student.dto';
import { QueryStudentsDto } from './dto/query-students.dto';
import { AssignClassDto } from './dto/assign-class.dto';
import { formatFullName } from '@krypton/utils';

@Injectable()
export class StudentsService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async create(createStudentDto: CreateStudentDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Check if admission number already exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.student.findUnique({
      where: {
        tenantId_admissionNumber: {
          tenantId,
          admissionNumber: createStudentDto.admissionNumber,
        },
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Admission number ${createStudentDto.admissionNumber} already exists`
      );
    }

    // Validate class and stream if provided
    if (createStudentDto.currentClassId) {
      await this.validateClass(createStudentDto.currentClassId);
    }

    if (createStudentDto.currentStreamId) {
      await this.validateStream(createStudentDto.currentStreamId);
    }

    // Extract guardians data
    const { guardians, ...studentData } = createStudentDto;

    // Create student with guardians in a transaction
    const student = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Create student
      const newStudent = await tx.student.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          ...studentData,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        },
      });

      // Create or link guardians
      for (const guardianInfo of guardians) {
        let guardian;

        if (guardianInfo.guardianId) {
          // Link existing guardian
          guardian = await tx.guardian.findUnique({
            where: { id: guardianInfo.guardianId },
          });

          if (!guardian || guardian.tenantId !== tenantId) {
            throw new NotFoundException(`Guardian ${guardianInfo.guardianId} not found`);
          }
        } else {
          // Create new guardian
          guardian = await tx.guardian.create({
            data: {
              tenantId,
              firstName: guardianInfo.firstName,
              lastName: guardianInfo.lastName,
              middleName: guardianInfo.middleName,
              phone: guardianInfo.phone,
              email: guardianInfo.email,
              occupation: guardianInfo.occupation,
              address: guardianInfo.address,
            },
          });
        }

        // Create link
        await tx.guardianStudentLink.create({
          data: {
            guardianId: guardian.id,
            studentId: newStudent.id,
            relationship: guardianInfo.relationship as any,
            isPrimary: guardianInfo.isPrimary || false,
            canPickup: true,
            receiveUpdates: true,
          },
        });
      }

      // Return student with guardians
      return tx.student.findUnique({
        where: { id: newStudent.id },
        include: {
          currentClass: {
            select: { id: true, name: true, level: true },
          },
          currentStream: {
            select: { id: true, name: true },
          },
          guardianLinks: {
            include: {
              guardian: {
                select: {
                  id: true,
                  firstName: true,
                  lastName: true,
                  phone: true,
                  email: true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      });
    });

    return student;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryStudentsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { page = 1, pageSize = 20, search, sortBy = 'createdAt', sortOrder = 'desc', ...filters } = query;

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    // Build where clause
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { firstName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { lastName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { admissionNumber: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    if (filters.classId) {
      where.currentClassId = filters.classId;
    }

    if (filters.streamId) {
      where.currentStreamId = filters.streamId;
    }

    if (filters.status) {
      where.status = filters.status;
    }

    if (filters.gender) {
      where.gender = filters.gender;
    }

    // Get total count
    const total = await this.prisma.student.count({ where });

    // Get students
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where,
      skip,
      take: pageSize,
      orderBy: { [sortBy]: sortOrder },
      include: {
        currentClass: {
          select: { id: true, name: true, level: true },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
        guardianLinks: {
          where: { isPrimary: true },
          take: 1,
          include: {
            guardian: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                phone: true,
                email: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

    return {
      data: students,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages,
        hasNextPage: page < totalPages,
        hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: {
        id,
        tenantId,
        deletedAt: null,
      },
      include: {
        currentClass: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            level: true,
            educationLevel: true,
          },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            capacity: true,
          },
        },
        guardianLinks: {
          include: {
            guardian: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                middleName: true,
                phone: true,
                alternatePhone: true,
                email: true,
                occupation: true,
                address: true,
              },
            },
          },
          orderBy: {
            isPrimary: 'desc',
          },
        },
        enrollments: {
          orderBy: {
            createdAt: 'desc',
          },
          take: 5,
          include: {
            class: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
            stream: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Student with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return student;
  }

  async update(id: string, updateStudentDto: UpdateStudentDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Validate class and stream if provided
    if (updateStudentDto.currentClassId) {
      await this.validateClass(updateStudentDto.currentClassId);
    }

    if (updateStudentDto.currentStreamId) {
      await this.validateStream(updateStudentDto.currentStreamId);
    }

    const student = await this.prisma.student.update({
      where: { id },
      data: updateStudentDto,
      include: {
        currentClass: {
          select: { id: true, name: true, level: true },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return student;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Soft delete
    await this.prisma.student.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        status: 'WITHDRAWN',
      },
    });

    return { message: 'Student deleted successfully' };
  }

  async assignClass(id: string, assignClassDto: AssignClassDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student exists
    const student = await this.findOne(id);

    // Validate class
    await this.validateClass(assignClassDto.classId);

    // Validate stream if provided
    if (assignClassDto.streamId) {
      await this.validateStream(assignClassDto.streamId);

      // Verify stream belongs to class
      const stream = await this.prisma.stream.findUnique({
        where: { id: assignClassDto.streamId },
      });

      if (stream?.classId !== assignClassDto.classId) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Stream does not belong to the specified class');
      }
    }

    // Update student
    const updated = await this.prisma.student.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        currentClassId: assignClassDto.classId,
        currentStreamId: assignClassDto.streamId || null,
      },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        currentStream: true,
      },
    });

    const currentYear = (await this.prisma.academicYear.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId, isCurrent: true },
    })) || (await this.prisma.academicYear.findFirst({ where: { tenantId } }));

    if (currentYear) {
      // Create enrollment record
      await this.prisma.enrollment.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          studentId: id,
          academicYearId: currentYear.id,
          classId: assignClassDto.classId,
          streamId: assignClassDto.streamId,
          enrollmentDate: new Date(),
        },
      });
    }

    return updated;
  }

  async getGuardians(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        guardianLinks: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
          },
          orderBy: {
            isPrimary: 'desc',
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Student with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return student.guardianLinks;
  }

  async getStats() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [total, active, graduated, transferred, withdrawn] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'ACTIVE', deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'GRADUATED', deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'TRANSFERRED', deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'WITHDRAWN', deletedAt: null },
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      total,
      active,
      graduated,
      transferred,
      withdrawn,
      byStatus: {
        ACTIVE: active,
        GRADUATED: graduated,
        TRANSFERRED: transferred,
        WITHDRAWN: withdrawn,
      },
    };
  }

  private async validateClass(classId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Class with ID ${classId} not found`);
    }

    return classExists;
  }

  private async validateStream(streamId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const streamExists = await this.prisma.stream.findFirst({
      where: { id: streamId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!streamExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Stream with ID ${streamId} not found`);
    }

    return streamExists;
  }

  async resolveStudentForUser(user: any) {
    const tenantId = user.tenantId || this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const student =
      (await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          deletedAt: null,
          OR: [{ email: user.email }, { id: user.id }],
        },
        include: {
          currentClass: true,
          currentStream: true,
        },
      })) ||
      (await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
        where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null },
        include: { currentClass: true, currentStream: true },
      }));

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student profile not found');
    }
    return student;
  }

  async getMyChildren(user: any) {
    const tenantId = user.tenantId || this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.findFirst({
      where: { tenantId, email: user.email },
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              include: { currentClass: true, currentStream: true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (guardian && guardian.studentLinks && guardian.studentLinks.length > 0) {
      return guardian.studentLinks.map((link) => ({
        id: link.student.id,
        firstName: link.student.firstName,
        lastName: link.student.lastName,
        admissionNumber: link.student.admissionNumber,
        class: link.student.currentClass
          ? { name: link.student.currentClass.name }
          : { name: 'Class' },
        stream: link.student.currentStream
          ? { name: link.student.currentStream.name }
          : null,
      }));
    }

    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null },
      include: { currentClass: true, currentStream: true },
      take: 5,
    });
    return students.map((s) => ({
      id: s.id,
      firstName: s.firstName,
      lastName: s.lastName,
      admissionNumber: s.admissionNumber,
      class: s.currentClass
        ? { name: s.currentClass.name }
        : { name: 'Class' },
      stream: s.currentStream ? { name: s.currentStream.name } : null,
    }));
  }

  async getMe(user: any) {
    const student = await this.resolveStudentForUser(user);
    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({
      where: { id: student.tenantId },
      select: { name: true },
    });
    return {
      ...student,
      class: student.currentClass
        ? { id: student.currentClass.id, name: student.currentClass.name }
        : { id: 'c1', name: 'Class' },
      stream: student.currentStream
        ? { id: student.currentStream.id, name: student.currentStream.name }
        : null,
      school: tenant?.name || 'School',
    };
  }

  async getMeDashboard(user: any) {
    const student = await this.getMe(user);
    const timetable = await this.getMeTimetable(user);
    const attendance = await this.getMeAttendance(user);
    const grades = await this.getMeGrades(user);
    const assignments = await this.getMeAssignments(user);
    const announcements = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: student.tenantId, startDate: { gte: new Date() } },
      orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
      take: 5,
    });

    const days = [
      'SUNDAY',
      'MONDAY',
      'TUESDAY',
      'WEDNESDAY',
      'THURSDAY',
      'FRIDAY',
      'SATURDAY',
    ];
    const todayName = days[new Date().getDay()] || 'MONDAY';
    const daySchedule = timetable.schedule.filter(
      (s: any) => s.day === todayName || s.day === 'MONDAY',
    );

    return {
      student,
      todaySchedule:
        daySchedule.length > 0 ? daySchedule : timetable.schedule.slice(0, 5),
      attendance: attendance.summary,
      recentGrades: grades.recentAssessments.slice(0, 4),
      pendingAssignments: assignments.pending.slice(0, 3),
      announcements: announcements.map((a) => ({
        id: a.id,
        title: a.title,
        content: a.description || a.title,
        date: a.startDate.toISOString(),
        category: a.category || 'School Event',
        priority: 'NORMAL',
      })),
    };
  }

  async getMeTimetable(user: any) {
    const student = await this.resolveStudentForUser(user);
    let entries: any[] = [];
    if (student.currentClassId) {
      entries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
        where: { tenantId: student.tenantId, classId: student.currentClassId },
        include: { subject: true, teacher: true },
        orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
      });
    }

    const dayNames = [
      'MONDAY',
      'TUESDAY',
      'WEDNESDAY',
      'THURSDAY',
      'FRIDAY',
      'SATURDAY',
      'SUNDAY',
    ];
    return {
      className: student.currentClass?.name,
      streamName: student.currentStream?.name,
      schedule: entries.map((e) => ({
        id: e.id,
        day: dayNames[e.dayOfWeek - 1] || 'MONDAY',
        period: e.period,
        startTime: e.startTime,
        endTime: e.endTime,
        subject: e.subject?.name || 'Subject',
        teacher: e.teacher
          ? `${e.teacher.firstName} ${e.teacher.lastName}`
          : 'Teacher',
        room: e.room || 'Classroom',
      })),
    };
  }

  async getMeAttendance(user: any) {
    const student = await this.resolveStudentForUser(user);
    const records = await this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: student.tenantId, studentId: student.id },
      orderBy: { date: 'desc' },
      take: 100,
    });
    const count = (status: string) =>
      records.filter((r) => r.status === status).length;
    return {
      records,
      summary: {
        totalDays: records.length,
        presentDays: count('PRESENT'),
        lateDays: count('LATE'),
        absentDays: count('ABSENT'),
        excusedDays: count('EXCUSED'),
        attendanceRate: records.length
          ? Math.round(
              ((count('PRESENT') + count('LATE')) / records.length) * 100,
            )
          : 100,
      },
    };
  }

  async getMeGrades(user: any) {
    const student = await this.resolveStudentForUser(user);
    const rows = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId: student.tenantId,
        studentId: student.id,
        examination: { isPublished: true },
      },
      include: { subject: true, examination: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
    return {
      subjects: rows.map((g) => ({
        id: g.subjectId,
        name: g.subject.name,
        code: g.subject.code,
        score: g.score,
        percentage: g.percentage,
        gradeLetter: g.letterGrade,
        level: g.competencyLevel,
      })),
      recentAssessments: rows.map((g) => ({
        id: g.id,
        subject: g.subject.name,
        exam: g.examination.name,
        score: g.score,
        total: g.totalMarks,
        grade: g.letterGrade,
        level: g.competencyLevel,
      })),
    };
  }

  async getMeReportCards(user: any) {
    const student = await this.resolveStudentForUser(user);
    const reportCards = await this.prisma.reportCard.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId: student.tenantId,
        studentId: student.id,
        status: 'PUBLISHED',
      },
      include: { term: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
    return { reportCards };
  }

  async getMeAssignments(user: any) {
    return {
      pending: [
        {
          id: 'asg-1',
          title: 'Mathematics CBC Practice Task',
          subject: 'Mathematics',
          assignedDate: new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toISOString(),
          dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000 * 2).toISOString(),
          description: 'Complete word problems exercise in workbook page 45.',
          status: 'PENDING',
          maxMarks: 20,
          teacher: 'Class Teacher',
        },
      ],
      completed: [],
    };
  }

  async getMeMaterials(user: any) {
    const student = await this.resolveStudentForUser(user);
    const borrowings = await this.prisma.bookBorrowing.findMany({
      where: { tenantId: student.tenantId, borrowerId: student.id },
      include: { book: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 10,
    });
    return {
      curriculumMaterials: [
        {
          id: 'mat-1',
          title: 'CBC Curriculum Guide & Reference Notes',
          subject: 'General',
          type: 'PDF',
          size: '2.5 MB',
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          downloadUrl: '#',
        },
      ],
      borrowedBooks: borrowings.map((b) => ({
        id: b.id,
        title: b.book.title,
        author: b.book.author,
        borrowedDate: b.borrowDate.toISOString(),
        dueDate: b.dueDate.toISOString(),
        status: b.status,
      })),
    };
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Body,
  Patch,
  Param,
  Delete,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiBearerAuth,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { SubscriptionsService } from './subscriptions.service';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../../common/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../../common/guards/roles.guard';
import { TenantGuard } from '../../common/guards/tenant.guard';
import { Roles } from '../../common/decorators/roles.decorator';
import { SkipTenantCheck } from '../../common/decorators/skip-tenant-check.decorator';
import { UserRole as Role } from '@krypton/types';
import {
  CreateSubscriptionDto,
  UpdateSubscriptionDto,
  RenewSubscriptionDto,
  CancelSubscriptionDto,
  UpdateUsageDto,
  QuerySubscriptionsDto,
} from './dto/subscription.dto';
import { CreatePlanDto, UpdatePlanDto } from './dto/plan.dto';

@ApiTags('Subscriptions & Plans')
@ApiBearerAuth()
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard, TenantGuard)
@Controller('subscriptions')
export class SubscriptionsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly subscriptionsService: SubscriptionsService,
    private readonly tenantService: any, // Will be injected properly in module
  ) {}

  // ==================== SUBSCRIPTION ENDPOINTS ====================

  @Post()
  @Roles(Role.SUPER_ADMIN)
  @SkipTenantCheck()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new subscription for a tenant' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Subscription created successfully',
  })
  async create(@Body() dto: CreateSubscriptionDto) {
    return this.subscriptionsService.createSubscription(dto);
  }

  @Get()
  @Roles(Role.SUPER_ADMIN)
  @SkipTenantCheck()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get all subscriptions with filters' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Subscriptions retrieved successfully',
  })
  async findAll(@Query() query: QuerySubscriptionsDto) {
    return this.subscriptionsService.findAll(query);
  }

  @Get('stats')
  @Roles(Role.SUPER_ADMIN)
  @SkipTenantCheck()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get subscription statistics and MRR' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Statistics retrieved successfully',
  })
  async getStats() {
    return this.subscriptionsService.getSubscriptionStats();
  }

  @Get('expiring')
  @Roles(Role.SUPER_ADMIN)
  @SkipTenantCheck()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get subscriptions expiring soon' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Expiring subscriptions retrieved',
  })
  async getExpiring(@Query('days') days?: number) {
    return this.subscriptionsService.checkExpiring(days);
  }

  @Post('process-expired')
  @Roles(Role.SUPER_ADMIN)
  @SkipTenantCheck()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Process and mark expired subscriptions' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Expired subscriptions processed',
  })
  async processExpired() {
    return this.subscriptionsService.processExpiredSubscriptions();
  }

  @Get('my-subscription')
  @Roles(
    Role.PRINCIPAL,
    Role.DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL,
    Role.SCHOOL_ADMIN,
  )
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get current school subscription' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: 'Subscription retrieved successfully',
  })

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ForbiddenException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  CreateSubscriptionDto,
  UpdateSubscriptionDto,
  RenewSubscriptionDto,
  CancelSubscriptionDto,
  UpdateUsageDto,
  QuerySubscriptionsDto,
  SubscriptionStatus,
} from './dto/subscription.dto';
import { CreatePlanDto, UpdatePlanDto } from './dto/plan.dto';
import { formatCurrency } from '@krypton/utils';

@Injectable()
export class SubscriptionsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SubscriptionsService.name);

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== SUBSCRIPTION MANAGEMENT ====================

  async createSubscription(dto: CreateSubscriptionDto) {
    // Validate tenant exists
    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({
      where: { id: dto.tenantId },
      include: { subscription: true },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Tenant not found');
    }

    if (tenant.subscription) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Tenant already has a subscription');
    }

    // Validate plan exists
    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id: dto.planId },
    });

    if (!plan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    if (!plan.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Plan is not available');
    }

    // Calculate dates
    const startDate = dto.startDate ? new Date(dto.startDate) : new Date();
    const trialEndsAt = new Date(startDate);
    trialEndsAt.setDate(trialEndsAt.getDate() + plan.trialDays);

    const endDate = new Date(trialEndsAt);
    if (plan.billingCycle === 'ANNUAL') {
      endDate.setFullYear(endDate.getFullYear() + 1);
    } else {
      endDate.setMonth(endDate.getMonth() + 1);
    }

    // Create subscription
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.create({
      data: {
        tenantId: dto.tenantId,
        planId: dto.planId,
        status: SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL,
        startDate,
        endDate,
        trialEndsAt,
        autoRenew: dto.autoRenew !== false,
        paymentMethod: dto.paymentMethod,
        smsCredits: plan.smsCredits,
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            subdomain: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription created for tenant ${tenant.name} (${plan.name} plan)`,
    );

    return subscription;
  }

  async findAll(query: QuerySubscriptionsDto) {
    const where: any = {};

    if (query.status) {
      where.status = query.status;
    }

    if (query.planId) {
      where.planId = query.planId;
    }

    if (!query.includeExpired) {
      where.status = { not: SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED };
    }

    const subscriptions = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            subdomain: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return subscriptions;
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            subdomain: true,
            contactEmail: true,
            contactPhone: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    return subscription;
  }

  async findByTenant(tenantId: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: {
        plan: true,
      },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No subscription found for this tenant');
    }

    return subscription;
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateSubscriptionDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    // If changing plan (upgrade/downgrade)
    if (dto.planId && dto.planId !== existing.planId) {
      return this.changePlan(id, dto.planId);
    }

    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.autoRenew !== undefined && { autoRenew: dto.autoRenew }),
        ...(dto.paymentMethod && { paymentMethod: dto.paymentMethod }),
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true, subdomain: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return subscription;
  }

  async changePlan(subscriptionId: string, newPlanId: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id: subscriptionId },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    const newPlan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id: newPlanId },
    });

    if (!newPlan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('New plan not found');
    }

    if (!newPlan.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException('New plan is not available');
    }

    // Calculate proration if mid-cycle
    const now = new Date();
    const isUpgrade = newPlan.price > subscription.plan.price;

    // Update subscription
    const updated = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id: subscriptionId },
      data: {
        planId: newPlanId,
        smsCredits: newPlan.smsCredits, // Reset SMS credits on plan change
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription ${subscriptionId} changed from ${subscription.plan.name} to ${newPlan.name}`,
    );

    return {
      subscription: updated,
      isUpgrade,
      priceDifference: newPlan.price - subscription.plan.price,
    };
  }

  async renew(id: string, dto: RenewSubscriptionDto) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    // Calculate new end date
    const currentEnd = new Date(subscription.endDate);
    const newEndDate = new Date(currentEnd);

    if (subscription.plan.billingCycle === 'ANNUAL') {
      newEndDate.setFullYear(newEndDate.getFullYear() + 1);
    } else {
      newEndDate.setMonth(newEndDate.getMonth() + 1);
    }

    const paymentDate = dto.paymentDate
      ? new Date(dto.paymentDate)
      : new Date();

    // Update subscription
    const renewed = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE,
        endDate: newEndDate,
        lastPaymentDate: paymentDate,
        nextPaymentDate: newEndDate,
        smsCredits: { increment: subscription.plan.smsCredits }, // Add monthly credits
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription ${id} renewed until ${newEndDate.toISOString()}`,
    );

    return renewed;
  }

  async cancel(id: string, dto: CancelSubscriptionDto) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    if (subscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.CANCELLED) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Subscription is already cancelled');
    }

    const cancelDate = dto.immediate ? new Date() : subscription.endDate;

    const cancelled = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: SubscriptionStatus.CANCELLED,
        autoRenew: false,
        ...(dto.immediate && { endDate: cancelDate }),
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription ${id} cancelled. Reason: ${dto.reason}. Immediate: ${dto.immediate}`,
    );

    return {
      subscription: cancelled,
      effectiveDate: cancelDate,
      reason: dto.reason,
    };
  }

  async updateUsage(tenantId: string, dto: UpdateUsageDto) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No subscription found for this tenant');
    }

    // Check limits
    if (dto.studentCount && dto.studentCount > subscription.plan.maxStudents) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Student count ${dto.studentCount} exceeds plan limit of ${subscription.plan.maxStudents}`,
      );
    }

    if (dto.staffCount && dto.staffCount > subscription.plan.maxStaff) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Staff count ${dto.staffCount} exceeds plan limit of ${subscription.plan.maxStaff}`,
      );
    }

    if (dto.storageUsedMB && dto.storageUsedMB > subscription.plan.maxStorageMB) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Storage usage ${dto.storageUsedMB}MB exceeds plan limit of ${subscription.plan.maxStorageMB}MB`,
      );
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { tenantId },
      data: {
        ...(dto.studentCount !== undefined && {
          studentCount: dto.studentCount,
        }),
        ...(dto.staffCount !== undefined && { staffCount: dto.staffCount }),
        ...(dto.storageUsedMB !== undefined && {
          storageUsedMB: dto.storageUsedMB,
        }),
        ...(dto.smsCredits !== undefined && { smsCredits: dto.smsCredits }),
      },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async checkLimits(tenantId: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No subscription found for this tenant');
    }

    const withinLimits = {
      students:
        subscription.studentCount <= subscription.plan.maxStudents,
      staff: subscription.staffCount <= subscription.plan.maxStaff,
      storage:
        subscription.storageUsedMB <= subscription.plan.maxStorageMB,
      sms: subscription.smsCredits > 0,
    };

    const allWithinLimits = Object.values(withinLimits).every((v) => v);

    return {
      withinLimits: allWithinLimits,
      details: {
        students: {
          used: subscription.studentCount,
          limit: subscription.plan.maxStudents,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.students,
          percentUsed: Math.round(
            (subscription.studentCount / subscription.plan.maxStudents) * 100,
          ),
        },
        staff: {
          used: subscription.staffCount,
          limit: subscription.plan.maxStaff,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.staff,
          percentUsed: Math.round(
            (subscription.staffCount / subscription.plan.maxStaff) * 100,
          ),
        },
        storage: {
          used: subscription.storageUsedMB,
          limit: subscription.plan.maxStorageMB,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.storage,
          percentUsed: Math.round(
            (subscription.storageUsedMB / subscription.plan.maxStorageMB) * 100,
          ),
        },
        sms: {
          remaining: subscription.smsCredits,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.sms,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  async checkExpiring(days: number = 30) {
    const futureDate = new Date();
    futureDate.setDate(futureDate.getDate() + days);

    const expiring = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL, SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE] },
        endDate: {
          lte: futureDate,
        },
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            contactEmail: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { endDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return expiring;
  }

  async processExpiredSubscriptions() {
    const now = new Date();

    const expired = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL, SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE] },
        endDate: { lte: now },
      },
    });

    const results = {
      processed: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const subscription of expired) {
      try {
        await this.prisma.subscription.update({
          where: { id: subscription.id },
          data: { status: SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED },
        });
        results.processed++;
      } catch (error: any) {
        results.errors.push({
          subscriptionId: subscription.id,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `Processed ${results.processed} expired subscriptions`,
    );

    return results;
  }

  // ==================== PLAN MANAGEMENT ====================

  async createPlan(dto: CreatePlanDto) {
    // Check if slug already exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { slug: dto.slug },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Plan slug already exists');
    }

    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.create({
      data: {
        name: dto.name,
        slug: dto.slug,
        description: dto.description,
        price: dto.price,
        billingCycle: dto.billingCycle || 'ANNUAL',
        trialDays: dto.trialDays || 14,
        maxStudents: dto.maxStudents,
        maxStaff: dto.maxStaff,
        maxStorageMB: dto.maxStorageMB || 10000,
        smsCredits: dto.smsCredits || 1000,
        features: dto.features,
        sortOrder: dto.sortOrder || 0,
      },
    });

    return plan;
  }

  async findAllPlans(activeOnly: boolean = false) {
    const where: any = {};

    if (activeOnly) {
      where.isActive = true;
    }

    const plans = await this.prisma.plan.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: [{ sortOrder: 'asc' }, { price: 'asc' }],
      include: {
        _count: {
          select: { subscriptions: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return plans;
  }

  async findOnePlan(id: string) {
    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        _count: {
          select: { subscriptions: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!plan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    return plan;
  }

  async updatePlan(id: string, dto: UpdatePlanDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.update({
      where: { id },
      data: dto,
    });

    return plan;
  }

  async deletePlan(id: string) {
    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        _count: {
          select: { subscriptions: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!plan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    if (plan._count.subscriptions > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Cannot delete plan with active subscriptions. Deactivate it instead.',
      );
    }

    await this.prisma.plan.delete({ where: { id } });

    return { success: true, message: 'Plan deleted' };
  }

  async getSubscriptionStats() {
    const [total, active, trial, expired, cancelled] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.subscription.count(),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE },
      }),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL },
      }),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED },
      }),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.CANCELLED },
      }),
    ]);

    // Calculate MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue)
    const activeSubscriptions = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    let mrr = 0;
    for (const sub of activeSubscriptions) {
      if (sub.plan.billingCycle === 'ANNUAL') {
        mrr += sub.plan.price / 12; // Convert annual to monthly
      } else {
        mrr += sub.plan.price;
      }
    }

    return {
      total,
      active,
      trial,
      expired,
      cancelled,
      mrr: Math.round(mrr), // in minor units
      mrrFormatted: formatCurrency(mrr),
    };
  }
}

import { BadGatewayException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AIQuestion } from '@krypton/types';

export const objectSchema = (properties: Record<string, unknown>) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required: Object.keys(properties), additionalProperties: false });
export const stringSchema = { type: 'string' };
export const stringListSchema = { type: 'array', items: stringSchema };
const invalid = (): never => { throw new BadGatewayException('AI returned an invalid teaching draft. Please generate again.'); };
export function aiObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return invalid();
  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
}
export function aiText(value: unknown, max = 2000): string {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim() || value.length > max) return invalid();
  return value.trim();
}
export function aiList(value: unknown, max = 6): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > max) return invalid();
  return value.map(v => aiText(v, 500));
}
export function keyedItems(value: unknown, key: string, expected: string[]): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const items = aiObject(value)[key];
  if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length !== expected.length) return invalid();
  const result = items.map(aiObject);
  const keys = result.map(item => aiText(item.key, 20));
  if (new Set(keys).size !== expected.length || keys.some(k => !expected.includes(k))) return invalid();
  return result;
}
export function questionPaper(value: unknown, requested: string) {
  const paper = aiObject(value);
  if (!Array.isArray(paper.questions) || paper.questions.length !== 10) return invalid();
  const questions: AIQuestion[] = paper.questions.map(value => {
    const q = aiObject(value), type = q.type;
    if (!['MCQ', 'SHORT_ANSWER'].includes(String(type)) || (requested !== 'MIXED' && type !== requested)) return invalid();
    const options = aiList(q.options, 4), answer = aiText(q.answer, 1500);
    if (type === 'MCQ' && (options.length !== 4 || new Set(options).size !== 4 || !options.includes(answer))) return invalid();
    if (type === 'SHORT_ANSWER' && options.length) return invalid();
    if (typeof q.marks !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(q.marks) || q.marks < 1 || q.marks > 10) return invalid();
    return { type: type as AIQuestion['type'], question: aiText(q.question, 1000), options, answer, explanation: aiText(q.explanation, 1500), marks: q.marks };
  });
  if (new Set(questions.map(q => q.question.toLowerCase())).size !== 10) return invalid();
  if (requested === 'MIXED' && new Set(questions.map(q => q.type)).size !== 2) return invalid();
  return { title: aiText(paper.title, 200), instructions: aiText(paper.instructions, 1000), questions, warnings: aiList(paper.warnings) };
}
