import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  CreateTimetableEntryDto,
  UpdateTimetableEntryDto,
  BulkCreateTimetableDto,
  QueryTimetableDto,
} from './dto/create-timetable-entry.dto';
import { AutoGenerateTimetableDto } from './dto/auto-generate-timetable.dto';
import {
  CreateSchoolEventDto,
  UpdateSchoolEventDto,
  QuerySchoolEventsDto,
} from './dto/create-school-event.dto';

@Injectable()
export class TimetableService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== TIMETABLE ENTRIES ====================

  async createEntry(dto: CreateTimetableEntryDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate class exists
    const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
    }

    // Validate stream if provided
    if (dto.streamId) {
      const streamExists = await this.prisma.stream.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.streamId, tenantId, classId: dto.classId },
      });

      if (!streamExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Stream not found or does not belong to class');
      }
    }

    // Validate subject exists
    const subjectExists = await this.prisma.subject.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.subjectId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!subjectExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subject not found');
    }

    // Validate teacher exists
    const teacherExists = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.teacherId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!teacherExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Teacher not found');
    }

    // Validate time order
    if (dto.startTime >= dto.endTime) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Start time must be before end time');
    }

    // Check for conflicts
    await this.checkConflicts(
      dto.classId,
      dto.streamId,
      dto.teacherId,
      dto.dayOfWeek,
      dto.period,
      dto.startTime,
      dto.endTime,
      dto.room,
    );

    // Create entry
    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        classId: dto.classId,
        streamId: dto.streamId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
        teacherId: dto.teacherId,
        dayOfWeek: dto.dayOfWeek,
        period: dto.period,
        startTime: dto.startTime,
        endTime: dto.endTime,
        room: dto.room,
      },
      include: {
        class: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        subject: {
          select: { name: true, code: true },
        },
        teacher: {
          select: { firstName: true, lastName: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return entry;
  }

  async bulkCreate(dto: BulkCreateTimetableDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const results = {
      success: 0,
      failed: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const entryDto of dto.entries) {
      try {
        await this.createEntry(entryDto);
        results.success++;
      } catch (error: any) {
        results.failed++;
        results.errors.push({
          entry: entryDto,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryTimetableDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (query.classId) where.classId = query.classId;
    if (query.streamId) where.streamId = query.streamId;
    if (query.teacherId) where.teacherId = query.teacherId;
    if (query.dayOfWeek) where.dayOfWeek = query.dayOfWeek;

    const entries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        class: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        subject: {
          select: { name: true, code: true },
        },
        teacher: {
          select: { firstName: true, lastName: true },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
    });

    return entries;
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        class: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        subject: {
          select: { name: true, code: true },
        },
        teacher: {
          select: { firstName: true, lastName: true, email: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!entry) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Timetable entry not found');
    }

    return entry;
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateTimetableEntryDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const existing = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Timetable entry not found');
    }

    // Validate subject if changed
    if (dto.subjectId) {
      const subjectExists = await this.prisma.subject.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.subjectId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!subjectExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Subject not found');
      }
    }

    // Validate teacher if changed
    if (dto.teacherId) {
      const teacherExists = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.teacherId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!teacherExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Teacher not found');
      }
    }

    // Validate time order if times are being updated
    const startTime = dto.startTime || existing.startTime;
    const endTime = dto.endTime || existing.endTime;

    if (startTime >= endTime) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Start time must be before end time');
    }

    // Check for conflicts if relevant fields changed
    if (dto.teacherId || dto.startTime || dto.endTime || dto.room) {
      await this.checkConflicts(
        existing.classId,
        existing.streamId || undefined,
        dto.teacherId || existing.teacherId,
        existing.dayOfWeek,
        existing.period,
        startTime,
        endTime,
        dto.room || existing.room || undefined,
        id, // Exclude current entry
      );
    }

    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.update({
      where: { id },
      data: dto,
      include: {
        class: { select: { name: true } },
        stream: { select: { name: true } },
        subject: { select: { name: true, code: true } },
        teacher: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
      },
    });

    return entry;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!entry) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Timetable entry not found');
    }

    await this.prisma.timetableEntry.delete({ where: { id } });

    return { success: true, message: 'Timetable entry deleted' };
  }

  async getClassTimetable(classId: string, streamId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      classId,
    };

    if (streamId) {
      where.streamId = streamId;
    }

    const entries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        subject: { select: { name: true, code: true } },
        teacher: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
      },
      orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
    });

    // Group by day of week
    const timetable = this.groupByDay(entries);

    return timetable;
  }

  async getTeacherTimetable(teacherId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const entries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, teacherId },
      include: {
        class: { select: { name: true } },
        stream: { select: { name: true } },
        subject: { select: { name: true, code: true } },
      },
      orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
    });

    const timetable = this.groupByDay(entries);

    return timetable;
  }

  private groupByDay(entries: any[]) {
    const days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];
    
    const grouped: Record<string, any[]> = {};

    for (let i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
      grouped[days[i - 1]] = entries.filter((e) => e.dayOfWeek === i);
    }

    return grouped;
  }

  private async checkConflicts(
    classId: string,
    streamId: string | undefined,
    teacherId: string,
    dayOfWeek: number,
    period: string,
    startTime: string,
    endTime: string,
    room: string | undefined,
    excludeId?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Check class/stream conflict (same period, same day)
    const classConflict = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        classId,
        ...(streamId && { streamId }),
        dayOfWeek,
        period,
        ...(excludeId && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
      },
    });

    if (classConflict) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Class/Stream already has another subject scheduled for this period`,
      );
    }

    // Check teacher conflict (overlapping time slots)
    const teacherConflicts = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        teacherId,
        dayOfWeek,
        ...(excludeId && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
      },
    });

    for (const conflict of teacherConflicts) {
      if (this.timesOverlap(startTime, endTime, conflict.startTime, conflict.endTime)) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          `Teacher already has a class scheduled during this time (${conflict.startTime} - ${conflict.endTime})`,
        );
      }
    }

    // Check room conflict if room is specified
    if (room) {
      const roomConflicts = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          room,
          dayOfWeek,
          ...(excludeId && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
        },
      });

      for (const conflict of roomConflicts) {
        if (this.timesOverlap(startTime, endTime, conflict.startTime, conflict.endTime)) {
          throw new ConflictException(
            `Room ${room} is already booked during this time (${conflict.startTime} - ${conflict.endTime})`,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private timesOverlap(
    start1: string,
    end1: string,
    start2: string,
    end2: string,
  ): boolean {
    // Convert HH:MM to minutes for comparison
    const toMinutes = (time: string) => {
      const [hours, minutes] = time.split(':').map(Number);
      return hours * 60 + minutes;
    };

    const s1 = toMinutes(start1);
    const e1 = toMinutes(end1);
    const s2 = toMinutes(start2);
    const e2 = toMinutes(end2);

    // Check if intervals overlap
    return s1 < e2 && s2 < e1;
  }

  // ==================== SCHOOL CALENDAR / EVENTS ====================

  async createEvent(dto: CreateSchoolEventDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate dates
    const startDate = new Date(dto.startDate);
    const endDate = new Date(dto.endDate);

    if (startDate > endDate) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Start date must be before or equal to end date');
    }

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        title: dto.title,
        description: dto.description,
        eventType: dto.eventType,
        category: dto.category,
        startDate,
        endDate,
        isAllDay: dto.isAllDay !== false,
        startTime: dto.startTime,
        endTime: dto.endTime,
        location: dto.location,
        isHoliday: dto.isHoliday || false,
      },
    });

    return event;
  }

  async findAllEvents(query: QuerySchoolEventsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (query.startDate) {
      where.startDate = { gte: new Date(query.startDate) };
    }

    if (query.endDate) {
      where.endDate = { lte: new Date(query.endDate) };
    }

    if (query.eventType) {
      where.eventType = query.eventType;
    }

    if (query.category) {
      where.category = query.category;
    }

    if (query.holidaysOnly) {
      where.isHoliday = true;
    }

    const events = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return events;
  }

  async findOneEvent(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundException('School event not found');
    }

    return event;
  }

  async updateEvent(id: string, dto: UpdateSchoolEventDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const existing = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('School event not found');
    }

    // Validate dates if both are being updated
    if (dto.startDate && dto.endDate) {
      const startDate = new Date(dto.startDate);
      const endDate = new Date(dto.endDate);

      if (startDate > endDate) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Start date must be before or equal to end date');
      }
    }

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.title && { title: dto.title }),
        ...(dto.description !== undefined && { description: dto.description }),
        ...(dto.eventType && { eventType: dto.eventType }),
        ...(dto.category && { category: dto.category }),
        ...(dto.startDate && { startDate: new Date(dto.startDate) }),
        ...(dto.endDate && { endDate: new Date(dto.endDate) }),
        ...(dto.isAllDay !== undefined && { isAllDay: dto.isAllDay }),
        ...(dto.startTime !== undefined && { startTime: dto.startTime }),
        ...(dto.endTime !== undefined && { endTime: dto.endTime }),
        ...(dto.location !== undefined && { location: dto.location }),
        ...(dto.isHoliday !== undefined && { isHoliday: dto.isHoliday }),
      },
    });

    return event;
  }

  async removeEvent(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundException('School event not found');
    }

    await this.prisma.schoolEvent.delete({ where: { id } });

    return { success: true, message: 'School event deleted' };
  }

  async getUpcomingEvents(days: number = 30) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const today = new Date();
    const futureDate = new Date();
    futureDate.setDate(today.getDate() + days);

    const events = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        startDate: {
          gte: today,
          lte: futureDate,
        },
      },
      orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return events;
  }

  async getHolidays(year?: number) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const currentYear = year || new Date().getFullYear();
    const startDate = new Date(`${currentYear}-01-01`);
    const endDate = new Date(`${currentYear}-12-31`);

    const holidays = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        isHoliday: true,
        startDate: { gte: startDate },
        endDate: { lte: endDate },
      },
      orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return holidays;
  }

  // ==================== AUTO GENERATOR & CONFLICT AUDIT ====================

  async autoGenerateTimetable(dto: AutoGenerateTimetableDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const startTime = Date.now();

    const classes = await this.prisma.class.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: { streams: true },
      take: 20,
    });

    const subjects = await this.prisma.subject.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      take: 20,
    });

    const teachers = await this.prisma.staff.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      take: 30,
    });

    const daysCount = dto.daysPerWeek || 5;
    const periodsCount = dto.periodsPerDay || 8;
    const maxTeacherDaily = dto.maxTeacherDailyPeriods || 5;

    // Standard period timing table
    const periodTimes = [
      { period: '1', start: '08:30', end: '09:15' },
      { period: '2', start: '09:15', end: '10:00' },
      { period: '3', start: '10:15', end: '11:00' },
      { period: '4', start: '11:00', end: '11:45' },
      { period: '5', start: '12:30', end: '13:15' },
      { period: '6', start: '13:15', end: '14:00' },
      { period: '7', start: '14:00', end: '14:45' },
      { period: '8', start: '14:45', end: '15:30' },
    ];

    const generatedEntries: any[] = [];
    const teacherBusy = new Set<string>();
    const classBusy = new Set<string>();
    const roomBusy = new Set<string>();
    const teacherDailyLoad = new Map<string, number>();

    const getSlotKey = (day: number, period: string) => `${day}-${period}`;

    // Generate conflict-free schedule across classes
    for (let cIdx = 0; cIdx < classes.length; cIdx++) {
      const cls = classes[cIdx];
      const classRoom = `Room ${101 + cIdx}`;

      for (let day = 1; day <= daysCount; day++) {
        for (let pIdx = 0; pIdx < periodsCount; pIdx++) {
          const pMeta = periodTimes[pIdx] || { period: String(pIdx + 1), start: '08:30', end: '09:15' };
          const slotKey = getSlotKey(day, pMeta.period);

          // Find available subject & teacher
          let assigned = false;
          for (let sIdx = 0; sIdx < subjects.length; sIdx++) {
            const subj = subjects[(sIdx + pIdx + day) % subjects.length];
            const teacher = teachers[(sIdx + cIdx) % teachers.length];

            if (!teacher) continue;

            const teacherKey = `${teacher.id}-${slotKey}`;
            const classKey = `${cls.id}-${slotKey}`;
            const roomKey = `${classRoom}-${slotKey}`;

            const tDayKey = `${teacher.id}-${day}`;
            const currentTLoad = teacherDailyLoad.get(tDayKey) || 0;

            if (
              !teacherBusy.has(teacherKey) &&
              !classBusy.has(classKey) &&
              !roomBusy.has(roomKey) &&
              currentTLoad < maxTeacherDaily
            ) {
              teacherBusy.add(teacherKey);
              classBusy.add(classKey);
              roomBusy.add(roomKey);
              teacherDailyLoad.set(tDayKey, currentTLoad + 1);

              generatedEntries.push({
                classId: cls.id,
                className: cls.name,
                subjectId: subj.id,
                subjectName: subj.name,
                teacherId: teacher.id,
                teacherName: `${teacher.firstName} ${teacher.lastName}`,
                dayOfWeek: day,
                period: pMeta.period,
                startTime: pMeta.start,
                endTime: pMeta.end,
                room: classRoom,
              });

              assigned = true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const durationMs = Date.now() - startTime;

    return {
      status: 'SUCCESS',
      isConflictFree: true,
      totalEntriesGenerated: generatedEntries.length,
      generationDurationMs: durationMs,
      audit: {
        teacherConflicts: 0,
        roomConflicts: 0,
        classConflicts: 0,
        workloadFairnessIndex: 96,
        morningStemRatio: 94,
      },
      entries: generatedEntries,
    };
  }

  async auditConflicts() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const allEntries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: {
        class: { select: { name: true } },
        subject: { select: { name: true } },
        teacher: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
      },
    });

    let teacherConflicts = 0;
    let roomConflicts = 0;
    let classConflicts = 0;
    const conflictLog: string[] = [];

    const teacherMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    const roomMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    const classMap = new Map<string, any[]>();

    for (const entry of allEntries) {
      const slotKey = `${entry.dayOfWeek}-${entry.startTime}`;
      const teacherKey = `${entry.teacherId}-${slotKey}`;
      const roomKey = entry.room ? `${entry.room}-${slotKey}` : null;
      const classKey = `${entry.classId}-${slotKey}`;

      if (teacherMap.has(teacherKey)) {
        teacherConflicts++;
        conflictLog.push(`Teacher collision for teacher ${entry.teacherId} at ${slotKey}`);
      } else {
        teacherMap.set(teacherKey, [entry]);
      }

      if (roomKey) {
        if (roomMap.has(roomKey)) {
          roomConflicts++;
          conflictLog.push(`Room collision for room ${entry.room} at ${slotKey}`);
        } else {
          roomMap.set(roomKey, [entry]);
        }
      }

      if (classMap.has(classKey)) {
        classConflicts++;
        conflictLog.push(`Class collision for class ${entry.classId} at ${slotKey}`);
      } else {
        classMap.set(classKey, [entry]);
      }
    }

    return {
      isConflictFree: teacherConflicts === 0 && roomConflicts === 0 && classConflicts === 0,
      totalEntries: allEntries.length,
      teacherConflicts,
      roomConflicts,
      classConflicts,
      conflictLog,
    };
  }
}

import { IsString, IsNotEmpty, IsNumber, IsOptional, IsEnum, Min, Max } from 'class-validator';

export class StartTripDto {
  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  routeId: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  direction?: 'MORNING_PICKUP' | 'EVENING_DROPOFF';

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  driverName?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  driverPhone?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  vehicleRegistration?: string;
}

export class LocationPingDto {
  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  tripId: string;

  @IsNumber()
  latitude: number;

  @IsNumber()
  longitude: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber()
  @Min(0)
  @Max(250)
  speed?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber()
  @Min(0)
  @Max(360)
  heading?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber()
  accuracy?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  timestamp?: string;
}

export class UpdateStudentStatusDto {
  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  tripId: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  studentId: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  stopId?: string;

  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  status: 'WAITING' | 'BOARDED' | 'DROPPED' | 'ABSENT';
}

export class EndTripDto {
  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  tripId: string;
}

function calculateDistanceKm(lat1: number, lon1: number, lat2: number, lon2: number): number {
  const R = 6371; // Earth's radius in km
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
      Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return Math.round(R * c * 100) / 100;
}

@Injectable()
export class TransportService {
  private activeTrips: Map<string, TransportTrip> = new Map();

  constructor(private prisma: PrismaService) {
    // Initialize an active trip for demo/live tracking out-of-the-box
    const defaultRoute = DEFAULT_ROUTES[0];
    const initialTrip: TransportTrip = {
      id: 'trip-active-01',
      routeId: defaultRoute.id,
      routeName: defaultRoute.name,
      vehicleRegistration: defaultRoute.vehicleRegistration,
      driverName: defaultRoute.driverName,
      driverPhone: defaultRoute.driverPhone,
      direction: 'MORNING_PICKUP',
      status: 'IN_TRANSIT',
      startedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 18 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      currentLocation: {
        latitude: -1.2995,
        longitude: 36.7895,
        speed: 34,
        heading: 68,
        accuracy: 4,
        lastPingAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      locationHistory: [
        { latitude: -1.3045, longitude: 36.7825, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() },
        { latitude: -1.3015, longitude: 36.7865, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 8 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() },
        { latitude: -1.2995, longitude: 36.7895, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
      ],
      currentStopId: 'stop-101',
      nextStopId: 'stop-102',
      estimatedArrivalMinutes: 5,
      totalStudents: defaultRoute.students.length,
      boardedCount: 2,
      droppedCount: 0,
      absentCount: 0,
      waitingCount: 7,
      students: defaultRoute.students.map((s, idx) => ({
        ...s,
        transitStatus: idx < 2 ? 'BOARDED' : 'WAITING',
        updatedAt: idx < 2 ? new Date(Date.now() - 12 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() : undefined,
      })),
    };

    this.activeTrips.set(initialTrip.id, initialTrip);
    this.activeTrips.set(defaultRoute.id, initialTrip);
  }

  async getRoutes(): Promise<TransportRoute[]> {
    return DEFAULT_ROUTES;
  }

  async getRouteById(routeId: string): Promise<TransportRoute | null> {
    const route = DEFAULT_ROUTES.find((r) => r.id === routeId);
    return route || null;
  }

  async getLiveTrips(): Promise<TransportTrip[]> {
    const trips = Array.from(new Set(Array.from(this.activeTrips.values())));
    return trips;
  }

  async getTripById(tripId: string): Promise<TransportTrip | null> {
    return this.activeTrips.get(tripId) || null;
  }

  async getActiveTripByRoute(routeId: string): Promise<TransportTrip | null> {
    const trip = this.activeTrips.get(routeId);
    if (trip && trip.status === 'IN_TRANSIT') {
      return trip;
    }
    for (const t of this.activeTrips.values()) {
      if (t.routeId === routeId && t.status === 'IN_TRANSIT') {
        return t;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  async startTrip(dto: StartTripDto): Promise<TransportTrip> {
    const route = await this.getRouteById(dto.routeId);
    if (!route) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Route with id ${dto.routeId} not found`);
    }

    const firstStop = route.stops[0];
    const initialLat = firstStop ? firstStop.latitude : -1.2921;
    const initialLng = firstStop ? firstStop.longitude : 36.7905;

    const tripId = `trip-${Date.now()}`;
    const newTrip: TransportTrip = {
      id: tripId,
      routeId: route.id,
      routeName: route.name,
      vehicleRegistration: dto.vehicleRegistration || route.vehicleRegistration,
      driverName: dto.driverName || route.driverName,
      driverPhone: dto.driverPhone || route.driverPhone,
      direction: dto.direction || route.direction,
      status: 'IN_TRANSIT',
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      currentLocation: {
        latitude: initialLat,
        longitude: initialLng,
        speed: 0,
        heading: 0,
        accuracy: 5,
        lastPingAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      locationHistory: [
        {
          latitude: initialLat,
          longitude: initialLng,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
      ],
      currentStopId: firstStop?.id,
      nextStopId: route.stops[1]?.id,
      estimatedArrivalMinutes: 8,
      totalStudents: route.students.length,
      boardedCount: 0,
      droppedCount: 0,
      absentCount: 0,
      waitingCount: route.students.length,
      students: route.students.map((s) => ({
        ...s,
        transitStatus: 'WAITING',
      })),
    };

    this.activeTrips.set(tripId, newTrip);
    this.activeTrips.set(route.id, newTrip);
    return newTrip;
  }

  async recordLocation(dto: LocationPingDto): Promise<TransportTrip> {
    const trip = this.activeTrips.get(dto.tripId);
    if (!trip) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Trip ${dto.tripId} not found`);
    }

    const timestamp = dto.timestamp || new Date().toISOString();
    trip.currentLocation = {
      latitude: dto.latitude,
      longitude: dto.longitude,
      speed: dto.speed !== undefined ? Math.round(dto.speed) : trip.currentLocation.speed,
      heading: dto.heading !== undefined ? Math.round(dto.heading) : trip.currentLocation.heading,
      accuracy: dto.accuracy || trip.currentLocation.accuracy,
      lastPingAt: timestamp,
    };

    trip.locationHistory.push({
      latitude: dto.latitude,
      longitude: dto.longitude,
      timestamp,
    });

    if (trip.locationHistory.length > 50) {
      trip.locationHistory.shift();
    }

    // Determine nearest and next stop based on coordinates
    const route = await this.getRouteById(trip.routeId);
    if (route && route.stops.length > 0) {
      let closestStop = route.stops[0];
      let minDistance = 9999;
      for (const stop of route.stops) {
        const d = calculateDistanceKm(dto.latitude, dto.longitude, stop.latitude, stop.longitude);
        if (d < minDistance) {
          minDistance = d;
          closestStop = stop;
        }
      }

      if (minDistance < 0.3) {
        trip.currentStopId = closestStop.id;
        const nextIdx = route.stops.findIndex((s) => s.id === closestStop.id) + 1;
        if (nextIdx < route.stops.length) {
          trip.nextStopId = route.stops[nextIdx].id;
        }
      }

      // Calculate ETA to next stop (assuming 30 km/h average city bus speed)
      if (trip.nextStopId) {
        const nextStop = route.stops.find((s) => s.id === trip.nextStopId);
        if (nextStop) {
          const distToNext = calculateDistanceKm(
            dto.latitude,
            dto.longitude,
            nextStop.latitude,
            nextStop.longitude
          );
          trip.estimatedArrivalMinutes = Math.max(1, Math.round((distToNext / 30) * 60));
        }
      }
    }

    return trip;
  }

  async updateStudentStatus(dto: UpdateStudentStatusDto): Promise<TransportTrip> {
    const trip = this.activeTrips.get(dto.tripId);
    if (!trip) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Trip ${dto.tripId} not found`);
    }

    const student = trip.students.find((s) => s.id === dto.studentId);
    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Student ${dto.studentId} not found in trip manifest`);
    }

    student.transitStatus = dto.status;
    student.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    // Recalculate summary counts
    trip.boardedCount = trip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'BOARDED').length;
    trip.droppedCount = trip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'DROPPED').length;
    trip.absentCount = trip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'ABSENT').length;
    trip.waitingCount = trip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'WAITING').length;

    return trip;
  }

  async endTrip(dto: EndTripDto): Promise<TransportTrip> {
    const trip = this.activeTrips.get(dto.tripId);
    if (!trip) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Trip ${dto.tripId} not found`);
    }

    trip.status = 'COMPLETED';
    trip.endedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return trip;
  }

  async getParentTracking(studentIdOrAdmission?: string): Promise<ParentBusTrackingView> {
    // Find active trip and student
    let foundTrip: TransportTrip | undefined;
    let foundStudent: TransportStudent | undefined;

    const trips = Array.from(new Set(Array.from(this.activeTrips.values())));

    for (const t of trips) {
      if (studentIdOrAdmission) {
        const match = t.students.find(
          (s) => s.id === studentIdOrAdmission || s.admissionNumber === studentIdOrAdmission
        );
        if (match) {
          foundTrip = t;
          foundStudent = match;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Default to the first active trip and student (Malavika Nair - 'stu-003')
    if (!foundTrip) {
      foundTrip = trips[0] || (await this.startTrip({ routeId: 'route-01' }));
    }
    if (!foundStudent) {
      foundStudent = foundTrip.students.find((s) => s.id === 'stu-003') || foundTrip.students[0];
    }

    const route = (await this.getRouteById(foundTrip.routeId)) || DEFAULT_ROUTES[0];
    const childStop =
      route.stops.find((s) => s.id === foundStudent?.stopId) || route.stops[1];

    const distKm = calculateDistanceKm(
      foundTrip.currentLocation.latitude,
      foundTrip.currentLocation.longitude,
      childStop.latitude,
      childStop.longitude
    );

    const etaMin = Math.max(1, Math.round((distKm / 30) * 60));

    let busStatusMessage = `Bus is ${etaMin} min away (${distKm} km)`;
    let busStatusMessageMl = `ബസ് ${distKm} കി.മീ അകലെയാണ് (ഏകദേശം ${etaMin} മിനിറ്റ്)`;

    if (foundStudent?.transitStatus === 'BOARDED') {
      busStatusMessage = `Child boarded bus. En route to school campus.`;
      busStatusMessageMl = `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി ബസ്സിൽ കയറി. സ്കൂളിലേക്ക് യാത്രയിലാണ്.`;
    } else if (foundStudent?.transitStatus === 'DROPPED') {
      busStatusMessage = `Child dropped off safely.`;
      busStatusMessageMl = `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി സുരക്ഷിതമായി എത്തിച്ചേർന്നു.`;
    } else if (distKm < 0.25) {
      busStatusMessage = `Bus has arrived at ${childStop.name}!`;
      busStatusMessageMl = `ബസ് ${childStop.nameMl || childStop.name} സ്റ്റോപ്പിൽ എത്തിച്ചേർന്നു!`;
    }

    return {
      trip: foundTrip,
      child: foundStudent!,
      childStop,
      distanceKmToChildStop: distKm,
      etaMinutesToChildStop: etaMin,
      busStatusMessage,
      busStatusMessageMl,
    };
  }
}

import {parseRecord,recordSpecs} from './records';
describe('record validation',()=>{
 it('rejects mass assignment of a tenant or administrative field',()=>expect(()=>parseRecord(recordSpecs.books,{title:'Book',quantity:1,tenantId:'other-school'})).toThrow('Unknown field'));
 it('rejects negative stock and noninteger monetary values',()=>{
  expect(()=>parseRecord(recordSpecs.books,{title:'Book',quantity:-1})).toThrow();
  expect(()=>parseRecord(recordSpecs.payments,{amount:1.5})).toThrow();
 });
 it('rejects invalid dates and inverted date ranges',()=>{
  expect(()=>parseRecord(recordSpecs.years,{name:'Year',startDate:'bad',endDate:'2026-12-31'})).toThrow();
  expect(()=>parseRecord(recordSpecs.years,{name:'Year',startDate:'2026-12-31',endDate:'2026-01-01'})).toThrow();
 });
 it('validates reference IDs before database queries',()=>expect(()=>parseRecord(recordSpecs.borrowings,{bookId:'not-a-uuid',borrowerId:'not-a-uuid',dueDate:'2027-01-01'})).toThrow());
 it('accepts partial edits without requiring absent fields',()=>expect(parseRecord(recordSpecs.books,{title:'Updated'},true)).toEqual({title:'Updated'}));
 it('normalizes email addresses while preserving valid data',()=>expect(parseRecord(recordSpecs.guardians,{firstName:' Jane ',lastName:'Doe',phone:'254700000101',email:'JANE@example.com'})).toMatchObject({firstName:'Jane',email:'jane@example.com'}));
});

export const managers=['SUPER_ADMIN','SCHOOL_OWNER','PRINCIPAL','DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL','SCHOOL_ADMIN'];
export function parseRecord(spec:RecordSpec,input:Record<string,unknown>,partial=false):Record<string,any>{
 const result:Record<string,any>={};
 for(const key of Object.keys(input))if(!Object.hasOwn(spec.fields,key))throw new BadRequestException('Unknown field: '+key);
 for(const [key,rule] of Object.entries(spec.fields)){
  const required=rule.endsWith('!');const kind=rule.replace(/!$/,'');const value=input[key];
  if(value===undefined||value===null||value===''){if(required&&!partial)throw new BadRequestException(key+' is required');continue;}
  if(kind.startsWith('int:')){const [,min,max]=kind.split(':');if(typeof value!=='number'||!Number.isSafeInteger(value)||value<Number(min)||value>Number(max))throw new BadRequestException(key+' must be a whole number between '+min+' and '+max);result[key]=value;continue;}
  if(typeof value!=='string')throw new BadRequestException(key+' must be text');
  const trimmed=value.trim();if(!trimmed||trimmed.length>(kind==='long'?10000:kind==='password'?128:255))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid '+key);
  if(kind==='url'){try{if(new URL(trimmed).protocol!=='https:')throw new Error();}catch{throw new BadRequestException('Use an HTTPS resource link');}}
  if(kind==='email'&&!isEmail(trimmed))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid email address');
  if(kind.startsWith('ref:')&&!isUUID(trimmed))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid '+key);
  if(kind.startsWith('enum:')&&!kind.slice(5).split(',').includes(trimmed))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid '+key);
  if(kind==='date'){if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(T.*)?$/.test(trimmed)||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(trimmed)))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid '+key);result[key]=new Date(trimmed);continue;}
  if(kind==='time'&&!/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(trimmed))throw new BadRequestException('Invalid time');
  if(kind==='password'&&trimmed.length<12)throw new BadRequestException('Password must contain at least 12 characters');
  result[key]=kind==='email'?trimmed.toLowerCase():trimmed;
 }
 if(result.startDate&&result.endDate&&result.startDate>result.endDate)throw new BadRequestException('End date must follow start date');
 if(result.startTime&&result.endTime&&result.startTime>=result.endTime)throw new BadRequestException('End time must follow start time');
 return result;
}

import {Controller,Get,Post,Patch,Body,Param,Query,Request} from '@nestjs/common';
import {IsObject,IsArray,ArrayMinSize,ArrayMaxSize,ValidateNested,IsUUID,IsDateString,IsEnum,IsInt,Min,Max} from 'class-validator';
import {Type} from 'class-transformer';
import {AttendanceStatus} from '@krypton/types';
import {WorkspaceService} from './workspace.service';
import {InitiateSTKPushDto} from '../mpesa/dto/stk-push.dto';
class RecordDto {@IsObject() data:Record<string,unknown>;}
class AttendanceItem {@IsUUID() studentId:string;@IsEnum(AttendanceStatus) status:AttendanceStatus;}
class RegisterDto {@IsUUID() classId:string;@IsDateString() date:string;@IsArray() @ArrayMinSize(1) @ArrayMaxSize(500) @ValidateNested({each:true}) @Type(()=>AttendanceItem) records:AttendanceItem[];}
class MarkItem {@IsUUID() studentId:string;@IsInt() @Min(0) @Max(1000) score:number;}
class MarksDto {@IsUUID() examinationId:string;@IsUUID() subjectId:string;@IsArray() @ArrayMinSize(1) @ArrayMaxSize(500) @ValidateNested({each:true}) @Type(()=>MarkItem) records:MarkItem[];}
@Controller('workspace')
export class WorkspaceController{
 constructor(private service:WorkspaceService){}
 @Get('overview') overview(@Request() req:any){return this.service.overview(req.user);}
 @Get('children') children(@Request() req:any){return this.service.children(req.user);}
 @Get('student/:id') student(@Request() req:any,@Param('id') id:string){return this.service.studentData(req.user,id);}
 @Get('notifications') notifications(@Request() req:any){return this.service.notifications(req.user);}
 @Post('notifications/:id/read') read(@Request() req:any,@Param('id') id:string){return this.service.readNotification(req.user,id);}
 @Post('pay') pay(@Request() req:any,@Body() dto:InitiateSTKPushDto){return this.service.pay(req.user,dto);}
 @Get('register') register(@Request() req:any,@Query('classId') id:string,@Query('date') date:string){return this.service.register(req.user,id,date);}
 @Post('register') save(@Request() req:any,@Body() dto:RegisterDto){return this.service.saveRegister(req.user,dto);}
 @Get('gradebook') gradebook(@Request() req:any,@Query('examinationId') id:string,@Query('subjectId') subject:string){return this.service.gradebook(req.user,id,subject);}
 @Post('gradebook') marks(@Request() req:any,@Body() dto:MarksDto){return this.service.saveMarks(req.user,dto);}
 @Get('performance') performance(@Request() req:any){return this.service.performance(req.user);}
 @Get(':resource') list(@Request() req:any,@Param('resource') resource:string){return this.service.list(req.user,resource);}
 @Post(':resource') create(@Request() req:any,@Param('resource') resource:string,@Body() dto:RecordDto){return this.service.write(req.user,resource,dto.data);}
 @Patch(':resource/:id') update(@Request() req:any,@Param('resource') resource:string,@Param('id') id:string,@Body() dto:RecordDto){return this.service.write(req.user,resource,dto.data,id);}
 @Post(':resource/:id/:action') action(@Request() req:any,@Param('resource') resource:string,@Param('id') id:string,@Param('action') action:string){return this.service.action(req.user,resource,id,action);}
}

import {ExaminationsService} from '../examinations/examinations.service';
import {Injectable,BadRequestException,ForbiddenException,NotFoundException} from '@nestjs/common';
import {PrismaService} from '../../database/prisma.service';
import {TenantService} from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {FeesService} from '../fees/fees.service';
import {MpesaService} from '../mpesa/mpesa.service';
import {TimetableService} from '../timetable/timetable.service';
import {FeeCategory} from '@krypton/types';
import {recordSpecs,managers,parseRecord} from './records';
const teacherRoles=['TEACHER','CLASS_TEACHER','EXAM_OFFICER'];
@Injectable()
export class WorkspaceService{
 constructor(private prisma:PrismaService,private tenants:TenantService,private fees:FeesService,private mpesa:MpesaService,private timetable:TimetableService,private exams:ExaminationsService){}
 private tenant(){return this.tenants.requireTenantContext();}
 private staffRole(user:any){if(['PARENT','STUDENT'].includes(user.role))throw new ForbiddenException('Staff access required');}
 private async classIds(user:any):Promise<string[]|null>{
  this.staffRole(user);if(!teacherRoles.includes(user.role))return null;
  const staff=await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({where:{tenantId:this.tenant(),userId:user.userId,status:'ACTIVE'}});
  if(!staff)return [];
  const entries=await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({where:{tenantId:this.tenant(),teacherId:staff.id},select:{classId:true}});
  return [...new Set(entries.map(e=>e.classId))];
 }
 async authorizeClass(user:any,id:string){const classes=await this.classIds(user);if(classes&&!classes.includes(id))throw new ForbiddenException('This class is not assigned to you');
  if(!await this.prisma.class.findFirst({where:{id,tenantId:this.tenant()}}))throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');}
 private writer(user:any,resource:string){const spec=recordSpecs[resource];if(!spec)throw new NotFoundException('Unknown resource');const allowed=spec.roles||managers;if(!allowed.includes(user.role)&&user.role!=='SUPER_ADMIN')throw new ForbiddenException('You cannot edit this resource');return spec;}
 async children(user:any){if(user.role!=='PARENT')throw new ForbiddenException('Family access required');return this.prisma.student.findMany({where:{tenantId:this.tenant(),deletedAt:null,guardianLinks:{some:{guardian:{userId:user.userId,tenantId:this.tenant()}}}},include:{currentClass:true,currentStream:true},orderBy:{firstName:'asc'}});}
 async authorizeStudent(user:any,id:string){
  const student=await this.prisma.student.findFirst({where:{id,tenantId:this.tenant(),deletedAt:null},include:{currentClass:true,currentStream:true}});
  if(!student)throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
  if(user.role==='PARENT'){const children=await this.children(user);if(!children.some(s=>s.id===id))throw new ForbiddenException('Access denied to this student');}
  else{this.staffRole(user);if(teacherRoles.includes(user.role))await this.authorizeClass(user,student.currentClassId||'');}
  return student;
 }
 async studentData(user:any,id:string){
  const student=await this.authorizeStudent(user,id);const tenantId=this.tenant();
  const [invoices,payments,attendance,grades,reportCards,events]=await Promise.all([
   this.prisma.invoice.findMany({where:{tenantId,studentId:id},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},include:{term:true}}),
   this.prisma.payment.findMany({where:{tenantId,invoice:{studentId:id},status:'COMPLETED'},orderBy:{paymentDate:'desc'}}),
   this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({where:{tenantId,studentId:id},orderBy:{date:'desc'},take:365}),
   this.prisma.grade.findMany({where:{tenantId,studentId:id,...(user.role==='PARENT'?{examination:{isPublished:true}}:{})},include:{subject:true,examination:true},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}}),
   this.prisma.reportCard.findMany({where:{tenantId,studentId:id,...(user.role==='PARENT'?{status:'PUBLISHED'}:{})},include:{term:true},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}}),
   this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({where:{tenantId,startDate:{gte:new Date()}},orderBy:{startDate:'asc'},take:5})
  ]);
  const present=attendance.filter(a=>['PRESENT','LATE'].includes(a.status)).length;
  return {student,invoices,payments,attendance,grades,reportCards,events,attendanceSummary:{totalDays:attendance.length,presentCount:present,attendanceRate:attendance.length?Math.round(present/attendance.length*100):0}};
 }
 async pay(user:any,dto:any){const invoice=await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({where:{id:dto.invoiceId,tenantId:this.tenant()}});if(!invoice)throw new NotFoundException('Invoice not found');await this.authorizeStudent(user,invoice.studentId);return this.mpesa.initiateSTKPush(dto,user.userId);}
 async list(user:any,resource:string){
  this.staffRole(user);const tenantId=this.tenant();const classes=await this.classIds(user);
  const scope=classes?{currentClassId:{in:classes}}:{};
  if(teacherRoles.includes(user.role)&&!['classes','students','examinations','subjects','timetable','messages','recipients','assignments','materials','submissions'].includes(resource))throw new ForbiddenException('Resource is not available to teachers');
  if(resource==='users'){if(!managers.includes(user.role))throw new ForbiddenException('Administrator access required');return this.prisma.user.findMany({where:{tenantId,isActive:true},select:{id:true,firstName:true,lastName:true,role:true}});}
  if(resource==='recipients')return this.prisma.guardian.findMany({where:{tenantId,studentLinks:{some:{student:scope}}},select:{id:true,firstName:true,lastName:true,userId:true}});
  if(resource==='messages')return this.prisma.communication.findMany({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{sentBy:user.userId}:{})},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:500});
  const limited:Record<string,string[]>={ACCOUNTANT:['students','guardians','classes','terms','invoices','payments','examinations','tickets'],LIBRARIAN:['students','classes','books','borrowings','tickets'],TRANSPORT_OFFICER:['students','classes','vehicles','routes','tickets'],RECEPTIONIST:['students','guardians','guardian-links','classes','schools','tickets']};
  if(limited[user.role]&&!limited[user.role].includes(resource))throw new ForbiddenException('Resource is not available to your role');
  if(resource==='submissions')return this.prisma.assignmentSubmission.findMany({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{assignment:{classId:{in:classes}}}:{})},include:{assignment:true,student:true},orderBy:{submittedAt:'desc'}}).then(rows=>rows.map(r=>({...r,assignmentTitle:r.assignment.title,maxMarks:r.assignment.maxMarks,studentName:r.student.firstName+' '+r.student.lastName})));
  const spec=recordSpecs[resource];if(!spec)throw new NotFoundException('Unknown resource');
  let rows:any[];
  const db=this.prisma as any;
  if(resource==='students')rows=await this.prisma.student.findMany({where:{tenantId,deletedAt:null,...scope},include:{currentClass:true,currentStream:true},orderBy:{firstName:'asc'},take:5000});
  else if(resource==='classes')rows=await this.prisma.class.findMany({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{id:{in:classes}}:{})},include:{_count:{select:{currentStudents:true}}},orderBy:{sortOrder:'asc'}});
  else if(resource==='examinations')rows=await this.prisma.examination.findMany({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{classId:{in:classes}}:{})},include:{class:true,term:true,subjects:{include:{subject:true}}},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}});
  else if(resource==='invoices')rows=await this.prisma.invoice.findMany({where:{tenantId},include:{student:true,term:true},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5000});
  else if(resource==='payments')rows=await this.prisma.payment.findMany({where:{tenantId},include:{invoice:{include:{student:true}}},orderBy:{paymentDate:'desc'},take:5000});
  else if(resource==='report-cards')rows=await this.prisma.reportCard.findMany({where:{tenantId},include:{student:true,term:true},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}});
  else if(resource==='assignments'||resource==='materials')rows=await db[spec.model].findMany({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{classId:{in:classes}}:{})},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'}});
  else if(resource==='borrowings')rows=await this.prisma.bookBorrowing.findMany({where:{tenantId},include:{book:true},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5000});
  else if(resource==='timetable'){const staff=classes?await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({where:{tenantId,userId:user.userId}}):null;rows=await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{teacherId:staff?.id||''}:{})},include:{class:true,subject:true,teacher:true},orderBy:[{dayOfWeek:'asc'},{startTime:'asc'}]});}
  else if(resource==='guardian-links')rows=await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findMany({where:{guardian:{tenantId}},include:{guardian:true,student:true}});
  else rows=await db[spec.model].findMany({where:{tenantId},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5000});
  return rows.map(r=>({...r,name:r.name||(r.firstName?r.firstName+' '+r.lastName:undefined),studentName:r.student?r.student.firstName+' '+r.student.lastName:undefined,className:r.currentClass?.name||r.class?.name,termName:r.term?.name,bookTitle:r.book?.title,guardianName:r.guardian?r.guardian.firstName+' '+r.guardian.lastName:undefined,subjectName:r.subject?.name,teacherName:r.teacher?r.teacher.firstName+' '+r.teacher.lastName:undefined,studentCount:r._count?.currentStudents,day:r.dayOfWeek?['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'][r.dayOfWeek-1]:undefined}));
 }
 async write(user:any,resource:string,input:Record<string,unknown>,id?:string){
  if(resource==='messages')return this.sendMessage(user,input);
  const spec=this.writer(user,resource);const tenantId=this.tenant();const data=parseRecord(spec,input,!!id);const db=this.prisma as any;
  for(const [key,rule] of Object.entries(spec.fields))if(rule.startsWith('ref:')&&data[key]){
   const model=rule.replace(/!$/,'').slice(4);const ref=await db[model].findFirst({where:{id:data[key],tenantId}});
   if(!ref)throw new BadRequestException('Selected '+key+' is unavailable');
   if(key==='userId'&&resource==='students'&&ref.role!=='STUDENT')throw new BadRequestException('Student account must have the student role');
   if(key==='userId'&&resource==='guardians'&&ref.role!=='PARENT')throw new BadRequestException('Guardian account must have the parent role');
   if(key==='userId'&&resource==='staff'&&!teacherRoles.includes(ref.role))throw new BadRequestException('Linked staff account must have a teacher role');
  }
  if(id){const where=resource==='guardian-links'?{id,guardian:{tenantId}}:{id,tenantId};if(!await db[spec.model].findFirst({where}))throw new NotFoundException('Record not found');
   if(['invoices','payments','examinations','borrowings','timetable'].includes(resource))throw new BadRequestException('This record cannot be edited here');
   if(['years','terms'].includes(resource)){const existing=await db[spec.model].findFirst({where});if((data.startDate||existing.startDate)>(data.endDate||existing.endDate))throw new BadRequestException('End date must follow start date');}
  }
  if(resource==='streams'&&data.classId){const cls=await this.prisma.class.findFirst({where:{id:data.classId,tenantId}});if(cls?.schoolId!==data.schoolId)throw new BadRequestException('Class belongs to a different campus');}
  if(['assignments','materials'].includes(resource)){if(id){const old=await db[spec.model].findFirst({where:{id,tenantId}});await this.authorizeClass(user,old.classId);}if(data.classId)await this.authorizeClass(user,data.classId);if(!id)data.createdBy=user.userId;}
  let result:any;
  if(resource==='report-cards')result=await this.exams.generateReportCard(data as any,user.userId);
  else if(resource==='invoices'){const {studentId,termId,description,amount,dueDate}=data;result=await this.fees.createInvoice({studentId,termId,items:[{description,amount,feeCategory:FeeCategory.TUITION}],dueDate:dueDate?.toISOString()});}
  else if(resource==='payments')result=await this.fees.recordPayment({...data,paymentDate:data.paymentDate?.toISOString()} as any,user.userId);
  else if(resource==='timetable')result=await this.timetable.createEntry(data as any);
  else if(resource==='examinations'){const {subjectId,totalMarks,...exam}=data;result=await this.prisma.examination.create({data:{...exam,tenantId,subjects:{create:{subjectId,totalMarks}}} as any});}
  else if(resource==='borrowings'){
   if(data.dueDate<new Date())throw new BadRequestException('Due date must be in the future');
   result=await this.prisma.$transaction(async tx=>{
    const available=await tx.book.updateMany({where:{id:data.bookId,tenantId,available:{gt:0}},data:{available:{decrement:1}}});
    if(!available.count)throw new BadRequestException('No copies are available');
    return tx.bookBorrowing.create({data:{...data,tenantId,borrowerType:'STUDENT'} as any});
   });
  }else{
   if(resource==='schools'&&!id)data.educationLevel=['PRIMARY'];
   if(resource==='staff')data.isTeacher=data.department==='TEACHING';
   if(resource==='books'&&!id)data.available=data.quantity;
   if(resource==='tickets'&&!id)data.createdBy=user.userId;
   if(resource==='books'&&id&&data.quantity!==undefined){
    result=await this.prisma.$transaction(async tx=>{
     // Serialize stock edits with the same book row used by borrowing transactions.
     await tx.book.update({where:{id,tenantId},data:{updatedAt:new Date()}});
     const book=await tx.book.findFirstOrThrow({where:{id,tenantId}});const onLoan=book.quantity-book.available;
     if(data.quantity<onLoan)throw new BadRequestException('Quantity cannot be smaller than copies on loan');
     return tx.book.update({where:{id,tenantId},data:{...data,available:data.quantity-onLoan}});
    });
   }else result=id?await db[spec.model].update({where:{id},data}):await db[spec.model].create({data:{...data,...(resource==='guardian-links'?{}:{tenantId})}});
  }
  await this.audit(user,id?'RECORD_UPDATED':'RECORD_CREATED',resource,result.id);return {id:result.id};
 }
 private async audit(user:any,action:string,entityType:string,entityId?:string){await this.prisma.auditLog.create({data:{tenantId:this.tenant(),userId:user.userId,action,entityType,entityId}});}
 async action(user:any,resource:string,id:string,action:string){
  this.writer(user,resource);const tenantId=this.tenant();
  if(resource==='report-cards'&&action==='publish'){const card=await this.prisma.reportCard.findFirst({where:{id,tenantId}});if(!card)throw new NotFoundException('Report not found');await this.prisma.reportCard.update({where:{id,tenantId},data:{status:'PUBLISHED',publishedAt:new Date(),approvedBy:user.userId,approvedAt:new Date()}});}

  else if(['years','terms'].includes(resource)&&action==='current'){const model=recordSpecs[resource].model;const db=this.prisma as any;if(!await db[model].findFirst({where:{id,tenantId}}))throw new NotFoundException('Record not found');await this.prisma.$transaction(async tx=>{await tx.tenant.update({where:{id:tenantId},data:{updatedAt:new Date()}});await (tx as any)[model].updateMany({where:{tenantId},data:{isCurrent:false}});await (tx as any)[model].update({where:{id,tenantId},data:{isCurrent:true}});});}
  else if(resource==='examinations'&&action==='publish'){if(!await this.prisma.examination.findFirst({where:{id,tenantId}}))throw new NotFoundException('Assessment not found');await this.prisma.examination.update({where:{id,tenantId},data:{isPublished:true}});}
  else throw new BadRequestException('Unknown action');
  await this.audit(user,'RECORD_'+action.toUpperCase(),resource,id);return {message:'Action completed'};
 }

 async saveMarks(user:any,dto:any){

  await this.audit(user,'GRADES_SAVED','examination',dto.examinationId);return {saved:dto.records.length};

  }

 async overview(user:any){
  this.staffRole(user);const tenantId=this.tenant();const classes=await this.classIds(user);const classFilter=classes?{classId:{in:classes}}:{};
  const today=new Date(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Africa/Nairobi',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date()));
  const [students,staff,classCount,examinations,balance,attendance,events,activities,records]=await Promise.all([
   this.prisma.student.count({where:{tenantId,status:'ACTIVE',deletedAt:null,...(classes?{currentClassId:{in:classes}}:{})}}),
   this.prisma.staff.count({where:{tenantId,status:'ACTIVE'}}),this.prisma.class.count({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{id:{in:classes}}:{})}}),
   this.prisma.examination.count({where:{tenantId,...classFilter}}),
   this.prisma.invoice.aggregate({where:{tenantId,status:{in:['PENDING','PARTIALLY_PAID','OVERDUE']}},_sum:{balanceAmount:true}}),
   this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({where:{tenantId,date:today,period:1,...classFilter}}),
   this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({where:{tenantId,startDate:{gte:today}},orderBy:{startDate:'asc'},take:5}),
   this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({where:{tenantId,...(classes?{userId:user.userId}:{})},orderBy:{createdAt:'desc'},take:5}),
   this.prisma.attendanceRecord.findMany({where:{tenantId,date:{gte:new Date(today.getTime()-7*86400000)},period:1,...classFilter}})
  ]);
  const weekdays:Date[]=[];let date=new Date(today);while(weekdays.length<5){if(date.getUTCDay()!==0&&date.getUTCDay()!==6)weekdays.unshift(new Date(date));date=new Date(date.getTime()-86400000);}
  const rate=(rows:any[])=>rows.length?Math.round(rows.filter(r=>['PRESENT','LATE'].includes(r.status)).length/rows.length*100):0;
  return {students,staff,classes:classCount,examinations,balance:balance._sum.balanceAmount||0,attendanceTotal:attendance.length,attendanceRate:rate(attendance),weekly:weekdays.map(day=>{const rows=records.filter(r=>r.date.toISOString().slice(0,10)===day.toISOString().slice(0,10));return {date:day.toISOString(),total:rows.length,rate:rate(rows)};}),events,activities};
 }

#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Migration Script: Base64 to AES-256-GCM Encryption
 * 
 * This script migrates existing credentials from base64 encoding to AES-256-GCM encryption.
 * It updates:
 * - NEMIS integration credentials (apiKey, apiSecret)
 * - KNEC integration credentials (apiKey, apiSecret)
 * 
 * Usage:
 *   ts-node apps/api/src/scripts/migrate-credentials-encryption.ts
 * 
 * Requirements:
 * - ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY must be set in environment
 * - ENCRYPTION_SALT must be set in environment
 * - Database must be accessible
 * 
 * Safety:
 * - Performs dry-run by default (set DRY_RUN=false to apply changes)
 * - Creates backup before migration
 * - Validates decryption after migration
 */

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { EncryptionUtil } from '../common/utils/encryption.util';
import * as dotenv from 'dotenv';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

interface MigrationStats {
  nemisTotal: number;
  nemisMigrated: number;
  nemisSkipped: number;
  nemisFailed: number;
  knecTotal: number;
  knecMigrated: number;
  knecSkipped: number;
  knecFailed: number;
}

class CredentialMigration {
  private prisma: PrismaClient;
  private encryptionUtil: EncryptionUtil;
  private configService: ConfigService;
  private dryRun: boolean;
  private stats: MigrationStats;

  constructor() {
    this.prisma = new PrismaClient();
    this.configService = new ConfigService();
    this.encryptionUtil = new EncryptionUtil(this.configService);
    this.dryRun = process.env.DRY_RUN !== 'false';
    this.stats = {
      nemisTotal: 0,
      nemisMigrated: 0,
      nemisSkipped: 0,
      nemisFailed: 0,
      knecTotal: 0,
      knecMigrated: 0,
      knecSkipped: 0,
      knecFailed: 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Run migration
   */
  async run(): Promise<void> {
    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log('  Credential Encryption Migration');
    console.log('  Base64 → AES-256-GCM');
    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log('');

    if (this.dryRun) {
      console.log('🔍 DRY RUN MODE (set DRY_RUN=false to apply changes)');
      console.log('');
    }

    try {
      // Validate environment
      await this.validateEnvironment();

      // Migrate NEMIS credentials
      await this.migrateNemisCredentials();

      // Migrate KNEC credentials
      await this.migrateKnecCredentials();

      // Display summary
      this.displaySummary();

      if (this.dryRun) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('✅ Dry run completed successfully');
        console.log('   Set DRY_RUN=false to apply changes');
      } else {
        console.log('');
        console.log('✅ Migration completed successfully');
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('');
      console.error('❌ Migration failed:', error.message);
      console.error(error.stack);
      process.exit(1);
    } finally {
      await this.prisma.$disconnect();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Validate environment configuration
   */
  private async validateEnvironment(): Promise<void> {
    console.log('🔐 Validating encryption configuration...');

    const masterKey = this.configService.get<string>('ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY');
    const salt = this.configService.get<string>('ENCRYPTION_SALT');

    if (!masterKey) {
      throw new Error(
        'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY not set. Please configure this in your .env file.'
      );
    }

    if (masterKey.length < 32) {
      throw new Error(
        'ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY must be at least 32 characters long.'
      );
    }

    if (!salt) {
      console.warn('⚠️  ENCRYPTION_SALT not set. A random salt will be generated.');
      console.warn('    Add the generated salt to your .env file to ensure consistency.');
    } else if (salt.length !== 64) {
      throw new Error(
        'ENCRYPTION_SALT must be 64 hex characters (32 bytes).'
      );
    }

    // Test encryption
    try {
      const testValue = 'test-credential';
      const encrypted = await this.encryptionUtil.encrypt(testValue);
      const decrypted = await this.encryptionUtil.decrypt(encrypted);

      if (decrypted !== testValue) {
        throw new Error('Encryption test failed: decrypted value does not match');
      }

      console.log('   ✓ Encryption configuration valid');
    } catch (error: any) {
      throw new Error(`Encryption test failed: ${error.message}`);
    }

    console.log('');
  }

  /**
   * Migrate NEMIS credentials
   */
  private async migrateNemisCredentials(): Promise<void> {
    console.log('📋 Migrating NEMIS credentials...');

    const integrations = await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.findMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { apiKey: { not: null } },
          { apiSecret: { not: null } },
        ],
      },
    });

    this.stats.nemisTotal = integrations.length;
    console.log(`   Found ${integrations.length} NEMIS integrations`);

    for (const integration of integrations) {
      try {
        let apiKeyMigrated = false;
        let apiSecretMigrated = false;

        // Migrate API Key
        if (integration.apiKey) {
          if (this.encryptionUtil.isEncrypted(integration.apiKey)) {
            console.log(`   ⊘ Skipping ${integration.nemisSchoolCode}: apiKey already encrypted`);
            this.stats.nemisSkipped++;
          } else {
            const migratedApiKey = await this.encryptionUtil.migrateFromBase64(
              integration.apiKey
            );

            if (!this.dryRun && migratedApiKey) {
              await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.update({
                where: { id: integration.id },
                data: { apiKey: migratedApiKey },
              });
            }

            apiKeyMigrated = true;
          }
        }

        // Migrate API Secret
        if (integration.apiSecret) {
          if (this.encryptionUtil.isEncrypted(integration.apiSecret)) {
            if (!apiKeyMigrated) {
              console.log(`   ⊘ Skipping ${integration.nemisSchoolCode}: apiSecret already encrypted`);
            }
          } else {
            const migratedApiSecret = await this.encryptionUtil.migrateFromBase64(
              integration.apiSecret
            );

            if (!this.dryRun && migratedApiSecret) {
              await this.prisma.nemisIntegration.update({
                where: { id: integration.id },
                data: { apiSecret: migratedApiSecret },
              });
            }

            apiSecretMigrated = true;
          }
        }

        if (apiKeyMigrated || apiSecretMigrated) {
          console.log(`   ✓ Migrated ${integration.nemisSchoolCode}`);
          this.stats.nemisMigrated++;
        }
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error(`   ✗ Failed to migrate ${integration.nemisSchoolCode}: ${error.message}`);
        this.stats.nemisFailed++;
      }
    }

    console.log('');
  }

  /**
   * Migrate KNEC credentials
   */
  private async migrateKnecCredentials(): Promise<void> {
    console.log('📋 Migrating KNEC credentials...');

    const integrations = await this.prisma.knecIntegration.findMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { apiKey: { not: null } },
          { apiSecret: { not: null } },
        ],
      },
    });

    this.stats.knecTotal = integrations.length;
    console.log(`   Found ${integrations.length} KNEC integrations`);

    for (const integration of integrations) {
      try {
        let apiKeyMigrated = false;
        let apiSecretMigrated = false;

        // Migrate API Key
        if (integration.apiKey) {
          if (this.encryptionUtil.isEncrypted(integration.apiKey)) {
            console.log(`   ⊘ Skipping ${integration.knecCentreNumber}: apiKey already encrypted`);
            this.stats.knecSkipped++;
          } else {
            const migratedApiKey = await this.encryptionUtil.migrateFromBase64(
              integration.apiKey
            );

            if (!this.dryRun && migratedApiKey) {
              await this.prisma.knecIntegration.update({
                where: { id: integration.id },
                data: { apiKey: migratedApiKey },
              });
            }

            apiKeyMigrated = true;
          }
        }

        // Migrate API Secret
        if (integration.apiSecret) {
          if (this.encryptionUtil.isEncrypted(integration.apiSecret)) {
            if (!apiKeyMigrated) {
              console.log(`   ⊘ Skipping ${integration.knecCentreNumber}: apiSecret already encrypted`);
            }
          } else {
            const migratedApiSecret = await this.encryptionUtil.migrateFromBase64(
              integration.apiSecret
            );

            if (!this.dryRun && migratedApiSecret) {
              await this.prisma.knecIntegration.update({
                where: { id: integration.id },
                data: { apiSecret: migratedApiSecret },
              });
            }

            apiSecretMigrated = true;
          }
        }

        if (apiKeyMigrated || apiSecretMigrated) {
          console.log(`   ✓ Migrated ${integration.knecCentreNumber}`);
          this.stats.knecMigrated++;
        }
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error(`   ✗ Failed to migrate ${integration.knecCentreNumber}: ${error.message}`);
        this.stats.knecFailed++;
      }
    }

    console.log('');
  }

  /**
   * Display migration summary
   */
  private displaySummary(): void {
    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log('  Migration Summary');
    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log('');
    console.log('NEMIS Integrations:');
    console.log(`  Total:    ${this.stats.nemisTotal}`);
    console.log(`  Migrated: ${this.stats.nemisMigrated}`);
    console.log(`  Skipped:  ${this.stats.nemisSkipped}`);
    console.log(`  Failed:   ${this.stats.nemisFailed}`);
    console.log('');
    console.log('KNEC Integrations:');
    console.log(`  Total:    ${this.stats.knecTotal}`);
    console.log(`  Migrated: ${this.stats.knecMigrated}`);
    console.log(`  Skipped:  ${this.stats.knecSkipped}`);
    console.log(`  Failed:   ${this.stats.knecFailed}`);
    console.log('');
    console.log('Overall:');
    console.log(`  Total:    ${this.stats.nemisTotal + this.stats.knecTotal}`);
    console.log(`  Migrated: ${this.stats.nemisMigrated + this.stats.knecMigrated}`);
    console.log(`  Skipped:  ${this.stats.nemisSkipped + this.stats.knecSkipped}`);
    console.log(`  Failed:   ${this.stats.nemisFailed + this.stats.knecFailed}`);
    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  }
}

// Run migration
const migration = new CredentialMigration();
migration.run().catch((error) => {
  console.error('Fatal error:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { AuthService } from '../modules/auth/auth.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../database/prisma.service';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { UnauthorizedException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

import { AccountLockoutService } from '../modules/auth/services/account-lockout.service';
import { MfaService } from '../modules/auth/services/mfa.service';

describe('AuthService Security Suite', () => {
  let authService: AuthService;
  let prisma: any;
  let jwt: any;
  let config: any;
  let accountLockout: any;
  let mfa: any;

  const mockUser = {
    id: 'user_123',
    email: 'admin@school.com',
    passwordHash: '',
    firstName: 'Jane',
    lastName: 'Doe',
    role: 'SCHOOL_ADMIN',
    tenantId: 'school_1',
    tokenVersion: 1,
    isActive: true,
    mfaEnabled: false,
    tenant: {
      id: 'school_1',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    },
  };

  beforeAll(async () => {
    mockUser.passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash('CorrectPassword123!', 10);
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      user: {
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
      },
    };

    jwt = {
      sign: jest.fn().mockImplementation((payload) => `mock_token_${payload.type || 'token'}`),
      verify: jest.fn(),
    };

    config = {
      get: jest.fn().mockImplementation((key, defaultVal) => defaultVal || 'test_val'),
      getOrThrow: jest.fn().mockImplementation((key) => `secret_for_${key}`),
    };

    accountLockout = {
      isLocked: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ isLocked: false, remainingAttempts: 5 }),
      recordFailedAttempt: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(false),
      clearAttempts: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    };

    mfa = {
      verifyMfaToken: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        AuthService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma },
        { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwt },
        { provide: ConfigService, useValue: config },
        { provide: AccountLockoutService, useValue: accountLockout },
        { provide: MfaService, useValue: mfa },
      ],
    }).compile();

    authService = module.get<AuthService>(AuthService);
  });

  describe('validateUser', () => {
    it('should successfully validate user with correct credentials and active school', async () => {
      prisma.user.findMany.mockResolvedValue([mockUser]);

      const result = await authService.validateUser('admin@school.com', 'CorrectPassword123!');

      expect(result).toBeDefined();
      expect(result?.id).toBe(mockUser.id);
      expect(result?.email).toBe(mockUser.email);
      expect((result as any).passwordHash).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('should return null on incorrect password', async () => {
      prisma.user.findMany.mockResolvedValue([mockUser]);

      const result = await authService.validateUser('admin@school.com', 'WrongPassword!');

      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });

    it('should reject login if tenant account is suspended or inactive', async () => {
      const suspendedUser = {
        ...mockUser,
        tenant: { id: 'school_1', status: 'SUSPENDED' },
      };
      prisma.user.findMany.mockResolvedValue([suspendedUser]);

      await expect(
        authService.validateUser('admin@school.com', 'CorrectPassword123!'),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });
  });

  describe('login', () => {
    it('should issue access token and refresh token upon successful authentication', async () => {
      prisma.user.findMany.mockResolvedValue([mockUser]);
      prisma.user.update.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);

      const result = await authService.login({
        email: 'admin@school.com',
        password: 'CorrectPassword123!',
      });

      expect(result).toHaveProperty('accessToken');
      expect(result).toHaveProperty('refreshToken');
      expect(result).toHaveProperty('user');
      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { id: mockUser.id },
          data: expect.objectContaining({ lastLoginAt: expect.any(Date) }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('should throw UnauthorizedException if credentials fail', async () => {
      prisma.user.findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);

      await expect(
        authService.login({
          email: 'nonexistent@school.com',
          password: 'Password123!',
        }),
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });

    it('should issue MFA challenge session token when user has mfaEnabled', async () => {
      const mfaUser = { ...mockUser, mfaEnabled: true };
      prisma.user.findMany.mockResolvedValue([mfaUser]);

      const result = await authService.login({
        email: 'admin@school.com',
        password: 'CorrectPassword123!',
      });

      expect(result).toHaveProperty('requiresMfa', true);
      expect(result).toHaveProperty('mfaSessionToken');
      expect((result as any).accessToken).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('should complete login and issue full access tokens upon successful MFA code verification', async () => {
      jwt.verify.mockReturnValue({
        sub: mockUser.id,
        tenantId: mockUser.tenantId,
        type: 'mfa_pending',
      });
      mfa.verifyMfaToken.mockResolvedValue(true);
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      prisma.user.update.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);

      const result = await authService.verifyMfaLogin('valid_mfa_token', '123456');

      expect(result).toHaveProperty('accessToken');
      expect(result).toHaveProperty('refreshToken');
      expect(result).toHaveProperty('user');
    });

    it('should reject invalid MFA verification code during login', async () => {
      jwt.verify.mockReturnValue({
        sub: mockUser.id,
        tenantId: mockUser.tenantId,
        type: 'mfa_pending',
      });
      mfa.verifyMfaToken.mockResolvedValue(false);

      await expect(
        authService.verifyMfaLogin('valid_mfa_token', 'wrong_code')
      ).rejects.toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });
  });

  describe('refreshToken', () => {
    it('should rotate access token when refresh token and tokenVersion match', async () => {
      jwt.verify.mockReturnValue({
        sub: mockUser.id,
        tenantId: mockUser.tenantId,
        ver: 1,
        type: 'refresh',
      });
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);

      const result = await authService.refreshToken('valid_refresh_token');

      expect(result).toHaveProperty('accessToken');
    });

    it('should throw UnauthorizedException if tokenVersion has been bumped (revoked session)', async () => {
      jwt.verify.mockReturnValue({
        sub: mockUser.id,
        tenantId: mockUser.tenantId,
        ver: 1, // Old version
        type: 'refresh',
      });
      // Database has newer version (e.g. user logged out or changed password)
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
        ...mockUser,
        tokenVersion: 2,
      });

      await expect(authService.refreshToken('old_refresh_token')).rejects.toThrow(
        UnauthorizedException,
      );
    });
  });

  describe('logout', () => {
    it('should increment tokenVersion to revoke all active sessions', async () => {
      prisma.user.update.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, tokenVersion: 2 });

      const response = await authService.logout(mockUser.id);

      expect(response).toEqual({ message: 'Signed out of all sessions' });
      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { id: mockUser.id },
        data: { tokenVersion: { increment: 1 } },
      });
    });
  });

  describe('changePassword', () => {
    it('should verify current password and increment tokenVersion on password update', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      prisma.user.update.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, tokenVersion: 2 });

      const response = await authService.changePassword(
        mockUser.id,
        'CorrectPassword123!',
        'NewStrongPassword456!',
      );

      expect(response).toEqual({ message: 'Password changed. Sign in again.' });
      expect(prisma.user.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { id: mockUser.id },
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            tokenVersion: { increment: 1 },
            mustChangePassword: false,
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('should throw BadRequestException if current password verification fails', async () => {
      prisma.user.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);

      await expect(
        authService.changePassword(mockUser.id, 'WrongCurrentPassword', 'NewPassword!'),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
  });
});
