import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { MpesaService } from '../modules/mpesa/mpesa.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../database/tenant.service';
import { FeesService } from '../modules/fees/fees.service';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PaymentMethod } from '@krypton/types';

describe('M-Pesa Service & Idempotency Suite', () => {
  let mpesaService: MpesaService;
  let prisma: any;
  let feesService: any;
  let tenantService: any;
  let configService: any;

  const mockPendingTransaction = {
    id: 'tx_mpesa_001',
    merchantRequestId: 'merchant_req_1',
    checkoutRequestId: 'ws_CO_01012025_12345678',
    amount: 1500000, // 15,000 KES in cents
    phoneNumber: '254712345678',
    status: 'PENDING',
    callbackReceived: false,
    invoiceId: 'inv_school_001',
    tenantId: 'school_1',
    initiatedBy: 'user_parent_01',
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      mpesaTransaction: {
        findFirst: jest.fn(),
        findUnique: jest.fn(),
        updateMany: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
        create: jest.fn(),
      },
    };

    feesService = {
      recordPayment: jest.fn(),
    };

    tenantService = {
      getTenantId: jest.fn().mockReturnValue('school_1'),
      setTenantId: jest.fn(),
    };

    configService = {
      get: jest.fn().mockImplementation((key, defaultVal) => defaultVal || ''),
    };

    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        MpesaService,
        { provide: PrismaService, useValue: prisma },
        { provide: TenantService, useValue: tenantService },
        { provide: FeesService, useValue: feesService },
        { provide: ConfigService, useValue: configService },
      ],
    }).compile();

    mpesaService = module.get<MpesaService>(MpesaService);
  });

  describe('handleSTKCallback', () => {
    const validCallbackDto = {
      Body: {
        stkCallback: {
          MerchantRequestID: 'merchant_req_1',
          CheckoutRequestID: 'ws_CO_01012025_12345678',
          ResultCode: 0,
          ResultDesc: 'The service request is processed successfully.',
          CallbackMetadata: {
            Item: [
              { Name: 'Amount', Value: 15000 },
              { Name: 'MpesaReceiptNumber', Value: 'QGH123XYZ' },
              { Name: 'TransactionDate', Value: 20261011120000 },
              { Name: 'PhoneNumber', Value: 254712345678 },
            ],
          },
        },
      },
    };

    it('should successfully complete transaction and auto-allocate fee payment atomically', async () => {
      prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(mockPendingTransaction);
      // Atomic CAS succeeds
      prisma.mpesaTransaction.updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 });
      feesService.recordPayment.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'pmt_fee_allocated_01' });
      prisma.mpesaTransaction.update.mockResolvedValue({
        ...mockPendingTransaction,
        status: 'COMPLETED',
        paymentId: 'pmt_fee_allocated_01',
      });

      await mpesaService.handleSTKCallback(validCallbackDto);

      // Verify atomic CAS check was performed
      expect(prisma.mpesaTransaction.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { id: mockPendingTransaction.id, callbackReceived: false },
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            status: 'COMPLETED',
            resultCode: 0,
            mpesaReceiptNumber: 'QGH123XYZ',
            callbackReceived: true,
          }),
        }),
      );

      // Verify payment was allocated to invoice
      expect(feesService.recordPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          invoiceId: 'inv_school_001',
          amount: 1500000,
          paymentMethod: PaymentMethod.MPESA,
          reference: 'QGH123XYZ',
        }),
        'user_parent_01',
      );

      // Verify payment link was saved
      expect(prisma.mpesaTransaction.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { id: mockPendingTransaction.id },
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            paymentId: 'pmt_fee_allocated_01',
            reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
          }),
        }),
      );
    });

    it('should safely drop concurrent duplicate callback without double-allocating fee payment', async () => {
      prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(mockPendingTransaction);
      // Atomic CAS returns count: 0 (another concurrent worker already processed it)
      prisma.mpesaTransaction.updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 });

      await mpesaService.handleSTKCallback(validCallbackDto);

      expect(prisma.mpesaTransaction.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      // FeesService MUST NOT be called a second time
      expect(feesService.recordPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(prisma.mpesaTransaction.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should reject callback if amount does not match original transaction', async () => {
      const tamperedDto = {
        Body: {
          stkCallback: {
            ...validCallbackDto.Body.stkCallback,
            CallbackMetadata: {
              Item: [
                { Name: 'Amount', Value: 500 }, // Underpaid or tampered
                { Name: 'MpesaReceiptNumber', Value: 'QGH123XYZ' },
                { Name: 'TransactionDate', Value: 20261011120000 },
                { Name: 'PhoneNumber', Value: 254712345678 },
              ],
            },
          },
        },
      };

      prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(mockPendingTransaction);

      await expect(mpesaService.handleSTKCallback(tamperedDto)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      expect(prisma.mpesaTransaction.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(feesService.recordPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should handle failed STK Push transaction gracefully', async () => {
      const failedCallbackDto = {
        Body: {
          stkCallback: {
            MerchantRequestID: 'merchant_req_1',
            CheckoutRequestID: 'ws_CO_01012025_12345678',
            ResultCode: 1032,
            ResultDesc: 'Request cancelled by user.',
          },
        },
      };

      prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(mockPendingTransaction);
      prisma.mpesaTransaction.update.mockResolvedValue({
        ...mockPendingTransaction,
        status: 'FAILED',
      });

      await mpesaService.handleSTKCallback(failedCallbackDto);

      expect(prisma.mpesaTransaction.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { id: mockPendingTransaction.id },
          data: expect.objectContaining({
            status: 'FAILED',
            resultCode: 1032,
            resultDesc: 'Request cancelled by user.',
            reconciliationStatus: 'FAILED',
          }),
        }),
      );
      expect(feesService.recordPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
});

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { StaffService } from '../modules/staff/staff.service';

import { TenantService } from '../database/tenant.service';
import { ConflictException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { StaffStatus, StaffDepartment, EmploymentType, Gender } from '@krypton/types';

describe('StaffService Multi-Tenant Suite', () => {
  let staffService: StaffService;
  let prisma: any;
  let tenantService: any;

  const mockStaffMember = {
    id: 'staff_uuid_001',
    tenantId: 'school_alpha_123',
    staffNumber: 'EMP-001',
    firstName: 'Peter',
    lastName: 'Mwangi',
    email: 'peter.mwangi@school.com',
    phone: '+254700112233',
    department: StaffDepartment.TEACHING,
    position: 'Senior Teacher',
    employmentType: EmploymentType.PERMANENT,
    status: StaffStatus.ACTIVE,
    hireDate: new Date('2024-01-15'),
    isTeacher: true,
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    prisma = {
      staff: {
        findFirst: jest.fn(),
        findMany: jest.fn(),
        count: jest.fn(),
        create: jest.fn(),
        update: jest.fn(),
      },
    };

    tenantService = {
      requireTenantContext: jest.fn().mockReturnValue('school_alpha_123'),

        position: 'Senior Teacher',

        gender: Gender.MALE,
        hireDate: '2024-01-15',
        isTeacher: true,
      } as any);

      expect(result).toBeDefined();
      expect(result.staffNumber).toBe('EMP-001');
      expect(prisma.staff.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

import { createTenantFilterMiddleware } from '@krypton/database';
import { TenantGuard } from '../common/guards/tenant.guard';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { UnauthorizedException, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TenantService } from '../database/tenant.service';

describe('Tenant Isolation Verification Suite', () => {
  describe('Prisma Tenant Filter Middleware', () => {
    let currentTenantId: string | null = null;
    const getTenantId = () => currentTenantId;
    const middleware = createTenantFilterMiddleware(getTenantId);

    beforeEach(() => {
      currentTenantId = 'school_alpha_123';
    });

    it('should inject tenantId into where clause for direct models on findMany', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
      const params = {
        model: 'Student' as any,
        action: 'findMany' as any,
        args: { where: { firstName: 'Alice' } },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await middleware(params, next);

      expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(params.args.where).toEqual({
        firstName: 'Alice',
        tenantId: 'school_alpha_123',
      });
    });

    it('should override cross-tenant where clause injection to enforce isolation', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
      const params = {
        model: 'Student' as any,
        action: 'findMany' as any,
        args: { where: { tenantId: 'school_beta_hacker' } },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await middleware(params, next);

      expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      // School A tenant context must override the malicious School B attempt
      expect(params.args.where.tenantId).toBe('school_alpha_123');
    });

    it('should convert findUnique to findFirst to enforce tenant scoping', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(null);
      const params = {
        model: 'Staff' as any,
        action: 'findUnique' as any,
        args: { where: { id: 'staff_999' } },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await middleware(params, next);

      expect(params.action).toBe('findFirst');
      expect(params.args.where).toEqual({
        id: 'staff_999',
        tenantId: 'school_alpha_123',
      });
      expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it('should reject cross-tenant creation with Forbidden Error', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn();
      const params = {
        model: 'Student' as any,
        action: 'create' as any,
        args: {
          data: {
            firstName: 'Bob',
            tenantId: 'school_beta_456', // Attempting to write into another school
          },
        },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await expect(middleware(params, next)).rejects.toThrow('Cross-tenant write denied');
      expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should assign current tenantId to created records when matching or omitted', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: 'rec_1' });
      const params = {
        model: 'Student' as any,
        action: 'create' as any,
        args: {
          data: {
            firstName: 'Charlie',
          },
        },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await middleware(params, next);

      expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect((params.args.data as any).tenantId).toBe('school_alpha_123');
    });

    it('should reject cross-tenant batch insertion in createMany', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn();
      const params = {
        model: 'Student' as any,
        action: 'createMany' as any,
        args: {
          data: [
            { firstName: 'Student 1', tenantId: 'school_alpha_123' },
            { firstName: 'Student 2', tenantId: 'school_beta_hacker' },
          ],
        },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await expect(middleware(params, next)).rejects.toThrow('Cross-tenant write denied');
      expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should reject tenant reassignment during update operations', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn();
      const params = {
        model: 'Staff' as any,
        action: 'update' as any,
        args: {
          where: { id: 'staff_1' },
          data: {
            tenantId: 'school_stolen_id',
          },
        },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await expect(middleware(params, next)).rejects.toThrow('Tenant reassignment denied');
      expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should bypass tenant filtering for exempt global models like Plan', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
      const params = {
        model: 'Plan' as any,
        action: 'findMany' as any,
        args: { where: { isActive: true } },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await middleware(params, next);

      expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(params.args.where).toEqual({ isActive: true });
    });

    it('should strictly isolate newly added models like ActivityFeed, NemisStudentRecord and ComplianceReport', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
      const sensitiveModels = ['ActivityFeed', 'NemisStudentRecord', 'ComplianceReport', 'MediaItem', 'ParentTeacherBooking'];

      for (const model of sensitiveModels) {
        const params = {
          model: model as any,
          action: 'findMany' as any,
          args: { where: {} },
          dataPath: [],
          runInTransaction: false,
        };

        await middleware(params, next);

        expect(params.args.where).toEqual({
          tenantId: 'school_alpha_123',
        });
      }
    });

    it('should reject adversarial cross-tenant creation on sensitive models', async () => {
      const next = jest.fn();
      const params = {
        model: 'NemisStudentRecord' as any,
        action: 'create' as any,
        args: {
          data: {
            upi: 'ABC1234XYZ',
            tenantId: 'school_beta_hacker',
          },
        },
        dataPath: [],
        runInTransaction: false,
      };

      await expect(middleware(params, next)).rejects.toThrow('Cross-tenant write denied');
      expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('TenantGuard Access Control', () => {
    let tenantGuard: TenantGuard;
    let tenantService: TenantService;
    let reflector: Reflector;

    beforeEach(() => {
      tenantService = new TenantService();
      reflector = new Reflector();
      tenantGuard = new TenantGuard(tenantService, reflector);
    });

    const mockExecutionContext = (req: any): ExecutionContext => ({
      switchToHttp: () => ({
        getRequest: () => req,
        getResponse: () => ({}) as any,
        getNext: () => ({}) as any,
      }),
      getHandler: () => (() => {}) as any,
      getClass: () => (() => {}) as any,
      getArgs: () => [] as any,
      getArgByIndex: () => ({}) as any,
      switchToRpc: () => ({}) as any,
      switchToWs: () => ({}) as any,
      getType: () => 'http' as any,
    });

    it('should allow request if route has skipTenantCheck decorator', () => {
      jest.spyOn(reflector, 'getAllAndOverride').mockReturnValue(true);
      const context = mockExecutionContext({});

      expect(tenantGuard.canActivate(context)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should allow SUPER_ADMIN role without tenant requirement', () => {
      jest.spyOn(reflector, 'getAllAndOverride').mockReturnValue(false);
      const context = mockExecutionContext({
        user: { role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', email: 'super@krypton.io' },
      });

      expect(tenantGuard.canActivate(context)).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should resolve tenant from authenticated user context if not set', () => {
      jest.spyOn(reflector, 'getAllAndOverride').mockReturnValue(false);
      const context = mockExecutionContext({
        user: { role: 'SCHOOL_ADMIN', tenantId: 'school_authenticated_42' },
      });

      expect(tenantGuard.canActivate(context)).toBe(true);
      expect(tenantService.getTenantId()).toBe('school_authenticated_42');
    });

    it('should reject request with UnauthorizedException if no tenant context exists', () => {
      jest.spyOn(reflector, 'getAllAndOverride').mockReturnValue(false);
      const context = mockExecutionContext({
        user: { role: 'TEACHER' }, // No tenantId on user and none in service
      });

      expect(() => tenantGuard.canActivate(context)).toThrow(UnauthorizedException);
    });
  });
});

File: apps/web/public/sw.js
================
const CACHE='krypton-static-v2';
self.addEventListener('install',event=>{event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE).then(cache=>cache.addAll(['/brand.svg','/offline.html'])));self.skipWaiting();});
self.addEventListener('activate',event=>{event.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(keys=>Promise.all(keys.filter(key=>key.startsWith('krypton-')&&key!==CACHE).map(key=>caches.delete(key)))).then(()=>self.clients.claim()));});
self.addEventListener('fetch',event=>{
 const request=event.request;const url=new URL(request.url);
 // Never retain authenticated pages, API responses, or user records in shared browser caches.
 if(request.method!=='GET'||url.origin!==self.location.origin||url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')||request.headers.has('Authorization'))return;
 if(request.mode==='navigate'){event.respondWith(fetch(request).catch(()=>caches.match('/offline.html')));return;}
 if(url.pathname!=='/brand.svg'&&!url.pathname.startsWith('/_next/static/'))return;
 event.respondWith(caches.open(CACHE).then(async cache=>{const cached=await cache.match(request);if(cached)return cached;const response=await fetch(request);if(response.ok)await cache.put(request,response.clone());return response;}));
});
self.addEventListener('message',event=>{if(event.data?.type==='SKIP_WAITING')self.skipWaiting();});

# Krypton School ERP - Parent Portal

A Progressive Web App (PWA) for parents to access their children's school information, pay fees, view grades, and track attendance.

## Features

### ✅ Completed Features

#### Authentication
- [x] Login with email/password
- [x] JWT token-based authentication
- [x] Automatic token refresh
- [x] Protected routes with role-based access control
- [x] Logout functionality

#### Dashboard
- [x] Overview of fee balance, attendance rate, and recent grades
- [x] Quick actions for common tasks
- [x] Student selector for parents with multiple children
- [x] Real-time data updates

#### Fee Management
- [x] View outstanding invoices
- [x] Payment history
- [x] M-Pesa STK Push integration
- [x] Pay fees directly from phone
- [x] Downloadable receipts
- [x] Fee balance tracking
- [x] Invoice details

#### Attendance
- [x] Calendar view of attendance
- [x] Monthly navigation
- [x] Status indicators (Present, Absent, Late, Excused)
- [x] Attendance statistics
- [x] Detailed records

#### Grades & Report Cards
- [x] View grades by term
- [x] Report card viewing
- [x] Performance statistics
- [x] Subject-wise grades
- [x] Teacher and principal comments
- [x] Download report cards (PDF ready)

#### Notifications
- [x] Fee reminders
- [x] Absence alerts
- [x] Payment receipts
- [x] Exam schedules
- [x] General announcements
- [x] Read/unread status
- [x] Priority indicators

#### PWA Features
- [x] Installable as native app
- [x] Offline support with service worker
- [x] Caching strategy (cache-first for static, network-first for API)
- [x] Background sync for offline actions
- [x] Push notifications support
- [x] App update prompts
- [x] Offline indicator
- [x] Install prompt

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **State Management:** React Context + Zustand
- **API Client:** Axios
- **Date Utilities:** date-fns
- **Icons:** Lucide React
- **PWA:** Custom service worker

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+
- pnpm 8+
- Access to Krypton School ERP API

### Installation

1. Install dependencies:
```bash
pnpm install
```

2. Create environment file:
```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

3. Configure environment variables:
```env
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001
```

4. Run development server:
```bash
pnpm dev
```

5. Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)

### Demo Credentials

```
Email: parent@demoacademy.ac.ke
Password: Parent@123
```

## API Integration

The parent portal connects to the Krypton School ERP backend API:

### Endpoints Used

- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` - User authentication
- `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` - Token refresh
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` - User logout
- `GET /api/v1/students/my-children` - Get linked children
- `GET /api/v1/students/:id` - Get student details
- `GET /api/v1/fees/invoices` - Get invoices
- `GET /api/v1/fees/payments` - Get payments
- `POST /api/v1/mpesa/stk-push` - Initiate M-Pesa payment
- `GET /api/v1/attendance/students` - Get attendance
- `GET /api/v1/attendance/students/report` - Get attendance summary
- `GET /api/v1/examinations/grades/query` - Get grades
- `GET /api/v1/examinations/report-cards` - Get report cards

### API Client Features

- Automatic JWT token injection
- Token refresh on 401 errors
- Request/response interceptors
- Error handling
- Retry logic

## PWA Features

### Service Worker

The app includes a custom service worker (`public/sw.js`) that provides:

- **Caching Strategies:**
  - Static assets: Cache-first
  - API requests: Network-first with cache fallback
  - Navigation requests: Network with offline fallback

- **Offline Support:**
  - Cached API responses available offline
  - Graceful degradation
  - Offline indicator

- **Background Sync:**
  - Queue failed requests
  - Retry when connection restored

- **Push Notifications:**
  - Fee reminders
  - Absence alerts
  - Payment confirmations

### Installation

The app can be installed on:
- Android (Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet)
- iOS (Safari 16.4+)
- Desktop (Chrome, Edge)

### Offline Capabilities

When offline, users can:
- ✅ View cached dashboard data
- ✅ View cached attendance records
- ✅ View cached grades
- ✅ View cached invoices
- ❌ Make M-Pesa payments (requires online)
- ❌ Load new data (requires online)

## Mobile-First Design

The app is optimized for mobile devices:

- **Touch-friendly:** 44px minimum tap areas
- **Responsive:** Works on all screen sizes
- **Fast:** Optimized bundle size
- **Accessible:** ARIA labels, keyboard navigation
- **Safe areas:** iOS notch support
- **Bottom navigation:** Easy thumb access

## Security

- JWT token authentication
- Automatic token refresh
- Secure token storage (localStorage with httpOnly cookie planned)
- Role-based access control
- Input validation
- XSS protection
- CSRF protection (API level)

## Performance

- **Lighthouse Score:** 95+ (target)
- **First Contentful Paint:** < 1.5s
- **Time to Interactive:** < 3.5s
- **Code splitting:** Automatic route-based
- **Image optimization:** Next.js built-in
- **Bundle size:** < 200KB (gzipped)

## Troubleshooting

### Service Worker Not Registering

1. Check HTTPS (required for PWA)
2. Clear browser cache
3. Check console for errors
4. Verify `sw.js` is accessible

### Offline Mode Not Working

1. Check service worker status
2. Verify cache is populated
3. Test network throttling
4. Check cache strategies

### M-Pesa Payment Issues

1. Verify API endpoint is correct
2. Check phone number format (254XXXXXXXXX)
3. Ensure M-Pesa credentials configured
4. Test with small amount first

### Authentication Issues

1. Check token expiry
2. Verify refresh token works
3. Clear localStorage
4. Re-login

'use client';
import {useState} from 'react';
import {useRouter} from 'next/navigation';
import {useAuth} from '@/contexts/AuthContext';
import {ProtectedRoute} from '@/components/ProtectedRoute';
import {PageHeading,Panel} from '@/components/WorkspaceUI';
import {Button,Input} from '@/components/ui';
import {apiClient} from '@/lib/api-client';
import {clearSession,homeForRole} from '@/lib/session';
import {messageFor} from '@/lib/workspace';
export default function AccountPage(){
 const {user}=useAuth();const router=useRouter();const [current,setCurrent]=useState('');const [next,setNext]=useState('');const [confirm,setConfirm]=useState('');const [error,setError]=useState('');const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false);
 async function submit(e:React.FormEvent){e.preventDefault();setError('');if(next!==confirm){setError('The new passwords do not match.');return;}setBusy(true);try{await apiClient.post('/auth/password',{currentPassword:current,newPassword:next});clearSession();window.location.assign('/login');}catch(err){setError(messageFor(err));}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 return <ProtectedRoute><main className="page-content max-w-3xl"><PageHeading title="Your account" description="Manage your access to the school workspace." actions={<Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={()=>router.push(homeForRole(user?.role||''))}>Back to workspace</Button>}/><div className="content-stack"><Panel title="Profile"><div className="panel-body"><h2>{user?.firstName} {user?.lastName}</h2><p className="muted text-sm mt-2">{user?.email}</p><span className="pill mt-4">{user?.role.replaceAll('_',' ').toLowerCase()}</span></div></Panel><Panel title="Change password" subtitle="Changing your password signs out all existing sessions"><form className="panel-body space-y-5" onSubmit={submit}>{error&&<div className="state-box" role="alert">{error}</div>}<Input label="Current password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" required value={current} onChange={e=>setCurrent(e.target.value)}/><Input label="New password" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" required minLength={12} maxLength={128} value={next} onChange={e=>setNext(e.target.value)} helpText="Use at least 12 characters."/><Input label="Confirm new password" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" required minLength={12} value={confirm} onChange={e=>setConfirm(e.target.value)}/><Button type="submit" isLoading={busy}>Change password</Button></form></Panel></div></main></ProtectedRoute>;
}

File: apps/web/src/app/api/admissions/[id]/admit/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { admissionsClient } from '@/lib/admissions-client';

export async function POST(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const body = await request.json();

    const updated = admissionsClient.completeAdmission(id, body, body.actor);
    if (!updated) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: 'Application not found' },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: updated,
      message: 'Student officially admitted and enrolled successfully',
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to complete admission' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { admissionsClient } from '@/lib/admissions-client';

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const search = searchParams.get('search') || undefined;
    const stage = (searchParams.get('stage') as any) || undefined;
    const grade = searchParams.get('grade') || undefined;
    const priority = searchParams.get('priority') || undefined;
    const source = searchParams.get('source') || undefined;

    const applications = admissionsClient.getApplications({
      search,
      stage,
      grade,
      priority,
      source,
    });

    const stats = admissionsClient.getFunnelStats();

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        applications,
        stats,
      },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to fetch admissions' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const created = admissionsClient.createApplication(body);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: created,
      message: 'Admission application created successfully',
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to submit admission application' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
}

File: apps/web/src/app/api/ptm/batch/route.ts
================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { VirtualPTMService } from '@/lib/virtual-ptm-client';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { teacherId, teacherName, teacherSubject, grade, date, startTime, endTime, slotDurationMinutes, bufferMinutes } = body;

    if (!teacherId || !grade || !date || !startTime || !endTime) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Missing batch parameters' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const createdSlots = VirtualPTMService.generateBatchSlots({
      teacherId,
      teacherName: teacherName || 'Teacher',
      teacherSubject: teacherSubject || 'General',
      grade,
      date,
      startTime,
      endTime,
      slotDurationMinutes: Number(slotDurationMinutes) || 15,
      bufferMinutes: Number(bufferMinutes) || 5,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: createdSlots.length, slots: createdSlots }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { VirtualPTMService } from '@/lib/virtual-ptm-client';
import { PTMBookSlotRequest } from '@krypton/types';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = (await request.json()) as PTMBookSlotRequest;
    if (!body.slotId || !body.studentId || !body.parentId || !body.parentPhone) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Missing booking details' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const bookedSlot = VirtualPTMService.bookSlot(body);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, slot: bookedSlot });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message || 'Booking failed' }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { VirtualPTMService } from '@/lib/virtual-ptm-client';

export async function GET(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    let slot = VirtualPTMService.getSlotById(id);
    if (!slot) {
      slot = VirtualPTMService.getSlotByCode(id);
    }

    if (!slot) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Slot not found' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, slot });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function PATCH(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const body = await request.json();
    const updated = VirtualPTMService.updateSlot(id, body);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, slot: updated });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const cancelled = VirtualPTMService.cancelSlot(id);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, slot: cancelled });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { VirtualPTMService } from '@/lib/virtual-ptm-client';
import { PTMCreateSlotRequest, PTMScheduleFilter } from '@krypton/types';

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const filter: PTMScheduleFilter = {
      date: searchParams.get('date') || undefined,
      grade: searchParams.get('grade') || undefined,
      status: (searchParams.get('status') as any) || undefined,
      teacherId: searchParams.get('teacherId') || undefined,
      search: searchParams.get('search') || undefined,
    };

    const slots = VirtualPTMService.getSlots(filter);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, slots });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to fetch slots' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = (await request.json()) as PTMCreateSlotRequest;
    if (!body.title || !body.date || !body.startTime || !body.endTime || !body.teacherId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Missing required slot fields' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const newSlot = VirtualPTMService.createSlot(body);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, slot: newSlot }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to create slot' }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { VirtualPTMService } from '@/lib/virtual-ptm-client';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { slotId, recipientPhone, recipientName } = await request.json();

    const slot = VirtualPTMService.getSlotById(slotId);
    if (!slot) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Slot not found' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const meetingLink = `https://school.krypton.ke/ptm/room/${slot.meetingCode}`;
    const textMessage = `*Krypton School ERP - Official PTM Invitation*\n\n` +
      `Dear ${recipientName || slot.parentName || 'Parent'},\n` +
      `Your Virtual Parent-Teacher Meeting with *${slot.teacherName}* is confirmed.\n\n` +
      `🗓 *Date:* ${slot.date}\n` +
      `⏰ *Time:* ${slot.startTime} - ${slot.endTime} (EAT)\n` +
      `🎓 *Student:* ${slot.studentName || 'Student'} (${slot.grade})\n` +
      `🔗 *Meeting Link:* ${meetingLink}\n` +
      `🔑 *Meeting ID:* ${slot.meetingCode}\n` +
      `🔒 *Passcode:* ${slot.meetingPin}\n\n` +
      `_Please join 3 minutes before your slot. You will enter the virtual waiting room until the teacher admits you._`;

    // Simulated cloud messaging response
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      delivered: true,
      messageId: `wamid_${Date.now()}_ptm`,
      phone: recipientPhone || slot.parentPhone,
      messagePreview: textMessage,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { smartSubstitutionApi } from '@/lib/substitution-client';
import { AssignProxyRequestDto } from '@krypton/types';

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const date = searchParams.get('date') || undefined;
    const teacherId = searchParams.get('teacherId') || undefined;

    const assignments = smartSubstitutionApi.getAssignments(date, teacherId);
    const notifications = smartSubstitutionApi.getNotificationLogs(teacherId);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        assignments,
        notifications,
      },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to fetch assignments' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = (await request.json()) as AssignProxyRequestDto;
    const assignment = smartSubstitutionApi.assignProxy(body);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: `Proxy assigned to ${assignment.substituteTeacherName} for ${assignment.className} - ${assignment.periodName}. Instant notification sent.`,
      data: assignment,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to assign proxy' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { assignmentId, action, remarks } = body;

    if (!assignmentId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'assignmentId is required' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (action === 'ACKNOWLEDGE') {
      const updated = smartSubstitutionApi.acknowledgeAssignment(assignmentId, remarks);
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Substitution duty acknowledged successfully',
        data: updated,
      });
    }

    if (action === 'COMPLETE') {
      const updated = smartSubstitutionApi.completeAssignment(assignmentId, remarks);
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Substitution marked as completed',
        data: updated,
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: 'Invalid action. Expected ACKNOWLEDGE or COMPLETE' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to update assignment status' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { smartSubstitutionApi } from '@/lib/substitution-client';

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const date = searchParams.get('date') || undefined;

    const vacantPeriods = smartSubstitutionApi.getVacantPeriods(date);
    const summary = smartSubstitutionApi.getDailySummary(date);
    const absentTeachers = smartSubstitutionApi.getAbsentTeachers(date);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        summary,
        absentTeachers,
        vacantPeriods,
      },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to fetch substitution engine state' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();

    // Mode 1: Auto-assign all vacant periods
    if (body.action === 'AUTO_ASSIGN_ALL') {
      const result = smartSubstitutionApi.autoAssignAllProxies(body.date);
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: `Successfully auto-assigned ${result.newAssignmentsCount} proxy periods with instant notifications.`,
        data: result,
      });
    }

    // Mode 2: Get recommended candidates for a specific period
    if (body.action === 'GET_CANDIDATES' && body.period) {
      const candidates = smartSubstitutionApi.getRecommendedCandidates(body.period, body.date);
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        data: candidates,
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: 'Invalid action. Expected AUTO_ASSIGN_ALL or GET_CANDIDATES' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to process substitution engine request' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { smartSubstitutionApi } from '@/lib/substitution-client';

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const date = searchParams.get('date') || undefined;

    const allTeachers = smartSubstitutionApi.getAllTeachers();
    const absentTeachers = smartSubstitutionApi.getAbsentTeachers(date);
    const absentIds = new Set(absentTeachers.map((a) => a.teacherId));

    const teachersWithStatus = allTeachers.map((teacher) => {
      const schedule = smartSubstitutionApi.getTeacherRegularSchedule(teacher.id);
      const isAbsent = absentIds.has(teacher.id);
      const absentInfo = absentTeachers.find((a) => a.teacherId === teacher.id);

      return {
        ...teacher,
        isAbsent,
        absentReason: absentInfo?.absenceReason,
        periodsCountToday: schedule.length,
        schedule,
      };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: teachersWithStatus,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to fetch teachers' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { teacherId, reason, date } = body;

    if (!teacherId || !reason) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: 'teacherId and reason are required' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const absentSchedule = smartSubstitutionApi.reportTeacherAbsence(teacherId, reason, date);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: `Teacher reported absent. ${absentSchedule.totalPeriodsToCover} periods registered for substitution.`,
      data: absentSchedule,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to report teacher absence' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const teacherId = searchParams.get('teacherId');
    const date = searchParams.get('date') || undefined;

    if (!teacherId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: 'teacherId is required' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    smartSubstitutionApi.cancelTeacherAbsence(teacherId, date);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Teacher absence cancelled and reverted to present.',
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: error.message || 'Failed to cancel absence' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

                        {rec.studentName}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-4">{rec.className}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono">{rec.issueDate}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                        {rec.verificationHash}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
                          {rec.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSelectedStudentId(rec.studentId);
                            setActiveTab(rec.certificateType);
                          }}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors"
                        >
                          View & Print
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Verification Modal */}
      <CertificateVerificationModal
        isOpen={isVerifierOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsVerifierOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Settings Modal */}
      <CertificateSettingsModal
        isOpen={isSettingsOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
        settings={schoolSettings}
        onSave={(updated) => setSchoolSettings(certificateApi.updateSchoolSettings(updated))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  const [studentName, setStudentName] = useState('Alan Kiprop');
  const [admissionNumber, setAdmissionNumber] = useState('ADM-2024-0089');
  const [parentDiscussionNotes, setParentDiscussionNotes] = useState('');
  const [isBooking, setIsBooking] = useState(false);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3500);
  };

  const loadSlots = () => {
    const list = VirtualPTMService.getSlots();
    setSlots(list);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSlots();
  }, []);

  const handleBookSlot = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedSlotToBook) return;

    setIsBooking(true);
    try {
      const booked = VirtualPTMService.bookSlot({
        slotId: selectedSlotToBook.id,
        studentId: 'std-1001',
        studentName,
        admissionNumber,
        parentId: 'par-501',
        parentName,
        parentPhone,
        parentEmail,
        parentNotes: parentDiscussionNotes,
      });

      setSelectedSlotToBook(null);
      loadSlots();
      showToast(`PTM meeting confirmed with ${booked.teacherName} on ${booked.date}!`);
      setParentDiscussionNotes('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast('Booking failed: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsBooking(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelBooking = (slotId: string) => {
    if (confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this scheduled consultation?')) {
      VirtualPTMService.cancelSlot(slotId, 'Cancelled by parent');
      loadSlots();
      showToast('Meeting cancelled successfully.');
    }
  };

  // Divide slots into "My Scheduled PTMs" and "Available to Book"
  const myBookedSlots = slots.filter(s => s.status === 'BOOKED' || s.status === 'WAITING' || s.status === 'IN_PROGRESS');
  const availableSlots = slots.filter(s => s.status === 'AVAILABLE');
  const pastSlots = slots.filter(s => s.status === 'COMPLETED');

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 pb-20">
      {/* Toast Alert */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed top-20 right-6 z-50 bg-indigo-600 text-white px-5 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center space-x-2 border border-indigo-400">
          <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
          </svg>
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900 via-indigo-800 to-slate-900 text-white pt-8 pb-12 px-6">
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/30 text-emerald-300 text-xs font-semibold mb-3">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                <span>Virtual Parent-Teacher Meetings</span>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
                Virtual PTM & Consultation Hub
              </h1>
              <p className="text-sm text-indigo-200 mt-2 max-w-xl">
                Connect directly with your child’s teachers from home or office through encrypted video meetings. Review CBC assessments, discuss homework, and agree on personalized academic progress goals.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/10 text-right">
              <div className="text-xs text-indigo-200">Active Student</div>
              <div className="text-lg font-bold text-white mt-0.5">Alan Kiprop Wanjiku</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-emerald-300 font-medium">Grade 7A (CBC Junior Secondary)</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 -mt-6 space-y-8">
        {/* ======================================================== */}
        {/* 1. MY UPCOMING SCHEDULED PTMS */}
        {/* ======================================================== */}
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-600" />
              <span>My Scheduled Consultation Meetings</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">{myBookedSlots.length} active sessions</span>
          </div>

          {myBookedSlots.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 text-center border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
                <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800">No Scheduled Meetings</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto mt-1">
                You have not booked any parent-teacher meetings yet. Select an available slot below to connect with your child's teachers.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
              {myBookedSlots.map(slot => (
                <div
                  key={slot.id}
                  className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border-2 border-indigo-500/20 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-100 hover:border-indigo-500 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between"
                >
                  <div>
                    {/* Status badge & time */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                      <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-xs font-bold border border-indigo-100">
                        {slot.date} • {slot.startTime} - {slot.endTime}
                      </span>
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold animate-pulse">
                        ● Confirmed
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-base leading-snug">
                      {slot.title}
                    </h3>

                    {/* Teacher profile pill */}
                    <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-sm">
                          {slot.teacherName.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900">{slot.teacherName}</div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">{slot.teacherSubject}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600">{slot.grade}</span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Meeting Credentials */}
                    <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-indigo-950/5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px] block">Meeting Code:</span>
                        <strong className="text-indigo-700">{slot.meetingCode}</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px] block">Passcode PIN:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-800">{slot.meetingPin}</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Parent Discussion Note preview */}
                    {slot.parentNotes && (
                      <div className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-600 italic bg-slate-50 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100">
                        "Your note: {slot.parentNotes}"
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Actions */}
                  <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-col space-y-2">
                    <Link
                      href={`/ptm/room/${slot.meetingCode}`}
                      className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 hover:from-indigo-700 hover:to-violet-700 text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wide shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                    >
                      <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                      </svg>
                      <span>Join Virtual Meeting Room</span>
                    </Link>

                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => VirtualPTMService.downloadIcs(slot)}
                        className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <span>📅 Add to Calendar (.ICS)</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleCancelBooking(slot.id)}
                        className="py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 font-semibold text-xs transition-colors"
                      >
                        Cancel
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ======================================================== */}
        {/* 2. AVAILABLE SLOTS FOR PARENT TO BOOK */}
        {/* ======================================================== */}
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
              <span>Available Consultation Slots (Open for Booking)</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">{availableSlots.length} slots open</span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
            {availableSlots.map(slot => (
              <div
                key={slot.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 text-xs font-bold">
                      Available Slot
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600">{slot.grade}</span>
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm mt-1">{slot.title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 line-clamp-2">{slot.description}</p>

                  <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 space-y-1 text-xs">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-slate-500">Teacher:</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-800">{slot.teacherName}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-slate-500">Subject:</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-700">{slot.teacherSubject}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-slate-500">Date:</span>
                      <strong className="text-indigo-600">{slot.date}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-slate-500">Time:</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-700">{slot.startTime} - {slot.endTime} ({slot.durationMinutes}m)</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSelectedSlotToBook(slot)}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
                  >
                    <span>Book Consultation Slot</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ======================================================== */}
        {/* 3. PAST COMPLETED PTMS & MINUTES */}
        {/* ======================================================== */}
        {pastSlots.length > 0 && (
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-slate-400" />
              <span>Past Meetings & Progress Notes History</span>
            </h2>

            <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
              {pastSlots.map(slot => (
                <div key={slot.id} className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-2 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{slot.title}</h4>
                      <p className="text-slate-500">With {slot.teacherName} • Completed on {slot.date}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 font-bold">
                      Completed
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {slot.teacherNotes && (
                    <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-700">
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 block mb-0.5">Teacher Progress Notes:</strong>
                      <p>{slot.teacherNotes}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {slot.actionItems && slot.actionItems.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="bg-indigo-50/60 p-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 text-indigo-900">
                      <strong className="block mb-1">Agreed Joint Action Items:</strong>
                      <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-0.5">
                        {slot.actionItems.map((item, idx) => (
                          <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* BOOKING MODAL */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {selectedSlotToBook && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Confirm PTM Slot Booking</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Virtual consultation with {selectedSlotToBook.teacherName}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedSlotToBook(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 text-lg p-1"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleBookSlot} className="mt-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100">
                <div className="font-bold text-indigo-900 text-sm">{selectedSlotToBook.title}</div>
                <div className="text-indigo-700 mt-0.5">
                  🗓 {selectedSlotToBook.date} • ⏰ {selectedSlotToBook.startTime} - {selectedSlotToBook.endTime}
                </div>
                <div className="text-indigo-600 mt-1">
                  Educator: {selectedSlotToBook.teacherName} ({selectedSlotToBook.teacherSubject})
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Student Name:</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={studentName}
                    onChange={e => setStudentName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Admission No:</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={admissionNumber}
                    onChange={e => setAdmissionNumber(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Parent / Guardian:</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={parentName}
                    onChange={e => setParentName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">WhatsApp / Phone:</label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={parentPhone}
                    onChange={e => setParentPhone(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Topics or Questions for the Teacher:</label>
                <textarea
                  value={parentDiscussionNotes}
                  onChange={e => setParentDiscussionNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Discuss Term 3 algebra score, homework habits, preparation for national assessment..."
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3 text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedSlotToBook(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isBooking}
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-semibold shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30"
                >
                  {isBooking ? 'Confirming...' : 'Confirm Booking'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

              </div>

              {isActive && (
                <div className="w-full h-1 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full mt-3" />
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Tab Panels */}
      <div className="transition-all animate-in fade-in">
        {activeTab === 'STAFF_GEOFENCE' && <StaffGeofenceCheckIn />}
        {activeTab === 'STUDENT_QR' && <StudentQRScannerAndIDCard />}

}

File: apps/web/src/app/driver/page.tsx
