'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Bus,
  Play,
  Square,
  Pause,
  MapPin,
  CheckCircle,
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  Phone,
  AlertTriangle,
  RotateCcw,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronRight,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowLeft,
  Smartphone,
  Navigation,
  Compass,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  transportApi,
  DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES,
  calculateDistanceKm,
} from '@/lib/transport-client';
import {
  TransportTrip,
  TransportRoute,
  StudentTransitStatus,
  RouteDirection,
} from '@krypton/types';
import { LiveBusMap } from '@/components/transport/LiveBusMap';

export default function DriverAppPage() {
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<TransportRoute[]>(DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES);
  const [selectedRouteId, setSelectedRouteId] = useState<string>('route-01');
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<RouteDirection>('MORNING_PICKUP');
  const [trip, setTrip] = useState<TransportTrip | null>(null);

  // GPS Beacon state
  const [isBroadcasting, setIsBroadcasting] = useState(false);
  const [isSimulated, setIsSimulated] = useState(false);
  const [gpsError, setGpsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastPingTime, setLastPingTime] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  const [currentSpeed, setCurrentSpeed] = useState<number>(0);
  const [currentHeading, setCurrentHeading] = useState<number>(65);
  const [accuracy, setAccuracy] = useState<number>(3);
  const [activeStopIndex, setActiveStopIndex] = useState(0);
  const [delayNotice, setDelayNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const watchIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const simIntervalRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const simStepRef = useRef(0);

  const currentRoute = routes.find((r) => r.id === selectedRouteId) || routes[0];
  const currentStop = currentRoute.stops[activeStopIndex] || currentRoute.stops[0];

  // Load or initialize trip
  const refreshTrip = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const active = await transportApi.getActiveTrip(selectedRouteId);
      setTrip(active);
      if (active.status === 'IN_TRANSIT') {
        setIsBroadcasting(true);
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }
  }, [selectedRouteId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshTrip();
  }, [refreshTrip]);

  // Handle Real Device HTML5 Geolocation Watch
  const startRealGpsWatch = useCallback(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {
      setGpsError('Geolocation is not supported by your browser.');
      return;
    }

    setGpsError(null);

    try {
      const id = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
        async (position) => {
          const { latitude, longitude, speed, heading, accuracy: acc } = position.coords;
          const spdKmH = speed ? Math.round(speed * 3.6) : 32;
          const headDeg = heading !== null && !isNaN(heading) ? Math.round(heading) : 70;

          setCurrentSpeed(spdKmH);
          setCurrentHeading(headDeg);
          setAccuracy(Math.round(acc || 4));
          setLastPingTime(new Date());

          if (trip) {
            const updated = await transportApi.sendLocationPing({
              tripId: trip.id,
              latitude,
              longitude,
              speed: spdKmH,
              heading: headDeg,
              accuracy: Math.round(acc || 4),
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            });
            setTrip(updated);
          }
        },
        (error) => {
          console.warn('Geolocation watch error:', error.message);
          setGpsError(`GPS Notice: ${error.message}. You can switch to Simulated Drive.`);
        },
        {
          enableHighAccuracy: true,
          maximumAge: 3000,
          timeout: 10000,
        }
      );

      watchIdRef.current = id;
    } catch (e: any) {
      setGpsError(`GPS activation error: ${e?.message}`);
    }
  }, [trip]);

  // Handle Simulation Mode
  const startSimulation = useCallback(() => {
    if (simIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(simIntervalRef.current);

    const stops = currentRoute.stops;
    let step = simStepRef.current;

    simIntervalRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
      step = (step + 1) % 40;
      simStepRef.current = step;

      const stopIdx = Math.min(Math.floor((step / 40) * stops.length), stops.length - 1);
      const nextIdx = Math.min(stopIdx + 1, stops.length - 1);

      const fromStop = stops[stopIdx];
      const toStop = stops[nextIdx];

      const fraction = (step % (40 / stops.length)) / (40 / stops.length);

      const lat = fromStop.latitude + (toStop.latitude - fromStop.latitude) * fraction;
      const lng = fromStop.longitude + (toStop.longitude - fromStop.longitude) * fraction;

      const simSpeed = step % 8 === 0 ? 0 : 38 + (step % 5) * 2;
      const simHeading = 68 + (step % 12);

      setCurrentSpeed(simSpeed);
      setCurrentHeading(simHeading);
      setAccuracy(3);
      setLastPingTime(new Date());

      if (trip) {
        const updated = await transportApi.sendLocationPing({
          tripId: trip.id,
          latitude: lat,
          longitude: lng,
          speed: simSpeed,
          heading: simHeading,
          accuracy: 3,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        setTrip(updated);
      }
    }, 2500);
  }, [currentRoute, trip]);

  // Start Route Button Handler
  const handleStartRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newTrip = await transportApi.startTrip({
        routeId: selectedRouteId,
        direction,
        driverName: currentRoute.driverName,
        driverPhone: currentRoute.driverPhone,
        vehicleRegistration: currentRoute.vehicleRegistration,
      });

      setTrip(newTrip);
      setIsBroadcasting(true);

      if (isSimulated) {
        startSimulation();
      } else {
        startRealGpsWatch();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Error starting route: ${err?.message}`);
    }
  };

  // End Route Button Handler
  const handleEndRoute = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to end this route trip? (യാത്ര അവസാനിപ്പിക്കണോ?)')) {
      return;
    }

    if (watchIdRef.current !== null && navigator.geolocation) {
      navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchIdRef.current);
      watchIdRef.current = null;
    }

    if (simIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(simIntervalRef.current);
      simIntervalRef.current = null;
    }

    setIsBroadcasting(false);

    if (trip) {
      const ended = await transportApi.endTrip(trip.id);
      setTrip(ended);
    }
  };

  // Toggle student boarding status
  const handleStudentStatus = async (studentId: string, status: StudentTransitStatus) => {
    if (!trip) return;
    try {
      const updated = await transportApi.updateStudentStatus({
        tripId: trip.id,
        studentId,
        stopId: currentStop.id,
        status,
      });
      setTrip(updated);
    } catch {}
  };

  // Mark all students at current stop as boarded
  const handleMarkAllStopBoarded = async () => {
    if (!trip) return;
    const studentsAtStop = trip.students.filter((s) => s.stopId === currentStop.id);
    for (const student of studentsAtStop) {
      await handleStudentStatus(student.id, 'BOARDED');
    }
  };

  // Cleanup watchers on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (watchIdRef.current !== null && navigator.geolocation) {
        navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchIdRef.current);
      }
      if (simIntervalRef.current) {
        clearInterval(simIntervalRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // Filter students for currently selected stop
  const studentsAtCurrentStop = trip?.students.filter((s) => s.stopId === currentStop.id) || [];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex flex-col">
      {/* Top Mobile App Bar */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link
              href="/school/transport"
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
              title="Back to Transport Center"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={18} />
            </Link>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  Krypton Bus Pilot
                </h1>
                <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 font-medium">
                  സീറോ ഹാർഡ്വെയർ
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {currentRoute.vehicleRegistration} • {currentRoute.driverName}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Link
              href="/dashboard/transport"
              target="_blank"
              className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-blue-400 border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
            >
              <span>Parent View</span>
              <ChevronRight size={14} />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Container */}
      <main className="flex-1 max-w-2xl w-full mx-auto p-4 space-y-4">
        {/* GPS Mode & Route Selector Card */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 shadow-xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
              1. റൂട്ട് തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക (Route)
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-950 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
              <button
                onClick={() => setDirection('MORNING_PICKUP')}
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  direction === 'MORNING_PICKUP'
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                Morning Pickup
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setDirection('EVENING_DROPOFF')}
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  direction === 'EVENING_DROPOFF'
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                Evening Drop
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {routes.map((r) => (
              <button
                key={r.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (isBroadcasting) {
                    alert('Please end the current route before switching routes.');
                    return;
                  }
                  setSelectedRouteId(r.id);
                  setActiveStopIndex(0);
                }}
                className={`text-left p-3 rounded-xl border transition ${
                  selectedRouteId === r.id
                    ? 'bg-blue-600/15 border-blue-500/80 text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/40'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-200">{r.code}</span>
                  <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 font-mono">
                    {r.vehicleRegistration}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 mt-1 truncate">{r.name}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">{r.nameMl}</p>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* GPS Mode Toggle: Real Smartphone vs Simulation */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-300">
              <Smartphone size={15} className="text-blue-400" />
              <span>GPS Beacon Mode:</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsSimulated(false)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  !isSimulated ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                📡 Device GPS (HTML5)
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setIsSimulated(true)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  isSimulated ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
                title="Automated route traversal for demonstration/testing"
              >
                🚗 Demo Simulator
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* GPS Broadcast & Big Beacon Control Action */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-5 border border-slate-800 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden">
          {/* Status Indicator Pill */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div
                className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full ${
                  isBroadcasting
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500 animate-ping'
                    : 'bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              />
              <span className="text-sm font-bold tracking-wide">
                {isBroadcasting
                  ? '🟢 GPS BROADCASTING LIVE (യാത്ര പുരോഗമിക്കുന്നു)'
                  : '⚪ ROUTE STANDBY (യാത്ര ആരംഭിച്ചിട്ടില്ല)'}
              </span>
            </div>

            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
              {isSimulated ? 'TEST SIMULATOR' : 'HARDWARE-FREE GPS'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Speed & Beacon Metrics HUD */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-5">
            <div className="bg-slate-950/80 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800/80 text-center">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">SPEED</span>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white font-mono">
                {isBroadcasting ? currentSpeed : 0}
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-400 ml-1">km/h</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-950/80 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800/80 text-center">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">HEADING</span>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-blue-400 font-mono">
                {isBroadcasting ? `${currentHeading}°` : '--'}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-950/80 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800/80 text-center">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block mb-0.5">ACCURACY</span>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                ±{accuracy}m
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {gpsError && (
            <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle size={16} className="flex-shrink-0" />
              <span>{gpsError}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Big High-Contrast Action Button */}
          {!isBroadcasting ? (
            <button
              onClick={handleStartRoute}
              className="w-full py-4 px-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white font-extrabold text-lg shadow-xl shadow-emerald-900/40 active:scale-[0.98] transition flex items-center justify-center gap-3"
            >
              <Play size={24} className="fill-white" />
              <span>START ROUTE / യാത്ര ആരംഭിക്കുക</span>
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleEndRoute}
                className="w-full py-4 px-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-red-600 hover:from-rose-500 hover:to-red-500 text-white font-extrabold text-lg shadow-xl shadow-rose-900/40 active:scale-[0.98] transition flex items-center justify-center gap-3"
              >
                <Square size={22} className="fill-white" />
                <span>END ROUTE / യാത്ര അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുക</span>
              </button>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400 px-2 pt-1 font-mono">
                <span>Beacon active via navigator.geolocation</span>
                <span>
                  Ping: {lastPingTime ? lastPingTime.toLocaleTimeString() : 'Just now'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Live Route Map Preview */}
        {trip && (
          <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
                ലൈവ് മാപ്പ് (Live Route Map)
              </span>
              <span className="text-slate-500">
                Next Stop: {currentStop.name}
              </span>
            </div>
            <LiveBusMap
              trip={trip}
              stops={currentRoute.stops}
              childStopId={currentStop.id}
              height="300px"
              interactive={true}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Stop Navigator Pills */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
              2. ബസ് സ്റ്റോപ്പ് ലിസ്റ്റ് (Bus Stops)
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-blue-400 font-medium">
              Stop {activeStopIndex + 1} of {currentRoute.stops.length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-thin">
            {currentRoute.stops.map((stop, idx) => {
              const isSelected = idx === activeStopIndex;
              const studentsForThisStop =
                trip?.students.filter((s) => s.stopId === stop.id) || [];
              const boardedCount = studentsForThisStop.filter(
                (s) => s.transitStatus === 'BOARDED' || s.transitStatus === 'DROPPED'
              ).length;

              return (
                <button
                  key={stop.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveStopIndex(idx)}
                  className={`flex-shrink-0 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border text-left transition ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 border-blue-400 text-white shadow-lg'
                      : 'bg-slate-950 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
                    <span>#{stop.sequence}</span>
                    <span className="truncate max-w-[120px]">{stop.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px] opacity-80 mt-1">
                    <span>{stop.scheduledTime}</span>
                    <span>
                      {boardedCount}/{studentsForThisStop.length} onboard
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Student Attendance & Single-Tap Boarding Manifest at Current Stop */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <MapPin size={17} className="text-amber-400" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-base">
                  {currentStop.name}
                </h3>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                {currentStop.nameMl} • scheduled {currentStop.scheduledTime}
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleMarkAllStopBoarded}
              disabled={studentsAtCurrentStop.length === 0}
              className="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600/20 hover:bg-emerald-600/30 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 font-semibold transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              ⚡ Mark All Boarded (എല്ലാവരും കയറി)
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Student List */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {studentsAtCurrentStop.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-6 text-slate-500 text-sm">
                No students assigned for pickup at this stop.
              </div>
            ) : (
              studentsAtCurrentStop.map((student) => {
                const isBoarded = student.transitStatus === 'BOARDED';
                const isDropped = student.transitStatus === 'DROPPED';
                const isAbsent = student.transitStatus === 'ABSENT';
                const isWaiting = student.transitStatus === 'WAITING';

                return (
                  <div
                    key={student.id}
                    className="bg-slate-950 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-slate-300">
                        {student.name.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm">
                            {student.name}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 font-mono">
                            {student.grade}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                          {student.admissionNumber} • Parent: {student.guardianName} ({student.guardianPhone})
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Single-Tap Buttons */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleStudentStatus(student.id, 'BOARDED')}
                        className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 ${
                          isBoarded
                            ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-900/40 ring-2 ring-emerald-400'
                            : 'bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <CheckCircle size={14} />
                        <span>Boarded (കയറി)</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleStudentStatus(student.id, 'DROPPED')}
                        className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 ${
                          isDropped
                            ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-900/40 ring-2 ring-blue-400'
                            : 'bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <MapPin size={14} />
                        <span>Dropped (ഇറങ്ങി)</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleStudentStatus(student.id, 'ABSENT')}
                        className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 ${
                          isAbsent
                            ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-amber-900/40 ring-2 ring-amber-400'
                            : 'bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <XCircle size={14} />
                        <span>Absent</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Driver Assistance & Delay Alert Actions */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
            3. അടിയന്തിര അറിയിപ്പുകൾ (Driver Quick Assistance)
          </span>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setDelayNotice('10 min traffic delay notification sent to all parents.');
                setTimeout(() => setDelayNotice(null), 4000);
              }}
              className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 hover:border-amber-500/50 text-left transition"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-400 text-xs font-bold mb-1">
                <Clock size={15} />
                <span>Traffic Delay (+10m)</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                രക്ഷിതാക്കൾക്ക് ട്രാഫിക് ഡിലേ മെസ്സേജ് അയക്കുക
              </p>
            </button>

            <a
              href="tel:+254700000000"
              className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-500/50 text-left transition"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold mb-1">
                <Phone size={15} />
                <span>Call School Desk</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                സ്കൂൾ ട്രാൻസ്പോർട്ട് ഓഫീസുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെടുക
              </p>
            </a>
          </div>

          {delayNotice && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle size={15} />
              <span>{delayNotice}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState, use } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { PTMSlot } from '@krypton/types';
import { VirtualPTMService, INITIAL_PTM_SLOTS } from '@/lib/virtual-ptm-client';
import { VirtualPTMConferenceRoom } from '@/components/ptm/VirtualPTMConferenceRoom';

interface PageProps {
  params: Promise<{ roomId: string }>;
}

export default function PTMRoomPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { roomId } = use(params);
  const [slot, setSlot] = useState<PTMSlot | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [userRole, setUserRole] = useState<'TEACHER' | 'PARENT' | 'ADMIN'>('TEACHER');
  const [userName, setUserName] = useState<string>('Mr. Joseph Kiprop');
  const [inLobby, setInLobby] = useState(true);
  const [micTest, setMicTest] = useState(true);
  const [cameraTest, setCameraTest] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let found = VirtualPTMService.getSlotByCode(roomId);
    if (!found) {
      found = VirtualPTMService.getSlotById(roomId);
    }

    if (found) {
      setSlot(found);
    } else {
      // Instant Fallback Meeting Creation (like Google Meet / Zoom new meeting)
      const instantSlot: PTMSlot = {
        id: `ptm-instant-${Date.now()}`,
        meetingCode: roomId,
        meetingPin: Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString(),
        title: 'Virtual Parent-Teacher Conference',
        description: 'Instant CBC Academic Assessment & Progress Consultation Room',
        grade: 'Grade 7A',
        teacherId: 'tch-001',
        teacherName: 'Mr. Joseph Kiprop',
        teacherSubject: 'Mathematics & Science',
        parentId: 'par-501',
        parentName: 'Mrs. Grace Wanjiku',
        parentPhone: '+254 722 998 877',
        studentId: 'std-1001',
        studentName: 'Alan Kiprop',
        studentGrade: 'Grade 7A',
        admissionNumber: 'ADM-2024-0089',
        date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        startTime: '10:00',
        endTime: '10:30',
        durationMinutes: 30,
        status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
        waitingRoom: true,
        meetingUrl: `/ptm/room/${roomId}`,
        academicSnapshot: {
          averageGrade: 84.5,
          attendanceRate: 96.8,
          conduct: 'Excellent - Highly Focused',
          topSubject: 'Integrated Science (91%)',
          needsImprovement: 'Mathematics - Algebra (76%)',
          termExamRank: '5th out of 42',
          homeworkCompletionRate: 88,
          cbcCoreCompetencies: {
            communication: 'EXCEEDING',
            criticalThinking: 'EXCEEDING',
            collaboration: 'MEETING',
            digitalLiteracy: 'EXCEEDING',
          },
        },
      };
      setSlot(instantSlot);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, [roomId]);

  if (loading || !slot) {
    return (
      <div className="h-screen w-screen bg-slate-950 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-4 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent animate-spin mb-4" />
        <p className="text-slate-400 font-medium text-sm">Connecting to Krypton Meeting Server...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Pre-Meeting Lobby / Device Check Screen (Google Meet / Zoom Greenroom)
  if (inLobby) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex flex-col justify-between p-6">
        {/* Lobby Header */}
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full pt-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600 to-violet-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30">
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-100">Krypton Meet</h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-indigo-400 font-medium">Virtual PTM Conferencing</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
            <span>256-Bit Encrypted Meeting</span>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Center Device Check / Greenroom Area */}
        <main className="max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 my-auto items-center">
          {/* Left: Video Preview Greenroom Box */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col items-center">
            <div className="w-full aspect-video bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-800 relative shadow-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
              {cameraTest ? (
                <div className="w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-slate-900 via-indigo-950/40 to-slate-900 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                  <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-bold text-white shadow-2xl">
                    {userName.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <span className="mt-4 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">Camera Preview Ready</span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center p-6">
                  <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 mx-auto mb-3">
                    <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6" />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-300">Camera is off</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* In-Preview Mic & Camera Toggles */}
              <div className="absolute bottom-4 flex items-center space-x-3 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setMicTest(!micTest)}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-all ${
                    micTest ? 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200' : 'bg-red-600 text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 11a7 7 0 01-7 7m0 0a7 7 0 01-7-7m7 7v4m0 0H8m4 0h4m-4-8a3 3 0 01-3-3V5a3 3 0 116 0v6a3 3 0 01-3 3z" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>{micTest ? 'Mic On' : 'Mic Off'}</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setCameraTest(!cameraTest)}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-all ${
                    cameraTest ? 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200' : 'bg-red-600 text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>{cameraTest ? 'Camera On' : 'Camera Off'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right: Meeting Details & Join Action Box */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col justify-center space-y-5">
            <div>
              <div className="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30 text-xs font-semibold mb-2">
                {slot.grade} • Scheduled Session
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-100 tracking-tight leading-snug">
                {slot.title}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2 leading-relaxed">
                {slot.description}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Meeting metadata pills */}
            <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Teacher:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">{slot.teacherName}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Student:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">{slot.studentName || 'Open Registration'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Scheduled Time:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold">{slot.date} • {slot.startTime} - {slot.endTime}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Meeting Code:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-400">{slot.meetingCode}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Role selection toggle for testing / joining */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">Join As:</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setUserRole('TEACHER');
                    setUserName(slot.teacherName);
                  }}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    userRole === 'TEACHER'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30'
                      : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  Teacher (Host)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setUserRole('PARENT');
                    setUserName(slot.parentName || 'Mrs. Grace Wanjiku');
                  }}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    userRole === 'PARENT'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30'
                      : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  Parent / Guardian
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Join Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setInLobby(false)}
              className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 hover:from-indigo-500 hover:to-violet-500 text-white font-bold text-sm shadow-2xl shadow-indigo-600/40 transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 transform hover:-translate-y-0.5"
            >
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
              </svg>
              <span>Join Meeting Now</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </main>

        <footer className="text-center text-xs text-slate-600 py-2">
          Krypton School ERP • Cloud Virtual Conferencing Suite • CBC Kenya
        </footer>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Active Zoom / Google Meet Conference
  return (
    <VirtualPTMConferenceRoom
      initialSlot={slot}
      currentUserRole={userRole}
      currentUserName={userName}
      onLeave={() => router.push(userRole === 'TEACHER' ? '/teacher/ptm' : '/dashboard/ptm')}
    />
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Bus,
  Smartphone,
  Navigation,
  MapPin,
  Users,
  ShieldCheck,
  Phone,
  Clock,
  ArrowRight,
  ExternalLink,
  Plus,
  Radio,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  QrCode,
  Share2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  transportApi,
  DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES,
} from '@/lib/transport-client';
import { TransportTrip, TransportRoute } from '@krypton/types';
import { LiveBusMap } from '@/components/transport/LiveBusMap';
import { ResourceTabs } from '@/components/ResourceTabs';

export default function SchoolTransportPage() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'fleet' | 'driver' | 'students' | 'manage'>('fleet');
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<TransportRoute[]>(DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES);
  const [selectedRouteId, setSelectedRouteId] = useState<string>('route-01');
  const [activeTrip, setActiveTrip] = useState<TransportTrip | null>(null);
  const [driverLinkCopied, setDriverLinkCopied] = useState(false);

  const fetchTrip = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const trip = await transportApi.getActiveTrip(selectedRouteId);
      setActiveTrip(trip);
    } catch {}
  }, [selectedRouteId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTrip();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchTrip, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [fetchTrip]);

  const currentRoute = routes.find((r) => r.id === selectedRouteId) || routes[0];

  const handleCopyDriverLink = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const url = `${window.location.origin}/driver`;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      setDriverLinkCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setDriverLinkCopied(false), 3000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-blue-950 to-indigo-950 rounded-3xl p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-300">
              ZERO-HARDWARE GPS BUS TRACKING
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">
            School Transport Command Center
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 mt-1">
            ബസ്സുകളിൽ പ്രത്യേക GPS ട്രാക്കറുകൾ ഇല്ലാതെ ഡ്രൈവറുടെ സ്മാർട്ട്ഫോൺ വഴി ലൈവ് ബസ് ട്രാക്കിംഗ്
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <Link
            href="/driver"
            target="_blank"
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-900/40 transition active:scale-95"
          >
            <Smartphone size={15} />
            <span>Open Driver App (ഫോൺ സ്ക്രീൻ)</span>
          </Link>

          <Link
            href="/dashboard/transport"
            target="_blank"
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600/80 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md transition"

              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-md'

                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                              : isDropped
                              ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                              : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isBoarded ? '✓ Boarded' : isDropped ? '★ Dropped' : '• Waiting'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}

            </table>
          </div>

      )}

      {/* TAB 4: VEHICLES & ROUTES MANAGEMENT */}
      {activeTab === 'manage' && (

              { key: 'vehicles', label: 'Vehicles' },

}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Award,
  BookOpen,
  Download,
  FileText,
  TrendingUp,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Sparkles,
  BarChart3,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client';
import { Card, CardHeader, CardContent, Badge, Button, LoadingSpinner } from '@/components/ui';

interface Assessment {
  name: string;
  max: number;
  score: number;
  level: string;
}

interface Subject {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  strands: string;
  rubricLevel: 'EE' | 'ME' | 'AE' | 'BE';
  score: number;
  gradeLetter: string;
  teacherRemarks: string;
  assessments: Assessment[];
}

interface AcademicsData {
  currentTerm: string;
  overallAverage: number;
  overallGrade: string;
  overallCBCLevel: string;
  rankInClass: string;
  subjects: Subject[];
}

interface ReportCard {
  id: string;
  term: string;
  academicYear: string;
  curriculum: string;
  class: string;
  stream: string;
  overallPercentage: number;
  position: string;
  cbcLevel: string;
  classTeacherRemarks: string;
  principalRemarks: string;
  issuedDate: string;
  status: string;
}

export default function StudentAcademicsPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<AcademicsData | null>(null);
  const [reportCards, setReportCards] = useState<ReportCard[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [expandedSubject, setExpandedSubject] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'cbc' | 'reports'>('cbc');
  const [viewingReportCard, setViewingReportCard] = useState<ReportCard | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      try {
        const [gradesRes, cardsRes] = await Promise.all([
          api.getStudentGradesInfo(),
          api.getStudentReportCardsList(),
        ]);
        setData(gradesRes);
        setReportCards(cardsRes.reportCards || []);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Using resilient academics fallback', err);
        setData({
          currentTerm: 'Term 2 - 2024',
          overallAverage: 87.5,
          overallGrade: 'A',
          overallCBCLevel: 'Exceeding Expectations (EE)',
          rankInClass: '4th out of 42',
          subjects: [
            {
              id: 'sub-1',
              name: 'Mathematics',
              code: 'MATH',
              strands: 'Numbers, Measurement, Geometry, Algebra',
              rubricLevel: 'EE',
              score: 92,
              gradeLetter: 'A',
              teacherRemarks: 'Demonstrates deep conceptual understanding and problem-solving initiative.',
              assessments: [
                { name: 'Formative Assessment 1', max: 50, score: 47, level: 'EE' },
                { name: 'Mid-Term Evaluation', max: 100, score: 91, level: 'EE' },
                { name: 'End-Term Examination', max: 100, score: 94, level: 'EE' },
              ],
            },
            {

              name: 'English Language',

              strands: 'Listening, Speaking, Reading Comprehension, Writing',
              rubricLevel: 'ME',
              score: 84,
              gradeLetter: 'A-',
              teacherRemarks: 'Strong comprehension and grammar skills. Reading fluency is commendable.',
              assessments: [
                { name: 'Oral Presentations', max: 50, score: 42, level: 'ME' },
                { name: 'Mid-Term Evaluation', max: 100, score: 85, level: 'ME' },
                { name: 'Creative Writing CAT', max: 50, score: 41, level: 'ME' },
              ],
            },
            {
              id: 'sub-3',
              name: 'Science & Technology',
              code: 'SCI',
              strands: 'Living Things, Matter, Energy, Digital Literacy',
              rubricLevel: 'EE',
              score: 90,
              gradeLetter: 'A',
              teacherRemarks: 'Exceptional enthusiasm in laboratory experiments and digital projects.',
              assessments: [
                { name: 'Practical Science Project', max: 50, score: 48, level: 'EE' },
                { name: 'Mid-Term Evaluation', max: 100, score: 88, level: 'EE' },
                { name: 'End-Term Examination', max: 100, score: 92, level: 'EE' },
              ],
            },
            {
              id: 'sub-4',
              name: 'Kiswahili',
              code: 'KISW',
              strands: 'Kusikiliza, Kuzungumza, Kusoma, Kuandika (Insha)',

              assessments: [

                { name: 'Mtihani wa Kati', max: 100, score: 78, level: 'ME' },
                { name: 'Sarufi na Ufahamu', max: 50, score: 40, level: 'ME' },
              ],
            },
            {
              id: 'sub-5',
              name: 'Social Studies & CRE',
              code: 'SST',
              strands: 'Community, Governance, Natural Environment, Values',
              rubricLevel: 'ME',

              assessments: [
                { name: 'Community Map Project', max: 50, score: 44, level: 'ME' },
                { name: 'Mid-Term Evaluation', max: 100, score: 86, level: 'ME' },
              ],
            },
            {
              id: 'sub-6',
              name: 'Creative Arts & Music',
              code: 'ARTS',
              strands: 'Visual Arts, Performing Arts, Indigenous Crafts',
              rubricLevel: 'EE',
              score: 94,
              gradeLetter: 'A',
              teacherRemarks: 'High artistic talent and creative execution in beadwork and choral singing.',
              assessments: [
                { name: 'Portfolio of Artifacts', max: 50, score: 48, level: 'EE' },
                { name: 'Performance Recital', max: 50, score: 46, level: 'EE' },
              ],
            },
          ],
        });
        setReportCards([
          {
            id: 'rc-2024-t1',
            term: 'Term 1',
            academicYear: '2024',
            curriculum: 'Kenyan CBC (Competency-Based)',

            stream: 'Alpha',

    }

  }, []);

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
        <LoadingSpinner message="Retrieving your academic records..." />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const getRubricBadge = (level: string) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 'EE':
        return <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">EE • Exceeding</span>;
      case 'ME':
        return <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800">ME • Meeting</span>;
      case 'AE':
        return <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">AE • Approaching</span>;
      default:
        return <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800">BE • Below</span>;

  };

  return (

      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">

            Subject Competencies
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('reports')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-all ${
              activeTab === 'reports' ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-indigo-700' : 'text-gray-600'

        </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-1">

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-1">
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">Subjects Assessed</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-black text-sky-600">{data.subjects.length} Learning Areas</p>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">100% Evaluation complete</span>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'cbc' ? (

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

              Evaluated Learning Areas & Strands
            </h2>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
              <span className="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span> EE = Exceeding
              <span className="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 ml-2"></span> ME = Meeting
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">

              return (

                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-6 self-end sm:self-auto">
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 block leading-tight">
                          {sub.score}%
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400">
                          Grade {sub.gradeLetter}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <button className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
                        {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp size={20} /> : <ChevronDown size={20} />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Expanded Breakdown */}
                  {isExpanded && (
                    <div className="border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-gray-800/20 p-5 space-y-4">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 mb-2">
                          Formative & Summative Assessments
                        </p>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                          {sub.assessments.map((a, i) => (
                            <div key={i} className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800">
                              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">{a.name}</p>
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
                                <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 text-sm">
                                  {a.score} / {a.max}
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700">
                                  {a.level}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-950">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-300 mb-1">
                          Teacher's Qualitative Remark:
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xs italic text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          "{sub.teacherRemarks}"
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* Report Cards View */
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {reportCards.map((rc) => (
              <Card key={rc.id} className="hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                <CardContent className="p-6 space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700">
                        {rc.academicYear} • {rc.term}
                      </span>
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 mt-2">
                        {rc.class} End-of-Term Progress Report
                      </h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{rc.curriculum}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span className="text-2xl font-black text-indigo-600 block">
                        {rc.overallPercentage}%
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">
                        Pos: {rc.position}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/40 text-xs space-y-1.5">
                    <p><strong>Principal Note:</strong> "{rc.principalRemarks}"</p>
                    <p className="text-gray-400">Issued on {new Date(rc.issuedDate).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={() => setViewingReportCard(rc)}
                      leftIcon={<FileText size={14} />}
                    >
                      View Report Details
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => window.print()}
                      leftIcon={<Download size={14} />}
                    >
                      Download PDF
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal for Report Card Detail */}
      {viewingReportCard && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 rounded-2xl p-6 max-w-lg w-full space-y-4 border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold">Official Report Card • {viewingReportCard.term} {viewingReportCard.academicYear}</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setViewingReportCard(null)} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <p><strong>Class:</strong> {viewingReportCard.class} ({viewingReportCard.stream})</p>
              <p><strong>Overall Score:</strong> {viewingReportCard.overallPercentage}%</p>
              <p><strong>CBC Evaluation:</strong> {viewingReportCard.cbcLevel}</p>
              <p><strong>Class Teacher:</strong> "{viewingReportCard.classTeacherRemarks}"</p>
              <p><strong>Principal:</strong> "{viewingReportCard.principalRemarks}"</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-4">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setViewingReportCard(null)}>Close</Button>
              <Button onClick={() => window.print()} leftIcon={<Download size={14} />}>Print / Download</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

            സ്റ്റുഡന്റ് അസൈൻമെന്റ് പോർട്ടൽ • Student Assignments
          </span>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900 mt-1">

          </h1>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href="/student/quizzes"
            className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all"
          >
            <Timer size={14} />
            <span>ഓൺലൈൻ മോഡൽ എക്സാമുകൾ (MCQ Quizzes)</span>
          </Link>

          <div className="bg-gray-100 p-1 rounded-xl flex items-center">
            <button
              onClick={() => setMode('MOBILE_PORTAL')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                mode === 'MOBILE_PORTAL' ? 'bg-white text-emerald-800 shadow-xs' : 'text-gray-600'
              }`}
            >
              ഫോട്ടോ/PDF സബ്മിഷൻ
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setMode('CLASSIC')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                mode === 'CLASSIC' ? 'bg-white text-gray-800 shadow-xs' : 'text-gray-600'
              }`}
            >
              ക്ലാസിക് വ്യൂ
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {mode === 'MOBILE_PORTAL' ? <StudentHomeworkPortal /> : <StudentWorkspace view="assignments" />}
    </div>
  );
}

            author: 'Kathleen Arnott',
            borrowedDate: '2024-09-20',
            dueDate: '2024-10-15',
            status: 'ON_LOAN',
          },
          {
            id: 'bk-2',
            title: 'Junior Illustrated Science Dictionary',
            author: 'Sarah Khan',
            borrowedDate: '2024-09-28',
            dueDate: '2024-10-20',
            status: 'ON_LOAN',
          },
        ]);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    load();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
        <LoadingSpinner message="Opening your digital library and resources..." />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const subjects = ['ALL', 'Mathematics', 'Science & Technology', 'English', 'Kiswahili'];
  const filteredMaterials = materials.filter((m) => {
    const matchesSubject = selectedSubject === 'ALL' || m.subject === selectedSubject;
    const matchesSearch =
      m.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      m.subject.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    return matchesSubject && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-12">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-xs font-semibold mb-2">
            <Library size={14} />
            <span>Digital Learning Resources</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 tracking-tight">
            Library & Study Notes
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            Approved KICD textbooks, revision notes, and borrowed library books.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Borrowed Books Section */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title="My Borrowed Library Books"
          subtitle="Physical books checked out from the school library"
        />
        <CardContent className="p-5">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {books.map((bk) => (
              <div
                key={bk.id}
                className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 bg-gray-50/50 flex items-start gap-4"
              >
                <div className="w-12 h-14 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shadow-md">
                  <Bookmark size={20} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1 flex-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
                    On Loan
                  </span>
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                    {bk.title}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Author: {bk.author}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">
                    <span>Borrowed: {bk.borrowedDate}</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-amber-700">Due: {bk.dueDate}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Digital Learning Materials */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title="Subject Revision Notes & CBC Worksheets"
          subtitle="Download guides and exercises prepared by teachers"
        />
        <CardContent className="p-5 space-y-4">
          {/* Search & Subject Filter */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search notes or topics..."
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex overflow-x-auto gap-1">
              {subjects.map((sub) => (
                <button
                  key={sub}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedSubject(sub)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
                    selectedSubject === sub
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  {sub}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* List of Files */}
          <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {filteredMaterials.map((mat) => (
              <div
                key={mat.id}
                className="py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 hover:bg-gray-50/50 px-2 rounded-xl transition-colors"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">
                    <FileText size={18} />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                      {mat.title}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      {mat.subject} • {mat.type} ({mat.size}) • Updated {mat.updatedAt}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="secondary"
                  onClick={() => alert(`Starting download for: ${mat.title}`)}
                  leftIcon={<Download size={13} />}
                >
                  Download
                </Button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

File: apps/web/src/app/teacher/ptm/page.tsx
