'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { PTMSlot, PTMStatus } from '@krypton/types';
import { VirtualPTMService } from '@/lib/virtual-ptm-client';

export default function TeacherPTMPage() {
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState<PTMSlot[]>([]);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [gradeFilter, setGradeFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedSlotForDetails, setSelectedSlotForDetails] = useState<PTMSlot | null>(null);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Batch Generation Modal state
  const [showBatchModal, setShowBatchModal] = useState(false);
  const [batchGrade, setBatchGrade] = useState('Grade 7A');
  const [batchDate, setBatchDate] = useState('2026-10-15');
  const [batchStartTime, setBatchStartTime] = useState('09:00');
  const [batchEndTime, setBatchEndTime] = useState('12:00');
  const [batchSlotDuration, setBatchSlotDuration] = useState(15);
  const [batchBufferMinutes, setBatchBufferMinutes] = useState(5);

  // Single Slot Modal state
  const [showSingleModal, setShowSingleModal] = useState(false);
  const [singleTitle, setSingleTitle] = useState('Quarterly CBC Academic Review');
  const [singleGrade, setSingleGrade] = useState('Grade 7A');
  const [singleDate, setSingleDate] = useState('2026-10-15');
  const [singleStart, setSingleStart] = useState('14:00');
  const [singleEnd, setSingleEnd] = useState('14:20');

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3500);
  };

  const loadSlots = () => {
    const list = VirtualPTMService.getSlots();
    setSlots(list);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSlots();
  }, []);

  const handleBatchGenerate = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const created = VirtualPTMService.generateBatchSlots({
      teacherId: 'tch-001',
      teacherName: 'Mr. Joseph Kiprop',
      teacherSubject: 'Mathematics & Science',
      grade: batchGrade,
      date: batchDate,
      startTime: batchStartTime,
      endTime: batchEndTime,
      slotDurationMinutes: Number(batchSlotDuration),
      bufferMinutes: Number(batchBufferMinutes),
    });

    setShowBatchModal(false);
    loadSlots();
    showToast(`Successfully created ${created.length} PTM consultation slots!`);
  };

  const handleCreateSingleSlot = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newSlot = VirtualPTMService.createSlot({
      title: singleTitle,
      description: 'Scheduled 1-on-1 parent academic review',
      teacherId: 'tch-001',
      teacherName: 'Mr. Joseph Kiprop',
      teacherSubject: 'Mathematics & Science',
      grade: singleGrade,
      date: singleDate,
      startTime: singleStart,
      endTime: singleEnd,
      durationMinutes: 20,
    });

    setShowSingleModal(false);
    loadSlots();
    showToast(`Created slot: ${newSlot.meetingCode}`);
  };

  const handleSendWhatsAppReminder = async (slot: PTMSlot) => {
    showToast(`Sending automated WhatsApp invite to ${slot.parentName || 'Parent'}...`);
    try {
      await fetch('/api/ptm/whatsapp-invite', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          slotId: slot.id,
          recipientPhone: slot.parentPhone || '+254 722 998 877',
          recipientName: slot.parentName,
        }),
      });
      showToast(`WhatsApp reminder dispatched to ${slot.parentPhone || '+254 722 998 877'}!`);
    } catch {
      showToast('Dispatched WhatsApp invitation message');
    }
  };

  const handleCancelSlot = (id: string) => {
    if (confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this booking? The slot will become available again.')) {
      VirtualPTMService.cancelSlot(id, 'Cancelled by teacher');
      loadSlots();
      showToast('Booking cancelled and slot opened.');
    }
  };

  // Filter slots
  const filteredSlots = slots.filter(slot => {
    if (statusFilter !== 'ALL' && slot.status !== statusFilter) return false;
    if (gradeFilter !== 'ALL' && slot.grade !== gradeFilter) return false;
    if (searchQuery) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const matchName = slot.studentName?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchParent = slot.parentName?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchCode = slot.meetingCode?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      if (!matchName && !matchParent && !matchCode) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  // Analytics Metrics
  const totalSlots = slots.length;
  const bookedSlots = slots.filter(s => s.status === 'BOOKED').length;
  const waitingSlots = slots.filter(s => s.status === 'WAITING').length;
  const completedSlots = slots.filter(s => s.status === 'COMPLETED').length;
  const openSlots = slots.filter(s => s.status === 'AVAILABLE').length;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 pb-16">
      {/* Toast Alert */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed top-20 right-6 z-50 bg-indigo-600 text-white px-5 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center space-x-2 border border-indigo-400">
          <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
          </svg>
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Banner / Hero */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900 via-indigo-800 to-slate-900 text-white pt-8 pb-14 px-6">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/30 text-indigo-200 text-xs font-semibold mb-3">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                <span>Zoom & Google Meet Integrated Experience</span>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
                Virtual PTM Scheduler & Conference Hub
              </h1>
              <p className="text-sm text-indigo-200 mt-2 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
                Seamlessly organize, automate, and host 1-on-1 virtual parent-teacher meetings with built-in WebRTC video, digital whiteboard, CBC report cards, and automated WhatsApp invitations.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowBatchModal(true)}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/40 transition-all flex items-center space-x-2"
              >
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 6v6m0 0v6m0-6h6m-6 0H6" />
                </svg>
                <span>Batch Generate Timetable Slots</span>
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => setShowSingleModal(true)}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-semibold text-xs border border-slate-700 transition-all flex items-center space-x-2"
              >
                <span>+ Custom 1-on-1 Slot</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Metric Stats Cards */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 mt-8">
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/10">
              <div className="text-xs text-indigo-200 font-medium">Total Slots</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-white mt-1">{totalSlots}</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-300 mt-0.5">Configured</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/10">
              <div className="text-xs text-indigo-200 font-medium">Booked by Parents</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-amber-300 mt-1">{bookedSlots}</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-300 mt-0.5">Upcoming meetings</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/10">
              <div className="text-xs text-indigo-200 font-medium">In Lobby / Waiting</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 mt-1">{waitingSlots}</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-300 mt-0.5">Ready to admit</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/10">
              <div className="text-xs text-indigo-200 font-medium">Completed</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-white mt-1">{completedSlots}</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-300 mt-0.5">Minutes recorded</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/10">
              <div className="text-xs text-indigo-200 font-medium">Open Available</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-indigo-300 mt-1">{openSlots}</div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-300 mt-0.5">For parent booking</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 -mt-6">
        {/* Filter Controls Bar */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mr-1">Status:</span>
            {['ALL', 'BOOKED', 'WAITING', 'AVAILABLE', 'COMPLETED'].map(status => (
              <button
                key={status}
                onClick={() => setStatusFilter(status)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                  statusFilter === status
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30'
                    : 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600'
                }`}
              >
                {status}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            {/* Grade filter */}
            <select
              value={gradeFilter}
              onChange={e => setGradeFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
            >
              <option value="ALL">All Grades</option>
              <option value="Grade 7A">Grade 7A</option>
              <option value="Grade 8B">Grade 8B</option>
              <option value="Grade 6C">Grade 6C</option>
            </select>

            {/* Search */}
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search student, parent, or code..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-700 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 w-60"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Slots Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 mt-6">
          {filteredSlots.map(slot => {
            const isBooked = slot.status === 'BOOKED';
            const isWaiting = slot.status === 'WAITING';
            const isCompleted = slot.status === 'COMPLETED';
            const isAvailable = slot.status === 'AVAILABLE';

            return (
              <div
                key={slot.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all p-5 flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div>
                  {/* Card Header: Grade, Date, Status */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-xs font-bold">
                      {slot.grade}
                    </span>
                    <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${
                      isWaiting
                        ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 animate-pulse'
                        : isBooked
                          ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                          : isCompleted
                            ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                            : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
                    }`}>
                      {isWaiting ? '● In Waiting Room' : slot.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Timing & Title */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 mb-1">
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>{slot.date} • {slot.startTime} - {slot.endTime} ({slot.durationMinutes} mins)</span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                    {slot.title}
                  </h3>

                  {/* Student & Parent Info */}
                  {slot.studentName ? (
                    <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span className="text-slate-500">Student:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-800">{slot.studentName}</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span className="text-slate-500">Parent / Guardian:</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-700">{slot.parentName}</span>
                      </div>
                      {slot.academicSnapshot && (
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-200 text-[11px]">
                          <span className="text-slate-500">Average: <strong className="text-emerald-700">{slot.academicSnapshot.averageGrade}%</strong></span>
                          <span className="text-slate-500">Attendance: <strong className="text-indigo-700">{slot.academicSnapshot.attendanceRate}%</strong></span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                      Open slot available for parent booking
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Meeting Credentials Pill */}
                  <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 bg-slate-100/70 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono">
                    <span>Code: <strong className="text-indigo-600">{slot.meetingCode}</strong></span>
                    <span>PIN: {slot.meetingPin}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Card Actions Footer */}
                <div className="mt-5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-col space-y-2">
                  {/* Start / Join Button */}
                  <Link
                    href={`/ptm/room/${slot.meetingCode}`}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
                  >
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>{isCompleted ? 'Re-open Meeting' : 'Start / Join Virtual Meeting'}</span>
                  </Link>

                  {/* Secondary buttons */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    {slot.parentPhone && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleSendWhatsAppReminder(slot)}
                        className="flex-1 py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center space-x-1"
                        title="Send WhatsApp Invite & Join Link"
                      >
                        <span>WhatsApp Invite</span>
                      </button>
                    )}

                    <button
                      onClick={() => VirtualPTMService.downloadIcs(slot)}
                      className="py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-semibold"
                      title="Add to Google/Outlook/iCal Calendar (.ics)"
                    >
                      📅 .ICS
                    </button>

                    {isBooked && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleCancelSlot(slot.id)}
                        className="py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 text-[11px] font-semibold"
                        title="Cancel this parent booking"
                      >
                        Cancel
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* BATCH GENERATE TIMETABLE SLOTS MODAL */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {showBatchModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Batch Generate PTM Slots</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Automate your parent-teacher meeting consultation schedule</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowBatchModal(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 text-lg p-1"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleBatchGenerate} className="mt-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Target Class / Grade:</label>
                <select
                  value={batchGrade}
                  onChange={e => setBatchGrade(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                >
                  <option value="Grade 7A">Grade 7A (CBC Junior Secondary)</option>
                  <option value="Grade 8B">Grade 8B (Integrated Science)</option>
                  <option value="Grade 6C">Grade 6C (Primary Transition)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Meeting Date:</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={batchDate}
                  onChange={e => setBatchDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Start Time (From):</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    value={batchStartTime}
                    onChange={e => setBatchStartTime(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">End Time (To):</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    value={batchEndTime}
                    onChange={e => setBatchEndTime(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Slot Duration:</label>
                  <select
                    value={batchSlotDuration}
                    onChange={e => setBatchSlotDuration(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                  >
                    <option value={10}>10 Minutes per parent</option>
                    <option value={15}>15 Minutes (Recommended)</option>
                    <option value={20}>20 Minutes</option>
                    <option value={30}>30 Minutes</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Buffer Time:</label>
                  <select
                    value={batchBufferMinutes}
                    onChange={e => setBatchBufferMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                  >
                    <option value={0}>0 Minutes (Back-to-back)</option>
                    <option value={5}>5 Minutes buffer</option>
                    <option value={10}>10 Minutes buffer</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowBatchModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-semibold shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30"
                >
                  Generate All Slots
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* SINGLE CUSTOM SLOT MODAL */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {showSingleModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Create 1-on-1 Consultation Slot</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowSingleModal(false)} className="text-slate-400 p-1">✕</button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateSingleSlot} className="mt-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Session Agenda / Title:</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={singleTitle}
                  onChange={e => setSingleTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Grade:</label>
                  <select
                    value={singleGrade}
                    onChange={e => setSingleGrade(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                  >
                    <option value="Grade 7A">Grade 7A</option>
                    <option value="Grade 8B">Grade 8B</option>
                    <option value="Grade 6C">Grade 6C</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Date:</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={singleDate}
                    onChange={e => setSingleDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Start Time:</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    value={singleStart}
                    onChange={e => setSingleStart(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"

                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-1">End Time:</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    value={singleEnd}
                    onChange={e => setSingleEnd(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-800"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowSingleModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30"
                >
                  Create Slot
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

                </svg>

                  {t('admin.superAdmin')}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Desktop Navigation */}
          <div className="hidden md:flex items-center space-x-1">
            <NavLink href="/admin/dashboard">{t('common.dashboard')}</NavLink>
            <NavLink href="/admin/copilot">AI Copilot</NavLink>
            <NavLink href="/dashboard/ptm">Virtual PTM</NavLink>
            <NavLink href="/dashboard/whatsapp">WhatsApp Hub</NavLink>

            {/* Language Switcher */}
            <LanguageSwitcher variant="compact" />
            
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowMenu(!showMenu)}

            >
              <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-purple-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                <span className="text-purple-700 font-medium text-sm">
                  {user?.firstName?.charAt(0)}{user?.lastName?.charAt(0)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="hidden sm:block text-gray-700 pr-2">
                {user?.firstName} {user?.lastName}
              </span>
              <svg
                className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500 mr-2"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path

                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"

            {showMenu && (
              <>
                {/* Overlay */}

                {/* Dropdown Menu */}
                <div className="absolute right-4 top-14 mt-2 w-56 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-gray-200 py-1 z-50">
                  <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-200">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                      {user?.firstName} {user?.lastName}

                      </svg>

                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" />
                      </svg>
                      {t('admin.auditLogs')}
                    </div>
                  </a>

            <MobileNavItem href="/admin/schools" icon="school" label={t('admin.mobileNav.schools')} />
            <MobileNavItem href="/admin/subscriptions" icon="billing" label={t('admin.mobileNav.billing')} />
            <MobileNavItem href="/admin/system" icon="system" label={t('admin.mobileNav.system')} />
          </div>

function NavLink({ href, children }: { href: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const isActive = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.pathname === href;

  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
        isActive
          ? 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700'
          : 'text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50'
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

function MobileNavItem({
  href,
  icon,
  label,
}: {
  href: string;
  icon: string;
  label: string;
}) {
  const isActive = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.pathname === href;

  const icons: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = {

    system: (

        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z" />
        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
      </svg>
    ),
  };

  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-2 transition-colors ${
        isActive ? 'text-purple-600' : 'text-gray-500'
      }`}
    >
      {icons[icon]}
      <span className="text-xs mt-1 font-medium">{label}</span>
    </a>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  AdmissionApplication,
  AdmissionStage,
  AdmissionPaymentMethod,
} from '@krypton/types';
import { admissionsClient } from '@/lib/admissions-client';

const STAGES: {
  key: AdmissionStage;
  title: string;
  titleMl: string;
  color: string;
  borderColor: string;
  badgeBg: string;
  badgeText: string;
  icon: string;
}[] = [
  {
    key: 'INQUIRY_RECEIVED',
    title: 'Inquiry Received',
    titleMl: 'പുതിയ അപേക്ഷ',
    color: 'bg-blue-50',
    borderColor: 'border-blue-200',
    badgeBg: 'bg-blue-100',
    badgeText: 'text-blue-800',
    icon: '📥',
  },
  {
    key: 'INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED',
    title: 'Interview Scheduled',
    titleMl: 'അഭിമുഖം നിശ്ചയിച്ചു',
    color: 'bg-amber-50',
    borderColor: 'border-amber-200',
    badgeBg: 'bg-amber-100',
    badgeText: 'text-amber-800',
    icon: '🗓️',
  },
  {
    key: 'ACCEPTED',
    title: 'Accepted',
    titleMl: 'അംഗീകരിച്ചു',
    color: 'bg-purple-50',
    borderColor: 'border-purple-200',
    badgeBg: 'bg-purple-100',
    badgeText: 'text-purple-800',
    icon: '🎯',
  },
  {
    key: 'FEE_PAID',
    title: 'Fee Paid',
    titleMl: 'ഫീസ് അടച്ചു',
    color: 'bg-emerald-50',
    borderColor: 'border-emerald-200',
    badgeBg: 'bg-emerald-100',
    badgeText: 'text-emerald-800',
    icon: '💳',
  },
  {
    key: 'ADMITTED',
    title: 'Admitted',
    titleMl: 'ഔദ്യോഗികമായി ചേർത്തു',
    color: 'bg-indigo-50',

    badgeText: 'text-indigo-800',
    icon: '🎓',
  },
];

export function AdmissionKanbanBoard() {
  const [applications, setApplications] = useState<AdmissionApplication[]>([]);
  const [draggedAppId, setDraggedAppId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOverStage, setDragOverStage] = useState<AdmissionStage | null>(null);

  // Filters
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [gradeFilter, setGradeFilter] = useState('ALL');
  const [priorityFilter, setPriorityFilter] = useState('ALL');
  const [sourceFilter, setSourceFilter] = useState('ALL');

  // Modals & Drawers
  const [selectedApp, setSelectedApp] = useState<AdmissionApplication | null>(null);
  const [scheduleInterviewApp, setScheduleInterviewApp] = useState<AdmissionApplication | null>(null);
  const [recordPaymentApp, setRecordPaymentApp] = useState<AdmissionApplication | null>(null);
  const [admitStudentApp, setAdmitStudentApp] = useState<AdmissionApplication | null>(null);
  const [showAddLeadModal, setShowAddLeadModal] = useState(false);

  // Interview Form State
  const [interviewForm, setInterviewForm] = useState({
    scheduledDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000 * 2).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    scheduledTime: '10:00',
    interviewerName: 'Dr. K. R. Nambiar (Principal)',
    venueOrLink: 'Principal Chambers, Academic Block',
    isVirtual: false,
    notes: 'Assessment on foundational literacy, numeracy & general awareness.',
  });

  // Payment Form State
  const [paymentForm, setPaymentForm] = useState({
    amount: 25000,
    paymentMethod: 'UPI' as AdmissionPaymentMethod,
    receiptNumber: `RCP-2026-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
    feeType: 'Admission & Term 1 Tuition Fee',
    transactionId: `TXN-${Date.now().toString().slice(-8)}`,
  });

  // Enrollment Form State
  const [enrollmentForm, setEnrollmentForm] = useState({
    officialAdmissionNumber: `KPS-2026-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
    assignedClass: 'Grade 1',
    assignedSection: 'A',
    rollNumber: '01',
    welcomeKitDispatched: true,
  });

  // Direct Lead Form State
  const [directLeadForm, setDirectLeadForm] = useState({
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    gender: 'Male' as 'Male' | 'Female' | 'Other',
    dateOfBirth: '2020-05-15',
    applyingForGrade: 'Grade 1',
    fatherName: '',
    phone: '',
    whatsappPhone: '',
    leadSource: 'WALK_IN' as any,
    priority: 'HIGH' as any,
    notes: '',
  });

  // Load from client storage
  const loadData = () => {
    const list = admissionsClient.getApplications({
      search,
      grade: gradeFilter,
      priority: priorityFilter,
      source: sourceFilter,
    });
    setApplications(list);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [search, gradeFilter, priorityFilter, sourceFilter]);

  const stats = admissionsClient.getFunnelStats();

  // Drag and Drop handlers
  const handleDragStart = (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => {
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', id);
    setDraggedAppId(id);
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, stage: AdmissionStage) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragOverStage(stage);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setDragOverStage(null);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent, targetStage: AdmissionStage) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragOverStage(null);
    const appId = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') || draggedAppId;
    if (!appId) return;

    const app = applications.find((a) => a.id === appId);
    if (!app || app.stage === targetStage) return;

    // Trigger stage-specific modal if required, or update stage directly
    if (targetStage === 'INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED' && !app.interview) {
      setScheduleInterviewApp(app);
    } else if (targetStage === 'FEE_PAID' && !app.payment) {
      setRecordPaymentApp(app);
    } else if (targetStage === 'ADMITTED' && !app.enrollment) {
      setEnrollmentForm((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        assignedClass: app.student.applyingForGrade,
      }));
      setAdmitStudentApp(app);
    } else {
      admissionsClient.updateStage(
        appId,
        targetStage,
        'School Admin (Kanban Drag)',
        `Moved directly to ${targetStage.replace('_', ' ')}`
      );
      loadData();
    }
    setDraggedAppId(null);
  };

  // Stage Advance Helper
  const handleQuickAdvance = (app: AdmissionApplication) => {
    const stagesOrder: AdmissionStage[] = [
      'INQUIRY_RECEIVED',
      'INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED',
      'ACCEPTED',
      'FEE_PAID',
      'ADMITTED',
    ];
    const currentIndex = stagesOrder.indexOf(app.stage);
    if (currentIndex < stagesOrder.length - 1) {
      const nextStage = stagesOrder[currentIndex + 1];
      if (nextStage === 'INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED' && !app.interview) {
        setScheduleInterviewApp(app);
      } else if (nextStage === 'FEE_PAID' && !app.payment) {
        setRecordPaymentApp(app);
      } else if (nextStage === 'ADMITTED' && !app.enrollment) {
        setEnrollmentForm((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          assignedClass: app.student.applyingForGrade,
        }));
        setAdmitStudentApp(app);
      } else {
        admissionsClient.updateStage(app.id, nextStage);
        loadData();
      }
    }
  };

  // Submit Modals
  const handleConfirmInterview = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!scheduleInterviewApp) return;

    admissionsClient.scheduleInterview(scheduleInterviewApp.id, {
      scheduledDate: interviewForm.scheduledDate,
      scheduledTime: interviewForm.scheduledTime,
      interviewerName: interviewForm.interviewerName,
      venueOrLink: interviewForm.venueOrLink,
      isVirtual: interviewForm.isVirtual,
      notes: interviewForm.notes,
      result: 'PENDING',
    });

    setScheduleInterviewApp(null);
    loadData();
  };

  const handleConfirmPayment = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!recordPaymentApp) return;

    admissionsClient.recordFeePayment(recordPaymentApp.id, {
      amount: Number(paymentForm.amount),
      currency: 'INR',
      receiptNumber: paymentForm.receiptNumber,
      paidAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      paymentMethod: paymentForm.paymentMethod,
      feeType: paymentForm.feeType,
      transactionId: paymentForm.transactionId,
    });

    setRecordPaymentApp(null);
    loadData();
  };

  const handleConfirmEnrollment = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!admitStudentApp) return;

    admissionsClient.completeAdmission(admitStudentApp.id, {
      officialAdmissionNumber: enrollmentForm.officialAdmissionNumber,
      assignedClass: enrollmentForm.assignedClass,
      assignedSection: enrollmentForm.assignedSection,
      rollNumber: enrollmentForm.rollNumber,
      admittedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      welcomeKitDispatched: enrollmentForm.welcomeKitDispatched,
    });

    setAdmitStudentApp(null);
    loadData();
  };

  const handleCreateDirectLead = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const fullName = `${directLeadForm.firstName} ${directLeadForm.lastName}`.trim();
    admissionsClient.createApplication({
      student: {
        firstName: directLeadForm.firstName,
        lastName: directLeadForm.lastName,
        fullName,
        gender: directLeadForm.gender,
        dateOfBirth: directLeadForm.dateOfBirth,
        applyingForGrade: directLeadForm.applyingForGrade,
        bloodGroup: 'B+ve',
        nationality: 'Indian',
      },
      parent: {
        fatherName: directLeadForm.fatherName,
        motherName: '',
        email: '',
        phone: directLeadForm.phone,
        whatsappPhone: directLeadForm.whatsappPhone || directLeadForm.phone,
        address: 'Walk-in / Front Desk inquiry',
        city: 'Kochi',
        pincode: '682301',
      },
      documents: {},
      leadSource: directLeadForm.leadSource,
      priority: directLeadForm.priority,
      notes: directLeadForm.notes,
    });

    setShowAddLeadModal(false);
    loadData();
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 min-h-screen text-slate-900 pb-12">
      {/* Top Header & Metrics Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                School Admissions CRM
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">Academic Session 2026-2027</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mt-1">
              Admission Pipeline & Lead Management
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500">
              അഡ്മിഷൻ പൈപ്പ്‌ലൈൻ കാൻബാൻ ബോർഡ് • Drag and drop leads across the 5 enrollment stages.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <a
              href="/admissions/apply"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 font-semibold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all"
            >
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10 6H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-4M14 4h6m0 0v6m0-6L10 14" />
              </svg>
              <span>Public Admission Portal ➔</span>
            </a>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAddLeadModal(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-md text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all"
            >
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
              </svg>
              <span>+ Add Walk-in Lead</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Executive Funnel Strip */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-3 mt-6">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg">
              📥
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase block">Total Inquiries</span>
              <strong className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-800">{stats.totalInquiries}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg">
              🗓️
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase block">Interviews</span>
              <strong className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-800">{stats.interviewScheduledCount}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center space-x-3">

            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase block">Fee Collected</span>
              <strong className="text-xl font-extrabold text-emerald-700">₹{stats.totalFeeCollected.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg">
              🎓
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase block">Admitted & Enrolled</span>
              <div className="flex items-baseline space-x-1.5">
                <strong className="text-xl font-extrabold text-indigo-700">{stats.admittedCount}</strong>
                <span className="text-xs text-indigo-600 font-semibold">({stats.conversionRate}%)</span>

          </select>

          <select
            value={sourceFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setSourceFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs bg-white font-medium text-slate-700"
          >

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Kanban Columns Board */}
      <div className="max-w-[1700px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 mt-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 items-start">

            const isTargetDrop = dragOverStage === col.key;

            return (
              <div
                key={col.key}
                onDragOver={(e) => handleDragOver(e, col.key)}
                onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
                onDrop={(e) => handleDrop(e, col.key)}
                className={`rounded-2xl border ${col.borderColor} ${col.color} p-3.5 transition-all min-h-[600px] flex flex-col ${
                  isTargetDrop ? 'ring-4 ring-blue-400 border-blue-500 shadow-lg scale-[1.01]' : 'shadow-sm'

                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold ${col.badgeBg} ${col.badgeText}`}
                  >
                    {colApps.length}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Column Cards Dropzone */}
                <div className="space-y-3 flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[750px] pr-1">
                  {colApps.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="h-36 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300/80 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-4 text-xs text-slate-400">
                      <span>No leads in this stage</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] mt-1 text-slate-400">Drag applicants here to advance</span>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    colApps.map((app) => (
                      <div
                        key={app.id}
                        draggable
                        onDragStart={(e) => handleDragStart(e, app.id)}
                        className="bg-white rounded-xl p-3.5 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:border-blue-400 group relative"
                      >
                        {/* Card Header & Priority */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                            {app.applicationNumber}
                          </span>
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                            {app.priority === 'HIGH' && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] bg-red-100 text-red-700 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                High
                              </span>
                            )}
                            <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium">
                              {app.leadSource.replace('_', ' ')}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Student Profile Info */}
                        <div className="flex items-start space-x-3 mb-2.5">
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-200 flex-shrink-0 overflow-hidden border border-slate-300">
                            {app.documents.studentPhotoUrl ? (
                              <img
                                src={app.documents.studentPhotoUrl}
                                alt={app.student.fullName}
                                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                              />
                            ) : (
                              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 font-bold text-xs">
                                {app.student.firstName[0]}
                                {app.student.lastName[0]}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 truncate">
                              {app.student.fullName}
                            </h4>
                            {app.student.fullNameMl && (
                              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 block truncate">
                                {app.student.fullNameMl}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            <div className="inline-block mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200">
                              {app.student.applyingForGrade}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Details badges */}
                        <div className="space-y-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600 py-2 border-t border-b border-slate-100 my-2">
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                            <span className="text-slate-400">Parent:</span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 truncate max-w-[130px]">
                              {app.parent.fatherName || app.parent.motherName}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                            <span className="text-slate-400">Phone:</span>
                            <span className="font-mono text-slate-700">{app.parent.phone}</span>
                          </div>

                          {/* Stage Specific Badges */}
                          {app.interview && (
                            <div className="bg-amber-50 p-1.5 rounded border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 text-[10px] mt-1 font-medium">
                              🗓️ {app.interview.scheduledDate} @ {app.interview.scheduledTime}
                            </div>
                          )}

                          {app.payment && (
                            <div className="bg-emerald-50 p-1.5 rounded border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 text-[10px] mt-1 font-bold">
                              💳 ₹{app.payment.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')} Paid ({app.payment.receiptNumber})
                            </div>
                          )}

                          {app.enrollment && (
                            <div className="bg-indigo-50 p-1.5 rounded border border-indigo-200 text-indigo-950 text-[10px] mt-1 font-bold">
                              🎓 Adm No: {app.enrollment.officialAdmissionNumber} (Sec {app.enrollment.assignedSection})
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* Document Badges */}
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[10px] text-slate-500 mb-3">
                          <span
                            className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
                              app.documents.birthCertificateUrl
                                ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                                : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-400 border-slate-200'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {app.documents.birthCertificateUrl ? '✓ Birth Cert' : '✗ No Birth Cert'}
                          </span>
                          <span
                            className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
                              app.documents.studentPhotoUrl
                                ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                                : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-400 border-slate-200'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {app.documents.studentPhotoUrl ? '✓ Photo' : '✗ No Photo'}
                          </span>
                          {app.transportRequired && (
                            <span className="bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-200">
                              🚌 Bus
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* Action Buttons */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 pt-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setSelectedApp(app)}
                              className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded font-medium"
                              title="View Full Profile & Documents"
                            >
                              👁️ View
                            </button>

                            <a
                              href={admissionsClient.generateWhatsAppUrl(
                                app,
                                app.stage === 'INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED'
                                  ? 'INTERVIEW'
                                  : app.stage === 'ACCEPTED'
                                  ? 'ACCEPTED'
                                  : app.stage === 'FEE_PAID'
                                  ? 'FEE_RECEIPT'
                                  : 'ADMISSION_CONFIRMED'
                              )}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noopener noreferrer"
                              className="p-1 text-[11px] bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 rounded"
                              title="Chat on WhatsApp"
                            >
                              💬
                            </a>

                            <a
                              href={`tel:${app.parent.phone}`}
                              className="p-1 text-[11px] bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 rounded"
                              title="Call Parent"
                            >
                              📞
                            </a>
                          </div>

                          {col.key !== 'ADMITTED' && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleQuickAdvance(app)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded shadow-sm flex items-center space-x-0.5"
                              title="Advance to next pipeline stage"
                            >
                              <span>Advance</span>
                              <span>➔</span>
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* MODAL 1: APPLICATION PROFILE & DOCUMENT VIEWER DRAWER     */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {selectedApp && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex justify-end animate-fade-in">
          <div className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-white h-full overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              {/* Header */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200">
                    {selectedApp.applicationNumber}
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mt-1">
                    {selectedApp.student.fullName}
                  </h3>
                  {selectedApp.student.fullNameMl && (
                    <span className="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">
                      {selectedApp.student.fullNameMl}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedApp(null)}
                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center font-bold"
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Status Banner */}
              <div className="my-4 p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-semibold block">Current Pipeline Stage</span>
                  <strong className="text-sm text-slate-800">{selectedApp.stage.replace('_', ' ')}</strong>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleQuickAdvance(selectedApp)}
                  className="text-xs font-bold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg"
                >
                  Advance Stage ➔
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Student Bio */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs sm:text-sm my-4 bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Class Applied:</span>
                  <strong>{selectedApp.student.applyingForGrade}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Date of Birth:</span>
                  <strong>{selectedApp.student.dateOfBirth}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Gender:</span>
                  <strong>{selectedApp.student.gender}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Blood Group:</span>
                  <strong>{selectedApp.student.bloodGroup}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Father:</span>
                  <strong>{selectedApp.parent.fatherName || 'N/A'}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Mother:</span>
                  <strong>{selectedApp.parent.motherName || 'N/A'}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Phone:</span>
                  <strong className="font-mono">{selectedApp.parent.phone}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Address:</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-700">{selectedApp.parent.address}, {selectedApp.parent.city}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Uploaded Documents Preview */}
              <div className="my-6">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                  Uploaded Verification Documents (ഡോക്യുമെന്റുകൾ)
                </h4>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  {/* Photo Preview */}
                  <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 bg-slate-50 text-center">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-2">
                      Passport Photo
                    </span>
                    {selectedApp.documents.studentPhotoUrl ? (
                      <div className="w-24 h-28 rounded-lg overflow-hidden mx-auto shadow border border-white">
                        <img
                          src={selectedApp.documents.studentPhotoUrl}
                          alt="Student"
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="h-28 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                        No photo uploaded
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Birth Certificate Preview */}
                  <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 bg-slate-50 text-center">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 block mb-2">
                      Birth Certificate
                    </span>
                    {selectedApp.documents.birthCertificateUrl ? (
                      <div className="h-28 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2">
                        <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-600 mb-1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" />
                        </svg>
                        <a
                          href={selectedApp.documents.birthCertificateUrl}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noopener noreferrer"
                          className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-700 hover:underline truncate max-w-full"
                        >
                          View Document ➔
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="h-28 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                        No birth cert uploaded
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Activity Timeline */}
              <div className="my-6">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                  Stage Audit Trail & History
                </h4>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {selectedApp.timeline.map((item) => (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-xs flex items-start space-x-2"
                    >
                      <span className="text-blue-600 mt-0.5">●</span>
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="flex justify-between">
                          <strong>{item.title}</strong>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            {new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-slate-600 mt-0.5">{item.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Bottom Actions */}
            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-between">
              <a
                href={admissionsClient.generateWhatsAppUrl(selectedApp, 'INTERVIEW')}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs"
              >
                <span>💬 WhatsApp Parent</span>
              </a>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedApp(null)}
                className="bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-semibold px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs"
              >
                Close Drawer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* MODAL 2: SCHEDULE INTERVIEW MODAL                        */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {scheduleInterviewApp && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-md w-full p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="text-xl">🗓️</span>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Schedule Assessment / Interview
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScheduleInterviewApp(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 font-bold"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-4">
              Scheduling interview for <strong>{scheduleInterviewApp.student.fullName}</strong> ({scheduleInterviewApp.student.applyingForGrade}).
            </p>

            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmInterview} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Interview Date
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  required
                  value={interviewForm.scheduledDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setInterviewForm({ ...interviewForm, scheduledDate: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Interview Time
                </label>
                <input
                  type="time"
                  required
                  value={interviewForm.scheduledTime}
                  onChange={(e) => setInterviewForm({ ...interviewForm, scheduledTime: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Interviewer Name / Panel
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={interviewForm.interviewerName}
                  onChange={(e) => setInterviewForm({ ...interviewForm, interviewerName: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Venue or Virtual Video Link
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={interviewForm.venueOrLink}
                  onChange={(e) => setInterviewForm({ ...interviewForm, venueOrLink: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Assessment Focus / Instructions
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={interviewForm.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setInterviewForm({ ...interviewForm, notes: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end space-x-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setScheduleInterviewApp(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow"
                >
                  Save & Notify Parent ➔
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* MODAL 3: RECORD FEE PAYMENT MODAL                        */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {recordPaymentApp && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-md w-full p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="text-xl">💳</span>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Record Admission Fee Payment
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRecordPaymentApp(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 font-bold"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-4">
              Confirming fee clearance for <strong>{recordPaymentApp.student.fullName}</strong> ({recordPaymentApp.student.applyingForGrade}).
            </p>

            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmPayment} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Amount Received (₹)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  required
                  value={paymentForm.amount}
                  onChange={(e) => setPaymentForm({ ...paymentForm, amount: Number(e.target.value) })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Payment Mode
                </label>
                <select
                  value={paymentForm.paymentMethod}
                  onChange={(e) => setPaymentForm({ ...paymentForm, paymentMethod: e.target.value as any })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs bg-white"
                >
                  <option value="UPI">UPI (Google Pay / PhonePe / Paytm)</option>
                  <option value="NET_BANKING">Net Banking / IMPS</option>
                  <option value="CARD">Credit / Debit Card</option>
                  <option value="CASH">Cash at Cashier Desk</option>
                  <option value="BANK_TRANSFER">Direct Bank Deposit</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Receipt Number
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={paymentForm.receiptNumber}
                  onChange={(e) => setPaymentForm({ ...paymentForm, receiptNumber: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Transaction / Ref ID
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={paymentForm.transactionId}
                  onChange={(e) => setPaymentForm({ ...paymentForm, transactionId: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end space-x-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setRecordPaymentApp(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow"
                >
                  Confirm & Clear Fee ➔
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* MODAL 4: OFFICIALLY ADMIT STUDENT MODAL                  */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {admitStudentApp && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-md w-full p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="text-xl">🎓</span>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
                  Complete Formal Admission
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAdmitStudentApp(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 font-bold"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-4">
              Enrolling <strong>{admitStudentApp.student.fullName}</strong> as an official student in the School ERP database.
            </p>

            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmEnrollment} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Official Admission Number (അഡ്മിഷൻ നമ്പർ)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={enrollmentForm.officialAdmissionNumber}
                  onChange={(e) => setEnrollmentForm({ ...enrollmentForm, officialAdmissionNumber: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-indigo-300 font-mono text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50/50"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                    Assigned Class
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
