'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { AlertCircle, Calendar, MessageCircle, Sparkles, TrendingDown, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import type { AIRiskReview, PredictiveAnalyticsReport, TeacherAIOptions } from '@krypton/types';
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';
import { fetchAtRiskStudents } from '@/lib/copilot-client';
import { messageFor } from '@/lib/workspace';
import { Panel } from './WorkspaceUI';
import { Button } from './ui';

export function AtRiskStudentsPanel() {
  const [report, setReport] = useState<PredictiveAnalyticsReport | null>(null);
  const [configured, setConfigured] = useState(false);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState<AIRiskReview | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [sentAlerts, setSentAlerts] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const active = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const generation = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    active.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    active.current = controller;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setReviews(null);

    try {
      const [result, options] = await Promise.all([
        fetchAtRiskStudents(controller.signal),
        apiClient.get<TeacherAIOptions>('/teacher-ai/options', { signal: controller.signal }),
      ]);
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setReport(result);
        setConfigured(options.data.status.configured);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(messageFor(err));
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    return () => {
      active.current?.abort();
      generation.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [load]);

  const flagged = (report?.students ?? []).filter(s =>
    [s.academic, s.dropout].some(r => ['HIGH', 'MODERATE'].includes(r.level)) ||
    (s.metrics.latestAverage !== null && s.metrics.projectedAverage !== null && s.metrics.latestAverage - s.metrics.projectedAverage >= 10) ||
    (s.metrics.attendanceDays >= 5 && s.metrics.attendanceRate !== null && s.metrics.attendanceRate < 80) ||
    s.metrics.outstandingBalance > 0
  );

  const visible = flagged.slice(0, 5);

  const review = async () => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    generation.current = controller;
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const { data } = await apiClient.post<AIRiskReview>(
        '/teacher-ai/risk-review',
        { studentIds: visible.map(s => s.studentId), language: 'English' },
        { timeout: 75000, signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setReviews(data);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(messageFor(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleWhatsAppAlert = (student: typeof flagged[0]) => {
    const text = encodeURIComponent(
      `Dear Parent of ${student.name} (${student.admissionNumber}), this is a gentle academic notification from the School. ` +
      `We noticed an attendance rate of ${student.metrics.attendanceRate ?? 'N/A'}% and exam average of ${student.metrics.latestAverage ?? 'N/A'}%. ` +
      `Our class teacher would love to schedule a brief check-in to support their progress.`
    );
    window.open(`https://wa.me/?text=${text}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    setSentAlerts(prev => ({ ...prev, [student.studentId]: true }));
  };

  return (
    <Panel
      title="AI Student Early-Warning & Dropout Predictor"
      subtitle="Proactive intervention for students with falling attendance, exam drops, or fee alerts"
      href="/school/predictive-analytics"
    >
      <div className="panel-body content-stack">
        {loading ? (
          <p role="status" className="text-sm text-gray-500 py-3">
            Checking academic records, test drops, and attendance trends…
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            {error && (
              <div className="state-box" role="alert">
                {error}
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void load()}>
                  Retry
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
            {report && (
              <>
                <div className="ai-risk-toolbar flex items-center justify-between bg-amber-50/70 border border-amber-200/80 p-3.5 rounded-xl">
                  <div>
                    <strong className="text-amber-950 text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold">
                      <AlertCircle size={16} className="text-amber-600" />
                      {flagged.length} At-Risk Students Flagged for Proactive Intervention
                    </strong>
                    <p className="text-xs text-amber-800 mt-0.5">
                      Flagged on Principal & Class Teacher radar. Take immediate action before term ends.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      leftIcon={<Sparkles size={15} />}
                      disabled={!configured || !visible.length || loading}
                      isLoading={busy}
                      onClick={() => void review()}
                    >
                      AI Support Review
                    </Button>
                    <Link
                      href="/dashboard/copilot"
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-medium rounded-md shadow-sm transition-all"
                    >
                      Ask Copilot →
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {!flagged.length ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 py-4">
                    No active student warning flags detected. Attendance and academic performance are stable across your classes.
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
                    {visible.map(student => {
                      const ai = reviews?.students.find(r => r.studentId === student.studentId);
                      const high = [student.academic, student.dropout].some(r => r.level === 'HIGH');
                      const attLow = student.metrics.attendanceRate !== null && student.metrics.attendanceRate < 80;
                      const hasFee = student.metrics.outstandingBalance > 0;
                      const isSent = !!sentAlerts[student.studentId];

                      return (
                        <article
                          className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-300 transition-all shadow-sm"
                          key={student.studentId}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                              <strong className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{student.name}</strong>
                              <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 ml-2">
                                {student.className} · {student.admissionNumber}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <span className={`pill ${high ? 'danger' : 'warning'}`}>
                              {high ? 'High At-Risk' : 'Moderate Review'}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-2 text-xs">
                            <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md ${attLow ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 font-medium' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700'}`}>
                              <TrendingDown size={12} />
                              Attendance: {student.metrics.attendanceRate !== null ? `${student.metrics.attendanceRate}%` : 'N/A'}
                            </span>
                            <span className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                              Latest Exam: {student.metrics.latestAverage !== null ? `${student.metrics.latestAverage}%` : 'N/A'}
                            </span>
                            {hasFee && (
                              <span className="bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-medium">
                                Fee Balance: {report.currency} {(student.metrics.outstandingBalance / 100).toLocaleString()}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          {/* Quick Proactive Intervention Actions */}
                          <div className="mt-3 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">Proactive Interventions:</span>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleWhatsAppAlert(student)}
                                className={`text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border flex items-center gap-1 transition-all ${
                                  isSent
                                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300'
                                    : 'bg-white hover:bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border-gray-200'
                                }`}
                              >
                                <MessageCircle size={13} />
                                {isSent ? 'Alert Dispatched' : 'WhatsApp Notice'}
                              </button>
                              <Link
                                href="/dashboard/ptm"
                                className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200 flex items-center gap-1 transition-all"
                              >
                                <Calendar size={13} />
                                Schedule PTM
                              </Link>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {ai && (
                            <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-indigo-50/60 rounded-lg text-xs text-indigo-950 border border-indigo-100">
                              <strong className="block mb-1 text-indigo-900">
                                AI Intervention Strategy · {ai.priority.replaceAll('_', ' ').toLowerCase()}
                              </strong>
                              <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-0.5 text-indigo-900 mb-2">
                                {ai.reasons.map((reason, i) => (
                                  <li key={i}>{reason}</li>
                                ))}
                              </ul>
                              <span className="font-semibold block text-indigo-900 mb-0.5">Staff Support Plan:</span>
                              <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-0.5 text-indigo-800">
                                {ai.supportPlan.map((action, i) => (
                                  <li key={i}>{action}</li>
                                ))}
                              </ul>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </article>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2">
                  {flagged.length > visible.length && (
                    <Link href="/school/predictive-analytics" className="panel-link text-xs">
                      Review all {flagged.length} flagged students in full analytics →
                    </Link>
                  )}
                  <Link href="/dashboard/copilot" className="panel-link text-xs ml-auto">
                    Search cohort with ERP Copilot →
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}

export function DynamicProjectorScreen() {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<DynamicProjectorSession>(() =>
    smartAttendanceApi.getProjectorSession()
  );
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number>(20);
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          const fresh = smartAttendanceApi.refreshProjectorCode();
          setSession(fresh);
          return 20;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const toggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.().catch((e) => console.log(e));
      setIsFullscreen(true);
    } else {
      document.exitFullscreen?.().catch((e) => console.log(e));
      setIsFullscreen(false);
    }
  };

  const handleManualRefresh = () => {
    const fresh = smartAttendanceApi.refreshProjectorCode();
    setSession(fresh);
    setCountdown(20);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`space-y-6 transition-all ${
        isFullscreen ? 'fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950 p-8 overflow-y-auto' : ''

            </span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">
            Live Dynamic QR Attendance
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            {session.schoolName} • {session.date}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={handleManualRefresh}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-xs font-bold backdrop-blur-md transition flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/10"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} />
            <span>Regenerate Token</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={toggleFullscreen}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg transition flex items-center gap-2"

            {isFullscreen ? <Minimize2 size={14} /> : <Maximize2 size={14} />}

import {
  ParentAbsenceApplication,

  StudentIDCardData,
} from '@krypton/types';

export function ParentAbsencePortal() {
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'PARENT_APPLY' | 'STAFF_REVIEW'>('PARENT_APPLY');
  const [applications, setApplications] = useState<ParentAbsenceApplication[]>(() =>
    smartAttendanceApi.getLeaveApplications()
  );

  // Form State
  const [selectedStudentId, setSelectedStudentId] = useState<string>(MOCK_STUDENTS[2].id); // Malavika Nair
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState<string>(() => {
    const tomorrow = new Date();
    tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
    return tomorrow.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  });
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState<string>(() => {
    const afterTomorrow = new Date();
    afterTomorrow.setDate(afterTomorrow.getDate() + 2);
    return afterTomorrow.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  });
  const [reasonCategory, setReasonCategory] = useState<AbsenceReasonCategory>('SICK');
  const [explanation, setExplanation] = useState<string>('');
  const [medicalCertName, setMedicalCertName] = useState<string>('Medical_Certificate_Apollo_Clinic.pdf');
  const [hasCert, setHasCert] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [guardianName, setGuardianName] = useState<string>('Radha Nair (Mother)');
  const [guardianPhone, setGuardianPhone] = useState<string>('+91 98470 33333');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Review Filter & Modal
  const [reviewFilter, setReviewFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [viewingCertApp, setViewingCertApp] = useState<ParentAbsenceApplication | null>(null);

  const refreshApplications = () => {
    setApplications([...smartAttendanceApi.getLeaveApplications(reviewFilter)]);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshApplications();
  }, [reviewFilter]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!explanation.trim()) {
      alert('Please enter a brief explanation for the leave request.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const created = smartAttendanceApi.submitAbsenceApplication({
        studentId: selectedStudentId,
        startDate,
        endDate,
        reasonCategory,
        explanation,
        medicalCertificateName: hasCert ? medicalCertName : undefined,
        guardianName,
        guardianPhone,
      });

      setSubmitting(false);
      setSubmitSuccess(
        `Leave application submitted for ${created.studentName} (${created.startDate} to ${created.endDate}). Awaiting teacher approval.`
      );
      setExplanation('');
      refreshApplications();
    }, 600);
  };

  const handleApprove = (id: string) => {
    smartAttendanceApi.reviewAbsenceApplication({
      applicationId: id,
      status: 'APPROVED',
      reviewerName: 'Dr. Priya Sharma (Class Coordinator)',
      reviewNotes: 'Leave approved. Attendance register automatically updated with status EXCUSED.',
    });
    refreshApplications();
  };

  const handleReject = (id: string) => {
    const reason = prompt('Enter reason for rejection:', 'Prior examination scheduled on this date.');
    if (reason !== null) {
      smartAttendanceApi.reviewAbsenceApplication({
        applicationId: id,
        status: 'REJECTED',
        reviewerName: 'Dr. Priya Sharma (Class Coordinator)',
        reviewNotes: reason || 'Application rejected.',
      });
      refreshApplications();
    }
  };

  const REASON_OPTIONS: Array<{

  }> = [

    { value: 'MEDICAL_APPOINTMENT', label: 'Doctor / Medical Appointment', labelMl: 'ഡോക്ടർ അപ്പോയിന്റ്മെന്റ്', icon: FileCheck },
    { value: 'FAMILY_EMERGENCY', label: 'Family Emergency / Function', labelMl: 'കുടുംബപരമായ അത്യാവശ്യം', icon: User },
    { value: 'RELIGIOUS_OBLIGATION', label: 'Religious Obligation', labelMl: 'മതപരമായ ചടങ്ങുകൾ', icon: Calendar },
    { value: 'TRAVEL', label: 'Out of Town Travel', labelMl: 'യാത്ര', icon: Calendar },

    { value: 'OTHER', label: 'Other Reason', labelMl: 'മറ്റ് കാരണങ്ങൾ', icon: FileText },

            className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs transition flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeView === 'PARENT_APPLY'
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
            }`}
          >
            <Send size={15} />
            <span>Parent Application Form (മുൻകൂട്ടി ലീവ് അപേക്ഷ)</span>

              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50/50 border border-indigo-100 space-y-3">

                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="font-bold text-gray-700 block mb-1">
                    Contact Phone:
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={guardianPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => setGuardianPhone(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Submit Button */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full py-3.5 px-6 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-lg transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <Send size={16} />
                <span>
                  {submitting ? 'Submitting Application...' : 'Submit Leave Application (അപേക്ഷ അയക്കുക)'}

            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Right Column: Track Submitted Applications */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white rounded-3xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-4">

                    </p>
                  )}

              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* TEACHER / STAFF PERSPECTIVE: REVIEW & APPROVAL DESK */
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">

                അംഗീകരിച്ചാൽ ആ ദിവസങ്ങളിലെ അറ്റൻഡൻസിൽ ഓട്ടോമാറ്റിക് ആയി &quot;Excused Leave&quot; രേഖപ്പെടുത്തപ്പെടും.
              </p>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-100 p-1 rounded-xl">

                        {app.reasonTitle} ({app.reasonTitleMl})
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-gray-400 block font-medium">Applied At:</span>
                      <span className="text-gray-600">{app.appliedAt}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-700 leading-relaxed bg-white p-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100">

                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleReject(app.id)}
                          className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 transition flex items-center gap-1.5"

                        </button>

                          onClick={() => handleApprove(app.id)}
                          className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5"

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import QRCode from 'qrcode';

interface QRCodeSVGProps {
  value: string;
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
  darkColor?: string;
  lightColor?: string;
  includeMargin?: boolean;
}

export function QRCodeSVG({
  value,
  size = 180,
  className = '',
  darkColor = '#0f172a',
  lightColor = '#ffffff',
  includeMargin = true,
}: QRCodeSVGProps) {
  const [svgString, setSvgString] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    QRCode.toString(value, {
      type: 'svg',
      width: size,
      margin: includeMargin ? 2 : 0,
      color: {
        dark: darkColor,
        light: lightColor,
      },
    })
      .then((svg) => {
        if (isMounted) setSvgString(svg);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('QR code generation error', err);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [value, size, darkColor, lightColor, includeMargin]);

  if (!svgString) {
    return (
      <div
        style={{ width: size, height: size }}
        className={`flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-100 rounded-lg animate-pulse ${className}`}
      >
        <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-indigo-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-block overflow-hidden rounded-lg shadow-sm ${className}`}
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svgString }}
    />
  );
}

  });

              <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-200 border border-indigo-400/30 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ShieldCheck size={14} className="text-indigo-400" />
                Allowed Radius: {geofenceConfig.radiusMeters}m
              </span>
              <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-200 border border-amber-400/30 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Clock size={14} />
                Shift: {geofenceConfig.allowedCheckInStart} - {geofenceConfig.allowedCheckOutStart} (Late after {geofenceConfig.lateThresholdTime})
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

        {/* Left: Mobile Staff Check-In Card & GPS Radar */}

            {/* Header with Staff Selector */}
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/70 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Smartphone size={18} className="text-indigo-600" />
                  Staff Mobile Check-In Terminal

                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                  അധ്യാപകരുടെയും ജീവനക്കാരുടെയും ഫോൺ വഴി ചെക്ക്-ഇൻ
                </p>
              </div>

                    const st = MOCK_STAFF_MEMBERS.find((s) => s.id === e.target.value);
                    if (st) {
                      setSelectedStaff(st);
                      setCheckInResult(null);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none shadow-sm"
                >
                  {MOCK_STAFF_MEMBERS.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                      {s.name} ({s.department})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
              {/* Selected Staff Profile Card */}

                    </span>

                </label>

                  className="w-full text-xs font-mono bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-gray-600"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 block mb-1">
                  Geofence Allowed Radius (Meters):
                </label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="50"
                    max="1000"
                    step="25"
                    value={customRadius}
                    onChange={(e) => setCustomRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="flex-1 accent-indigo-600"
                  />
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 w-16 text-right">
                    {customRadius} m
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-1">
                  Any mobile check-in further than {customRadius}m will be rejected automatically.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3">

              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleUpdateRadius}

  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  QrCode,
  ScanLine,
  Printer,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Camera,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
  User,
  ShieldCheck,
  Calendar,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  smartAttendanceApi,
  MOCK_STUDENTS,
} from '@/lib/smart-attendance-client';
import { StudentIDCardData, ScanStudentQRResult } from '@krypton/types';
import { QRCodeSVG } from './QRCodeSVG';

export function StudentQRScannerAndIDCard() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'SCANNER' | 'ID_STUDIO'>('SCANNER');
  const [students, setStudents] = useState<StudentIDCardData[]>(MOCK_STUDENTS);
  const [selectedStudentForCard, setSelectedStudentForCard] = useState<StudentIDCardData>(
    MOCK_STUDENTS[2] // Malavika Nair
  );
  const [scannedResult, setScannedResult] = useState<ScanStudentQRResult | null>(null);
  const [manualInput, setManualInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [isScanningActive, setIsScanningActive] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [recentScans, setRecentScans] = useState<any[]>(() =>
    smartAttendanceApi.getStudentScans()
  );

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);

  const refreshScans = () => {
    setRecentScans([...smartAttendanceApi.getStudentScans()]);
  };

  // Play audio chime on success
  const playBeep = () => {
    if (!soundEnabled || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext)();
      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, audioCtx.currentTime); // High pitch A5
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.15);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.15);
    } catch {
      // AudioContext policy
    }
  };

  // Handle Scanning student payload
  const handleProcessScan = (payload: string, source: 'CAMERA_SCAN' | 'BARCODE_SCANNER' = 'CAMERA_SCAN') => {
    const res = smartAttendanceApi.scanStudentQR({
      qrPayload: payload,
      source,
    });
    setScannedResult(res);
    playBeep();
    refreshScans();
  };

  // Camera video stream toggle
  const toggleCamera = async () => {
    if (isScanningActive) {
      if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.srcObject) {
        const stream = videoRef.current.srcObject as MediaStream;
        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
        videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
      }
      setIsScanningActive(false);
    } else {
      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: 'environment' },
        });
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        }
        setIsScanningActive(true);
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.warn('Camera access unavailable:', err.message);
        alert('Camera stream unavailable or permission denied. You can use the instant scan simulator buttons below.');
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.srcObject) {
        const stream = videoRef.current.srcObject as MediaStream;
        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.print();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Sub-Tabs: Scanner vs ID Card Print Studio */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white p-2 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('SCANNER')}
            className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs transition flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeTab === 'SCANNER'
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
            }`}
          >
            <ScanLine size={16} />
            <span>Smart QR Scanner (ഹാജർ സ്കാനർ)</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('ID_STUDIO')}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { StudentCertificateProfile, SchoolCertificateSettings } from '@krypton/types';
import { certificateApi } from '@/lib/certificate-client';
import { PortraitCardFront, PortraitCardBack } from './DigitalIDCardView';

interface BatchIDCardsSheetProps {
  students: StudentCertificateProfile[];
  settings: SchoolCertificateSettings;
  side: 'FRONT' | 'BACK' | 'BOTH';
  isMalayalamSubtitles?: boolean;
}

export function BatchIDCardsSheet({
  students,
  settings,
  side,
  isMalayalamSubtitles = true,
}: BatchIDCardsSheetProps) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white p-4">
      <div className="hidden print:block text-center mb-6 text-xs text-gray-500 font-sans border-b border-gray-300 pb-2">
        <p className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm">
          {settings.schoolName} — BATCH STUDENT ID CARD PRINT SHEET ({students.length} CARDS)
        </p>
        <p>A4 Grid Layout • Standard Card Size (54mm x 86mm) • Ready for Cutting & Laminating</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 print:grid-cols-2 gap-6 print:gap-4 justify-items-center">
        {students.map((student) => {
          const cardData = certificateApi.generateIDCard(student.id);

          return (
            <div key={student.id} className="w-[280px] break-inside-avoid print:w-[270px]">
              {side === 'FRONT' && (
                <PortraitCardFront
                  data={cardData}
                  settings={settings}
                  isMalayalamSubtitles={isMalayalamSubtitles}
                />
              )}
              {side === 'BACK' && (
                <PortraitCardBack
                  data={cardData}
                  settings={settings}
                />
              )}
              {side === 'BOTH' && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <PortraitCardFront
                    data={cardData}
                    settings={settings}
                    isMalayalamSubtitles={isMalayalamSubtitles}
                  />
                  <PortraitCardBack
                    data={cardData}
                    settings={settings}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Search,
  X,
  QrCode,
  FileCheck,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { certificateApi } from '@/lib/certificate-client';
import { GeneratedCertificateRecord, StudentCertificateProfile } from '@krypton/types';

interface CertificateVerificationModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialCode?: string;
}

export function CertificateVerificationModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  initialCode = '',
}: CertificateVerificationModalProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialCode);
  const [verifiedState, setVerifiedState] = useState<{
    tested: boolean;
    valid: boolean;
    record?: GeneratedCertificateRecord;
    student?: StudentCertificateProfile;
  } | null>(initialCode ? () => certificateApi.verifyCertificate(initialCode) && { tested: true, ...certificateApi.verifyCertificate(initialCode) } : null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleVerify = (codeToTest?: string) => {
    const target = (codeToTest !== undefined ? codeToTest : query).trim();
    if (!target) return;
    const res = certificateApi.verifyCertificate(target);
    setVerifiedState({
      tested: true,
      valid: res.valid,
      record: res.record,
      student: res.student,
    });
  };

  const sampleCodes = [
    { label: 'Sample TC Hash', code: 'TC-KPS-2024-103-8F3D1A' },
    { label: 'Sample Bonafide Ref', code: 'BON/2026/112' },
    { label: 'Aarav Patel (Adm No)', code: 'KPS-2024-101' },
    { label: 'Malavika Nair (Adm No)', code: 'KPS-2024-103' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-200 max-w-lg w-full overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-950 to-blue-900 text-white p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-800/80 border border-indigo-700 flex items-center justify-center">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold">Public Certificate & ID Verifier</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200">
                ക്രിപ്റ്റോഗ്രാഫിക് ഡിജിറ്റൽ സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റ് പരിശോധന
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-indigo-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-5">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
              Enter Verification Hash, Ref No, or Admission No:
            </label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={query}
                  onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleVerify()}
                  placeholder="e.g., TC-KPS-2024-103-8F3D1A or KPS-2024-101"
                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleVerify()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <span>Verify</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Click Samples */}
          <div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 block mb-1.5 font-medium">
              Quick test with issued sample records:
            </span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {sampleCodes.map((s) => (
                <button
                  key={s.code}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setQuery(s.code);
                    handleVerify(s.code);
                  }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition-colors"
                >
                  {s.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Verification Results */}
          {verifiedState?.tested && (
            <div className="pt-2 animate-fadeIn">
              {verifiedState.valid ? (
                <div className="bg-emerald-50 border-2 border-emerald-400/80 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-800">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-emerald-950">
                        100% Authenticated & Digitally Verified
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700">
                        Official document issued by institution authority.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-white/80 rounded-xl p-3 border border-emerald-200 text-xs space-y-1.5 font-sans">
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Document Type:</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">
                        {verifiedState.record?.certificateType.replace('_', ' ')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Student Name:</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-indigo-950">
                        {verifiedState.student?.fullName || verifiedState.record?.studentName}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Admission No:</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-gray-800">
                        {verifiedState.student?.admissionNumber || verifiedState.record?.admissionNumber}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Current Class:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium text-gray-800">
                        {verifiedState.student?.currentClass || verifiedState.record?.className}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Authorized Signatory:</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-800">
                        {verifiedState.record?.issuedBy}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Cryptographic Seal:</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-gray-600">
                        SHA-256 Validated
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="bg-rose-50 border-2 border-rose-300 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-start gap-3 text-rose-900">
                  <XCircle className="w-6 h-6 text-rose-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-rose-950">
                      Certificate Not Found or Invalid
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-rose-700 mt-0.5">
                      The entered code or token does not match any official certificate record in the school ledger. Please check the spelling or scan the original QR code.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 text-gray-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-colors"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DigitalIDCardView({

  settings,
  isMalayalamSubtitles = true,
}: DigitalIDCardViewProps) {
  const [activeSide, setActiveSide] = useState<'FRONT' | 'BACK'>('FRONT');
  const [orientation, setOrientation] = useState<'PORTRAIT' | 'LANDSCAPE'>('PORTRAIT');

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">

                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            Vertical (Lanyard Badge)
          </button>
          <button

              orientation === 'LANDSCAPE'
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            Horizontal (Wallet Card)
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">View:</span>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSide(activeSide === 'FRONT' ? 'BACK' : 'FRONT')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors"
          >
            <RotateCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Screen Interactive Card Display */}
      <div className="flex justify-center print:hidden">
        {orientation === 'PORTRAIT' ? (
          <div className="w-[320px] transition-all duration-300">
            {activeSide === 'FRONT' ? (

          <div className="w-[300px]">

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface PrincipalDigitalSignatureProps {
  principalName?: string;
  principalTitle?: string;
  principalDegree?: string;
  issueDate?: string;
  verificationHash?: string;
  showSeal?: boolean;
  sealColor?: 'gold' | 'blue' | 'crimson';
  compact?: boolean;
}

export function PrincipalDigitalSignature({
  principalName = 'Dr. K. R. Nambiar',
  principalTitle = 'Principal & Head of Institution',
  principalDegree = 'M.Sc., M.Ed., Ph.D.',
  issueDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],

                IP: <span className="font-semibold">{record.performedBy.ipAddress}</span>
              </div>

                UA: {record.performedBy.userAgent}

              <div className="bg-slate-950 p-2 rounded text-indigo-200 font-bold break-all select-all border border-indigo-900/60">
                {record.currentHash}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            <span>
              {isMalayalam
                ? 'ഈ രേഖ തിരുത്തപ്പെടാത്ത സുരക്ഷിത ചെയിനിൽ എൻക്രിപ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നു.'
                : 'Tamper-Proof & Non-Repudiable Audit Record.'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-5 py-2 bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-slate-800 transition"
          >
            {isMalayalam ? 'അടയ്ക്കുക' : 'Close Details'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  AuditEntityType,
  AuditAction,
  AuditFieldDiff,
  TamperProofAuditRecord,
} from '@krypton/types';
import { complianceClient } from '@/lib/compliance-engine-client';
import { X, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle, Lock, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';

interface RecordOverrideModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onRecordCreated: (newRecord: TamperProofAuditRecord) => void;
  isMalayalam?: boolean;
}

export function RecordOverrideModal({
  onClose,
  onRecordCreated,
  isMalayalam = false,
}: RecordOverrideModalProps) {
  const [entityType, setEntityType] = useState<AuditEntityType>('GRADE');
  const [action, setAction] = useState<AuditAction>('GRADE_OVERRIDE');
  const [entityId, setEntityId] = useState('GRD-MATH-10B-205');
  const [entityName, setEntityName] = useState('Class 10B Mathematics Exam - Diya Mary Joseph');
  const [fieldLabel, setFieldLabel] = useState('Math Term 1 Marks');
  const [oldValue, setOldValue] = useState('79.0');
  const [newValue, setNewValue] = useState('88.0');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [approvalRef, setApprovalRef] = useState('PR/REV/2026/102');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleEntityTypeChange = (type: AuditEntityType) => {
    setEntityType(type);
    if (type === 'GRADE') {
      setAction('GRADE_OVERRIDE');
      setEntityId('GRD-MATH-10B-205');
      setEntityName('Class 10B Mathematics Exam - Diya Mary Joseph');
      setFieldLabel('Mathematics Final Score');
      setOldValue('79.0');
      setNewValue('88.0');
    } else if (type === 'FEE_PAYMENT') {
      setAction('FEE_STATUS_MODIFIED');
      setEntityId('INV-2026-940');
      setEntityName('Tuition Fee Invoice #INV-2026-940 - Siddharth Nair');
      setFieldLabel('Payment Status');
      setOldValue('PENDING');
      setNewValue('WAIVED_PRINCIPAL_SCHOLARSHIP');
    } else if (type === 'STUDENT_RECORD') {
      setAction('DOB_ALTERED');
      setEntityId('STU-105');
      setEntityName('Student Master Record - Siddharth Nair');
      setFieldLabel('Date of Birth');
      setOldValue('2010-09-28');
      setNewValue('2010-09-30');
    } else if (type === 'CERTIFICATE') {
      setAction('CERTIFICATE_REVOKED');
      setEntityId('TC-2026-09');
      setEntityName('Transfer Certificate #TC-2026-09');
      setFieldLabel('Certificate Status');
      setOldValue('ISSUED');
      setNewValue('REVOKED');
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reason.trim()) {
      setError(
        isMalayalam
          ? 'മാറ്റത്തിനുള്ള കാരണം നൽകൽ നിർബന്ധമാണ്!'
          : 'Mandatory justification / reason is required for security audit!',
      );
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const changes: AuditFieldDiff[] = [
        {
          field: fieldLabel.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_'),
          fieldLabel,
          oldValue,
          newValue,
          changeType: 'MODIFIED',
        },
      ];

      const newRecord = complianceClient.appendAuditRecord({
        entityType,
        entityId,
        entityName,
        action,
        performedBy: {
          userId: 'usr-admin-current',
          fullName: 'Dr. K. R. Nambiar (Principal)',
          role: 'PRINCIPAL_DIRECTOR',
          email: 'principal@kryptonschool.edu.in',
          ipAddress: '192.168.1.10',
          userAgent: navigator.userAgent || 'Mozilla/5.0 Krypton-Admin-Client',
        },
        reason: reason.trim(),
        approvalRef: approvalRef.trim() || undefined,
        changes,
      });

      onRecordCreated(newRecord);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Failed to append cryptographic audit block');
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-200 w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-950 via-slate-900 to-indigo-950 text-white p-6 relative">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="absolute top-5 right-5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="p-2.5 bg-red-500/20 border border-red-400/40 rounded-xl text-red-300">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-6 h-6" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">
                {isMalayalam ? 'സുരക്ഷിത രേഖ തിരുത്തൽ ലോഗ് ചെയ്യുക' : 'Log Controlled Record Modification'}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-0.5">
                {isMalayalam
                  ? 'മാർക്ക്, ഫീസ്, സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റ് തുടങ്ങിയ പ്രധാന വിവരങ്ങൾ തിരുത്തുമ്പോൾ ക്രിപ്റ്റോഗ്രാഫിക് ബ്ലോക്ക് ചെയിനിൽ രേഖപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു.'
                  : 'Tamper-evident SHA-256 blockchain audit block will be cryptographically sealed.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 flex-1 text-sm">
          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl text-red-700 text-xs font-semibold">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Entity Category Selector */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 mb-2">
              {isMalayalam ? 'തിരുത്തേണ്ട വിഭാഗം (Entity Type)' : 'Target Domain / Entity Type'}
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
              {[
                { type: 'GRADE', label: 'Marks / Grades', labelMl: 'മാർക്കുകൾ' },
                { type: 'FEE_PAYMENT', label: 'Fee / Payment', labelMl: 'ഫീസ് സ്റ്റാറ്റസ്' },
                { type: 'STUDENT_RECORD', label: 'Student Bio', labelMl: 'വിദ്യാർത്ഥി പ്രൊഫൈൽ' },
                { type: 'CERTIFICATE', label: 'Certificate', labelMl: 'സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റ്' },
              ].map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.type}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleEntityTypeChange(item.type as AuditEntityType)}
                  className={`px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold text-center transition ${
                    entityType === item.type
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600 shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isMalayalam ? item.labelMl : item.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Entity Name & ID */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">

              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">
                {isMalayalam ? 'റെക്കോർഡ് വിവരണം' : 'Target Entity Description'}
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={entityName}
                onChange={(e) => setEntityName(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none text-xs"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">
                {isMalayalam ? 'റെക്കോർഡ് ഐഡി' : 'Target Entity ID'}
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={entityId}
                onChange={(e) => setEntityId(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none text-xs font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Field Label, Old Value, New Value */}

                onChange={(e) => setFieldLabel(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs text-red-700 font-semibold mb-1">
                  {isMalayalam ? 'പഴയ മൂല്യം (Before)' : 'Old / Current Value'}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={oldValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setOldValue(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-red-300 bg-red-50/40 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs text-emerald-700 font-semibold mb-1">
                  {isMalayalam ? 'പുതിയ മൂല്യം (After)' : 'New Overridden Value'}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewValue(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/40 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Mandatory Reason */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-red-600 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{isMalayalam ? 'മാറ്റത്തിനുള്ള കാരണം (നിർബന്ധം)*' : 'Mandatory Justification / Reason *'}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-normal">Audited by External Regulators</span>
            </label>
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              required
              placeholder={
                isMalayalam
                  ? 'ഉദാഹരണത്തിന്: പ്രിൻസിപ്പലിന്റെ അനുമതിയോടെയുള്ള പുനർമൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം / ബാങ്ക് ചെക്ക് മടങ്ങിയതുമൂലമുള്ള ഫീസ് സ്റ്റാറ്റസ് മാറ്റം...'
                  : 'e.g. Re-evaluation approved by Academic Board Ref: PR/REV/2026/102...'
              }
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Approval Reference */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">
              {isMalayalam ? 'അംഗീകാര നമ്പർ / ഓർഡർ റഫറൻസ്' : 'Official Approval Reference / Order No'}
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={approvalRef}
              onChange={(e) => setApprovalRef(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. PR/REV/2026/102"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Blockchain Seal Notice */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-indigo-900">
            <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 flex-shrink-0" />
            <span>
              {isMalayalam
                ? 'ഈ മാറ്റം SHA-256 ക്രിപ്റ്റോഗ്രാഫിക് ഹാഷ് ഉപയോഗിച്ച് സീൽ ചെയ്യപ്പെടും. ഒരിക്കൽ ചേർത്താൽ മാറ്റാൻ കഴിയില്ല.'
                : 'This action will generate a permanent, tamper-evident cryptographic block in the immutable audit ledger.'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Form Actions */}
          <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-slate-100 transition"
            >
              {isMalayalam ? 'റദ്ദാക്കുക' : 'Cancel'}
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:brightness-110 transition shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>{isMalayalam ? 'സീൽ ചെയ്ത് ലോഗ് ചെയ്യുക' : 'Seal & Append to Ledger'}</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  TamperProofAuditRecord,
  AuditEntityType,
  AuditChainVerificationResult,
} from '@krypton/types';
import { complianceClient } from '@/lib/compliance-engine-client';
import { AuditDiffModal } from './AuditDiffModal';
import { RecordOverrideModal } from './RecordOverrideModal';
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  ShieldAlert,
  Search,
  Filter,
  RefreshCw,
  PlusCircle,
  Hash,
  Clock,
  User,
  ArrowRight,
  Lock,
  Unlock,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  AlertOctagon,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface TamperProofAuditTrailProps {
  isMalayalam?: boolean;
}

export function TamperProofAuditTrail({ isMalayalam = false }: TamperProofAuditTrailProps) {
  const [records, setRecords] = useState<TamperProofAuditRecord[]>(() =>
    complianceClient.getAuditRecords(),
  );
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedEntityFilter, setSelectedEntityFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [selectedRecordForDiff, setSelectedRecordForDiff] = useState<TamperProofAuditRecord | null>(null);
  const [isOverrideModalOpen, setIsOverrideModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [verificationResult, setVerificationResult] = useState<AuditChainVerificationResult | null>(null);
  const [isVerifying, setIsVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [tamperingSimulated, setTamperingSimulated] = useState(false);

  // Filter records
  const filteredRecords = records.filter((rec) => {
    const matchesFilter =
      selectedEntityFilter === 'ALL' || rec.entityType === selectedEntityFilter;
    const matchesSearch =
      rec.entityName.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      rec.performedBy.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      rec.reason.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      rec.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesFilter && matchesSearch;
  });

  // Verify chain integrity
  const handleVerifyChain = () => {
    setIsVerifying(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const result = complianceClient.verifyChainIntegrity();
      setVerificationResult(result);
      setIsVerifying(false);
    }, 600);
  };

  // Simulate unauthorized tampering
  const handleSimulateTamper = () => {
    try {
      complianceClient.simulateTampering(1);
      setTamperingSimulated(true);
      setRecords(complianceClient.getAuditRecords());
      // Re-verify immediately to demonstrate detection
      const result = complianceClient.verifyChainIntegrity();
      setVerificationResult(result);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Tamper simulation error: ${err?.message}`);
    }
  };

  // Restore chain
  const handleRestoreChain = () => {
    complianceClient.restoreChain();
    setTamperingSimulated(false);
    setRecords(complianceClient.getAuditRecords());
    setVerificationResult(complianceClient.verifyChainIntegrity());
  };

  // When a new record is created
  const handleRecordCreated = (newRecord: TamperProofAuditRecord) => {
    setRecords(complianceClient.getAuditRecords());
    setVerificationResult(complianceClient.verifyChainIntegrity());
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Verification & Integrity Banner */}
      <div
        className={`rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 border transition-all ${
          verificationResult?.isValid === false
            ? 'bg-red-950 text-white border-red-800 shadow-xl'
            : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-indigo-950 text-white border-slate-700 shadow-xl'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
            <div
              className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border ${
                verificationResult?.isValid === false
                  ? 'bg-red-900/60 border-red-500 text-red-200 animate-pulse'
                  : 'bg-indigo-500/20 border-indigo-400/30 text-indigo-300'
              }`}
            >
              {verificationResult?.isValid === false ? (
                <AlertOctagon className="w-8 h-8 text-red-400" />
              ) : (
                <ShieldCheck className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-400" />
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-white/10 text-white">
                  SHA-256 Merkle-Chain
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-mono">
                  {records.length} Blocks Minted
                </span>
              </div>

              <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-white mt-1">
                {verificationResult?.isValid === false
                  ? isMalayalam
                    ? '⚠️ മുന്നറിയിപ്പ്: ഡാറ്റാ തിരുത്തൽ / കൃത്രിമം കണ്ടെത്തി!'
                    : 'CRITICAL ALERT: Unauthorized Data Tampering Detected!'
                  : isMalayalam
                  ? 'തിരുത്താനാവാത്ത സെക്യൂരിറ്റി ഓഡിറ്റ് ലോഗ് (Tamper-Proof Audit Trail)'
                  : 'Tamper-Proof Security Audit Trail & Ledger'}
              </h2>

              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 mt-1 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
                {verificationResult?.isValid === false
                  ? verificationResult.tamperDetails
                  : isMalayalam
                  ? 'മാർക്കുകളോ, ഫീ പേയ്മെന്റുകളോ, സ്കൂൾ രേഖകളോ തിരുത്തപ്പെട്ടാൽ ആര്, എപ്പോൾ, എന്തുകൊണ്ട് മാറ്റി എന്ന് SHA-256 ക്രിപ്റ്റോഗ്രാഫിക് ഹാഷ് ചെയിൻ വഴി ശാശ്വതമായി സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.'
                  : 'Any modifications to marks, fee statuses, or certificates are cryptographically hash-chained with mandatory justification and IP origin.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={handleVerifyChain}
              disabled={isVerifying}
              className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md ${
                isVerifying
                  ? 'bg-slate-700 text-slate-400'
                  : 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isVerifying ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>
                {isVerifying
                  ? isMalayalam
                    ? 'പരിശോധിക്കുന്നു...'
                    : 'Verifying Blocks...'
                  : isMalayalam
                  ? 'ചെയിൻ പരിശോധിക്കുക (Verify Integrity)'
                  : 'Verify Chain Integrity'}
              </span>
            </button>

            {!tamperingSimulated ? (
              <button
                onClick={handleSimulateTamper}
                title="Test how the cryptographic engine catches direct database manipulation"
                className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-red-900/60 hover:bg-red-800 text-red-200 border border-red-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Unlock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-400" />
                <span>{isMalayalam ? 'കൃത്രിമം സിമുലേറ്റ് ചെയ്യുക (Test)' : 'Simulate DB Tampering'}</span>
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={handleRestoreChain}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isMalayalam ? 'ലോഗ് പുനഃസ്ഥാപിക്കുക' : 'Restore Clean Ledger'}</span>
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={() => setIsOverrideModalOpen(true)}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-white text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
              <span>{isMalayalam ? 'പുതിയ മാറ്റം ലോഗ് ചെയ്യുക' : 'Log Record Override'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Verification Success Box */}
        {verificationResult && verificationResult.isValid && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-emerald-950/80 border border-emerald-700/60 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-emerald-200">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>
                {isMalayalam
                  ? `ക്രിപ്റ്റോഗ്രാഫിക് പരിശോധന പൂർത്തിയായി: എല്ലാ ${verificationResult.totalBlocksVerified} ബ്ലോക്കുകളും സുരക്ഷിതമാണ്. ഒരു തിരുത്തലും കണ്ടെത്താനായില്ല.`
                  : `Cryptographic Audit Validated: All ${verificationResult.totalBlocksVerified} blocks intact. Zero tampering detected across entire ledger.`}
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-emerald-400">
              Verified: {new Date(verificationResult.verifiedAt).toLocaleTimeString()}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar: Filters & Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-200/90 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Entity Filters */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
          {[
            { id: 'ALL', label: 'All Records', labelMl: 'എല്ലാം' },
            { id: 'GRADE', label: 'Marks & Grades', labelMl: 'മാർക്കുകൾ' },
            { id: 'FEE_PAYMENT', label: 'Fees & Invoices', labelMl: 'ഫീസ്' },
            { id: 'STUDENT_RECORD', label: 'Student Bio', labelMl: 'വിദ്യാർത്ഥി പ്രൊഫൈൽ' },
          ].map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              onClick={() => setSelectedEntityFilter(item.id)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                selectedEntityFilter === item.id
                  ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              {isMalayalam ? item.labelMl : item.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={
              isMalayalam
                ? 'പേര്, ഐഡി, കാരണം തിരയുക...'
                : 'Search audit records, users, reasons...'
            }
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Audit Blocks Feed */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {filteredRecords.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-12 text-center border border-slate-200">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-2" />
            <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm">
              {isMalayalam ? 'ഓഡിറ്റ് രേഖകൾ ലഭ്യമല്ല' : 'No Audit Records Match Query'}
            </h3>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredRecords.map((record) => {
            const isCorrupted = record.isTampered;

            return (
              <div
                key={record.id}
                className={`bg-white rounded-2xl border transition-all overflow-hidden ${
                  isCorrupted
                    ? 'border-red-500 shadow-md ring-2 ring-red-400'
                    : 'border-slate-200/90 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Block Header Strip */}
                <div
                  className={`px-6 py-3 border-b flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs ${
                    isCorrupted
                      ? 'bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-900'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 text-white text-[11px]">
                      Block #{record.sequence}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-500 font-semibold">{record.id}</span>
                    <span
                      className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold text-[10px] uppercase ${
                        record.entityType === 'GRADE'
                          ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                          : record.entityType === 'FEE_PAYMENT'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                          : record.entityType === 'STUDENT_RECORD'
                          ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800'
                          : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {record.action.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                      {new Date(record.timestamp).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
                        dateStyle: 'medium',
                        timeStyle: 'short',
                      })}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono bg-slate-200/70 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-slate-600">
                      IP: {record.performedBy.ipAddress}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Block Content */}
                <div className="p-6">
                  <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                    {/* Left: Target and Mandatory Reason */}
                    <div className="max-w-2xl space-y-2">
                      <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>{record.entityName}</span>
                        {isCorrupted && (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-600 text-white text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
                            TAMPERED
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Mandatory Reason (Highlighted) */}
                      <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/70 border border-amber-200/80 rounded-xl text-xs text-amber-950 font-medium">
                        <span className="font-bold text-amber-900">
                          {isMalayalam ? 'മാറ്റത്തിനുള്ള കാരണം:' : 'Mandatory Reason:'}{' '}
                        </span>
                        &ldquo;{record.reason}&rdquo;
                        {record.approvalRef && (
                          <span className="ml-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-amber-200 text-amber-900 font-bold rounded text-[10px]">
                            Ref: {record.approvalRef}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Operator Info */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                        <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{record.performedBy.fullName}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400">•</span>
                        <span className="text-indigo-700 font-semibold">{record.performedBy.role}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400">•</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px]">{record.performedBy.email}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right: Quick Diff Preview & Inspect Button */}
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3">
                      {record.changes.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs min-w-[220px]">
                          <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">
                            {record.changes[0].fieldLabel}
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
                            <span className="text-red-700 line-through truncate max-w-[80px]">
                              {String(record.changes[0].oldValue || '')}
                            </span>
                            <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                            <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold truncate max-w-[100px]">
                              {String(record.changes[0].newValue || '')}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <button
                        onClick={() => setSelectedRecordForDiff(record)}
                        className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm whitespace-nowrap"
                      >
                        <span>{isMalayalam ? 'പൂർണ്ണ മാറ്റം കാണുക' : 'Inspect Full Diff'}</span>
                        <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Cryptographic Hash Bar */}
                  <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate max-w-md">
                      <Hash className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-500" />
                      <span className="text-slate-500">Hash:</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-700 font-bold truncate select-all">
                        {record.currentHash}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-slate-500">Prev Hash:</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[120px] select-all">
                        {record.previousHash.substring(0, 16)}...
                      </span>
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded border border-indigo-200 text-[10px] font-bold">
                        {record.signature}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Inspect Diff Modal */}
      {selectedRecordForDiff && (
        <AuditDiffModal
          record={selectedRecordForDiff}
          onClose={() => setSelectedRecordForDiff(null)}
          isMalayalam={isMalayalam}
        />
      )}

      {/* Record Controlled Modification Modal */}
      {isOverrideModalOpen && (
        <RecordOverrideModal
          onClose={() => setIsOverrideModalOpen(false)}
          onRecordCreated={handleRecordCreated}
          isMalayalam={isMalayalam}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { BoardExportTemplate, ComplianceValidationIssue } from '@krypton/types';

interface ValidationIssuesModalProps {

  onClose: () => void;
  onProceedExport: () => void;
  isMalayalam?: boolean;
