export function ValidationIssuesModal({
  template,
  issues,
  onClose,
  onProceedExport,
  isMalayalam = false,
}: ValidationIssuesModalProps) {
  if (!template) return null;

  const errors = issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'ERROR');
  const warnings = issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'WARNING');

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-200 w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-[88vh] flex flex-col">

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="absolute top-5 right-5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="p-2.5 bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/40 rounded-xl text-indigo-300">

                {template.portalName}

              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                {isMalayalam ? 'കംപ്ലയൻസ് സ്കോർ' : 'Compliance Readiness'}
              </div>

              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
            {errors.length > 0 && (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold bg-red-100 text-red-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {errors.length} {isMalayalam ? 'പിഴവുകൾ' : 'Errors'}
              </span>
            )}
            {warnings.length > 0 && (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {warnings.length} {isMalayalam ? 'മുന്നറിയിപ്പുകൾ' : 'Warnings'}
              </span>
            )}
            {issues.length === 0 && (
              <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {isMalayalam ? '100% കൃത്യം' : '100% Verified'}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

                  </span>
                  <span>{issue.suggestedFix}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}

            onClick={onClose}

            onClick={() => {
              onProceedExport();
              onClose();

          </button>

'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Bot,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronRight,
  Download,
  Filter,
  GraduationCap,
  HelpCircle,
  MessageCircle,
  Printer,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
  UserCheck,
  Users,
  Wallet,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type {
  ERPCopilotQueryResponse,
  ERPCopilotStudentMatch,
  TeachingLanguage,
} from '@krypton/types';
import { runCopilotQuery } from '@/lib/copilot-client';
import { exportCsv, messageFor } from '@/lib/workspace';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
import { PageHeading, Panel, StatCard } from '@/components/WorkspaceUI';

const SUGGESTED_QUERIES = [
  'Show me all Grade 9 students who have attendance < 80% and unpaid fee balance',
  'Find students with fee arrears over 10000 in Grade 10',
  'Which students had marks drop below 40% or need academic support?',
  'Students with low attendance < 75% across the school',
  'Show high-risk dropout students with falling attendance',
  'Find top academic achievers with marks > 85%',
];

interface ERPCopilotViewProps {
  portal?: 'admin' | 'teacher' | 'school' | 'dashboard';
}

export function ERPCopilotView({ portal = 'school' }: ERPCopilotViewProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('Show me all Grade 9 students who have attendance < 80% and unpaid fee balance');
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState<TeachingLanguage>('English');
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ERPCopilotQueryResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [selectedStudent, setSelectedStudent] = useState<ERPCopilotStudentMatch | null>(null);
  const [whatsappNoticeSent, setWhatsappNoticeSent] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const activeRequest = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const executeSearch = useCallback(async (searchQuery: string) => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
    activeRequest.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    activeRequest.current = controller;

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSelectedStudent(null);

    try {
      const data = await runCopilotQuery(searchQuery.trim(), language, controller.signal);
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setResult(data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setError(messageFor(err));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [language]);

  // Run initial query on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    void executeSearch(query);
    return () => activeRequest.current?.abort();
  }, []);

  const handlePromptClick = (promptText: string) => {
    setQuery(promptText);
    void executeSearch(promptText);
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    if (!result || !result.matches.length) return;
    const records = result.matches.map(m => ({
      name: m.name,
      admission: m.admissionNumber,
      className: m.className,
      attendance: m.attendanceRate !== null ? `${m.attendanceRate}%` : 'N/A',
      examAverage: m.latestAverage !== null ? `${m.latestAverage}%` : 'N/A',
      feeBalance: m.outstandingBalance / 100,
      riskLevel: m.riskLevel,
      parentName: m.parentName || 'N/A',
      parentPhone: m.parentPhone || 'N/A',
      reasons: m.reasons.join(' | '),
    }));

    exportCsv('copilot-executive-results', [
      { key: 'name', label: 'Student Name' },
      { key: 'admission', label: 'Admission Number' },
      { key: 'className', label: 'Class' },
      { key: 'attendance', label: 'Attendance Rate' },
      { key: 'examAverage', label: 'Latest Exam Average' },
      { key: 'feeBalance', label: `Outstanding Fee (${result.currency})` },
      { key: 'riskLevel', label: 'Risk Priority' },
      { key: 'parentName', label: 'Parent Name' },
      { key: 'parentPhone', label: 'Parent Phone' },
      { key: 'reasons', label: 'Identified Signals' },
    ], records);
  };

  const openWhatsAppAlert = (student: ERPCopilotStudentMatch) => {
    const parentPhone = student.parentPhone?.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') || '';
    const message = encodeURIComponent(
      `Dear Parent of ${student.name} (${student.admissionNumber}), this is an official academic & attendance update from the School Administration.\n\n` +
      `Current Attendance: ${student.attendanceRate !== null ? `${student.attendanceRate}%` : 'Under Review'}\n` +
      `Academic Average: ${student.latestAverage !== null ? `${student.latestAverage}%` : 'Under Review'}\n` +
      (student.outstandingBalance > 0 ? `Pending Fee Balance: ${result?.currency ?? 'KES'} ${(student.outstandingBalance / 100).toLocaleString()}\n` : '') +
      `\nPlease contact the Class Teacher or schedule a Virtual PTM at your earliest convenience.`
    );

    const url = parentPhone
      ? `https://wa.me/${parentPhone}?text=${message}`
      : `https://wa.me/?text=${message}`;

    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    setWhatsappNoticeSent(prev => ({ ...prev, [student.studentId]: true }));
  };

  const currencySymbol = result?.currency ?? 'KES';

  return (
    <div className="content-stack copilot-workspace">
      <PageHeading
        eyebrow="INTELLIGENT ACADEMIC & ERP COPILOT"
        title="Ask ERP Copilot"
        description="Type natural language queries to search, filter, and extract actionable insights across attendance, marks, fees, and student risks in seconds."
        actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <select
              aria-label="Copilot Language"
              value={language}
              onChange={e => setLanguage(e.target.value as TeachingLanguage)}
              className="text-sm bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500"
            >
              <option value="English">English</option>
              <option value="Malayalam">Malayalam (മലയാളം)</option>
              <option value="Swahili">Swahili (Kiswahili)</option>
            </select>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={loading || !result?.matches.length}
              leftIcon={<Download size={15} />}
              onClick={handleExportCsv}
            >
              Export CSV
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              leftIcon={<Printer size={15} />}
              onClick={() => window.print()}
            >
              Print Report
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {/* Main NLP Search Bar */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900 via-primary-900 to-indigo-950 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-xl text-white">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/30 flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-300">
            <Bot size={22} className="animate-pulse" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              Natural Language Executive Search
              <span className="text-xs bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-200 border border-indigo-400/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono">
                AI Powered
              </span>
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200">
              Query student rosters, fee arrears, attendance rates, and exam drops in conversational English or regional terms.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <form
          onSubmit={e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            void executeSearch(query);
          }}
          className="relative mt-2"
        >
          <div className="relative flex items-center">
            <Search className="absolute left-4 text-indigo-300" size={20} />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={query}
              onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Show me all Grade 9 students who have attendance < 80% and unpaid fee balance"
              className="w-full pl-12 pr-32 py-4 rounded-xl bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white placeholder-indigo-200 text-base focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400 focus:bg-white/15 transition-all shadow-inner"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading || !query.trim()}
              className="absolute right-2 px-5 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-primary-600 hover:from-indigo-600 hover:to-primary-700 text-white font-medium text-sm rounded-lg shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              {loading ? <RefreshCw size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles size={16} />}
              Ask Copilot
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Quick Suggestion Pills */}
        <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-white/10">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-300 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-2">
            Try Suggested Queries:
          </span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {SUGGESTED_QUERIES.map((sq, idx) => (
              <button
                key={idx}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePromptClick(sq)}
                className="text-xs text-left bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:bg-white/30 text-indigo-100 border border-white/15 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Sparkles size={12} className="text-indigo-300 flex-shrink-0" />
                <span>{sq}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="state-box" role="alert">
          {error}
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void executeSearch(query)}>
            Retry Query
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {loading && (
        <div className="panel panel-body text-center py-10" role="status">
          <RefreshCw size={32} className="animate-spin text-primary-600 mx-auto mb-3" />
          <p className="font-medium text-gray-800">Copilot is analyzing student records, attendance registers, and payment balances…</p>
          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">Applying multi-parameter filter predicates in real time.</span>

                <Filter size={14} /> Filter Breakdown:
              </span>
              {result.parsedFilters.map((badge, idx) => (
                <span
                  key={idx}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-white text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-200 shadow-sm"
                >
                  <strong className="text-indigo-600">{badge.label}:</strong>
                  <span>{badge.value}</span>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Metric Summary Cards */}
          <div className="metric-grid">
            <StatCard
              label="Matching Students"
              value={result.totalCount}
              note="Meeting all query parameters"
              icon={Users}
            />
            <StatCard
              label="Outstanding Fee Arrears"
              value={`${currencySymbol} ${(result.summary.totalOutstanding / 100).toLocaleString()}`}
              note="Cumulative debt in this cohort"
              icon={Wallet}
            />
            <StatCard

                    {result.matches.map(student => {
                      const isHigh = student.riskLevel === 'HIGH';
                      const isMod = student.riskLevel === 'MODERATE';
                      const noticeSent = !!whatsappNoticeSent[student.studentId];

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={student.studentId}
                          className="hover:bg-indigo-50/40 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <td className="py-3 px-4">
                            <strong className="block text-gray-900 font-semibold">{student.name}</strong>
                            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono">{student.admissionNumber}</span>

                          <td className="py-3 px-3">
                            {student.attendanceRate !== null ? (
                              <span className={`font-medium ${student.attendanceRate < 80 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
                                {student.attendanceRate}%
                                <small className="text-gray-400 block text-xs">
                                  {student.attendanceDays} days recorded
                                </small>
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-gray-400 text-xs">No records</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-3">
                            {student.latestAverage !== null ? (
                              <span className={`font-medium ${student.latestAverage < 50 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
                                {student.latestAverage}%
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-gray-400 text-xs">No grades</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-3">
                            {student.outstandingBalance > 0 ? (
                              <span className="font-semibold text-red-600">
                                {currencySymbol} {(student.outstandingBalance / 100).toLocaleString()}
                                {student.overdueBalance > 0 && (
                                  <span className="block text-xs font-normal text-red-500">Overdue</span>
                                )}
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-emerald-600 text-xs font-medium">Cleared</span>

                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 px-3">

                              {student.riskLevel}
                            </span>

                              <Link

                      </strong>

                      <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 block">Exam Average</span>
                      <strong className="text-base text-gray-900">

                      Parent / Guardian Contact

                      <p><strong>Phone:</strong> {selectedStudent.parentPhone || 'Not provided'}</p>
                      <p><strong>Email:</strong> {selectedStudent.parentEmail || 'Not provided'}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      Identified Signal Details
                    </h4>
                    <ul className="text-xs text-gray-700 space-y-1 bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-100">
                      {selectedStudent.reasons.map((r, i) => (
                        <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-primary-600 font-bold">•</span>
                          <span>{r}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => openWhatsAppAlert(selectedStudent)}
                      leftIcon={<MessageCircle size={15} />}
                    >
                      Send WhatsApp Notice
                    </Button>
                    <Link
                      href="/dashboard/ptm"
                      className="px-4 py-2 bg-primary-600 hover:bg-primary-700 text-white text-xs font-medium rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <Calendar size={15} />
                      Book Virtual PTM
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function NavLink({ href, children }: { href: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const isActive = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.pathname === href;

  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
        isActive
          ? 'bg-primary-50 text-primary-700'
          : 'text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50'
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Award,
  Users,
  GraduationCap,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  Sliders,
  Percent,
  Search,
  ArrowRight,
  Info,
  Building,
  HeartHandshake,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  financeClient,
} from '@/lib/finance-client';
import {
  ConcessionRule,
  StudentConcessionMatch,
} from '@krypton/types';

export function ConcessionMatrixView() {
  const [rules, setRules] = useState<ConcessionRule[]>(() => financeClient.getConcessionRules());
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<'ALL' | 'SIBLING' | 'STAFF' | 'MERIT'>('ALL');

  const matches: StudentConcessionMatch[] = financeClient.evaluateConcessionsMatrix();

  const handleToggleRule = (ruleId: string) => {
    const updated = rules.map((r) => (r.id === ruleId ? { ...r, isActive: !r.isActive } : r));
    setRules(updated);
    financeClient.saveConcessionRules(updated);
  };

  const handlePercentageChange = (ruleId: string, newPercent: number) => {
    const updated = rules.map((r) =>
      r.id === ruleId ? { ...r, discountPercentage: Math.max(1, Math.min(100, newPercent)) } : r
    );
    setRules(updated);
    financeClient.saveConcessionRules(updated);
  };

  const filteredMatches = matches.filter((m) => {
    const matchSearch =
      m.studentName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      m.admissionNumber.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      m.grade.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

    if (!matchSearch) return false;

    if (activeCategory === 'SIBLING') return (m.siblingCount || 0) > 1;
    if (activeCategory === 'STAFF') return m.isStaffChild;
    if (activeCategory === 'MERIT') return (m.academicGpaPercent || 0) >= 90;

    return true;
  });

  const totalConcessionsGranted = matches.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.totalConcessionAmount, 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 text-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-indigo-900/40">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/30 rounded-xl text-indigo-300">
                <Award size={22} />
              </span>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">
                Scholarship & Sibling Concession Matrix
              </h2>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 max-w-2xl">
              Automated institutional discount matrix engine. Intelligently cross-references sibling
              guardianship, staff biological dependents, and board examination merit scores to
              auto-apply fee concessions without manual paperwork.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md px-5 py-3 rounded-xl border border-white/15 text-right">
            <span className="text-xs text-indigo-200 block uppercase font-medium">Total Concessions Granted</span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
              ₹{totalConcessionsGranted.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 block">Applied across student invoices</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dynamic Rule Matrix Cards */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sliders size={16} className="text-indigo-600" />
            Configured Concession Rules & Percentage Matrix
          </h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Live Auto-Evaluation Active</span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {rules.map((rule) => (
            <div
              key={rule.id}
              className={`p-4 rounded-xl border transition ${
                rule.isActive
                  ? 'bg-white border-slate-200 shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 opacity-60'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                <span
                  className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase ${
                    rule.type === 'SIBLING'
                      ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                      : rule.type === 'STAFF_CHILD'
                      ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800'
                      : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  {rule.type.replace('_', ' ')}
                </span>
                <label className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={rule.isActive}
                    onChange={() => handleToggleRule(rule.id)}
                    className="sr-only peer"
                  />
                  <div className="w-8 h-4 bg-slate-300 peer-focus:outline-none rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-[1px] after:left-[2px] after:bg-white after:border-slate-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-3.5 after:w-3.5 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-indigo-600"></div>
                </label>
              </div>

              <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm mb-1">{rule.name}</h4>
              {rule.nameMl && (
                <p className="text-xs text-indigo-700 font-medium mb-2">{rule.nameMl}</p>
              )}
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-3">{rule.criteriaDescription}</p>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">Waiver %</span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={5}
                    max={100}
                    value={rule.discountPercentage}
                    onChange={(e) => handlePercentageChange(rule.id, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)}
                    className="w-14 text-xs font-bold text-center px-1.5 py-1 border border-slate-300 rounded font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">%</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Search Bar for Students */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full sm:w-auto">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory('ALL')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition ${
              activeCategory === 'ALL'
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
            }`}
          >
            All Students ({matches.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory('SIBLING')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition flex items-center gap-1 ${
              activeCategory === 'SIBLING'
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
            }`}
          >
            <Users size={13} /> Sibling Groups
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory('STAFF')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition flex items-center gap-1 ${
              activeCategory === 'STAFF'
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
            }`}
          >
            <Building size={13} /> Staff Children
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory('MERIT')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition flex items-center gap-1 ${
              activeCategory === 'MERIT'
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
            }`}
          >
            <GraduationCap size={13} /> Merit Scholars (90%+)
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
          <input
            type="text"

            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full text-xs pl-8 pr-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 bg-white"
          />

                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200">
              {filteredMatches.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                    No students match the selected category.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredMatches.map((m) => {
                  const hasConcession = m.appliedConcessions.length > 0;
                  return (
                    <tr key={m.studentId} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm block">

                          {m.admissionNumber} • {m.grade}

                        {m.siblingCount && m.siblingCount > 1 ? (

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  Send,
  MessageSquare,
  Mail,
  Smartphone,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  TrendingUp,
  RefreshCw,
  Sparkles,
  HelpCircle,
  CreditCard,
  Layers,
  ChevronRight,
  ShieldAlert,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  financeClient,
  DemoInvoice,
} from '@/lib/finance-client';
import {
  DunningStage,
  DunningNotice,
  PaymentPlan,
} from '@krypton/types';

interface DunningAutomationViewProps {
  invoices: DemoInvoice[];
  onOpenCheckout: (invoice: DemoInvoice) => void;
  onRefreshData: () => void;
}

export function DunningAutomationView({
  invoices,
  onOpenCheckout,
  onRefreshData,
}: DunningAutomationViewProps) {
  const [filterStage, setFilterStage] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [isRunningAutomation, setIsRunningAutomation] = useState(false);
  const [dispatchLog, setDispatchLog] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedNoticeForPreview, setSelectedNoticeForPreview] = useState<DunningNotice | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'notices' | 'plans'>('notices');

  const dunningNotices = financeClient.evaluateDunningSchedule(invoices);
  const paymentPlans = financeClient.getPaymentPlans();

  // Statistics across dunning pipeline
  const softCount = dunningNotices.filter((n) => n.stage === 'UPCOMING_SOFT').length;
  const dueCount = dunningNotices.filter((n) => n.stage === 'DUE_ALERT').length;
  const lateFeeCount = dunningNotices.filter((n) => n.stage === 'OVERDUE_LATE_FEE').length;
  const planOfferCount = dunningNotices.filter((n) => n.stage === 'PAYMENT_PLAN_OFFER').length;

  const totalLateFeeAccrued = dunningNotices.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.lateFeeAmount, 0);

  const filteredNotices = dunningNotices.filter((n) => {
    if (filterStage === 'ALL') return true;
    return n.stage === filterStage;
  });

  const handleRunDunningAutomation = async () => {
    setIsRunningAutomation(true);
    setDispatchLog([]);

    const logs: string[] = [];
    logs.push('Evaluating dunning schedule for all active invoices against today (11 Oct 2026)...');
    setDispatchLog([...logs]);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));

    logs.push(`Found ${softCount} students within 7-day soft reminder window.`);
    setDispatchLog([...logs]);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));

    logs.push(`Found ${dueCount} invoices due today (Due Alert dispatched via WhatsApp).`);
    setDispatchLog([...logs]);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));

    logs.push(`Calculated ₹${totalLateFeeAccrued.toLocaleString()} late fees on ${lateFeeCount} overdue accounts.`);
    setDispatchLog([...logs]);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));

    logs.push(`Generated automated 3-Month Payment Plan options for ${planOfferCount} extended delinquent accounts.`);
    logs.push('✓ Automated Dunning cycle executed successfully. Notifications delivered.');
    setDispatchLog([...logs]);

    setIsRunningAutomation(false);
  };

  const handleActivatePaymentPlan = (invoiceId: string) => {
    try {
      const plan = financeClient.createPaymentPlan(invoiceId, 3);
      alert(`Payment Plan created successfully! Total amount of ₹${plan.totalAmount.toLocaleString()} split into 3 monthly interest-free installments.`);
      onRefreshData();
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || 'Failed to create plan');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Engine Overview Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 text-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-indigo-900/40 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/30 rounded-xl text-indigo-300">
                <Clock size={22} />
              </span>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">
                Automated Dunning & Fee Escalation Engine
              </h2>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 max-w-2xl">
              Proactive multi-stage dunning automation: 7-day Soft Reminders ➔ Due Alerts ➔ Dynamic Late Fee
              Escalation ➔ Automatic 3-Month Installment Plans. Maximizes fee recovery while protecting parent trust.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={handleRunDunningAutomation}
              disabled={isRunningAutomation}
              className="px-5 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-indigo-600 hover:from-indigo-600 hover:to-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/25 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition disabled:opacity-75 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={isRunningAutomation ? 'animate-spin' : ''} size={16} />
              <span>{isRunningAutomation ? 'Running Cycle...' : 'Run Automated Dunning Cycle'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4-Stage Visual Dunning Pipeline Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Stage 1: Soft Reminder */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setFilterStage('UPCOMING_SOFT')}
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border transition cursor-pointer ${
            filterStage === 'UPCOMING_SOFT'
              ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/60 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20'
              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              STAGE 1 • T - 7 DAYS
            </span>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{softCount}</span>
          </div>
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">Soft Friendly Reminder</h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Gentle courtesy notice with 1-click payment link sent via WhatsApp.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Stage 2: Due Alert */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setFilterStage('DUE_ALERT')}
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border transition cursor-pointer ${
            filterStage === 'DUE_ALERT'
              ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50/60 ring-2 ring-blue-500/20'
              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-800 bg-blue-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              STAGE 2 • DUE DATE (T-0)
            </span>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-blue-600">{dueCount}</span>
          </div>
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">Due Date Alert</h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Urgent notification on the deadline to prevent lapse into penalty period.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Stage 3: Late Fee Accrual */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setFilterStage('OVERDUE_LATE_FEE')}
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border transition cursor-pointer ${
            filterStage === 'OVERDUE_LATE_FEE'
              ? 'border-amber-500 bg-amber-50/60 ring-2 ring-amber-500/20'
              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-800 bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              STAGE 3 • T + 1-14 DAYS
            </span>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-amber-600">{lateFeeCount}</span>
          </div>
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">Late Fee Escalation</h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Dynamic late fees added (₹{totalLateFeeAccrued.toLocaleString()} total accrued).
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Stage 4: Payment Plan Offer */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setFilterStage('PAYMENT_PLAN_OFFER')}
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border transition cursor-pointer ${
            filterStage === 'PAYMENT_PLAN_OFFER'
              ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/60 ring-2 ring-rose-500/20'
              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-800 bg-rose-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              STAGE 4 • T + 15+ DAYS
            </span>
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-rose-600">{planOfferCount}</span>
          </div>
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">Payment Plan Offer</h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Split into 3 monthly interest-free installments to recover funds safely.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live Automation Dispatch Console (when running) */}
      {dispatchLog.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-200 p-4 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs space-y-1.5 border border-slate-800 shadow-md">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-indigo-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-800 pb-1.5 mb-2">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles size={14} /> Dunning Automation Execution Log
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Timestamp: 2026-10-11T12:20:00Z</span>
          </div>
          {dispatchLog.map((log, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="leading-relaxed">
              <span className="text-indigo-400">»</span> {log}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs: Dunning Notices vs Active Installment Plans */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('notices')}
            className={`text-sm font-bold pb-2 transition flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeTab === 'notices'
                ? 'text-indigo-600 border-b-2 border-indigo-600'
                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            <Clock size={16} />
            <span>Active Dunning Notices ({dunningNotices.length})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('plans')}
            className={`text-sm font-bold pb-2 transition flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeTab === 'plans'
                ? 'text-indigo-600 border-b-2 border-indigo-600'
                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'
            }`}
          >
            <Layers size={16} />
            <span>Active Installment Payment Plans ({paymentPlans.length})</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {activeTab === 'notices' && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">Filter Stage:</span>
            <select
              value={filterStage}
              onChange={(e) => setFilterStage(e.target.value)}
              className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
            >
              <option value="ALL">All Stages ({dunningNotices.length})</option>
              <option value="UPCOMING_SOFT">Stage 1: Soft Reminder</option>
              <option value="DUE_ALERT">Stage 2: Due Alert</option>
              <option value="OVERDUE_LATE_FEE">Stage 3: Late Fee Overdue</option>
              <option value="PAYMENT_PLAN_OFFER">Stage 4: Payment Plan Offer</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'notices' ? (
        /* DUNNING NOTICES TABLE */
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Student & Guardian</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Dunning Stage</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Due Date</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Fee Balance</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Late Fee</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Total Payable</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Notification Preview</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200">
                {filteredNotices.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={8} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                      No invoices currently in this dunning stage.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  filteredNotices.map((notice) => {
                    const originalInv = invoices.find((i) => i.id === notice.invoiceId);
                    return (
                      <tr key={notice.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition">
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm block">
                            {notice.studentName}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                            {notice.guardianName} • {notice.guardianPhone}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          {notice.stage === 'UPCOMING_SOFT' && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
                              <Clock size={12} /> 7-Day Soft Reminder
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {notice.stage === 'DUE_ALERT' && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200">
                              <AlertTriangle size={12} /> Due Today Alert
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {notice.stage === 'OVERDUE_LATE_FEE' && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200">
                              <AlertTriangle size={12} /> {Math.abs(notice.daysRemainingOrOverdue)}d Overdue (+Late Fee)
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {notice.stage === 'PAYMENT_PLAN_OFFER' && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200">
                              <ShieldAlert size={12} /> {Math.abs(notice.daysRemainingOrOverdue)}d Overdue (Payment Plan)
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-slate-600">
                          {notice.dueDate}
                          <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            {notice.daysRemainingOrOverdue >= 0
                              ? `in ${notice.daysRemainingOrOverdue} days`
                              : `${Math.abs(notice.daysRemainingOrOverdue)} days past`}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-700">
                          ₹{notice.originalAmount.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-amber-600 font-semibold">
                          {notice.lateFeeAmount > 0 ? `+₹${notice.lateFeeAmount.toLocaleString()}` : '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                          ₹{notice.totalPayable.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setSelectedNoticeForPreview(notice)}
                            className="text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 text-[11px] font-medium underline inline-flex items-center gap-1"
                          >
                            <MessageSquare size={13} /> View Message
                          </button>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right space-x-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                          {notice.paymentPlanEligible && !notice.paymentPlanOffered && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => handleActivatePaymentPlan(notice.invoiceId)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-purple-50 hover:bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold transition"
                            >
                              Offer 3-Mo Plan
                            </button>
                          )}
                          {originalInv && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => onOpenCheckout(originalInv)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded text-[11px] font-semibold shadow-sm transition"
                            >
                              Pay Now
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* PAYMENT PLANS OVERVIEW */
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {paymentPlans.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-400">
              <Layers size={36} className="mx-auto mb-2 opacity-50" />
              <p className="font-semibold text-slate-600">No active installment plans yet.</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
                Installment plans can be offered automatically to students with 15+ days overdue fees.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            paymentPlans.map((plan) => (
              <div key={plan.id} className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-base">{plan.studentName}</h4>
                      <span className="text-xs bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono font-semibold">
                        0% Interest Relief Plan
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                      Total Financed: ₹{plan.totalAmount.toLocaleString()} • Split across {plan.installmentsCount} Monthly Tranches
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded border border-indigo-200">
                    STATUS: {plan.status}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  {plan.installments.map((inst) => (
                    <div
                      key={inst.installmentNumber}
                      className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-xs space-y-1"
                    >
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-bold text-slate-700">
                        <span>Tranche #{inst.installmentNumber}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-900">₹{inst.amount.toLocaleString()}</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Calendar size={12} /> Due: {inst.dueDate}
                      </p>
                      <span className="inline-block mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">
                        PENDING
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Message Preview Modal */}
      {selectedNoticeForPreview && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl max-w-md w-full p-5 border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-900 font-bold text-sm">
                <MessageSquare size={18} className="text-indigo-600" />
                <span>Automated Dunning Message Preview</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedNoticeForPreview(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-500">
                <span>Channel: <strong>{selectedNoticeForPreview.channel}</strong></span>
                <span>To: <strong>{selectedNoticeForPreview.guardianPhone}</strong></span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-slate-800 font-sans leading-relaxed bg-white p-3 rounded border border-slate-200">
                "{selectedNoticeForPreview.messagePreview}"
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedNoticeForPreview(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Close Preview
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type FinanceTab = 'overview' | 'dunning' | 'concessions' | 'payroll' | 'staff-portal';

export function FinanceDashboard() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<FinanceTab>('overview');
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<DemoInvoice[]>(() => financeClient.getInvoices());
  const [selectedInvoiceForCheckout, setSelectedInvoiceForCheckout] = useState<DemoInvoice | null>(null);
  const [isCheckoutOpen, setIsCheckoutOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'PENDING' | 'OVERDUE' | 'PAID' | 'PAYMENT_PLAN'>('ALL');

  const metrics = financeClient.getSummaryMetrics();
  const paymentRecords = financeClient.getPaymentRecords();

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    setInvoices(financeClient.getInvoices());
  };

  const handleOpenCheckout = (inv: DemoInvoice) => {
    setSelectedInvoiceForCheckout(inv);
    setIsCheckoutOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePaymentComplete = (updatedInv: DemoInvoice) => {
    setInvoices(financeClient.getInvoices());
  };

  const filteredInvoices = invoices.filter((inv) => {
    const matchSearch =
      inv.studentName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      inv.invoiceNumber.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      inv.admissionNumber.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      inv.guardianName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

    if (!matchSearch) return false;
    if (statusFilter !== 'ALL' && inv.status !== statusFilter) return false;
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-16">
      {/* Top Banner / Hero */}

        {/* Subtle decorative glow */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 -mr-20 -mt-20 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 -ml-20 -mb-20 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/30 text-indigo-300 text-xs font-semibold">
              <Sparkles size={14} />
              <span>End-to-End Financial Automation ERP</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
              Advanced Institutional Finance & Treasury Engine
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
              പൂർണ്ണ സാമ്പത്തിക നിയന്ത്രണം: Global Multi-Gateway Checkout (Stripe, M-Pesa, PayPal, UPI) •
              Automated Dunning & Late Fee Escalation • Scholarship & Sibling Concession Matrix • Staff HRMS & 1-Click Payroll.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                const overdueInv = invoices.find((i) => i.status === 'OVERDUE' || i.status === 'PENDING') || invoices[0];
                handleOpenCheckout(overdueInv);
              }}
              className="px-5 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-indigo-600 hover:from-indigo-600 hover:to-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 flex items-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <CreditCard size={18} />
              <span>Launch Global Checkout</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Executive Financial Metrics Bar */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 pt-6 mt-6 border-t border-indigo-900/60">

            <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-200 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">
              TOTAL INVOICED
            </span>
            <span className="text-lg font-bold font-mono text-white mt-0.5 block">
              ₹{metrics.totalInvoiced.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
          </div>

          className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition whitespace-nowrap relative ${
            activeTab === 'dunning'
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100'
          }`}
        >
          <Clock size={16} />
          <span>Automated Dunning & Escalation</span>
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 absolute top-2 right-2" />
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('concessions')}
          className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition whitespace-nowrap ${
            activeTab === 'concessions'
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100'
          }`}

          className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition whitespace-nowrap ${
            activeTab === 'staff-portal'
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100'
          }`}
        >
          <Briefcase size={16} />
          <span>Staff Self-Service Portal</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab Content Rendering */}
      {activeTab === 'overview' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Invoices Filters & Search Bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full sm:w-auto">
              {(['ALL', 'PENDING', 'OVERDUE', 'PAID', 'PAYMENT_PLAN'] as const).map((st) => (
                <button
                  key={st}
                  onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                    statusFilter === st
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
                  }`}
                >
                  {st.replace('_', ' ')}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search student, invoice #, guardian..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full text-xs pl-8 pr-3 py-2 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 bg-white"
              />
              <Search size={14} className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Invoices Master Table */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">
                  Active Student Invoices & Payment Ledger
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Click 'Pay with Gateway' on any invoice to test international checkout (Stripe, M-Pesa, PayPal, UPI).
                </p>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                {filteredInvoices.length} Invoices
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Invoice #</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Student & Grade</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Guardian Contact</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Tuition</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Concession</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Late Fee</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Total Payable</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Status</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200">
                  {filteredInvoices.map((inv) => (
                    <tr key={inv.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-slate-800">
                        {inv.invoiceNumber}
                        <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-sans font-normal">
                          Due: {inv.dueDate}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm block">
                          {inv.studentName}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px] font-mono">
                          {inv.admissionNumber} • {inv.grade}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 block">{inv.guardianName}</span>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">{inv.guardianPhone}</span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-medium text-slate-700">
                        ₹{inv.tuitionFee.toLocaleString()}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-emerald-600">
                        {inv.concessionApplied > 0 ? `-₹${inv.concessionApplied.toLocaleString()}` : '—'}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-amber-600">
                        {inv.lateFee > 0 ? `+₹${inv.lateFee.toLocaleString()}` : '—'}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                        ₹{inv.balanceAmount.toLocaleString()}
                        {inv.paidAmount > 0 && (
                          <span className="block text-[10px] text-emerald-600 font-normal">
                            Paid: ₹{inv.paidAmount.toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                        {inv.status === 'PAID' && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
                            <CheckCircle2 size={12} /> PAID
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {inv.status === 'PENDING' && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                            PENDING
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {inv.status === 'OVERDUE' && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">
                            OVERDUE
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {inv.status === 'PAYMENT_PLAN' && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-purple-100 text-purple-800">
                            PAYMENT PLAN
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                        {inv.status !== 'PAID' ? (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleOpenCheckout(inv)}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-lg font-semibold text-xs shadow-sm transition flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-auto"
                          >
                            <CreditCard size={13} />
                            <span>Pay with Gateway</span>
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-semibold">Settled</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Recent Multi-Gateway Transaction Audit */}
          {paymentRecords.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5 space-y-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldCheck size={16} className="text-emerald-600" />
                Live Multi-Gateway Settlement Stream (Verified Audits)
              </h3>
              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-xs">
                {paymentRecords.slice(0, 5).map((pay) => (
                  <div key={pay.id} className="py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{pay.studentName}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-mono ml-2">[{pay.reference}]</span>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        Gateway: <strong>{pay.gateway}</strong> • Receipt: {pay.receiptNumber}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span className="font-bold font-mono text-emerald-700 text-sm">
                        +₹{pay.amount.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                      <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        {new Date(pay.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {activeTab === 'dunning' && (
        <DunningAutomationView
          invoices={invoices}
          onOpenCheckout={handleOpenCheckout}
          onRefreshData={handleRefresh}
        />
      )}

      {activeTab === 'concessions' && <ConcessionMatrixView />}

      {activeTab === 'payroll' && <StaffPayrollView />}

      {activeTab === 'staff-portal' && <StaffPortalPayslipView />}

      {/* Global Multi-Gateway Modal */}
      {selectedInvoiceForCheckout && (
        <MultiGatewayCheckoutModal
          invoice={selectedInvoiceForCheckout}
          isOpen={isCheckoutOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsCheckoutOpen(false)}
          onPaymentComplete={handlePaymentComplete}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  CreditCard,
  Smartphone,
  Globe,
  QrCode,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Printer,
  Download,
  AlertCircle,
  ArrowRight,
  ExternalLink,
  Lock,
  Building,
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  PaymentGatewayType,
  CurrencyCode,
} from '@krypton/types';
import {
  financeClient,
  DemoInvoice,
  SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES,
} from '@/lib/finance-client';
import { QRCodeSVG } from '@/components/attendance/QRCodeSVG';
import { SchoolCrestLogo } from '@/components/certificates/SchoolCrestLogo';

interface MultiGatewayCheckoutModalProps {
  invoice: DemoInvoice;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onPaymentComplete: (updatedInvoice: DemoInvoice) => void;
}

export function MultiGatewayCheckoutModal({
  invoice,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onPaymentComplete,
}: MultiGatewayCheckoutModalProps) {
  const [selectedGateway, setSelectedGateway] = useState<PaymentGatewayType>('UPI');
  const [selectedCurrency, setSelectedCurrency] = useState<CurrencyCode>('INR');
  const [payerName, setPayerName] = useState(invoice.guardianName);
  const [payerEmail, setPayerEmail] = useState(invoice.guardianEmail);
  const [payerPhone, setPayerPhone] = useState(invoice.guardianPhone);

  // Gateway specific states
  const [cardNumber, setCardNumber] = useState('4242 •••• •••• 4242');
  const [cardExpiry, setCardExpiry] = useState('12/28');
  const [cardCvc, setCardCvc] = useState('888');
  const [upiId, setUpiId] = useState('parent@okhdfcbank');
  const [mpesaPhone, setMpesaPhone] = useState('+254 712 345678');
  const [selectedBank, setSelectedBank] = useState('State Bank of India');

  // Processing & Success State
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [processingStep, setProcessingStep] = useState('');
  const [receiptData, setReceiptData] = useState<{
    receiptNumber: string;
    transactionReference: string;
    timestamp: string;
    amountPaid: number;
    currency: CurrencyCode;
    gateway: PaymentGatewayType;
  } | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentCurrencyConfig = SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES[selectedCurrency];
  // Calculate converted amount if switched currency
  const convertedAmount =
    selectedCurrency === 'INR'
      ? invoice.balanceAmount
      : Math.round(
          (invoice.balanceAmount * SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.INR.exchangeRateToUSD) /
            currentCurrencyConfig.exchangeRateToUSD
        );

  const handlePayNow = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setProcessingStep(`Connecting to ${selectedGateway} secure payment network...`);

    try {
      if (selectedGateway === 'MPESA') {
        setProcessingStep('Sending STK Push prompt to M-Pesa handset...');
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200));
        setProcessingStep('Waiting for M-Pesa PIN authorization...');
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
      } else if (selectedGateway === 'STRIPE' || selectedGateway === 'CARD') {
        setProcessingStep('Validating 3D-Secure 2.0 Strong Customer Authentication...');
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
      } else if (selectedGateway === 'UPI') {
        setProcessingStep('Verifying Virtual Payment Address (NPCI UPI Network)...');
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1400));
      } else if (selectedGateway === 'PAYPAL') {
        setProcessingStep('Authorizing international PayPal wallet token...');
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1300));
      }

      setProcessingStep('Finalizing transaction & updating ledger...');
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));

      const result = await financeClient.processPayment({
        invoiceId: invoice.id,
        amount: invoice.balanceAmount,
        gateway: selectedGateway,
        currency: selectedCurrency,
        payerDetails: {
          payerName,
          email: payerEmail,
          phone: payerPhone,
          cardNumberMasked: cardNumber,
          upiId,
          mpesaPhone,
        },
      });

      setReceiptData({
        receiptNumber: result.receiptNumber,
        transactionReference: result.transactionReference,
        timestamp: result.timestamp,
        amountPaid: invoice.balanceAmount,
        currency: selectedCurrency,
        gateway: selectedGateway,
      });

      onPaymentComplete(result.invoice);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Payment processing failed. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
      setProcessingStep('');
    }
  };

  const handlePrintReceipt = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/75 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 text-white px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-indigo-900/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <SchoolCrestLogo size={42} />
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight">Krypton Global Checkout</h3>
                <span className="text-xs bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-400/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono">
                  PCI-DSS Level 1 Secure
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-300">
                Multi-Gateway Education Fee Portal • Invoice #{invoice.invoiceNumber}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
          {receiptData ? (
            /* SUCCESS RECEIPT VIEW */
            <div className="space-y-6 animate-scaleUp">
              <div className="text-center space-y-2">
                <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-inner">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={36} />
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Payment Successfully Settled!</h2>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
                  Your official school fee receipt has been recorded and cryptographically stamped.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Printable Official Receipt Slip */}
              <div
                id="official-receipt-print"
                className="bg-slate-50 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-6 relative"
              >
                {/* Watermark Crest */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center opacity-5 pointer-events-none">
                  <SchoolCrestLogo size={280} />
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b border-slate-200 pb-4 mb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <SchoolCrestLogo size={52} />
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-base">KRYPTON INTERNATIONAL ACADEMY</h4>

                        {invoice.grade}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono">Inv: {invoice.invoiceNumber}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{invoice.term}</p>

                        <span className="font-mono">₹{invoice.tuitionFee.toLocaleString()}</span>
                      </div>
                      {invoice.activityFee > 0 && (

                          <span>Activity & Lab:</span>
                          <span className="font-mono">₹{invoice.activityFee.toLocaleString()}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {invoice.transportFee > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex justify-between">
                          <span>Transport:</span>
                          <span className="font-mono">₹{invoice.transportFee.toLocaleString()}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {invoice.concessionApplied > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex justify-between text-emerald-600 font-medium">
                          <span>Concession Waiver:</span>
                          <span className="font-mono">-₹{invoice.concessionApplied.toLocaleString()}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {invoice.lateFee > 0 && (

                    </div>

                  {selectedGateway === 'NET_BANKING' && (

                      </label>

                        <option>Federal Bank</option>
                        <option>Canara Bank</option>
                        <option>Punjab National Bank</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Submit Action */}
                <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
                  <button
                    onClick={handlePayNow}
                    disabled={isProcessing}
                    className="w-full py-3 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 via-indigo-700 to-indigo-800 hover:from-indigo-700 hover:to-indigo-900 text-white rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition disabled:opacity-75 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {isProcessing ? (
                      <>
                        <RefreshCw className="animate-spin" size={18} />
                        <span>{processingStep}</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Lock size={16} />
                        <span>
                          Pay {currentCurrencyConfig.symbol}
                          {convertedAmount.toLocaleString()} via {selectedGateway}
                        </span>
