                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-center text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                    <ShieldCheck size={13} className="text-emerald-500" />
                    256-bit Bank Grade SSL Encryption • Automated Instant Receipt Issued
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Users,
  DollarSign,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  Download,
  Printer,
  Sparkles,
  TrendingDown,
  Building,
  GraduationCap,
  FileText,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  RefreshCw,
  Sliders,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  financeClient,
} from '@/lib/finance-client';
import {
  StaffPayrollProfile,
  StaffPayslip,
  MonthlyPayrollRun,
} from '@krypton/types';
import { PayslipModal } from './PayslipModal';

export function StaffPayrollView() {
  const [profiles] = useState<StaffPayrollProfile[]>(() => financeClient.getStaffProfiles());
  const [unpaidLeaveMap, setUnpaidLeaveMap] = useState<Record<string, number>>({
    'st-02': 1,
    'st-05': 2,
  });
  const [isProcessingRun, setIsProcessingRun] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPayslip, setSelectedPayslip] = useState<StaffPayslip | null>(null);
  const [isPayslipModalOpen, setIsPayslipModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [runHistory, setRunHistory] = useState<MonthlyPayrollRun[]>(() => financeClient.getPayrollRuns());
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState('October 2026');

  const handleLeaveChange = (staffId: string, count: number) => {
    setUnpaidLeaveMap((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [staffId]: Math.max(0, count),
    }));
  };

  const handleExecute1ClickPayroll = async () => {
    setIsProcessingRun(true);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200));

    try {
      const run = financeClient.executeMonthlyPayrollRun(selectedMonth, 2026, unpaidLeaveMap);
      setRunHistory(financeClient.getPayrollRuns());
      alert(`🎉 1-Click Payroll Run for ${selectedMonth} completed successfully!\nDisbursed ₹${run.totalNetDisbursed.toLocaleString()} across ${run.totalStaffCount} staff members.`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to process payroll');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessingRun(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenPayslip = (profile: StaffPayrollProfile) => {
    const unpaid = unpaidLeaveMap[profile.id] || 0;
    const slip = financeClient.calculateStaffPayslip(profile, selectedMonth, 2026, unpaid);
    setSelectedPayslip(slip);
    setIsPayslipModalOpen(true);
  };

  const currentRun = runHistory.find((r) => r.month === selectedMonth) || runHistory[0];

  // Quick aggregates
  const totalStaff = profiles.length;
  const totalMonthlyGross = profiles.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.monthlyGrossSalary, 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 text-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-indigo-900/40">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/30 rounded-xl text-indigo-300">
                <Users size={22} />
              </span>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">
                Staff HRMS & 1-Click Monthly Payroll
              </h2>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 max-w-2xl">
              Unified institutional HR compensation engine. Automatically factors teaching allowances,
              attendance registers, unpaid leave deductions (Loss of Pay), statutory PF/TDS withholdings,
              and enables 1-click batch disbursement with verified digital payslips.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3">
            <select
              value={selectedMonth}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedMonth(e.target.value)}
              className="text-xs bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/20 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl focus:outline-none"
            >
              <option value="October 2026" className="text-slate-900">October 2026 (Current)</option>
              <option value="September 2026" className="text-slate-900">September 2026</option>
              <option value="August 2026" className="text-slate-900">August 2026</option>
            </select>

            <button
              onClick={handleExecute1ClickPayroll}
              disabled={isProcessingRun}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-600 hover:to-teal-700 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 flex items-center gap-2 transition disabled:opacity-75 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              {isProcessingRun ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="animate-spin" size={16} />
                  <span>Disbursing Batch...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles size={16} />
                  <span>1-Click Run Monthly Payroll</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase">ACTIVE STAFF ROSTER</span>
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mt-1">
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">{totalStaff}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-indigo-600 font-medium">3 Faculty • 2 Ops</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase">MONTHLY GROSS LIABILITY</span>

                  <span className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-emerald-700">
                    ₹{slip.netPayable.toLocaleString()}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleViewPayslip(slip)}
                    className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-lg font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shadow-sm"
                  >
                    <Download size={14} /> Download Payslip PDF
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Payslip Modal */}
      <PayslipModal
        payslip={activePayslip}
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { useLanguageContext, Language } from '@/contexts/LanguageContext';

interface LanguageSwitcherProps {
  variant?: 'default' | 'compact';
  className?: string;
}

export default function LanguageSwitcher({ variant = 'default', className = '' }: LanguageSwitcherProps) {
  const { language, setLanguage } = useLanguageContext();

  const languages: { code: Language; label: string; flag: string }[] = [
    { code: 'en', label: 'English', flag: '🇬🇧' },
    { code: 'sw', label: 'Kiswahili', flag: '🇰🇪' },
  ];

  if (variant === 'compact') {
    return (
      <button
        onClick={() => setLanguage(language === 'en' ? 'sw' : 'en')}
        className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors ${className}`}
        title={language === 'en' ? 'Switch to Kiswahili' : 'Badilisha kwa English'}
      >
        <span className="text-xl">
          {language === 'en' ? '🇬🇧' : '🇰🇪'}
        </span>
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">
          {language === 'en' ? 'EN' : 'SW'}
        </span>
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`relative ${className}`}>
      <select
        value={language}
        onChange={(e) => setLanguage(e.target.value as Language)}
        className="appearance-none bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 pr-10 text-sm font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer"
      >
        {languages.map((lang) => (
          <option key={lang.code} value={lang.code}>
            {lang.flag} {lang.label}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center px-2 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
        <svg className="fill-current h-4 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
          <path d="M9.293 12.95l.707.707L15.657 8l-1.414-1.414L10 10.828 5.757 6.586 4.343 8z" />
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface HomeworkTeacherManagerProps {
  onNotify?: (msg: string) => void;
}

export function HomeworkTeacherManager({ onNotify }: HomeworkTeacherManagerProps) {
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<Assignment[]>(() => LMSStore.getAssignments());
  const [submissions, setSubmissions] = useState<HomeworkSubmission[]>(() => LMSStore.getSubmissions());
  const [selectedAssignment, setSelectedAssignment] = useState<Assignment | null>(null);
  const [selectedSubmission, setSelectedSubmission] = useState<HomeworkSubmission | null>(null);
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
  const [previewFile, setPreviewFile] = useState<SubmissionFile | null>(null);

  // Filter & Search states
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterSubject, setFilterSubject] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [submissionFilter, setSubmissionFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'PENDING' | 'GRADED'>('ALL');

  // Grading form state
  const [gradeInput, setGradeInput] = useState<number | ''>('');
  const [feedbackInput, setFeedbackInput] = useState('');
  const [isGrading, setIsGrading] = useState(false);

  // Create Assignment Form State
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState('');
  const [newTitleMl, setNewTitleMl] = useState('');
  const [newSubject, setNewSubject] = useState('Mathematics');
  const [newSubjectMl, setNewSubjectMl] = useState('കണക്ക്');
  const [newClass, setNewClass] = useState('Class 10-A');
  const [newDueDate, setNewDueDate] = useState(
    new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0]
  );
  const [newMaxMarks, setNewMaxMarks] = useState<number>(20);
  const [newDescription, setNewDescription] = useState('');
  const [newDescriptionMl, setNewDescriptionMl] = useState('');
  const [attachedFileName, setAttachedFileName] = useState('');

  const refreshData = () => {
    setAssignments(LMSStore.getAssignments());
    setSubmissions(LMSStore.getSubmissions());
  };

  const handleCreateAssignment = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newTitle.trim()) return;

    LMSStore.createAssignment({
      title: newTitle,
      titleMl: newTitleMl || newTitle,
      description: newDescription,
      descriptionMl: newDescriptionMl || newDescription,
      subject: newSubject,
      subjectMl: newSubjectMl,
      className: newClass,
      classId: 'cls-10a',
      teacherId: 'tch-01',
      teacherName: 'Suresh Kumar (Teacher)',
      dueDate: newDueDate,
      maxMarks: Number(newMaxMarks) || 20,
      attachments: attachedFileName
        ? [
            {
              id: `att-${Date.now()}`,
              name: attachedFileName,
              fileType: attachedFileName.endsWith('.pdf') ? 'PDF' : 'IMAGE',
              url: '#',
              size: '1.2 MB',
            },
          ]
        : [],
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      totalStudents: 32,
      allowLateSubmission: true,
    });

    setShowCreateModal(false);
    resetCreateForm();
    refreshData();
    if (onNotify) onNotify('അസൈൻമെന്റ് വിജയകരമായി പബ്ലിഷ് ചെയ്തു! Assignment published successfully.');
  };

  const resetCreateForm = () => {
    setNewTitle('');
    setNewTitleMl('');
    setNewDescription('');
    setNewDescriptionMl('');
    setAttachedFileName('');
    setNewMaxMarks(20);
  };

  const openGradingModal = (sub: HomeworkSubmission) => {
    setSelectedSubmission(sub);
    setGradeInput(sub.grade !== undefined ? sub.grade : '');
    setFeedbackInput(sub.feedback || '');
  };

  const handleSaveGrade = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedSubmission) return;

    setIsGrading(true);
    const score = Number(gradeInput) || 0;
    LMSStore.gradeSubmission(
      selectedSubmission.id,
      score,
      feedbackInput || 'Work evaluated and verified.',
      'Suresh Kumar (Teacher)'
    );

    setIsGrading(false);
    setSelectedSubmission(null);
    refreshData();
    if (onNotify) onNotify(`മാർക്ക് നൽകി വിജയകരമായി സേവ് ചെയ്തു (${score}/${selectedSubmission.maxMarks})`);

  });

  const activeSubmissionsList = submissions.filter((s) => {

    if (submissionFilter === 'PENDING') return s.status === 'SUBMITTED';
    if (submissionFilter === 'GRADED') return s.status === 'GRADED';
    return true;
  });

  return (

        ) : (

                          {sub.className} • Roll {sub.studentRollNo}

                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-100 text-red-700 font-semibold">
                            LATE
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-1 font-medium">
                        Assignment: <span className="text-indigo-900">{asg?.title || 'Coursework'}</span>
                      </p>

                      {sub.studentNotes && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1 italic bg-amber-50/60 p-1.5 rounded border border-amber-100/80">
                          &quot;{sub.studentNotes}&quot;
                        </p>
                      )}

                      {/* File Attachments */}
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-2">
                        {sub.files.map((file) => (
                          <button
                            key={file.id}
                            onClick={() => setPreviewFile(file)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-all"
                          >
                            <Eye size={13} />
                            <span>{file.name}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-500">
                              ({file.fileType === 'IMAGE' ? 'Photo' : 'PDF'})
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Grading status & action */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 self-end md:self-center">
                    {sub.status === 'GRADED' ? (
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 text-emerald-700 font-bold text-base">
                          <Award size={18} />
                          <span>
                            {sub.grade} / {sub.maxMarks}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Evaluated</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">
                        Pending Marks
                      </span>
                    )}

                    <button
                      onClick={() => openGradingModal(sub)}
                      className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                        sub.status === 'GRADED'
                          ? 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200'
                          : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-sm'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {sub.status === 'GRADED' ? 'മാർക്ക് തിരുത്തുക' : 'മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം / Grade Now'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* CREATE ASSIGNMENT MODAL */}
      {showCreateModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-gray-100">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">പുതിയ അസൈൻമെന്റ് നൽകുക</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Create new homework assignment for students</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}
                className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateAssignment} className="space-y-4 mt-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Assignment Title (English) *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. Quadratic Equations Ex 4.2"
                  value={newTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Title in Malayalam (മലയാളം തലക്കെട്ട്)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="ഉദാഹരണം: ക്വാഡ്രാറ്റിക് സമവാക്യങ്ങൾ - ഹോംവർക്ക് 4.2"
                  value={newTitleMl}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTitleMl(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">Subject</label>
                  <select
                    value={newSubject}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setNewSubject(e.target.value);
                      if (e.target.value === 'Mathematics') setNewSubjectMl('കണക്ക്');
                      if (e.target.value === 'Physics') setNewSubjectMl('ഭൗതികശാസ്ത്രം');
                      if (e.target.value === 'Malayalam') setNewSubjectMl('മലയാളം');
                    }}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="Mathematics">Mathematics</option>
                    <option value="Physics">Physics</option>
                    <option value="Chemistry">Chemistry</option>
                    <option value="Malayalam">Malayalam</option>
                    <option value="English">English</option>
                    <option value="Social Science">Social Science</option>
                    <option value="Computer Science">Computer Science</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">Class</label>
                  <select
                    value={newClass}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewClass(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="Class 10-A">Class 10-A</option>
                    <option value="Class 10-B">Class 10-B</option>
                    <option value="Class 9-A">Class 9-A</option>
                    <option value="Class 8-A">Class 8-A</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">Due Date</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    required
                    value={newDueDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewDueDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">Maximum Marks</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    max="100"
                    value={newMaxMarks}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewMaxMarks(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Instructions / ചോദ്യവിവരങ്ങൾ

                  rows={3}
                  placeholder="കുട്ടികൾ ചെയ്യേണ്ട കാര്യങ്ങൾ വിശദീകരിക്കുക..."
                  value={newDescription}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewDescription(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"

                <button
                  type="button"

                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-sm"
                >
                  പബ്ലിഷ് ചെയ്യുക (Publish Assignment)

          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-gray-200">
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700">
                  മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയ ബോർഡ് • Student Submission Evaluation
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1">
                  {selectedSubmission.studentName} (Roll No: {selectedSubmission.studentRollNo})
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedSubmission(null)}
                className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mt-4">
              {/* Left Column: Student Submitted Files Viewer */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Paperclip size={14} />
                  <span>സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്ത പേജുകൾ / Documents ({selectedSubmission.files.length})</span>
                </h4>

                <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-2 bg-gray-50 space-y-2">
                  {selectedSubmission.files.map((file, idx) => (
                    <div key={file.id} className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white">
                      <div className="p-2.5 bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700">
                        <span>
                          Page {idx + 1}: {file.name}
                        </span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setPreviewFile(file)}
                          className="text-indigo-600 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          <Eye size={13} />
                          Full View
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {/* Document Preview Frame */}
                      <div className="p-2 flex justify-center bg-gray-800">
                        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                        <img
                          src={file.url}
                          alt={file.name}
                          className="max-h-[380px] w-auto object-contain rounded shadow"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {selectedSubmission.studentNotes && (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 text-xs">
                    <span className="font-bold text-amber-900">Student Note: </span>
                    <span className="text-amber-800">{selectedSubmission.studentNotes}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Right Column: Teacher Marks & Feedback Form */}
              <form onSubmit={handleSaveGrade} className="space-y-4">
                <div className="p-4 bg-indigo-50/70 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-indigo-900 uppercase mb-1">
                    മാർക്കുകൾ നൽകുക / Enter Marks (Out of {selectedSubmission.maxMarks}) *
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      required
                      min="0"
                      max={selectedSubmission.maxMarks}
                      value={gradeInput}
                      onChange={(e) => setGradeInput(e.target.value === '' ? '' : Number(e.target.value))}
                      placeholder="e.g. 19"
                      className="w-32 text-2xl font-bold px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-indigo-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none text-indigo-950"
                    />
                    <span className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-500">/ {selectedSubmission.maxMarks} Marks</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                    ടീച്ചറുടെ ഫീഡ്ബാക്ക് / Constructive Feedback
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={4}
                    placeholder="കുട്ടിയുടെ നോട്ട്ബുക്കിലെ ഉത്തരങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള അഭിപ്രായങ്ങൾ..."
                    value={feedbackInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setFeedbackInput(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Quick Feedback Chips */}
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase block mb-1.5">Quick Remarks:</span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {quickFeedbackChips.map((chip, idx) => (
                      <button
                        key={idx}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setFeedbackInput((prev) => (prev ? `${prev} ${chip}` : chip))
                        }
                        className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 border border-gray-200 transition-all text-left"
                      >
                        + {chip}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-gray-200">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedSubmission(null)}
                    className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={isGrading || gradeInput === ''}
                    className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-md disabled:opacity-50 transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                    <span>സേവ് ചെയ്യുക & കുട്ടിയെ അറിയിക്കുക</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* FULLSCREEN PREVIEW LIGHTBOX */}
      {previewFile && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="relative max-w-4xl w-full bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[95vh]">
            <div className="p-3 bg-gray-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{previewFile.name}</span>
              <button
                onClick={() => setPreviewFile(null)}
                className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white rounded-full hover:bg-gray-800"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-gray-950 flex-1 overflow-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img
                src={previewFile.url}
                alt={previewFile.name}
                className="max-h-[80vh] w-auto object-contain rounded"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Timer,
  Plus,
  BarChart2,
  Users,
  Award,
  CheckCircle2,
  Trash2,
  X,
  FileQuestion,
  Sparkles,
  HelpCircle,
  Eye,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { MCQQuiz, MCQQuestion, QuizAttempt } from '@krypton/types';
import { LMSStore } from '@/lib/lms-client';

interface QuizTeacherManagerProps {
  onNotify?: (msg: string) => void;
}

export function QuizTeacherManager({ onNotify }: QuizTeacherManagerProps) {
  const [quizzes, setQuizzes] = useState<MCQQuiz[]>(() => LMSStore.getQuizzes());
  const [attempts, setAttempts] = useState<QuizAttempt[]>(() => LMSStore.getAttempts());
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedQuizAnalytics, setSelectedQuizAnalytics] = useState<MCQQuiz | null>(null);

  // New Quiz Builder State
  const [newQuizTitle, setNewQuizTitle] = useState('');
  const [newQuizTitleMl, setNewQuizTitleMl] = useState('');
  const [newSubject, setNewSubject] = useState('General Science');
  const [newClass, setNewClass] = useState('Class 10-A');
  const [newDuration, setNewDuration] = useState<number>(10);
  const [newPassPct, setNewPassPct] = useState<number>(60);
  const [newDescription, setNewDescription] = useState('');

  // Questions builder state for the quiz
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Array<Omit<MCQQuestion, 'id'>>>([
    {
      questionText: 'Which planet is known as the Red Planet?',
      questionTextMl: 'ചുവന്ന ഗ്രഹം എന്നറിയപ്പെടുന്ന ഗ്രഹം ഏതാണ്?',
      options: [
        { id: 'A', text: 'Venus (ശുക്രൻ)' },
        { id: 'B', text: 'Mars (ചൊവ്വ)' },
        { id: 'C', text: 'Jupiter (വ്യാഴം)' },
        { id: 'D', text: 'Mercury (ബുധൻ)' },
      ],
      correctOptionId: 'B',
      explanation: 'Mars appears reddish due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.',
      explanationMl: 'ചൊവ്വയുടെ ഉപരിതലത്തിലെ അയേൺ ഓക്സൈഡ് കാരണമാണ് ചുവപ്പ് നിറം.',
      marks: 4,
    },
    {
      questionText: 'What is the chemical formula of common salt?',
      questionTextMl: 'കറിയുപ്പിന്റെ രാസസൂത്രം എന്താണ്?',
      options: [
        { id: 'A', text: 'NaCl' },
        { id: 'B', text: 'KCl' },
        { id: 'C', text: 'NaOH' },
        { id: 'D', text: 'HCl' },
      ],
      correctOptionId: 'A',
      explanation: 'Common table salt is Sodium Chloride (NaCl).',
      explanationMl: 'സോഡിയം ക്ലോറൈഡ് ആണ് കറിയുപ്പ്.',
      marks: 4,
    },
  ]);

  const [currentQText, setCurrentQText] = useState('');
  const [currentQTextMl, setCurrentQTextMl] = useState('');
  const [currentOptA, setCurrentOptA] = useState('');
  const [currentOptB, setCurrentOptB] = useState('');
  const [currentOptC, setCurrentOptC] = useState('');
  const [currentOptD, setCurrentOptD] = useState('');
  const [currentCorrectOpt, setCurrentCorrectOpt] = useState('A');
  const [currentExplanation, setCurrentExplanation] = useState('');
  const [currentMarks, setCurrentMarks] = useState<number>(3);

  const addQuestionToBuilder = () => {
    if (!currentQText.trim() || !currentOptA.trim() || !currentOptB.trim()) return;

    setQuestions((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        questionText: currentQText,
        questionTextMl: currentQTextMl,
        options: [
          { id: 'A', text: currentOptA },
          { id: 'B', text: currentOptB },
          { id: 'C', text: currentOptC || 'Option C' },
          { id: 'D', text: currentOptD || 'Option D' },
        ],
        correctOptionId: currentCorrectOpt,
        explanation: currentExplanation || 'Standard scientific concept.',
        marks: Number(currentMarks) || 3,
      },
    ]);

    // Reset current question inputs
    setCurrentQText('');
    setCurrentQTextMl('');
    setCurrentOptA('');
    setCurrentOptB('');
    setCurrentOptC('');
    setCurrentOptD('');
    setCurrentExplanation('');
  };

  const removeQuestion = (index: number) => {
    setQuestions((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== index));
  };

  const handleSaveQuiz = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newQuizTitle.trim() || questions.length === 0) return;

    const totalMarks = questions.reduce((sum, q) => sum + q.marks, 0);

    const questionsWithIds: MCQQuestion[] = questions.map((q, i) => ({
      ...q,
      id: `q-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
    }));

    LMSStore.createQuiz({
      title: newQuizTitle,
      titleMl: newQuizTitleMl || newQuizTitle,
      description: newDescription || 'Timed online model exam for class assessment.',
      subject: newSubject,
      className: newClass,
      classId: 'cls-10a',
      durationMinutes: Number(newDuration) || 10,
      totalMarks,
      passPercentage: Number(newPassPct) || 60,
      instructions: [
        `Duration: ${newDuration} minutes. Auto-submits on timeout.`,
        'Each question has single correct choice.',
        'Immediate score calculation upon submission.',
      ],
      questions: questionsWithIds,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    });

    setShowCreateModal(false);
    setQuizzes(LMSStore.getQuizzes());
    if (onNotify) onNotify('പുതിയ മോഡൽ പരീക്ഷ വിജയകരമായി തയ്യാറാക്കി! Online Quiz created.');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 border border-violet-200">
              ടീച്ചർ ക്വിസ് സ്റ്റുഡിയോ • Model Exam Creator
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">Auto-Grading Engine</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1">
            ഓൺലൈൻ മോഡൽ എക്സാം മാനേജർ & അനലിറ്റിക്സ്
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
            Create timed MCQ model exams with automated mark calculations and view class attempt rankings.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-700 text-white font-medium text-sm shadow-sm transition-all transform active:scale-95"
        >
          <Plus size={18} />
          <span>പുതിയ മോഡൽ പരീക്ഷ നിർമ്മിക്കുക</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Quizzes List */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {quizzes.map((quiz) => {
          const quizAttempts = attempts.filter((a) => a.quizId === quiz.id);
          const passCount = quizAttempts.filter((a) => a.passed).length;
          const avgScore = quizAttempts.length
            ? Math.round(
                quizAttempts.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.percentage, 0) / quizAttempts.length
              )
            : 0;

          return (
            <div
              key={quiz.id}
              className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-violet-300 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between"
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-violet-50 text-violet-700">
                    {quiz.subject} • {quiz.className}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {quiz.totalMarks} Marks ({quiz.questions.length} Qs)
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 mt-2">{quiz.title}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-violet-900 mt-0.5">{quiz.titleMl}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-2 line-clamp-2">{quiz.description}</p>

                {/* Performance Mini Bar */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 text-center">
                  <div className="bg-gray-50 p-2 rounded-xl">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 block">Attempts</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">{quizAttempts.length}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-gray-50 p-2 rounded-xl">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 block">Avg Score</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700">
                      {quizAttempts.length ? `${avgScore}%` : '—'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-gray-50 p-2 rounded-xl">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 block">Passed</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">
                      {quizAttempts.length ? `${passCount}/${quizAttempts.length}` : '—'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Timer size={13} className="text-violet-600" />
                  {quiz.durationMinutes} Minutes Countdown
                </span>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedQuizAnalytics(quiz)}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-violet-50 hover:bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <BarChart2 size={14} />
                  <span>ലീഡർബോർഡ് & മാർക്കുകൾ</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* QUIZ LEADERBOARD & ATTEMPTS MODAL */}
      {selectedQuizAnalytics && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-gray-200">
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-violet-700 uppercase">
                  Class Performance Analysis
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1">
                  {selectedQuizAnalytics.title}
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedQuizAnalytics(null)}
                className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-gray-700">
                കുട്ടികളുടെ സ്കോറുകൾ (Automated Student Scores)
              </h4>

              {(() => {
                const quizAttempts = attempts.filter(
                  (a) => a.quizId === selectedQuizAnalytics.id
                );

                if (quizAttempts.length === 0) {
                  return (
                    <div className="p-8 text-center bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl">
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">No student submissions recorded yet.</p>
                    </div>
                  );
                }

                return (
                  <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100 border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-white">
                    {quizAttempts.map((att, idx) => (
                      <div
                        key={att.id}
                        className="p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-gray-50 text-xs"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-violet-100 text-violet-800 font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-[11px]">
                            {idx + 1}
                          </span>
                          <div>
                            <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 block">{att.studentName}</span>
                            <span className="text-gray-500 text-[11px]">
                              Time spent: {Math.floor(att.timeSpentSeconds / 60)}m{' '}
                              {att.timeSpentSeconds % 60}s
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="text-right">
                          <span className="font-extrabold text-sm text-gray-900">
                            {att.score} / {att.totalMarks} ({att.percentage}%)
                          </span>
                          <span
                            className={`block font-bold text-[10px] ${
                              att.passed ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-red-700'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {att.passed ? 'PASSED ✓' : 'FAILED'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                );
              })()}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CREATE QUIZ MODAL */}
      {showCreateModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-gray-200">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">പുതിയ മോഡൽ പരീക്ഷ തയ്യാറാക്കുക</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Build timed MCQ examination with instant auto-grading</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}
                className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSaveQuiz} className="space-y-4 mt-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Quiz Title *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. SSLC Physics Chapter 3 Model Exam"
                  value={newQuizTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewQuizTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500 focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                  Title in Malayalam (മലയാളം തലക്കെട്ട്)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="ഉദാഹരണം: പത്താം ക്ലാസ് ഫിസിക്സ് മാതൃകാ പരീക്ഷ"
                  value={newQuizTitleMl}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewQuizTitleMl(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500 focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">Subject</label>
                  <select
                    value={newSubject}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewSubject(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm"
                  >
                    <option value="General Science">General Science (ശാസ്ത്രം)</option>
                    <option value="Mathematics">Mathematics (കണക്ക്)</option>
                    <option value="Physics">Physics</option>
                    <option value="Social Science">Social Science</option>
                    <option value="English">English</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                    Timer (Minutes)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    max="180"
                    value={newDuration}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewDuration(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-sm"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Questions Section */}
              <div className="pt-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-gray-700">
                    ചോദ്യങ്ങൾ / Exam Questions ({questions.length})
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-3 bg-gray-50">
                  {questions.map((q, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      className="p-2.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 flex items-start justify-between text-xs"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">
                          {idx + 1}. {q.questionText}
                        </span>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                          Correct: Option {q.correctOptionId} • ({q.marks} Marks)
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeQuestion(idx)}
                        className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600 p-1"
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {/* Add New Question Mini Box */}
                <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-violet-50/60 rounded-2xl border border-violet-100 space-y-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-violet-900 block">
                    + ചോദ്യം ചേർക്കുക (Add Question to Test)
                  </span>

                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Question text in English..."
                    value={currentQText}
                    onChange={(e) => setCurrentQText(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs"
                  />

                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="ചോദ്യം മലയാളത്തിൽ (Malayalam translation)..."
                    value={currentQTextMl}
                    onChange={(e) => setCurrentQTextMl(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs"
                  />

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Option A"
                      value={currentOptA}
                      onChange={(e) => setCurrentOptA(e.target.value)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs"
                    />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Option B"
                      value={currentOptB}
                      onChange={(e) => setCurrentOptB(e.target.value)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs"
                    />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Option C"
                      value={currentOptC}
                      onChange={(e) => setCurrentOptC(e.target.value)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs"
                    />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Option D"
                      value={currentOptD}
                      onChange={(e) => setCurrentOptD(e.target.value)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">Correct Option:</span>
                      <select
                        value={currentCorrectOpt}
                        onChange={(e) => setCurrentCorrectOpt(e.target.value)}
                        className="px-2 py-1 border border-gray-300 rounded text-xs font-bold"
                      >
                        <option value="A">A</option>
                        <option value="B">B</option>
                        <option value="C">C</option>
                        <option value="D">D</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={addQuestionToBuilder}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-violet-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-violet-700"
                    >
                      + Add Question
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-gray-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={questions.length === 0}
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-700 text-white shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  പരീക്ഷ പബ്ലിഷ് ചെയ്യുക (Publish Test)
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
