'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Smartphone,
  Camera,
  Upload,
  FileText,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Award,
  AlertCircle,
  Eye,
  Trash2,
  Sparkles,
  Paperclip,
  Check,
  ChevronRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  X,
  FileCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Assignment, HomeworkSubmission, SubmissionFile } from '@krypton/types';
import { LMSStore, SAMPLE_NOTEBOOK_PAGE_SVG, SAMPLE_PHYSICS_NOTEBOOK_SVG } from '@/lib/lms-client';

interface StudentHomeworkPortalProps {
  onNotify?: (msg: string) => void;
}

export function StudentHomeworkPortal({ onNotify }: StudentHomeworkPortalProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'PENDING' | 'SUBMITTED'>('PENDING');
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<Assignment[]>(() => LMSStore.getAssignments());
  const [submissions, setSubmissions] = useState<HomeworkSubmission[]>(() => LMSStore.getSubmissions());
  const [selectedAssignment, setSelectedAssignment] = useState<Assignment | null>(null);

  // Student info (Mock logged in student)
  const currentStudent = {
    id: 'std-14',
    name: 'Rahul Sharma',
    rollNo: '14',
    className: 'Class 10-A',
    classId: 'cls-10a',
  };

  // Upload modal state
  const [uploadedFiles, setUploadedFiles] = useState<SubmissionFile[]>([]);
  const [studentNotes, setStudentNotes] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submissionSuccess, setSubmissionSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [previewModalFile, setPreviewModalFile] = useState<SubmissionFile | null>(null);

  const refreshData = () => {
    setAssignments(LMSStore.getAssignments());
    setSubmissions(LMSStore.getSubmissions());
  };

  // Check which assignments the student has already submitted
  const studentSubmissionsMap = new Map<string, HomeworkSubmission>();
  submissions
    .filter((s) => s.studentId === currentStudent.id)
    .forEach((s) => studentSubmissionsMap.set(s.assignmentId, s));

  const pendingAssignments = assignments.filter((a) => !studentSubmissionsMap.has(a.id));
  const completedSubmissions = submissions.filter((s) => s.studentId === currentStudent.id);

  // Handle file selection from phone camera or gallery
  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!e.target.files || e.target.files.length === 0) return;

    const filesArray = Array.from(e.target.files);
    filesArray.forEach((file) => {
      const isPdf = file.type === 'application/pdf' || file.name.endsWith('.pdf');
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        const resultUrl = (reader.result as string) || SAMPLE_NOTEBOOK_PAGE_SVG;
        const newFile: SubmissionFile = {
          id: `file-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
          name: file.name,
          fileType: isPdf ? 'PDF' : 'IMAGE',
          url: resultUrl,
          sizeBytes: file.size,
          uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        setUploadedFiles((prev) => [...prev, newFile]);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  };

  // Quick Demo Add Note Photo / PDF
  const addQuickDemoPhoto = () => {
    const demo: SubmissionFile = {
      id: `file-demo-${Date.now()}`,
      name: `Notebook_Scan_Page_${uploadedFiles.length + 1}.png`,
      fileType: 'IMAGE',
      url: uploadedFiles.length % 2 === 0 ? SAMPLE_NOTEBOOK_PAGE_SVG : SAMPLE_PHYSICS_NOTEBOOK_SVG,
      sizeBytes: 450000,
      uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    setUploadedFiles((prev) => [...prev, demo]);
  };

  const removeFile = (id: string) => {
    setUploadedFiles((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== id));
  };

  const handleHomeworkSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedAssignment || uploadedFiles.length === 0) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      LMSStore.submitHomework({
        assignmentId: selectedAssignment.id,
        studentId: currentStudent.id,
        studentName: currentStudent.name,
        studentRollNo: currentStudent.rollNo,
        className: currentStudent.className,
        classId: currentStudent.classId,
        files: uploadedFiles,
        studentNotes,
      });

      setIsSubmitting(false);
      setSubmissionSuccess(true);
      refreshData();
      if (onNotify) onNotify('ഹോംവർക്ക് വിജയകരമായി സമർപ്പിച്ചു! Homework submitted successfully.');
    }, 700);
  };

  const closeSubmissionFlow = () => {
    setSelectedAssignment(null);
    setUploadedFiles([]);
    setStudentNotes('');
    setSubmissionSuccess(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Student Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 via-teal-600 to-cyan-700 text-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md text-xs font-semibold mb-2">
              <Smartphone size={14} />
              <span>വിദ്യാർത്ഥി മൊബൈൽ പോർട്ടൽ • Student Mobile View</span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">
              ഹലോ, {currentStudent.name}!
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-emerald-100 mt-1">
              {currentStudent.className} • Roll No: {currentStudent.rollNo} • സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യാനുള്ള ഹോംവർക്കുകൾ
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Quick stats pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl border border-white/20 text-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-emerald-100 block">Pending</span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold">{pendingAssignments.length}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl border border-white/20 text-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-emerald-100 block">Submitted</span>
              <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold">{completedSubmissions.length}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Decorative background glow */}
        <div className="absolute right-0 bottom-0 translate-x-10 translate-y-10 w-64 h-64 bg-white/10 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 pb-2">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('PENDING')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'PENDING'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          <Clock size={16} />
          <span>ചെയ്യാനുള്ള ഹോംവർക്കുകൾ (Pending: {pendingAssignments.length})</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('SUBMITTED')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'SUBMITTED'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
          <span>സമർപ്പിച്ചവ & മാർക്കുകൾ (Completed & Graded: {completedSubmissions.length})</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* PENDING ASSIGNMENTS TAB */}
      {activeTab === 'PENDING' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {pendingAssignments.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-12 text-center border border-gray-200">
              <CheckCircle2 className="mx-auto text-emerald-500" size={48} />
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mt-3">എല്ലാ ഹോംവർക്കുകളും പൂർത്തിയായി!</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                You have completed all assignments assigned by your teachers.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {pendingAssignments.map((asg) => (
                <div
                  key={asg.id}
                  className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-emerald-400 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between"
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
                        {asg.subject} {asg.subjectMl && `(${asg.subjectMl})`}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                        {asg.maxMarks} Marks
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 mt-2">{asg.title}</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-800 mt-0.5">{asg.titleMl}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-2 line-clamp-2">{asg.description}</p>

                    {/* Teacher's attached worksheet */}
                    {asg.attachments.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mt-3 p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-gray-700">
                          <Paperclip size={13} className="text-emerald-600" />
                          <span className="font-medium truncate max-w-[180px]">{asg.attachments[0].name}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 font-semibold cursor-pointer hover:underline">
                          ഡൗൺലോഡ്
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-red-600 font-medium">
                      <Clock size={13} />
                      <span>Due: {asg.dueDate}</span>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedAssignment(asg);
                        setUploadedFiles([]);
                        setSubmissionSuccess(false);
                      }}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs shadow-sm transition-all transform active:scale-95"
                    >
                      <Camera size={14} />
                      <span>ഫോട്ടോ / PDF സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യുക</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* COMPLETED & GRADED SUBMISSIONS TAB */}
      {activeTab === 'SUBMITTED' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {completedSubmissions.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-12 text-center border border-gray-200">
              <Clock className="mx-auto text-gray-400" size={48} />
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mt-3">സമർപ്പിച്ച വർക്കുകൾ ലഭ്യമല്ല</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Submitted assignments will appear here with teacher marks.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {completedSubmissions.map((sub) => {
                const asg = assignments.find((a) => a.id === sub.assignmentId);

                return (
                  <div key={sub.id} className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-5 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">
                          {asg?.subject || 'Coursework'}
                        </span>
                        <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1.5">
                          {asg?.title || 'Assignment'}
                        </h4>
                      </div>

                      {/* Marks Awarded Pill */}
                      {sub.status === 'GRADED' ? (
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700 font-extrabold text-lg">
                            <Award size={20} />
                            <span>
                              {sub.grade} / {sub.maxMarks}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                            വിലയിരുത്തി (Graded)
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-amber-200">
                          ടീച്ചറുടെ പരിശോധനയിൽ
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Teacher's feedback comment */}
                    {sub.feedback && (
                      <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-emerald-50/70 rounded-xl border border-emerald-100">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-900 block">
                          ടീച്ചറുടെ വിലയിരുത്തൽ (Feedback):
                        </span>
                        <p className="text-xs text-emerald-800 mt-1">{sub.feedback}</p>
                        {sub.gradedByName && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 mt-1.5 block">
                            — {sub.gradedByName}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Submitted files preview */}
                    <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-500">
                      <span>Submitted on {new Date(sub.submissionDate).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        {sub.files.map((file) => (
                          <button
                            key={file.id}
                            onClick={() => setPreviewModalFile(file)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-medium"
                          >
                            <Eye size={12} />
                            <span>{file.fileType === 'IMAGE' ? 'Photo' : 'PDF'}</span>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MOBILE HOMEWORK SUBMISSION MODAL */}
      {selectedAssignment && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
            {!submissionSuccess ? (
              <form onSubmit={handleHomeworkSubmit} className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-gray-100">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700">
                      {selectedAssignment.subject}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1">
                      {selectedAssignment.title}
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={closeSubmissionFlow}
                    className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100"
                  >
                    <X size={20} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl text-xs text-gray-600 border border-gray-200">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800">നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ (Instructions):</p>
                  <p className="mt-1">{selectedAssignment.description}</p>
                </div>

                {/* Upload Section - Mobile Style */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase">
                    ഹോംവർക്ക് ഫോട്ടോ / PDF അപ്ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുക *
                  </label>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    {/* Camera Capture Button */}
                    <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 border-2 border-dashed border-emerald-300 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer transition-all text-center">
                      <Camera className="text-emerald-700 mb-1" size={26} />
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-900">ഫോൺ ക്യാമറ</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700">Take Photo</span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        capture="environment"
                        onChange={handleFileChange}
                        className="hidden"
                      />
                    </label>

                    {/* Gallery or PDF Picker */}
                    <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 border-2 border-dashed border-indigo-300 rounded-2xl cursor-pointer transition-all text-center">
                      <Upload className="text-indigo-700 mb-1" size={26} />
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-900">ഫയൽ / PDF</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-700">Choose PDF / Image</span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*,application/pdf"
                        multiple
                        onChange={handleFileChange}
                        className="hidden"
                      />
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  {/* Quick Browser Demo Button */}
                  <div className="flex justify-end pt-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={addQuickDemoPhoto}
                      className="text-xs text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-800 font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <Sparkles size={13} />
                      <span>+ ഡെമോ നോട്ട്ബുക്ക് പേജ് ഫോട്ടോ ചേർക്കുക (Quick Demo Photo)</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Selected Files Preview List */}
                {uploadedFiles.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 block">
                      അപ്ലോഡ് ചെയ്ത പേജുകൾ ({uploadedFiles.length}):
                    </span>

                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {uploadedFiles.map((file, idx) => (
                        <div
                          key={file.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 overflow-hidden">
                            {/* Thumbnail */}
                            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                            <img
                              src={file.url}
                              alt={file.name}
                              className="w-10 h-10 object-cover rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white"
                            />
                            <div className="overflow-hidden">
                              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 truncate">{file.name}</p>
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 font-medium">
                                Page {idx + 1} • {file.fileType}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setPreviewModalFile(file)}
                              className="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-indigo-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-white"
                            >
                              <Eye size={16} />
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => removeFile(file.id)}
                              className="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-white"
                            >
                              <Trash2 size={16} />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Student Notes */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase mb-1">
                    ടീച്ചറോട് പറയാനുള്ളത് / Student Note (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={2}
                    placeholder="ഉദാഹരണം: സർ, ഗ്രാഫ് വരച്ച് പേജ് 2-ൽ ചേർത്തിട്ടുണ്ട്..."
                    value={studentNotes}
                    onChange={(e) => setStudentNotes(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={closeSubmissionFlow}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={isSubmitting || uploadedFiles.length === 0}
                    className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-md disabled:opacity-50 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
                  >
                    {isSubmitting ? (
                      <span>അപ്ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുന്നു...</span>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Check size={16} />
                        <span>സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യുക (Submit Work)</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            ) : (
              /* Success Confirmation Card */
              <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-4">
                <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-inner">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={36} />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">ഹോംവർക്ക് സമർപ്പിച്ചു!</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                  നിങ്ങളുടെ അസൈൻമെന്റ് വിജയകരമായി ടീച്ചർക്ക് കൈമാറി. മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയത്തിന് ശേഷം മാർക്ക് ഇവിടെ കാണാം.
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={closeSubmissionFlow}
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-emerald-700 shadow"
                >
                  ശരി (Done)
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* FULLSCREEN PREVIEW LIGHTBOX */}
      {previewModalFile && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="relative max-w-4xl w-full bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[95vh]">
            <div className="p-3 bg-gray-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{previewModalFile.name}</span>
              <button
                onClick={() => setPreviewModalFile(null)}
                className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white rounded-full hover:bg-gray-800"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-gray-950 flex-1 overflow-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img
                src={previewModalFile.url}
                alt={previewModalFile.name}
                className="max-h-[80vh] w-auto object-contain rounded"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Timer,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  Award,
  AlertTriangle,
  RotateCcw,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronLeft,
  Sparkles,
  BarChart3,
  Calendar,
  Check,
  Flag,
  Flame,
  ArrowRight,
  BookOpen,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { MCQQuiz, QuizAttempt, QuestionBreakdown } from '@krypton/types';
import { LMSStore } from '@/lib/lms-client';

interface StudentMCQQuizRunnerProps {
  onNotify?: (msg: string) => void;
}

export function StudentMCQQuizRunner({ onNotify }: StudentMCQQuizRunnerProps) {
  const [quizzes, setQuizzes] = useState<MCQQuiz[]>(() => LMSStore.getQuizzes());
  const [attempts, setAttempts] = useState<QuizAttempt[]>(() => LMSStore.getAttempts());

  // Active exam state
  const [activeQuiz, setActiveQuiz] = useState<MCQQuiz | null>(null);
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [timeRemainingSeconds, setTimeRemainingSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [examStartedAt, setExamStartedAt] = useState<number>(0);
  const [showConfirmSubmit, setShowConfirmSubmit] = useState(false);

  // Result state
  const [lastResult, setLastResult] = useState<QuizAttempt | null>(null);

  // Mock logged-in student info
  const studentInfo = {
    studentId: 'std-14',
    studentName: 'Rahul Sharma',
    classId: 'cls-10a',
  };

  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const startQuiz = (quiz: MCQQuiz) => {
    setActiveQuiz(quiz);
    setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
    setAnswers({});
    setTimeRemainingSeconds(quiz.durationMinutes * 60);
    setExamStartedAt(Date.now());
    setLastResult(null);
    setShowConfirmSubmit(false);
  };

  // Timer countdown hook
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeQuiz) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeRemainingSeconds((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          // Timer reached 0: Auto submit!
          if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          handleAutoSubmit();
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [activeQuiz]);

  const handleAutoSubmit = () => {
    if (!activeQuiz) return;
    executeSubmission();
    if (onNotify) onNotify('സമയം പൂർത്തിയായി! പരീക്ഷ ഓട്ടോമാറ്റിക് ആയി സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യപ്പെട്ടു.');
  };

  const handleManualSubmit = () => {
    setShowConfirmSubmit(true);
  };

  const executeSubmission = () => {
    if (!activeQuiz) return;

    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);

    const timeSpentSeconds = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.round((Date.now() - examStartedAt) / 1000)
    );

    // Instant automatic grade calculation!
    const result = LMSStore.submitQuizAttempt(
      activeQuiz.id,
      studentInfo,
      answers,
      timeSpentSeconds
    );

    setLastResult(result);
    setActiveQuiz(null);
    setShowConfirmSubmit(false);
    setAttempts(LMSStore.getAttempts());

    if (onNotify) {
      onNotify(
        `പരീക്ഷ പൂർത്തിയായി! നിങ്ങളുടെ മാർക്ക്: ${result.score} / ${result.totalMarks} (${result.percentage}%)`
      );
    }
  };

  const selectAnswer = (questionId: string, optionId: string) => {
    setAnswers((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [questionId]: optionId,
    }));
  };

  const formatTimer = (totalSecs: number) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(totalSecs / 60);
    const secs = totalSecs % 60;
    return `${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const totalAnsweredCount = Object.keys(answers).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* CASE 1: RESULT SCREEN (INSTANT AUTOMATED SCORECARD) */}
      {lastResult && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-gray-200 shadow-xl overflow-hidden p-6 md:p-8 space-y-6 animate-fadeIn">
          {/* Result Header Hero */}
          <div
            className={`p-6 rounded-2xl text-center relative overflow-hidden ${
              lastResult.passed
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-600 via-teal-600 to-cyan-700 text-white'
                : 'bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-600 via-orange-600 to-red-600 text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md text-xs font-bold mb-3">
              <Sparkles size={14} />
              <span>തത്സമയ ഓട്ടോമാറ്റിക് മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം • Instant Auto-Graded</span>
            </div>

            <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black">{lastResult.quizTitle}</h2>
            {lastResult.quizTitleMl && (
              <p className="text-sm font-medium opacity-90 mt-1">{lastResult.quizTitleMl}</p>
            )}

            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-6">
              <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/25 text-center">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider block opacity-90">നേടിയ മാർക്ക്</span>
                <span className="text-4xl font-black">
                  {lastResult.score} / {lastResult.totalMarks}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/25 text-center">
                <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider block opacity-90">ശതമാനം</span>
                <span className="text-4xl font-black">{lastResult.percentage}%</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <span className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold uppercase bg-white text-gray-900 shadow">
                {lastResult.passed ? 'വിജയിച്ചു! PASSED' : 'കൂടുതൽ പരിശീലിക്കുക / NEEDS PRACTICE'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs opacity-90">
                • സമയം: {Math.floor(lastResult.timeSpentSeconds / 60)}m {lastResult.timeSpentSeconds % 60}s
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action to Retake or Go Back */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-gray-200">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">
                വിശദമായ ഉത്തരങ്ങൾ & വിശകലനം (Detailed Solution Review)
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                ചോദ്യങ്ങളും ശരിയായ ഉത്തരങ്ങളും വിശദീകരണത്തോടൊപ്പം താഴെ നൽകുന്നു
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setLastResult(null);
                setQuizzes(LMSStore.getQuizzes());
              }}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 hover:bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <RotateCcw size={14} />
              <span>മറ്റ് പരീക്ഷകൾ കാണുക (Back to Exams)</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Question-by-Question Solution Breakdown */}
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {lastResult.breakdown.map((item, idx) => {
              // Find question from initial quizzes to display full question text and options
              const matchedQuiz = quizzes.find((q) => q.id === lastResult.quizId);
              const question = matchedQuiz?.questions.find((q) => q.id === item.questionId);

              return (
                <div
                  key={item.questionId}
                  className={`p-5 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                    item.isCorrect
                      ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/40'
                      : 'border-red-200 bg-red-50/40'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span
                        className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold ${
                          item.isCorrect ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-red-600 text-white'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">
                        {item.isCorrect ? 'ശരിയുത്തരം (+Marks awarded)' : 'തെറ്റായ ഉത്തരം (Incorrect)'}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <span
                      className={`text-xs font-extrabold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md ${
                        item.isCorrect ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {item.marksAwarded} Marks
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 mt-2.5">
                    {question?.questionText}
                  </h4>
                  {question?.questionTextMl && (
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-900 mt-0.5">
                      {question.questionTextMl}
                    </p>
                  )}

                  {/* Options List */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-3">
                    {question?.options.map((opt) => {
                      const isStudentSelected = item.selectedOptionId === opt.id;
                      const isCorrectAnswer = item.correctOptionId === opt.id;

                      let style = 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700';
                      if (isCorrectAnswer) {
                        style = 'bg-emerald-100 border-emerald-400 text-emerald-950 font-bold';
                      } else if (isStudentSelected && !isCorrectAnswer) {
                        style = 'bg-red-100 border-red-400 text-red-950 line-through';
                      }

                      return (
                        <div
                          key={opt.id}
                          className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs flex items-center justify-between ${style}`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-black/10 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-[10px]">
                              {opt.id}
                            </span>
                            <span>{opt.text}</span>
                          </div>
                          {isCorrectAnswer && <Check size={15} className="text-emerald-700" />}
                          {isStudentSelected && !isCorrectAnswer && (
                            <XCircle size={15} className="text-red-600" />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                  {/* Explanation Box */}
                  <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-white/80 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 text-xs text-gray-700">
                    <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900 block mb-0.5">
                      വിശദീകരണം (Explanation):
                    </span>
                    <p>{item.explanation}</p>
                    {item.explanationMl && (
                      <p className="text-indigo-800 mt-1 font-medium">{item.explanationMl}</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CASE 2: ACTIVE EXAM IN PROGRESS (WITH STICKY COUNTDOWN TIMER) */}
      {activeQuiz && !lastResult && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-gray-200 shadow-xl overflow-hidden animate-fadeIn">
          {/* Sticky Header with Timer & Progress */}
          <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-gray-200 p-4 md:px-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700 uppercase">
                  {activeQuiz.subject} • {activeQuiz.className}
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">{activeQuiz.title}</h3>
              </div>

              {/* Countdown Timer Display */}
              <div
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl border font-mono font-bold text-lg shadow-sm transition-all ${
                  timeRemainingSeconds <= 120
                    ? 'bg-red-50 border-red-300 text-red-600 animate-pulse'
                    : 'bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-200 text-indigo-700'
                }`}
              >
                <Timer size={20} className={timeRemainingSeconds <= 120 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-indigo-600'} />
                <span>{formatTimer(timeRemainingSeconds)}</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-sans uppercase text-gray-500">Left</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Question Quick Navigation Strip */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto py-2.5 mt-2">
              {activeQuiz.questions.map((q, idx) => {
                const isAnswered = !!answers[q.id];
                const isCurrent = idx === currentQuestionIndex;

                let pillStyle = 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-gray-200';
                if (isCurrent) {
                  pillStyle = 'bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold ring-2 ring-indigo-300';
                } else if (isAnswered) {
                  pillStyle = 'bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold';
                }

                return (
                  <button
                    key={q.id}
                    onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex(idx)}
                    className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 border transition-all ${pillStyle}`}
                  >
                    {idx + 1}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Active Question Area */}
          <div className="p-6 md:p-8 space-y-6">
            {(() => {
              const currentQuestion = activeQuiz.questions[currentQuestionIndex];
              const selectedOptId = answers[currentQuestion.id] || '';

              return (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-500">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">
                      ചോദ്യം {currentQuestionIndex + 1} of {activeQuiz.questions.length}
                    </span>
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 font-bold border border-indigo-200">
                      +{currentQuestion.marks} Marks
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Question Text */}
                  <div className="bg-gray-50 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200">
                    <h3 className="text-base md:text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 leading-relaxed">
                      {currentQuestion.questionText}
                    </h3>
                    {currentQuestion.questionTextMl && (
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-indigo-900 mt-2 leading-relaxed">
                        {currentQuestion.questionTextMl}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Options */}
                  <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2">
                    {currentQuestion.options.map((opt) => {
                      const isSelected = selectedOptId === opt.id;

                      return (
                        <div
                          key={opt.id}
                          onClick={() => selectAnswer(currentQuestion.id, opt.id)}
                          className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/80 shadow-sm'
                              : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-gray-50/50'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <span
                              className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold border transition-all ${
                                isSelected
                                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600'
                                  : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {opt.id}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{opt.text}</span>
                          </div>

                          <div
                            className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center ${
                              isSelected ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600' : 'border-gray-300'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isSelected && <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-white" />}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })()}

            {/* Bottom Actions Bar */}
            <div className="pt-6 border-t border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={currentQuestionIndex === 0}
                onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1))}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-300 text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={16} />
                <span>മുൻപത്തെ ചോദ്യം</span>
              </button>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {currentQuestionIndex < activeQuiz.questions.length - 1 ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex((prev) => prev + 1)}
                    className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
                  >
                    <span>അടുത്ത ചോദ്യം</span>
                    <ChevronRight size={16} />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleManualSubmit}
                    className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                    <span>പരീക്ഷ സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യുക (Submit Exam)</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CONFIRMATION SUBMISSION MODAL */}
      {showConfirmSubmit && activeQuiz && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 text-center space-y-4">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
              <HelpCircle size={32} />
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">പരീക്ഷ സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യണോ?</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">
              നിങ്ങൾ {activeQuiz.questions.length} ചോദ്യങ്ങളിൽ {totalAnsweredCount} എണ്ണത്തിന് ഉത്തരം നൽകിയിട്ടുണ്ട്.
              സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്താൽ ഉടൻ തന്നെ മാർക്കുകൾ കണക്കാക്കപ്പെടും.
            </p>

            <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmSubmit(false)}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200"
              >
                തുടർന്ന് എഴുതുക (Resume)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={executeSubmission}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow"
              >
                തീർച്ചയായും സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യുക
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CASE 3: EXAM CATALOG / LIST (WHEN NO EXAM IS ACTIVE) */}
      {!activeQuiz && !lastResult && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Header Banner */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900 via-indigo-800 to-violet-900 text-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-lg">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md text-xs font-semibold">
                  ഓൺലൈൻ മോഡൽ പരീക്ഷകൾ • Timed MCQ Model Exams
                </span>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-black mt-2">
                  SSLC / ക്ലാസ് മോഡൽ പരീക്ഷാ കേന്ദ്രം
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
                  കുട്ടികൾ പരീക്ഷ സബ്മിറ്റ് ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ തന്നെ തത്സമയം മാർക്കുകളും ഉത്തരങ്ങളുടെ വിശദീകരണവും ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/20">
                <Flame className="text-amber-400" size={24} />
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-200 block">Available Tests</span>
                  <span className="text-xl font-bold">{quizzes.length} Model Exams</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Available Quizzes Grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {quizzes.map((quiz) => {
              const quizAttempts = attempts.filter((a) => a.quizId === quiz.id);
              const bestScore = quizAttempts.length
                ? Math.max(...quizAttempts.map((a) => a.percentage))
                : null;

              return (
                <div
                  key={quiz.id}
                  className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-indigo-400 hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between"
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700">
                        {quiz.subject}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                        {quiz.totalMarks} Marks
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 mt-2.5">{quiz.title}</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-900 mt-0.5">{quiz.titleMl}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-2">{quiz.description}</p>

                    {/* Metadata chips */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mt-4 text-xs text-gray-500">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-indigo-700">
                        <Timer size={14} />
                        <span>{quiz.durationMinutes} Minutes Timer</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <HelpCircle size={14} />
                        <span>{quiz.questions.length} Questions</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Award size={14} />
                        <span>Pass: {quiz.passPercentage}%</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-5 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      {bestScore !== null ? (
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
                          Best Score: {bestScore}%
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">Not Attempted Yet</span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => startQuiz(quiz)}
                      className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-sm transition-all transform active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                    >
                      <span>പരീക്ഷ തുടങ്ങുക (Start Test)</span>
                      <ChevronRight size={14} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Past Attempts Leaderboard / History */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 p-6 shadow-sm">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart3 className="text-indigo-600" size={18} />
              <span>മുൻപത്തെ പരീക്ഷാ ഫലങ്ങൾ (Past Exam History & Automated Scores)</span>
            </h3>

            {attempts.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">No exam attempts recorded yet.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100 mt-3">
                {attempts.map((att) => (
                  <div
                    key={att.id}
                    className="py-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-900">{att.quizTitle}</h4>
                      <span className="text-gray-500">
                        {att.studentName} • Time taken: {Math.floor(att.timeSpentSeconds / 60)}m{' '}
                        {att.timeSpentSeconds % 60}s
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className="font-extrabold text-sm text-gray-900">
                          {att.score} / {att.totalMarks} ({att.percentage}%)
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`block font-bold text-[10px] ${
                            att.passed ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-red-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {att.passed ? 'PASSED' : 'NEEDS PRACTICE'}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => setLastResult(att)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 font-semibold hover:bg-indigo-100"
                      >
                        ഉത്തരങ്ങൾ കാണുക
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { FormEvent, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, GraduationCap, ShieldCheck, Users, BookOpen } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/AuthContext';
import { Button, Input, Alert } from './ui';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import LanguageSwitcher from './LanguageSwitcher';
export function LoginScreen({portal = 'school'}: {portal?: string}) {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      await login(email, password);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.message || t('auth.unableToSignIn'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const portalLabel = portal === 'admin' ? t('admin.administration') 
    : portal === 'teacher' ? t('teacher.teaching') 
    : portal === 'parent' ? t('parent.family') 
    : portal === 'student' ? 'Student'
    : t('common.school');

  return (
    <div className="login-page">
      <section className="login-story">
        <Link href="/" className="brand">
          <span className="brand-symbol">K</span>
          <span>
            Krypton
            <small>{t('common.schoolWorkspace')}</small>
          </span>
        </Link>
        <div className="login-story-content">
          <span className="eyebrow light">
            <span className="workspace-dot" />
            {t('common.connectedSchool')}
          </span>
          <h1>
            {t('common.betterSchoolDays')}
            <br />
            <span>{t('common.brighterFutures')}</span>
          </h1>
          <p>{t('common.workspaceDescription')}</p>
          <div className="story-features">
            <div>
              <Users />
              <span>{t('common.peopleConnected')}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <BookOpen />
              <span>{t('common.learningSupported')}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <ShieldCheck />
              <span>{t('common.accessProtected')}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="story-art" aria-hidden="true">
            <div className="art-orbit" />
            <div className="art-book">
              <GraduationCap size={68} strokeWidth={1} />
              <span>{t('common.placeToGrow')}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="art-dot one" />
            <div className="art-dot two" />
          </div>
          <small>{t('common.oneCommunity')}</small>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="login-form-panel">
        {/* Language Switcher */}
        <div className="absolute top-4 right-4">
          <LanguageSwitcher variant="compact" />
        </div>

        <div className="login-form-wrap">
          <span className="eyebrow">{t('common.welcomeToKrypton')}</span>
          <h2>{t('auth.goodToSeeYou')}</h2>
          <p className="muted">
            {t('auth.signInToWorkspace', { workspace: portalLabel })}
          </p>
          <div className="portal-tabs">
            <Link className={portal === 'school' ? 'selected' : ''} href="/login">
              {t('common.school')}
            </Link>
            <Link className={portal === 'teacher' ? 'selected' : ''} href="/teacher/login">
              {t('teacher.teacher')}
            </Link>
            <Link className={portal === 'student' ? 'selected' : ''} href="/student/login">
              Student
            </Link>
            <Link className={portal === 'parent' ? 'selected' : ''} href="/parent/login">
              {t('parent.family')}
            </Link>
            <Link className={portal === 'admin' ? 'selected' : ''} href="/admin/login">
              {t('admin.platform')}
            </Link>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}
            <Input
              label={t('auth.email')}
              type="email"
              autoComplete="username"
              placeholder="you@school.ac.ke"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            />
            <div className="password-field">
              <Input
                label={t('auth.password')}
                type={show ? 'text' : 'password'}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                placeholder={t('auth.enterPassword')}
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={show ? t('auth.hidePassword') : t('auth.showPassword')}
                onClick={() => setShow(!show)}
              >
                {show ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
              </button>
            </div>
            <Button type="submit" fullWidth isLoading={busy} rightIcon={<ArrowRight size={18} />}>
              {t('auth.signInToWorkspace')}
            </Button>
          </form>
          <p className="login-help">
            <ShieldCheck size={16} />
            {t('auth.accessAssigned')}
          </p>
          <p className="login-contact">{t('auth.needHelpContact')}</p>
        </div>
        <footer>{t('common.organizedSchools')}</footer>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import {useState,useEffect,useCallback} from 'react';
import {Send,MessageSquare} from 'lucide-react';

export function MessagesPage(){
 const [messages,setMessages]=useState<any[]>([]);const [classes,setClasses]=useState<any[]>([]);const [classId,setClass]=useState('');const [subject,setSubject]=useState('');const [body,setBody]=useState('');const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false);const [error,setError]=useState('');const [notice,setNotice]=useState('');

}

import {useState,useEffect,useCallback} from 'react';

import {apiClient} from '@/lib/api-client';
import {getRows,dateLabel,messageFor} from '@/lib/workspace';
import {Button} from './ui';
export function NotificationsPage(){
 const [rows,setRows]=useState<any[]>([]);const [error,setError]=useState('');const [busy,setBusy]=useState<string|null>(null);const load=useCallback(async()=>{try{setRows(await getRows('/workspace/notifications'));setError('');}catch(err){setError(messageFor(err));}},[]);
 useEffect(()=>{void load();},[load]);
 async function read(id:string){setBusy(id);try{await apiClient.post('/workspace/notifications/'+id+'/read');setRows(rows.map(r=>r.id===id?{...r,read:true}:r));}catch(err){setError(messageFor(err));}finally{setBusy(null);}}
 return <><PageHeading title="School updates" description="Messages and announcements for your family."/>{error&&<div role="alert" className="state-box">{error}</div>}<Panel title="Your inbox" subtitle={rows.filter(r=>!r.read).length+' unread messages'}>{rows.length?<div className="panel-body">{rows.map(r=><article key={r.id} className="activity-row"><div className="activity-icon"><MessageSquare size={17}/></div><div className="flex-1"><strong>{r.title}{!r.read&&<span className="pill ml-2">New</span>}</strong><p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{r.body}</p><time>{dateLabel(r.createdAt)}{r.platform?' ? Platform update':''}</time></div>{!r.read&&<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={busy===r.id} onClick={()=>void read(r.id)} leftIcon={<Check size={15}/>}>Mark read</Button>}</article>)}</div>:<EmptyState title="You?re all caught up" description="School updates will arrive here."/>}</Panel></>;
}

  if (isOnline) {

  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-16 left-0 right-0 z-50 px-4 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        <Alert variant="warning">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <svg
              className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M18.364 5.636a9 9 0 010 12.728m0 0l-2.829-2.829m2.829 2.829L21 21M15.536 8.464a5 5 0 010 7.072m0 0l-2.829-2.829m-4.243 2.829a4.978 4.978 0 01-1.414-2.83m-1.414 5.658a9 9 0 01-2.167-9.238m7.824 2.167a1 1 0 111.414 1.414m-1.414-1.414L3 3m8.293 8.293l1.414 1.414"
              />

File: apps/web/src/components/portfolio/StudentDigitalPortfolioHub.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Award,
  BookOpen,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronRight,
  Download,
  ExternalLink,
  Filter,
  GraduationCap,
  Medal,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  Sparkles,
  Star,
  Trophy,
  User,
  X,
  Zap,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  StudentDigitalPortfolio,
  StudentBadge,
  PortfolioAchievement,
  PortfolioProject,
  BadgeCategory,
  BadgeRarity,
} from '@krypton/types';
import { PortfolioStore, BADGE_LIBRARY } from '@/lib/portfolio-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';

interface StudentDigitalPortfolioHubProps {
  portal?: 'student' | 'teacher' | 'dashboard' | 'parent';
  initialStudentId?: string;
}

export function StudentDigitalPortfolioHub({
  portal = 'dashboard',
  initialStudentId = 'std-14',
}: StudentDigitalPortfolioHubProps) {
  const [portfolios, setPortfolios] = useState<StudentDigitalPortfolio[]>([]);
  const [selectedStudentId, setSelectedStudentId] = useState<string>(initialStudentId);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'OVERVIEW' | 'BADGES' | 'ACHIEVEMENTS' | 'PROJECTS' | 'CERTIFICATES'>('OVERVIEW');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string>('');

  // Modals
  const [isAwardModalOpen, setIsAwardModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedBadgeCode, setSelectedBadgeCode] = useState(BADGE_LIBRARY[0]?.code || '');
  const [badgeCustomReason, setBadgeCustomReason] = useState('');
  const [awardedByTeacher, setAwardedByTeacher] = useState('Senior Faculty In-charge');

  const [isAddAchModalOpen, setIsAddAchModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [achTitle, setAchTitle] = useState('');
  const [achTitleMl, setAchTitleMl] = useState('');
  const [achCategory, setAchCategory] = useState<any>('ARTS_CULTURE');
  const [achLevel, setAchLevel] = useState<any>('DISTRICT');
  const [achPosition, setAchPosition] = useState<any>('FIRST');
  const [achDesc, setAchDesc] = useState('');
  const [achOrganizer, setAchOrganizer] = useState('');
  const [achYear, setAchYear] = useState('2025-2026');

  const [isAddProjModalOpen, setIsAddProjModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [projTitle, setProjTitle] = useState('');
  const [projSubject, setProjSubject] = useState('');
  const [projDesc, setProjDesc] = useState('');
  const [projSkills, setProjSkills] = useState('');
  const [projScore, setProjScore] = useState('A+ (100/100)');
  const [projFeedback, setProjFeedback] = useState('');

  const refreshData = () => {
    const list = PortfolioStore.getPortfolios();
    setPortfolios(list);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshData();
  }, []);

  const activePortfolio =
    portfolios.find((p) => p.studentId === selectedStudentId) || portfolios[0] || null;

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(''), 4500);
  };

  const handleAwardBadge = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activePortfolio || !selectedBadgeCode) return;
    const awarded = PortfolioStore.awardBadge(
      activePortfolio.studentId,
      selectedBadgeCode,
      awardedByTeacher,
      badgeCustomReason
    );
    if (awarded) {
      refreshData();
      setIsAwardModalOpen(false);
      setBadgeCustomReason('');
      showToast(`🏆 Badge "${awarded.name}" successfully awarded to ${activePortfolio.name}!`);
    }
  };

  const handleAddAchievement = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activePortfolio || !achTitle) return;
    const added = PortfolioStore.addAchievement(activePortfolio.studentId, {
      studentId: activePortfolio.studentId,
      title: achTitle,
      titleMl: achTitleMl || achTitle,
      category: achCategory,
      academicYear: achYear,
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      level: achLevel,
      position: achPosition,
      description: achDesc,
      organizer: achOrganizer || 'School Authority',
      certificateNumber: `ACH-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`,
    });
    if (added) {
      refreshData();
      setIsAddAchModalOpen(false);
      setAchTitle('');
      setAchTitleMl('');
      setAchDesc('');
      showToast(`✨ Achievement "${added.title}" recorded in student digital portfolio!`);
    }
  };

  const handleAddProject = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activePortfolio || !projTitle) return;
    const added = PortfolioStore.addProject(activePortfolio.studentId, {
      studentId: activePortfolio.studentId,
      title: projTitle,
      subject: projSubject || 'General Science',
      academicYear: '2025-2026',
      completionDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      description: projDesc,
      skillsAcquired: projSkills.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
      scoreOrGrade: projScore,
      teacherFeedback: projFeedback || 'Excellent dedication and creative execution.',
      featured: true,
    });
    if (added) {
      refreshData();
      setIsAddProjModalOpen(false);
      setProjTitle('');
      setProjDesc('');
      setProjSkills('');
      showToast(`🚀 Capstone Project "${added.title}" added to showcase!`);
    }
  };

  if (!activePortfolio) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">Loading student portfolios...</div>;
  }

  const rarityBadgeClass = (rarity: BadgeRarity) => {
    switch (rarity) {
      case 'LEGENDARY':
        return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 ring-2 ring-amber-400/30';
      case 'EPIC':
        return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-900 border-purple-300';
      case 'RARE':
        return 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 border-sky-300';
      default:
        return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 border-emerald-300';
    }
  };

  const filteredBadges = activePortfolio.badges.filter((b) => {
    if (categoryFilter !== 'ALL' && b.category !== categoryFilter) return false;
    if (searchQuery && !b.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())) return false;
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Toast Alert */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-emerald-900 text-white px-5 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 border border-emerald-700 animate-slide-up">
          <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-300 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">{toastMessage}</span>
          <button onClick={() => setToastMessage('')} className="ml-2 text-emerald-300 hover:text-white">
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header and Student Selector Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-700 mb-1">
            <Trophy size={15} />
            <span>STUDENT DIGITAL PORTFOLIO & BADGES</span>
            <span className="bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
              Multi-Year Ledger
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
            Digital Profile, Achievements & Gamified Badges
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
            ഓരോ കുട്ടിയുടെയും കലാ-കായിക നേട്ടങ്ങൾ, പ്രോജക്റ്റുകൾ, ലഭിച്ച സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റുകൾ എന്നിവ വർഷങ്ങളോളം സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്ന ഡിജിറ്റൽ പ്രൊഫൈൽ.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {/* Student Selector */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200">
            <User size={16} className="text-gray-500" />
            <select
              value={selectedStudentId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedStudentId(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-transparent text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              {portfolios.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.studentId} value={p.studentId}>
                  {p.name} ({p.className})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          {(portal === 'teacher' || portal === 'dashboard') && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                leftIcon={<Award size={15} />}
                onClick={() => setIsAwardModalOpen(true)}
              >
                Award Badge
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                leftIcon={<Plus size={15} />}
                onClick={() => setIsAddAchModalOpen(true)}
              >
                Log Achievement
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="primary"
            leftIcon={<Printer size={15} />}
            onClick={() => window.print()}
          >
            Print / Export Portfolio PDF
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Hero Student Digital Passport Card */}
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-950 via-slate-900 to-indigo-900 text-white rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xl border border-indigo-800/40">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute -bottom-10 -left-10 w-80 h-80 bg-amber-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-5">
            <div className="relative w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-amber-400 via-indigo-400 to-cyan-300 p-1 shadow-lg flex-shrink-0">
              <div className="w-full h-full bg-slate-900 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-3xl text-amber-300">
