'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { BrainCircuit, CreditCard, Download, GraduationCap, RefreshCw, Search, UserRoundCheck, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import type { PredictiveAnalyticsReport, RiskAssessment, RiskKind, RiskLevel, StudentRiskProfile } from '@krypton/types';
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';
import { exportCsv, messageFor } from '@/lib/workspace';
import { predictiveAnalyticsRoles } from '@/lib/session';
import { ProtectedRoute } from './ProtectedRoute';
import { EmptyState, PageHeading, Panel, StatCard } from './WorkspaceUI';
import { Button } from './ui';

const labels: Record<RiskLevel, string> = { HIGH: 'High', MODERATE: 'Moderate', LOW: 'Low', INSUFFICIENT_DATA: 'Limited evidence' };
const kinds: { key: RiskKind; label: string; href: string }[] = [
  { key: 'academic', label: 'Academic failure risk', href: '/school/grades' },
  { key: 'feeDefault', label: 'Fee default risk', href: '/school/fees' },
  { key: 'dropout', label: 'Dropout support signal', href: '/school/attendance' },
];
function RiskPill({ risk }: { risk: Pick<RiskAssessment, 'level' | 'score'> }) {
  return <span className={`pill ${risk.level === 'HIGH' ? 'danger' : risk.level === 'MODERATE' ? 'warning' : risk.level === 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA' ? 'neutral' : ''}`}>
    {labels[risk.level]}{risk.score !== null && <span> · {risk.score}/100</span>}
  </span>;
}
// Spreadsheet formula injection protection for school-entered names and evidence.
const safeCsv = (value: string) => /^[\s]*[=+@-]/.test(value) ? "'" + value : value;

export function PredictiveAnalytics() {
  return <ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={predictiveAnalyticsRoles}><AnalyticsDashboard /></ProtectedRoute>;
}

function AnalyticsDashboard() {
  const [report, setReport] = useState<PredictiveAnalyticsReport | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [classId, setClassId] = useState('');
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<RiskKind | 'all'>('all');
  const [level, setLevel] = useState('AT_RISK');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const request = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const detailHeading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    request.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController(); request.current = controller;
    setLoading(true); setError(''); setReport(null); setSelectedId(null);
    try {
      const response = await apiClient.get<PredictiveAnalyticsReport>('/predictive-analytics', { signal: controller.signal });
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setReport(response.data);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setError(messageFor(err));
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { void load(); return () => request.current?.abort(); }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => { setPage(1); }, [query, classId, kind, level, report]);
  useEffect(() => { if (selectedId) detailHeading.current?.focus(); }, [selectedId]);
  const selected = report?.students.find(s => s.studentId === selectedId);
  const rows = (report?.students ?? []).filter(student => {
    const riskLevel = kind === 'all' ? student.overall : student[kind].level;
    return (!classId || (classId === 'unassigned' ? !student.classId : student.classId === classId)) &&
      `${student.name} ${student.admissionNumber}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()) &&
      (level === 'ALL' || (level === 'AT_RISK' ? ['HIGH', 'MODERATE'].includes(riskLevel) : riskLevel === level));
  });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length / 10));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount);
  const visible = rows.slice((currentPage - 1) * 10, currentPage * 10);
  const currency = (amount: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { style: 'currency', currency: report?.currency ?? 'KES', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(amount / 100);
  const exportReport = () => {
    const records = rows.map(s => ({
      name: safeCsv(s.name), admission: safeCsv(s.admissionNumber), className: safeCsv(s.className),
      overall: labels[s.overall], academic: s.academic.score ?? 'Limited evidence', fee: s.feeDefault.score ?? 'Limited evidence',
      dropout: s.dropout.score ?? 'Limited evidence', attendance: s.metrics.attendanceRate ?? 'Limited evidence',
      outstanding: s.metrics.outstandingBalance / 100,
      evidence: safeCsv(kinds.map(k => `${k.label}: ${s[k.key].evidence.join(' ')}`).join(' | ')),
      generatedAt: report!.generatedAt,
    }));
    exportCsv('student-risk-review', [
      { key: 'name', label: 'Student' }, { key: 'admission', label: 'Admission number' }, { key: 'className', label: 'Class' },
      { key: 'overall', label: 'Review priority' }, { key: 'academic', label: 'Academic risk index /100' },
      { key: 'fee', label: 'Fee risk index /100' }, { key: 'dropout', label: 'Dropout support index /100' },
      { key: 'attendance', label: 'Attendance %' }, { key: 'outstanding', label: `Outstanding (${report!.currency})` },
      { key: 'evidence', label: 'Evidence' }, { key: 'generatedAt', label: 'Generated at (UTC)' },
    ], records);
  };
  return <div className="content-stack analytics-page">
    <PageHeading eyebrow="EARLY SUPPORT · BETTER OUTCOMES" title="AI Predictive Analytics" description="Spot academic, fee and attendance warning signs while there is time to help."
      actions={<><Button size="sm" variant="outline" isLoading={loading} leftIcon={<RefreshCw size={15} />} onClick={() => void load()}>Refresh</Button>
        <Button size="sm" disabled={!rows.length || loading} leftIcon={<Download size={15} />} onClick={exportReport}>Export review list</Button></>} />
    {loading && <div className="panel panel-body" role="status"><span className="spinner mr-2" /> Analysing school records…</div>}
    {error && <div className="state-box" role="alert">{error} <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void load()}>Try again</Button></div>}
    {report && <>
      <div className="analytics-intro"><BrainCircuit size={28} /><div><strong>Early signals. A chance to intervene.</strong>
        <p>Scores help staff prioritise a supportive review. They do not establish that a student will fail, default or leave school.</p>
        <small>Updated {new Date(report.generatedAt).toLocaleString()} · {report.summary.students} active students · {report.summary.incompleteData} with incomplete evidence</small></div></div>
      <div className="metric-grid">
        <StatCard label="Students to review" value={report.summary.atRisk} note="High or moderate in any dimension" icon={Users} />
        <StatCard label="Academic warning" value={report.summary.academicHigh} note="High academic risk" icon={GraduationCap} />
        <StatCard label="Fee warning" value={report.summary.feeDefaultHigh} note={`${currency(report.summary.overdueBalance)} overdue across the school`} icon={CreditCard} />
        <StatCard label="Retention support" value={report.summary.dropoutHigh} note="High attendance-based support signal" icon={UserRoundCheck} />
      </div>
      <details className="panel analytics-methodology"><summary>How predictions work & model readiness</summary>
        <p>{report.methodology}</p>
        <div className="analytics-model-grid">{(['academic', 'feeDefault'] as const).map(key => {
          const model = report.models[key];
          return <div key={key}><strong>{key === 'academic' ? 'Academic model' : 'Fee default model'}</strong>
            <span className={`pill ${model.status === 'ACTIVE' ? '' : 'neutral'}`}>{model.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'School-trained model active' : model.status === 'VALIDATION_FAILED' ? 'Early-warning mode · validation did not pass' : 'Early-warning mode · more history needed'}</span>
            <p>{model.samples} historical examples · {model.validationSamples} held out for validation{model.balancedAccuracy !== null ? ` · balanced accuracy ${Math.round(model.balancedAccuracy * 100)}% · Brier score ${model.brierScore}` : ''}.</p></div>;
        })}</div>
        <p>Models need at least 60 examples, both outcomes, and a later-date validation set. Fee learning requires reconciled payment ledgers and applies seven days before the due date. High: 65–100; moderate: 35–64; low: 0–34. A missing score means limited evidence. Health, gender and family demographics are excluded. Dropout support uses attendance and declining exam trends.</p>
      </details>
      {selected && <Panel title="Student support review" subtitle="Review the evidence before taking action">
        <div className="panel-body analytics-review"><div className="analytics-review-heading"><div><h3 ref={detailHeading} tabIndex={-1}>{selected.name}</h3><p>{selected.admissionNumber} · {selected.className}</p></div><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSelectedId(null)}>Close review</Button></div>
          <div className="analytics-evidence-grid">{kinds.map(k => <EvidenceCard key={k.key} student={selected} kind={k} />)}</div>
          <div className="analytics-facts"><span>Latest exam <strong>{selected.metrics.latestAverage === null ? 'Unavailable' : `${selected.metrics.latestAverage}%`}</strong></span>
            <span>Attendance <strong>{selected.metrics.attendanceRate === null ? 'Limited evidence' : `${selected.metrics.attendanceRate}%`}</strong></span>
            <span>Outstanding fees <strong>{currency(selected.metrics.outstandingBalance)}</strong></span></div>
        </div>
      </Panel>}
      <Panel title="Student watchlist" subtitle="Highest risk scores first. Open a review to see the evidence and suggested support.">
        <div className="table-toolbar analytics-filters"><label className="search-field"><Search size={16} /><input aria-label="Search student or admission number" value={query} placeholder="Student or admission number" onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)} /></label>
          <label>Class<select aria-label="Class" value={classId} onChange={e => setClassId(e.target.value)}><option value="">All classes</option>{report.classes.map(c => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>)}<option value="unassigned">Unassigned</option></select></label>
          <label>Risk dimension<select aria-label="Risk dimension" value={kind} onChange={e => setKind(e.target.value as RiskKind | 'all')}><option value="all">Any dimension</option>{kinds.map(k => <option key={k.key} value={k.key}>{k.label}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>Priority<select aria-label="Priority" value={level} onChange={e => setLevel(e.target.value)}><option value="AT_RISK">High & moderate</option><option value="ALL">All students</option>{Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>)}</select></label>
        </div>
        {!report.students.length ? <EmptyState title="No active students yet" description="Analytics will appear as students, exam results, attendance and fee records are added." /> : !rows.length ?
          <EmptyState title="No students match this view" description="Change the class, risk or priority filters to review other students." /> : <>
            <div className="table-wrap"><table><caption className="sr-only">Student early-warning risk indices, scored out of 100</caption><thead><tr><th>Student</th><th>Review priority</th><th>Academic</th><th>Fee default</th><th>Dropout support</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{visible.map(s => <tr key={s.studentId}><td><strong>{s.name}</strong><small className="analytics-student-meta">{s.admissionNumber} · {s.className}</small></td><td><RiskPill risk={{ level: s.overall, score: null }} /></td>{kinds.map(k => <td key={k.key}><RiskPill risk={s[k.key]} /></td>)}
                <td><Button variant="outline" size="sm" aria-label={`Review ${s.name}`} aria-pressed={selectedId === s.studentId} onClick={() => setSelectedId(s.studentId)}>Review</Button></td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>
            <div className="table-pagination"><span>{(currentPage - 1) * 10 + 1}–{Math.min(currentPage * 10, rows.length)} of {rows.length} students</span><div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={currentPage === 1} onClick={() => setPage(currentPage - 1)}>Previous</Button><span>Page {currentPage} of {pageCount}</span><Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={currentPage >= pageCount} onClick={() => setPage(currentPage + 1)}>Next</Button></div></div>
          </>}
      </Panel>
    </>}
  </div>;
}

function EvidenceCard({ student, kind }: { student: StudentRiskProfile; kind: typeof kinds[number] }) {
  const risk = student[kind.key];
  return <section className="analytics-evidence"><h3>{kind.label}</h3><RiskPill risk={risk} />
    <p className="analytics-basis">{risk.basis === 'SCHOOL_MODEL' ? 'School-trained model' : 'Explainable early-warning indicator'}</p>
    <h4>Why this appears</h4><ul>{risk.evidence.map(e => <li key={e}>{e}</li>)}</ul>
    <h4>Suggested support</h4><ul>{risk.actions.map(a => <li key={a}>{a}</li>)}</ul>
    <Link className="panel-link" href={kind.href}>Open {kind.key === 'academic' ? 'gradebook' : kind.key === 'feeDefault' ? 'fee records' : 'attendance'} →</Link>
  </section>;
}

'use client';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/AuthContext';
import { PageLoader } from '@/components/ui';
import { homeForRole } from '@/lib/session';
export function ProtectedRoute({ children, allowedRoles }: { children: React.ReactNode; allowedRoles?: string[] }) {
  const { user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const permitted = !!user && (!allowedRoles || allowedRoles.includes(user.role));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !user) router.replace('/login');
    else if (!isLoading && user && !permitted) router.replace(homeForRole(user.role));
  }, [isLoading, user, permitted, router]);
  if (isLoading) return <PageLoader />;
  return permitted ? <>{children}</> : null;
}

            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600 to-violet-500 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30">
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide text-slate-100">
                  {slot.title}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30 font-medium">
                  {slot.grade}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
                <span>Student: <strong className="text-slate-200">{slot.studentName || 'Open Slot'}</strong></span>
                <span>•</span>
                <span>Teacher: <strong className="text-slate-200">{slot.teacherName}</strong></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center Indicators: Timer, Security, Recording */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
          {/* Time Remaining Badge with PTM countdown */}
          <div className={`flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium border ${
            isTimeRunningLow 
              ? 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border-red-500/40 animate-pulse'
              : 'bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-300 border-slate-700'
          }`}>
            <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
            </svg>
            <span>Slot: {formatTimer(remainingSeconds)} left</span>
            <span className="text-slate-500">|</span>
            <span className="text-slate-400">Elapsed: {formatTimer(meetingTimer)}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Recording Pill */}
          {isRecording && (
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-red-600/30 border border-red-500/50 text-red-200 text-xs font-mono animate-pulse">
              <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-500" />
              <span>REC {formatTimer(recordingDuration)}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* End-to-End Encryption Shield */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSidePanel(activeSidePanel === 'security' ? 'none' : 'security')}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-emerald-500/20 transition-colors"
            title="Meeting Security Settings"
          >
            <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z" />
            </svg>
            <span>Secure HD</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Right Header Actions: Code, Copy, Layout */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          {/* Copy Meeting Info Pill */}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined') {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(
                  `Krypton Virtual PTM\nMeeting Code: ${slot.meetingCode}\nPIN: ${slot.meetingPin}\nJoin: ${window.location.href}`

                showToast('Meeting details copied to clipboard!');
              }
            }}
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-xs transition-colors border border-slate-700"

            <span className="font-mono text-indigo-400 font-semibold">{slot.meetingCode}</span>

            </svg>
          </button>

          {/* Layout switcher */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-800 rounded-lg p-0.5 border border-slate-700">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveLayout('grid')}

              title="Grid View (Gallery)"
            >
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM14 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM4 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2zM14 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2z" />

              onClick={() => {

            >
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* 2. MAIN MEETING VIEWPORT & SIDE PANELS */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden relative">
        {/* Waiting Room Banner alert if host and people waiting */}
        {waitingRoomList.length > 0 && currentUserRole === 'TEACHER' && (
          <div className="absolute top-3 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-40 bg-amber-900/90 border border-amber-600/70 text-amber-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs">
            <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 animate-spin" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />

            <span><strong>{waitingRoomList[0].name}</strong> is in the waiting room</span>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => admitWaitingParticipant(waitingRoomList[0].id)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-medium"
              >
                Admit
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSidePanel('participants')}
                className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300"
              >
                View Lobby ({waitingRoomList.length})
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Video Canvas / Participants Stage */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col p-3 overflow-hidden relative bg-slate-950">
          {/* SCREEN SHARE PRESENTATION STAGE */}
          {isScreenSharing && (
            <div className="flex-1 bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative border border-slate-800 flex flex-col mb-3">
              <div className="h-9 bg-slate-800/90 px-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300 border-b border-slate-700">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-100">Presentation: Grade 7 Term 3 CBC Assessment & Progress Deck</span>
                </div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs">Shared by {slot.teacherName} (You)</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-indigo-950/40 to-slate-900 p-6 flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden">
                {/* Simulated Presentation Slide if real screen not shared */}
                <div className="max-w-3xl w-full bg-slate-900/90 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-xl p-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-4 mb-6">
                    <div>
                      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-100">Krypton Junior Secondary Academy</h2>
                      <p className="text-sm text-indigo-400 font-medium">CBC Competency-Based Assessment Portfolio: {slot.studentName}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-sm font-semibold border border-emerald-500/30">
                      Overall: 84.5% (Exceeding)
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                    <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">Integrated Science</div>
                      <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-400 mt-1">91%</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-1">Exceeding Expectation</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">Mathematics</div>
                      <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-400 mt-1">76%</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-1">Approaching Expectation</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">Attendance Rate</div>
                      <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-400 mt-1">96.8%</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-1">Exemplary Record</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-800/40 p-4 rounded-xl text-xs text-indigo-200">
                    <strong>Teacher Recommendations for Home Study:</strong> Focus on algebraic equations for 15 minutes each evening. Continue encouraging independent inquiry and practical experiments.
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* PARTICIPANTS VIDEO TILES */}
          <div className={`flex-1 grid gap-3 ${
            isScreenSharing 
              ? 'h-36 shrink-0 grid-flow-col auto-cols-fr' 
              : activeLayout === 'grid' 
                ? 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' 
                : 'grid-cols-1'
          }`}>
            {participants.map((p) => {
              const isSpeaker = activeSpeaker === p.id;
              const isTeacher = p.id === 'teacher';
              const isLocalUser = p.isLocal;

              return (
                <div
                  key={p.id}
                  className={`group relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-900 border transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-xl ${
                    isSpeaker
                      ? 'border-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/40'
                      : 'border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {/* Real WebRTC Webcam feed for local user */}
                  {isLocalUser && !isVideoOff ? (
                    <video
                      ref={localVideoRef}
                      autoPlay
                      playsInline
                      muted
                      className={`w-full h-full object-cover transform -scale-x-100 ${
                        virtualBg === 'blur' ? 'filter blur-[1px]' : ''
                      }`}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    /* Fallback High-Fidelity Animated Avatar & Studio Stage */
                    <div className={`w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative ${
                      virtualBg === 'classroom' 
                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-950 via-slate-900 to-indigo-950'
                        : virtualBg === 'library'
                          ? 'bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-950/40 via-slate-900 to-amber-950/40'
                          : 'bg-gradient-to-tr from-slate-900 via-slate-850 to-slate-900'
                    }`}>
                      {/* Realistic Avatar Circle */}
                      <div className={`w-28 h-28 rounded-full ${p.avatarBg} flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-bold text-white shadow-2xl relative transition-transform group-hover:scale-105`}>
                        {p.name.charAt(0)}
                        {/* Audio Pulse Ring when speaking */}
                        {isSpeaker && (
                          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-4 border-emerald-400 animate-ping opacity-60" />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Role & Status Subtitle */}
                      <div className="mt-3 text-center">
                        <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-100">{p.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                          {isTeacher ? 'Host • Class Educator' : p.id === 'student' ? 'Student • Grade 7' : 'Guardian / Parent'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Top-Right Participant Badges: Hand Raise, Network */}
                  <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 flex items-center space-x-2">
                    {p.handRaised || (isLocalUser && isHandRaised) ? (
                      <div className="px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 text-xs font-bold flex items-center space-x-1 animate-bounce shadow-lg">
                        <span>✋</span>
                        <span>Raised Hand</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : null}

                    {/* Network quality bars */}
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-0.5 bg-slate-900/80 px-2 py-1 rounded-md backdrop-blur-md">
                      <div className="w-1 h-2 rounded bg-emerald-400" />
                      <div className="w-1 h-3 rounded bg-emerald-400" />
                      <div className="w-1 h-4 rounded bg-emerald-400" />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Bottom Participant Info Bar */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 text-xs">
                      {/* Audio mic icon */}
                      {p.audio ? (
                        <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400">
                          <svg fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M7 4a3 3 0 016 0v4a3 3 0 11-6 0V4zm4 10.93A7.001 7.001 0 0017 8a1 1 0 10-2 0A5 5 0 015 8a1 1 0 00-2 0 7.001 7.001 0 006 6.93V17H6a1 1 0 100 2h8a1 1 0 100-2h-3v-2.07z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-400">
                          <svg fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M13.477 14.89A6 6 0 015.11 6.524l8.367 8.366zm1.414-1.414L6.525 5.11A6 6 0 0114.89 13.476zM3.707 2.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l14 14a1 1 0 001.414-1.414l-14-14z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <span className="font-medium text-slate-200">
                        {p.name} {isLocalUser ? '(You)' : ''}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Spotlight / Pin Button */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSpotlightId(p.id);
                        setActiveLayout('spotlight');
                      }}
                      className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1.5 bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-md text-slate-300 transition-opacity"
                      title="Spotlight Participant"
                    >
                      <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 5a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z" />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* REAL-TIME LIVE CAPTIONS OVERLAY (Google Meet feature) */}
          {captionsEnabled && activeCaptions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 max-w-2xl w-full bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-2xl z-20">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-400 mb-1">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 animate-pulse" />
                <span>Live Transcription (English / Swahili / Malayalam)</span>
              </div>
              {activeCaptions.map((cap, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="text-sm text-slate-200 leading-relaxed">
                  <strong className="text-amber-400">{cap.speaker}: </strong>
                  <span>{cap.text}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ======================================================== */}
        {/* 3. SIDE PANELS: CHAT, PARTICIPANTS, ACADEMIC, WHITEBOARD */}
        {/* ======================================================== */}

        {/* SIDE PANEL: IN-MEETING CHAT (Zoom & Google Meet) */}
        {activeSidePanel === 'chat' && (
          <aside className="w-80 md:w-96 bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col z-30 shrink-0">
            <div className="h-14 px-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z" />
                </svg>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-100">In-Meeting Chat</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSidePanel('none')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Target selector: Everyone vs Host Private */}
            <div className="px-4 py-2 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-850 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Send to:</span>
              <select
                value={chatTarget}
                onChange={e => setChatTarget(e.target.value as any)}
                className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-slate-200 text-xs focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                <option value="everyone">Everyone in Meeting</option>
                <option value="private">Teacher (Host Only)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Messages Scroll Area */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3">
              {chatMessages.map(msg => (
                <div
                  key={msg.id}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl text-xs ${
                    msg.senderRole === 'SYSTEM'
                      ? 'bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/60 text-slate-300 text-center italic'
                      : msg.senderRole === currentUserRole
                        ? 'bg-indigo-600/30 border border-indigo-500/40 text-slate-100 ml-4'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-100 mr-4'
                  }`}
                >
                  {msg.senderRole !== 'SYSTEM' && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-1">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{msg.senderName}</span>
                      <span>{msg.timestamp}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <p className="leading-relaxed">{msg.message}</p>
                  {msg.isPrivate && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-semibold block mt-1">Direct Message</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Message Input Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleSendMessage} className="p-3 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-850 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Type a message to parents..."
                value={newChatMessage}
                onChange={e => setNewChatMessage(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!newChatMessage.trim()}
                className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-40 text-white transition-colors"
              >
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 19l9 2-9-18-9 18 9-2zm0 0v-8" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </form>
          </aside>
        )}

        {/* SIDE PANEL: PARTICIPANTS & WAITING ROOM (Zoom Lobby) */}
        {activeSidePanel === 'participants' && (
          <aside className="w-80 md:w-96 bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col z-30 shrink-0">
            <div className="h-14 px-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                </svg>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-100">Participants ({participants.length})</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSidePanel('none')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4">
              {/* Waiting Room Section */}
              {waitingRoomList.length > 0 && (
                <div className="bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-600/40 rounded-xl p-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">
                      Waiting Room ({waitingRoomList.length})
                    </span>
                    {currentUserRole === 'TEACHER' && (
                      <button
                        onClick={admitAllWaiting}
                        className="text-xs text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-200 underline font-semibold"
                      >
                        Admit All
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {waitingRoomList.map(w => (
                    <div key={w.id} className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-t border-amber-900/40 text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-medium text-slate-200">{w.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-400/80">{w.time}</div>
                      </div>
                      {currentUserRole === 'TEACHER' && (
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => admitWaitingParticipant(w.id)}
                            className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-medium text-xs"
                          >
                            Admit
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setWaitingRoomList(prev => prev.filter(x => x.id !== w.id))}
                            className="px-1.5 py-1 rounded bg-red-800/60 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs"
                          >
                            Remove
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* In-Meeting Participants list */}
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 mb-2 uppercase tracking-wider">In Meeting</h4>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {participants.map(p => (
                    <div key={p.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/60">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                        <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full ${p.avatarBg} flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-white`}>
                          {p.name.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200">
                            {p.name} {p.isLocal ? '(You)' : ''}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{p.role}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Participant status icons */}
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-slate-400">
                        {p.audio ? (
                          <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M7 4a3 3 0 016 0v4a3 3 0 11-6 0V4zm4 10.93A7.001 7.001 0 0017 8a1 1 0 10-2 0A5 5 0 015 8a1 1 0 00-2 0 7.001 7.001 0 006 6.93V17H6a1 1 0 100 2h8a1 1 0 100-2h-3v-2.07z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                          </svg>
                        ) : (
                          <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M13.477 14.89A6 6 0 015.11 6.524l8.367 8.366zm1.414-1.414L6.525 5.11A6 6 0 0114.89 13.476zM3.707 2.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l14 14a1 1 0 001.414-1.414l-14-14z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                          </svg>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Host Bulk Actions */}
            {currentUserRole === 'TEACHER' && (
              <div className="p-3 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-850 flex items-center justify-between">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setParticipants(prev => prev.map(p => ({ ...p, audio: false })));
                    showToast('All participants muted');
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-medium text-slate-200 border border-slate-700"
                >
                  Mute All
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => showToast('Security lock enabled - no new entries')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-xs font-medium text-slate-200 border border-slate-700"
                >
                  Lock Meeting
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </aside>
        )}

        {/* SIDE PANEL: INTEGRATED PTM ACADEMIC SNAPSHOT & MINUTES */}
        {activeSidePanel === 'academic' && (
          <aside className="w-80 md:w-[420px] bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col z-30 shrink-0">
            <div className="h-14 px-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253" />
                </svg>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-100">PTM Student Academic Record</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSidePanel('none')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
              {/* Student Header Card */}
              <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-100">{slot.studentName || 'Student'}</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-400">{slot.grade} • {slot.admissionNumber || 'ADM-2024-0089'}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 font-bold text-sm">
                      {slot.academicSnapshot?.averageGrade || 84.5}%
                    </span>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Term 3 Average</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-700">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">Attendance:</span>
                    <strong className="text-slate-200 ml-1">{slot.academicSnapshot?.attendanceRate || 96.8}%</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">Class Rank:</span>
                    <strong className="text-slate-200 ml-1">{slot.academicSnapshot?.termExamRank || '5th / 42'}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">Strong Subject:</span>
                    <strong className="text-emerald-400 ml-1">{slot.academicSnapshot?.topSubject || 'Science'}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">Focus Area:</span>
                    <strong className="text-amber-400 ml-1">{slot.academicSnapshot?.needsImprovement || 'Math'}</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* CBC Core Competency Rating */}
              <div className="bg-slate-800/50 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                <h5 className="font-semibold text-slate-300 mb-2">CBC Competencies Assessment</h5>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div className="bg-slate-850 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-750">
                    <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">Communication</div>
                    <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs">Exceeding</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-slate-850 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-750">
                    <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">Critical Thinking</div>
                    <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs">Exceeding</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-slate-850 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-750">
                    <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">Collaboration</div>
                    <div className="text-indigo-400 font-bold text-xs">Meeting</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-slate-850 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-750">
                    <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">Digital Literacy</div>
                    <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs">Exceeding</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Parent Pre-Meeting Note */}
              {slot.parentNotes && (
                <div className="bg-indigo-950/40 p-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-800/40 text-indigo-200">
                  <div className="font-semibold text-indigo-300 text-xs mb-1">Parent Discussion Topic:</div>
                  <p className="italic">{slot.parentNotes}</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* LIVE MEETING MINUTES & ACTIONS NOTEPAD */}
              <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 space-y-3">
                <h5 className="font-bold text-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>Teacher Meeting Minutes</span>
                  {minutesSavedSuccess && (
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 text-[11px] font-medium">✓ Saved</span>
                  )}
                </h5>

                <textarea
                  value={meetingMinutes}
                  onChange={e => setMeetingMinutes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Record key agreements, discussion points, and teacher observations during the PTM..."
                  rows={4}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-xs text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                />

                {/* Agreed Action Items */}
                <div>
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-300 block mb-1">Agreed Joint Action Items:</label>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 mb-2">
                    {actionItems.map((item, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-900 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-750 text-xs">
                        <span className="text-slate-200">• {item}</span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveActionItem(idx)}
                          className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 text-xs ml-2"
                        >
                          ✕
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Add new action item..."
                      value={newActionItem}
                      onChange={e => setNewActionItem(e.target.value)}
                      onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAddActionItem()}
                      className="flex-1 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-500"
                    />
                    <button
                      onClick={handleAddActionItem}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-medium text-xs"
                    >
                      + Add
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Save and Dispatch actions */}
                <div className="pt-2 flex flex-col space-y-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSaveMinutes}
                    disabled={isSavingMinutes}
                    className="w-full py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
                  >
                    <span>Save Minutes to ERP</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSendMinutesWhatsApp}
                    className="w-full py-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
                  >
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path d="M12.031 6.172c-3.181 0-5.767 2.586-5.768 5.766-.001 1.298.38 2.27 1.019 3.287l-.582 2.128 2.182-.573c.978.58 1.911.928 3.145.929 3.178 0 5.767-2.587 5.768-5.766 0-3.187-2.59-5.771-5.764-5.771zm3.392 8.244c-.144.405-.837.774-1.17.824-.299.045-.677.063-1.092-.069-.252-.08-.575-.187-.988-.365-1.739-.751-2.874-2.502-2.961-2.617-.087-.116-.708-.94-.708-1.793s.448-1.273.607-1.446c.159-.173.346-.217.462-.217l.332.006c.106.005.249-.04.39.299.144.347.491 1.2.534 1.287.043.087.072.188.014.304-.058.116-.087.188-.173.289l-.26.304c-.087.086-.177.18-.076.353.101.173.448.74 0.963 1.2.662.591 1.221.774 1.394.86.173.086.275.072.376-.044.101-.116.433-.505.549-.679.116-.173.231-.144.39-.087s1.011.477 1.184.564.289.13.332.202c.043.073.043.419-.101.824z" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>Send Summary to Parent via WhatsApp</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </aside>
        )}

        {/* SIDE PANEL / MODAL: INTERACTIVE WHITEBOARD (Zoom Whiteboard / Jamboard) */}
        {activeSidePanel === 'whiteboard' && (
          <aside className="w-80 md:w-[500px] bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col z-30 shrink-0">
            <div className="h-14 px-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15.232 5.232l3.536 3.536m-2.036-5.036a2.5 2.5 0 113.536 3.536L6.5 21.036H3v-3.572L16.732 3.732z" />
                </svg>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-100">Collaborative Whiteboard</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSidePanel('none')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Whiteboard Toolbar */}
            <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-850 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              {/* Tool selector */}
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setBrushTool('pen')}
                  className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs ${brushTool === 'pen' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                  title="Pen"
                >
                  ✏️
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setBrushTool('highlighter')}
                  className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs ${brushTool === 'highlighter' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                  title="Highlighter"
                >
                  🖍️
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setBrushTool('eraser')}
                  className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs ${brushTool === 'eraser' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                  title="Eraser"
                >
                  🧹
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Color pickers */}
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                {['#ffffff', '#4f46e5', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444'].map(color => (
                  <button
                    key={color}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setBrushColor(color);
                      setBrushTool('pen');
                    }}
                    style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
                    className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border ${brushColor === color ? 'ring-2 ring-indigo-400 scale-110' : 'border-slate-600'}`}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Clear button */}
              <button
                onClick={clearCanvas}
                className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Interactive Canvas Area */}
            <div className="flex-1 bg-white relative overflow-hidden cursor-crosshair">
              <canvas
                ref={canvasRef}
                width={500}
                height={600}
                onMouseDown={startDrawing}
                onMouseMove={draw}
                onMouseUp={stopDrawing}
                onMouseLeave={stopDrawing}
                className="w-full h-full"
              />
            </div>
          </aside>
        )}

        {/* SIDE PANEL: HOST SECURITY & MEETING PERMISSIONS (Zoom Security) */}
        {activeSidePanel === 'security' && (
          <aside className="w-80 md:w-96 bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col z-30 shrink-0">
            <div className="h-14 px-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z" />
                </svg>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-100">Security & Controls</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSidePanel('none')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-slate-200 mb-2">Meeting Locks</h4>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">Lock Meeting (Prevent New Joins)</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" className="rounded bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-0" />
                  </label>
                  <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">Enable Waiting Room (Lobby)</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" defaultChecked className="rounded bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-0" />
                  </label>
                  <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">Hide Profile Pictures</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" className="rounded bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-0" />
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-slate-200 mb-2">Allow Participants To:</h4>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">Share Screen</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" defaultChecked className="rounded bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-0" />
                  </label>
                  <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">Chat with Everyone</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" defaultChecked className="rounded bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-0" />
                  </label>
                  <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">Unmute Themselves</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" defaultChecked className="rounded bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-0" />
                  </label>
                  <label className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">Start Video</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" defaultChecked className="rounded bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 focus:ring-0" />
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Virtual Background Options */}
              <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-slate-200 mb-2">Virtual Background Filter</h4>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { setVirtualBg('none'); showToast('Background set to Standard'); }}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-center ${virtualBg === 'none' ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-600/30' : 'border-slate-700 bg-slate-900'}`}
                  >
                    None
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { setVirtualBg('blur'); showToast('Background Blur enabled'); }}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-center ${virtualBg === 'blur' ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-600/30' : 'border-slate-700 bg-slate-900'}`}
                  >
                    Blur Background
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { setVirtualBg('classroom'); showToast('Classroom background filter applied'); }}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-center ${virtualBg === 'classroom' ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-600/30' : 'border-slate-700 bg-slate-900'}`}
                  >
                    Classroom
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { setVirtualBg('library'); showToast('Library background filter applied'); }}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-center ${virtualBg === 'library' ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-600/30' : 'border-slate-700 bg-slate-900'}`}
                  >
                    Academy Library
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </aside>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* 4. BOTTOM FLOATING CONTROLS TOOLBAR (Zoom & Meet style) */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      <footer className="h-20 bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between px-6 z-40 shrink-0">
        {/* Left: Meeting info & Time */}
        <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs text-slate-300">
          <span className="font-semibold">{slot.title.split('-')[0]}</span>
          <span className="text-slate-600">•</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-slate-400">{slot.meetingCode}</span>
        </div>

        {/* Center: Primary Media & Interactive Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 md:space-x-3 mx-auto">
          {/* MUTE / UNMUTE BUTTON */}
          <button
            onClick={toggleAudio}
            className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl transition-all shadow-lg ${
              isAudioMuted
                ? 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white'
                : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-750 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700'
            }`}
            title={isAudioMuted ? 'Unmute Microphone' : 'Mute Microphone'}
          >
            {isAudioMuted ? (
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5.586 15H4a1 1 0 01-1-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h1.586l4.707-4.707C10.923 3.663 12 4.109 12 5v14c0 .891-1.077 1.337-1.707.707L5.586 15z" />
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M17 14l2-2m0 0l2-2m-2 2l-2-2m2 2l2 2" />
              </svg>
            ) : (
              <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 11a7 7 0 01-7 7m0 0a7 7 0 01-7-7m7 7v4m0 0H8m4 0h4m-4-8a3 3 0 01-3-3V5a3 3 0 116 0v6a3 3 0 01-3 3z" />
              </svg>
            )}
            <span className="text-[10px] mt-0.5">{isAudioMuted ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute'}</span>
          </button>

          {/* START / STOP VIDEO BUTTON */}
          <button
            onClick={toggleVideo}
            className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl transition-all shadow-lg ${
              isVideoOff
                ? 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white'
                : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-750 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700'
            }`}
            title={isVideoOff ? 'Start Camera' : 'Stop Camera'}
          >
            {isVideoOff ? (
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6" />
              </svg>
            ) : (
              <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
              </svg>
            )}
            <span className="text-[10px] mt-0.5">{isVideoOff ? 'Start Video' : 'Stop Video'}</span>
          </button>

          {/* SHARE SCREEN BUTTON */}
          <button
            onClick={toggleScreenShare}
            className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl transition-all shadow-lg ${
              isScreenSharing
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white'
                : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-750 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700'
            }`}
            title="Share Screen"

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { usePWA } from '@/hooks/usePWA';
import { Button, Card } from '@/components/ui';

export function PWAInstallPrompt() {
  const { canInstall, showInstallPrompt, isInstalled } = usePWA();
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false);
  const [showPrompt, setShowPrompt] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if user has previously dismissed
    const wasDismissed = localStorage.getItem('pwa-install-dismissed');
    if (wasDismissed) {
      setDismissed(true);
    }

    // Show prompt after 5 seconds if can install
    if (canInstall && !isInstalled && !wasDismissed) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setShowPrompt(true);
      }, 5000);

      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [canInstall, isInstalled]);

  const handleInstall = async () => {
    await showInstallPrompt();
    setShowPrompt(false);
  };

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    setShowPrompt(false);
    setDismissed(true);
    localStorage.setItem('pwa-install-dismissed', 'true');
  };

  if (!showPrompt || dismissed || isInstalled || !canInstall) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-6 left-4 right-4 md:left-auto md:right-6 md:w-96 z-50 animate-slide-in-right">
      <Card className="shadow-2xl border-2 border-primary-200">
        <div className="p-5">
          <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
            <div className="flex-shrink-0 w-12 h-12 bg-primary-600 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
              <svg
                className="w-7 h-7 text-white"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M12 18h.01M8 21h8a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H8a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2z"
                />
              </svg>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-1">
                Install App
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">
                Install Krypton Parent Portal for quick access and offline support
              </p>

              <div className="flex space-x-2">
                <Button size="sm" onClick={handleInstall} fullWidth>
                  Install
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={handleDismiss} fullWidth>
                  Maybe Later
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleDismiss}
              className="flex-shrink-0 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 tap-area"
            >
              <svg
                className="w-5 h-5"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from './ui';
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';
import { getRows, messageFor } from '@/lib/workspace';
export interface Field {key:string;label:string;type?:string;required?:boolean;options?:string[];source?:string;min?:number;max?:number}
export function RecordModal({title,endpoint,fields,initial,onClose,onSaved}:{title:string;endpoint:string;fields:Field[];initial?:Record<string,any>;onClose:()=>void;onSaved:()=>void}){
 const [values,setValues]=useState<Record<string,string>>(()=>Object.fromEntries(fields.map(f=>[f.key,f.type==='date'&&initial?.[f.key]?String(initial[f.key]).slice(0,10):String(initial?.[f.key]??'')])));
 const [options,setOptions]=useState<Record<string,any[]>>({});const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false);const [error,setError]=useState('');const dialog=useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 useEffect(()=>{
  const previous=document.activeElement as HTMLElement|null;
  const element=dialog.current; element?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input,select,textarea,button')?.focus();
  const key=(e:KeyboardEvent)=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&!busy)onClose();if(e.key==='Tab'){const focusable=element?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled),input,select,textarea');if(!focusable?.length)return;const first=focusable[0],last=focusable[focusable.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}}};
  document.addEventListener('keydown',key);const previousOverflow=document.body.style.overflow;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  return()=>{document.removeEventListener('keydown',key);document.body.style.overflow=previousOverflow;previous?.focus();};
 },[onClose,busy]);
 useEffect(()=>{let active=true;Promise.all(fields.filter(f=>f.source).map(async f=>[f.key,await getRows(f.source!)] as const)).then(rows=>{if(active)setOptions(Object.fromEntries(rows));}).catch(err=>{if(active)setError(messageFor(err));});return()=>{active=false;};},[fields]);
 async function submit(e:FormEvent){e.preventDefault();setBusy(true);setError('');const data:Record<string,unknown>={};fields.forEach(f=>{if(values[f.key]!=='')data[f.key]=f.type==='number'?Number(values[f.key]):values[f.key];});try{if(initial)await apiClient.patch(endpoint+'/'+initial.id,{data});else await apiClient.post(endpoint,{data});onSaved();}catch(err){setError(messageFor(err));}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 return <div className="modal-backdrop" onMouseDown={e=>{if(e.target===e.currentTarget&&!busy)onClose();}}><div ref={dialog} className="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="record-title"><div className="modal-header"><h2 id="record-title">{title}</h2><button disabled={busy} onClick={onClose} className="icon-button" aria-label="Close dialog"><X size={20}/></button></div><form onSubmit={submit}>{error&&<div role="alert" className="state-box">{error}</div>}<div className="form-grid">{fields.map(f=><div className="field" key={f.key}><label htmlFor={'field-'+f.key}>{f.label}{f.required?' *':''}</label>{f.options||f.source?<select id={'field-'+f.key} required={f.required&&!(initial&&f.type==='password')} value={values[f.key]} onChange={e=>setValues({...values,[f.key]:e.target.value})}><option value="">Select {f.label.toLowerCase()}</option>{f.options?.map(o=><option key={o} value={o}>{o.replaceAll('_',' ')}</option>)}{options[f.key]?.map(o=><option key={o.id} value={o.id}>{o.name||o.title||o.invoiceNumber||[o.firstName,o.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}</option>)}</select>:f.type==='textarea'?<textarea id={'field-'+f.key} required={f.required} value={values[f.key]} onChange={e=>setValues({...values,[f.key]:e.target.value})}/>:<input id={'field-'+f.key} type={f.type||'text'} required={f.required&&!(initial&&f.type==='password')} min={f.min} max={f.max} maxLength={f.type==='password'?128:undefined} value={values[f.key]} onChange={e=>setValues({...values,[f.key]:e.target.value})}/>}</div>)}</div><div className="modal-actions"><Button variant="ghost" type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button type="submit" isLoading={busy}>{initial?'Save changes':'Create record'}</Button></div></form></div></div>;
}

'use client';
import {useState,useEffect,useCallback} from 'react';
import {Save,CheckCheck,ClipboardCheck,BookOpen} from 'lucide-react';
import {apiClient} from '@/lib/api-client';
import {getRows,messageFor} from '@/lib/workspace';
import {PageHeading,EmptyState} from './WorkspaceUI';
import {Button} from './ui';
export function RegisterPage({grades=false}:{grades?:boolean}){
 const [classes,setClasses]=useState<any[]>([]);const [exams,setExams]=useState<any[]>([]);const [classId,setClass]=useState('');const [examId,setExam]=useState('');const [subjectId,setSubject]=useState('');const [date,setDate]=useState(()=>new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Africa/Nairobi',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date()));
 const [rows,setRows]=useState<any[]>([]);const [maximum,setMaximum]=useState(100);const [locked,setLocked]=useState(false);const [loading,setLoading]=useState(false);const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false);const [dirty,setDirty]=useState(false);const [error,setError]=useState('');const [notice,setNotice]=useState('');

 useEffect(()=>{const handler=(e:BeforeUnloadEvent)=>{if(dirty){e.preventDefault();e.returnValue='';}};window.addEventListener('beforeunload',handler);return()=>window.removeEventListener('beforeunload',handler);},[dirty]);
 useEffect(()=>{if(!dirty)return;const handler=(e:MouseEvent)=>{const target=(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('a');if(target?.href&&!window.confirm('Leave this page and discard unsaved changes?'))e.preventDefault();};document.addEventListener('click',handler,true);return()=>document.removeEventListener('click',handler,true);},[dirty]);
 const load=useCallback(async()=>{if(grades?(!examId||!subjectId):!classId)return;setLoading(true);setError('');try{const {data}=await apiClient.get(grades?'/workspace/gradebook':'/workspace/register',{params:grades?{examinationId:examId,subjectId}:{classId,date}});setRows(grades?data.rows:data);if(grades){setMaximum(data.totalMarks);setLocked(data.isPublished);}setDirty(false);}catch(err){setRows([]);setError(messageFor(err));}finally{setLoading(false);}},[grades,examId,subjectId,classId,date]);
 useEffect(()=>{void load();},[load]);
 const change=(fn:()=>void)=>{if(dirty&&!window.confirm('Discard unsaved changes and change selection?'))return;fn();setNotice('');setDirty(false);};
 async function save(){setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');const key=grades?'score':'status';const filled=rows.filter(r=>r[key]!==''&&r[key]!==undefined);if(!filled.length){setError('Enter at least one record before saving.');setBusy(false);return;}
 try{await apiClient.post(grades?'/workspace/gradebook':'/workspace/register',grades?{examinationId:examId,subjectId,records:filled.map(r=>({studentId:r.id,score:Number(r.score)}))}:{classId,date,records:filled.map(r=>({studentId:r.id,status:r.status}))});setDirty(false);setNotice(filled.length+' records saved successfully.');await load();}catch(err){setError(messageFor(err));}finally{setBusy(false);}}
 const selectedExam=exams.find(e=>e.id===examId);
 return <><PageHeading title={grades?'Gradebook':'Attendance register'} description={grades?'Capture learning progress with clear, accurate marks.':'A thoughtful start to every school day.'} actions={<>{!grades&&<Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={!rows.length||busy||loading} leftIcon={<CheckCheck size={16}/>} onClick={()=>{setRows(rows.map(r=>({...r,status:'PRESENT'})));setDirty(true);}}>Mark all present</Button>}<Button size="sm" leftIcon={<Save size={16}/>} isLoading={busy} disabled={!dirty||locked||loading} onClick={()=>void save()}>Save {grades?'marks':'register'}</Button></>}/>

Its marks are locked.</div>}

}
