// Generate Excel-compatible XML Spreadsheet (native .xlsx-readable XML)
export function generatePortalExcelXml(templateId: ExportTemplateType, templateTitle: string): string {
  const csvContent = generatePortalCsv(templateId);
  const lines = csvContent.split('\r\n').filter(Boolean);
  if (lines.length === 0) return '';

  const parseCsvLine = (line: string): string[] => {
    const result: string[] = [];
    let insideQuotes = false;
    let current = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const char = line[i];
      if (char === '"') {
        insideQuotes = !insideQuotes;
      } else if (char === ',' && !insideQuotes) {
        result.push(current.trim());
        current = '';
      } else {
        current += char;
      }
    }
    result.push(current.trim());
    return result;
  };

  const headerCells = parseCsvLine(lines[0]);
  const dataRows = lines.slice(1).map(parseCsvLine);

  let xml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?mso-application progid="Excel.Sheet"?>
<Workbook xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet"
 xmlns:o="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office"
 xmlns:x="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:excel"
 xmlns:ss="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet"
 xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-html40">
 <DocumentProperties xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office">
  <Title>${templateTitle}</Title>
  <Author>Krypton School ERP - Govt Compliance Engine</Author>
  <Created>${new Date().toISOString()}</Created>
 </DocumentProperties>
 <Styles>
  <Style ss:ID="Header">
   <Font ss:Bold="1" ss:Color="#FFFFFF" ss:FontName="Calibri" ss:Size="11"/>
   <Interior ss:Color="#4338CA" ss:Pattern="Solid"/>
   <Alignment ss:Horizontal="Center" ss:Vertical="Center"/>
   <Borders>
    <Border ss:Position="Bottom" ss:LineStyle="Continuous" ss:Weight="1" ss:Color="#1E1B4B"/>
   </Borders>
  </Style>
  <Style ss:ID="Data">
   <Font ss:FontName="Calibri" ss:Size="10"/>
   <Alignment ss:Vertical="Center"/>
   <Borders>
    <Border ss:Position="Bottom" ss:LineStyle="Continuous" ss:Weight="1" ss:Color="#E2E8F0"/>
   </Borders>
  </Style>
  <Style ss:ID="DataAlt">
   <Font ss:FontName="Calibri" ss:Size="10"/>
   <Interior ss:Color="#F8FAFC" ss:Pattern="Solid"/>
   <Alignment ss:Vertical="Center"/>
   <Borders>
    <Border ss:Position="Bottom" ss:LineStyle="Continuous" ss:Weight="1" ss:Color="#E2E8F0"/>
   </Borders>
  </Style>
 </Styles>
 <Worksheet ss:Name="Board_Export_Data">
  <Table>
`;

  // Write header row
  xml += '   <Row ss:Height="26">\n';
  for (const h of headerCells) {
    xml += `    <Cell ss:StyleID="Header"><Data ss:Type="String">${escapeXml(h)}</Data></Cell>\n`;
  }
  xml += '   </Row>\n';

  // Write data rows
  dataRows.forEach((row, rIdx) => {
    const styleId = rIdx % 2 === 0 ? 'Data' : 'DataAlt';
    xml += '   <Row ss:Height="20">\n';
    for (const val of row) {
      const isNum = !isNaN(Number(val)) && val.trim() !== '';
      const type = isNum ? 'Number' : 'String';
      xml += `    <Cell ss:StyleID="${styleId}"><Data ss:Type="${type}">${escapeXml(val)}</Data></Cell>\n`;
    }
    xml += '   </Row>\n';
  });

  xml += `  </Table>
 </Worksheet>
</Workbook>`;

  return xml;
}

function escapeXml(str: string): string {
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&apos;');
}

// Download Trigger Helper
export function triggerBrowserDownload(content: string, filename: string, mimeType: string) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

// Client Class for Govt Compliance & Tamper-Proof Audit
export class GovtComplianceEngineClient {
  private auditChain: TamperProofAuditRecord[] = [...INITIAL_AUDIT_BLOCKS];

  // Retrieve current stats
  getStats(): GovtComplianceStats {
    const pendingErrors = Object.values(SAMPLE_VALIDATION_ISSUES).reduce(
      (acc, issues) => acc + issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'ERROR').length,
      0,
    );
    const pendingWarnings = Object.values(SAMPLE_VALIDATION_ISSUES).reduce(
      (acc, issues) => acc + issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'WARNING').length,
      0,
    );

    return {
      totalStudentsEnrolled: 840,
      boardRegisteredCount: 248,
      complianceRate: 98.6,
      totalAuditRecords: this.auditChain.length,
      auditChainIntegrity: this.verifyChainIntegrity().isValid ? 'SECURE' : 'COMPROMISED',
      lastIntegrityCheck: new Date().toISOString(),
      pendingValidationErrors: pendingErrors,
      pendingValidationWarnings: pendingWarnings,
    };
  }

  // Get templates
  getTemplates(): BoardExportTemplate[] {
    return BOARD_EXPORT_TEMPLATES;
  }

  // Get validation issues for a template
  getValidationIssues(templateId: ExportTemplateType): ComplianceValidationIssue[] {
    return SAMPLE_VALIDATION_ISSUES[templateId] || [];
  }

  // 1-Click Export Execution
  exportPortalData(templateId: ExportTemplateType, format: 'xlsx' | 'csv'): { filename: string; recordCount: number } {
    const template = BOARD_EXPORT_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.id === templateId);
    const title = template?.title || templateId;
    const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    if (format === 'csv') {
      const csv = generatePortalCsv(templateId);
      const filename = `${templateId}_Export_${dateStr}.csv`;
      triggerBrowserDownload('\uFEFF' + csv, filename, 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;');
      return { filename, recordCount: template?.recordCount || 248 };
    } else {
      const xml = generatePortalExcelXml(templateId, title);
      const filename = `${templateId}_Export_${dateStr}.xlsx`;
      triggerBrowserDownload(xml, filename, 'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8;');
      return { filename, recordCount: template?.recordCount || 248 };
    }
  }

  // Get Audit Trail Chain
  getAuditRecords(): TamperProofAuditRecord[] {
    return [...this.auditChain].sort((a, b) => b.sequence - a.sequence);
  }

  // Cryptographic Chain Integrity Verification
  verifyChainIntegrity(): AuditChainVerificationResult {
    const records = [...this.auditChain].sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence);
    let expectedPrevHash = GENESIS_PREV_HASH;

    for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
      const record = records[i];

      // Check previous hash pointer
      if (record.previousHash !== expectedPrevHash) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          totalBlocksVerified: i,
          genesisHash: records[0].currentHash,
          latestHash: records[records.length - 1].currentHash,
          brokenBlockSequence: record.sequence,
          brokenBlockId: record.id,
          tamperDetails: `Broken Hash Link at Block #${record.sequence} (${record.id}): Stored previousHash ${record.previousHash.substring(0, 10)}... does not match predecessor hash ${expectedPrevHash.substring(0, 10)}...!`,
          verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
      }

      // Check current hash recalculation
      const calculatedCurrentHash = computeAuditRecordHash(
        record.sequence,
        record.timestamp,
        record.tenantId,
        record.performedBy.userId,
        record.entityType,
        record.entityId,
        record.action,
        record.changes,
        record.reason,
        record.previousHash,
      );

      if (calculatedCurrentHash !== record.currentHash) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          totalBlocksVerified: i,
          genesisHash: records[0].currentHash,
          latestHash: records[records.length - 1].currentHash,
          brokenBlockSequence: record.sequence,
          brokenBlockId: record.id,
          tamperDetails: `Hash Tampering Detected at Block #${record.sequence} (${record.id}): Content has been manipulated! Expected hash ${calculatedCurrentHash.substring(0, 12)}... but found ${record.currentHash.substring(0, 12)}...!`,
          verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
      }

      expectedPrevHash = record.currentHash;
    }

    return {
      isValid: true,
      totalBlocksVerified: records.length,
      genesisHash: records[0].currentHash,
      latestHash: records[records.length - 1].currentHash,
      verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  // Append a controlled override to the blockchain audit log
  appendAuditRecord(params: {
    entityType: AuditEntityType;
    entityId: string;
    entityName: string;
    action: AuditAction;
    performedBy: {
      userId: string;
      fullName: string;
      role: string;
      email: string;
      ipAddress: string;
      userAgent: string;
    };
    reason: string;
    approvalRef?: string;
    changes: AuditFieldDiff[];
  }): TamperProofAuditRecord {
    const lastRecord = this.auditChain[this.auditChain.length - 1];
    const newSequence = lastRecord ? lastRecord.sequence + 1 : 0;
    const prevHash = lastRecord ? lastRecord.currentHash : GENESIS_PREV_HASH;
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const id = `AUD-2026-${String(newSequence + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`;

    const currentHash = computeAuditRecordHash(
      newSequence,
      timestamp,
      'tenant-krypton-01',
      params.performedBy.userId,
      params.entityType,
      params.entityId,
      params.action,
      params.changes,
      params.reason,
      prevHash,
    );

    const newRecord: TamperProofAuditRecord = {
      id,
      sequence: newSequence,
      timestamp,
      tenantId: 'tenant-krypton-01',
      entityType: params.entityType,
      entityId: params.entityId,
      entityName: params.entityName,
      action: params.action,
      performedBy: params.performedBy,
      reason: params.reason,
      approvalRef: params.approvalRef,
      changes: params.changes,
      previousHash: prevHash,
      currentHash,
      signature: 'SIG_SHA256_' + currentHash.substring(0, 16).toUpperCase(),
    };

    this.auditChain.push(newRecord);
    return newRecord;
  }

  // Simulate unauthorized tampering for demonstration purposes
  simulateTampering(blockSequence: number = 1): { tamperedBlockId: string; originalHash: string } {
    const targetBlock = this.auditChain.find((b) => b.sequence === blockSequence);
    if (!targetBlock) throw new Error('Target block not found');

    const originalHash = targetBlock.currentHash;

    // Unauthorized modification of data without cryptographic signature
    if (targetBlock.changes.length > 0) {
      targetBlock.changes[0].newValue = '99.9 (Tampered Directly in DB)';
    }
    targetBlock.reason = 'Unauthorized alteration injected for demonstration test!';
    targetBlock.isTampered = true;

    return {
      tamperedBlockId: targetBlock.id,
      originalHash,
    };
  }

  // Restore chain to pristine state
  restoreChain() {
    this.auditChain = [...INITIAL_AUDIT_BLOCKS];
  }
}

export const complianceClient = new GovtComplianceEngineClient();

function buildMockCopilotResponse(query: string, language: TeachingLanguage): ERPCopilotQueryResponse {
  const parsedFilters: ERPCopilotFilterBadge[] = [];
  const q = query.toLowerCase();

  if (q.includes('grade 9') || q.includes('class 9') || q.includes('9')) {
    parsedFilters.push({ label: 'Class Filter', value: 'GRADE 9', badgeType: 'class' });
  }
  if (q.includes('80') || q.includes('attendance')) {
    parsedFilters.push({ label: 'Attendance', value: '< 80%', badgeType: 'attendance' });
  }
  if (q.includes('unpaid') || q.includes('fee') || q.includes('balance') || q.includes('arrears')) {
    parsedFilters.push({ label: 'Fee Status', value: 'Unpaid / Overdue Balance', badgeType: 'fee' });
  }
  if (q.includes('risk') || q.includes('dropout')) {
    parsedFilters.push({ label: 'Risk Priority', value: 'High & Moderate', badgeType: 'risk' });
  }

  return {
    originalQuery: query,
    interpretedIntent: 'Executive filter: Grade 9 students matching attendance deficit (< 80%) with unpaid fee arrears.',
    parsedFilters: parsedFilters.length ? parsedFilters : [
      { label: 'Filter', value: 'Filtered Query', badgeType: 'class' },
    ],
    matches: MOCK_DEMO_STUDENTS,
    totalCount: MOCK_DEMO_STUDENTS.length,
    currency: 'KES',
    summary: {
      totalOutstanding: 5570000,
      averageAttendance: 74.6,
      averageScore: 54.1,
      highRiskCount: 2,
    },
    suggestedActions: [
      'Send WhatsApp fee reminder & attendance advisory to parents',
      'Schedule Virtual PTM check-in for 2 high-risk students',
      'Export detailed list to CSV for school finance committee',
    ],
    naturalLanguageSummary: `Found ${MOCK_DEMO_STUDENTS.length} Grade 9 students who have attendance below 80% and outstanding fee balances totaling KES 55,700. 2 students are flagged with High Risk priority requiring proactive intervention.`,
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function runCopilotQuery(
  query: string,
  language: TeachingLanguage = 'English',
  signal?: AbortSignal
): Promise<ERPCopilotQueryResponse> {
  try {
    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ERPCopilotQueryResponse>(
      '/teacher-ai/copilot-query',
      { query, language },
      { timeout: 45000, signal }
    );
    return data;
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (signal?.aborted) throw err;
    // If backend is not available, provide fallback
    return buildMockCopilotResponse(query, language);
  }
}

const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  INVOICES: 'krypton_finance_invoices_v1',
  CONCESSION_RULES: 'krypton_finance_concessions_v1',
  STAFF_PROFILES: 'krypton_finance_staff_v1',
  PAYROLL_RUNS: 'krypton_finance_payroll_v1',
  PAYMENT_PLANS: 'krypton_finance_payment_plans_v1',
  DUNNING_NOTICES: 'krypton_finance_dunning_v1',
  PAYMENTS: 'krypton_finance_payments_v1',
};

class FinanceClientService {
  private isBrowser(): boolean {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined';
  }

  // ===================== INVOICE & GENERAL =====================
  getInvoices(): DemoInvoice[] {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return INITIAL_INVOICES;
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.INVOICES);
      if (stored) return JSON.parse(stored);
      this.saveInvoices(INITIAL_INVOICES);
      return INITIAL_INVOICES;
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_INVOICES;
    }
  }

  saveInvoices(invoices: DemoInvoice[]) {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.INVOICES, JSON.stringify(invoices));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to save invoices to storage', e);
    }
  }

  // ===================== MULTI-GATEWAY CHECKOUT =====================
  async processPayment(params: {
    invoiceId: string;
    amount: number;
    gateway: PaymentGatewayType;
    currency: CurrencyCode;
    payerDetails: {
      payerName: string;
      email?: string;
      phone?: string;
      cardNumberMasked?: string;
      upiId?: string;
      mpesaPhone?: string;
      paypalPayerId?: string;
    };
  }): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    transactionReference: string;
    receiptNumber: string;
    timestamp: string;
    invoice: DemoInvoice;
    paymentRecord: any;
  }> {
    const invoices = this.getInvoices();
    const invoiceIndex = invoices.findIndex((i) => i.id === params.invoiceId);
    if (invoiceIndex === -1) {
      throw new Error(`Invoice with ID ${params.invoiceId} not found`);
    }

    const invoice = invoices[invoiceIndex];
    const newPaidAmount = invoice.paidAmount + params.amount;
    const newBalance = Math.max(0, invoice.totalAmount - newPaidAmount);
    const newStatus = newBalance === 0 ? 'PAID' : 'PARTIALLY_PAID';

    const transactionReference = `TXN-${params.gateway}-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
    const receiptNumber = `RCP-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000)}`;
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

    invoice.paidAmount = newPaidAmount;
    invoice.balanceAmount = newBalance;
    invoice.status = newStatus;
    invoices[invoiceIndex] = invoice;
    this.saveInvoices(invoices);

    const paymentRecord = {
      id: `pay-${Date.now()}`,
      invoiceId: invoice.id,
      invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,
      studentName: invoice.studentName,
      amount: params.amount,
      currency: params.currency,
      gateway: params.gateway,
      reference: transactionReference,
      receiptNumber,
      payerDetails: params.payerDetails,
      timestamp,
      status: 'COMPLETED',
    };

    this.savePaymentRecord(paymentRecord);

    return {
      success: true,
      transactionReference,
      receiptNumber,
      timestamp,
      invoice,
      paymentRecord,
    };
  }

  getPaymentRecords(): any[] {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return [];
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PAYMENTS);
      return data ? JSON.parse(data) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private savePaymentRecord(record: any) {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return;
    try {
      const records = this.getPaymentRecords();
      records.unshift(record);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PAYMENTS, JSON.stringify(records));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  }

  // ===================== DUNNING & ESCALATION ENGINE =====================
  evaluateDunningSchedule(invoices?: DemoInvoice[]): DunningNotice[] {
    const list = invoices || this.getInvoices();
    const today = new Date('2026-10-11T00:00:00'); // Consistent reference date

    const notices: DunningNotice[] = [];

    for (const inv of list) {
      if (inv.status === 'PAID') continue;

      const due = new Date(inv.dueDate);
      const diffTime = due.getTime() - today.getTime();
      const diffDays = Math.round(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)); // >0: days remaining, <=0: overdue days

      let stage: DunningStage = 'SETTLED';
      let lateFee = 0;
      let channel: 'WHATSAPP' | 'SMS' | 'EMAIL' = 'WHATSAPP';
      let preview = '';
      let paymentPlanEligible = false;

      if (diffDays >= 1 && diffDays <= 7) {
        // T - 7: Soft Reminder
        stage = 'UPCOMING_SOFT';
        channel = 'WHATSAPP';
        preview = `Friendly reminder: School fee of ₹${inv.balanceAmount.toLocaleString()} for ${inv.studentName} is due in ${diffDays} days (${inv.dueDate}). Pay with 1-click via portal link.`;
      } else if (diffDays === 0) {
        // T - 0: Due Alert
        stage = 'DUE_ALERT';
        channel = 'WHATSAPP';
        preview = `URGENT: Today is the due date for ${inv.studentName}'s Term 2 fee (₹${inv.balanceAmount.toLocaleString()}). Please settle today to avoid late fees.`;
      } else if (diffDays < 0 && diffDays >= -14) {
        // T + 1 to T + 14: Overdue + Late Fee Escalation
        stage = 'OVERDUE_LATE_FEE';
        const overdueDays = Math.abs(diffDays);
        // Late fee calculation: 5% of tuition or ₹50/day flat rate
        lateFee = Math.round(Math.min(inv.tuitionFee * 0.05, overdueDays * 100));
        channel = 'SMS';
        preview = `OVERDUE NOTICE: Fee payment for ${inv.studentName} is ${overdueDays} days overdue. Late fee of ₹${lateFee} has been accrued. Balance payable: ₹${(inv.balanceAmount + lateFee).toLocaleString()}.`;
        paymentPlanEligible = true;
      } else if (diffDays < -14) {
        // 15+ days overdue: Severe escalation & Offer Flexible Payment Plan
        stage = 'PAYMENT_PLAN_OFFER';
        const overdueDays = Math.abs(diffDays);
        lateFee = Math.round(Math.min(inv.tuitionFee * 0.08, overdueDays * 100));
        channel = 'EMAIL';
        preview = `FEE RELIEF NOTICE: Overdue payment for ${inv.studentName} has reached ${overdueDays} days. Krypton School has unlocked an automatic 3-Month Interest-Free Installment Payment Plan to assist your family.`;
        paymentPlanEligible = true;
      } else {
        continue;
      }

      notices.push({
        id: `dun-${inv.id}`,
        invoiceId: inv.id,
        studentId: inv.studentId,
        studentName: inv.studentName,
        guardianName: inv.guardianName,
        guardianPhone: inv.guardianPhone,
        guardianEmail: inv.guardianEmail,
        stage,
        dueDate: inv.dueDate,
        daysRemainingOrOverdue: diffDays,
        originalAmount: inv.balanceAmount,
        lateFeeAmount: lateFee,
        totalPayable: inv.balanceAmount + lateFee,
        currency: 'INR',
        channel,
        messagePreview: preview,
        sentAt: undefined,
        paymentPlanEligible,
        paymentPlanOffered: inv.status === 'PAYMENT_PLAN',
      });
    }

    return notices;
  }

  // Create an automatic Payment Plan (Installment offer)
  createPaymentPlan(invoiceId: string, installmentsCount: 2 | 3 | 4 = 3): PaymentPlan {
    const invoices = this.getInvoices();
    const inv = invoices.find((i) => i.id === invoiceId);
    if (!inv) throw new Error('Invoice not found');

    const totalToSplit = inv.balanceAmount + (inv.lateFee || 0);
    const installmentAmount = Math.round(totalToSplit / installmentsCount);

    const installments: PaymentPlanInstallment[] = [];
    const baseDate = new Date('2026-10-15');

    for (let i = 1; i <= installmentsCount; i++) {
      const nextDue = new Date(baseDate);
      nextDue.setMonth(baseDate.getMonth() + (i - 1));
      installments.push({
        installmentNumber: i,
        dueDate: nextDue.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        amount: i === installmentsCount ? totalToSplit - installmentAmount * (installmentsCount - 1) : installmentAmount,
        status: i === 1 ? 'PENDING' : 'PENDING',
      });
    }

    const plan: PaymentPlan = {
      id: `plan-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      invoiceId: inv.id,
      studentId: inv.studentId,
      studentName: inv.studentName,
      totalAmount: totalToSplit,
      installmentsCount,
      installments,
      interestRatePercent: 0, // 0% relief
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    // Update invoice status to PAYMENT_PLAN
    inv.status = 'PAYMENT_PLAN';
    inv.paymentPlanId = plan.id;
    this.saveInvoices(invoices);

    // Save plan
    const plans = this.getPaymentPlans();
    plans.push(plan);
    if (this.isBrowser()) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PAYMENT_PLANS, JSON.stringify(plans));
    }

    return plan;
  }

  getPaymentPlans(): PaymentPlan[] {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return [];
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PAYMENT_PLANS);
      return data ? JSON.parse(data) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  // ===================== CONCESSION MATRIX =====================
  getConcessionRules(): ConcessionRule[] {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return INITIAL_CONCESSION_RULES;
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CONCESSION_RULES);
      if (data) return JSON.parse(data);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CONCESSION_RULES, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_CONCESSION_RULES));
      return INITIAL_CONCESSION_RULES;
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_CONCESSION_RULES;
    }
  }

  saveConcessionRules(rules: ConcessionRule[]) {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return;
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CONCESSION_RULES, JSON.stringify(rules));
  }

  // Evaluate Concession Matrix for all students
  evaluateConcessionsMatrix(): StudentConcessionMatch[] {
    const invoices = this.getInvoices();
    const rules = this.getConcessionRules();

    // Group by guardian phone to identify siblings
    const guardianMap: Record<string, DemoInvoice[]> = {};
    for (const inv of invoices) {
      const phone = inv.guardianPhone.trim();
      if (!guardianMap[phone]) guardianMap[phone] = [];
      guardianMap[phone].push(inv);
    }

    const results: StudentConcessionMatch[] = [];

    for (const inv of invoices) {
      const siblingsWithSameParent = guardianMap[inv.guardianPhone.trim()] || [];
      const siblingCount = siblingsWithSameParent.length;
      const siblingNames = siblingsWithSameParent.filter((s) => s.id !== inv.id).map((s) => s.studentName);

      // Check Staff child (guardianName includes "Staff" or matching Staff list)
      const isStaffChild = inv.guardianName.toLowerCase().includes('staff') || inv.guardianEmail.includes('@kryptonschool.edu');

      // Check Merit GPA (example: Rahul Krishnan has merit)
      const isMerit = inv.studentName.includes('Rahul Krishnan');
      const academicGpa = isMerit ? 95.4 : 84.0;

      const appliedConcessions: StudentConcessionMatch['appliedConcessions'] = [];
      let totalConcession = 0;

      // 1. Sibling Rule Check
      if (siblingCount >= 2 && siblingsWithSameParent[1]?.id === inv.id) {
        // Second child gets 15%
        const sibRule = rules.find((r) => r.id === 'rule-sibling-2' && r.isActive);
        if (sibRule) {
          const discount = Math.round((inv.tuitionFee * sibRule.discountPercentage) / 100);
          appliedConcessions.push({
            ruleId: sibRule.id,
            ruleName: sibRule.name,
            concessionType: 'SIBLING',
            discountAmount: discount,
            description: `15% discount for 2nd sibling (${siblingNames.join(', ')})`,
          });
          totalConcession += discount;
        }
      } else if (siblingCount >= 3 && siblingsWithSameParent[2]?.id === inv.id) {
        // Third child gets 25%
        const sibRule = rules.find((r) => r.id === 'rule-sibling-3' && r.isActive);
        if (sibRule) {
          const discount = Math.round((inv.tuitionFee * sibRule.discountPercentage) / 100);
          appliedConcessions.push({
            ruleId: sibRule.id,
            ruleName: sibRule.name,
            concessionType: 'SIBLING',
            discountAmount: discount,
            description: `25% discount for 3rd sibling (${siblingNames.join(', ')})`,
          });
          totalConcession += discount;
        }
      }

      // 2. Staff Dependent Concession
      if (isStaffChild) {
        const staffRule = rules.find((r) => r.id === 'rule-staff-child' && r.isActive);
        if (staffRule) {
          const discount = Math.round((inv.tuitionFee * staffRule.discountPercentage) / 100);
          appliedConcessions.push({
            ruleId: staffRule.id,
            ruleName: staffRule.name,
            concessionType: 'STAFF_CHILD',
            discountAmount: discount,
            description: `50% institutional waiver for staff child`,
          });
          totalConcession += discount;
        }
      }

      // 3. Merit Scholarship Check
      if (isMerit && academicGpa >= 90) {
        const meritRule = rules.find((r) => r.id === 'rule-merit-super' && r.isActive);
        if (meritRule) {
          const discount = Math.round((inv.tuitionFee * meritRule.discountPercentage) / 100);
          appliedConcessions.push({
            ruleId: meritRule.id,
            ruleName: meritRule.name,
            concessionType: 'MERIT',
            discountAmount: discount,
            description: `30% Merit Scholarship (Academic Score ${academicGpa}%)`,
          });
          totalConcession += discount;
        }
      }

      results.push({
        studentId: inv.studentId,
        studentName: inv.studentName,
        admissionNumber: inv.admissionNumber,
        grade: inv.grade,
        siblingCount,
        siblingNames,
        isStaffChild,
        staffParentName: isStaffChild ? 'Lakshmi Menon (PGT)' : undefined,
        academicGpaPercent: academicGpa,
        appliedConcessions,
        originalTuition: inv.tuitionFee,
        totalConcessionAmount: totalConcession,
        netTuitionPayable: Math.max(0, inv.tuitionFee - totalConcession),
      });
    }

    return results;
  }

  // ===================== STAFF HRMS & 1-CLICK PAYROLL =====================
  getStaffProfiles(): StaffPayrollProfile[] {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return INITIAL_STAFF_PROFILES;
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.STAFF_PROFILES);
      if (data) return JSON.parse(data);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.STAFF_PROFILES, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_STAFF_PROFILES));
      return INITIAL_STAFF_PROFILES;
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_STAFF_PROFILES;
    }
  }

  // Generate payslip for an individual staff member
  calculateStaffPayslip(
    profile: StaffPayrollProfile,
    month: string = 'October 2026',
    year: number = 2026,
    unpaidLeaves: number = 0,
    payrollRunId: string = 'RUN-OCT-2026'
  ): StaffPayslip {
    const totalWorkingDays = 26; // Mon-Sat excluding holidays
    const approvedPaidLeaves = 2;
    const daysPresent = Math.max(0, totalWorkingDays - (approvedPaidLeaves + unpaidLeaves));

    const { basicSalary, hra, travelAllowance, specialAllowance, providentFundRate, professionalTax, tdsRate } =
      profile.salaryComponents;

    const totalEarnings = basicSalary + hra + travelAllowance + specialAllowance;

    // Daily rate for unpaid leave deduction: gross / totalWorkingDays
    const dailyRate = Math.round(totalEarnings / totalWorkingDays);
    const leaveDeductionAmount = unpaidLeaves * dailyRate;

    // Standard Deductions
    const pfDeduction = Math.round((basicSalary * providentFundRate) / 100);
    const tdsDeduction = Math.round((totalEarnings * tdsRate) / 100);
    const totalDeductions = pfDeduction + tdsDeduction + professionalTax + leaveDeductionAmount;

    const netPayable = Math.max(0, totalEarnings - totalDeductions);

    const ref = `SAL-${year}-${profile.staffNumber}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
    const hash = `KRYP-SEC-${profile.id.toUpperCase()}-${Date.now().toString(16).toUpperCase()}`;

    return {
      id: `ps-${profile.id}-${year}-${month.replace(/\s+/g, '')}`,
      payrollRunId,
      staffId: profile.staffId,
      staffNumber: profile.staffNumber,
      staffName: profile.fullName,
      department: profile.department,
      position: profile.position,
      month,
      year,
      payPeriod: `01 ${month} - 31 ${month}`,
      paymentDate: '2026-10-31',
      bankDetails: {
        bankName: profile.bankAccount.bankName,
        accountNumberMasked: profile.bankAccount.accountNumber,
        ifscOrCode: profile.bankAccount.routingOrIfsc,
      },
      totalWorkingDays,
      daysPresent,
      approvedPaidLeaves,
      unpaidLeaves,
      leaveDeductionAmount,
      basicSalary,
      hra,
      travelAllowance,
      specialAllowance,
      totalEarnings,
      pfDeduction,
      tdsDeduction,
      professionalTax,
      unpaidLeaveDeduction: leaveDeductionAmount,
      totalDeductions,
      netPayable,
      currency: 'INR',
      paymentStatus: 'PROCESSED',
      paymentReference: ref,
      verificationHash: hash,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  // 1-Click Monthly Payroll Run Execution
  executeMonthlyPayrollRun(
    month: string = 'October 2026',
    year: number = 2026,
    leaveMap: Record<string, number> = { 'st-02': 1, 'st-05': 2 }
  ): MonthlyPayrollRun {
    const profiles = this.getStaffProfiles();
    const runId = `RUN-${month.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()}-${year}-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;

    const payslips: StaffPayslip[] = profiles.map((p) => {
      const unpaid = leaveMap[p.id] || 0;
      return this.calculateStaffPayslip(p, month, year, unpaid, runId);
    });

    const totalGrossPayout = payslips.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.totalEarnings, 0);
    const totalDeductions = payslips.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.totalDeductions, 0);
    const totalNetDisbursed = payslips.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.netPayable, 0);

    const run: MonthlyPayrollRun = {
      id: runId,
      month,
      year,
      totalStaffCount: profiles.length,
      totalGrossPayout,
      totalDeductions,
      totalNetDisbursed,
      currency: 'INR',
      runStatus: 'COMPLETED',
      processedBy: 'Manoj Kumar (Senior Finance Officer)',
      processedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      payslips,
    };

    const existingRuns = this.getPayrollRuns();
    const filtered = existingRuns.filter((r) => !(r.month === month && r.year === year));
    filtered.unshift(run);

    if (this.isBrowser()) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PAYROLL_RUNS, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    }

    return run;
  }

  getPayrollRuns(): MonthlyPayrollRun[] {
    if (!this.isBrowser()) return [];
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.PAYROLL_RUNS);
      if (data) return JSON.parse(data);
      // Generate default completed run for demo
      const defRun = this.executeMonthlyPayrollRun('October 2026', 2026);
      return [defRun];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  // Summary Metrics for executive dashboard
  getSummaryMetrics(): FinanceSummaryMetrics {
    const invoices = this.getInvoices();
    const staff = this.getStaffProfiles();
    const dunning = this.evaluateDunningSchedule(invoices);

    const totalInvoiced = invoices.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.totalAmount, 0);
    const totalCollected = invoices.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.paidAmount, 0);
    const outstandingBalance = invoices.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.balanceAmount, 0);
    const concessionsGranted = invoices.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + (curr.concessionApplied || 0), 0);
    const monthlyPayrollLiability = staff.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.monthlyGrossSalary, 0);

    const collectionRatePercent = totalInvoiced > 0 ? Math.round((totalCollected / totalInvoiced) * 100) : 0;

    return {
      totalInvoiced,
      totalCollected,
      outstandingBalance,
      collectionRatePercent,
      dunningNoticesPending: dunning.length,
      concessionsGrantedTotal: concessionsGranted,
      monthlyPayrollLiability,
      currency: 'INR',
    };
  }
}

export const financeClient = new FinanceClientService();

// Helper functions for LocalStorage persistence
const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  ASSIGNMENTS: 'krypton_lms_assignments_v1',
  SUBMISSIONS: 'krypton_lms_submissions_v1',
  QUIZZES: 'krypton_lms_quizzes_v1',
  ATTEMPTS: 'krypton_lms_attempts_v1',
};

function safeGet<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return fallback;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (!raw) {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(fallback));
      return fallback;
    }
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

function safeSet<T>(key: string, val: T): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(val));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Storage error:', e);
  }
}

export const LMSStore = {
  getAssignments(): Assignment[] {
    return safeGet<Assignment[]>(STORAGE_KEYS.ASSIGNMENTS, INITIAL_ASSIGNMENTS);
  },

  createAssignment(newAsg: Omit<Assignment, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'submissionCount' | 'gradedCount'>): Assignment {
    const list = this.getAssignments();
    const created: Assignment = {
      ...newAsg,
      id: `asg-${Date.now()}`,
      submissionCount: 0,
      gradedCount: 0,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const updated = [created, ...list];
    safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.ASSIGNMENTS, updated);
    return created;
  },

  getSubmissions(assignmentId?: string): HomeworkSubmission[] {
    const list = safeGet<HomeworkSubmission[]>(STORAGE_KEYS.SUBMISSIONS, INITIAL_SUBMISSIONS);
    if (assignmentId) {
      return list.filter((s) => s.assignmentId === assignmentId);
    }
    return list;
  },

  submitHomework(submission: {
    assignmentId: string;
    studentId: string;
    studentName: string;
    studentRollNo: string;
    className: string;
    classId: string;
    files: SubmissionFile[];
    studentNotes?: string;
  }): HomeworkSubmission {
    const list = this.getSubmissions();
    const assignments = this.getAssignments();
    const asg = assignments.find((a) => a.id === submission.assignmentId);

    const newSub: HomeworkSubmission = {
      id: `sub-${Date.now()}`,
      assignmentId: submission.assignmentId,
      studentId: submission.studentId,
      studentName: submission.studentName,
      studentRollNo: submission.studentRollNo,
      className: submission.className,
      classId: submission.classId,
      submissionDate: new Date().toISOString(),
      isLate: asg ? new Date() > new Date(asg.dueDate) : false,
      files: submission.files,
      studentNotes: submission.studentNotes,
      status: 'SUBMITTED',
      maxMarks: asg?.maxMarks || 20,
    };

    // Update assignment submission count
    if (asg) {
      asg.submissionCount += 1;
      safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.ASSIGNMENTS, assignments);
    }

    const updated = [newSub, ...list];
    safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.SUBMISSIONS, updated);
    return newSub;
  },

  gradeSubmission(submissionId: string, grade: number, feedback: string, teacherName: string): HomeworkSubmission | null {
    const list = this.getSubmissions();
    const sub = list.find((s) => s.id === submissionId);
    if (!sub) return null;

    sub.status = 'GRADED';
    sub.grade = grade;
    sub.feedback = feedback;
    sub.gradedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    sub.gradedByName = teacherName;

    // Update assignment gradedCount
    const assignments = this.getAssignments();
    const asg = assignments.find((a) => a.id === sub.assignmentId);
    if (asg) {
      asg.gradedCount = list.filter((s) => s.assignmentId === asg.id && s.status === 'GRADED').length;
      safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.ASSIGNMENTS, assignments);
    }

    safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.SUBMISSIONS, list);
    return sub;
  },

  // Quizzes API
  getQuizzes(): MCQQuiz[] {
    return safeGet<MCQQuiz[]>(STORAGE_KEYS.QUIZZES, INITIAL_QUIZZES);
  },

  createQuiz(newQuiz: Omit<MCQQuiz, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'totalAttempts'>): MCQQuiz {
    const list = this.getQuizzes();
    const created: MCQQuiz = {
      ...newQuiz,
      id: `quiz-${Date.now()}`,
      totalAttempts: 0,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const updated = [created, ...list];
    safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.QUIZZES, updated);
    return created;
  },

  getAttempts(quizId?: string): QuizAttempt[] {
    const list = safeGet<QuizAttempt[]>(STORAGE_KEYS.ATTEMPTS, INITIAL_ATTEMPTS);
    if (quizId) {
      return list.filter((a) => a.quizId === quizId);
    }
    return list;
  },

  // Instant Automated Quiz Grading Calculation Engine!
  submitQuizAttempt(
    quizId: string,
    studentInfo: { studentId: string; studentName: string; classId: string },
    answers: Record<string, string>,
    timeSpentSeconds: number
  ): QuizAttempt {
    const quizzes = this.getQuizzes();
    const quiz = quizzes.find((q) => q.id === quizId);
    if (!quiz) throw new Error('Quiz not found');

    let totalScore = 0;
    const breakdown: QuestionBreakdown[] = [];

    quiz.questions.forEach((q) => {
      const selected = answers[q.id] || '';
      const isCorrect = selected === q.correctOptionId;
      const marksAwarded = isCorrect ? q.marks : 0;
      totalScore += marksAwarded;

      breakdown.push({
        questionId: q.id,
        selectedOptionId: selected,
        correctOptionId: q.correctOptionId,
        isCorrect,
        marksAwarded,
        explanation: q.explanation,
        explanationMl: q.explanationMl,
      });
    });

    const percentage = Math.round((totalScore / quiz.totalMarks) * 100);
    const passed = percentage >= quiz.passPercentage;

    const attempt: QuizAttempt = {
      id: `att-${Date.now()}`,
      quizId: quiz.id,
      quizTitle: quiz.title,
      quizTitleMl: quiz.titleMl,
      subject: quiz.subject,
      studentId: studentInfo.studentId,
      studentName: studentInfo.studentName,
      classId: studentInfo.classId,
      startedAt: new Date(Date.now() - timeSpentSeconds * 1000).toISOString(),
      submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      timeSpentSeconds,
      answers,
      score: totalScore,
      totalMarks: quiz.totalMarks,
      percentage,
      passed,
      breakdown,
    };

    // Increment quiz attempts count
    quiz.totalAttempts += 1;
    safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.QUIZZES, quizzes);

    const attempts = this.getAttempts();
    safeSet(STORAGE_KEYS.ATTEMPTS, [attempt, ...attempts]);

    return attempt;
  },

  getOverviewStats(): LMSOverviewStats {
    const assignments = this.getAssignments();
    const submissions = this.getSubmissions();
    const quizzes = this.getQuizzes();
    const attempts = this.getAttempts();

    const pendingSubs = submissions.filter((s) => s.status === 'SUBMITTED').length;
    const gradedSubs = submissions.filter((s) => s.status === 'GRADED').length;
    const avgScore = attempts.length
      ? Math.round(attempts.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.percentage, 0) / attempts.length)
      : 80;

    return {
      totalAssignments: assignments.length,
      activeAssignments: assignments.filter((a) => a.status === 'ACTIVE').length,
      pendingSubmissionsCount: pendingSubs,
      gradedSubmissionsCount: gradedSubs,
      totalQuizzes: quizzes.length,
      activeQuizzes: quizzes.filter((q) => q.status === 'ACTIVE').length,
      totalQuizAttempts: attempts.length,
      avgQuizScorePercentage: avgScore,
    };
  },
};

export const PortfolioStore = {
  getPortfolios(): StudentDigitalPortfolio[] {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_PORTFOLIOS;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!raw) {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_PORTFOLIOS));
        return INITIAL_PORTFOLIOS;
      }
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_PORTFOLIOS;
    }
  },

  getPortfolioByStudentId(studentId: string): StudentDigitalPortfolio | null {
    const list = this.getPortfolios();
    return list.find(p => p.studentId === studentId) || list[0] || null;
  },

  awardBadge(studentId: string, badgeCode: string, teacherName: string, customReason?: string): StudentBadge | null {
    const list = this.getPortfolios();
    const portfolio = list.find(p => p.studentId === studentId);
    if (!portfolio) return null;

    const template = BADGE_LIBRARY.find(b => b.code === badgeCode);
    if (!template) return null;

    const newBadge: StudentBadge = {
      ...template,
      id: `bdg-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      unlockedAt: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      awardedBy: teacherName || 'Class Teacher',
      description: customReason || template.description,
    };

    portfolio.badges.unshift(newBadge);
    portfolio.totalPoints += newBadge.points;

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
    return newBadge;
  },

  addAchievement(
    studentId: string,
    achievement: Omit<PortfolioAchievement, 'id' | 'isVerified'>
  ): PortfolioAchievement | null {
    const list = this.getPortfolios();
    const portfolio = list.find(p => p.studentId === studentId);
    if (!portfolio) return null;

    const newAch: PortfolioAchievement = {
      ...achievement,
      id: `ach-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      isVerified: true,
    };

    portfolio.achievements.unshift(newAch);
    portfolio.totalPoints += 50;

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
    return newAch;
  },

  addProject(studentId: string, project: Omit<PortfolioProject, 'id'>): PortfolioProject | null {
    const list = this.getPortfolios();
    const portfolio = list.find(p => p.studentId === studentId);
    if (!portfolio) return null;

    const newProj: PortfolioProject = {
      ...project,
      id: `prj-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
    };

    portfolio.projects.unshift(newProj);
    portfolio.totalPoints += 40;

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
    return newProj;
  },
};

// PWA Registration and Management Utilities

export interface BeforeInstallPromptEvent extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
  userChoice: Promise<{ outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed' }>;
}

/**
 * Register the service worker
 */
export async function registerServiceWorker(): Promise<ServiceWorkerRegistration | null> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
    console.log('Service Workers not supported');
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', {
      scope: '/',
    });

    console.log('Service Worker registered:', registration);

    // Check for updates every hour
    setInterval(() => {
      registration.update();
    }, 60 * 60 * 1000);

    // Handle updates
    registration.addEventListener('updatefound', () => {
      const newWorker = registration.installing;
      if (!newWorker) return;

      newWorker.addEventListener('statechange', () => {
        if (newWorker.state === 'installed' && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
          // New service worker available
          console.log('New content available, please refresh');
          
          // Notify user about update
          if (window.confirm('New version available! Reload to update?')) {
            newWorker.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
            window.location.reload();
          }
        }
      });
    });

    return registration;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Service Worker registration failed:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Unregister the service worker
 */
export async function unregisterServiceWorker(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
    if (registration) {
      return await registration.unregister();
    }
    return false;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Service Worker unregistration failed:', error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Check if the app is running as a PWA (standalone mode)
 */
export function isPWA(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;

  return (
    window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
    (window.navigator as any).standalone === true ||
    document.referrer.includes('android-app://')
  );
}

/**
 * Check if the app can be installed
 */
export function canInstallPWA(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  
  // Check if already installed
  if (isPWA()) return false;

  // Check if beforeinstallprompt event will fire
  return 'BeforeInstallPromptEvent' in window || 'onbeforeinstallprompt' in window;
}

/**
 * Request persistent storage permission
 */
export async function requestPersistentStorage(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.storage || !navigator.storage.persist) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const isPersisted = await navigator.storage.persist();
    console.log(`Persistent storage: ${isPersisted ? 'granted' : 'denied'}`);
    return isPersisted;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Persistent storage request failed:', error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Get storage estimate
 */
export async function getStorageEstimate(): Promise<{ usage: number; quota: number } | null> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.storage || !navigator.storage.estimate) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();
    return {
      usage: estimate.usage || 0,
      quota: estimate.quota || 0,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Storage estimate failed:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Check if the user is online
 */
export function isOnline(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return true;
  return navigator.onLine;
}

/**
 * Add online/offline event listeners
 */
export function addConnectionListeners(
  onOnline: () => void,
  onOffline: () => void
): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return () => {};
  }

  window.addEventListener('online', onOnline);
  window.addEventListener('offline', onOffline);

  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('online', onOnline);
    window.removeEventListener('offline', onOffline);
  };
}

/**
 * Request notification permission
 */
export async function requestNotificationPermission(): Promise<NotificationPermission> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) {
    return 'denied';
  }

  if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
    return 'granted';
  }

  if (Notification.permission !== 'denied') {
    const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
    return permission;
  }

  return Notification.permission;
}

/**
 * Show a notification
 */
export async function showNotification(
  title: string,
  options?: NotificationOptions
): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) {
    return;
  }

  if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') {
    await requestNotificationPermission();
  }

  if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
    const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
    if (registration) {
      await registration.showNotification(title, {
        icon: '/icon-192.png',
        badge: '/icon-192.png',
        ...options,
      });
    } else {
      new Notification(title, options);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Cache specific URLs for offline access
 */
export async function cacheUrls(urls: string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
    return;
  }

  const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
  if (registration && registration.active) {
    registration.active.postMessage({
      type: 'CACHE_URLS',
      urls,
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Clear all caches
 */
export async function clearAllCaches(): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('caches' in window)) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    const cacheNames = await caches.keys();
    await Promise.all(cacheNames.map((name) => caches.delete(name)));
    console.log('All caches cleared');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to clear caches:', error);
  }
}

export const teacherRoles = ['TEACHER', 'CLASS_TEACHER', 'EXAM_OFFICER'];
export const schoolRoles = ['SCHOOL_OWNER', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL', 'SCHOOL_ADMIN', 'ACCOUNTANT', 'LIBRARIAN', 'TRANSPORT_OFFICER', 'RECEPTIONIST', 'AUDITOR'];
export const predictiveAnalyticsRoles = ['SCHOOL_OWNER', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL', 'SCHOOL_ADMIN'];
export function homeForRole(role: string) {
  if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') return '/admin/dashboard';
  if (teacherRoles.includes(role)) return '/teacher/dashboard';
  if (schoolRoles.includes(role)) return '/school/dashboard';
  if (role === 'STUDENT') return '/student/dashboard';
  return '/dashboard';
}
export function clearSession() {
  for (const key of ['user', 'accessToken', 'refreshToken', 'adminToken', 'adminUser']) localStorage.removeItem(key);
}

// Haversine formula to compute geodesic distance between two GPS coordinates in meters
export function calculateHaversineDistanceMeters(
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
): number {
  const R = 6371e3; // Earth's radius in meters
  const φ1 = (lat1 * Math.PI) / 180;
  const φ2 = (lat2 * Math.PI) / 180;
  const Δφ = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const Δλ = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;

  const a =
    Math.sin(Δφ / 2) * Math.sin(Δφ / 2) +
    Math.cos(φ1) * Math.cos(φ2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));

  return Math.round(R * c);
}

class SmartAttendanceService {
  private geofenceConfig: GeofenceConfig = DEFAULT_GEOFENCE_CONFIG;
  private staffRecords: StaffSmartAttendanceRecord[] = [];
  private studentScans: Array<{
    id: string;
    studentId: string;
    studentName: string;
    admissionNumber: string;
    className: string;
    time: string;
    status: 'PRESENT' | 'LATE';
    verifiedMethod: string;
  }> = [];
  private leaveApplications: ParentAbsenceApplication[] = [];
  private currentProjectorCode: string = '';
  private currentProjectorToken: string = '';
  private tokenExpiresAt: number = 0;

  constructor() {
    this.loadFromStorage();
    this.refreshProjectorCode();
  }

  private isClient(): boolean {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined';
  }

  private loadFromStorage() {
    if (!this.isClient()) {
      this.leaveApplications = [...INITIAL_LEAVE_APPLICATIONS];
      return;
    }

    try {
      const geo = localStorage.getItem('krypton_smart_geofence');
      if (geo) this.geofenceConfig = JSON.parse(geo);

      const staff = localStorage.getItem('krypton_smart_staff_records');
      if (staff) {
        this.staffRecords = JSON.parse(staff);
      } else {
        // Seed default records for today
        const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        this.staffRecords = [
          {
            id: 'sar-01',
            staffId: 'stf-001',
            staffName: 'Dr. Priya Sharma',
            staffNumber: 'STF-2024-001',
            department: 'Mathematics',
            date: todayStr,
            checkInTime: '08:14 AM',
            latitude: 10.02615,
            longitude: 76.31248,
            distanceMeters: 28,
            status: 'PRESENT',
            verifiedMethod: 'GEOFENCE_GPS',
            deviceInfo: 'iPhone 15 Pro (Safari)',
            notes: 'Verified inside school campus geofence (28m from center)',
          },
          {
            id: 'sar-02',
            staffId: 'stf-002',
            staffName: 'Rajesh Varma',
            staffNumber: 'STF-2024-002',
            department: 'Computer Science',
            date: todayStr,
            checkInTime: '08:22 AM',
            latitude: 10.02602,
            longitude: 76.31261,
            distanceMeters: 45,
            status: 'PRESENT',
            verifiedMethod: 'GEOFENCE_GPS',
            deviceInfo: 'Samsung Galaxy S24 (Chrome)',
            notes: 'Verified inside school campus geofence (45m from center)',
          },
        ];
        this.saveStaffRecords();
      }

      const scans = localStorage.getItem('krypton_smart_student_scans');
      if (scans) {
        this.studentScans = JSON.parse(scans);
      } else {
        this.studentScans = [
          {
            id: 'scn-01',
            studentId: 'stu-001',
            studentName: 'Aarav Patel',
            admissionNumber: 'KPS-2024-101',
            className: 'Grade 10 (Stream A)',
            time: '08:05 AM',
            status: 'PRESENT',
            verifiedMethod: 'ID_CARD_SCAN',
          },
          {
            id: 'scn-02',
            studentId: 'stu-002',
            studentName: 'Ananya Sharma',
            admissionNumber: 'KPS-2024-102',
            className: 'Grade 10 (Stream A)',
            time: '08:12 AM',
            status: 'PRESENT',
            verifiedMethod: 'ID_CARD_SCAN',
          },
        ];
        this.saveStudentScans();
      }

      const leaves = localStorage.getItem('krypton_smart_leave_apps');
      if (leaves) {
        this.leaveApplications = JSON.parse(leaves);
      } else {
        this.leaveApplications = [...INITIAL_LEAVE_APPLICATIONS];
        this.saveLeaveApplications();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error loading smart attendance from storage', e);
    }
  }

  private saveStaffRecords() {
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.setItem('krypton_smart_staff_records', JSON.stringify(this.staffRecords));
    }
  }

  private saveStudentScans() {
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.setItem('krypton_smart_student_scans', JSON.stringify(this.studentScans));
    }
  }

  private saveLeaveApplications() {
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.setItem('krypton_smart_leave_apps', JSON.stringify(this.leaveApplications));
    }
  }

  // Geofence Config Methods
  getGeofenceConfig(): GeofenceConfig {
    return this.geofenceConfig;
  }

  updateGeofenceConfig(config: Partial<GeofenceConfig>): GeofenceConfig {
    this.geofenceConfig = { ...this.geofenceConfig, ...config };
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.setItem('krypton_smart_geofence', JSON.stringify(this.geofenceConfig));
    }
    return this.geofenceConfig;
  }

  // Geofenced Staff Check-in / Check-out
  checkInStaff(req: StaffCheckInRequest): StaffCheckInResult {
    const staff = MOCK_STAFF_MEMBERS.find((s) => s.id === req.staffId) || MOCK_STAFF_MEMBERS[0];
    const distanceMeters = calculateHaversineDistanceMeters(
      req.latitude,
      req.longitude,
      this.geofenceConfig.latitude,
      this.geofenceConfig.longitude
    );

    const isWithin = distanceMeters <= this.geofenceConfig.radiusMeters;
    const now = new Date();
    const timeFormatted = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true });
    const todayStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0];

    if (!isWithin) {
      return {
        success: false,
        type: req.type,
        recordId: '',
        staffId: staff.id,
        staffName: staff.name,
        timestamp: timeFormatted,
        distanceMeters,
        isWithinGeofence: false,
        status: 'REJECTED',
        message: `Check-in rejected! You are ${distanceMeters} meters away from school campus. Permitted radius is ${this.geofenceConfig.radiusMeters}m.`,
        messageMl: `ചെക്ക്-ഇൻ നിരസിച്ചു! നിങ്ങൾ സ്കൂൾ കോമ്പൗണ്ടിൽ നിന്നും ${distanceMeters} മീറ്റർ അകലെയാണ്. അനുവദനീയമായ പരിധി ${this.geofenceConfig.radiusMeters} മീറ്റർ മാത്രമാണ്.`,
      };
    }

    // Check if late (e.g., after lateThresholdTime)
    const [lateH, lateM] = this.geofenceConfig.lateThresholdTime.split(':').map(Number);
    const lateThresholdDate = new Date();
    lateThresholdDate.setHours(lateH, lateM, 0, 0);
    const isLate = now > lateThresholdDate;
    const status = isLate ? 'LATE' : 'PRESENT';

    let existingRecord = this.staffRecords.find(
      (r) => r.staffId === staff.id && r.date === todayStr
    );

    if (req.type === 'CHECK_OUT') {
      if (existingRecord) {
        existingRecord.checkOutTime = timeFormatted;
        existingRecord.status = 'CHECKED_OUT';
        existingRecord.notes = (existingRecord.notes || '') + ` | Checked out at ${timeFormatted} (${distanceMeters}m from center)`;
      } else {
        existingRecord = {
          id: 'sar-' + Date.now(),
          staffId: staff.id,
          staffName: staff.name,
          staffNumber: staff.staffNumber,
          department: staff.department,
          date: todayStr,
          checkOutTime: timeFormatted,
          latitude: req.latitude,
          longitude: req.longitude,
          distanceMeters,
          status: 'CHECKED_OUT',
          verifiedMethod: 'GEOFENCE_GPS',
          deviceInfo: req.deviceInfo || 'Mobile Device',
          notes: `Check-out recorded (${distanceMeters}m from campus center)`,
        };
        this.staffRecords.unshift(existingRecord);
      }
      this.saveStaffRecords();

      return {
        success: true,
        type: 'CHECK_OUT',
        recordId: existingRecord.id,
        staffId: staff.id,
        staffName: staff.name,
        timestamp: timeFormatted,
        distanceMeters,
        isWithinGeofence: true,
        status: 'CHECKED_OUT',
        message: `Check-out successful! Time: ${timeFormatted}. Safe travels.`,
        messageMl: `ചെക്ക്-ഔട്ട് വിജയകരം! സമയം: ${timeFormatted}. ശുഭയാത്ര.`,
      };
    }

    // CHECK_IN
    if (existingRecord && existingRecord.checkInTime) {
      return {
        success: true,
        type: 'CHECK_IN',
        recordId: existingRecord.id,
        staffId: staff.id,
        staffName: staff.name,
        timestamp: existingRecord.checkInTime,
        distanceMeters,
        isWithinGeofence: true,
        status: existingRecord.status as any,
        message: `Already checked in today at ${existingRecord.checkInTime} (${existingRecord.status}).`,
        messageMl: `ഇന്ന് ${existingRecord.checkInTime}-ന് ഇതിനകം ചെക്ക്-ഇൻ പൂർത്തിയായിട്ടുണ്ട് (${existingRecord.status}).`,
      };
    }

    const newRecord: StaffSmartAttendanceRecord = {
      id: 'sar-' + Date.now(),
      staffId: staff.id,
      staffName: staff.name,
      staffNumber: staff.staffNumber,
      department: staff.department,
      date: todayStr,
      checkInTime: timeFormatted,
      latitude: req.latitude,
      longitude: req.longitude,
      distanceMeters,
      status,
      verifiedMethod: 'GEOFENCE_GPS',
      deviceInfo: req.deviceInfo || 'Mobile GPS Check-in',
      notes: `Verified within geofence (${distanceMeters}m from campus center). GPS accuracy: ${req.accuracyMeters || 12}m`,
    };

    this.staffRecords.unshift(newRecord);
    this.saveStaffRecords();

    return {
      success: true,
      type: 'CHECK_IN',
      recordId: newRecord.id,
      staffId: staff.id,
      staffName: staff.name,
      timestamp: timeFormatted,
      distanceMeters,
      isWithinGeofence: true,
      status,
      message: `Verified! Check-in recorded at ${timeFormatted} (${distanceMeters}m from campus center). Status: ${status}.`,
      messageMl: `പരിശോധന വിജയിച്ചു! ${distanceMeters} മീറ്റർ അകലെ വച്ച് ${timeFormatted}-ൽ ചെക്ക്-ഇൻ രേഖപ്പെടുത്തി. സ്റ്റാറ്റസ്: ${status === 'LATE' ? 'വൈകി എത്തിയത് (Late)' : 'ഹാജർ (Present)'}.`,
    };
  }

  getStaffRecords(dateFilter?: string): StaffSmartAttendanceRecord[] {
    const targetDate = dateFilter || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return this.staffRecords.filter((r) => !dateFilter || r.date === targetDate);
  }

  getAllStaff(): MockStaffMember[] {
    return MOCK_STAFF_MEMBERS;
  }

  // Student QR Code Scanning
  scanStudentQR(req: ScanStudentQRRequest): ScanStudentQRResult {
    const raw = req.qrPayload.trim();
    let student: StudentIDCardData | undefined;

    // Parse payload: either "KRYPTON:ATTEND:stu-001:..." or direct studentId or admission number
    if (raw.startsWith('KRYPTON:ATTEND:')) {
      const parts = raw.split(':');
      const studentId = parts[2];
      student = MOCK_STUDENTS.find((s) => s.id === studentId || s.admissionNumber === parts[3]);
    } else {
      student = MOCK_STUDENTS.find(
        (s) =>
          s.id.toLowerCase() === raw.toLowerCase() ||
          s.admissionNumber.toLowerCase() === raw.toLowerCase() ||
          s.name.toLowerCase().includes(raw.toLowerCase())
      );
    }

    if (!student) {
      student = MOCK_STUDENTS[0]; // fallback demo
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const timeFormatted = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true });
    const todayStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0];

    const alreadyMarked = this.studentScans.some((s) => s.studentId === student!.id);

    if (alreadyMarked) {
      const existing = this.studentScans.find((s) => s.studentId === student!.id)!;
      return {
        success: true,
        alreadyMarked: true,
        student: {
          id: student.id,
          admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
          name: student.name,
          className: student.className,
          streamName: student.streamName,
          photoUrl: student.photoUrl,
          parentPhone: student.emergencyContact,
        },
        record: {
          id: existing.id,
          date: todayStr,
          time: existing.time,
          status: existing.status,
          verifiedMethod: 'ID_CARD_SCAN',
        },
        message: `${student.name} is already marked ${existing.status} today at ${existing.time}.`,
        messageMl: `${student.name}-ന്റെ ഹാജർ ഇന്ന് ${existing.time}-ൽ ${existing.status === 'LATE' ? 'വൈകിയതായി' : 'ഹാജരായി'} രേഖപ്പെടുത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ട്.`,
      };
    }

    // Check if after 08:45 AM
    const isLate = now.getHours() > 8 || (now.getHours() === 8 && now.getMinutes() >= 45);
    const status: 'PRESENT' | 'LATE' = isLate ? 'LATE' : 'PRESENT';


    const newScan = {
      id: 'scn-' + Date.now(),
      studentId: student.id,
      studentName: student.name,
      admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
      className: `${student.className} (${student.streamName || ''})`,
      time: timeFormatted,
      status,
      verifiedMethod: req.source === 'PROJECTOR_KIOSK' ? 'DYNAMIC_QR' : 'ID_CARD_SCAN',
    };

    this.studentScans.unshift(newScan);
    this.saveStudentScans();

    return {
      success: true,
      alreadyMarked: false,
      student: {
        id: student.id,
        admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
        name: student.name,
        className: student.className,
        streamName: student.streamName,
        photoUrl: student.photoUrl,
        parentPhone: student.emergencyContact,
      },
      record: {
        id: newScan.id,
        date: todayStr,
        time: timeFormatted,
        status,
        verifiedMethod: newScan.verifiedMethod as any,
      },
      message: `Verified! ${student.name} (${student.admissionNumber}) marked ${status} at ${timeFormatted}.`,
      messageMl: `പരിശോധന വിജയിച്ചു! ${student.name} (${student.admissionNumber}) - ഹാജർ രേഖപ്പെടുത്തി (${timeFormatted}).`,
    };
  }

  getAllStudents(): StudentIDCardData[] {
    return MOCK_STUDENTS;
  }

  getStudentScans() {
    return this.studentScans;
  }

  // Dynamic Projector Screen Session
  refreshProjectorCode(): DynamicProjectorSession {
    const now = Date.now();
    const randomSalt = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase();
    this.currentProjectorCode = `KRYPTON-ATTEND-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}-${randomSalt}`;
    this.currentProjectorToken = Buffer.from(this.currentProjectorCode).toString('base64');
    this.tokenExpiresAt = now + 20000; // 20-second dynamic rotation

    const totalStudents = 120; // Simulated school strength for the grade
    const presentToday = this.studentScans.length;
    const lateToday = this.studentScans.filter((s) => s.status === 'LATE').length;
    const excusedToday = this.leaveApplications.filter((l) => l.status === 'APPROVED').length;
    const absentToday = Math.max(0, totalStudents - presentToday - excusedToday);
    const attendancePercentage = Math.round(((presentToday + excusedToday) / totalStudents) * 100);

    return {
      sessionId: 'sess-' + Math.floor(now / 20000),
      currentCode: this.currentProjectorCode,
      token: this.currentProjectorToken,
      validUntil: this.tokenExpiresAt,
      countdownSeconds: 20,
      refreshIntervalMs: 20000,
      schoolName: this.geofenceConfig.schoolName,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
        weekday: 'long',
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'long',
        day: 'numeric',
      }),
      stats: {
        totalStudents,
        presentToday,
        lateToday,
        absentToday,
        excusedToday,
        attendancePercentage,
      },
      recentScans: this.studentScans.slice(0, 10),
    };
  }

  getProjectorSession(): DynamicProjectorSession {
    if (Date.now() >= this.tokenExpiresAt) {
      return this.refreshProjectorCode();
    }
    const totalStudents = 120;
    const presentToday = this.studentScans.length;
    const lateToday = this.studentScans.filter((s) => s.status === 'LATE').length;
    const excusedToday = this.leaveApplications.filter((l) => l.status === 'APPROVED').length;
    const absentToday = Math.max(0, totalStudents - presentToday - excusedToday);
    const attendancePercentage = Math.round(((presentToday + excusedToday) / totalStudents) * 100);

    return {
      sessionId: 'sess-' + Math.floor(this.tokenExpiresAt / 20000),
      currentCode: this.currentProjectorCode,
      token: this.currentProjectorToken,
      validUntil: this.tokenExpiresAt,
      countdownSeconds: Math.max(1, Math.round((this.tokenExpiresAt - Date.now()) / 1000)),
      refreshIntervalMs: 20000,
      schoolName: this.geofenceConfig.schoolName,
      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
        weekday: 'long',
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'long',
        day: 'numeric',
      }),
      stats: {
        totalStudents,
        presentToday,
        lateToday,
        absentToday,
        excusedToday,
        attendancePercentage,
      },
      recentScans: this.studentScans.slice(0, 10),
    };
  }

  // Parent Planned Absence Portal
  submitAbsenceApplication(dto: SubmitAbsenceRequestDto): ParentAbsenceApplication {
    const student = MOCK_STUDENTS.find((s) => s.id === dto.studentId) || MOCK_STUDENTS[2];
    const startDateObj = new Date(dto.startDate);
    const endDateObj = new Date(dto.endDate);
    const diffTime = Math.abs(endDateObj.getTime() - startDateObj.getTime());
    const totalDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1);

    const reasonTitles: Record<AbsenceReasonCategory, { en: string; ml: string }> = {
      SICK: { en: 'Illness / Medical Sickness', ml: 'അസുഖം / ശാരീരിക അസ്വാസ്ഥ്യം' },
      MEDICAL_APPOINTMENT: { en: 'Medical / Dental Appointment', ml: 'ഡോക്ടർ അപ്പോയിന്റ്മെന്റ്' },
      FAMILY_EMERGENCY: { en: 'Family Emergency / Function', ml: 'കുടുംബപരമായ അത്യാവശ്യം' },
      RELIGIOUS_OBLIGATION: { en: 'Religious Obligation / Festival', ml: 'മതപരമായ ചടങ്ങുകൾ' },
      TRAVEL: { en: 'Out of Station Travel', ml: 'യാത്ര' },
      SPORTS_OR_EVENT: { en: 'External Sports / Academic Competition', ml: 'കായിക / മത്സര രംഗം' },
      OTHER: { en: 'Personal / Other Reason', ml: 'മറ്റ് വ്യക്തിപരമായ കാരണങ്ങൾ' },
    };

    const reasonMeta = reasonTitles[dto.reasonCategory] || reasonTitles.OTHER;

    const newApp: ParentAbsenceApplication = {
      id: 'abs-' + Date.now(),
      studentId: student.id,
      studentName: student.name,
      admissionNumber: student.admissionNumber,
      className: `${student.className} (${student.streamName || ''})`,
      guardianId: 'grd-' + student.id,
      guardianName: dto.guardianName || 'Parent / Guardian',
      guardianPhone: dto.guardianPhone || student.emergencyContact,
      startDate: dto.startDate,
      endDate: dto.endDate,
      totalDays,
      reasonCategory: dto.reasonCategory,
      reasonTitle: reasonMeta.en,
      reasonTitleMl: reasonMeta.ml,
      explanation: dto.explanation,
      hasMedicalCertificate: Boolean(dto.medicalCertificateName),
      medicalCertificateName: dto.medicalCertificateName,
      medicalCertificateBase64: dto.medicalCertificateBase64,
      medicalCertificateUrl: dto.medicalCertificateBase64 ? '#' : undefined,
      status: 'PENDING',
      appliedAt: new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', {
        dateStyle: 'medium',
        timeStyle: 'short',
      }),
      attendanceAutoMarked: false,
    };

    this.leaveApplications.unshift(newApp);
    this.saveLeaveApplications();
    return newApp;
  }

  getLeaveApplications(statusFilter?: string): ParentAbsenceApplication[] {
    if (!statusFilter || statusFilter === 'ALL') {
      return this.leaveApplications;
    }
    return this.leaveApplications.filter((app) => app.status === statusFilter);
  }

  reviewAbsenceApplication(dto: ReviewAbsenceRequestDto): ParentAbsenceApplication {
    const app = this.leaveApplications.find((a) => a.id === dto.applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      throw new Error(`Application ${dto.applicationId} not found`);
    }

    app.status = dto.status;
    app.reviewedBy = dto.reviewerName || 'Teacher / Attendance In-Charge';
    app.reviewedAt = new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', {
      dateStyle: 'medium',
      timeStyle: 'short',
    });
    app.reviewNotes = dto.reviewNotes || (dto.status === 'APPROVED' ? 'Approved by Class Teacher' : 'Rejected');

    if (dto.status === 'APPROVED') {
      // Automatically marks attendance as EXCUSED in student daily register!
      app.attendanceAutoMarked = true;
    } else {
      app.attendanceAutoMarked = false;
    }

    this.saveLeaveApplications();
    return app;
  }

  resetDemoData() {
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.removeItem('krypton_smart_geofence');
      localStorage.removeItem('krypton_smart_staff_records');
      localStorage.removeItem('krypton_smart_student_scans');
      localStorage.removeItem('krypton_smart_leave_apps');
    }
    this.geofenceConfig = DEFAULT_GEOFENCE_CONFIG;
    this.loadFromStorage();
  }
}
