class SmartSubstitutionService {
  private absentTeachers: AbsentTeacherSchedule[] = [];
  private assignments: SubstitutionAssignment[] = [];
  private notificationLogs: SubstitutionNotificationLog[] = [];
  private listeners: Array<() => void> = [];

  constructor() {
    this.loadState();
  }

  private isClient(): boolean {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined';
  }

  private loadState() {
    if (!this.isClient()) {
      this.absentTeachers = [...INITIAL_ABSENT_TEACHERS];
      return;
    }

    try {
      const storedAbsent = localStorage.getItem('krypton_proxy_absent_teachers');
      if (storedAbsent) {
        this.absentTeachers = JSON.parse(storedAbsent);
      } else {
        this.absentTeachers = [...INITIAL_ABSENT_TEACHERS];
        this.saveAbsentTeachers();
      }

      const storedAssignments = localStorage.getItem('krypton_proxy_assignments');
      if (storedAssignments) {
        this.assignments = JSON.parse(storedAssignments);
      } else {
        // Seed 1 active sample assignment so user can see it right away
        const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        const sampleAssignment: SubstitutionAssignment = {
          id: 'sub-init-01',
          date: todayStr,
          periodNumber: 1,
          periodName: 'Period 1',
          timeSlot: '08:30 AM - 09:15 AM',
          classId: 'cls-10a',
          className: 'Class 10A',
          subjectName: 'Computer Science',
          room: 'Room 302',
          absentTeacherId: 'stf-002',
          absentTeacherName: 'Rajesh Varma',
          absentTeacherNameMl: 'രാജേഷ് വർമ്മ',
          absentReason: 'Viral Fever & Medical Rest',
          substituteTeacherId: 'stf-007',
          substituteTeacherName: 'Arun Kumar',
          substituteTeacherNameMl: 'അരുൺ കുമാർ',
          substituteTeacherPhone: '+91 98470 78901',
          substituteTeacherAvatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
          status: 'NOTIFIED',
          matchScore: 92,
          assignedAt: '08:05 AM',
          assignedBy: 'AI Smart Engine (Auto)',
          notificationSentAt: '08:06 AM',
          notificationChannels: ['PUSH', 'WHATSAPP'],
          lessonPlanHandover: 'Finish Section 3.2 on Boolean Logic exercises in textbook.',
        };
        this.assignments = [sampleAssignment];
        this.saveAssignments();

        this.notificationLogs = [
          {
            id: 'notif-01',
            assignmentId: 'sub-init-01',
            teacherId: 'stf-007',
            teacherName: 'Arun Kumar',
            teacherPhone: '+91 98470 78901',
            channel: 'WHATSAPP',
            title: 'Substitution Assigned: Class 10A - Period 1',
            titleMl: 'പ്രോക്സി അസൈൻ ചെയ്തു: ക്ലാസ്സ് 10A - പീരീഡ് 1',
            body: 'You have substitution in Class 10A - Period 1 (08:30 AM - 09:15 AM) replacing Rajesh Varma.',
            bodyMl: 'ക്ലാസ്സ് 10A - പീരീഡ് 1-ൽ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് സബ്സ്റ്റിറ്റ്യൂഷൻ അസൈൻ ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട് (പകരം: രാജേഷ് വർമ്മ).',
            whatsappPreview: '📢 *KRYPTON PROXY ALERT*\nDear Arun Kumar, you have substitution in Class 10A - Period 1 (08:30 AM) replacing Rajesh Varma. Room: 302.',
            sentAt: '08:06 AM',
            delivered: true,
            status: 'SENT',
          },
        ];
        this.saveNotifications();
      }

      const storedNotifs = localStorage.getItem('krypton_proxy_notifications');
      if (storedNotifs) {
        this.notificationLogs = JSON.parse(storedNotifs);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error loading proxy engine state:', e);
    }
  }

  private saveAbsentTeachers() {
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.setItem('krypton_proxy_absent_teachers', JSON.stringify(this.absentTeachers));
    }
    this.notifyListeners();
  }

  private saveAssignments() {
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.setItem('krypton_proxy_assignments', JSON.stringify(this.assignments));
    }
    this.notifyListeners();
  }

  private saveNotifications() {
    if (this.isClient()) {
      localStorage.setItem('krypton_proxy_notifications', JSON.stringify(this.notificationLogs));
    }
    this.notifyListeners();
  }

  public subscribe(listener: () => void) {
    this.listeners.push(listener);
    return () => {
      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter((l) => l !== listener);
    };
  }

  private notifyListeners() {
    this.listeners.forEach((fn) => fn());
  }

  // ==================== QUERY METHODS ====================

  public getAbsentTeachers(date?: string): AbsentTeacherSchedule[] {
    const targetDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return this.absentTeachers.filter((t) => !t.absenceDate || t.absenceDate === targetDate);
  }

  public getAllTeachers(): TeacherProfile[] {
    return TEACHER_PROFILES;
  }

  public getTeacherProfile(id: string): TeacherProfile | undefined {
    return TEACHER_PROFILES.find((t) => t.id === id);
  }

  public getTeacherRegularSchedule(teacherId: string, dayOfWeek?: number): TeacherTimetableSlot[] {
    // Check if auto-generated timetable exists in localStorage
    if (this.isClient()) {
      try {
        const stored = localStorage.getItem('krypton_auto_timetable_result');
        if (stored) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
          const day = new Date().getDay();
          const targetDay = dayOfWeek || (day === 0 || day === 6 ? 1 : day); // Default to current weekday (or Mon on weekend)
          const slots = parsed.slots?.filter(
            (s: any) => s.teacherId === teacherId && s.dayOfWeek === targetDay
          );
          if (slots && slots.length > 0) {
            return slots.map((s: any) => ({
              periodNumber: s.periodNumber,
              periodName: s.periodName,
              timeSlot: s.timeSlot,
              classId: s.classId,
              className: s.className,
              subjectName: s.subjectName,
              room: s.roomName,
              lessonPlanNote: s.lessonPlanNote,
            }));
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // fallback
      }
    }
    return MASTER_TIMETABLE[teacherId] || [];
  }

  public getAssignments(date?: string, teacherId?: string): SubstitutionAssignment[] {
    const targetDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return this.assignments.filter((a) => {
      const matchDate = !a.date || a.date === targetDate;
      const matchTeacher = !teacherId || a.substituteTeacherId === teacherId;
      return matchDate && matchTeacher;
    });
  }

  public getVacantPeriods(date?: string): SubstitutionPeriod[] {
    const absent = this.getAbsentTeachers(date);
    const existingAssignments = this.getAssignments(date);
    const assignedPeriodKeys = new Set(
      existingAssignments.map((a) => `${a.absentTeacherId}-${a.periodNumber}`)
    );

    const vacant: SubstitutionPeriod[] = [];
    absent.forEach((teacher) => {
      teacher.periods.forEach((period) => {
        const key = `${teacher.teacherId}-${period.periodNumber}`;
        if (!assignedPeriodKeys.has(key)) {
          vacant.push(period);
        }
      });
    });

    return vacant.sort((a, b) => a.periodNumber - b.periodNumber);
  }

  public getDailySummary(date?: string): SubstitutionDailySummary {
    const targetDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const absent = this.getAbsentTeachers(targetDate);
    const totalPeriodsToCover = absent.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.periods.length, 0);
    const dayAssignments = this.getAssignments(targetDate);
    const assignedCount = dayAssignments.length;
    const acknowledgedCount = dayAssignments.filter((a) => a.status === 'ACKNOWLEDGED' || a.status === 'COMPLETED').length;
    const pendingCount = Math.max(0, totalPeriodsToCover - assignedCount);
    const coveragePercentage = totalPeriodsToCover === 0 ? 100 : Math.round((assignedCount / totalPeriodsToCover) * 100);

    return {
      date: targetDate,
      totalAbsentTeachers: absent.length,
      totalPeriodsToCover,
      assignedCount,
      pendingCount,
      acknowledgedCount,
      coveragePercentage,
    };
  }

  public getNotificationLogs(teacherId?: string): SubstitutionNotificationLog[] {
    if (teacherId) {
      return this.notificationLogs.filter((n) => n.teacherId === teacherId);
    }
    return this.notificationLogs;
  }

  // ==================== SMART MATCHING & SCORING ALGORITHM ====================

  /**
   * Core Smart Engine: Evaluates all teachers for a given vacant period and scores them.
   * Considers:
   * 1. 100% Hard Constraint: Teacher must be FREE in this period (no scheduled class & no other proxy assignment), and must NOT be absent.
   * 2. Subject Expertise (40%): Same subject or allied subject.
   * 3. Workload Balancing (25%): Teachers with fewer periods today scored higher to prevent burnout.
   * 4. Class Familiarity (25%): Teacher already teaches this specific class (e.g. 8B) in another period.
   * 5. Department Affinity (10%): Same academic department.
   */
  public getRecommendedCandidates(period: SubstitutionPeriod, date?: string): TeacherCandidateScore[] {
    const targetDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const absentTeacherIds = new Set(this.getAbsentTeachers(targetDate).map((t) => t.teacherId));
    const activeAssignments = this.getAssignments(targetDate);

    // Map teacher -> Set of periods they are already assigned proxy
    const teacherProxyPeriods = new Map<string, Set<number>>();
    // Map teacher -> total proxies assigned today
    const teacherProxyCount = new Map<string, number>();

    activeAssignments.forEach((a) => {
      if (!teacherProxyPeriods.has(a.substituteTeacherId)) {
        teacherProxyPeriods.set(a.substituteTeacherId, new Set<number>());
      }
      teacherProxyPeriods.get(a.substituteTeacherId)!.add(a.periodNumber);
      teacherProxyCount.set(a.substituteTeacherId, (teacherProxyCount.get(a.substituteTeacherId) || 0) + 1);
    });

    const candidates: TeacherCandidateScore[] = [];

    for (const teacher of TEACHER_PROFILES) {
      // Rule 0: Cannot assign the absent teacher themselves or any other absent teacher
      if (absentTeacherIds.has(teacher.id)) {
        continue;
      }

      // Check regular schedule for conflicts
      const schedule = this.getTeacherRegularSchedule(teacher.id);
      const regularClassInPeriod = schedule.find((s) => s.periodNumber === period.periodNumber);
      const hasProxyInPeriod = teacherProxyPeriods.get(teacher.id)?.has(period.periodNumber) ?? false;

      let isAvailable = true;
      let conflictReason: string | undefined;

      if (regularClassInPeriod) {
        isAvailable = false;
        conflictReason = `Busy: Teaching ${regularClassInPeriod.className} (${regularClassInPeriod.subjectName})`;
      } else if (hasProxyInPeriod) {
        isAvailable = false;
        conflictReason = `Busy: Already assigned substitution in Period ${period.periodNumber}`;
      }

      // Workload calculation
      const regularPeriodsToday = schedule.length;
      const proxyPeriodsToday = teacherProxyCount.get(teacher.id) || 0;
      const totalPeriodsToday = regularPeriodsToday + proxyPeriodsToday;

      // Score computation
      let subjectScore = 0;
      let classFamiliarityScore = 0;
      let workloadScore = 0;
      let departmentScore = 0;
      const reasons: string[] = [];
      const reasonsMl: string[] = [];

      if (isAvailable) {
        // 1. Subject Match (0 to 40)
        const isExactSubject =
          teacher.primarySubject.toLowerCase().includes(period.subjectName.toLowerCase()) ||
          period.subjectName.toLowerCase().includes(teacher.primarySubject.toLowerCase());

        const isAlliedSubject = teacher.alliedSubjects.some(
          (s) =>
            s.toLowerCase().includes(period.subjectName.toLowerCase()) ||
            period.subjectName.toLowerCase().includes(s.toLowerCase())
        );

        if (isExactSubject) {
          subjectScore = 40;
          reasons.push(`🎯 Exact subject specialist (${teacher.primarySubject})`);
          reasonsMl.push(`🎯 അതേ വിഷയത്തിലെ വിദഗ്ദ്ധൻ (${teacher.primarySubject})`);
        } else if (isAlliedSubject) {
          subjectScore = 26;
          reasons.push(`🔬 Allied subject expertise (${teacher.primarySubject} & allied)`);
          reasonsMl.push(`🔬 അനുബന്ധ വിഷയ വൈദഗ്ദ്ധ്യം (${teacher.primarySubject})`);
        } else {
          subjectScore = 12;
          reasons.push('General faculty substitution');
          reasonsMl.push('ജനറൽ ഫാക്കൽറ്റി സബ്സ്റ്റിറ്റ്യൂഷൻ');
        }

        // 2. Class Familiarity (0 to 25)
        const teachesThisClass = teacher.assignedClasses.includes(period.className);
        const gradeLevel = period.className.split(' ')[1]?.replace(/[A-Z]/, '') || '';
        const teachesSameGrade = teacher.assignedClasses.some((c) => c.includes(gradeLevel));

        if (teachesThisClass) {
          classFamiliarityScore = 25;
          reasons.push(`👨‍🏫 Regularly teaches ${period.className} (high rapport)`);
          reasonsMl.push(`👨‍🏫 ${period.className}-ൽ സ്ഥിരമായി ക്ലാസെടുക്കുന്ന ടീച്ചർ (കുട്ടികൾക്ക് പരിചിതം)`);
        } else if (teachesSameGrade) {
          classFamiliarityScore = 16;
          reasons.push(`Grade ${gradeLevel} curriculum familiarity`);
          reasonsMl.push(`ഗ്രേഡ് ${gradeLevel} കരിക്കുലം പരിചയം`);
        } else {
          classFamiliarityScore = 8;
        }

        // 3. Workload Balancing (0 to 25)
        if (totalPeriodsToday <= 2) {
          workloadScore = 25;
          reasons.push(`⚖️ Very light workload today (only ${totalPeriodsToday} classes)`);
          reasonsMl.push(`⚖️ ഇന്ന് കുറഞ്ഞ ജോലിഭാരം (${totalPeriodsToday} ക്ലാസുകൾ മാത്രം)`);
        } else if (totalPeriodsToday === 3) {
          workloadScore = 20;
          reasons.push(`⚖️ Balanced workload (${totalPeriodsToday} classes)`);
          reasonsMl.push(`⚖️ ബാലൻസ്ഡ് വർക്ക്‌ലോഡ് (${totalPeriodsToday} ക്ലാസുകൾ)`);
        } else if (totalPeriodsToday === 4) {
          workloadScore = 12;
          reasons.push(`Workload: 4 classes today`);
          reasonsMl.push(`ഇന്ന് 4 ക്ലാസുകൾ ഉണ്ട്`);
        } else {
          workloadScore = 4;
          reasons.push(`High workload (${totalPeriodsToday} classes today)`);
          reasonsMl.push(`കൂടിയ വർക്ക്‌ലോഡ് (${totalPeriodsToday} ക്ലാസുകൾ)`);
        }

        // 4. Department Score (0 to 10)
        if (teacher.department.toLowerCase().includes(period.originalTeacherDepartment.toLowerCase())) {
          departmentScore = 10;
          reasons.push(`🏛️ Same department (${teacher.department})`);
          reasonsMl.push(`🏛️ അതേ ഡിപ്പാർട്ട്മെന്റ് (${teacher.department})`);
        } else {
          departmentScore = 3;
        }
      } else {
        reasons.push(`❌ ${conflictReason}`);
        reasonsMl.push(`❌ ലഭ്യമല്ല: ${conflictReason}`);
      }

      const matchScore = isAvailable ? Math.min(100, Math.round(subjectScore + classFamiliarityScore + workloadScore + departmentScore)) : 0;

      candidates.push({
        teacherId: teacher.id,
        teacherNumber: teacher.staffNumber,
        teacherName: teacher.name,
        teacherNameMl: teacher.nameMl,
        department: teacher.department,
        phone: teacher.phone,
        email: teacher.email,
        avatarUrl: teacher.avatarUrl,
        isAvailable,
        conflictReason,
        currentPeriodsToday: totalPeriodsToday,
        maxPeriodsPerDay: teacher.maxPeriodsPerDay,
        weeklySubstitutionCount: proxyPeriodsToday + 1,
        matchScore,
        breakdown: {
          isFree: isAvailable,
          subjectScore,
          workloadScore,
          classFamiliarityScore,
          departmentScore,
        },
        reasons,
        reasonsMl,
      });
    }

    // Sort available candidates by matchScore DESC, then unavailable at the bottom
    return candidates.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.isAvailable && !b.isAvailable) return -1;
      if (!a.isAvailable && b.isAvailable) return 1;
      return b.matchScore - a.matchScore;
    });
  }

  // ==================== ACTIONS ====================

  /**
   * Assign a proxy teacher to a vacant period & trigger instant notification
   */
  public assignProxy(dto: AssignProxyRequestDto): SubstitutionAssignment {
    const subTeacher = this.getTeacherProfile(dto.substituteTeacherId);
    if (!subTeacher) {
      throw new Error(`Teacher with id ${dto.substituteTeacherId} not found`);
    }

    const absentSchedule = this.absentTeachers.find((t) => t.teacherId === dto.absentTeacherId);
    const absentTeacherName = absentSchedule ? absentSchedule.teacherName : 'Absent Faculty';
    const absentTeacherNameMl = absentSchedule ? absentSchedule.teacherNameMl : 'അധ്യാപകൻ';
    const absentReason = absentSchedule ? absentSchedule.absenceReason : 'Leave';

    // Format current time
    const now = new Date();
    const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    // Look up slot time
    const slot = PERIOD_SLOTS.find((s) => s.number === dto.periodNumber);
    const timeSlot = slot ? slot.timeSlot : `Period ${dto.periodNumber}`;

    // Remove any previous assignment for this specific teacher & period if present
    this.assignments = this.assignments.filter(
      (a) => !(a.absentTeacherId === dto.absentTeacherId && a.periodNumber === dto.periodNumber && a.date === dto.date)
    );

    const newAssignment: SubstitutionAssignment = {
      id: `sub-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      date: dto.date,
      periodNumber: dto.periodNumber,
      periodName: `Period ${dto.periodNumber}`,
      timeSlot,
      classId: `cls-${dto.className.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`,
      className: dto.className,
      subjectName: dto.subjectName,
      room: dto.room,
      absentTeacherId: dto.absentTeacherId,
      absentTeacherName,
      absentTeacherNameMl,
      absentReason,
      substituteTeacherId: subTeacher.id,
      substituteTeacherName: subTeacher.name,
      substituteTeacherNameMl: subTeacher.nameMl,
      substituteTeacherPhone: subTeacher.phone,
      substituteTeacherAvatar: subTeacher.avatarUrl,
      status: 'NOTIFIED',
      matchScore: 94,
      assignedAt: timeString,
      assignedBy: 'Academic Coordinator',
      notificationSentAt: timeString,
      notificationChannels: ['PUSH', 'SMS', 'WHATSAPP'],
      lessonPlanHandover: dto.lessonPlanHandover || `Regular syllabus progression for ${dto.subjectName}.`,
    };

    this.assignments.unshift(newAssignment);
    this.saveAssignments();

    // Trigger instant notification
    this.dispatchInstantNotification(newAssignment);

    return newAssignment;
  }

  /**
   * One-Click Engine: Automatically assigns optimal proxies for ALL vacant periods today!
   */
  public autoAssignAllProxies(date?: string): AutoAssignEngineResult {
    const targetDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const vacantPeriods = this.getVacantPeriods(targetDate);
    const newAssignments: SubstitutionAssignment[] = [];
    let notificationsSent = 0;

    for (const period of vacantPeriods) {
      // Re-run recommendation engine (which accounts for newly assigned teachers dynamically)
      const recommendations = this.getRecommendedCandidates(period, targetDate);
      const bestCandidate = recommendations.find((c) => c.isAvailable);

      if (bestCandidate) {
        const assignment = this.assignProxy({
          periodId: period.id,
          absentTeacherId: period.originalTeacherId,
          substituteTeacherId: bestCandidate.teacherId,
          date: targetDate,
          periodNumber: period.periodNumber,
          className: period.className,
          subjectName: period.subjectName,
          room: period.room,
          lessonPlanHandover: period.lessonPlanNote,
          notifyImmediately: true,
        });

        assignment.matchScore = bestCandidate.matchScore;
        assignment.assignedBy = 'Smart Proxy Engine (Auto-Match)';
        newAssignments.push(assignment);
        notificationsSent++;
      }
    }

    this.saveAssignments();

    return {
      date: targetDate,
      totalProcessedPeriods: vacantPeriods.length,
      newAssignmentsCount: newAssignments.length,
      unassignedPeriodsCount: vacantPeriods.length - newAssignments.length,
      assignments: newAssignments,
      notificationsSent,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Dispatch Instant Push & WhatsApp notification to substitute teacher
   */
  public dispatchInstantNotification(assignment: SubstitutionAssignment) {
    const now = new Date();
    const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    const pushTitle = `🔔 Substitution Assigned: ${assignment.className} - ${assignment.periodName}`;
    const pushTitleMl = `🔔 പ്രോക്സി ഡ്യൂട്ടി: ${assignment.className} - ${assignment.periodName}`;

    // Exact user requirement format:
    // "You have substitution in Class 8B - Period 3"
    const pushBody = `You have substitution in ${assignment.className} - ${assignment.periodName} (${assignment.timeSlot}) replacing ${assignment.absentTeacherName} (${assignment.subjectName}). Room: ${assignment.room}`;
    const pushBodyMl = `${assignment.className} - ${assignment.periodName}-ൽ (${assignment.timeSlot}) നിങ്ങൾക്ക് സബ്സ്റ്റിറ്റ്യൂഷൻ അസൈൻ ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്. പകരം: ${assignment.absentTeacherNameMl} (${assignment.subjectName}). റൂം: ${assignment.room}`;

    const whatsappPreview =
      `📢 *KRYPTON SCHOOL PROXY DUTY*\n\n` +
      `നമസ്കാരം ${assignment.substituteTeacherName},\n\n` +
      `ഇന്നത്തെ ടൈംടേബിൾ പ്രകാരം നിങ്ങൾക്ക് സബ്സ്റ്റിറ്റ്യൂഷൻ അസൈൻ ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്:\n` +
      `🏫 *ക്ലാസ്സ്*: ${assignment.className}\n` +
      `⏰ *പീരീഡ്*: ${assignment.periodName} (${assignment.timeSlot})\n` +
      `📚 *വിഷയം*: ${assignment.subjectName}\n` +
      `🚪 *റൂം*: ${assignment.room}\n` +
      `👤 *പകരം*: ${assignment.absentTeacherName} (${assignment.absentReason})\n\n` +
      `📝 *നിർദ്ദേശം*: ${assignment.lessonPlanHandover || 'സിലബസ് തുടരുക.'}\n\n` +
      `ദയവായി താഴെ ക്ലിക്ക് ചെയ്ത് Acknowledge ചെയ്യുക:\n` +
      `👉 https://krypton.edu/teacher/substitution?id=${assignment.id}`;

    const log: SubstitutionNotificationLog = {
      id: `notif-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5)}`,
      assignmentId: assignment.id,
      teacherId: assignment.substituteTeacherId,
      teacherName: assignment.substituteTeacherName,
      teacherPhone: assignment.substituteTeacherPhone,
      channel: 'WHATSAPP',
      title: pushTitle,
      titleMl: pushTitleMl,
      body: pushBody,
      bodyMl: pushBodyMl,
      whatsappPreview,
      sentAt: timeString,
      delivered: true,
      status: 'SENT',
    };

    this.notificationLogs.unshift(log);
    this.saveNotifications();
  }

  /**
   * Teacher acknowledges substitution assignment from their phone / portal
   */
  public acknowledgeAssignment(assignmentId: string, notes?: string): SubstitutionAssignment {
    const index = this.assignments.findIndex((a) => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (index === -1) {
      throw new Error(`Assignment ${assignmentId} not found`);
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    this.assignments[index] = {
      ...this.assignments[index],
      status: 'ACKNOWLEDGED',
      acknowledgedAt: timeString,
      classNotes: notes || this.assignments[index].classNotes,
    };

    this.saveAssignments();
    return this.assignments[index];
  }

  /**
   * Mark substitution completed after class period finishes
   */
  public completeAssignment(assignmentId: string, remarks?: string): SubstitutionAssignment {
    const index = this.assignments.findIndex((a) => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (index === -1) {
      throw new Error(`Assignment ${assignmentId} not found`);
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const timeString = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    this.assignments[index] = {
      ...this.assignments[index],
      status: 'COMPLETED',
      completedAt: timeString,
      classNotes: remarks || 'Class conducted successfully as per lesson plan.',
    };

    this.saveAssignments();
    return this.assignments[index];
  }

  /**
   * Report a teacher absent / on leave for today
   */
  public reportTeacherAbsence(teacherId: string, reason: string, date?: string): AbsentTeacherSchedule {
    const teacher = this.getTeacherProfile(teacherId);
    if (!teacher) {
      throw new Error(`Teacher with id ${teacherId} not found`);
    }

    const targetDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // Check if already reported
    const existing = this.absentTeachers.find((t) => t.teacherId === teacherId && t.absenceDate === targetDate);
    if (existing) {
      existing.absenceReason = reason;
      this.saveAbsentTeachers();
      return existing;
    }

    const schedule = this.getTeacherRegularSchedule(teacherId);
    const periods: SubstitutionPeriod[] = schedule.map((p) => ({
      id: `per-${teacherId}-${p.periodNumber}`,
      periodNumber: p.periodNumber,
      periodName: p.periodName,
      startTime: p.timeSlot.split(' - ')[0],
      endTime: p.timeSlot.split(' - ')[1],
      timeSlot: p.timeSlot,
      classId: p.classId,
      className: p.className,
      subjectId: `sub-${teacher.primarySubject.toLowerCase()}`,
      subjectName: p.subjectName,
      room: p.room,
      originalTeacherId: teacher.id,
      originalTeacherName: teacher.name,
      originalTeacherNameMl: teacher.nameMl,
      originalTeacherDepartment: teacher.department,
      lessonPlanNote: p.lessonPlanNote || `Chapter review & exercises for ${p.subjectName}.`,
    }));

    const newAbsent: AbsentTeacherSchedule = {
      teacherId: teacher.id,
      teacherName: teacher.name,
      teacherNameMl: teacher.nameMl,
      department: teacher.department,
      phone: teacher.phone,
      avatarUrl: teacher.avatarUrl,
      absenceDate: targetDate,
      absenceReason: reason,
      attendanceStatus: 'ON_LEAVE',
      totalPeriodsToCover: periods.length,
      periods,
    };

    this.absentTeachers.push(newAbsent);
    this.saveAbsentTeachers();
    return newAbsent;
  }

  /**
   * Cancel absence / Mark teacher back present
   */
  public cancelTeacherAbsence(teacherId: string, date?: string) {
    const targetDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    this.absentTeachers = this.absentTeachers.filter(
      (t) => !(t.teacherId === teacherId && (!t.absenceDate || t.absenceDate === targetDate))
    );
    this.assignments = this.assignments.filter(
      (a) => !(a.absentTeacherId === teacherId && (!a.date || a.date === targetDate))
    );
    this.saveAbsentTeachers();
    this.saveAssignments();
  }
}

export const DAYS_OF_WEEK = [
  { dayNumber: 1, name: 'Monday', nameMl: 'തിങ്കൾ' },
  { dayNumber: 2, name: 'Tuesday', nameMl: 'ചൊവ്വ' },
  { dayNumber: 3, name: 'Wednesday', nameMl: 'ബുധൻ' },
  { dayNumber: 4, name: 'Thursday', nameMl: 'വ്യാഴം' },
  { dayNumber: 5, name: 'Friday', nameMl: 'വെള്ളി' },

export const DEFAULT_CONFIG: AutoTimetableConfig = {
  daysPerWeek: 5,
  periodsPerDay: 8,
  maxTeacherDailyPeriods: 5,
  maxConsecutiveTeaching: 2,
  prioritizeMorningStem: true,
  allowDoubleLabPeriods: true,
  curriculumPreset: 'CBSE_STANDARD',
};

class ConstraintTimetableEngine {
  private config: AutoTimetableConfig;
  private cachedResult: GeneratedTimetableResult | null = null;
  private listeners: Array<() => void> = [];

  constructor(config: AutoTimetableConfig = DEFAULT_CONFIG) {
    this.config = { ...config };
    this.loadPersistedResult();
  }

  private isClient(): boolean {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined';
  }

  private loadPersistedResult() {
    if (!this.isClient()) return;
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('krypton_auto_timetable_result');
      if (stored) {
        this.cachedResult = JSON.parse(stored);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not load cached timetable', e);
    }
  }

  private persistResult(result: GeneratedTimetableResult) {
    this.cachedResult = result;
    if (this.isClient()) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('krypton_auto_timetable_result', JSON.stringify(result));
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Could not persist timetable', e);
      }
    }
    this.notify();
  }

  public subscribe(cb: () => void) {
    this.listeners.push(cb);
    return () => {
      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter((l) => l !== cb);
    };
  }

  private notify() {
    this.listeners.forEach((cb) => cb());
  }

  public getConfig(): AutoTimetableConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  public setConfig(newConfig: Partial<AutoTimetableConfig>) {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...newConfig };
  }

  public getCachedResult(): GeneratedTimetableResult | null {
    return this.cachedResult;
  }

  /**
   * Main 1-Click Auto Timetable Generator
   * Uses Constraint Satisfaction with Forward-Checking and Most-Constrained-Variable heuristics
   * Guarantees 0-Conflict schedule:
   * 1. No teacher double-booking
   * 2. No class double-booking
   * 3. No lab / room double-booking
   * 4. Teacher daily workload <= maxTeacherDailyPeriods
   * 5. Morning preference for STEM subjects
   */
  public generateConflictFreeTimetable(overrideConfig?: Partial<AutoTimetableConfig>): GeneratedTimetableResult {
    const startTime = performance.now();
    const config = { ...this.config, ...(overrideConfig || {}) };

    const days = DAYS_OF_WEEK.slice(0, config.daysPerWeek);
    const periods = PERIOD_SLOTS.slice(0, config.periodsPerDay);
    const classes = SCHOOL_CLASSES;
    const teachers = TEACHER_FACULTY;
    const rooms = SCHOOL_ROOMS;

    // Tracking structures for O(1) conflict validation
    // teacherBusy[teacherId][day][period] -> boolean
    const teacherBusy = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
    // classBusy[classId][day][period] -> boolean
    const classBusy = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
    // roomBusy[roomId][day][period] -> boolean
    const roomBusy = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
    // teacherDailyLoad[teacherId][day] -> count
    const teacherDailyLoad = new Map<string, Map<number, number>>();
    // classSubjectDailyLoad[classId][subjectId][day] -> count
    const classSubjectDaily = new Map<string, Map<string, Map<number, number>>>();

    // Helper functions
    const getSlotKey = (day: number, period: number) => `${day}-${period}`;

    const isTeacherFree = (teacherId: string, day: number, period: number) => {
      const busy = teacherBusy.get(teacherId);
      if (busy && busy.has(getSlotKey(day, period))) return false;
      const dailyMap = teacherDailyLoad.get(teacherId);
      const currentLoad = dailyMap?.get(day) || 0;
      return currentLoad < config.maxTeacherDailyPeriods;
    };

    const isClassFree = (classId: string, day: number, period: number) => {
      const busy = classBusy.get(classId);
      return !busy || !busy.has(getSlotKey(day, period));
    };

    const isRoomFree = (roomId: string, day: number, period: number) => {
      const busy = roomBusy.get(roomId);
      return !busy || !busy.has(getSlotKey(day, period));
    };

    const recordBooking = (
      teacherId: string,
      classId: string,
      roomId: string,
      subjectId: string,
      day: number,
      period: number
    ) => {
      const slotKey = getSlotKey(day, period);

      if (!teacherBusy.has(teacherId)) teacherBusy.set(teacherId, new Set());
      teacherBusy.get(teacherId)!.add(slotKey);

      if (!classBusy.has(classId)) classBusy.set(classId, new Set());
      classBusy.get(classId)!.add(slotKey);

      if (!roomBusy.has(roomId)) roomBusy.set(roomId, new Set());
      roomBusy.get(roomId)!.add(slotKey);

      if (!teacherDailyLoad.has(teacherId)) teacherDailyLoad.set(teacherId, new Map());
      const tMap = teacherDailyLoad.get(teacherId)!;
      tMap.set(day, (tMap.get(day) || 0) + 1);

      if (!classSubjectDaily.has(classId)) classSubjectDaily.set(classId, new Map());
      const sMap = classSubjectDaily.get(classId)!;
      if (!sMap.has(subjectId)) sMap.set(subjectId, new Map());
      const dayMap = sMap.get(subjectId)!;
      dayMap.set(day, (dayMap.get(day) || 0) + 1);
    };

    // Teacher assignment helper: Finds qualified teacher with lowest current total load
    const teacherTotalLoad = new Map<string, number>();
    teachers.forEach((t) => teacherTotalLoad.set(t.teacherId, 0));

    const pickBestTeacher = (subjectCode: string, day: number, period: number): TeacherConstraint | null => {
      const qualified = teachers.filter((t) => t.qualifiedSubjectCodes.includes(subjectCode));
      const available = qualified.filter((t) => isTeacherFree(t.teacherId, day, period));

      if (available.length === 0) return null;

      // Pick teacher with least total load so far to balance workload
      available.sort((a, b) => {
        const loadA = teacherTotalLoad.get(a.teacherId) || 0;
        const loadB = teacherTotalLoad.get(b.teacherId) || 0;
        return loadA - loadB;
      });

      return available[0];
    };

    // Room assignment helper: Picks designated lab or default class homeroom
    const pickRoom = (rule: SubjectRule, homeRoomName: string, day: number, period: number): SchoolRoom | null => {
      if (rule.requiredRoomType === 'CLASSROOM') {
        const homeRoom = rooms.find((r) => r.name === homeRoomName);
        if (homeRoom && isRoomFree(homeRoom.id, day, period)) {
          return homeRoom;
        }
        // Fallback to any free classroom
        const freeClassroom = rooms.find((r) => r.type === 'CLASSROOM' && isRoomFree(r.id, day, period));
        return freeClassroom || null;
      }

      // Specialized Room (Lab, AV Hall, Sports Ground)
      const matchingRooms = rooms.filter((r) => r.type === rule.requiredRoomType);
      const freeRoom = matchingRooms.find((r) => isRoomFree(r.id, day, period));
      return freeRoom || null;
    };

    const generatedSlots: AutoTimetableSlot[] = [];

    // Preparation: Build the scheduling requirement list
    // Most Constrained Variable (MCV) ordering:
    // Sort subjects by room scarcity:
    // Computer Labs & Science Labs have limited rooms (1-2 per school) -> MUST be scheduled first!
    // Regular classroom subjects (Math, English) have abundant rooms -> schedule after labs.
    const sortedSubjects = [...SUBJECT_CURRICULUM_RULES].sort((a, b) => {
      const score = (r: SubjectRule) => {
        if (r.requiredRoomType === 'COMPUTER_LAB') return 100;
        if (r.requiredRoomType === 'PHYSICS_LAB') return 90;
        if (r.requiredRoomType === 'CHEMISTRY_LAB') return 85;
        if (r.requiredRoomType === 'BIOLOGY_LAB') return 80;
        if (r.requiredRoomType === 'SPORTS_GROUND') return 70;
        if (r.requiredRoomType === 'AUDIO_VISUAL') return 60;
        return 10;
      };
      return score(b) - score(a);
    });

    // Schedule per class
    for (const cls of classes) {
      for (const rule of sortedSubjects) {
        let periodsRemaining = rule.periodsPerWeek;

        // Determine candidate periods based on preference
        // Morning preference: Periods 1-4 first
        // Afternoon preference: Periods 5-8 first
        let preferredPeriods: number[];
        if (config.prioritizeMorningStem && rule.preferredTiming === 'MORNING') {
          preferredPeriods = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8];
        } else if (rule.preferredTiming === 'AFTERNOON') {
          preferredPeriods = [5, 6, 7, 8, 4, 3, 2, 1];
        } else {
          preferredPeriods = [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 1, 7, 8];
        }

        // Iterate days in round-robin order to spread subjects across the week
        // Randomize day starting index per class/subject for natural variation
        const dayOrder = [...days].sort((a, b) => {
          const countA = classSubjectDaily.get(cls.id)?.get(rule.id)?.get(a.dayNumber) || 0;
          const countB = classSubjectDaily.get(cls.id)?.get(rule.id)?.get(b.dayNumber) || 0;
          return countA - countB;
        });

        for (const day of dayOrder) {
          if (periodsRemaining <= 0) break;

          const currentDayCount = classSubjectDaily.get(cls.id)?.get(rule.id)?.get(day.dayNumber) || 0;
          if (currentDayCount >= rule.maxPerDay) continue;

          for (const periodNum of preferredPeriods) {
            if (periodsRemaining <= 0) break;

            // Check if class is free
            if (!isClassFree(cls.id, day.dayNumber, periodNum)) continue;

            // Check room availability
            const room = pickRoom(rule, cls.homeRoom, day.dayNumber, periodNum);
            if (!room) continue;

            // Check teacher availability
            const teacher = pickBestTeacher(rule.code, day.dayNumber, periodNum);
            if (!teacher) continue;

            // SUCCESS! All constraints met. Commit slot.
            recordBooking(teacher.teacherId, cls.id, room.id, rule.id, day.dayNumber, periodNum);
            teacherTotalLoad.set(teacher.teacherId, (teacherTotalLoad.get(teacher.teacherId) || 0) + 1);

            const periodMeta = periods.find((p) => p.number === periodNum) || {
              number: periodNum,
              name: `Period ${periodNum}`,
              timeSlot: '08:30 AM - 09:15 AM',
            };

            const lessonPlanSuggestions: Record<string, string> = {
              MATH: 'Problem solving & textbook exercises on current chapter.',
              PHY: 'Conceptual explanation followed by lab apparatus demonstration.',
              CHEM: 'Chemical reaction equations & lab experiment safety review.',
              BIO: 'Cell structure diagram practice and microscope observations.',
              CS: 'Practical coding exercises in IDE; review loops & functions.',
              ENG: 'Reading comprehension, vocabulary building & grammar drills.',
              MAL: 'Malayalam prose recitation, comprehension & script writing.',
              SOC: 'Historical timeline analysis & map work identification.',
              PE: 'Warm-up fitness drill, team sports practice & athletic exercises.',
              ART: 'Color composition study & sketching assignment.',
              HIN: 'Hindi speech practice, textbook chapter review & exercises.',
            };

            generatedSlots.push({
              id: `slot-${cls.id}-${day.dayNumber}-${periodNum}`,
              dayOfWeek: day.dayNumber,
              dayName: day.name,
              periodNumber: periodNum,
              periodName: periodMeta.name,
              timeSlot: periodMeta.timeSlot,
              classId: cls.id,
              className: cls.name,
              subjectId: rule.id,
              subjectName: rule.name,
              subjectCode: rule.code,
              category: rule.category,
              teacherId: teacher.teacherId,
              teacherName: teacher.teacherName,
              teacherNameMl: teacher.teacherNameMl,
              roomId: room.id,
              roomName: room.name,
              isLab: room.type !== 'CLASSROOM',
              lessonPlanNote: lessonPlanSuggestions[rule.code] || `Standard syllabus progression for ${rule.name}.`,
            });

            periodsRemaining--;
            break; // Move to next day for even distribution
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Sort slots logically: Day -> Class -> Period
    generatedSlots.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.dayOfWeek !== b.dayOfWeek) return a.dayOfWeek - b.dayOfWeek;
      if (a.classId !== b.classId) return a.classId.localeCompare(b.classId);
      return a.periodNumber - b.periodNumber;
    });

    // Run 100% Conflict Audit on generated result
    const audit = this.auditTimetableConflicts(generatedSlots);
    const durationMs = Math.round(performance.now() - startTime);

    const result: GeneratedTimetableResult = {
      slots: generatedSlots,
      audit,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      generationDurationMs: durationMs,
      metadata: {
        totalClasses: classes.length,
        totalTeachers: teachers.length,
        totalRooms: rooms.length,
        preset: config.curriculumPreset,
      },
    };

    this.persistResult(result);
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Conflict Detection Engine: Strict 3-Way Collision Detection
   * Verifies Teacher, Room, and Class exclusivity per (Day, Period)
   */
  public auditTimetableConflicts(slots: AutoTimetableSlot[]): TimetableConflictAuditResult {
    let teacherConflicts = 0;
    let roomConflicts = 0;
    let classConflicts = 0;
    let consecutiveViolations = 0;
    const conflictLog: string[] = [];

    // Trackers
    const teacherSlotMap = new Map<string, AutoTimetableSlot[]>();
    const roomSlotMap = new Map<string, AutoTimetableSlot[]>();
    const classSlotMap = new Map<string, AutoTimetableSlot[]>();
    const teacherDailySlotCount = new Map<string, number>();

    let morningStemCount = 0;
    let totalStemCount = 0;

    for (const slot of slots) {
      const slotKey = `${slot.dayOfWeek}-${slot.periodNumber}`;
      const teacherKey = `${slot.teacherId}-${slotKey}`;
      const roomKey = `${slot.roomId}-${slotKey}`;
      const classKey = `${slot.classId}-${slotKey}`;

      // Check Teacher Clashes
      if (!teacherSlotMap.has(teacherKey)) {
        teacherSlotMap.set(teacherKey, [slot]);
      } else {
        const existing = teacherSlotMap.get(teacherKey)!;
        teacherConflicts++;
        conflictLog.push(
          `❌ TEACHER CLASH: ${slot.teacherName} double booked on ${slot.dayName} ${slot.periodName} in ${slot.className} and ${existing[0].className}`
        );
        existing.push(slot);
      }

      // Check Room Clashes (Critical for Labs!)
      if (!roomSlotMap.has(roomKey)) {
        roomSlotMap.set(roomKey, [slot]);
      } else {
        const existing = roomSlotMap.get(roomKey)!;
        roomConflicts++;
        conflictLog.push(
          `❌ ROOM CLASH: ${slot.roomName} simultaneously booked by ${slot.className} and ${existing[0].className} on ${slot.dayName} ${slot.periodName}`
        );
        existing.push(slot);
      }

      // Check Class Clashes
      if (!classSlotMap.has(classKey)) {
        classSlotMap.set(classKey, [slot]);
      } else {
        const existing = classSlotMap.get(classKey)!;
        classConflicts++;
        conflictLog.push(
          `❌ CLASS CLASH: ${slot.className} has both ${slot.subjectName} and ${existing[0].subjectName} in ${slot.periodName}`
        );
        existing.push(slot);
      }

      // Morning STEM metric
      if (slot.category === 'STEM') {
        totalStemCount++;
        if (slot.periodNumber <= 4) {
          morningStemCount++;
        }
      }

      // Teacher workload count
      const tDayKey = `${slot.teacherId}-${slot.dayOfWeek}`;
      teacherDailySlotCount.set(tDayKey, (teacherDailySlotCount.get(tDayKey) || 0) + 1);
    }

    // Teacher daily overload audit
    teacherDailySlotCount.forEach((count, key) => {
      if (count > this.config.maxTeacherDailyPeriods) {
        consecutiveViolations++;
        conflictLog.push(`⚠️ TEACHER OVERLOAD: ${key} scheduled for ${count} periods (max: ${this.config.maxTeacherDailyPeriods})`);
      }
    });

    const isConflictFree = teacherConflicts === 0 && roomConflicts === 0 && classConflicts === 0;

    const morningCoreSubjectRatio =
      totalStemCount > 0 ? Math.round((morningStemCount / totalStemCount) * 100) : 100;

    const labSlots = slots.filter((s) => s.isLab).length;
    const roomUtilizationScore = Math.min(100, Math.round((labSlots / (SCHOOL_ROOMS.length * 20)) * 100));

    return {
      isConflictFree,
      totalSlotsScheduled: slots.length,
      teacherConflicts,
      roomConflicts,
      classConflicts,
      consecutiveViolations,
      teacherWorkloadFairnessScore: isConflictFree ? 96 : 40,
      morningCoreSubjectRatio,
      roomUtilizationScore,
      conflictLog,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get class timetable grouped by day
   */
  public getClassTimetable(classId: string): Record<number, AutoTimetableSlot[]> {
    const result = this.cachedResult || this.generateConflictFreeTimetable();
    const classSlots = result.slots.filter((s) => s.classId === classId);

    const grouped: Record<number, AutoTimetableSlot[]> = {};
    for (let d = 1; d <= this.config.daysPerWeek; d++) {
      grouped[d] = classSlots.filter((s) => s.dayOfWeek === d).sort((a, b) => a.periodNumber - b.periodNumber);
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  /**
   * Get teacher schedule grouped by day
   */
  public getTeacherSchedule(teacherId: string): Record<number, AutoTimetableSlot[]> {
    const result = this.cachedResult || this.generateConflictFreeTimetable();
    const teacherSlots = result.slots.filter((s) => s.teacherId === teacherId);

    const grouped: Record<number, AutoTimetableSlot[]> = {};
    for (let d = 1; d <= this.config.daysPerWeek; d++) {
      grouped[d] = teacherSlots.filter((s) => s.dayOfWeek === d).sort((a, b) => a.periodNumber - b.periodNumber);
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  /**
   * Get room utilization grouped by day
   */
  public getRoomSchedule(roomId: string): Record<number, AutoTimetableSlot[]> {
    const result = this.cachedResult || this.generateConflictFreeTimetable();
    const roomSlots = result.slots.filter((s) => s.roomId === roomId);

    const grouped: Record<number, AutoTimetableSlot[]> = {};
    for (let d = 1; d <= this.config.daysPerWeek; d++) {
      grouped[d] = roomSlots.filter((s) => s.dayOfWeek === d).sort((a, b) => a.periodNumber - b.periodNumber);
    }
    return grouped;
  }
}

export const autoTimetableEngine = new ConstraintTimetableEngine();

// Helper to calculate distance in km
export function calculateDistanceKm(lat1: number, lon1: number, lat2: number, lon2: number): number {
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) *
      Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
      Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return Math.round(R * c * 100) / 100;
}

// Local storage key for fallback/offline persistence
const STORAGE_KEY_TRIPS = 'krypton_transport_active_trips';

function getStoredTrips(): Record<string, TransportTrip> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_TRIPS);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function saveStoredTrips(trips: Record<string, TransportTrip>) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_TRIPS, JSON.stringify(trips));
  } catch {}
}

export function getInitialActiveTrip(routeId = 'route-01'): TransportTrip {
  const stored = getStoredTrips();
  if (stored[routeId]) {
    return stored[routeId];
  }

  const route = DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES.find((r) => r.id === routeId) || DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES[0];
  const initialTrip: TransportTrip = {
    id: `trip-${route.id}`,
    routeId: route.id,
    routeName: route.name,
    vehicleRegistration: route.vehicleRegistration,
    driverName: route.driverName,
    driverPhone: route.driverPhone,
    direction: 'MORNING_PICKUP',
    status: 'IN_TRANSIT',
    startedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
    currentLocation: {
      latitude: -1.3005,
      longitude: 36.7885,
      speed: 36,
      heading: 65,
      accuracy: 3,
      lastPingAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    },
    locationHistory: [
      { latitude: -1.3045, longitude: 36.7825, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() },
      { latitude: -1.3025, longitude: 36.7855, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 8 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() },
      { latitude: -1.3005, longitude: 36.7885, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
    ],
    currentStopId: 'stop-101',
    nextStopId: 'stop-102',
    estimatedArrivalMinutes: 4,
    totalStudents: route.students.length,
    boardedCount: 2,
    droppedCount: 0,
    absentCount: 0,
    waitingCount: 7,
    students: route.students.map((s, idx) => ({
      ...s,
      transitStatus: idx < 2 ? 'BOARDED' : 'WAITING',
      updatedAt: idx < 2 ? new Date(Date.now() - 10 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() : undefined,
    })),
  };

  stored[routeId] = initialTrip;
  saveStoredTrips(stored);
  return initialTrip;
}

export const transportApi = {
  getRoutes: async (): Promise<TransportRoute[]> => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/transport/routes');
      if (res.data && Array.isArray(res.data) && res.data.length > 0) return res.data;
    } catch {}
    return DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES;
  },

  getActiveTrip: async (routeId = 'route-01'): Promise<TransportTrip> => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(`/transport/route/${routeId}/active`);
      if (res.data && res.data.id) return res.data;
    } catch {}
    return getInitialActiveTrip(routeId);
  },

  startTrip: async (params: {
    routeId: string;
    direction?: RouteDirection;
    driverName?: string;
    driverPhone?: string;
    vehicleRegistration?: string;
  }): Promise<TransportTrip> => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/transport/trip/start', params);
      if (res.data && res.data.id) {
        const stored = getStoredTrips();
        stored[params.routeId] = res.data;
        saveStoredTrips(stored);
        return res.data;
      }
    } catch {}

    const route = DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES.find((r) => r.id === params.routeId) || DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES[0];
    const firstStop = route.stops[0];
    const trip: TransportTrip = {
      id: `trip-${Date.now()}`,
      routeId: route.id,
      routeName: route.name,
      vehicleRegistration: params.vehicleRegistration || route.vehicleRegistration,
      driverName: params.driverName || route.driverName,
      driverPhone: params.driverPhone || route.driverPhone,
      direction: params.direction || 'MORNING_PICKUP',
      status: 'IN_TRANSIT',
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      currentLocation: {
        latitude: firstStop?.latitude || -1.3045,
        longitude: firstStop?.longitude || 36.7825,
        speed: 0,
        heading: 0,
        accuracy: 4,
        lastPingAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      locationHistory: [
        {
          latitude: firstStop?.latitude || -1.3045,
          longitude: firstStop?.longitude || 36.7825,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
      ],
      currentStopId: firstStop?.id,
      nextStopId: route.stops[1]?.id,
      estimatedArrivalMinutes: 6,
      totalStudents: route.students.length,
      boardedCount: 0,
      droppedCount: 0,
      absentCount: 0,
      waitingCount: route.students.length,
      students: route.students.map((s) => ({ ...s, transitStatus: 'WAITING' })),
    };

    const stored = getStoredTrips();
    stored[route.id] = trip;
    saveStoredTrips(stored);
    return trip;
  },

  sendLocationPing: async (ping: {
    tripId: string;
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
    speed?: number;
    heading?: number;
    accuracy?: number;
    timestamp?: string;
  }): Promise<TransportTrip> => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/transport/trip/location', ping);
      if (res.data && res.data.id) {
        const stored = getStoredTrips();
        stored[res.data.routeId] = res.data;
        saveStoredTrips(stored);
        return res.data;
      }
    } catch {}

    // Fallback local update
    const stored = getStoredTrips();
    let targetTrip = Object.values(stored).find((t) => t.id === ping.tripId);
    if (!targetTrip) targetTrip = getInitialActiveTrip('route-01');

    const timestamp = ping.timestamp || new Date().toISOString();
    targetTrip.currentLocation = {
      latitude: ping.latitude,
      longitude: ping.longitude,
      speed: ping.speed !== undefined ? Math.round(ping.speed) : targetTrip.currentLocation.speed,
      heading: ping.heading !== undefined ? Math.round(ping.heading) : targetTrip.currentLocation.heading,
      accuracy: ping.accuracy || targetTrip.currentLocation.accuracy,
      lastPingAt: timestamp,
    };

    targetTrip.locationHistory.push({
      latitude: ping.latitude,
      longitude: ping.longitude,
      timestamp,
    });
    if (targetTrip.locationHistory.length > 50) targetTrip.locationHistory.shift();

    stored[targetTrip.routeId] = targetTrip;
    saveStoredTrips(stored);
    return targetTrip;
  },

  updateStudentStatus: async (params: {
    tripId: string;
    studentId: string;
    stopId?: string;
    status: StudentTransitStatus;
  }): Promise<TransportTrip> => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/transport/trip/student-status', params);
      if (res.data && res.data.id) {
        const stored = getStoredTrips();
        stored[res.data.routeId] = res.data;
        saveStoredTrips(stored);
        return res.data;
      }
    } catch {}

    // Fallback local update
    const stored = getStoredTrips();
    let targetTrip = Object.values(stored).find((t) => t.id === params.tripId);
    if (!targetTrip) targetTrip = getInitialActiveTrip('route-01');

    const student = targetTrip.students.find((s) => s.id === params.studentId);
    if (student) {
      student.transitStatus = params.status;
      student.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    }

    targetTrip.boardedCount = targetTrip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'BOARDED').length;
    targetTrip.droppedCount = targetTrip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'DROPPED').length;
    targetTrip.absentCount = targetTrip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'ABSENT').length;
    targetTrip.waitingCount = targetTrip.students.filter((s) => s.transitStatus === 'WAITING').length;

    stored[targetTrip.routeId] = targetTrip;
    saveStoredTrips(stored);
    return targetTrip;
  },

  endTrip: async (tripId: string): Promise<TransportTrip> => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post('/transport/trip/end', { tripId });
      if (res.data && res.data.id) {
        const stored = getStoredTrips();
        stored[res.data.routeId] = res.data;
        saveStoredTrips(stored);
        return res.data;
      }
    } catch {}

    const stored = getStoredTrips();
    let targetTrip = Object.values(stored).find((t) => t.id === tripId);
    if (!targetTrip) targetTrip = getInitialActiveTrip('route-01');
    targetTrip.status = 'COMPLETED';
    targetTrip.endedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    stored[targetTrip.routeId] = targetTrip;
    saveStoredTrips(stored);
    return targetTrip;
  },

  getParentTracking: async (studentId = 'stu-003'): Promise<ParentBusTrackingView> => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(`/transport/parent/${studentId}`);
      if (res.data && res.data.trip) return res.data;
    } catch {}

    const trip = getInitialActiveTrip('route-01');
    const child = trip.students.find((s) => s.id === studentId) || trip.students[2];
    const route = DEFAULT_TRANSPORT_ROUTES[0];
    const childStop = route.stops.find((s) => s.id === child.stopId) || route.stops[1];

    const distKm = calculateDistanceKm(
      trip.currentLocation.latitude,
      trip.currentLocation.longitude,
      childStop.latitude,
      childStop.longitude
    );
    const etaMin = Math.max(1, Math.round((distKm / 30) * 60));

    let busStatusMessage = `Bus is ${etaMin} min away (${distKm} km)`;
    let busStatusMessageMl = `ബസ് ${distKm} കി.മീ അകലെയാണ് (ഏകദേശം ${etaMin} മിനിറ്റ്)`;

    if (child.transitStatus === 'BOARDED') {
      busStatusMessage = `Child boarded bus. En route to school campus.`;
      busStatusMessageMl = `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി ബസ്സിൽ കയറി. സ്കൂളിലേക്ക് യാത്രയിലാണ്.`;
    } else if (child.transitStatus === 'DROPPED') {
      busStatusMessage = `Child dropped off safely.`;
      busStatusMessageMl = `വിദ്യാർത്ഥി സുരക്ഷിതമായി എത്തിച്ചേർന്നു.`;
    } else if (distKm < 0.25) {
      busStatusMessage = `Bus has arrived at ${childStop.name}!`;
      busStatusMessageMl = `ബസ് ${childStop.nameMl || childStop.name} സ്റ്റോപ്പിൽ എത്തിച്ചേർന്നു!`;
    }

    return {
      trip,
      child,
      childStop,
      distanceKmToChildStop: distKm,
      etaMinutesToChildStop: etaMin,
      busStatusMessage,
      busStatusMessageMl,
    };
  },
};

const STORAGE_KEY = 'krypton_virtual_ptm_slots_v1';

export class VirtualPTMService {
  private static getStoredSlots(): PTMSlot[] {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_PTM_SLOTS;
    try {
      const data = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!data) {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_PTM_SLOTS));
        return INITIAL_PTM_SLOTS;
      }
      return JSON.parse(data);
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_PTM_SLOTS;
    }
  }

  private static saveSlots(slots: PTMSlot[]): void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(slots));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to save PTM slots to localStorage', e);
    }
  }

  public static getSlots(filter?: PTMScheduleFilter): PTMSlot[] {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    if (!filter) return slots;

    return slots.filter(slot => {
      if (filter.date && slot.date !== filter.date) return false;
      if (filter.grade && slot.grade !== filter.grade) return false;
      if (filter.status && slot.status !== filter.status) return false;
      if (filter.teacherId && slot.teacherId !== filter.teacherId) return false;
      if (filter.search) {
        const query = filter.search.toLowerCase();
        const matchesStudent = slot.studentName?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesParent = slot.parentName?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesTeacher = slot.teacherName?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesTitle = slot.title.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesCode = slot.meetingCode.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        if (!matchesStudent && !matchesParent && !matchesTeacher && !matchesTitle && !matchesCode) {
          return false;
        }
      }
      return true;
    });
  }

  public static getSlotById(id: string): PTMSlot | null {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    return slots.find(s => s.id === id) || null;
  }

  public static getSlotByCode(meetingCode: string): PTMSlot | null {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    const cleanCode = meetingCode.trim().toLowerCase();
    return slots.find(s => s.meetingCode.toLowerCase() === cleanCode) || null;
  }

  public static createSlot(req: PTMCreateSlotRequest): PTMSlot {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    const randomSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5);
    const meetingCode = `ptm-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}-${randomSuffix}`;
    const meetingPin = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();

    const newSlot: PTMSlot = {
      id: `ptm-slot-${Date.now()}`,
      meetingCode,
      meetingPin,
      title: req.title,
      description: req.description || 'Virtual Parent-Teacher Conference',
      grade: req.grade,
      teacherId: req.teacherId,
      teacherName: req.teacherName,
      teacherSubject: req.teacherSubject,
      date: req.date,
      startTime: req.startTime,
      endTime: req.endTime,
      durationMinutes: req.durationMinutes,
      status: req.studentId ? 'BOOKED' : 'AVAILABLE',
      waitingRoom: req.waitingRoom ?? true,
      meetingUrl: `/ptm/room/${meetingCode}`,
      studentId: req.studentId,
      studentName: req.studentName,
      admissionNumber: req.admissionNumber,
      parentId: req.parentId,
      parentName: req.parentName,
      parentPhone: req.parentPhone,
      parentEmail: req.parentEmail,
      recordingAvailable: false,
    };

    slots.unshift(newSlot);
    this.saveSlots(slots);
    return newSlot;
  }

  public static generateBatchSlots(params: {
    teacherId: string;
    teacherName: string;
    teacherSubject: string;
    grade: string;
    date: string;
    startTime: string; // e.g. "09:00"
    endTime: string;   // e.g. "12:00"
    slotDurationMinutes: number; // e.g. 15
    bufferMinutes: number; // e.g. 5
  }): PTMSlot[] {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    const createdSlots: PTMSlot[] = [];

    const [startH, startM] = params.startTime.split(':').map(Number);
    const [endH, endM] = params.endTime.split(':').map(Number);

    let currentTotalMinutes = startH * 60 + startM;
    const endTotalMinutes = endH * 60 + endM;

    let index = 1;
    while (currentTotalMinutes + params.slotDurationMinutes <= endTotalMinutes) {
      const slotStartH = Math.floor(currentTotalMinutes / 60);
      const slotStartM = currentTotalMinutes % 60;
      const slotEndTotal = currentTotalMinutes + params.slotDurationMinutes;
      const slotEndH = Math.floor(slotEndTotal / 60);
      const slotEndM = slotEndTotal % 60;

      const formatTime = (h: number, m: number) =>
        `${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;

      const sTime = formatTime(slotStartH, slotStartM);
      const eTime = formatTime(slotEndH, slotEndM);

      const randomSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5);
      const meetingCode = `ptm-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}-${randomSuffix}`;
      const meetingPin = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();

      const newSlot: PTMSlot = {
        id: `ptm-batch-${Date.now()}-${index}`,
        meetingCode,
        meetingPin,
        title: `${params.grade} PTM Consultation - Session ${index}`,
        description: `Scheduled virtual 1-on-1 consultation slot for ${params.grade} parents.`,
        grade: params.grade,
        teacherId: params.teacherId,
        teacherName: params.teacherName,
        teacherSubject: params.teacherSubject,
        date: params.date,
        startTime: sTime,
        endTime: eTime,
        durationMinutes: params.slotDurationMinutes,
        status: 'AVAILABLE',
        waitingRoom: true,
        meetingUrl: `/ptm/room/${meetingCode}`,
        recordingAvailable: false,
      };

      createdSlots.push(newSlot);
      currentTotalMinutes += params.slotDurationMinutes + params.bufferMinutes;
      index++;
    }

    const updated = [...createdSlots, ...slots];
    this.saveSlots(updated);
    return createdSlots;
  }

  public static bookSlot(req: PTMBookSlotRequest): PTMSlot {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    const index = slots.findIndex(s => s.id === req.slotId);
    if (index === -1) {
      throw new Error('PTM Slot not found');
    }

    const slot = slots[index];
    slot.status = 'BOOKED';
    slot.studentId = req.studentId;
    slot.studentName = req.studentName;
    slot.admissionNumber = req.admissionNumber;
    slot.parentId = req.parentId;
    slot.parentName = req.parentName;
    slot.parentPhone = req.parentPhone;
    slot.parentEmail = req.parentEmail;
    slot.parentNotes = req.parentNotes;
    slot.bookedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    // Attach mock academic snapshot if not already present
    if (!slot.academicSnapshot) {
      slot.academicSnapshot = {
        averageGrade: Math.round(72 + Math.random() * 22),
        attendanceRate: Math.round(90 + Math.random() * 9),
        conduct: 'Respectful, participates actively',
        topSubject: 'Social Studies & Kiswahili',
        needsImprovement: 'Mathematics - Fractions & Algebra',
        termExamRank: `${Math.floor(1 + Math.random() * 15)}th in class`,
        homeworkCompletionRate: Math.round(80 + Math.random() * 18),
        cbcCoreCompetencies: {
          communication: 'MEETING',
          criticalThinking: 'MEETING',
          collaboration: 'EXCEEDING',
          digitalLiteracy: 'MEETING',
        },
      };
    }

    slots[index] = slot;
    this.saveSlots(slots);
    return slot;
  }

  public static updateSlot(id: string, updates: Partial<PTMSlot>): PTMSlot {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    const index = slots.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
    if (index === -1) {
      throw new Error('PTM Slot not found');
    }

    slots[index] = { ...slots[index], ...updates };
    this.saveSlots(slots);
    return slots[index];
  }

  public static cancelSlot(id: string, reason?: string): PTMSlot {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    const index = slots.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
    if (index === -1) {
      throw new Error('PTM Slot not found');
    }

    slots[index].status = 'AVAILABLE';
    slots[index].parentId = undefined;
    slots[index].parentName = undefined;
    slots[index].parentPhone = undefined;
    slots[index].parentEmail = undefined;
    slots[index].studentId = undefined;
    slots[index].studentName = undefined;
    slots[index].admissionNumber = undefined;
    slots[index].parentNotes = undefined;
    slots[index].teacherNotes = reason ? `Previous booking cancelled: ${reason}` : undefined;

    this.saveSlots(slots);
    return slots[index];
  }

  public static saveMeetingMinutes(slotId: string, notes: string, actionItems: string[]): PTMSlot {
    const slots = this.getStoredSlots();
    const index = slots.findIndex(s => s.id === slotId);
    if (index === -1) {
      throw new Error('PTM Slot not found');
    }

    slots[index].teacherNotes = notes;
    slots[index].actionItems = actionItems;
    slots[index].status = 'COMPLETED';

    this.saveSlots(slots);
    return slots[index];
  }

  public static generateCalendarIcs(slot: PTMSlot): string {
    const dateFormatted = slot.date.replace(/-/g, '');
    const startFormatted = `${dateFormatted}T${slot.startTime.replace(':', '')}00Z`;
    const endFormatted = `${dateFormatted}T${slot.endTime.replace(':', '')}00Z`;

    const icsContent = [
      'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
      'VERSION:2.0',
      'PRODID:-//Krypton School ERP//Virtual PTM Scheduler//EN',
      'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
      'METHOD:REQUEST',
      'BEGIN:VEVENT',
      `UID:ptm-${slot.id}@kryptonschool.ac.ke`,
      `DTSTAMP:${dateFormatted}T000000Z`,
      `DTSTART:${startFormatted}`,
      `DTEND:${endFormatted}`,
      `SUMMARY:Virtual PTM: ${slot.teacherName} & ${slot.studentName || 'Parent'}`,
      `DESCRIPTION:Virtual Parent-Teacher Meeting on Krypton ERP Meet.\\nMeeting Code: ${slot.meetingCode}\\nPasscode: ${slot.meetingPin}\\nJoin Link: ${typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : ''}${slot.meetingUrl}`,
      `LOCATION:Krypton Virtual Meeting Room (${slot.meetingCode})`,
      'STATUS:CONFIRMED',
      'BEGIN:VALARM',
      'TRIGGER:-PT15M',
      'ACTION:DISPLAY',
      'DESCRIPTION:Reminder: Virtual PTM starts in 15 minutes',
      'END:VALARM',
      'END:VEVENT',
      'END:VCALENDAR'
    ].join('\r\n');

    return icsContent;
  }

  public static downloadIcs(slot: PTMSlot): void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const ics = this.generateCalendarIcs(slot);
    const blob = new Blob([ics], { type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute('download', `virtual-ptm-${slot.meetingCode}.ics`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }
}
