class WhatsAppClientStore {
  private messages: WhatsAppCloudMessage[] = [...INITIAL_MESSAGES];
  private students: StudentParentContact[] = [...INITIAL_STUDENTS];
  private invoices: FeeInvoiceItem[] = [...INITIAL_INVOICES];
  private pdfDocuments: SchoolPdfDocument[] = [...INITIAL_PDF_DOCUMENTS];
  private config: WhatsAppAutomationConfig = {
    wabaId: 'WABA_254700889900',
    phoneNumberId: 'PNID_254712000111',
    displayPhoneNumber: '+254 712 000 111',
    businessName: 'Krypton Academy Nairobi (Official)',
    apiTokenConfigured: true,
    webhookVerified: true,
    morningAbsenceTriggerTime: '08:30 AM',
    autoFeeReminderDaysBeforeDue: 3,
    autoPdfDeliveryEnabled: true,
    defaultLanguage: 'sw',
  };

  getMessages(): WhatsAppCloudMessage[] {
    return [...this.messages];
  }

  getStudents(): StudentParentContact[] {
    return [...this.students];
  }

  getInvoices(): FeeInvoiceItem[] {
    return [...this.invoices];
  }

  getPdfDocuments(): SchoolPdfDocument[] {
    return [...this.pdfDocuments];
  }

  getConfig(): WhatsAppAutomationConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<WhatsAppAutomationConfig>): WhatsAppAutomationConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  getStats(): WhatsAppAutomationStats {
    const totalSent = this.messages.length;
    const totalDelivered = this.messages.filter((m) => ['DELIVERED', 'READ', 'REPLIED'].includes(m.status)).length;
    const totalRead = this.messages.filter((m) => ['READ', 'REPLIED'].includes(m.status)).length;
    const openRatePercentage = totalDelivered > 0 ? Number(((totalRead / totalDelivered) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 98.6;

    const paidInvoices = this.invoices.filter((i) => i.status === 'PAID');
    const paymentCollected = paidInvoices.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.amountKsh, 0);

    return {
      totalSentToday: totalSent + 185,
      totalDelivered: totalDelivered + 182,
      totalRead: totalRead + 180,
      openRatePercentage: 98.9,
      paymentConversionsCount: paidInvoices.length + 42,
      paymentCollectedAmount: paymentCollected + 420000, // in KSh
      pdfDownloadsCount: 215,
      avgReadTimeMinutes: 2.4,
    };
  }

  // Feature 1: Trigger Absentee Notifications (Kenya Context)
  sendAbsenteeAlert(studentId: string, language: WhatsAppLanguage = 'sw'): WhatsAppCloudMessage {
    const student = this.students.find((s) => s.id === studentId);
    if (!student) {
      throw new Error(`Student ${studentId} not found`);
    }

    const isSw = language === 'sw';
    const isMl = language === 'ml';
    const currentTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    let header = '🔴 School Absence Alert';
    let bodyText = `Dear Parent (${student.parentName}), \n\nYour child ${student.name} (${student.className}, Roll: ${student.rollNumber}) has been marked ABSENT today during morning roll call at ${currentTime}.\n\nPlease ensure your child is safe. If this is an unexpected absence, please contact the school administration immediately.`;
    let sickBtn = '🤒 Sick Leave';
    let busBtn = '🚗 Transport Delay';
    let callBtn = '📞 Call School Office';

    if (isSw) {
      header = '🔴 Arifa ya Mahudhurio (Absence Alert)';
      bodyText = `Mpendwa Mzazi (${student.parentName}), \n\nMwanao ${student.name} (${student.className}, Roll: ${student.rollNumber}) hakuhudhuria shuleni leo asubuhi wakati wa mahudhurio ya saa ${currentTime}.\n\nTafadhali thibitisha ikiwa yuko salama nyumbani au unahitaji usaidizi kutoka kwa uongozi wa shule.`;
      sickBtn = '🤒 Mtoto ni Mgonjwa (Sick)';
      busBtn = '🚌 Basi Lilichelewa (Late)';
      callBtn = '📞 Piga Simu Shuleni';
    } else if (isMl) {
      header = '🔴 സ്കൂൾ ഹാജർ അറിയിപ്പ് (Absence Alert)';
      bodyText = `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ (${student.parentName}), നിങ്ങളുടെ കുട്ടി ${student.name} (${student.className}, Roll: ${student.rollNumber}) ഇന്ന് രാവിലത്തെ ഹാജർ നിലയിൽ എത്തിയിട്ടില്ലെന്ന് രേഖപ്പെടുത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. കുട്ടി സുരക്ഷിതമാണെന്ന് ഉറപ്പുവരുത്തുക.`;
      sickBtn = '🤒 അസുഖം / Sick Leave';
      busBtn = '🚌 യാത്രാ തടസ്സം / Late';
      callBtn = '📞 സ്കൂളുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെടുക';
    }

    const newMsg: WhatsAppCloudMessage = {
      id: `msg-wa-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: 'tenant-kps-kenya',
      recipientPhone: student.phone,
      parentName: student.parentName,
      studentId: student.id,
      studentName: student.name,
      studentClass: student.className,
      type: 'ABSENCE_ALERT',
      language,
      headerText: header,
      bodyText,
      footerText: 'Krypton Academy Nairobi • Safaricom Meta Cloud API',
      buttons: [
        {
          type: 'QUICK_REPLY',
          text: sickBtn,
          payload: 'REASON_SICK',
        },
        {
          type: 'QUICK_REPLY',
          text: busBtn,
          payload: 'REASON_TRAVEL',
        },
        {
          type: 'PHONE_NUMBER',
          text: callBtn,
          phoneNumber: '+254712000111',
        },
      ],
      attendanceDetails: {
        date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        rollNumber: student.rollNumber,
        reportedTime: currentTime,
        parentAcknowledged: false,
      },
      status: 'READ',
      sentAt: currentTime,
      deliveredAt: currentTime,
      readAt: currentTime,
      wabaMessageId: `wamid.HBgM${Date.now()}`,
    };

    this.messages.unshift(newMsg);
    return newMsg;
  }

  // Feature 2: Trigger 1-Click Fee Payment Link (M-Pesa STK Push)
  sendFeeReminder(invoiceId: string, language: WhatsAppLanguage = 'sw'): WhatsAppCloudMessage {
    const invoice = this.invoices.find((i) => i.id === invoiceId);
    if (!invoice) {
      throw new Error(`Invoice ${invoiceId} not found`);
    }

    const isSw = language === 'sw';
    const isMl = language === 'ml';
    const currentTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    let header = '💳 School Fee Reminder (Lipa Na M-Pesa)';
    let bodyText = `Dear ${invoice.parentName}, \n\nFee due reminder for ${invoice.studentName} (${invoice.className}).\n\n• Invoice No: ${invoice.invoiceNumber}\n• Description: ${invoice.description}\n• Amount Due: KSh ${invoice.amountKsh.toLocaleString()}\n• Due Date: ${invoice.dueDate}\n• M-Pesa Paybill: ${invoice.mpesaPaybill}\n• Account No: ${invoice.mpesaAccountNumber}\n\nTap the 1-Click M-Pesa button below to trigger an instant STK PIN prompt directly on your Safaricom line.`;
    let payBtnText = `⚡ 1-Click Pay KSh ${invoice.amountKsh.toLocaleString()} via M-Pesa`;
    let viewBtnText = '📄 View Fee Breakdown';

    if (isSw) {
      header = '💳 Kikumbusho cha Ada (Lipa Na M-Pesa)';
      bodyText = `Mpendwa ${invoice.parentName}, \n\nKikumbusho cha ada ya shule ya ${invoice.studentName} (${invoice.className}).\n\n• Nambari ya Ankara: ${invoice.invoiceNumber}\n• Maelezo: ${invoice.descriptionSw}\n• Kiasi Kinachodaiwa: KSh ${invoice.amountKsh.toLocaleString()}\n• Tarehe ya Mwisho: ${invoice.dueDate}\n• M-Pesa Paybill: ${invoice.mpesaPaybill}\n• Akaunti: ${invoice.mpesaAccountNumber}\n\nBofya kitufe cha M-Pesa hapa chini kupokea arifa ya papo hapo (STK Push) kwenye simu yako na uweke PIN yako ya M-Pesa kwa urahisi.`;
      payBtnText = `⚡ Lipa KSh ${invoice.amountKsh.toLocaleString()} via M-Pesa`;
      viewBtnText = '📄 Tazama Ankara';
    } else if (isMl) {
      header = '💳 സ്കൂൾ ഫീ പേയ്‌മെന്റ് റിമൈൻഡർ (M-Pesa)';
      bodyText = `പ്രിയ ${invoice.parentName}, ${invoice.studentName} (${invoice.className}) യുടെ സ്കൂൾ ഫീസ് KSh ${invoice.amountKsh.toLocaleString()} M-Pesa വഴി അടയ്ക്കാൻ താഴെയുള്ള ബട്ടൺ ക്ലിക്ക് ചെയ്യുക. Paybill: ${invoice.mpesaPaybill}, Acc: ${invoice.mpesaAccountNumber}.`;
      payBtnText = `⚡ Pay KSh ${invoice.amountKsh.toLocaleString()} via M-Pesa`;
      viewBtnText = '📄 ഇൻവോയ്സ് വിവരങ്ങൾ';
    }

    const newMsg: WhatsAppCloudMessage = {
      id: `msg-wa-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: 'tenant-kps-kenya',
      recipientPhone: invoice.parentPhone,
      parentName: invoice.parentName,
      studentId: invoice.studentId,
      studentName: invoice.studentName,
      studentClass: invoice.className,
      type: 'FEE_PAYMENT_LINK',
      language,
      headerText: header,
      bodyText,
      footerText: 'Safaricom Daraja API • Instant M-Pesa Receipt',
      paymentDetails: {
        invoiceId: invoice.id,
        invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,
        amount: invoice.amountKsh,
        currency: 'KES',
        dueDate: invoice.dueDate,
        paymentUrl: `https://pay.kryptonschool.co.ke/inv/${invoice.invoiceNumber}`,
        paymentMethod: 'MPESA_STK',
        mpesaPaybill: invoice.mpesaPaybill,
        mpesaAccountNumber: invoice.mpesaAccountNumber,
        status: invoice.status,
      },
      buttons: [
        {
          type: 'URL',
          text: payBtnText,
          url: `https://pay.kryptonschool.co.ke/mpesa/pay/${invoice.invoiceNumber}`,
        },
        {
          type: 'URL',
          text: viewBtnText,
          url: `https://pay.kryptonschool.co.ke/inv/${invoice.invoiceNumber}`,
        },
      ],
      status: 'READ',
      sentAt: currentTime,
      deliveredAt: currentTime,
      readAt: currentTime,
      wabaMessageId: `wamid.HBgM${Date.now()}`,
    };

    this.messages.unshift(newMsg);
    return newMsg;
  }

  // Feature 3: Digital PDF Delivery (Kenyan Report Card, M-Pesa Receipt, Circular)
  sendPdfDelivery(documentId: string, language: WhatsAppLanguage = 'sw'): WhatsAppCloudMessage {
    const doc = this.pdfDocuments.find((d) => d.id === documentId);
    if (!doc) {
      throw new Error(`Document ${documentId} not found`);
    }

    const isSw = language === 'sw';
    const isMl = language === 'ml';
    const currentTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    let header = '';
    let bodyText = '';
    let recipientPhone = '+254 712 345 678';
    let parentName = 'David Kipchoge';
    let studentName = 'Brian Kipchoge';
    let studentClass = 'Grade 8B (JSS)';
    let studentId = 'std-ken-101';
    let msgType: WhatsAppMessageType = 'REPORT_CARD_PDF';

    if (doc.type === 'REPORT_CARD') {
      msgType = 'REPORT_CARD_PDF';
      if (isSw) {
        header = '🎓 Ripoti Rasmi ya Mtihani (CBC PDF)';
        bodyText = `Mpendwa ${parentName},\n\nKadi rasmi ya ripoti ya mtihani wa ${studentName} kwa Muhula wa 2 (CBC Assessment) imeambatishwa hapa.\n\n${doc.summarySw}\n\nUnaweza kupakua na kuhifadhi nakala rasmi ya PDF hapa hapa WhatsApp bila kuingia kwenye tovuti.`;
      } else if (isMl) {
        header = '🎓 പരീക്ഷാ ഫല പ്രോഗ്രസ് കാർഡ് (PDF)';
        bodyText = `പ്രിയ ${parentName},\n\n${studentName} ന്റെ ഔദ്യോഗിക പരീക്ഷാ ഫലം (PDF) താഴെ നൽകുന്നു.\n\n${doc.summary}`;
      } else {
        header = '🎓 Official Assessment Report Card (PDF)';
        bodyText = `Dear ${parentName},\n\nOfficial Term 2 Progress Report Card for ${studentName} is attached below.\n\n${doc.summary}\n\nYou can download and save the verified signed document directly from WhatsApp.`;
      }
    } else if (doc.type === 'FEE_RECEIPT') {
      msgType = 'FEE_RECEIPT_PDF';
      if (isSw) {
        header = '🧾 Risiti Rasmi ya M-Pesa (Verified PDF)';
        bodyText = `Mpendwa ${parentName},\n\nMalipo ya ada ya ${studentName} kupitia Lipa Na M-Pesa yamepokelewa kikamilifu. Risiti yako rasmi ya PDF yenye stempu ya KRA imeambatishwa.\n\n${doc.summarySw}`;
      } else if (isMl) {
        header = '🧾 എം-പെസ ഫീ റെസീപ്റ്റ് (Official PDF)';
        bodyText = `പ്രിയ ${parentName},\n\n${studentName} ന്റെ M-Pesa ഫീ പേയ്‌മെന്റ് വിജയകരമായി സ്വീകരിച്ചു. ഔദ്യോഗിക രസീത് PDF താഴെ ഡൗൺലോഡ് ചെയ്യാം.\n\n${doc.summary}`;
      } else {
        header = '🧾 Official M-Pesa Fee Receipt (PDF)';
        bodyText = `Dear ${parentName},\n\nM-Pesa fee payment received successfully for ${studentName}. Your official verified PDF tax receipt is attached.\n\n${doc.summary}`;
      }
    } else {
      msgType = 'SCHOOL_NOTICE_PDF';
      if (isSw) {
        header = '📢 Waraka Rasmi wa Shule (Notice PDF)';
        bodyText = `Mpendwa Mzazi,\n\nTangazo muhimu kutoka kwa uongozi wa shule: ${doc.titleSw}.\n\n${doc.summarySw}\n\nTafadhali pakua na usome waraka kamili ulioambatishwa.`;
      } else if (isMl) {
        header = '📢 സ്കൂൾ നോട്ടീസ് & സർക്കുലർ (PDF)';
        bodyText = `പ്രിയ രക്ഷിതാവേ, സ്കൂൾ നോട്ടീസ് താഴെ നൽകുന്നു: ${doc.title}.\n\n${doc.summary}`;
      } else {
        header = '📢 Official School Notice (PDF)';
        bodyText = `Dear Parent,\n\nOfficial circular from the School Administration: ${doc.title}.\n\n${doc.summary}\n\nPlease download and review the official notice.`;
      }
    }

    const newMsg: WhatsAppCloudMessage = {
      id: `msg-wa-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: 'tenant-kps-kenya',
      recipientPhone,
      parentName,
      studentId,
      studentName,
      studentClass,
      type: msgType,
      language,
      headerText: header,
      bodyText,
      footerText: 'Krypton Academy Nairobi • Official Verified PDF',
      attachment: {
        type: 'DOCUMENT',
        filename: `${doc.title.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}.pdf`,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        fileSizeBytes: doc.fileSizeBytes,
        url: doc.downloadUrl,
        caption: isSw ? doc.titleSw : doc.title,
      },
      pdfDetails: {
        documentId: doc.id,
        documentTitle: doc.title,
        documentType: doc.type,
        termOrPeriod: doc.termOrSession,
        downloadUrl: doc.downloadUrl,
        pagesCount: doc.pagesCount,
      },
      buttons: [
        {
          type: 'URL',
          text: `📥 ${isSw ? 'Pakua PDF' : isMl ? 'Download PDF' : 'Download PDF'} (${(doc.fileSizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`,
          url: doc.downloadUrl,
        },
        {
          type: 'QUICK_REPLY',
          text: isSw ? '✅ Nimeona / Sawa' : isMl ? '✅ കണ്ടു / Acknowledged' : '✅ Acknowledged',
          payload: 'ACK_PDF',
        },
      ],
      status: 'READ',
      sentAt: currentTime,
      deliveredAt: currentTime,
      readAt: currentTime,
      wabaMessageId: `wamid.HBgM${Date.now()}`,
    };

    this.messages.unshift(newMsg);
    return newMsg;
  }

  // Interactive Simulator Action: Parent completes M-Pesa STK push or clicks quick reply
  simulateParentAction(
    messageId: string,
    action: 'LEAVE_REASON' | 'PAY_FEE' | 'ACKNOWLEDGE',
    payloadValue?: string,
  ): { success: boolean; feedbackMessage: string; followUpMessage?: WhatsAppCloudMessage } {
    const msg = this.messages.find((m) => m.id === messageId);
    if (!msg) {
      return { success: false, feedbackMessage: 'Message not found' };
    }

    const currentTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    if (action === 'LEAVE_REASON') {
      if (msg.attendanceDetails) {
        msg.attendanceDetails.parentAcknowledged = true;
        msg.attendanceDetails.reason = payloadValue || 'Ugonjwa / Sick Leave';
        msg.attendanceDetails.acknowledgedAt = currentTime;
      }
      msg.status = 'REPLIED';

      // Auto-reply confirmation from school bot in Swahili/English
      const followUp: WhatsAppCloudMessage = {
        id: `msg-wa-${Date.now()}`,
        tenantId: 'tenant-kps-kenya',
        recipientPhone: msg.recipientPhone,
        parentName: msg.parentName,
        studentId: msg.studentId,
        studentName: msg.studentName,
        studentClass: msg.studentClass,
        type: 'CUSTOM_ANNOUNCEMENT',
        language: msg.language,
        headerText: msg.language === 'sw' ? '✅ Sababu ya Kutohudhuria Imerekodiwa' : '✅ Leave Reason Acknowledged',
        bodyText:
          msg.language === 'sw'
            ? `Asante ${msg.parentName}. Taarifa yako kuhusu kutohudhuria kwa ${msg.studentName} ("${payloadValue || 'Mgonjwa'}") imerekodiwa katika sajili ya shule na mwalimu wa darasa amearifiwa.`
            : `Thank you ${msg.parentName}. The absence reason for ${msg.studentName} ("${payloadValue || 'Medical Leave'}") has been logged into the school portal and the class teacher has been notified.`,
        footerText: 'Krypton Academy Automated Desk',
        status: 'READ',
        sentAt: currentTime,
        deliveredAt: currentTime,
        readAt: currentTime,
        wabaMessageId: `wamid.HBgM${Date.now()}`,
      };
      this.messages.unshift(followUp);

      return {
        success: true,
        feedbackMessage: 'Sababu ya kutohudhuria imesasishwa kwenye mfumo wa shule!',
        followUpMessage: followUp,
      };
    }

    if (action === 'PAY_FEE') {
      const mpesaRef = `QKJ${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}ABC`;
      if (msg.paymentDetails) {
        msg.paymentDetails.status = 'PAID';
        msg.paymentDetails.paidAt = currentTime;
        msg.paymentDetails.transactionId = mpesaRef;
        msg.paymentDetails.mpesaReceiptNumber = mpesaRef;
      }
      msg.status = 'REPLIED';

      // Update invoice in store
      const inv = this.invoices.find((i) => i.id === msg.paymentDetails?.invoiceId);
      if (inv) {
        inv.status = 'PAID';
        inv.paidAt = currentTime;
        inv.transactionId = mpesaRef;
        inv.mpesaReceiptNumber = mpesaRef;
      }

      // Generate & auto-deliver official PDF M-Pesa Receipt
      const receiptDoc = this.pdfDocuments.find((d) => d.type === 'FEE_RECEIPT') || this.pdfDocuments[1];
      const followUpReceipt = this.sendPdfDelivery(receiptDoc.id, msg.language);

      return {
        success: true,
        feedbackMessage: `Malipo ya KSh ${msg.paymentDetails?.amount.toLocaleString()} kupitia M-Pesa (Ref: ${mpesaRef}) yamekamilika! Risiti ya PDF imetumwa WhatsApp.`,
        followUpMessage: followUpReceipt,
      };
    }

    if (action === 'ACKNOWLEDGE') {
      msg.status = 'REPLIED';
      return {
        success: true,
        feedbackMessage: 'Taarifa imethibitishwa na mzazi.',
      };
    }

    return { success: true, feedbackMessage: 'Updated' };
  }
}

export const whatsAppClient = new WhatsAppClientStore();

import { apiClient } from './api-client';
export function messageFor(error: unknown) {
 const value = error as { response?: { data?: { message?: string | string[] } }; message?: string };
 const message = value.response?.data?.message;
 return Array.isArray(message) ? message.join('. ') : message || 'Could not complete the request. Please try again.';
}
export const money = (value: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE',{style:'currency',currency:'KES',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(value / 100);
export const dateLabel = (value: string) => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleDateString('en-KE',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'}) : '?';
export async function getRows(endpoint: string, params?: Record<string,string>) {
 const {data} = await apiClient.get(endpoint,{params});
 return Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items || data.data || [];
}
export function exportCsv(name:string, columns: {label:string;key:string}[], rows:Record<string,unknown>[]) {
 const cell = (value:unknown) => {
  let text=String(value??''); if (/^[=+@\-\t\r]/.test(text)) text="'"+text;
  return '"'+text.replaceAll('"','""')+'"';
 };
 const csv = [columns.map(c=>cell(c.label)).join(','),...rows.map(row=>columns.map(c=>cell(row[c.key])).join(','))].join('\r\n');
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\ufeff'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}));
 const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name+'.csv';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

## 🎯 Key Design Patterns

1. **Service Layer Pattern**: Business logic separated in services
2. **Repository Pattern**: Prisma ORM for data access
3. **Queue Pattern**: Bull for asynchronous job processing
4. **Scheduler Pattern**: Cron jobs for automated tasks
5. **DTO Pattern**: Data validation and transformation
6. **Factory Pattern**: Report generation utilities
7. **Strategy Pattern**: Different sync types (full, incremental)
8. **Observer Pattern**: Alerts and notifications

## 🔐 Security Architecture

```
Request Flow Security
├── 1. JWT Authentication
│   └──► Verify token, extract user & tenant
├── 2. Role-Based Access Control
│   └──► Check user permissions
├── 3. Tenant Isolation
│   └──► Filter all queries by tenantId
├── 4. Input Validation
│   └──► class-validator DTOs
├── 5. Data Encryption
│   └──► AES-256-GCM for credentials
├── 6. Audit Logging
│   └──► Track all operations
└── 7. Rate Limiting
    └──► Throttle API requests
```

## 📈 Scalability Considerations

- **Horizontal Scaling**: Stateless services, shared Redis queue
- **Queue-Based Processing**: Background jobs prevent API timeout
- **Database Indexing**: Optimized queries on common fields
- **Caching Strategy**: Redis for frequently accessed data
- **Retry Logic**: Exponential backoff for failed jobs
- **Circuit Breaker**: Prevent cascading failures

---

**Architecture designed for reliability, scalability, and maintainability! 🏗️**

# Krypton School ERP - System Architecture

## Executive Summary

**Product:** Krypton School ERP  
**Company:** KryptonLogic  
**Target Market:** Kenyan Private Schools, CBC/CBE Schools, Academies, Tuition Centres  
**Architecture:** Multi-tenant SaaS Platform  
**Status:** Production-Ready Development

## 1. System Overview

Krypton School ERP is a comprehensive, cloud-based school management system built as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. Each school operates as an independent tenant with complete data isolation while sharing the same application infrastructure.

### 1.1 Business Model
- Annual subscription plans (Starter, Professional, Enterprise)
- Per-school pricing: KES 15,000 - 80,000/year
- Feature-based entitlements
- Free trial period
- Automated billing and renewals

### 1.2 Key Capabilities
- Student lifecycle management
- School fee management with M-Pesa integration
- CBC-compliant assessments and reporting
- Attendance tracking
- Parent and teacher portals
- Multi-channel communications
- Financial accounting
- Operations management (transport, library, inventory)

## 2. Architecture Principles

### 2.1 Design Philosophy
- **Modular Monolith First:** Start with a well-structured monolith with clear module boundaries
- **Tenant Isolation:** Absolute data separation between schools at all layers
- **Mobile-First:** Optimized for low-cost smartphones and slower networks
- **Offline-Capable:** Critical functions queue locally and sync when connected
- **Secure by Default:** Multi-layer security, encryption, audit logging
- **Kenyan-Optimized:** M-Pesa, CBC curriculum, local compliance

### 2.2 Technology Stack

#### Frontend
- **Framework:** Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript 5+
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 3+
- **Components:** Headless UI / Radix UI (accessible)
- **State Management:** React Context + TanStack Query
- **Forms:** React Hook Form + Zod validation
- **PWA:** next-pwa for offline support
- **i18n:** next-intl (English, Swahili)

#### Backend
- **Framework:** NestJS 10+
- **Language:** TypeScript 5+
- **API Style:** REST with OpenAPI documentation
- **Validation:** class-validator, class-transformer
- **Authentication:** JWT + Passport.js
- **Background Jobs:** BullMQ + Redis
- **File Storage:** S3-compatible (MinIO/AWS S3)
- **Logging:** Winston + structured JSON

#### Database
- **Primary DB:** PostgreSQL 15+
- **ORM:** Prisma 5+
- **Cache:** Redis 7+
- **Search:** PostgreSQL full-text search
- **Migrations:** Prisma Migrate
- **Backup:** pg_dump + encryption

#### Infrastructure
- **Containerization:** Docker + Docker Compose
- **Reverse Proxy:** Nginx
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions
- **Monitoring:** Prometheus + Grafana (optional)
- **Logging:** ELK Stack or similar (optional)
- **Error Tracking:** Sentry (optional)

## 3. Multi-Tenant Architecture

### 3.1 Tenant Isolation Strategy

**Approach:** Shared database with tenant ID discrimination (Row-Level Multi-Tenancy)

**Rationale:**
- Cost-effective for thousands of schools
- Simpler operations and maintenance
- Easier cross-tenant analytics for platform admin
- Sufficient isolation with proper implementation

**Key Implementation:**
1. Every table includes `tenantId` (school ID)
2. All queries filtered by tenant context
3. PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policies
4. Middleware enforces tenant context
5. API layer validates tenant access
6. Automated tests verify isolation

### 3.2 Tenant Identification

```typescript
// Request flow
Incoming Request 
  → Extract tenant from: 
    - Subdomain (school-name.kryptonschool.com)
    - Custom domain (www.exampleschool.ac.ke)
    - JWT claim (tenantId)
  → Set tenant context in request
  → All DB queries auto-filtered by tenantId
```

### 3.3 Data Isolation Layers

1. **Application Layer:** Tenant middleware
2. **ORM Layer:** Global tenant filter in Prisma
3. **Database Layer:** Row-Level Security policies
4. **API Layer:** Route guards checking tenant ownership
5. **Test Layer:** Cross-tenant access tests

### 3.4 Tenant Provisioning

```
Super Admin creates school
  → Generate unique tenantId
  → Create school record
  → Create default admin user
  → Initialize fee structures
  → Set up academic calendar
  → Assign subscription plan
  → Send welcome email with credentials
```

## 6. Database Schema Design

### 6.1 Schema Principles

1. **Multi-tenant by default:** Every tenant-specific table has `tenantId`
2. **Audit trails:** `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `createdBy`, `updatedBy`
3. **Soft deletes:** Use `deletedAt` where recovery is needed
4. **Financial precision:** Use `DECIMAL(19,2)` or integer minor units
5. **Immutable records:** Financial transactions never deleted, only reversed
6. **Referential integrity:** Foreign keys enforced
7. **Indexes:** On tenant ID, foreign keys, and query-heavy fields

### 6.2 Core Tables Overview

```sql
-- Platform/Tenant Management
tenants (id, name, subdomain, customDomain, status, ...)
subscriptions (id, tenantId, planId, status, startDate, endDate, ...)
plans (id, name, price, features, limits, ...)

-- User Management
users (id, tenantId, email, passwordHash, role, ...)
roles (id, tenantId, name, permissions, ...)
audit_logs (id, tenantId, userId, action, entityType, entityId, ...)

-- Student Management
students (id, tenantId, admissionNumber, firstName, lastName, ...)
guardians (id, tenantId, firstName, lastName, phone, email, ...)
guardian_student_links (id, guardianId, studentId, relationship, ...)

-- Academic Management
academic_years (id, tenantId, name, startDate, endDate, ...)
terms (id, tenantId, academicYearId, name, startDate, endDate, ...)
classes (id, tenantId, name, level, ...)
streams (id, tenantId, classId, name, ...)
subjects (id, tenantId, name, code, ...)
enrollments (id, tenantId, studentId, classId, streamId, termId, ...)

-- Assessment Management
examinations (id, tenantId, termId, name, startDate, endDate, ...)
grades (id, tenantId, examinationId, studentId, subjectId, marks, ...)
report_cards (id, tenantId, studentId, termId, status, ...)

-- Finance Management
fee_structures (id, tenantId, termId, classId, ...)
fee_items (id, feeStructureId, name, amount, ...)
invoices (id, tenantId, studentId, termId, totalAmount, paidAmount, ...)
invoice_items (id, invoiceId, description, amount, ...)
payments (id, tenantId, invoiceId, amount, method, reference, ...)
mpesa_transactions (id, tenantId, merchantRequestId, checkoutRequestId, ...)
receipts (id, tenantId, paymentId, receiptNumber, ...)

-- Attendance Management
attendance_records (id, tenantId, studentId, date, status, ...)
staff_attendance (id, tenantId, staffId, date, status, ...)

-- Operations
timetables (id, tenantId, classId, day, period, subjectId, teacherId, ...)
vehicles (id, tenantId, registrationNumber, capacity, ...)
routes (id, tenantId, name, ...)

-- Communication

```

### 6.3 Multi-Tenant Access Pattern

```typescript
// Every query automatically filtered
const students = await prisma.student.findMany({
  where: {
    tenantId: currentTenantId, // Injected by middleware
    classId: '...'
  }
});

// Enforced at Prisma middleware level
prisma.$use(async (params, next) => {
  if (params.model && !GLOBAL_MODELS.includes(params.model)) {
    params.args.where = {
      ...params.args.where,
      tenantId: getTenantContext()
    };
  }
  return next(params);
});
```

## 7. Security Architecture

### 7.1 Authentication Flow

```
1. User submits credentials (email + password)
2. Backend validates against user table
3. Backend generates JWT with claims:
   - userId
   - tenantId
   - role
   - permissions
4. Backend returns access token + refresh token
5. Frontend stores tokens securely (httpOnly cookies)
6. Every API request includes token
7. Backend validates token and extracts tenant context
```

### 7.2 Authorization Model

**Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**

```typescript
@Roles('PRINCIPAL', 'SCHOOL_ADMIN')
@UseGuards(RolesGuard)
async updateFeeStructure() { ... }

@Permissions('students:read', 'students:export')
@UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
async exportStudents() { ... }
```

**Default Roles:**
- SUPER_ADMIN (platform)
- SCHOOL_OWNER
- PRINCIPAL
- DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL
- SCHOOL_ADMINISTRATOR
- ACCOUNTANT
- TEACHER
- CLASS_TEACHER
- PARENT
- STUDENT

### 7.3 Security Layers

1. **Transport Security:** TLS 1.2+ for all connections
2. **Authentication:** JWT tokens with expiration
3. **Authorization:** RBAC + fine-grained permissions
4. **Tenant Isolation:** Multi-layer enforcement
5. **Input Validation:** DTOs with class-validator
6. **Rate Limiting:** Per-endpoint limits
7. **CSRF Protection:** Token-based for state-changing operations
8. **SQL Injection:** Parameterized queries via Prisma
9. **XSS Protection:** Input sanitization, CSP headers
10. **File Upload:** Type validation, size limits, virus scanning
11. **Secrets Management:** Environment variables, never committed
12. **Audit Logging:** All sensitive operations logged

### 7.4 Data Protection

**Encryption at Rest:**
- Database: PostgreSQL encryption
- Files: Encrypted storage bucket
- Backups: Encrypted archives
- Secrets: Encrypted in secrets manager

**Encryption in Transit:**
- HTTPS/TLS for all API calls
- WSS for WebSocket connections
- Encrypted database connections

**Personal Data Handling:**
- Minimal collection
- Purpose limitation
- Access controls
- Retention schedules
- Data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure)
- Breach notification procedures

## 8. M-Pesa Integration Architecture

### 8.1 Integration Strategy

**Official Safaricom Daraja API Integration**

**Supported Payment Methods:**
1. **STK Push (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online):** Initiated by school/parent
2. **C2B (Customer to Business):** Parent-initiated via Paybill

### 8.2 Payment Flow - STK Push

```
1. Parent views outstanding fees in portal
2. Parent clicks "Pay with M-Pesa"
3. Parent enters amount and phone number
4. Frontend sends payment request to backend
5. Backend validates:
   - Student exists and belongs to tenant
   - Amount is valid
   - Invoice exists
6. Backend calls Daraja STK Push API
7. Daraja returns MerchantRequestId + CheckoutRequestId
8. Backend stores transaction with PENDING status
9. User's phone receives M-Pesa prompt
10. User enters M-Pesa PIN
11. Daraja sends callback to our endpoint
12. Backend validates callback authenticity
13. Backend processes callback idempotently:
    - Check transaction not already processed
    - Verify amount matches
    - Update transaction status
    - Allocate payment to invoice
    - Generate receipt
    - Send confirmation notification
14. Parent receives receipt
```

### 8.3 Payment Architecture Principles

1. **Per-School Credentials:** Each school has own Paybill/merchant config
2. **Idempotency:** Same callback processed once only
3. **Reconciliation:** Periodic verification against provider records
4. **Retry Logic:** Handle network failures gracefully
5. **Webhook Security:** Validate callback source and signature
6. **Timeout Handling:** Query status for unconfirmed transactions
7. **Partial Payments:** Support multiple payments per invoice
8. **Refunds:** Reversal transactions with audit trail

### 8.4 M-Pesa Transaction States

```
INITIATED → User action pending
PENDING → Waiting for callback
SUCCESS → Payment confirmed, allocated, receipt issued
FAILED → Payment declined or cancelled
TIMEOUT → No callback received, requires status query
RECONCILED → Verified against provider records
```

### 8.5 Critical Safety Features

- **Duplicate Prevention:** CheckoutRequestId uniqueness
- **Amount Verification:** Callback amount matches request
- **Transaction Locking:** Prevent concurrent callback processing
- **Manual Review Queue:** Unmatched payments flagged for admin
- **Audit Trail:** Every state change logged
- **Financial Controls:** Double-entry accounting validation

# Krypton School ERP — Comprehensive Technical Audit Report
**Date:** October 11, 2026  
**Auditor:** Antigravity Senior Software & Security Architecture Assessment Team  
**Scope:** Full repository technical audit across Architecture, Multi-Tenant Security, Database Integrity, Financial Logic, API Completeness, Frontend UX, Testing, and DevOps.  
**Baseline Quality Score:** 7.2 / 10  
**Target Quality Score:** = 9.0 / 10  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

A comprehensive architectural and security audit of the Krypton School ERP monorepo was executed. Krypton School ERP is architected as a Next.js (frontend) and NestJS (backend) monorepo utilizing PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, managed with pnpm workspaces and Turborepo. 

While the architectural vision and initial domain modeling are robust, several critical technical liabilities were identified that prevent production readiness:
1. **Critical Multi-Tenant Isolation Vulnerabilities:** Database query middleware relies on legacy Prisma `$use` that breaks on `findUnique` operations and lacks deterministic tenant enforcement across shared API gateways.
2. **Financial Race Conditions & Non-Atomic Callbacks:** M-Pesa STK push and C2B payment processing lack database row locking and transactional boundaries, risking duplicate payment allocations.
3. **Ghost Modules & Incomplete Workflows:** `StaffModule` is an empty shell (`controllers: [], providers: []`), while `PlatformModule` relies on unstructured generic table reflection rather than enterprise SaaS management.
4. **Recent Frontend Regressions:** Working dashboard implementations in teacher, parent, and platform administration were partially displaced by generic placeholder components, breaking type contracts and i18n localization in Swahili and French.
5. **Zero Test Coverage:** No unit, integration, or E2E tests exist in the repository (0% coverage).
6. **Deployment Infrastructure Deficiencies:** No production Dockerfile, CI/CD pipeline, backup automation, or staging environments are configured.

---

## 2. Detailed Technical Findings & Severity Classification

| ID | Module / Component | Exact File Path | Severity | Finding & Impact | Recommended Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **SEC-01** | Multi-Tenancy / DB | `packages/database/src/middleware/tenant-filter.ts` | **CRITICAL** | `createTenantFilterMiddleware` mutates `findUnique` and `findUniqueOrThrow` queries with `{ ...where, tenantId }`. In Prisma, `findUnique` rejects non-unique compound fields, causing query crashes or bypassing tenant checks. Furthermore, if `tenantId` is null, queries proceed unfiltered. | Convert read actions for `findUnique`/`findUniqueOrThrow` to `findFirst`/`findFirstOrThrow` with explicit tenant conditions. Enforce strict non-null tenant assertion for tenant-scoped operations. |
| **SEC-02** | Auth & Multi-Tenancy | `apps/api/src/common/middleware/tenant-resolution.middleware.ts` & `apps/api/src/common/guards/tenant.guard.ts` | **CRITICAL** | `TenantResolutionMiddleware` only inspects subdomains and custom domains. Requests to shared API endpoints (e.g., `api.domain.com` or local testing) fail to resolve tenant from JWT claims or headers. Additionally, `TenantGuard` is NOT registered globally in `app.module.ts`, leaving routes without `@UseGuards(TenantGuard)` vulnerable. | Register `TenantGuard` globally or standardize guard chains. Update middleware and auth pipeline to resolve and validate tenant identity from verified JWT claims with cross-tenant access rejection. |
| **SEC-03** | Auth & Token Security | `apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts` | **HIGH** | User lookup during authentication accepts potential ambiguities if duplicate emails exist across separate school tenants; token rotation lacks Redis-backed blacklisting or cryptographic invalidation on logout. | Enforce composite unique indexing `(tenantId, email)`. Require school subdomain / identifier during login or provide unambiguous tenant selection. Implement token version incrementation on logout. |
| **FIN-01** | Payments & M-Pesa | `apps/api/src/modules/mpesa/mpesa.service.ts` (lines 255–340) | **CRITICAL** | STK Push callback handling checks `if (transaction.callbackReceived)` in memory without row-level locking or idempotency keys. Concurrent webhook calls from Safaricom can execute `recordPayment()` multiple times, causing duplicate fee credits. | Wrap callback processing inside an interactive `prisma.$transaction()` with explicit state transition checks (`UPDATE ... WHERE callbackReceived = false`). |
| **FIN-02** | Payments & M-Pesa | `apps/api/src/modules/mpesa/mpesa.service.ts` (lines 420–490) | **HIGH** | C2B payment confirmation relies on finding an invoice where `invoiceNumber == dto.BillRefNumber`. If multiple tenants share the same invoice number format (e.g. `INV-001`), resolution fails and payment is dropped. Does not support student admission numbers or shortcode mapping. | Resolve tenant using `dto.BusinessShortCode` mapped to `School.mpesaShortcode`, and match `BillRefNumber` against both invoice numbers and student admission numbers within that tenant. |
| **MOD-01** | Staff Administration | `apps/api/src/modules/staff/staff.module.ts` | **HIGH** | `StaffModule` contains empty `controllers: []` and `providers: []`. There are no dedicated REST endpoints or service layer for staff directory, contracts, department filtering, or staff credentials. | Implement `StaffController`, `StaffService`, and DTOs for staff CRUD, role assignment, departmental listing, and portal provisioning. |
| **MOD-02** | SaaS Administration | `apps/api/src/modules/platform/` & `apps/web/src/app/admin/` | **HIGH** | Platform administration relies on generic table introspection rather than structured SaaS business logic (subscription plan changes, tenant provisioning, system health telemetry, audit log inspection). | Implement dedicated platform endpoints for tenant onboarding, subscription status management, tenant suspension/reactivation, and audit logging. |
| **MOD-03** | Academic & Attendance | `apps/api/src/modules/attendance/attendance.service.ts` & `packages/types/src/enums.ts` | **MEDIUM** | Mismatch between Prisma `AttendanceStatus` enums and application enum definitions (`UNAUTHORIZED_ABSENCE` vs `ABSENT`, `EXCUSED_ABSENCE` vs `EXCUSED`), leading to compile-time warnings and calculation discrepancies. | Harmonize enum definitions between `packages/types`, `packages/database`, and API services. |
| **MOD-04** | Communication Engine | `apps/api/src/modules/communications/communications.service.ts` | **MEDIUM** | Type comparison error on `MessageChannel.PUSH` when the database only supports `SMS`, `EMAIL`, and `IN_APP`. Delivery status callbacks and SMS provider error backoff are unhandled. | Fix type definitions, remove nonexistent enum comparisons, and implement structured SMS/Email delivery logging. |
| **UI-01** | Frontend UX & Portals | `apps/web/src/app/teacher/*`, `apps/web/src/app/dashboard/*`, `apps/web/src/app/admin/*` | **HIGH** | Rich custom dashboards for teachers, parents, and admins were replaced with generic table viewers, stripping interactive features (STK Push modals, student selectors, attendance registers, report card cards). | Restore and optimize full-featured portal interfaces while ensuring real backend integration and responsive layouts. |
| **UI-02** | Localization & Types | `apps/web/src/i18n/translations.ts` | **MEDIUM** | French (`fr`) and Swahili (`sw`) translation dictionaries are missing dozens of keys added to English (`en`), causing TypeScript compiler errors during production build. | Synchronize translation dictionary schemas across all supported languages (en, sw, fr). |
| **QA-01** | Automated Testing | Monorepo Root & All Packages | **CRITICAL** | Zero test files exist (`0.0%` test coverage). No tenant isolation tests, payment callback tests, auth tests, or end-to-end user journey tests exist. | Construct comprehensive testing suites in Jest: Unit tests, API integration tests, and Multi-tenant isolation verification tests. |
| **OPS-01** | Production Deployment | Monorepo Root | **HIGH** | No multi-stage Dockerfiles for `@krypton/api` and `@krypton/web`. No CI/CD workflow, database migration automation in container startup, or health probe endpoints (`/health/live`, `/health/ready`). | Build production-ready Dockerfiles, GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, automated backup scripts, and standard NestJS health checks. |

## 🚀 How to Use

### For End Users

1. **On Login Page:**
   - Look for language switcher in top-right corner
   - Click to toggle between English (🇬🇧) and Swahili (🇰🇪)
   - Your choice is saved automatically

2. **While Logged In:**
   - Find language switcher in navigation bar
   - Click to switch languages instantly
   - All text updates immediately
   - Preference persists across sessions

### For Developers

1. **Use Translation Hook:**
```typescript
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function MyComponent() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>{t('common.welcome')}</h1>
      <button>{t('auth.signIn')}</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

2. **Add Language Switcher:**
```typescript
import LanguageSwitcher from '@/components/LanguageSwitcher';

// Compact version (for navigation bars)
<LanguageSwitcher variant="compact" />

// Full version (for login pages)
<LanguageSwitcher />
```

3. **Add New Translations:**
```typescript
// In apps/web/src/i18n/translations.ts

// 1. Add to interface
export interface Translations {
  myModule: {
    myKey: string;
  };
}

// 2. Add English
en: {
  myModule: {
    myKey: 'English text',
  },
}

// 3. Add Swahili
sw: {
  myModule: {
    myKey: 'Maandishi ya Kiswahili',
  },
}

// 4. Use in component
const { t } = useTranslation();
return <p>{t('myModule.myKey')}</p>;
```

# Bilingual Implementation Guide (English & Swahili)

## Overview

The Krypton School ERP application now supports complete bilingual functionality with English and Swahili (Kiswahili), Kenya's national language. Users can switch between languages seamlessly across all portals (Parent, Teacher, and Admin).

## Implementation Summary

### Architecture Components

1. **Language Context Provider** (`LanguageContext.tsx`)
   - Manages current language state (en/sw)
   - Persists language preference in localStorage
   - Provides language switching functions
   - Prevents hydration mismatches

2. **Translation Hook** (`useTranslation.ts`)
   - Custom React hook for accessing translations
   - Provides `t()` function for retrieving translated strings
   - Supports nested translation keys (e.g., `t('auth.email')`)
   - Falls back to English if translation missing

3. **Language Switcher Component** (`LanguageSwitcher.tsx`)
   - Two variants: default dropdown and compact toggle
   - Shows flag icons (🇬🇧 for English, 🇰🇪 for Kiswahili)
   - Integrated in all navigation bars
   - Available on login pages before authentication

4. **Comprehensive Translations File** (`translations.ts`)
   - 300+ translated strings covering all features
   - Organized by modules (common, auth, parent, teacher, admin)
   - Includes calendar terms (days/months)
   - Status messages and confirmations

## File Structure

```
apps/web/src/
├── contexts/
│   └── LanguageContext.tsx          # Language state management
├── hooks/
│   └── useTranslation.ts            # Translation hook
├── components/
│   ├── LanguageSwitcher.tsx         # Language switcher UI
│   ├── DashboardNav.tsx             # Parent portal nav (translated)
│   ├── TeacherNav.tsx               # Teacher portal nav (translated)
│   ├── AdminNav.tsx                 # Admin portal nav (translated)
│   └── LoginScreen.tsx              # Shared login component (translated)
├── i18n/
│   └── translations.ts              # All translation strings
└── app/
    ├── layout.tsx                   # Root layout with LanguageProvider
    ├── login/page.tsx               # Parent login (translated)
    └── teacher/login/page.tsx       # Teacher login (translated)
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic Translation in Component

```typescript
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function MyComponent() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>{t('common.welcome')}</h1>
      <p>{t('auth.signIn')}</p>
      <button>{t('common.submit')}</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Navigation Component with Translations

```typescript
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import LanguageSwitcher from '@/components/LanguageSwitcher';

export function MyNav() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <nav>
      <LanguageSwitcher variant="compact" />
      <a href="/dashboard">{t('common.dashboard')}</a>
      <button onClick={logout}>{t('auth.signOut')}</button>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

### Adding Language Switcher to Login Pages

```typescript
import LanguageSwitcher from '@/components/LanguageSwitcher';

export default function LoginPage() {
  return (
    <div>
      {/* Language Switcher - Top Right */}
      <div className="flex justify-end mb-4">
        <LanguageSwitcher />
      </div>
      
      {/* Login form */}
      <form>...</form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Translation Key Structure

Translation keys use dot notation for organization:

```typescript
// Common keys
t('common.appName')           // "Krypton School ERP" / "Krypton School ERP"
t('common.dashboard')         // "Dashboard" / "Dashibodi"
t('common.save')              // "Save" / "Hifadhi"

// Auth keys
t('auth.signIn')              // "Sign in" / "Ingia"
t('auth.email')               // "Email Address" / "Barua pepe"
t('auth.password')            // "Password" / "Nywila"

// Parent portal keys
t('parent.fees')              // "Fees" / "Ada"
t('parent.attendance')        // "Attendance" / "Mahudhurio"
t('parent.payNow')            // "Pay Now" / "Lipa Sasa"

// Teacher portal keys
t('teacher.myClasses')        // "My Classes" / "Madarasa Yangu"
t('teacher.markAttendance')   // "Mark Attendance" / "Weka Mahudhurio"

// Admin portal keys
t('admin.platformAdmin')      // "Platform Admin" / "Msimamizi wa Jukwaa"
t('admin.schools')            // "Schools" / "Shule"
t('admin.subscriptions')      // "Subscriptions" / "Usajili"

// Status keys
t('status.active')            // "Active" / "Inatumika"
t('status.pending')           // "Pending" / "Inasubiri"

// Calendar keys
t('calendar.monday')          // "Monday" / "Jumatatu"
t('calendar.january')         // "January" / "Januari"
```

## Language Persistence

Language preference is automatically:
- Saved to localStorage on change
- Loaded on app initialization
- Persists across browser sessions
- Independent per device/browser

Storage key: `preferred-language`  
Values: `'en'` or `'sw'`

## Responsive Design

The LanguageSwitcher adapts to different screen sizes:

**Desktop:**
- Full dropdown with flags and language names
- Positioned in navigation bars

**Mobile:**
- Compact toggle showing flag icon and code (EN/SW)
- Minimal space usage in mobile navigation

## Adding New Translations

### Step 1: Add to Interface

```typescript
// In apps/web/src/i18n/translations.ts

export interface Translations {
  myModule: {
    newKey: string;
    anotherKey: string;
  };
}
```

### Step 2: Add English Translation

```typescript
en: {
  myModule: {
    newKey: 'English text',
    anotherKey: 'Another English text',
  },
}
```

### Step 3: Add Swahili Translation

```typescript
sw: {
  myModule: {
    newKey: 'Maandishi ya Kiswahili',
    anotherKey: 'Maandishi mengine ya Kiswahili',
  },
}
```

### Step 4: Use in Component

```typescript
const { t } = useTranslation();
return <p>{t('myModule.newKey')}</p>;
```

## Best Practices

### ✅ DO:

1. **Use Translation Keys Everywhere**
   - Never hardcode user-facing text
   - Always use `t('key')` for strings

2. **Organize Keys Logically**
   - Group by feature/module
   - Use consistent naming conventions

3. **Test Both Languages**
   - Verify all text displays correctly
   - Check for layout issues with longer Swahili text

4. **Provide Context**
   - Use descriptive key names
   - Add comments for complex translations

5. **Handle Missing Keys Gracefully**
   - Hook automatically falls back to English
   - Console warning for missing keys

### ❌ DON'T:

1. **Don't Hardcode Text**
   ```typescript
   // BAD
   <button>Sign In</button>
   
   // GOOD
   <button>{t('auth.signIn')}</button>
   ```

2. **Don't Skip Translation Updates**
   - Always update both languages
   - Keep translations in sync

3. **Don't Translate Technical Terms**
   - Email, SMS, API remain as-is
   - User-facing labels should be translated

4. **Don't Assume Text Length**
   - Swahili text may be longer
   - Design for flexible text lengths

## Swahili Translation Guidelines

### Key Principles

1. **Formal vs. Informal**
   - Use formal Swahili for professional context
   - "Ingia" (formal) vs "Ingia tu" (informal)

2. **Direct Translation**
   - Maintain meaning, not literal words
   - "Dashboard" → "Dashibodi" (borrowed term, commonly understood)

3. **Technical Terms**
   - Some terms kept in English where commonly used
   - SMS, Email, API, M-Pesa remain unchanged

4. **Cultural Appropriateness**
   - Use Kenyan Swahili conventions
   - Respect educational terminology

### Common Swahili Terms Used

| English | Swahili | Context |
|---------|---------|---------|
| School | Shule | General |
| Student | Mwanafunzi | General |
| Teacher | Mwalimu | General |
| Parent | Mzazi | General |
| Fees | Ada | Financial |
| Payment | Malipo | Financial |
| Attendance | Mahudhurio | Academic |
| Grades | Alama | Academic |
| Dashboard | Dashibodi | Technical |
| Login | Ingia | Auth |
| Logout | Toka | Auth |
| Settings | Mipangilio | System |

### Translation Updates

When updating translations:
1. Edit `apps/web/src/i18n/translations.ts`
2. Update both `en` and `sw` objects
3. Test changes in both languages
4. Verify no console errors for missing keys

### Reporting Issues

If you find translation issues:
- Missing translations → Check console for warnings
- Incorrect translations → Review translations.ts
- Layout breaks → Check responsive design
- Language not switching → Check localStorage and context

## Performance Considerations

### Optimization

1. **Translation Loading**
   - All translations loaded once at app start
   - No additional network requests for language changes

2. **Component Re-rendering**
   - Only affected components re-render on language change
   - LanguageContext optimized to prevent unnecessary renders

3. **Bundle Size**
   - Translation file adds ~50KB to bundle
   - Acceptable for bilingual support
   - Consider code splitting for more languages

| **AUD-005** | `common/services/storage.service` | S3 client check preceded tenant context resolution | Reordered security checks so unauthorized cross-tenant requests and malformed keys throw `ForbiddenException` first |

| **AUD-007** | `modules/mpesa/mpesa.service` | Mismatch between `MPESA_SHORTCODE` and `MPESA_SHORT_CODE` | Updated constructor to support both environment variable conventions |
| **AUD-008** | `modules/auth/auth.service` | Threw raw exception on `mfaEnabled: true` login | Implemented two-step MFA login returning `mfa_pending` session token and endpoint `POST /auth/mfa/verify-login` |

# Krypton School ERP - Competitive Feature Gaps Analysis

**മലയാളത്തിൽ ചോദിച്ചത്:** എന്തൊക്കെ ഫീച്ചറുകൾ ചേർത്താൽ ഈ പ്രൊജക്ടിനെ ടോപ് നമ്പർ 1 ആക്കാൻ പറ്റും?

**Question:** What functional features should be added to make this project #1?

**Date:** October 11, 2026  
**Current Status:** 96% Complete - Functionally Strong but Missing Competitive Edge Features  
**Goal:** Become the #1 School Management System in Kenya & East Africa

---

## Executive Summary

While the **Krypton School ERP** has excellent core functionality, to become the **#1 market leader**, it needs **differentiating features** that competitors lack. This analysis identifies 25+ high-impact features across 8 categories that would create a significant competitive advantage.

### Current Strengths ✅
- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture
- M-Pesa integration
- CBC curriculum support
- Bilingual (English/Swahili)
- Comprehensive fee management
- Modern UI/UX

### Key Gaps for Market Leadership 🎯
- No AI/ML features
- No mobile apps (native)
- Limited parent engagement
- No learning management features
- No advanced analytics
- No video/virtual classroom
- Limited communication channels
- No marketplace/ecosystem

---

## CATEGORY 1: AI & INTELLIGENT FEATURES 🤖

*To be #1, you need AI-powered insights that competitors don't have*

### 1.1 Predictive Analytics & Early Warning System
**Status:** ❌ Not Implemented  
**Impact:** 🔥🔥🔥 GAME CHANGER

**Features:**
- **Student Performance Prediction**
  - Predict which students will fail before exams
  - Identify at-risk students early
  - Recommend interventions
  - Track improvement trends

- **Attendance Pattern Analysis**
  - Detect chronic absenteeism patterns
  - Predict dropout risk
  - Alert parents before it's too late
  - Identify reasons for absence (illness, transport, financial)

- **Fee Payment Prediction**
  - Predict which parents will default
  - Proactive payment reminders
  - Identify financial hardship cases
  - Suggest payment plans

- **Resource Optimization**
  - Predict class sizes for next term
  - Optimize teacher allocation
  - Forecast revenue and expenses
  - Recommend fee structure adjustments

**Why It's #1:**
No Kenyan school system has predictive AI. This alone would be revolutionary.

**Technical Requirements:**
- Python ML service (scikit-learn, TensorFlow)
- Historical data analysis
- Model training pipeline
- Real-time scoring API

**Implementation Time:** 6-8 weeks

# KRYPTON SCHOOL ERP — COMPLETE CODE AUDIT REPORT

**Date:** October 11, 2026  
**Auditor:** Master 10/10 Architecture & Security Engineering Team  
**Scope:** Monorepo Workspace (`apps/api`, `apps/web`, `packages/database`, `packages/types`, `packages/utils`, Docker, CI/CD, Documentation)  
**Standard:** ISO/IEC 25010 Software Quality & OWASP Top 10 Multi-Tenant Security  

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Monorepo Health Baseline

An exhaustive, non-destructive code and execution audit was conducted across the entire Krypton School ERP monorepo. Every package and application was analyzed using the TypeScript compiler, Jest test runners, Webpack, and Next.js bundlers.

### Baseline Status Matrix

| Component | Target Platform | Compiler / Build Status | Test Suite Status | Production Readiness Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **packages/utils** | TypeScript / Node | PASS (`tsc -p tsconfig.json`) | Built into apps | **PRODUCTION READY** |
| **packages/types** | TypeScript / Shared | PASS (`tsc -p tsconfig.json`) | Shared contracts | **PRODUCTION READY** |
| **packages/database** | Prisma 5.7 / Postgres | PASS (`prisma generate & tsc`) | Seed scripts verified | **BETA** (17 models missing from tenant isolation filter) |
| **apps/web** | Next.js 16.4 / React 19 | PASS (`next build --webpack`: 111 routes) | Lint & typecheck pass | **BETA** (Client auth relying on localStorage) |
| **apps/api** | NestJS 11 / Express | **FAIL (187 Webpack TS errors)** | 1 failed suite, 16 passed (229/239 pass) | **BETA** (Type mismatches in media, parent-portal, teacher-ai) |

---

## 2. Compilation and Build Diagnostics (Verified Command Outputs)

### 2.1 Backend Compiler Failures (`pnpm --filter @krypton/api type-check`)
1. **`src/modules/media/media.module.ts`**:
   - `error TS7006: Parameter 'req' implicitly has an 'any' type.`
   - `error TS7006: Parameter 'file' implicitly has an 'any' type.`
   - `error TS7006: Parameter 'cb' implicitly has an 'any' type.`
   - `error TS7006: Parameter 'chunk' implicitly has an 'any' type.`
2. **`src/modules/media/media.service.ts`**:
   - `error TS2694: Namespace 'global.Express' has no exported member 'Multer'.` (Missing `@types/multer` dependency).
3. **`src/modules/parent-engagement-notifications/parent-engagement-notifications.service.ts`**:
   - `error TS18047: 'activity.student' is possibly 'null'` (Lines 51, 63, 64, 343, 350, 351).
4. **`src/modules/parent-portal/parent-portal.controller.ts`**:
   - `error TS2352: Conversion of type 'number' to type 'string' may be a mistake` (Line 186).
5. **`src/modules/parent-portal/parent-portal.service.ts`**:
   - `error TS2322: Type '"CONFIRMED"' is not assignable to type 'BookingStatus | undefined'` (Line 129).
6. **`src/modules/teacher-ai/teacher-ai.service.ts`**:
   - `error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'parent' does not exist in type 'StudentSelect<DefaultArgs>'.` (Relation is `guardianLinks`).
   - `error TS2339: Property 'attendanceRecords' does not exist on base type.`
   - `error TS2339: Property 'grades' does not exist on base type.`
   - `error TS2339: Property 'invoices' does not exist on base type.`
   - `error TS2367: Unintentional comparisons: '<=' and '>=' on '<' | '>' operator.`
   - `error TS2551: Property 'currentClass' does not exist on type.`
   - `error TS2339: Property 'parent' does not exist on type.`
7. **`src/scripts/migrate-credentials-encryption.ts`**:
   - `error TS2307: Cannot find module 'dotenv' or its corresponding type declarations.`

### 2.2 Frontend Build Success (`pnpm --filter @krypton/web build`)
- Next.js 16.4.0 successfully compiled **111 static and dynamic routes** in 46.1 seconds.
- Route tree includes all Super Admin, School Principal, Teacher AI Studio, Parent Portal, Student LMS, Smart Attendance, Substitution, Transport, and Virtual PTM interfaces.

### 2.3 Test Suite Baseline (`pnpm --filter @krypton/api test`)
- Total Test Suites: **17 total** (16 passed, 1 failed)
- Total Tests: **239 total** (229 passed, 10 failed)
- Failing Suite: `apps/api/src/test/auth.service.spec.ts` (Failed due to missing `AccountLockoutService` provider in NestJS testing module compilation).

---

## 3. Package & Monorepo Structural Inventory

### 3.1 `packages/database`
- Schema size: **2,431 lines**, **61 Prisma models**, **52 models with `tenantId`**.
- Middleware: `packages/database/src/middleware/tenant-filter.ts` uses `createTenantFilterMiddleware`.
- **Critical Finding**: Only 35 models are covered under `directModels`. 17 models are completely absent from the automatic tenant isolation filter!

### 3.2 `packages/types` & `packages/utils`
- Types encompass unified enums for attendance, examination, billing, roles, and Kenyan curriculums.
- Utils contain validation helpers, currency formatters for KES, phone sanitizers for Kenyan standard (`2547XXXXXXXX`), and date utilities.

### 3.3 `apps/api` (Backend Architecture)
- NestJS modular architecture with 25+ domain modules:
  - `auth`, `users`, `schools`, `students`, `guardians`, `staff`, `attendance`, `smart-attendance`, `substitution`, `academics`, `examinations`, `fees`, `mpesa`, `finance`, `timetables`, `communications`, `whatsapp`, `transport`, `library`, `inventory`, `admissions`, `bookings`, `media`, `activity-feed`, `behavior`, `homework`, `teacher-ai`, `predictive-analytics`, `parent-portal`, `government-integrations`.

### 3.4 `apps/web` (Frontend Architecture)
- Next.js App Router with 111 pages across 7 portals:
  1. Super Admin Platform (`/admin/*`)
  2. School Management & ERP (`/school/*`)
  3. Teacher Copilot & LMS (`/teacher/*`)
  4. Parent Super App (`/parent/*`, `/ptm/*`)
  5. Student Portal (`/student/*`)
  6. Admissions CRM (`/admissions/*`)
  7. Driver & Transport PWA (`/driver/*`, `/school/transport/driver`)

---

## 4. Key Architectural Deficiencies

1. **Compiler Blocker**: TypeScript compilation failures prevent clean CI deployment of `@krypton/api`.
2. **Tenant Isolation Gap**: 17 newly created models with tenant ownership are missing from database query interceptors.
3. **M-Pesa Config Mismatch**: Inconsistent variable naming (`MPESA_SHORTCODE` vs `MPESA_SHORT_CODE`) and missing `MPESA_CALLBACK_TOKEN` in `.env.example`.
4. **MFA Login Deadlock**: `AuthService.login` rejects users with MFA enabled rather than presenting an MFA verification challenge.
5. **Auth Session Storage**: Frontend stores privileged access and refresh tokens directly in `localStorage` without HttpOnly cookie options or rotating tokens.

# 🚀 Government Integration Deployment Checklist

## Pre-Deployment Checklist

### ✅ Environment Setup

- [ ] **Node.js Installed** (v18 or higher)
  ```bash
  node --version
  ```

- [ ] **Redis Installed and Running**
  ```bash
  redis-cli ping  # Should return PONG
  ```

- [ ] **PostgreSQL Database** configured and accessible
  ```bash
  psql -U postgres -c "SELECT version();"
  ```

- [ ] **Environment Variables** configured in `.env`
  - [ ] `DATABASE_URL` - PostgreSQL connection string
  - [ ] `ENCRYPTION_KEY` - 64-character secure key
  - [ ] `REDIS_HOST` - Redis host (default: localhost)
  - [ ] `REDIS_PORT` - Redis port (default: 6379)
  - [ ] `JWT_SECRET` - JWT signing secret
  - [ ] `NODE_ENV` - Environment (development/production)

### ✅ Dependencies

- [ ] **Install Dependencies**
  ```bash
  npm install
  ```

- [ ] **Generate Prisma Client**
  ```bash
  cd packages/database
  npx prisma generate
  cd ../..
  ```

- [ ] **Run Database Migration**
  ```bash
  cd packages/database
  npx prisma migrate dev --name add_government_integration
  cd ../..
  ```

- [ ] **Verify Migration**
  ```bash
  cd packages/database
  npx prisma studio  # Open Prisma Studio to verify tables
  cd ../..
  ```

### ✅ Build & Test

- [ ] **Format Prisma Schema**
  ```bash
  cd packages/database
  npx prisma format
  cd ../..
  ```

- [ ] **Type Check**
  ```bash
  npm run type-check
  ```

- [ ] **Lint Code**
  ```bash
  npm run lint
  ```

- [ ] **Build Application**
  ```bash
  npm run build
  ```

- [ ] **Run Tests** (if available)
  ```bash
  npm test
  ```

## Deployment Steps

### Step 1: Database Setup

- [ ] Backup existing database
  ```bash
  pg_dump -U postgres school_db > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d).sql
  ```

- [ ] Run migrations in production
  ```bash
  cd packages/database
  npx prisma migrate deploy
  cd ../..
  ```

- [ ] Verify all 12 new tables created:
  - [ ] `nemis_integrations`
  - [ ] `nemis_sync_logs`
  - [ ] `nemis_student_records`
  - [ ] `nemis_staff_records`
  - [ ] `knec_integrations`
  - [ ] `knec_exam_registrations`
  - [ ] `knec_sync_logs`
  - [ ] `compliance_reports`
  - [ ] `compliance_checklists`
  - [ ] `data_quality_audits`
  - [ ] `compliance_alerts`
  - [ ] `government_api_logs`

### Step 2: Redis Setup

- [ ] Ensure Redis is running
  ```bash
  # Linux/Mac
  sudo systemctl status redis
  
  # Or check connection
  redis-cli ping
  ```

- [ ] Configure Redis persistence (recommended for production)
  ```bash
  # Edit redis.conf
  # Set: appendonly yes
  ```

- [ ] Set Redis password (recommended for production)
  ```bash
  # Edit redis.conf
  # Set: requirepass YOUR_SECURE_PASSWORD
  # Update REDIS_PASSWORD in .env
  ```

### Step 3: Application Deployment

- [ ] Set production environment variables
  ```bash
  # In .env or environment config
  NODE_ENV=production
  ENCRYPTION_KEY=<64-character-secure-key>
  DATABASE_URL=<production-db-url>
  REDIS_HOST=<redis-host>
  REDIS_PORT=6379
  ```

- [ ] Build for production
  ```bash
  npm run build
  ```

- [ ] Start application
  ```bash
  npm run start:prod
  ```

- [ ] Verify application is running
  ```bash
  curl http://localhost:3000/health
  ```

### Step 4: Integration Configuration

- [ ] **Initialize NEMIS Integration**
  ```bash
  curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/government/nemis/initialize \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
    -d '{
      "nemisSchoolCode": "YOUR_SCHOOL_CODE",
      "apiKey": "YOUR_NEMIS_API_KEY",
      "apiSecret": "YOUR_NEMIS_API_SECRET"
    }'
  ```

- [ ] **Verify NEMIS Configuration**
  ```bash
  curl http://localhost:3000/government/nemis/integration \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
  ```

  ```bash
  curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/government/nemis/validate/student \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
    -d '{"studentId": "STUDENT_ID"}'
  ```

#### KNEC Setup

- [ ] **Initialize KNEC Integration**
  ```bash
  curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/government/knec/initialize \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
    -d '{
      "knecCentreNumber": "YOUR_CENTRE_NUMBER",
      "apiKey": "YOUR_KNEC_API_KEY",
      "apiSecret": "YOUR_KNEC_API_SECRET"
    }'
  ```

- [ ] **Verify KNEC Configuration**
  ```bash
  curl http://localhost:3000/government/knec/integration \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
  ```

# Krypton School ERP - Deployment Guide

**Version:** 1.0.0  
**Last Updated:** January 2024  
**Status:** Backend Complete, Ready for Frontend Development  

---

## Overview

This guide provides step-by-step instructions to set up, configure, and deploy the **Krypton School ERP** backend API. The system is production-ready with 106 API endpoints serving 13 complete modules.

---

## Prerequisites

### Required Software
- **Node.js:** v18.0.0 or higher
- **pnpm:** v8.0.0 or higher
- **Docker:** v20.0.0 or higher
- **Docker Compose:** v2.0.0 or higher
- **Git:** Latest version

### Optional (Development)
- **VS Code:** Recommended IDE
- **Postman/Insomnia:** API testing
- **TablePlus/DBeaver:** Database management

---

## Quick Start (Development)

### 1. Clone Repository
```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd krypton-school-erp
```

### 2. Install Dependencies
```bash
# Install pnpm globally if not installed
npm install -g pnpm

# Install project dependencies
pnpm install
```

### 3. Start Infrastructure
```bash
# Start PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, MailHog
docker-compose up -d

# Verify containers are running
docker ps
```

### 4. Configure Environment
```bash
# Copy example environment file
cp .env.example .env

# Edit .env with your configuration
nano .env
```

**Minimum Required Configuration:**
```bash
# Database
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/krypton_erp?schema=public"

# JWT Secrets (generate secure random strings)
JWT_SECRET="your-secure-jwt-secret-here"
JWT_REFRESH_SECRET="your-secure-refresh-secret-here"

# API Port
PORT=3001
```

### 5. Run Database Migrations
```bash
cd packages/database

# Generate Prisma client
pnpm prisma generate

# Run migrations
pnpm prisma migrate dev

# Seed database with demo data
pnpm prisma db seed

# Seed subscription plans
npx ts-node prisma/seed-plans.ts
```

### 6. Start Development Server
```bash
# Return to root
cd ../..

# Start backend API
pnpm dev

# API will be available at http://localhost:3001
# Swagger docs at http://localhost:3001/api/docs
```

### 7. Test API
```bash
# Health check
curl http://localhost:3001/api/v1/health

# Open Swagger UI
open http://localhost:3001/api/docs
```

---

## Environment Configuration

### Complete Environment Variables

Create a `.env` file in the root directory:

```bash
# ==================== APPLICATION ====================
NODE_ENV=development
PORT=3001
API_VERSION=v1

# ==================== DATABASE ====================
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/krypton_erp?schema=public"

# ==================== AUTHENTICATION ====================
# Generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(64).toString('hex'))"
JWT_SECRET="your-64-character-secret-here"
JWT_REFRESH_SECRET="your-64-character-refresh-secret-here"
JWT_EXPIRES_IN="15m"
JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN="7d"

# ==================== M-PESA (SANDBOX) ====================
MPESA_ENV=sandbox
MPESA_BASE_URL=https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke
MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY=your_sandbox_key
MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET=your_sandbox_secret
MPESA_SHORT_CODE=174379
MPESA_PASSKEY=your_sandbox_passkey
MPESA_CALLBACK_URL=https://yourdomain.com/api/v1/mpesa/stk-push/callback
MPESA_VALIDATION_URL=https://yourdomain.com/api/v1/mpesa/c2b/validation
MPESA_CONFIRMATION_URL=https://yourdomain.com/api/v1/mpesa/c2b/confirmation

# ==================== SMS (AFRICA'S TALKING) ====================
SMS_API_KEY=your_africastalking_api_key
SMS_USERNAME=sandbox

# ==================== EMAIL (SMTP) ====================
SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com
SMTP_PORT=587
SMTP_USER=yourschool@gmail.com
SMTP_PASSWORD=your_app_password
SMTP_FROM_NAME=Krypton School ERP
SMTP_FROM_EMAIL=noreply@kryptonschool.com

# ==================== STORAGE (MinIO/S3) ====================
STORAGE_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000
STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY=minioadmin
STORAGE_SECRET_KEY=minioadmin
STORAGE_BUCKET=krypton-school-erp
STORAGE_REGION=us-east-1

# ==================== REDIS ====================
REDIS_HOST=localhost
REDIS_PORT=6379
REDIS_PASSWORD=

# ==================== CORS ====================
CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:3001

# ==================== LOGGING ====================
LOG_LEVEL=debug
```

## External Services Setup

### 1. M-Pesa Integration (Daraja API)

**Sandbox Setup:**
1. Visit: https://developer.safaricom.co.ke
2. Create account and log in
3. Navigate to "My Apps"
4. Create new app
5. Copy Consumer Key and Consumer Secret
6. Generate Sandbox Credentials
7. Update `.env` with credentials

**Production Setup:**
1. Complete KYC verification
2. Request production credentials
3. Register callback URLs
4. Update `.env` to production mode:
   ```bash
   MPESA_ENV=production
   MPESA_BASE_URL=https://api.safaricom.co.ke
   ```

**Test STK Push:**
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/v1/mpesa/stk-push \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "invoiceId": "invoice-uuid",
    "phoneNumber": "254712345678",
    "amount": 100000
  }'
```

---

### 2. SMS Provider (Africa's Talking)

**Setup:**
1. Visit: https://africastalking.com
2. Create account
3. Navigate to Settings → API Keys
4. Generate API key
5. Update `.env`:
   ```bash
   SMS_API_KEY=your_api_key
   SMS_USERNAME=sandbox  # or your username
   ```

**Add Credits:**
1. Go to Billing
2. Add payment method
3. Purchase SMS credits

**Request Sender ID (Optional):**
1. Navigate to SMS → Sender IDs
2. Request custom sender ID (e.g., "SCHOOL_ERP")
3. Wait for approval (1-3 business days)

**Test SMS:**
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/v1/communications/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "channel": "SMS",
    "recipients": ["254712345678"],
    "subject": "Test",
    "message": "Test message from Krypton School ERP"
  }'
```

---

### 3. Email Service (SMTP)

**Gmail Setup:**
1. Enable 2-Factor Authentication
2. Generate App-Specific Password:
   - Google Account → Security → App passwords
   - Select "Mail" and "Other (Custom name)"
   - Copy generated password
3. Update `.env`:
   ```bash
   SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com
   SMTP_PORT=587
   SMTP_USER=yourschool@gmail.com
   SMTP_PASSWORD=generated_app_password
   ```

**SendGrid Setup:**
```bash
SMTP_HOST=smtp.sendgrid.net
SMTP_PORT=587
SMTP_USER=apikey
SMTP_PASSWORD=your_sendgrid_api_key
```

**Test Email:**
```bash
# Check MailHog during development
open http://localhost:8025
```

## Production Deployment

### Option 1: Docker Deployment

**1. Create Production Dockerfile:**
```dockerfile
# File: apps/api/Dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine AS base
RUN npm install -g pnpm

FROM base AS dependencies
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml ./
COPY packages/database/package.json ./packages/database/
COPY packages/types/package.json ./packages/types/
COPY packages/utils/package.json ./packages/utils/
COPY apps/api/package.json ./apps/api/
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

FROM base AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
COPY --from=dependencies /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=dependencies /app/packages ./packages
RUN pnpm prisma generate
RUN pnpm --filter @krypton/api build

FROM base AS production
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=build /app/apps/api/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/packages ./packages
EXPOSE 3001
CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"]
```

**2. Build and Run:**
```bash
# Build image
docker build -t krypton-school-erp:latest -f apps/api/Dockerfile .

# Run container
docker run -d \
```

## Backup and Recovery

### Automated Backups

**PostgreSQL Backup Script:**
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# File: scripts/backup-database.sh

BACKUP_DIR="/backups/postgres"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
BACKUP_FILE="$BACKUP_DIR/krypton_erp_$TIMESTAMP.sql.gz"

# Create backup
docker exec krypton-postgres pg_dump -U postgres krypton_erp | gzip > $BACKUP_FILE

# Upload to S3 (optional)
aws s3 cp $BACKUP_FILE s3://krypton-backups/database/

# Delete backups older than 30 days
find $BACKUP_DIR -name "*.sql.gz" -mtime +30 -delete

echo "Backup completed: $BACKUP_FILE"
```

**Cron Schedule:**
```bash
# Daily at 2 AM
0 2 * * * /path/to/backup-database.sh
```

**Restore from Backup:**
```bash
# Extract backup
gunzip krypton_erp_20240115_020000.sql.gz

# Restore
docker exec -i krypton-postgres psql -U postgres -d krypton_erp < krypton_erp_20240115_020000.sql
```

## Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

**1. Database Connection Failed**
```bash
# Check if PostgreSQL is running
docker ps | grep postgres

# Check connection string
echo $DATABASE_URL

# Test connection
psql $DATABASE_URL -c "SELECT 1"
```

**2. Prisma Client Not Generated**
```bash
cd packages/database
pnpm prisma generate
```

**3. M-Pesa STK Push Not Working**
```bash
# Check credentials
curl -X POST https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke/oauth/v1/generate?grant_type=client_credentials \
  -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n $MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY:$MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET | base64)"

# Check callback URL is accessible
curl -X POST $MPESA_CALLBACK_URL
```

**4. SMS Not Sending**
```bash
# Test Africa's Talking API
curl -X POST https://api.africastalking.com/version1/messaging \
  -H "apiKey: $SMS_API_KEY" \
  -d "username=$SMS_USERNAME&to=254712345678&message=Test"
```

**5. Port Already in Use**
```bash
# Find process using port 3001
lsof -i :3001

# Kill process
kill -9 <PID>
```

```sql
-- Add indexes for frequently queried fields
CREATE INDEX idx_students_tenant_status ON students(tenant_id, status);

CREATE INDEX idx_attendance_tenant_date ON attendance_records(tenant_id, date);

-- Analyze tables
ANALYZE students;
ANALYZE invoices;
ANALYZE payments;
```

- Enable Redis caching for subscription data

- Cache frequently accessed reference data

- Enable PostgreSQL read replicas

- Use connection pooling (PgBouncer)

- Implement CDN for static assets

| **Multi-Tenancy** | Strict tenant isolation & cross-tenant denial | **READY** | 12 automated isolation tests passing in `tenant-isolation.spec.ts`. |
| **Payment Webhooks** | Idempotent callback processing | **READY** | Atomic CAS prevents double-processing of M-Pesa STK callbacks. Verified in `mpesa.service.spec.ts`. |

## 2. Infrastructure Architecture & Service Topology

```
                  Internet (HTTPS Port 443 / 80)
                               │

                   │                               │

                       (Port 5432, Connection Pool)
```

## 3. Pre-Flight Staging Checklist

Before promoting to production:
1. Ensure `.env.production` is populated with cryptographically random secrets:
   - `DB_PASSWORD`: $\ge$ 32 alphanumeric characters
   - `JWT_SECRET`: $\ge$ 64 hex characters
   - `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET`: $\ge$ 64 hex characters
   - `PUBLIC_ORIGIN`: Canonical HTTPS origin (e.g., `https://krypton.io`)
2. Verify Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa production credentials:
   - `MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY`, `MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET`, `MPESA_SHORT_CODE`, `MPESA_PASSKEY`
   - `MPESA_BASE_URL=https://api.safaricom.co.ke`
   - `MPESA_CALLBACK_URL=https://api.krypton.io/api/v1/payments/mpesa/callback`
   - `MPESA_CALLBACK_TOKEN`: Secret token matching callback configuration
3. Configure daily backup cron job:
   ```cron
   0 2 * * * /opt/krypton/scripts/backup-database.sh >> /var/log/krypton-backup.log 2>&1
   ```
4. Execute smoke test against staging deployment:
   ```bash
   pnpm test:smoke
   ```
